comments: We had a great stay at Fiona's place. The house is beautiful and welcoming, and big enough for six of us. The bus stop is very close and the hood interesting. We loved the view of Table mountain. Fiona was very kind and helpful before and during our stay, helping with directions and useful information. We'd love to come stay again!
We had an amazing week at Fiona's place, the house was stunning and we all felt very much at home there. Fiona was very helpful and welcoming!
Our group of 6 person had a great time in this wonderful house. Fiona is a great hostess, good neighbors nearby.  Everything is provided in the house, we liked everything very much

Doreen and her family of staff were very accommodating and helped us enjoy her beautiful space. The house is stunning and conveniently located for getting to know Cape Town. We immediately became part of the family. I will be returning to stay again in the near future.
After a long ride on the motorbike Doreen welcomed us with some drinks and food. The place itself is just beautiful and perfectly located in CPT on Kloof Street. All in All a just AWEsome time! :)

We loved our time at the Garden Cottage - its a beautifully designed space in a great location - we spent a lot of money at the fabulous Melissas (deli/cafe) which is just minutes away!
Doreen,Robert and the team were so helpful suppling lots of baby stuff and generally making our stay as comfortable and easy as possible.
Great also to have the use of the pool and beautiful garden as well as having our own small private outside space.
We will definitely return.

ok, where should i start? the place itself is just so beautiful and very beautifully decorated with love to the detail. doreen and her family are so friendly, warm and loving. everything felt just so comfortable and we felt so welcome. robert and his wife are also very friendly and helping. the whole vibe of the place is extraordinary and it is by far our favorite stay in cape town! really the nicest, most lovely hosts! we already miss it so much and when we come back to cape town this is where we would always want to stay! on a side note: we got our three year old daughter a little giraffe cuddly toy at a market in cape town and she named it robert. that says it all ;)

Fantastic hospitality, in a close-to-everything-spot in CT. We were traveling with a one year old, and were a bit concerned about not having enough space for her to play - but Doreen's place combines privacy with social areas, calm with the busy hot-spot-life of a great area in CT. Would recommend it without a doubt.
Thoroughly enjoyed my stay again! They made me feel like part of the family. Highly recommended for everyone.

Katrine and her family were wonderful hosts for my stay in Cape Town. The entire family was warm, helpful and kind.
The room itself was great, sunny, cool and comfortable. The house is beautiful and situated in a great quiet area with easy access to public transportation to get around the area, including getting back and forth from UCT.
Staying in this home was a special opportunity and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Cape Town!

It was my first experience using Airbnb. I couldn't have asked for a better host. Lovely neighbourhood, lovely house, lovely room, lovely people. Would definitely recommend this accommodation to anyone.

A great experience, a beautiful living room with Katrine and her family are very nice people, helpful. Their home and beautiful Victorian type we all amenities in the house, otherwise the downtown Claremont is 10 minutes walk. There are any, I am athletic, I could exercise in a comprehensive sports complex. I really enjoyed myself. Otherwise the station is 8 minutes walk is very convenient. You can eat in the evening Katrine, and for my part I ate there every night and I really enjoyed myself. I say more, I loved I was very attached to the family of Katrine, I shared a great time. They déjà.Même I miss the maid is super nice. Voila. I strongly recommend you to Katrine. This is a real favorite.

Katrine and her parents are the best hosts you could wish for when travelling to a foreign country. Such a lovely family, everybody made me feel very welcome in their home, so that it also felt like my home for this time. Katrine's parents, Andries and Gaby, took me to markets, to hike with them and to a lot more places and were never short with advice and help. I was also invited to join them at family breakfasts or dinners.
The house and garden is lovely and charming as well. At the time I was there, Andries was doing a lot of renovations, so that it'll be even prettier by now. Three adorable cats are also part of the family, so you should definitely be a cat's person to enjoy your stay even more :-).
I would definitely recommend this place to anybody not only looking for a place to stay but really live in.

Gaby and Andries are extremely friendly and warm people. If you are looking for an affordable, nicely furnitured room with niiiiice blankets and a feeling of being part of the family - this is the place to be! I can highly recommend this air bnb room/house/family. There is nothing I can complain about after my 2 weeks stay. :)))

Andries and Gabby are wonderful hosts. Their house is gorgeous, the garden is lovely, and the general vibe of the neighbourhood is peaceful and safe.  The WiFi is good, and as a bonus they seem to get less loadshedding than others parts of the city.

Andries and Gaby are wonderful hosts, absolutely wonderful. Their home is clean, noise free, fresh (natural light and clean air coming from all directions), happy, and the garden is delightful. Pablo the cat is also kind, I felt right at home! I also enjoyed taking walks around their neighbourhood.

Andries‘ and Gaby‘s home is a gorgeous place. Just exactly what I was looking for. I had to spent some hours on the laptop, but that felt easy, in such a beautiful surrounding . They are both immensely kind human beings and made me feel like home within few hours, showing me around and integrating me in their life at home.
We stayed for just one night but in hindsight should have definitely stayed longer. The apartment is situated  in a beautiful, quiet location with amazing views of the harbour.

Comfortable stay for our family with two kids. The view is uncredible and theres a massive balcony to enjoy it from. Location is right on top of the hill overlooking the harbour. Very peaceful and quiet day and night. Will come again!

We had a wonderful stay in Claire's apartment. She made us feel very welcome, with great contact before we arrived and a welcome drink waiting for us!
Her apartment is even more beautiful in person than in the pictures and was perfect for our stay in Cape Town. The information folder was also brilliant- packed with loads of useful information and great tips for restaurants and bars.
Next time we are back in Cape Town (I'm not sure when that will be but I hope soon), I would love to stay here again.
Thank you so much Claire for letting us stay in your gorgeous apartment and for all your help with our stay :)

The Apartment was basically brand new and just as advertised. The service provided by Claire was extremely professional....I arrived late so all arrangements had been made with security who were well organised upon my arrival . Very central location....I would definitely stay again.

We have had many great AirBnB experiences, but this one was by far our favorite. The apartment is so beautiful, modern and very clean. The location and views could not be beat, and the guidebooks were so helpful. We stayed here to start our honeymoon and Claire made us feel so welcome with a complimentary bottle of bubbly to start our celebration! We were also very pleased with her quick reservation acceptance and availability to answer questions at all times. This was a remarkable experience, and I would suggest this listing to anyone visiting Cape Town!

Great location and views, comfy accommodations, easy check in and Claire left a ton of information about Cape Town and the apartment in a binder, which was really useful. We appreciated her fast response time to any questions and would recommend anyone to stay in her place. Thanks Claire!

This is what Airbnb is all about! Claire's loft is absolute perfection. A fabulous location, incredible amenities, and super responsive host. The loft had been freshly cleaned when we arrived and had everything we could want and more. It is conveniently located near most of the major attractions and free, secure parking is a big plus. The security guys at the front desk were very friendly and helpful. We'd absolutely recommend this loft to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Cape Town. Thank you, Claire!

The host wasn't there when we arrived but had made all the arrangements to ensure we got access. The apartment is clean and safe - it's on a main road which is quite busy during the day - but the double glazing means sleep isn't disturbed . Great to sit on the balcony looking at the colours changing on the Table Mountain and watch the buzz of the city
The apartment is in a great part of CT - loads of bars/cafes and restaurants within easy and safe walking distance.
Info book available and phone left for making local calls.

Claire is an amazing host and her flat is perfect for a Cape Town visit!  We were lucky to meet her when we arrived and she was very sweet giving us all kinds of advice on Cape Town.  The flat is super comfortable in a very convenient location to all the CT highlights.  Small details were great such as a drawer full of power converters and adapters which were awesome for my wife's hair gadgets!  Thanks very much and we hope to come back soon!  From Seattle, Simon and Kristen.
Claire's place was better than a hotel. Should we come back to Cape Town we will definitely stay here again!

Claire was helpful and easy to reach. Accessing the apartment was comfortable, security made the apartment safe. The apartment has abundant space for two with a beautiful view of table mountain from the balcony. We stayed three nights due to lack of availability but were happy we had to change as there are more beautiful/comfortable locations in cape town to stay at!
Great apartment with stunning views over table mountain. Centrally located at walking distance to the waterfront and long street. A bit a dodgy neighbourghoud at night but lpts of security around.

Two weeks over Xmas and NYE, and we could not have stayed in a better accommodation. Flat is excellent and offers beautiful views of the mountain and a convenient location close to everything. Claire is a wonderful hostess who is very responsive and available to help answer questions/give recommendations to local must-visits. You can truly feel 'at home' here, sipping a glass of wine on the balcony watching the sun set behind the Lion's Head.

THE place to stay in Cape Town.  Claire's place is both gorgeous, comfortable, and convenient.  There is a beautiful view of Table Mountain (where I then hiked and abseiled).  I stayed two nights and dreaded having to leave.  I booked at the last minute and needed to store luggage - Claire was more than accommodating and on top of that, she provided a bottle of wine.  Thanks Claire!

Great place to stay, apartment was very clean and left with everything for the perfect stay.  Location was good, a short walk from V&A and also not far from HOHO bus stops. Didn't use the pool but looked very clean. View was great exactly as described of Table Mountain.

First time in Cape Town and Africa and couldn't ask for more! The apartment is amazing with fantastic views of table mountain. Claire suggested to use Uber to get around town and it was 100% the right call, especially with all the amazing restaurants and bars.
We have stayed in a few airbnb's and the book that Claire has made for the surrounding areas is second to none!
Thank you for making the end for our honeymoon the best!!!
A + K
Claire's place was very nice with scenic views! We were greeted with a bottle of wine and were able to walk to close by bars,restaurants, etc! Would definitely recommend.

My recent short stay at Claire's place was fantastic and wish I had more time to enjoy.  Although we didn't have a chance to meet during our stay, she ensured that were provided with all the necessary details of her place, the neighborhood and local sites.  I would definitely recommend this place for short and long stays in beautiful Cape Town!

Claire was a great host, she was very prompt in responding to inquiries. The place was very clean and met our expectations. Great view from the balcony. She had great suggestions on what to do and where to go. She also has a great guide book in the apt with awesome suggestions on most of what Capetown has to offer. We used her suggestions and the guidebook quite a bit. We had a great time in Capetown. We plan on going back and would definitely look into staying at Claire's place again.

Great apartment, informative and responsive host, and fantastic location.  There was some construction noise but Claire was very clear and upfront about it prior to accepting me as a guest.  Highly recommended and would stay again if I make it back to Cape Town.

Claire’s place is the best.
I had an amazing time as a solo traveller.
The view in the morning from the apartment is just stunning!
I will be coming back for sure.

Beautiful view of Table Mountain (though also some construction nearby— no noise issue for us). Lovely space, great tips of local restaurants etc. We appreciated having 24 hour desk staff — made us feel safe.
Place has a great view of the Table Mountain.  I love that Claire compiled many nearby F&B recommendations. You can find books to read at the apt as well!

Claire's place is beyond beautiful and has an even more amazing view. We truly felt like we were in our own private luxurious apartment in Cape Town! Not only was the location ideal for anyone wanting to walk through the city/CBD, Claire's recommendations of the area made the trip so seamless! Honestly can't wait to go back soon.
Claire was very accessible, her space, spotless and well appointed. I especially appreciated the 24 hour doorman and being able to check in at a later than previously expected hour. Excellent!!!!
We enjoyed our stay at Claire's place - clean, comfortable and homey. Would definitely stay there again next time I'm in Cape Town.

Great loft space near many restaurants, bars and art galleries. Everything is a quick Uber ride away and the parking spot is great for those returning or leaving to do the Garden Route. Avis and Budget car rentals are conveniently close nearby. Only complaint would be that the shower is on the small size. Otherwise great space and location!
Lovely appartment in a great location. Everything we needed to make our stay in Cape Town perfect.

We enjoyed every aspect of our stay.  Claire’s spot is idealic. Perfectly situated in town, beautiful & thoughtfully decorated with GREAT care & detail to making the stay a very pleasant experience. Claire has taken a lot of time to make sure that her guests have ample opportunity and information to experience the beauty of the City and the Cape. We will definitely be returning as Claire’s place really does feel like a home away from home. And the view is out of this world gorgeous. What a gem.

This is a gorgeous apartment with a view that will make your stay in Cape Town that much more unforgettable! I was very impressed with how easy check in was and the host was very accommodating to late check ins which was a necessity for me!

Stayed at Claire's place for a month while working remotely, and it was absolutely perfect. The Wi-Fi remained connected for the entire period, and the apartment is within walking distance to at least 5 of Cape Town's best coffee spots, and I have to mention that the view from the balcony is breathtaking. The apartment is also equipped with all the necessary amenities for a long-term stay. Claire is a friendly and responsive host, and I can highly recommend this place as a great home away from home.
The place is convenient and close to all popular spots, malls, beach , freeway. The parking bay is very narrow, needs a smaller car.

I enjoyed my stay here! It has a beautiful view of Table Mountain, especially from the balcony. The floor-to-ceiling windows make it a bright space. And for those working while traveling, it has a proper office chair.

Claire's place is lovely! This was my best Airbnb experience so far! The view of Table Mountain is amazing, the place is close to everything so super convenient. I stayed for a month and was able to work remotely - the WiFi is great and there's a good work chair and set up that makes it easy to focus. All the amenities in the loft work really well. I was a solo traveller for the most part of this trip and security was really good.
Claire was super welcoming, responsive and really easy to contact for anything I needed.
Claire is very kind and helpful, and the apartment is well located and has all the amenities for a very nice stay!
I had a great and comfortable stay. The place is located very close to restaurants and amenities. The flat itself is comfortable and has a great view. Check in and out was easy.

I had a great time. The communication was super easy and quick and the place looks exactly like it does on the pictures. The neighborhood is very conveniently located and although it’s a lively neighborhood the apartment is very quiet! Would absolutely recommend to stay there!

Claire was brilliant at communicating and came to our rescue at very short notice after a nearby hotel had lost our booking. The view of table mountain was amazing and Claire's two storey apartmebt was very stylish. Lots of thoughtful amenities including fash wash, coffee capsules for the coffee machine, washing machine tablets, etc. Wifi was also excellent allowing us to work from home. Would highly recommend!
One of the best places I’ve ever stayed at in Cape Town. 10/10 recommend it!

We had an amazing experience at Claire‘s Airbnb. She was a perfect host who took care of us and answered all of our questions immediately! But also the Airbnb was a dream.
There is honestly nothing bad to say about.
If we go to CapeTown again, we will definitely book this Airbnb again.

My wife and I spent a wonderful week at Claire’s apartment. The view of Table Mountain was lovely, the bed was very comfy, the kitchen was well set up for cooking, and the building’s security was good. We would definitely stay here again if we return to Cape Town in the future.

Perfect apartment for any type of stay, business or pleasure. Managed by an excellent host who has clearly gone the extra mile to ensure absolute comfort. Claire was friendly, empathetic and readily available when needed. We are looking forward to coming back!
Glorious bed! Glorious view! Cozy space in Cape Town walking distance from many places. If I need a place to stay in the city again, I will definitely book with Claire.

Nice place to stay! Very convenient and a lot good suggestions for food and other practicalities.
I would recommend staying here!

We had a great time! The view was 10x better than the pictures and the place was nice and clean. I would recommend this place as a staycation.
Only thing I would suggest is having a big enough blanket to cover the king size bed as apposed to having two single blankets as we were a couple.
Otherwise thanks for the great space! Can we live there 😉

This is a lovely location just by the beach and close to everything you need. Fabrizio was an amazing host and communicated perfectly, I got everything I needed, every day cleaning was good and made the apartment very clean all the time. Lovely scenery by the pool, I’ll definitely recommend this place, would love to come back!

This house is WONDERFULL!!!
We stayed there with 2 adults and 1 young kid. We had a very great time there: our son loved feeding the ducks, paddling around and of course swimming.
Jessica is a very lovely person who cared for everything to make our stay as comfortable as possible. Thanks a lot Jessica.
We highly recommend it! The best place to stay!

We are a South Korean family(a couple with a son and a daughter) living in Pretoria. We spent two nights of holidays in the guest house of Jason & Jessica Stainer. The house was a perfect place for my family. Kitchen is perfectly equipped and comfortable for self catering.  Rooms and beds are very clean. Price is very reasonable for this house.  In particular, the kids love this house with the canal and beautiful scenary around.  We appreciate a lot the thoughtfulness and kindness of Jessica.  We spent real happy time in this house.  Thank you so much!!!

Thank you so much for the wonderful home away from home. It really felt like that and we had an awesome stay! There is nothing to complain about! It is just perfect. Of course, I would recommend the cottage. To all future guests: You will definitely have a wonderful time there!

As great as what I excpected, my family from France and I just loved our time there and wish we stayed longer.
Jessica was so accomodating, we really felt home and didnt want to leave... We all said we would be back... I would recommend to anybody!!
Beautiful home, great space, clean, well-equipped - hosts were super friendly and easy going. Would definitely be back :)

We really enjoyed our stay at Cottage-A Home Away. This is a lovely 3 BR house, spacious with everything you need for your holiday.
The hosts gave us a warm welcome and were helpful and always available for any queries. Highly recommended!

Being the house on the lagoon I don't think it is too safe for small children unless they are under strict supervision. Otherwise I  have only to praise about everything. I spent 4 very happy days with my overseas guests.
Jessica and her family was sweet and warm. The appartement is perfect - surroundings even better. I will be back next time I’m travelling to SA

The pictures are a perfect depiction of the beautiful home Jess and Jason have. I only wish I had more time to completely enjoy all of the amenities that were available. But we did get to enjoy the peace and tranquility the house offered. As hosts Jess is an extremely attentive and a wonderful person. Very friendly, easy to communicate with, and very flexible. I look forward to staying with them again if I am lucky enough to ever get a booking again.

Very clean and lovely house equipped with everything you need. The rooms were spacious...the lake view was breathtaking, it's even more beautiful in person than in pictures
Thanks Jessica for a wonderful stay
It’s a beautiful place, clean, quiet and it has got a beautiful view of the mountains. We had a great time with my partner, it was everything we needed😊

Wow!! What a beautiful place this is, when we walked in the view was absolutely breathtaking. The host Jessica was super friendly and kindly assisted me with all my questions from the get go. The house also has everything you need making the stay easy and convenient. Will definitely be back here and will recommend it to anyone who is looking for a relaxing get away.

This was one to remember.
We felt safe and secure during the difficult time we dealing with due to the health crisis.
Check in and check out was as easy as pie and our host did everything possible to accommodate our stay.
Most importantly the home and surroundings was probably more beautiful then anticipated, then again it’s so hard to capture all the beauty in pictures. I tried myself.
Very happy. 10/10

Loved the place, it was hard to leave. Only disappointment was that the waterways were closed so we couldn’t use them, but nothing the host could do about that. Definitely recommend Jessica’s place for short or long stays.

What an amazing stay! A real home away from home. Very clean and stunning views. The paddle boats were a hit and pictures on the dock were a fave. The sunroom is THE best room since we visited in winter - it is constantly warm 😍 and the sunset is gorgeous.
It’s a about 25mins from cape town and the “hot spots” so I would suggest hiring a car for your stay if you are not trying to spend too much on Uber/Bolt. It’s very close to a shopping complex however and take away spots which is convenient and a short 5mins drive to Muizenburg beach that has those famous colourful houses/cottages on the beach which give a great photo opps.
Jessica was a great host, very responsive and assisted when there were issues quickly.
I would 100% recommend ♥️

Wonderful Airbnb, exactly as shown and described, 100% recommend to anyone wanting to stay in this area. Communication with the host was first rate.
A variety of shops just across the road for groceries and alcohol. Beach within a few minutes drive with a number of restaurants.

We had an excellent stay in this home. The host was kind and helpful with personal recommendations. The house was very peaceful. Even with loadshedding, the host supplied battery light bulbs and inverter for the wifi was great! Would stay here again.
Absolutely beautiful home on the water, so peaceful and calming. Would definitely go again with my family:)
2nd time booking. Had a lovely stay. This time with my son that loved the open air.  Definable a gem and worth booking!

Marina Da Gama in itself is a gem - the tranquility, canoeing on the waterways, abundant birdlife etc.
Jessica's house exceeded expectations - very well located, very well equipped, spotlessly clean and very comfortable. I enjoyed the easy and direct access to the water using the really good canoes provided and the surprisingly efficient pedal boat. The fynbos garden is immaculate and attracts beautiful birds. Lovely indoor braai in the lounge that opens up the outside via enormous fold back doors making the whole place very light and airy.
No complaints, only praise for this wonderful location.

Perfet accomodation in Table View!
Fully furnished cottage, very new and super clean.
Everything in the house is perfect, hosts are very attentive.
Stayed there for a month, enjoyed every day.
Great place if you are looking for kitesurfing and a good quality and comfortable studio. Birgit is a really great host.
We had a great stay at Birgit's place. It is well located, spotless and comfortable. Birgit is a very outgoing and organised host, this combination made our stay most pleasant

Absolute legend of a host. Amazing communication. Stunning home that was in the heart of town yet perfectly situated away from any main roads. The pool was beautiful and the array of lighting catered for ever mood. Thanks Chris!

We received a very gracious welcome by Natasha who picked us up from the airport and Chris who met us at the house. With the fridge stocked with basics, a full fruit bowl, and a gorgeous house, we felt immediately at home and jumped into the pool! The location was perfect with nearby conveniences and activities while Uber was always available and quick to pick us up for outings further afield. The best Airbnb property we've chosen yet, previously in Australia, Portugal, Spain, Singapore.

Lovely house in a great location. Beautifully designed and spacious. Everything you might need (including some welcome fruits) was provided! The host is very nice and helpful. We wish we could have stayed longer

Although I travel quite a bit, this was my first time using Airbnb. I thought the required Airbnb verification process was tedious but after meeting Chris, our host, and seeing the house rental, it was all worth it. Chris is a wonderful host. His thoughtfulness is apparent from the start with the airport pick up (by Natasha who is great) and continues throughout the stay. He even provides a cell phone for direct contact during your stay. He was very responsive and really made us feel at home. The house was like an oasis in a busy city with quick Uber/cab pickup and several very good restaurants within walking distance (e.g., NU (health food restaurant with great breakfast), Shego (Turkish) and Gold (traditional African). The home is spacious and the outdoor space in the backyard is beautiful. All in all, the rental is even better in person than in the pictures. I highly recommend renting from Chris and would do it again in a heart beat.

I'd recommend this house to anyone. It perfectly suited our large group (8+ people) and we never felt on top of each  other, as it has great, large indoor and outdoor living areas. We spent most of our time lazing around outside, on the spacious grassed area and the pool.
magnificent house. great place. ample space. wonderful pool. large rooms and great bathrooms. residence with easy access to any part of cape town.

We had a lovely stay at Designer Oasis. The photos are a true representation of the property. The living room area and outside sitting area were very comfortable. The house is spacious and well equipped. The yard and pool are beautiful.
The central location is a short walk to the waterfront and beaches. There are a number of restaurants within walking distance too.
Chris was very helpful and quick to respond to any questions we had. He also put us in contact with someone who we hired for an excellent tour of the area outside the city.

I definitely recommend this house. It is beautifully decorated, modern, functional, spacious and well located (close to the buzz, but in a quiet, secluded street).
Chris is also a great host, giving out great advice on the town and its attractions and how to make the most of your time there. You can tell he has done this several times and is keen to improve even more his great hosting.
We felt right at home at Chris' place.

Chris's house was the perfect balance of feeling at home with a special elegance and easy to do access to all the special features. Chris was fantastic so helpful with all personal and logistics questions. Location was amazing easy to walk to market, shops and restaurants all while being tucked away in a private residence.
Highly recommend; can't wait to go back

We spent 7 nights in Cape Town, Chris's house was one of the main highlights of the trip, the house was beautiful and comfy, the location was really helpful close to all the main attractions of Cape Town.

We have just returned from staying at Chris' house at Wessels Road, Cape Town, and can not recommend it highly enough.
We are a family of 2 adults and 3 children and the house was perfectly located for access into the V&A waterfront, either on foot or by car if needed.
This was our first experience of Airbnb so didn't know what to expect, however Chris was welcoming, friendly and full of recommendations, plus we found his local knowledge invaluable.
If we manage to get back to Cape Town, we would definitely look to stay here again.
This house is more beautiful in person than pictures would suggest.  We had a wonderful time and your house is amazing!!  Great location, wonderful amenities, and personal service!

The house is very well situated around 12 minutes walk from the V&A. There are also restaurants and shops within walking distance. In Winter (late June) we did find the house to be chilly as there is no central air in South Africa. The duvet on the bed was quite thin for the temperature. Not an issue for 10 of the 12 months I'm sure! We all loved Cape Town and want to go back. Unfortunately we only had 3 nights at the house. I would book the house again.

Chris' home is fully equipped with everything you need and is a great base for your to explore Cape Town. We had a large group of 9 friends and the house was the ideal size and set up, with each bedroom having its own en suite bathroom. The living and dining rooms were big enough for our entire group to hang out together and there's a lovely backyard and back deck. It's within walking distance to many restaurants, a grocery store and tourist sites like the V&A Waterfront. Farther sites are easily accessible with Uber. Chris was a wonderful host, giving us with many recommendations and even helping us coordinate a surprise birthday dinner (complete with private chef!) for two in our group who were celebrating birthdays during our trip. He was very communicative and very knowledgeable about area attractions, restaurants and bars. We would not hesitate to stay at the Wessels House again. Thank you, Chris!!
Chris was very helpful and responsive during the booking process.  Sharyn the property manager was also very accommodating during the arrival process.
Well located, and a great house in which to stay for a large family or group. The arrangements for our stay were very well managed by Sharyn, Chris's House manager.

Wessels House is a great choice if you want to be in the heart of Cape Town but feel very safe. We were a party of 5 adults and two children. It's a pleasant 10 - 15 min walk to the V&A Waterfront, where you can catch the Hop on/Hop off bus, get taxis, etc. We were also able to book Uber from the house without any issues (using our own accounts). The facilities are great, and it was super helpful to have the basics such as bread and milk stocked for our arrival. There's a coffee machine, toaster, BBQs, kettle, dishwasher etc. The pool is fenced which is perfect if you have children, and the garden is a really good size. There's a Woolworths food shop 5 mins away which had everything we needed for our stay. Would definitely recommend the place to families and groups.

14 Wessels is a quiet haven in the midst of Cape Town. Despite its position it is very quiet and private, making it a perfect place to stay. The 4 bedrooms are well appointed, each with its own en suite so works well with a large family. And the fresh bread and condiments were a surprise and much appreciated. Finally, all questions were very promptly answered. Thank you.

Would recommend Wessel's House to anyone!
Chris and his team are the epitome of great host and really go the extra mile.
The house has everything you could need and full of information about what you can do in and around Cape Town. Great location to base you Cape holiday from and is in walking distance from great shops and restaurants.
Will definitely be staying here again.

We loved the apartment and the location. It was perfect for our two families.
The space is amazing and great to come back to after a long day sightseeing.
The kids loved the graden and the jungle gym!
The extra heating was highly appreciated and the fireplace made our evenings special.
Chris is a great host, very fast at responding when necessary.
We will certainly come back.
Great spot for people in a bigger group, with everything you need as if you were at home!

A great spot to enjoy Cape Town - spacious accommodation with a lovely garden to relax in after a days exploring. We sat and had Christmas Dinner in the garden - great food cooked in the kitchen with sun and laughter - perfect combination.
About a 10-15 min walk to V&A area but to be honest Uber was available for about £3 so we tended to use that.
Woolworths just around the corner for all food requirements plus a few restaurants/cafes so if you don’t want to go too far then you don’t need to.
One must do tip for breakfast - visit Jason’s Bakery just up from Woolworths- such a great spot for delicious breakfast!
Chris had great tips for us on the site seeing front and was available for any questions

This is the best place ever! It is like coming to a hotel since Chris support special made soap, shampoo and lotion. The house is amazing and we haven’t had any troubles at all and the kids loved it too. It is close to waterfront and a lot of restaurants nearby. Chris was very friendly supporting us when I needed to visit a doctor. Finally the coffee machine which was like going to the coffee shop every morning.

I don't think 5 stars is enough of a rating. I wish Icould give 10. The house was a great location, walkable to shops and restaurants and close to everything. Chris was a wonderful host and had great insights to Cape Town.
The house was perfect for our family of 8. It couldn't have been better!

The house is as pictured. The beds are super comfortable!  We were a party of seven and had plenty of space to spread out.  The terrace is lovely!  Very close to many activities in the downtown area.  The street is on a sharp incline so hold onto your luggage when loading and   Chris couldn’t have been more helpful!  If you don’t feel like walking everywhere Uber is very inexpensive!

WOW stunning place to stay. It was so well situated and easy to get around. The house is very spacious and clean. The beds were super comfortable and bathrooms were a nice size. Everything we needed was there.  Chris thanks so much for making our stay so pleasant.  Chris thanks for being so  accommodating -from early check in to where can I buy a pizza :)

OMG! If you’re in Cape Town South Africa you have to stay at Wessels house. Great location, great place, very nicely decorated, super comfortable, clean with great accessories! But most of all a fantastic host! Don’t miss Russell‘s house in Cape Town!!
Honestly was the best experience. The house is beyond beautiful and the views are breathtaking. I would recommend all friends and family to come and have a vacation at this house.
Great location and wonderful house . Went as a family with a toddler garden , pool and entertainment area just perfect . Really convenient location. Chris was an excellent host

A beautiful house that felt like a home during our stay in Capetown . Outdoor champagne breakfasts , evening Netflix and Apple TV came in handy too.
Chris was very helpful and friendly with our questions . The venue is walking distance from woolworths , Hudson’s bar ,moro gelato and the waterfront . This made our stay even more enjoyable .
I highly suggest this venue for families on vacation in Capetown .
Love the koi pond as well . Well deserving 5 star .
Thank you
Bianca

We spent a week in Wessels House to celebrate an auspicious birthday. Chris went out of his way and beyond all expectations in making this a memorable event .
He was always available, and we can not thank him enough !
The house is secure, very comfortable, has a great flow for entertaining, the patio is fantastic and the pool is perfect !
Everything is an easy Uber ride away!
Thank you Chris for making our week so great

Chris is an extremely good communicator.
Pre our arrival and during our stay he was extremely helpful and responded quickly.
The property is in an excellent location and is in a safe neighbourhood.
It was an ideal base for our family pre and post my daughters wedding.
I would not hesitate to recommend to others.
Beautiful home in a central location in Cape Town. Chris was an amazing host who made us feel welcome and gave several great local recommendations.

Chris was very helpful and informative. The house was clean but there were we few things that need attention, we couldn’t open a window and really craved fresh air in the basement, the room also had a leak from the ceiling. We thought we had secure parking but ended up parking in the street. Location is good and the outside area is lovely but can only be enjoyed until 10pm. Having lights and internet during load shedding is a great bonus.

The house is in a super convenient location and presents really well. An ensuite for each bedroom makes it the perfect executive stay or family holiday. Easily accommodated our party of four and we look forward to returning again soon. Thanks Chris for a great stay.
We had a wonderful time, the house is beautiful and in a great location. Chris was charming and incredibly helpful. Overall a perfect stay and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend to anyone visiting CT.

Chris was helpful from day one.
Even better when we arrived as he called the car hire to stay open so we could drool the car off even though it was closing.
He spent time with us going through the lovely house and sharing local knowledge - which was priceless .
We had the house in winter and can only imagine the outside pool and leisure area in the summer that would be amazing .
Definitely would come back.

I had an excellent trip to South Africa and couldnt have asked for more from the apartment.

Excellent views and very easy to get to, this is a great place to stay.

Highly recommended.

We had a great time staying at this apartment -- the place was very clean and spacious, with wonderful views of the ocean. The weather was unfortunately a little too cold to allow us to use the balcony or the pool much, but we can only imagine how enjoyable our stay would have been had the weather been warm to let us use these amenities. Colleen, the owner, was available to let us in and answer questions and even offered to give us a ride into town if we needed it. The apartment is perhaps a ten minute walk away from restaurants in Sea Point and is perhaps a half hour from the Waterfront. The neighborhood is lovely during the day but exercise some caution at night if walking alone or in a couple -- as is true in most areas of Cape Town. We had a great time staying here.

We enjoyed apartments! All in line just as in the photos. Location of the house was very convenient. Walking 20 minutes you can walk to the promenade with restaurants and shopping centre, from there you can go by bus through the city. From the house near a busy street with restaurants and food store. In fact, a taxi can be reached in 5-10 minutes to any location in the center. The city has excellent uber !! In the house have all you need. The kitchen is well equipped, bathroom. A lovely veranda where the table could eat breakfast and enjoy views of the ocean!
We are well placed in the house!
A really amazing place which felt so much like it was my own little home in Cape Town. A beautiful view on a very quiet street. Very much recommended!

One of the best tripe of my life, even having just 2 days to stay in Cape Town.
Amazing location, great view, very friendly and helpful host.
More than recommended.

Grate location! It’s real garden, perfect place to have a rest and excellent breakfast/dinner.
Colleen is very hospitable person, provided all information for comfortable stay.
We hope to return here.
June’s cottage is exactly as listed. It is safe  and secure with off street parking and has it’s own entrance. Everything we needed was there. We will definitely book here again.

I loved my 6 night stay at June’s. The accommodation was exceptional, and it had beautiful, crisp linen, a comfortable bed and all new appliances.
It was lovely and even better than I expected from the photos. It was a short stroll to Kelvin Grove and other amenities.
June and Brian were very helpful and friendly. I will definitely stay there again.

It was such a wonderful place to be for a week. June is such an excellent host - always available if there is a need. I know Rondebosch very well, having stayed many times over the last few years, and the location is perfect.

We had a wonderful stay at June‘s. The place was nice, kitchen was well equipped, bathroom had all you needed including blowdryer, there were many magazines and a folder she compiled with ideas for activities and most important info. She is a perfect host, made sure she said hi after our arrival and goodbye before we left. Could not have been any better. If you do not want the hustle of the city center you are at a perfect location with a beautiful garden to enjoy. Would definitely recommend it to my friends.

I had the pleasure of staying at June's place for ten days, and it indeed ranks among the best Airbnb accommodations I’ve experienced. The space was immaculate and fully equipped with all the amenities one could desire. Located in the safe and welcoming neighbourhood of Rondebosch, I felt completely comfortable exploring the area independently.
The highlight of my stay was definitely the enchanting courtyard. It offered a serene private spot under a majestic oak tree, complete with a swimming pool and a lovely pond adorned with vibrant water lilies and playful fish.
June was a wonderful hostess, always ready with thoughtful recommendations that made my visit even more enjoyable. I felt genuinely at home throughout my stay. I highly recommend this accommodation to anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable getaway!

June's place was lovely, exactly as it was described. Peaceful, private and close to everything I needed, the unit was beautifully  designed and very spacious. June's comms was always on point and I will definitely be back for my next stay. Thank you.

The photos don’t do it justice! This place is stunning.
The representative insisted we sign a form and provide credit card information, which is outside of Airbnb policy. So after a short discussion he let it go but if you book through Airbnb know it’s not required to provide this kind of information!
The pool was out of order during our stay but the hosts were doing there best to resolve this.
Would recommend this place to anyone!
The house is fantastic, well organized and supports many people with a very good equipment for many people ... clean, high quality ... we will come back again

My family enjoyed our four (4) night stay in comfort.  Merridew is spacious, well appointed, and beautifully furnished.  In particular, I enjoyed the artwork and found each room uniquely themed.  The house is within a 10 minute walk of the beach and local restaurants along along the main waterfront road.   I cannot offer any greater superlatives/ recommendation, other than I would definitely re-book the property should I visit CapeTown in the future.  Merridew offers tremendous value for your money.
Lovely home with lots of space. If the pool had been heated that would have been a bonus , but overall highly recommended

I had the absolute pleasure of staying at Will’s’s incredible Airbnb, and I can’t recommend it highly enough! From start to finish, everything exceeded my expectations. The location was perfect, convenient yet peaceful, with stunning views that made every moment feel like a getaway in paradise. The accommodation itself was immaculate, beautifully decorated, and equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. It truly felt like a home away from home.

Will was also an outstanding host; attentive, friendly, and quick to respond to any questions we had. They went above and beyond to make sure our stay was seamless and enjoyable. If you’re looking for the perfect place to relax and soak in breathtaking scenery, this is it. I’ll be returning and can’t wait for my next visit!
Absolutely lovely place. Great style and well designed. Amazing location and central but also private and quiet.

I had an absolutely wonderful stay in Cape Town! The apartment in Tamboerskloof is a true gem – stylish, cozy, and equipped with everything you could possibly need. The location is quiet and exclusive, yet you’re still close to all the action the city has to offer. I especially loved the balcony with its stunning view – the perfect spot to unwind after an exciting day. An absolute hidden treasure that I can wholeheartedly recommend to anyone!

It’s definitely a home away from home. I thoroughly enjoyed spending time at Franziska’s place. It’s even more beautiful than the photos. Close to CBD and amazing restaurants. The surrounding neighborhood was very peaceful, safe and had great views.
Franziska was super helpful whenever we needed assistance with anything.
She supported us during the Capetown cycle tour 2025.
Would definitely recommend her place.
Stunning stay - great location and fantastic hosts. Janice was amazing , helpful and discreet . It really was a home from home stay
great place to stay great location & so relaxing in the garden Janice is like a ray of sunshine & can't do enough to make you feel welcome loved it
Convenient and cosy place for 2 in a beautiful garden setting. Janice was a fantastic host.

Amazing stay, great host and sparkling clean..
The beautiful outdoor and homely touch definitely makes this an amazing place

We really enjoyed our stay ay Treetops, a great location in Constantia really close to the shops but at the same time quiet and peaceful.  Janice was a great host. The fast broadband was a definite plus. We will be going back I can't give a higher recommendation than that.
Location is great for walking safely to and from Constantia village. All in all a good place for anyone visiting the area. Thanks.

I am from the States, Dallas, Texas, and the place was safe, peaceful, and beautiful! I highly recommend this place. I felt right at home and the hostess was eager to help and give directions. The surroundings were so lovely, and there were so many tasteful restaurants, markets, and shopping malls. Thank you so much Janece for your kindness!!

Convenient location, short walking distance to restaurants, supermarket, in a nice area.   Place is nice, noise not an issue.    Even though I had some electricity issues, I think it was an aberration and normally this spot would be excellent value.
Amazing place to stay, lush gardens and very peaceful. Great host, would love to come back here
My daughter stayed here for a week whilst we were based around the corner - she had a lovely time - thank you Janice?
It was comfortable but it does need some maintenance and the shower could do with a good scrub. Otherwise for the price it is safe and in a great location. Janice was friendly and very nice

Great place in a great area, close to the Constantia winelands.
Wonderful, helpful host and a highly recommended stay!
We had only 1 bath towel and 3 hand towels. Found out too late in the evening to report.

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! This space is beautifully decorated and clean. Our host, Janice is very responsive and accommodating to our needs. Also, we loved the neighbourhood. Treetops is located in a relatively safe area, it is peaceful and quiet, and is conveniently close to a shopping mall and hypermarket. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and peaceful break away.

We fell in love with Michelle's place and her hospitality. And in result, we extended our stay. We definitely would like to visit Cape Town again some time and her place will be the first we will check for availability.

We had a fantastic stay at the Everview Suite. The place is even better than the pictures and the location is outstanding. Michelle met us the day we arrived and was extremely helpful assisting us to arrange where to go and what to do. Camps bay is a lovely part of Cape Town and the location is ideal for exploring the surrounding areas.
Simply put, it couldn't have been better and it will - without doubt be our first port of call the next time we head to Cape Town.

Thank you !

Dan and family

Michelle is very nice, she gave us fresh bread and fruits and helps us with laundry! We were awed by how nice her place is, it's just as described. Only problem is that our stay was too short, would've been perfect if we could stay longer! Highly recommend her place to anyone that want to stay in Cape Town!

Michelle was such a fantastic host , it makes such a difference to arrive somewhere with all the little basics that really make a place feel homely. Nothing was too much effort and the little birthday extras were such a lovely welcome .  The apartment itself is breathtaking and in a superb location for all camps bay and cape town has to offer. We would have no hesitation in booking with Michelle again. Thank you for a fantastic few days
This property was breathtaking and beautiful.  The description and photos were accurate to the aesthetic and overall experience.

House was amazing and was just as described in the Airbnb listing.  Views were spectacular, and the Camps Bay area was second to none for our visit to Cape Town.  Would come back and stay at Everview without thinking twice if I plan to return to the Western Cape of South Africa anytime in the future.  Thank you Michelle and Alpheus!

We LOVED our stay at Everview Suite!! Michelle was a perfect hostess and the home is as beautiful as it appears on airbnb. The location was within minutes of the spectacular Camps bay beach area. The view from the deck was amazing (especially during those incredible South African sunsets)! We would definitely go back and would certainly recommend the home to everyone.

This was such a beautiful place to stay while we visited Cape Town.  It was easy to get anywhere (despite road construction).  The views from the  rooms and deck were magnificent.  The care we were shown was exceptional (especially since our plans ended up including an unexpected wedding with all it's attendant necessary needs - dress and rings....)  Michelle could not have been a more gracious host.  We will definitely book with Everview in mind next time we visit Cape Town.
Awesome experience. Great view! Wonderful to meet such a friendly and helpful host. Thank you, and we'll be in touch next time we head South of the Equator

The property was unique and stunning with its 360 degree views of the water and mountains.  We could not have asked for more during our stay in Camps Bay! We loved the outdoor spaces especially the grill which we used every night.

The ocean and mountain view from Everview is excellent! Can´t be better! What can be a bit better is the information bit. We were given an overload of information on arrival. Too much in a very short time. Some written information would have worked better. Being there in winter time, the house was too cold. The heater we were promised beforehand, were not there on arrival. But when we told the host, she fixed it fairly quick. On the improvement side also: As a man being 184cm tall, I would have appreciated the beds being somewhat longer. Apart from that, Overview is great in every way. And Michelle is very helpful. Her help maddest much easier and comfortable for us to travel in Cape Town with two small kids. For instance she let us borrow a stroller. And her tip on using the Uber taxis really made the vacation much much better for us. We even used a Uber driver all the way down to Cape Point.

We were warmly welcomed with fresh bread and a divine South African wine in this beautifully designed apartment. Facilities were perfectly organized and state-of-art. It was a true pleasure falling asleep in the excellent beds with the sounds of the ocean. The stunning view the next morning encouraged us to explore the beauty of Cape Town and its surroundings. The apartment is ideally located  within a ten-minute walk to Camps bay beach and offers lots of privacy. Michelle is a very kind and cooperative host, with whom we immediately felt comfortable and at home.

We were in cape town for 6 nights & stayed in Everview Suite for a 3 nights ...our only regret is we didn't stay there the whole 6 nights...
Michelle is wonderful host with a very good team to make you feel welcome and comfortable in this place with outstanding views.
The bowl of fruit ,hot bread and wine, milk & eggs ....was added touch to make us feel at home!!
We'll defiantly come back.....Thanks heaps Farrah
Brilliant stay and an amazing location. Michelle and team made us feel very welcome and the views were truly amazing. Thanks for a great holiday!!

This was my first airbnb experience and needless to say, Michelle set the bar extremely high. She was welcoming, informative and even provided amenities. The house is stunning, clean and very functional. We had no problems at all. There is a market up the street, the beach is a ten minute walk and the house itself was a treat.

Michelle helps us book a wonderful day trip to the wineries, booked dinner reservations for us and even helped with special requests.

I highly recommend this airbnb to anyone who would like to fully experience the joys of Cape Town. I wish I could give it ten stars.

Michelle was an excellent host. We have been welcomed by her staff, who was incredibly nice. There was a bottle of white wine in the fridge, fruits on the table and a loaf of bread cooking in the oven.
Amazing view, the house was really clean.
We had encouragement to use the
Truly amazing !

We had 3 wonderful days at this beautiful and stylish apartment! Our host Michele and her stuff helped us with all our needs! The view from the apartment is breathtaking! What a wonderful welcome with fresh baked bread, cheese and wine! We can absolutely recommend this place and hope we will come back some time...

We had an absolutely wonderful time at The Everview Suite.The house and location were perfect for our week stay.The pictures on the AirBnB website don't do the place enough justice.Michelle was a lovely hostess and was always available if we needed her.I would happily stay there again when I travel back to Cape Town

We had a wonderful stay in this truly beautiful house. Everyone was so helpful and friendly and all we needed was taken care of. The house is very well equipped and beautifully appointed. I only wish we could have stayed longer. Thanks Michelle and staff for a memorable stay.
Amazing house, amazing view, amazing place and amazing host. Everything was perfect. Hope to visit Cape Town and stay the same house soon
First class - we had a fantastic experience. Exactly as described, great comms and Alpheus couldn't do more to help. We'll be back one day :-).
Spectacular view, great accommodation, friendly helpful staff and host .  Appreciated having the basics in the kitchen that we were free to use.  Hope to be back one day.

Michelle was extremely welcoming and even had fresh fruit and freshly baked bread upon our arrival. The place was just as beautiful as the photos. The view spectacular.
We arrived later than planned and Michelle was very accommodating. I look forward to staying here again and will send everyone that I know is heading to Cape Town the link to stay at her place.

This was a lovely apartment with gorgeous views. Michelle and her family were very helpful and provided us with a useful booklet of information as well as a much needed bottle of wine. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to stay in Camps Bay!

Michelle was there to greet us on arrival. We were shown around the amazing property, it really is as stunning as the photos if not more!
The place was stocked with food for breakfast and all the essentials for cooking and we were given freshly baked bread on arrival.
Michelle was very friendly and made us fell most welcome..highly recommend.

Enjoyed our stay. Magnificent view of the sea and sunsets.
The home baked bread etc was a lovely touch.

This place truly is a paradise in the middle of Cape Town. The apartment itself is gorgeous on the inside, and the views on the outside are stunning. It was one of the most beautiful pieces of property we have ever seen.
Michelle is also a great host. She is extremely thorough with her check in process and leaves guests with a welcome pack that has local recommendations and answers to any questions you might have. She is also extremely helpful and responsive.
I would recommend this place to anyone going to Cape Town!
Contemporary masterpiece in the heart of Camps Bay.  Close to the beach and restaurants, and loaded with amenities and treats such as homemade bread!  Highly recommended!

Incredible! On the slopes of Table Mountain, the gorgeous deck looks out over the coastal bays of the Atlantic, and behind you the gondolas lifting tourists to the summit is clearly visible. Binoculars are an enhancement and recommended. The bird and whale watching from the deck is spectacular!
Bedrooms and living space was ideal for three couples on a Cape Town winter holiday. Wine on the sunny deck by afternoon, cosy fireplace by cold winter night. The house cleaning service was excellent and it was an unmitigated delight.
On our arrival we were greeted with wine and fresh warm bread which was a pleasure after a long arduous journey. Our hostess was responsive and very helpful. We were well taken care of and felt very welcome.

We had a wonderful stay in Cape Town with Michelle in her lovely villa. The layout is perfect for up to 6 guests, and the views are amazing! Michelle was the perfect host making sure that our stay was comfortable (freshly baked bread upon arrival!) and kept us well informed all throughout our stay. We loved the open floor plan, wood-burning fireplace. gorgeous terrace, well-stocked kitchen, sliding wall to the patio and the location which was tucked on a private street only a few moments from downtown Camp's Bay. Overall, the perfect place to relax and enjoy Cape Town!
Michelle is a great host that helps you with any problem. The house is decorated with style and has a beautiful garden and view. I would certainly recommend it!

Everview is breathtaking. The photos are incredible but if anything they don’t do the place justice. The view is beyond spectacular; the location fantastic, within a short walk of Camps Bay; and the apartment itself is fabulous.
Queries directed to Michelle prior to arrival were promptly and efficiently answered and the information that was provided up front and in the apartment was comprehensive and very helpful.
The apartment was spotless and Gertrude kept it that way during our stay.
Overall, I can’t recommend Everview highly enough.
2nd time here and Still just as amazing as the first! Spectacular views and very safe! Michelle is a great host and will stay here again for my 3rd return!

We stayed at Michelle’s place for a week and loved our stay. The location if perfect if you are looking for some peace and quiet. Michelle was also quick to respond on any enquiries that we had. I hope to be back some day!
Great location. Awesome views of the table mountain & the sea. Very communicative and helpful host. We had a great stay. Highly recommended.

Our first stop was Cape Town and the start couldn’t have been better than Michelle’s apartment. The place has a spectacular view of 12 Apostles and the serene ocean . Everything has been done so artistically be it the furniture or the decor or the fire place.   Michelle is an amazing and warm host and you can totally rely on her suggestions. She is very careful in taking care of her guests needs. She welcomes all your queries any time and every time. It is THE place to stay when you are in Cape Town .

Exactly like pics- Beautiful modern home with amazing views
Convenient!
Small extra touches were so kind and thoughtful ! Would absolutely stay again !!!

We had an unbelievable stay at Everview and truly had an unforgettable weekend.
Michelle is a fantastic host, she is always available to assist and really does go above and beyond to make your stay special.
The view is even better than what you see in the photos, and the design of the rooms are ultra modern.
The extra touches like a home baked bread, bottle of wine and the fantastic ladies who assist in the upkeep makes this stay super special.

Michelle is a professional host, she was respectful, great in communication and welcoming. We really enjoyed our experience. The place is close to camps bay restaurants and markets. I hope that you enjoy as well.

This is a fantastic apartment at a great location, ie. a quiet street and wonderful view of the ocean. Very stylishly decorated, spacious and everything you need is available. This was the last place we stayed at during our 3 week trip in South Africa. It does leave us with very nice memories of Cape Town.

We had a wonderful stay at Michelle's place.  She has thought of everything and made it so comfortable and welcoming to stay.  Additional touches we enjoyed included the eggs, milk and handmade bread waiting for us, the convenient local grocery around the corner, the open beautiful sitting space outside and the quiet peaceful atmosphere.

Everview Suite was the most incredible Airbnb we have ever stayed in! The views are some of the best in Camps Bay and the sunset over the ocean was just incredible. Michelle was so helpful, no question or query was too much. Gertrude and Nikie were amazing and really made sure we had everything that we could possibly need - including a delicious loaf of homemade bread! We were very sad to leave, fingers crossed we can visit again soon!

Amazing stay! The home is lovely and the views are breathtaking! Warm fresh baked bread was there upon our arrival and the house was left sparkling clean after each of our day trips out. Michelle had loads of good tips on what to do and where to eat and her response time was almost immediate. Thanks so much for a lovely stay!

Our family loved Michelle's flat.  The view was absolutely stunning, water or mountain vistas from every angle.   It was very comfortable, well equipped and quiet.  Michelle was a super responsive host and made everything easy.  We really enjoyed being in Camps Bay and had good meals at several of the local restaurants.  We used Uber to travel around, which was very easy.  We would highly recommend  Michelle's apartment if you're visiting Cape Town.

Michelle was an excellent host and Everview was the perfect place for the six of us to use. The suite itself was very tastefully decorated with all the provisions you'd need for a stay. The location is perfect, an easy Uber ride to the middle of Cape Town, quiet with the most incredible views. If you're looking to stay here, don't miss the opportunity...it was amazing!
Absolutely beautiful apartment and outstanding views. Michelle was an excellent host and Nikki's hot bread that was waiting for us was delicious!

Michelle's pictures don't do this place justice. The sunsets are unreal! The location is great.. a safe 10 minute walk to camps bay beach. If you want to do a day trip and not drive use Reginald - he was amazing and showed us so much.
I have nothing bad to say about this place, and when I come back I will 100% be staying here again. Thanks again to Michelle and her team! It really made our holiday unforgettable.
We had a fantastic stay and couldn’t have asked for more. Just what we wanted for the week before the wedding!! The ladies servicing the apartment were amazing as well!! Thanks so much!

Everything about our stay was glorious! Michelle is the perfect host (she even brought up a box of lego for our kiddos to play with!) and the space itself is absolutely stunning while also being homey and comfortable. Perfect location, too. Truly, on a scale of 1 to 10, this was an 11.

Amazing location with great views. Hospitality was amazing and they were kind enough to provide us with freshly baked bread every morning. The local tips provided to us in the welcome booklet were also very helpful. I would definitely stay at this place again if I had the opportunity.

A wonderful place to stay, you will not be disappointed with your choice to stay here - everything from booking, checking in, staying and checking out was first class. The view from the suite was phenomenal and everything was basically just great!!

I can’t say enough great things about Michelle herself and her place.   She has everything we needed and more, suggestions of food places and things to do which was so helpful, made us homemade bread, house was immaculate and beautiful.  Highly highly recommend!

Michelle's place was more than my clients expected.  They were in Cape Town for 3 days and they loved their time at her beautifully decorated place.  The views are outstanding! The beds were very comfortable and they were able to have a relaxing time staying at Michelle's place.  Michelle provided excellent service! Michelle helped me organize a two day itinerary for my clients.  They enjoyed an amazing day touring wineries and then the next day they went to see the penguins at Boulder Beach, visit beautiful Cape Point while driving along a breathtaking scenic route.  She also recommended two wonderful restaurants to have lunch while on both tours.  Reginald, the driver Michelle recommended, was perfect for my clients and they enjoyed both days him.  I am a travel agent for luxury clients and I would not hesitate recommending as a great place to stay when visiting Cape Town.  Thank you Michelle for all your help.

Michelle is super kind and such a lovely host! We had the most wonderful time at Everview Suite including stunning sunsets every night and although we were in Cape Town for work the place made us feel like we were there for a holiday. I would recommend this place definitely to my friends and when I come to Cape Town next year, I will definitely ask Michelle if Everview Suite is free to book :)
The neighbourhood is very nice and feels super safe, nice beaches, supermarkets and good restaurants are in walking distance and from Michelle to the housekeepers, we only met the loveliest ladies at Everview, who welcomed us with warm, homemade bread and Sauvignon Blanc, helped us with trip plannings and truly made us feel at home.

So they stay with Michelle and her Family was a little bit like a movie, it came during the shutdown and forget about how beautiful the place is and the view and the surrounding area. It is Michelle and her husband who made me feel even in the time of lockdown as If I was home, she even managed to bring me 2 bottles of Wine which was almost impossible during lockdown. If you are alone of with family of 4 or 5 people, this is the place to be in Capetown.

A little slice of heaven !
the home made bread and wine on arrival was PERFECTION !

We are a family of four with teenage kids. This is a great apartment for a longer stay in Cape Town. The views are out of this world. We particularly liked the amenities including the outdoor fireplace and the well equipped kitchen. The apartment is very well located and you’re able to travel anywhere around the peninsula easily. Michelle is a great host and the staff, particularly Gertrude, are extremely friendly and helpful.

It was great stay for our honeymoon
The suite clean and have fantastic views from the living room and bedrooms
Michelle was very friendly and helpful to us
I really recommend this suite and i hope to stay there again

Communication was very easy. Felt quite safe in the neighborhood.  It was about a 15min walk to the restaurants and beach area of Camps Bay. The view is AMAZING! Both in front and behind the place. The deck area is fantastic. The kitchen/dining and living room space is very open and spacious. Each bedroom has a bathroom- it is a bit odd that the toilet is in with the showers but easy to get used to. The beds were comfortable. The bread is wonderful! Very much enjoyed our stay and wish we could have stayed longer! Had to cut our stay a bit short seconday to COVID 😞.

Was a lovely stay here at the Everview Suite. The house was very clean, had everything we needed, and the location was excellent!
Michelle left a through booklet of information that was very useful and mostly responded to any questions we had. Would definitely recommend this spot. Thank you very much!

What a beautiful and serene place - We enjoyed our stay at Everview so much. Spacious, beautifully decorated and we especially enjoyed the outside deck and braai area. The great view was the cherry on top. Would definitely recommend

We had a wonderful weekend in this beautiful home! The view of the ocean is amazing. Michelle and Bernhard are great hosts and very helpful. The delicious warm bread, butter, wine and eggs on arrival was a real treat. The suite is also well stocked with the basics and has all the necessary home comforts. Thank you so much. We hope to be back soon.

We had a wonderful stay at Michelle‘s House! Everything was as described and even better. You have incredible views from every angle of the house. We only met Michelle‘s husband who is such a really nice guy and he welcomed us so warmly that we felt just like friends.
I would highly recommend a stay at this place and would definitely book it again. Thank you Michelle for sharing your beautiful home!

The house is beautiful with an amazing view on the ocean. We stayed for 5 days and did not want to leave. It was worth it and made the experience in Capetown a wonderful one. The hospitality of Michelle and Gertrude was great. An amazing house in amazing location

By far one of the most beautiful, comfortable, well-located AirBnBs I've ever stayed at! Just a stunning place with stunning views! We were welcomed with fresh bread, a bottle of wine and plenty of smiles!!
We were only 2, but with 3 spacious bedrooms, full kitchen, huge terrace and pool area etc, family and friends can easily be accommodated.
You WILL love this place!! Book it ASAP :-)

The place is amazing and one of the best Airbnbs I’ve been to, and it’s mainly because of its added values which are these two:
1. The great host
2. Very child friendly place.
Michelle greeted us personally with her sweet daughter. She was super friendly, always responsive, and gave us homemade bread upon our arrival!
As we were with our 2 year old, the apartment had a big box full of toys, a security gate blocking the stairs, and kind of a gate around the pool! This only shows how this place is properly prepared for its guests which is very impressive!
In general- the place is sparkling clean, the beds were very comfortable, the design of the place is extraordinary, the kitchen appliances and accessories are high quality. And the view!!! Absolute amazing, you have the ocean in front of you and mountains behind you.
Bottom line- really high level accommodation and highly recommended!!!!!

We had an absolutely wonderful time staying at this Airbnb in Camps Bay. The sea view is absolutely breathtaking, and the apartment itself is modern and beautifully established.
What really made this Airbnb experience stand out, however, was the host, Michelle. In every circumstance, she was incredibly helpful and went above beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable. The communication was excellent throughout our stay, which was greatly appreciated.
Overall, I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a luxurious and relaxing stay in Camps Bay!

Our stay at Michelle's home in Camps Bay was fantastic! What a wonderful location and home. Michelle and her team were unbelievable in their communication and willingness to make our stay truly special. If you are considering her home as your home base while staying in Cape Town do not hesitate – it is a wonderful home and they will do everything to make your stay truly memorable. Thanks again for everything it was awesome!
Beautiful airbnb! Looks just like the photos and the hosts are extremely friendly and accommodating. Highly recommend!

We loved our stay here! Michelle went beyond to make our stay as much comfortable as possible! She had even toys for our daughter to play with. The view and the neighbor is beautiful and we felt very safe as a family.

Stunning apartment looks just like the photos Michelle was extremely helpful and personable she went above and beyond for us. Next to the views the homemade breads was a highlight of the Airbnb. Cannot wait to come back!!!

I enjoyed my stay here and everything was in place as described on the photos
I’ll visit again.

My family had 3 nights at Michelle’s absolutely beautiful apartment. It is so beautiful and the most amazing location. Very easy walk to camps bay, and the most incredible views from every window. The check in was very easy, Michelle was the most responsive and helpful host I have ever had! I met her and her and her husband are very lovely. The apartment is very clean, very luxurious and very safe. We will definitely come back and stay longer next time! Thank you Michelle

"Absolutely Stunning!
Michelle's Camps Bay retreat exceeded all our expectations! The location is unbeatable, with breathtaking views of the ocean and Table Mountain. The apartment is tastefully decorated, modern, and spotlessly clean.
Michelle is an exceptional host - warm, responsive, and thoughtful. She provided excellent recommendations for local restaurants and activities.
We loved:
- The spacious rooms and comfy beds
- The fully equipped kitchen with stunning views
- The private balcony perfect for sunset cocktails
- The short walk to Camps Bay Beach and vibrant restaurants
Michelle's attention to detail and hospitality made our stay truly unforgettable. We can't wait to return!
5/5 stars without hesitation. Highly recommend!"

Such a great stay would definitely stay there again if I came back to South Africa. Food was great and everything is walkable. There is a great coffee spot down the road and a market a block away to get all your necessities.

I absolutely enjoyed the stay at Michelle’s place. There was only two nights available during my time in Cape Town otherwise I would certainly have stayed longer!
With breathtaking views of the ocean and the mountains ,it’s a double win! Michelle went the extra mile to make sure we were comfortable. Very responsive, hospitable (had freshly baked bread and some welcome chilled wine in the fridge ).
Definitely plan to come back!

Amazing location, amazing house and amazing host! Thank you Michelle for a fabulous stay at your gorgeous house. Sun downers on the terrace, watching the sunset a def highlight. Great spot, easy to walk down into Camps Bay. Would highly recommend and would stay again.

Beautifully arranged accommodation, with stunning 360 views of the Twelve Apostles, Lions Head and Atlantic Ocean beyond Camps Bay. Spectacular sunsets, very well equipped. All supported by a fantastic hosting couple and their excellent team.

We really enjoyed our stay. The view is amazing! Everything we needed was available in the appartement. We enjoyed the short walk to the beach.
We stayed with two kids and were happy that there was a fence for around the pool to ensure the youngest couldn’t fall in pool while playing outside. However, when you are in the pool there is no fence/glass wall at the edge.
We really enjoyed our stay thank you for everything!
We had a wonderful stay at Michelle’s house. She was a very friendly and hospitable host.
Michelle is a great host. It is a beautiful house with a beautiful view. We enjoyed our stay a lot. Very good accommodation for families with kids. Already planning our next trip!
Very friendly host and great place with stunning view just ljke the picture. Located in quiet residential area yet close to camps bay just like other comments mentioned.

The place is very spacious and well laid out. After going up the staircase, you enter a full floor with a master bedroom, a large living room, and two additional bedrooms. The balcony is wide and spacious, offering a truly breathtaking view. The cleanliness was excellent, which made the stay even more comfortable and enjoyable.

The place is very convenient and walkable to the Waterfront. We had a great room with a view of the stadium and the ocean, really increadible. Nazeema and Danielle took good care of us and we're very helpful. When we return to Cape Town I would definately stay there again.

Great place to stay for visiting the sites of Cape Town. 15 - 20 minutes and your in the city centre. A shopping mall is only 5 minutes away. The house is superb with everything you could wish for. Lovely pool and garden. Safe and secure. Thoroughly recommended.
Great house, great location. Nice and spacey. Can get really hot indoors which is why we opted to stay outdoors but the garden was so homey I didn’t mind this at all.

This home was lovely, spacious and clean with a great front deck where you can spend hours under a white sail sheet in the warm shade. It is close to the beach and we took the little ones for a walk to the sea each day. Great holiday spot with lock up parking.
