We had such a great time staying at Heather and Tristan's place - we were there with 4 toddlers so things got a bit crazy but Heather was so gracious when there was a spill on the couch etc. Loved that it was so close to the beach and a quick drive to Imhoff farm where we could spend hours with the kids.

Heather is a fantastic, amazing host and so responsive and helpful.
The location of this property is amazing and I’ll sure we will be back to stay again!

What a wonderful place to get some rest! A great base to explore Cape Town or further south to Cape of Good Hope. Gabrielle and her family were super warm and welcoming, wanting to ensure we were comfortable and taken care of.  The cottage is very nice, with a lovely view of the mountains surrounding Hout Bay.
Such an amazing view, every morning was a pleasure to wake up. Location is great, so secure. Amazing on the amenities!

This place is an absolute gem! We felt right at home in the cozy and beautifully designed cottage and it was the perfect spot to start our trips in and around Cape Town from or just spend a day at the pool. Safety was no concern at all and Gabi and Ralph gave us lots of great tips on places to visit in the area.
We would love to be back!

Really cozy and safe Apartement. You feel at home immediately. Really comfortable bed and sofa. Gaby is really nice and the garden is just awesome! The pool is almost private, because Gaby and Ralph are usually somewhere else when you decide staying at the pool.
When comparing it to other apartments we stayed in the past with similar facilities, it‘s a little expensive. But for us it was worth the money, because we decided on a short term to stay there.

We had a wonderful time at Gabriele’s cozy and comfortable accommodation. The garden with the swimming pool are amazing – perfect for relaxing and enjoying the beautiful surroundings.
Gabriele and her husband were incredibly friendly and warm hosts. They always responded quickly and were happy to assist whenever we had questions. Their hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable.
We would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing getaway!

The cottage was amazing - even more beautiful than in the photos. The location is perfect for anyone who loves the beach, since it's only a few blocks away from Bloubergrand Beach. The cottage was very comfortable and had everything we needed for a two-month stay in Cape Town, and Adam and his wife were excellent hosts.
Adam reached out to us early on and welcomed us to his cottage. He was always helpful and friendly.

Adam was super nice to us. He told us about everything that we wanted to now and even managed to book á sky dive for us, though the company told us that our date was full. The house is in a great location, safe neigborhood and the house it self is wonderful. Very cozy and feels like your home. We had a wonderful stay in Adams house. Would recomend having a rental car, it is super cheap! Thank you again Adam, you were very nice to us.

We had a lovely stay in Adam's cottage. Really nice decoration espacially the rooms. Good & clean accomodation! the location is safe, nearby from shops, tiny bars and restaurants. Adam was really friendly with us and we have appreciated all the recommandations he gave us.
We will definately come back!
Claire & Alain

Beautiful and stylish cottage in Blouberg ! Everything was perfect : the communication with Adam and his warm welcome and disponibility, the location, the cottage ( style, space and parking place ) ... and you are in 5 minutes by feet on the fabulous beach ! Just perfect to spend great time with friends or family ! Thanks Adam !
Great place to stay. Close to the beach with a stunning view to Table Mountain. Adam was a good host and always there, when we needed help.

The place looks exactly the same as in the photos advertised.
Everyone is extremely welcoming and they make you feel at home.
Thank you very much for the hospitality.

A very nice and clean place in a residential area of Blouberg close to the beach.
I enjoyed my stay here.

Lovely peaceful place, pictures are very accurate, good location, safe feel, the outside area is really nice to chill and adds so much to the property.  Little stretch of grass perfect to clean a kite. Recommended!
Beautiful and very clean place. Close to shops. Beautiful beach near by. The host was incredible always willing and quick to help.

Our stay at Adams place was perfect for what we needed. Great location - walking distance to shops and the most beautiful beaches.
Would definitely recommend others to stay here.

Super chill and comfortable space near the beach and good restaurants. Adam is a super accommodating, kind host. He went above and beyond to help without appearing inconvenienced. We appreciated his generous nature.
Had a great 2 week stay.... Walking distance to Blaauwberg Beach and restaurants nearby. Host was great, will definetely recommend!
Great place to stay in Blouberg, Adam is a friendly host, flexibel and helpful. Lovely apartment, with everything in it for a relaxt stay
The apartment was very nice and clean and the beach was really nearby.  The Waterfront and CBD were close enough and reachable within a 10 minutes drive.
Brett was a fantastic host, he was reachable at any time! The Apartment is great and beautifully located. The view is  fantastic and the city is within a 15 Min drive.
Great host and awesome place. Our second time here and will definitely be back again. Location location location.

Brett is a brilliant host, personally met us and showed us through the apartment. The apartment itself is very well designed and modern pics do not do justice much better in real life. The porch can be converted to an indoor room with its secure folding glass sliding doors. This leads out to the beach with THE BEST sunsets and view of Table Mountain. You can also make use of the Hotel's Pool, bars and restaurants. This place is a must stay on your visit to Cape Town.

Generally it was a great place to stay. Close to everything. The hotel facilities were good and was nice to have them on your doorstep. However the hotel can be busy with conferences and events during the Festive Season and noise from the events can be heard from the apartment.

Brett's place is amazing! The beach is beautiful and it's right next to a bus stop, which gives easy access to all main areas in town. At the same time, it's far enough from central Cape Town to be quiet and relaxing. The sunsets are amazing!

Overall we enjoyed the stay. Comforrable, affordable with lovely views. It was indeed a very pleasant experience. I will recommend your place to anyone. Host was very friendly and helpful. The place was very save aswell. Thanks Brett

The host, Brett, was fantastic in communicating and in making suggestions for what to do in cape town such as restaurants and etc. The apartment is excellent and is located 15 min drive from the V & A waterfront, facing the sea in a quiet area. Much better than staying in the center where the night is more dangerous. I recommend it to everyone and would definitely stay in the same apartment again.

Wonderful ckean and comfortable apartment; beds, linen and pillows a dream to sleep on. Problems resolved ASAP and we received a warm and friendly welcome even though it was after 20h00.
The beach nearby is a wonderful treat and we loved our stay here😍

We had a great stay in Brett's appartment - clean, spacious, ocean access and, within ten meters walking distance, a fantastic view on Table Mountain. Plus: Brett is one of the friendliest people you'll ever meet. Thank you so much for having us!

The apartment was clean and tidy. Also spacious and modern. The apartment was very warm and comfy.
The hosts were very nice. They provided an itinerary that goes all around Cape Town. I arrived late at night, and they were very welcoming.

Very nice apartment right at the beach. If you like to kite surf it is a good place in between the beaches and the city. Brett is very responsive and easy to communicate with. Can recommend the place!
They can expect a unit perfectly placed on the beach , within walking distance of downtown. A perfect location, with all the eloquent amenities and appointments !!!
Amazing apartment with a million $ view.  We had an awesome time. Thanks Brett for your prompt response and hospitality.

Excellent stay, great location. Brett and Henry very responsive to messages or questions. An early check in was accomadated which was very much welcome after a long flight with 3 year old child. Nice complex, restaurant, bar, swimming pools. Right on the beach. Thank you Brett and Henry
Amazing stay.literally on the beach.Just awesome to walk in the morning and see Table Mountain

Communication and local tips was very good and if you want to stay a place were the host is informative and quick to response, you get the best right here.
the place was very nice and the pictures is as the description. You have a fantastic view of the table Mountain and Cape Town from the beach.
The only drawback was the ocean were polluted to a level where it was not advisable to go in for a dip.
However, with a 15 min walk up the beach or the 2 pools at the hotel, we were still able to cool down after a hot day on the table mountain.
Big recommendations from me

This place is just perfect. You won't get closer to the beach. From the door its like 10 steps and you on the sand. The pool was lovely. There are restaurants in and around the hotel and the view of the mountain is stunning. Very spacious and ideal holiday get away for a family with young children. Big grass area infront of units for kids to play. We were there with my daughter who is in a wheelchair and she could access everything.

The place is as advertised. Loved waking up to the ocean view.
Place was a bit further out than expected from tourist attractions, we were made aware of this. Unfortunately, we lost wifi connection mid stay following a power cut and our phone signal was poor.
The pools and views from the pool were amazing.
Great place and stunning views. Can definitely recommend this place and we would love to stay here again!

My family and I had a wonderful experience. The apartment was spacious and we had direct access to the beach. This is the best view I have seen in Cape Town. The host was readily available to be contacted. Will definitely book this apartment in the near future.
We loved the apartment. Everything was as shown in the pictures. We enjoyed our stay and if we are ever in Cape Town again we wouldn’t think twice about booking this apartment.

What a wonderful location!!! I would highly recommend this place it is very safe plus you're just a stone throw from the beach
We had an unforgettable stay and would surely recommend this place to all my family and friends

It was my second time staying at Brett’s place and I don’t think I will ever book anywhere else in Cape Town again. The location is perfect and central to EVERYTHING. The apartment has everything you need, not to mention that it’s within the hotel which has a great restaurant and spa.

Perfect location: right at the beach, safe, easy to access with public transport or uber.
The electricity cut is a bite of a pain but this is part of the life in Cape Town.

Fantastic value for money. Although we visited in a cold season and swimming was not a good option, we still spent hours walking on the beach picking up awesome shells and stones. Moreover, the apartment is very central, roughly 10-15min from most of Cape Town City and roughly 30min from other great locations such as Strand or Blouberg or Melkbos.

Brett and Henry is great
We had a wonderful stay at their apartment. On our arrival the apartment was spotless you could smell the fresh cleaning aroma
Pictures is just as is. Peaceful stay. Definitely be back again
Amazing apartment with incredible views with the beach literally on your doorstep. Very clean place, felt right at home. Absolutely recommend this place! Will visit again! 10/10

We stayed for an event at Grand West Casino.  Very conveniently located.  Also centrally located for Century City and trips into V&A Waterfront. Unit is ground floor and you walk out from your lounge right to the beach.  Beach is great walking beach.  Unit located in a larger hotel/apartment complex so have benefit of restaurant in hotel plus Wang Thai food which is great.  Security excellent, especially underground parking. Brett and Henry are very communicative and make everything easy.  Highly recommended

Booked the Apartment for my mom and Grandmother. It was an amazing stay! Brett and Henry were lovely host an super accommodating and helpful. Highly recommend this venue we will definitely book with them again!

We felt so at home. Comfortable beds, well stocked kitchen, very secure and beautiful sunsets! It was a 25 min walk to grocery store. Restaurant at the hotel was amazing. Host was very responsive to questions and provided excellent information for what to do in the local area and peninsula. Absolutely loved it!
Words are not enough to describe your place everything one wishes to get was accessible place very food and looked after..to list the few.

We thoroughly enjoyed staying at the Meerkat Manor. It's part of a larger complex (I think three bedroom/bathroom/kitchen units and the main house) but private AF, which is what we wanted. We will stay here again.

The apartment was well appointed and has amazing views over the city. Lorraine was easy to communicate with and met me at the apartment. The apartment is central and many city sites can be visited in walking distance. I would recommend this apartment to people who enjoy the hustle and bustle of city life.

Lorraine was a really sweet host. Had all the arrangements made for our stay. She even left some lovely roses in the apartment for us. The place has some amazing views of the city from all sides. We had a wonderful time. Must visit property if you plan to stay in the city.

Lorraine's apartment is in a great location, is beautifully decorated and has everything that you need. Lorraine was a great host and even came to meet us to drop off the keys. We had a phenomenal family weekend! Thank you, Rob, Tish, Jayme and Lea xxx

Wow I actually don't have words as to how lovely of a home it is, secondly how lovely of a city its but most importantly how gentle caring and open honest as well as understanding she is......
She made suggestions on places for me to go see and was always available whenever I needed anything from her or needed to know anything from her, she truly made it so easy, I felt like I was home!!
The apartment itself has views to die for and is actually perfectly central to EVERYWHERE.....
Anyone thinking of booking her place, don't think, just do it!!!!

Lorraine was indeed an amazing host. Full of hospitality and always willing and trying to help you have a great time in Cape Town. The accommodation was well maintained and equipped with modern charming furniture. I stayed with my wife and three kids and all of us enjoyed a lot!

Quality finishings and comfortable beds in a secure building with perfect city location. Some water stains in the roof plaster, but nothing that makes a difference to your stay. A brilliant penthouse!

Our stay was everything we imagined and more. The photos are very accurate and upon arrival we were even more impressed. The VIEWS for each balcony are one to remember. Lorraine was very responsive and quick to answer any questions we had. Such a modern, classy yet homey vibe. After a long day of sight seeing it was a pleasure to come back to! We didn't want to leave ... but unfortunately our time was up. Whenever I return to Cape Town I for sure will book another stay at Lorraine's penthouse!
Exactly as described. Very clean and would stay again. Also very much appreciated her tips of where to go and where to eat in the city!

Highly Recommended for the most stunning view of Cape Town in both directions, City and Harbour view to the front and Table Mountain, Devils Peak on the backside. Situated just in the centre of Cape Town, near parliament with good opportunities for food and groceries nearby. Good starting point for all activities. Parking in closed house owned garage.
Penthouse in top condition fully equipped Just perfect.
Lorraine's informations have been absolutely complete with very very quick response to all questions.
Absolutely amazing contact.
It's been an awesome stay. We just can say thank you for having us.

Incredible apartment, just as in the description, and well located within the city. Perfect for two couples or a small family. Stunning views and beautiful interior design and artwork (the owner is an artist). Recommend!

Lorraine's place is perfect for your stay in Cape Town. The penthouse has amazing views of tabletop mountain. She provided us with great suggestions of things to do and places to eat near the apt. When we arrived flowers were on the table and a bottle of wine in the fridge. Lorraine responded quickly to any questions we had during our stay.

The Communication with Lorraine was excellent. Her Information always very helpful and precise. Particularly her replies have been always very prompt. The penthouse is extraordinary good equiped. The biggest issue is the great view on the city and the table mountain from the 18. Floor
Great penthouse on 18 th floor . Very centrally located , great view on Table mounting and Port of Cape Town . Very secure building with yoga place on the roof .

We had a lovely stay in the City Bowl. The city scape and mountain views are to die for. It was our first city living visit. We also really enjoyed our morning coffees at Truth and being close to a few good restaurants.
The owner communicated well before the time, sending lots of tips of what to see and do in the area, and there was a welcome bottle of wine and fresh flowers on arrival.
It's a well run apartment block and we had a great stay in Cape Town.

Comfortable and spacious apartment in the heart of Cape Town.  Building a bit dated but apartment has been upgraded.  Good security.  Great views of Table Mountain and the city.  Many coffee shops within walking distance and convenient basement parking.  Lorraine provided info on what's available within walking distance.
Excellent 5 star apartment. Super clean. Luxurious. Stunning views. Host was constantly in touch over whatsapp for any suggestions and help. Highly recommended

Highly reccommended!
Beautiful apartament with spectacular view of the city, very good central location and an amazing hostess, very hospitable.

We had a fantastic stay at Lorraine's place. The view is amazing and easy to access everything you need. We hired a car so used the parking and went straight up into the apartment via the lift. We went to stay last minute and Lorraine was kind enough to leave us some warmer clothing, such as jumpers in the wardrobe! She was extremely helpful and we ended up having a fantastic time in Cape Town.

A lovely penthouse with spectacular view of the Table Mountain and the city. Pretty good location, close to many good coffee shops and restaurants.
Lorraine is a very gracious host, very helpful and responsive to all our questions and needs, before we arrive and during our stay. Her recommendations for places to go are great. Wish we could come back again.

What a fantastic host Lorraine is!
We wish we had her everywhere to give us the best recommendations for restaurants & bars & cafes!
Excellent, clean apartment with amazing views all over. Seemed like it is one of the tallest buildings in Cape town, must go to the terrace above the apartment for some picturesque views of Cape town. Location is so convenient as well.
Thanks Lorraine!

We had a great stay at Lorraine's beautiful home. The location and views were spectacular. The home is huge and has everything we needed. Any questions were immediately and thoroughly answered. I would absolutely stay here again.
The unit is centrally located with amazing views of Cape Town all round. The unit was very clean and Lorraine communicated superbly to inform us of amenities close to the unit.

What a view!!! All you want to see in Cape Town panorama is there: Table Mountain on one side, city, harbour, distant mountain on the other side. Amazing day and night. Location is great for all the cafe, bars and similar, and the area is very interesting for both museums and to feel like a local. Lorraine is a fantastic host, helpful and ready to reply. Walking distance to the shopping and restaurant areas that we love in CT, max 15’ ride to the waterfront. A bit more expensive than similar places we stayed at, and more than we would have been happy to pay for this apartment.

Fantastic large penthouse with panoramic balcony views towards Cape Town city centre and the most impressive Table mountain. Secure unground car parking with easy access. Easy walking distance into town.
The host Lorraine was so accommodating towards us, flexible and always available if needed. Will stay again as it’s an excellent location especially for the Cape Town Cycle tour. Until next year.
Fantastic penthouse, very stylish while comfortable.. Great location with cool spots nearby and great advice from Lorraine on a couple of them. We loved our stay and would come back without a doubt
Great, spacious apartment centrally located in the heart of Cape Town with great views. Very friendly and super helpful owner. Would recommend for an easy and carefree stay while in SA.

The apartment is just as beautiful as shown in the photos, and the views of Cape Town even more so! In advance of our trip, Lorraine sent very helpful details about the check-in process, parking, and recommendations for the local area. We found everything as we had hoped when booking Airbnb Plus - sparkling clean, plenty of linens and bath products, and a fully equipped kitchen. The wifi worked very well and the washing machine was a nice convenience as well. Lorraine was helpful and communicative throughout. Four of us were very comfortable here for three nights, and we would have liked to stay longer.

Lorraine is an exceptional host who is extremely responsive and who has curated a beautiful, comfortable apartment in Cape Town. She did everything she could to help us best understand the area before our arrival and helped us troubleshoot any concern that we had during our stay.
While I would highly recommend staying here and would recommend any stay at any of Lorraine's properties (if she has more than one) given her hospitality, I do think it would be helpful to have a little more context on the building. While the apartment itself is beautiful, the building is a bit outdated, which led us to feel a bit unsafe. Ultimately, there was no issue of safety but I think it's important to note this for future travelers in case that's top of mind.
The view from the huge windows is amazing. And the house is very very big for CT standards. Lorreine is a great host

The place needs some revamping here and there to make it more hospitable. The carpets in the bedrooms will not work for anyone with sinus issues.
The place has an almost 360 degree views of the city which is breathtaking. We took some stunning pics.

A Penthouse indeed it was. Great views, spacious, clean, very secure parking and all other good things that you expect. The location is beyond perfect, in and out of the city center in a jiffy with no traffic hassels. The communication from the host Lorraine was very good.
Lorraine is a fantastic host, her penthouse has immaculate views and is very central. I would definitely recommend this place and stay here again.

This is a stunning apartment with dual aspect views from the living room, over the city and the mountains. The bedrooms both had lovely uninterrupted views to the mountains. Our trip was way too short but this was a very convenient safe base for us to see Cape Town with underground parking and a lift directly to the 18th floor. Lorraine was really helpful in suggesting good places to eat locally and she was very easy and helpful to communicate with. She went the extra mile for us in looking after our luggage whilst we went out as we had a late flight. Would love to go back again soon.-we didn’t have enough time in this fabulous city!

What a pleasurable experience I had at this beautiful apartment it felt a like a home away from home I highly recommend it to anyone who is visiting Cape Town if you are looking for comfort peace space opulence than this where you would want to be at.

The location of Lorraine’s home is perfect. We were able to walk many places and Uber never had a problem finding us. The place was clean and the building is secure with a guard 24 hours and fob system. The views of Table Mountain were incredible!

The apartment has to be one of the best two bedrooms in Cape Town.  What the pictures do not show are the best views in the city.... essentially 360 degrees w a balcony on both the north and south side running the full length of the 18th floor unit w a direct view of table mountain from the master bed when you wake up every morning.  Otherwise the inside pics are accurate.  Lorraine is easily reachable for any questions.

This penthouse has spectacular views and finishings. I actually wanted to extend my stay, however other guests were already booked.
Lorraine is a great host, super friendly and extremely accommodating. She really assisted by confirming our stay at extremely short notice and ensured that we were comfortable throughout the duration - highly recommend if you want to enjoy uninterrupted views of the city and mountains!
The place was clean and the security is very tight and I felt safe all the time. Friendly host and always reachable
Beautiful views from all angles of the this home.  Artful touches that made the property even more special. Felt at home in this lovely apartment

Lorraines home in Cape Town is an absolute gem - it’s a top floor penthouse overlooking all of Cape Town. Grand piano, you feel like a rockstar. Lorraine herself is an amazing human and will help you with anything you need.

I did not personally stay here but rather booked it as a mini vacation stay for my sister. She and her family had a lovely stay! They loved the place as well as the location which had amazing views of the mountain and city. Lorraine was also a great host who was always available and very accommodating! I’d love to go and stay at Lorraine’s place myself the next time I’m in CPT!

We had the most wonderful experience staying at this Airbnb for a month. After a disappointing experience at another property, we booked this place last minute—and it turned out to be a blessing. From the very beginning, the host was incredibly accommodating, understanding our situation and going above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable.
She maintained great communication throughout our entire stay, always checking in and making sure we had everything we needed. The space itself was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed for a long-term stay.
We truly felt at home, and we’re so grateful for the kindness and care shown to us. Highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a peaceful and well-managed place to stay!
An absolutely amazing place and location! And let's not forget Lorraine—she's incredibly supportive and always takes the initiative to help out! I'll recommend the place to everyone.

We had a wonderful 2 weeks in this house, it felt like our own house. Mary-Ann made it easy for us to book, stay and we didn't want to leave. Its perfect for a family with young children that doesn t need the beach but in stead prefer a wonderful garden and swimming pool. We actually prefer the area over busy atlantic sea. The house was in immaculate condition and we were felt very welcome with a welcome note, guide and bottle of Wine. Already missing it.

We stayed for 10 nights in this lovely comfortable home in Constantia Heights. It was perfect for our family including 2 sons aged 21 and 24 years. Stayed at Colleen’s place for 4 weeks. The place is small but has everything you need, and the garden is absolutely stunning! The apartment had everything we needed, but could get quite cold on winter nights, as I suppose most Cape Town places do. Would definitely recommend, especially for short-term stays this is an absolute hidden gem!

A private, well situated accommodation backing onto table mountain. Had everything we needed and we enjoyed our stay. The only complaint was the sound of the geezer that often was running and was intrusive. Also the mattress feels like it had lost its spring and was too soft. Dstv accessibility would have been a bonus. But thank you to Colleen for giving us a comfortable weekend away.

Peaceful accommodation very close to the hiking trails of the Table Mountain! I would recommend this place if you are looking for comfort and and a garden.
Thank you for your hospitality Colleen!
Very good location, close to the mountain.  Well stocked and plenty of room and great garden, well worth it.

What a find! We had a wonderful stay at Colleen's space. Beautiful views, perfectly protected from the strong Cape wind and very private. Our check-in was made that much easier by Lameck who helped us with our luggage and many bags. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Colleen’s place - we were there for a few days and didn’t really spend much time indoors - it was however great coming back to enjoy a glass of wine on the patio and silence. Loved the plants, wind blowing against the trees, birds chirping, gorgeous Mountain View & the privacy.

Colleen and Marsha were very welcoming an and friendly. We were allowed to check in earlier with our baby, what was great. The location is amazing, with a stunning view over Cape Town, in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood. Cozy place with a private garden, we just loved it. Thanks for the hospitality!

This is the perfect place to stay if you want a quiet neighbourhood but still want to be close to everything else! It is clean, well equipped, and has a lovely veranda. I will definitely stay there again!

The place is a lovely and lush green getaway with beautiful views of the city. We had a very nice stay! I fell ill and Colleen was very helpful in recommending a doctor and pharmacy which we greatly appreciated. Lastly, as an added bonus we really enjoyed the company of the cat who was very friendly and social.

Thank you for sharing this stunning place with us.
view was magnificent : lions head & table mountain
Backyard is perfectly safe for trekking / walking
Fabulous spot up against Table Mountain. Lots of space inside and a garden outside with a beautiful view. Very quiet at night for good sleeping.

Aubrey was a great host. He bought us little things to eat for the kids and gave us lots of advice of what to do in the area. The appartement is a stone throw to the beach and café. 3 LARGE bedrooms! Thanks for the stay Aubrey!

Beautiful spacious apartment with a great view of the beach. Very tastefully decorated and well equipped for a home away from home experience. Perfectly located for all sorts of attractions in the area, close to beach and shops, everything you need is in walking distance. Great host, very polite and helpful. Would definitely recommend.
Absolutely amazing stay! Thank you so much Aubrey for the superb hospitality! We will most definitely be booking with you again :)

Aubrey and Kerry was awesome to communicate with, their place was neat and clean, with everything that you needed right there within walking distance. The 4 of us will definitely  recommend it to everyone we know. thank you very much. Cape Agulhas ICT Team
Amazing place to stay. House is well kept and staying there was a breeze and we'll worth th price! Host was responsive and great. Recommended to all!

The place was great. Enjoyed the views of the beach and the spacious house. Its a safe place with all the utilities that are needed and place is close to amenities. Aubrey and Kerry are great hosts, i recommend their house if you are planning to stay in Muizenburg.
Place is really spacious, comfortable and perfect for children. Great location right on the beach. I would recommend!

Loverly stay , fully equipped bedrooms, bathrooms and kitchen . Pristine and very clean ! Extremely homely ! A gem !
We needed for nothing and will recommend to anyone visiting for a long or short stay .
Thank you Aubrey, we had a lovely time in Muizenberg and in your place. We will recommend it to friends.
Thank you for hosting us. We were super comfortable definitely a home away from home. The apartment is so spacious and easy to find.

Amazing place to stay. Perfect location right across from the beach. Very comfortable and spacious. Looked just like the photos. Had everything we needed. Safe parking included. Great host responded very quickly to any questions.

great place. roomy, good wifi, clean.
Athini really great at communication.
we wished we'd had more time to stay there.

It was a beautiful place to stay close by the beach! Communication was great every time i needed something chris was there for me!
Thanks Athini

Was a really nice stay but in sep. it was to cold.. Fireplace and electrical heaters are there and helps a little bit.
Location is great, close to the beach and cafe, restaurants and supermarkets are also in short distance. We enjoy are stay despite the cold weather.
In kitchen you find everything and we cooked a lot.

I would recommend this house. It has loads of space and is close to the beach with lots of amenities nearby. It is  within walking distance of the beach with lots of restaurants, the train station and the Blue Bird Garage Market.  There were a few things that needed attention but they were either sorted quickly or easy to remedy and were possibly due to the previous guests.

Wonderful place! The atmosphere is even better than on the pictures. Stunning views and a spacious veranda. Well equipped kitchen and a neat house. Security is provided and Thomas as well as Barbara take care. Many thanks!

Litsa’s villa is incredible! We loved staying there and were so sad to leave. It couldn’t be in a better location, with Camp’s Bay beach a few mins walk away. The views really are the best and never grow old. The house itself is pristine and really well equipped with everything you need, with stunning interior design and finishes. There is a smaller apartment below Litsa’s but you don’t look over them and to be honest you don’t even know they are there as they are set further forward than you. Having use of the double garage is also extremely useful. All in all a brilliant property and we are trying work out how we can come back to stay again ASAP. Thanks so much :)

What a glorious glorious place! I rank it as certainly in my top 5 Airbnb stays, comparable to our stays in Malibu, Athens and Sonoma! We were met at the door by Carolyn who went over all the amenities! The view from the balconies are simply magnificent! 12 apostles, Camp's Bay beach and the sunset was fantastic! The villa was close to everything and in probably the most secure part of Capetown. Camp's Bay beach is a very short walk away. Within 25 mins, you would be able to be at VA Waterfront and Beau Constania (highly recommended!)
Just 18 mins to Table Mountain and even less to Signal Hill.
We were most certainly impressed and will recommend Ivory Villa to all our friends and family!

Absolutely out of this world. Beautiful property with stunning views. Spotlessly clean. Had everything we needed. Exceeded our expectations.
Would 100% recommend this property to anyone looking to stay in Camps Bay.
Joe answered any questions we had straight away, and was happy for us to store our suitcases in the garage until we were able to check in.
The views are just mesmerising from the balcony.
We would definitely book this place again. i felt very safe here.
Don't even bother looking anywhere else i can guarantee this place is probably
the best you will find.

This is one of those situations where you want to keep this place a secret but it was absolutely fantastic.  Views were gorgeous and it was a very easy walk to town. Couldn't recommend this place enough.
We couldn’t have wished for a better base in Camp’s Bay.  The view was out of this world and the house could not be better equipped.  We couldn’t recommend Ocean’s 33 enough.  We will be back!!

Loved Annick’s place at the heart of camps bay. Close enough to some restaurants and a beach and an incredible view of the water and mountains. Very central & close to everything. Loved the entire experience!

Honestly such an amazing stay. Beautifully designed , comfortable and perfect location.
Host is flexible and responsive. Will stay again when I’m back.
Thank you !

FANTASTIC VILLA!  Excellent location, convenient to walking into town with beach, restaurants, shopping. Villa is gorgeous and even better than photos!  It’s clean, modern, well-stocked with stunning views.  Annick, Joe and Tammy will take care of your every need. HIGHLY RECOMMEND-  5 Star++!!

This villa is perfect for a luxurious stay in Camps Bay. it offers both home comfort as well as spectacular feel good vibe from the moment you enter. The views are stunning and it could not be better located with great restaurants all close by as well as beautiful Camps Bay beach.
Annick is great to deal with and everyone connected to this villa could not do any more to make your stay 5 star. It certainly adds to all of the wonderful experiences that combine to make sure you want to go back to South Africa.
Huge thanks from all of us to Annick, Joe and Thandi - a very special trip in 2025.

Roger and Bev are extremely hospitable, and easy to get along with.
Nothing seems to be too much trouble.
The room offered is stylish, immaculate and has an exceptional view of the mountain from the bed
Big plus for a Luxurious clean bathroom

What a wonderful time we spend with Roger and Bev ! Perfect place to stay and plenty informations to get around.

Amazing hosts! Bev and Roger are the best. The location is wonderful, near everything you need and what a lovely beach nearby. View is amazing and room spotless and comfy! 10/10!
Will definitely be back!

Me and my fiancée had a quick stop here before heading out to the wine region and Rog&Bev could not have been better hosts. They truly embody the spirit of what airbnb should be. Awesome people with a private, quiet and clean flatlet.
Better than i had expected. Fabulous friendly but unobtrusive people. Thoughtful touches like booking my Uber and rinsing my filthy car for me.

The best place by far visited in fish hoek. The hosts were amazing and the view was even better. Will definately be back soon.

After only arriving to this beautiful accommodation after midnight, both Bev and Roger had waited up until we had arrived to check-in. Clean and tidy throughout with a great view of the mountains and some sea. The bed is absolutely, amazingly comfortable. Clean towels and linen. We will definitely be back and ensure to book with Bev and Roger for any further stays in Cape Town.

Bev and Roger are stellar hosts. My experience and stay was all the more special because of their hospitality and delightful company. I was able to enjoy their company as well as the privacy of the room when necessary. Their home is well worth visiting and returning to.

I would highly recommend this stay. The location is central to a number of activities and sights to see within the Kalk Bay area. Roger and Bev are extremely helpful with activity recommendations and make you feel right at home. The room has everything you need and is wonderfully decorated.
Rogar and his wife a very kind and friendly hosts, the place has a wonderful view. We had a beautiful stay and would for sure recommend their lovely place. Thank you again!

Bev and Roger are wonderful hosts. The place is really nicely decorated, very comfortable and in a very quiet residential area. You will be near the main spots to visit (Boulders, Cape of Hope...), the beach and tasty restaurants... a lovely getaway from busy Cape Town.

Robert and Bev are the perfect hosts!  From communication to check out everything was seamless. The views were to die for and the apartment was stunning. Everything they recommended was absolutely worth our while. Roger and Bev as so thoughtful and passionate beautiful souls. We cannot recommend this place enough!!! Thank you for a lovely stay.

Bev and Roger are wonderful hosts and welcomed me into their beautifully appointed and artfully decorated home with open arms. Kind and thoughtful,
they always went the extra mile to make me feel at home. A private and serene little space including a zen garden for me to chill in and with beautiful views over the Fish Hoek Valley. I couldn't have asked for more. I hope to return in the future.

I would definitely recommend Roger’s place. Roger and his wife were really lovely hosts. We got our privacy and the outside table and chairs were great for an evening dinners. The place is perfect for a romantic getaway or just to unwind.

Roger and Bev‘s place is amazing. The apartment itself has everything you need and is a great place to explore the surroundings. But even better are the hosts. Bev and Roger are very welcoming and open, they also gave us amazing recommendations for restaurants and things to do in the area and South Africa.
Definitely coming back!

The best and friendliest hosts and people, it was truly a blessing to have met and stayed with Roger and his beautiful wife. We felt right at home and will without a doubt stay with them every time I visit Cape Town.
Amazing room and amazing hosts! Super friendly and made us feel right at home! Would definitely visit again

Roger and Bev are fantastic hosts. They are warm, helpful in every way. Their accommodation includes an outside suntrap, a winter's morning dream.
A place you can call home away from home.

With no doubt it was our favorite accommodation during our 3 weeks trip. The room and bathroom are really comfortable. And Bev and Roger are so nice. Thanks a lot for your kindness. We have really enjoyed our 2 nights in fish hoek 😊😊

Roger & his wife Bev are fabulous hosts.
We made new friends & will definitely recommend anyone to use their place. They are very friendly & makes one feel right at home.
Roger and Bev were such great hosts and made me feel right at home. The place was beautiful and cosy. Will definitely be back again.

If you are looking for a quiet place with amazing views into the mountains, go and stay with Bev and Roger.
Very friendly, warmhearted people.
Highly recommended.
Thank you!!
Warm and generous hosts,  the room and attached bathroom were comfortable and well equipped. Excellent value for money and i loved the quirky artwork and zen garden in front.

My fiancé and I had a lovely 2 nights' stay at Roger and Bev's place. They were truly super hosts and very friendly. The location was safe, peaceful and had wonderful views from the porch. Roger and Bev are lovely hosts.
The place is quite and located on mountainside above Fishhoek. It has some gorgeous views. It was a very pleasant stay.

Roger and his wife are so so wonderful .people. (and so are their 2 cats!!) The born hosts. The room is beautiful, great view and close to everything even Kommetje, Kalk Bay and Noordhoek. The most hospitable people.

Such a lovely stay. I felt really safe as a single traveler because Roger and his wife were on the property. They were warm and welcoming. Great location for a long weekend on the Peninsula, close to everything.

perfect place to surf at sunset beach, close to shops and to the beach. You can leave your stuff inside the gate, and the car can be parked outside with no parking problem. We thanks Peter for the help he give to us and personally thanks to introduce me to the surfski club.
I hope to be back the next year.

roberto
Thanks for accommodating our late arrival. We had a comfortable stay and would defiantly recommend it. Beautiful location!

Peter's place is perfectly situated if you love walks on the beach and a great view of the mountain. For me it's perfect as my second office is in Century City so it was just a 10 minute drive into work while I was here.
Peter's got great recommendations for sporting activities like learning how to SUP or kite surf, but we were just here to chill.
We absolutely enjoyed our stay at Peter's. The area is quiet, very close to the beach and the studio flat has everything you need. Will definitely go back!

Verna’s house is a wonderful upmarket house that offers wonderful views of Table Mountain.

Great experience, great house, highly recommended.  Extremely accommodating  hosts; very open to special requests. Beautiful views, very comfortable upscale finishings.  Very responsive service. Very spacious and relaxing home; we stayed there with three generations, and it was equally enjoyable to all.  Can't wait until we have chance to return!!

If you are planning to visit Cape Town with your family or a large group i would recommend Verna's place.Close proximity to the beach, very secure, excellent facilities, clean home, amazing views and best of all a great host.

What an amazing experience! The house was perfect in terms of location, views and hosts. Verna and Mark were so helpful and easy to contact. The kids loved the heated pool. And you can’t beat the sunsets! Thanks again for a lovely stay in beautiful Cape Town!

The hosts Verna and Mark are fantastic!
They made their home kid friendly!
The house was styled perfectly
Both of them kept us up to date with load shedding schedules and things to do in and around Blouberg!
Wonderful views!
Beautiful garden and entertainment area!
Thank you for such an awesome holiday!

Verna is an incredible host: communicated so well with us before we arrived, recommended an amazing chef to cook for us during our stay and had so many thoughtful touches for us in the house on arrival.
The views from the home are beautiful; of both the ocean and Table Mountain. The living areas upstairs are spacious and we enjoyed watching the sunset over evening drinks. The home is walking distance from the beach which was great for our morning beach walks and coffee.
The pool water is a lovely temperature and the kids spent most afternoons in there.
We will definitely be back!

Verna’s home is more than amazing the photos don’t do it justice! The location is perfect for a beach base to visit this amazing city 💖 I am hesitant to recommend it too much as I don’t want it all booked up when we want to visit again!

Beautiful home away from home in a perfect location for seeing all Cape Town and its surrounding areas have to offer. What a view! Central location and comfort all the way.
10 sleeper double rooms with everything you need.
May you stay for summer, or winter, you will feel right at home.
Perfect location, amazing hosts and the most beautiful sunsets!
Thank you Verna for allowing us your space for the last couple of days of family time.

I’d happily return for future stays and would definitely recommend it to any of my friends. Beautiful, relaxed, safe and secure! Makes your holiday all the better! Absolutely stunning setting in a very good location. Margie was very friendly & welcoming.

Margie and her husband Neil and their sons are very nice and accommodating.
We would love to come back again.

Nice atmosphere, great hospitality. Margie and Neil were very friendly and helpful and nice to talk to, lovely hosts.

Margie was a great host. All that she promised, we received!! The location of this house is a once in a lifetime kind of stay. You’re right on the water, and the privacy of both the house and the beach was amazing. Our stay was delightful, definitely recommend!!
Everything was perfect for me. The location and hosting is just perfect for a rejuvenating get away. I do not plan to stay anywhere else but here during my solo trips to Cape Town.

What a place to spend your last weekend in CapeTown. Unique location, stunning walks and we did swim in the rock pools and not only to get our “five star” guest rating the host challenged us to. Thank you for our two day magical stay.

Margie's place is at the Waters Edge, and waking up to the sights and sounds of the Atlantic Ocean and Table Mountain was such a treat. She and her hubby Neil were so helpful throughout our stay. Wasn't it for the fact that the place was booked after our last day, we would had have extended our stay.
Just a garden gate between the studio and the ocean with really awesome footpaths and the most amazing views and sunsets.
A magical place with a breathtaking view and lovely hosts. Seeing whales from the rocks was a dream come true
A wonderful, safe location with lovely hosts who were very welcoming. Right on the rocks with direct access to the ocean and beaches via short paths.

Margie has been wonderfully welcoming, excellent communication, she gave us lots of recomandation around, and the place is even more beautifull than the pictures ! We ll definitely come back to Margies' !

A great studio apartment with some of the most stunning views you could ever wish to see. Neil & Margie were fantastic hosts, and we highly recommend their place for anyone wanting a relaxing few days, unrivalled sunsets and easy beach access.
Margie and her husband Neil were very welcoming and responsive to any issues always updating us had a lovely few days stunning sunset Thanks Niall and Lisa

Top top Airbnb. Beautiful house just stones throw from the beach. Clean separate bedroom / bathroom. Amazing couple (helped so much when we were trying to find a lost/stolen phone!) solid internet for any remote workers. Safe neighbourhood. Thanks for having us - We’ll be back 100%!!

Private room with private bathroom in a great home in secure neighborhood close to Big Bay and Melkbosstrand. Very friendly hosts with great recommendations for the area and restaurants. Had a fantastic stay.

We had an amazing stay!

Viv is a very nice host and her hour is wonderful. Very good vibes and you feel like at home.

We really enjoyed our stay, it was lovely ! Our hosts were very nice. Avril kindly made muffins for us when we arrived. She was always available for us and gave advices on what to do around Cape Town.

David and Vernon made us feel extremely welcome and their communication was fantastic. A chilled bottle of Chenin blanc was waiting for us on our arrival too! The place was amazing. We stayed in the studio and it was very nice and convenient. The best thing is the balcony and the view were we spent a lot of time during breakfast, in the afternoon and at night starring.

David and Vernon are great hosts. They helped us before arriving when we planned our trip from home and at sight giving us recommendations.

Excellent accommodation in a prefect location for frequent travel to the city centre.  Incredible view to enjoy; definitely my first choice for accommodation in Cape Town for business.

This was an idyllic experience from beginning to end. I had to collect my jaw from the floor when I walked in and got a glimpse of the view from the suite. The most stunning ocean views I've ever had at a place I've stayed. The unit itself is gorgeous and it is clear a lot of care went into putting together a simple yet modern, aesthetically pleasing, and highly functional unit. I wished I could have just moved in there.
The area is fantastic. The David and Vernon created a beautiful experience with very quick response to anything I needed. I couldn't recommend this place more strongly.
Wonderful stay. The pictures don't do the view justice. I strongly recommend bringing binoculars if possible to watch the ships, boats and yachts.

Such a amazing spot!
very comfortable with amazing views
will definitely be back!
The view from the apartment is amazing. And the kitchen is well equipped. Vernon is super responsive and welcoming host

Amazing stay in Vernon and David's place. The location of the flat is perfect to visit cape Town and to be in a walking distance to the stadium to be able to enjoy the RWC 7s. The view from the flat is beautiful, and I really thank our hosts to have welcomed my parents well.
Great place with nice view over Greenpoint. Uber to city centre takes a few minutes. Hosts are very friendly
Vernon is a fantastic hosty, very helpful and friendly. The apartment is just below Signal Hill with fantastic hiking opportunities.

Perched on the hillside of Signal Hill the apartment nestles like an eagles nest on the cliffs and provides a stunning 24/7 birds eye view of Green Point, Cape Town Stadium and the V&A Waterfront.
Everything works and access to a washing machine makes it truly a home from home experience. The queen size bed and mattress coupled with exceptional quality linen made sleeping an absolute pleasure.
The outdoor balcony was our daily meditation corner from where we viewed and listened to Cape Town's hustle and bustle whilst remaining completely unaffected.
Getting to Sea Point, the V&A or the City is literally less than 5 minutes by car and as such we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will definitely return for any future visits to Cape Town.

We truly enjoyed our time here and we’re delighted to find such a peaceful and clean flat with all the essentials in order. And the view is just magnificent, it can’t get better than that. Vernon is a wonderful host, responded quickly to all our requests. The location is perfect, easy access to everything that this incredible city has to offer. Cape Town stole our hearts! Highly recommended!

We stayed here for almost 2 weeks and we loved it here. Very close to hiking trails and near sea point and the waterfront. Very safe area. Was nice to have it's own garage for the car we rented. Laundry was also easy and would recommend especially for longer stays. The view from the apartment was also incredible. Vernon communicated very well to help us if we needed anything. Thank you for hosting us!

Vernon’s place is spectacular! The location is perfect at the base of signal hill in between green point and seapoint which made both neighborhoods easily walkable and we would uber or bolt back up the hill. The views are stunning! The bed was very, very comfortable and many thoughtful touches throughout the space, including a battery pack and cooking basics along with a nice welcome gift! Extremely flexible check-in and check-out times which allowed us a very smooth arrival and departure. Couldn’t have asked for a better first stay in Cape Town and already planning when we can go back

All I can say is, I can describe it to detail but one will not get the full picture. Stepping over that threshold and being greeted by the Majestic Atlantic Ocean with Robben Island gently blowing kisses of stories of the human spirit and resilience. 🥰🥰🥰🥰

I was in this house for the second time. The hosts are outstanding!
Friendly, polite and always taking care of their guests. I can highly recommend the stay in this appartement and it’s wonderful sight over the sea!
Everything was perfect - the apartment is located in a safe area with a great view over Green Point. Vernon was very kind and helpful.

Bettina ' s place was very nice! It's a Loveley house with a nice atmosphere. In the kitchen we had everything we need.  The garden and the pool were very nice. It was a nice walk to the lighthouse and the beach.

The Cottage was a great place. Located outside from the City Center on the Cape peninsula it is ideal to spend some quiet days in a nice surrounding. The ocean is just a 5 min. walk away with a beautiful old lighthouse nearby.
Bettina was a very kind and helpful host who did everything to make our stay as pleasant as possible and provided us with some valuable advice where to go and how to get there.
The house was clean and tastefully decorated, so it was a pleasure to return in the evening after a long and adventurous day and relax.

We had a fantastic stay at Kommetjie Cottages, Bettina was a wonderful host and gave us plenty of recommendations for restaurants and things to do around Cape Town. We loved the Cottages, beautiful period buildings with gorgeous gardens and located in the most beautiful area outside Cape Town. The cottage we stayed was spacious, very comfortable and decorated very tastefully. The Cottages are located 30 to 40 mins outside the city, 20 mins drive from Cape Point and you have a multitude of things to do and to see in the area.
I would highly recommend anyone to stay in Kommetjie Cottages, i fell in love with the place and wouldn't want to stay anywhere else when i'm in Cape Town.

We really enjoyed our 1 week stay at this quiet little cottage. The Cape Dutch cottage felt safe and secluded although there are other cottages on the property. The grounds are beautiful with great views of the sea and it was lovely having a swimming pool above the cottage to use in the mornings.  Bettina was always close by to help and if asked, made great suggestions of places to eat and visit. One of her suggestions, the open market at Cape Point Vineyard nearby was one of the highlights of our trip. Kommetjie is close to Fish Hoek, Noordhoek and Simon's Town and is less than an hour drive from Cape Town CBD in one direction and Cape Point in the other. An ideal location for exploring the Cape peninsula. Thanks Bettina!
We had a lovely stay and it was wonderful to be so near to the sea. The cottage was spacious and clean and comfortable. Although part of a few cottages on the premises, this cottage is private.
We have very much enjoyed our stay at Kommetjie Cottages and can only recommend others to come and appreciate the cottage and Bettina + Dieter warm welcome. We'll come again for sure!!!
i loved this place, so chilled and what a veiw! Dieter and Bettina were great hosts and very approachable. We'd definitely go back
What a lovely, quiet place tucked away in a pretty coastal town. Everything we needed was available and Bettina was an attentive and thoughtful host. Definitely a place I’d recommend.
Lovely stay at Bettina and Dieter’s family home. Super welcoming from offers to loan his board to Christmas cookies from Grandma.

We spent out first few nights in SA here and are really happy with everything! The place is very nice, spacious and the common garden and pool are fantastic too! Bettina and Dieter were lovely hosts, very caring and communicative. We enjoyed every minute and can only recommend it! Thank you Bettina and Dieter for a lovely stay!

This is a fabulous base for beach babes, surf lovers and sunset contemplators .  The historic house is in the heart of the village, close to the board walk and good swimming and surfing spots.  It’s a wonderful location to watch the sun go down, after an exhilarating day in the ocean, and see the lighthouse swing into action.

Had a great stay at the venue. It was quite the cold weekend and we were not geared for the  cold weather, luckily we found extra blankets in the cupboard.  You can see the lighthouse when you walk up to the swimming pool otherwise not much of a view unless you leave the cottage.

We were very happy to spend a few days at Bettina's cottage. We had a very relaxing time, the garden is incredibly beautiful and our young son enjoyed exploring every corner of it! Very quiet place, very close to all amenities. And we enjoyed the kindness and hospitality of Bettina and Dieter. We'll come back!
We had a great time at Bettina's cottage! Beautiful garden, walking distance to the beach and very friendly host!
Really enjoyed our stay, Betinna and her husband are very hospitable and we got some great tips about the surroundings.  We really felt at home and would love to stay at their place again.

Great stay with the most amazing garden. The host is also really nice and helps out with tips and other questions you have. We had a lovely week at this place. Defenitely would go back! The utilities are basic but it has everything you need.

Everything went great during our stay. Bettina and her husband are really kind and good hosts. House is clean and everything is like described. House is very close to the light house. And the sleep was the best we remember in long time :)))

What a lovely cottage located close to the centre of a peaceful beachside town, yet on the edge so it feels a bit wild and windswept. The garden is beautiful and many layered with ideal spots built in to enjoy the spectacular views. Dieter made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed, and was very welcoming of the kids. Overall a great stay!

We had a great time at Bettina's Cottage and fell in love with the place and surroundings. It is in a small surf town, right next to the ocean and the lighthouse. It was tough for us to leave. We definitely would love to come again! Thanks again to Bettina and her husband for being such great hosts and for sharing this beautiful place!

The most beautiful and Idyllic stay. Bettina and  Dieter were wonderful communicators, made us feel right at home and we would come back in a heart beat. Our whole family loved it. Thank you Bettina and Dieter! A secret oasis.
This is a beautiful apartment and only overshadowed by the warm and friendly nature of the hosts. You will love everything about this place.
Perfect! A wonderful experience in a lovely apartment ... Yvette went out of her way to make sure we were well taken care of. Loved the views and special touches! We will be back.
good check in, absolutely fantastic and unforgottable view on table mountain!!! confi bad - was a good stay!

Great place, well located for us who wanted to be more northerly located. Incredible views, more than what we needed in the apartment. Parking secure and easy, great to have the 24/7 security staff too even though the area seems fine. The hosts are very welcoming and helpful.
Yvette was extremely helpful, responsive and it was a pleasure to stay at her place. Will stay again.
Amazing place with breath taking views. Close to everything. Secure and such a beautiful apartment. Couldnt have ask for any better. We enjoyed every minute of our stay. Highly recommended

Roger and Yvette were extremely accommodating and helpful.  There was no electricity at the time of check in and they told us to stay at the wfront until it came on ( 10.30pm)  so that we would not be in the dark.  Roger ws kind enough to get us a bottle of wine that night and even help me load airtime on my phone for my GPS the next day.  Btw the best view of both worlds and a very clean apartment . ps..I am very hard to please :)
Stylish details to the apartment that overlooks beach,  sea and Table Mountain.  Would love to come back to this place.

We had a wonderful stay . The apartment was lovely. We had all the amenities needed, the location was superb, and the view was just amazing. We had an ideal view of the New Year’s Eve firework display across the bay from the porch. I can’t recommend this place even more.  The hosts were extremely helpful with recommendations and were easily accessible if needed.  It made our first trip to Cape Town unforgettable.

Outstanding value for money. Super stylish apartment which was sparkling clean with all the bells and whistles. The hosts are fantastic and everything was exactly as advertised. We had a great stay and would definitely return.
Very transperant and helpful host. Very lovely. I would have loved to meet with her in person. Thank you for a wonderful time
This is very comfortable apartment with the best appliances, lovely parking and Roger is an absolute star. Thank you, Clive and Jane.

Thoughtfull, sincere and attentive host who is willing to go the extra mile for guests.
Accommodating and welcoming for any family, couple or solo traveler.
The apartments were well maintained and have everything you need. Just ask.
The pool was warm and cleaned on the daily.
Overall. Great stay!

Great place and great space. Very conveniently located to the local shops, malls, the beach and local transport links. Fabrizio is very knowledgeable about a lot of stuff and always on hand to help with anything you want or just for a chat. Great and accommodating host. I’ll be back again in the summer to enjoy the beautiful pool.

Everything was perfect as advertised.
Will definitely book again when in that area.
Highly recommended !!
An honest and funny person -> Fabrizio :-) We enjoyed our stay in his apartment. It was clean, quiet and we had a pool. We can warmly recommend a stay there.

Cosy and tidy spot and even though it was a short stay I appreciated the warm welcome from Fabrizio - you can certainly sense he knows alot about the area and that he prioritize high guest hospitality :)

Nice and spacious unit in a great area! Would've liked to visit the beach, but the weather was bad. The staff on site is very friendly and helpful. Will certainly use this unit again when I am in that Milnerton/Blouberg area. Thank you Fabrizio

Our experience at Alexander Beach Studio was great. The position is A1.
Both Chris and Lloyd were very receptive and attentive to our needs. There was a few issues with internet and electricity dropping out but that was more a reflection on the area than the property itself. The view is breathtaking and I would definitely stay there again.
Very nice place and well managed. Only could stay 2 nights. But I wish it was longer. Thanks

Great location. Everything is 10min walk away. Stunning view and sound of the sea.
Inside little fireplace was a fantastic feature for the cold nights.
Great hosts.
The building in the house across the street could be a distraction for business travellers like me who had to spend hours on VC calls but the overall positives of the place was worth it for me.
Lovely studio with a nice view of the beach, clean, with the utilities you need…and we enjoyed the overall floor plan, felt spatious and great location to walk around in the area!

Great location in Camps Bay! Easy walk to the beach, restaurants and shops. This place had everything we needed for a week and the proximity to the beach was a huge bonus. We would stay here again for sure.
Perfectly located in Camps Bay with a view of the beach. We really enjoyed our stay there!

Great place with excellent view at the beach. It felt safe and peaceful. We were very well received at the appartment at the day of arrival and our host not only walked us through everything the appartement has to offer, but also kindly helped us on our way with any questions we had.

The villa and it's apartment Noble View is in one of the nicest parts of Cape Town. We got a warm welcome and felt we could get back to Karin whenever we would need help. Arriving on a sunny day we have been overwhelmed by the stunning view from the apartment - looking out on the ocean even while taking a shower. To top this we had the luck to even watch a whale family playing and eating. The bed was very comfortable and the whole interior of the apartment was of high quality and spotless clean. I would recommend Noble View to all my friends and family without a doubt.

This place was the best stay I've ever had and I've been travelling a lot and stayed in many nice places. The apartment is fantastic and has all the things you need (fiber wifi, kitchen accessories, cable tv etc), the service is very accomodating and last but not least, the view from the front yard/pool/lounge area is breathtaking. I'm already longing back. Thank you so much for two amazing weeks!
Nice place, especially for kiters right on the spots. Restaurants and bars just around the corner. The host was very nice, helpful and friendly!

It was very easy to communicate with CB-one, before we arrived as well as during our stay when we had questions. The place is in an idyllic location, is very peaceful and the views are incredible! It would take us a few minutes to drive into Camps Bay and about 10 mins to drive to Kloof or Bree street, where there are some great cafes and restaurants. We also used Uber a lot in the evenings and drivers are never more than 5 mins away. Our room was very tidy and well-equipped before we arrived and also got cleaned every day, which was an added bonus. We had a superb time here and would highly recommend this place as a place to stay.

What you see is what you get. Beautiful apartment with impeccable finishes. Stunning ocean views and tranquil space for some R & R.

Paul and the host were very accommodating. The service and facilities were excellent, I highly recommend this apartment. We’ll be back!

Staying at CB ONE was absolutely amazing. The flat was very stylish but cozy at the same time. The bed was so comfortable and the pool and views from the property were unbeatable. Karin and Elri were super helpful all the way through incl. recommendations and restaurant bookings. They even offered laundry services. We had a incredible time. Can only recommend!

Stunning view over Camps Bay especially for watching the beautiful sunsets in Cape Town. The infinity pool is insane, we had the best time of our vacation there. Super clean, light, stylish and modern Appartement. We had a very warm welcome from Elri, thank you so much for all the recommendations and inspirations for Cape Town. We will definitely come back !

Mary-Louise was very helpful prior to our arrival and was even patient when I forgot she had already given me instructions for the apartment. The place was great as well and I would definitely recommend her properties!

This was the best airbnb experience ive personally had to date. The house is situated literally right on the ocean, and it seems as if the water goes right under the house. The inside of the house is almost as stunning as the outside. Pictures cant do it justice. This place is magical and made us feel like celebrities. Everything is walkable and parking was easy. Mary Louise is wonderful as well. All in all an incredible experience. We also became friends withe folks who were renting the downstairs and the whole house is AMAZING. Thank you!
2nd time staying at the house - loved it. Extremely close the the beach and restaurants.

Incredible spot - right on the beach with spectacular views.  We didn't want (or need!) to go anywhere else, so we pretty much stayed here and enjoyed the sights, sounds and smells of the ocean! Highly recommended!

This listing exceeded every expectation. It was clean, great location, gorgeous beach front views, and so well-decorated. We plan to return and rent or the whole bungalow...top and bottom floors...for a family trip.

Everything has already been said, stunning location right on the beach, and beautiful decoration!
Like a lot of places in South Africa, not very well heated in winter, but this is compared to our European standards ;) the floor heating is working well after a few hours and turned at max.
Very quiet area, not dangerous and only noise that you hear are waves!

The penthouse is even more beautiful and spacious than the pictures can show - all of the furnishings and decor are well appointed and exude a relaxed African beach style.  We were so comfortable here.  We visited in winter so did not use the pool but we did enjoy the balcony on sunny days especially enjoying the sunsets... the view is breath-takingly spectacular - beach, waves, rocky coves, mountains... what more could you want?!  ML is a wonderful host - she is not only very responsive and pleasant to deal with but she is a genuinely caring person - we could tell she really wanted us to enjoy our stay.  Visiting here is an experience we will not forget.  We hope to come back one day - thanks so much for sharing your place with us, ML.
You won't be disappointed! Fantatic place to stay and either relax or enjot the offerings of the city around you.

Mary-Louise’s place is a perfect spot to explore what the Cape is offering, yet secluded and quiet on the Glen Beach. The place is very tastefully decorated, creating a relaxing and a bit eclectic atmosphere. The beach has a private entrance to the downstairs bungalow and one of the bedrooms and terrace have fantastic views to the ocean. Definitely stay again.

We had a fantastic stay in this beautiful apartment.  The location and view is even more spectacular than we expected, and its kitted out with everything we could possibly have wanted! Mary-Louise and her team were extremely helpful and accommodating.  Cannot recommend this highly enough.

Husband review: We absolutely loved 12 Glen Beach. The decor, the view, the location - everything was absolutely perfect and I recommend Mary-Louise and her beautiful home. We will be back!
Wife review: I couldn’t imagine a better place to stay. Every detail thought about, the style is impeccable, the house is spotless and all accommodations are provided (the house was made up every day, laundry done, put away dishes etc). The space is so remarkable you’ll find it hard to leave the house...we ate dinner a few nights on our porch bc the view was unbeatable, sunset view is probably the best on the beach! You can walk into town for a lunch or dinner if you’d like as well. Perfectly located!

I had such a relaxing time at Mary-Louise’s place. It was the perfect environment for me to take a few days to myself, get some work done, and enjoy Cape Town’s beauty. I would reccommend this place to absolutely anyone, it is truly lovely.

Beautiful view and great location! For future visits we would definitely stay here again. Mary-Louise was very accommodating and quick to respond. Perfect balcony to watch sunsets and the surfers. Short walk to multiple great restaurants. Easy to get to table mountain park. Would highly recommend!
Just wonderful - even better than it looks on the photos!  Mary-Louise and Sean are very friendly and helpful. Everything was perfect :-)

Rented for my daughter and boyfriend. Would highly recommend 100 percent. The location is breathtaking and apartment was absolutely stunning. They enjoyed their weekend away and have already booked to go back. Mary-Louise is an outstanding host and went above and beyond to make it a nice stay  for them -5 stars for sure

This place was stunning! Perfect location, perfect interior and perfect views! We stayed here for one leg of our honeymoon and it was a truly special experience. Really easy to get to surrounding attractions so we were able to cram a lot into a week but the best bit was the amazing sunset every night from either the balcony or the beach literally on the doorstep.

The location of this place is so spectacular. The design capitalises on the view with an easy flow for a relaxed stay. It feels very secure while still being spacious. The hosts went out of their way to make it feel homely, luxurious and lovely.
It is absolutely amazing. Just a beautiful location and Mary-Louise was wonderful. I would definitely visit it again.

Beautiful place to stay, right on the beach and a short walk to the shops, restaurants of Camps Bay. We really enjoyed to just spend time at the house, relaxing on the deck and taking in the view.
Mary-Louise is a great host, easy going and organized. Was my third time staying at one of her properties.
Highly recommended.

Fantastic house in the most perfect location - great for a relaxed stay, perfectly suited to families. Antje and her family were wonderful hosts and looked after us well throughout our stay, with great communication and thoughtful touches. Couldn’t recommend the place enough, we’ll be back!

A beautiful house with stunning views. Antje and Thomas were extremely helpful and welcoming.
5 stars!

Highly recommended accommodation; clean, secure, comfortable and well appointed.  Loved the views to the west from the balcony.  Close to the restaurants and shops.  Warm hosts who settled us in quickly with plenty of tips for local attractions.

Antje and Thoma's place is really a little paradise. I strongly recommend this accommodation. The house was spacious and the fire place is an amazing touch for those cold winter nights.  The views are amazing and amenities ( shops, vineyards, ocean, nightlight) are a 5 min drive away.

Little Paradise is truly a paradise. It has everything that you need. Situated in the right place, 15 min drive to the places that you would want to visit. Antje was an amazing host. She was kind enough to check us in at 3.30 am as we got stuck on the road due to fog. She made us comfortable and we felt like we were home. Definitely going back to Little Paradise!
This is a lovely home away from home! It is clean, has great WiFi, and all you need for a working holiday.

Shelagh was a wonderful host! Easy to contact, quick to respond and very accommodating. Pin Oak is a lovely flat with beautiful decor and extremely comfortable and clean. You have great privacy and it feels just like a home away from home. The flat also has a great location and is close to lots of popular places. Will definitely return :)

Privacy, comfort, design, creativity, tranquility, relaxation and more
All these details in this wonderful house.
All the details that make you enjoy your home are provided, there are daily cleaning and changing towels.
Safety is very high, private parking is close to the house directly.
Delivery services from restaurants are available, home location next to a wonderful garden and tennis.
It is very nice to re-experience my beautiful experience at this house, I highly recommend it.

Great host. My flight landed pretty late but she was still there waiting to check me in. The place is exactly how it looks in the pictures which was great. The house was always kept neat and tidy. Overall, great host and would most definitely recommend it for someone
Happy to have stayed at Shelagh’s beautiful place again! As good as we remembered it to be! The hot water bottles were a great touch for the cold, rainy weather
This is an awesome private flatlet with wonderful space. Shelah is a fantastic host. We would love to stay here again.
Everything one could need in an extremely neat apartment. Lots of extra touches to make me feel welcome.
This little treasure cove is better than i expected. The bedding is hotel quality. The bathroom is beautiful. It has everything you need to cook. I really liked it here!
We had a lovely stay. The cottage is very comfortable and homey with charming decor and lots of amenities. Location is easy to access but best to have a car.

Excellent ! The best location in Cape Town !
You might find something cheaper, but for the difference, you are highly recommended to take this apartment which is run by hospitality professionals.

We had a perfect stay at the Hyde Hotel for 3 nights. It is located just next to the beach and many restaurants nearby. Also the place was perfect, and just like the pictures. It was a great stay and I can recommend this place to everyone.

The unit was exactly as pictured and overall a very nice place to stay.  We loved the modern finishes and the large living area.  The bedroom was a bit small and not ideal location for the bathroom through the bedroom, but it was fine for a couple and we did not find it to be inconvenient.  Being located inside the hotel was a bonus - as the rental came with all of the hotel amenities such as the pool, concierge, and housekeeping.  We were able to add on breakfast for an additional fee. Location was very close to the ocean and quick walk or Uber to restaurants, cafes and nightlife.  Great view from the pool deck (not really any view from room).  Overall, very nice place to stay.
