excellent location, pool nice, staff very friendly. the bathroom needs updating and showing its age and the bedroom was tight with hardly any room to move around the bed or store suitcases. otherwise a nice size lounge and kitchen but could do with more TV channels.
Very stylish and clean apartment only a few hundred meters from the Sea Point promenade. Melindie was quick to respond to our request for a earlier check in. We had a great stay and will be back.
The location is excellent, however general maintenance especially at pool deck was lacking. Nobody cleaned or cleared the pool area. Staff were friendly and efficient at reception.

Great little hotel in a cool location of town. For convenience, location and amenities, it gives you exactly what you need if you're looking for a hotel. Perfect as a base to explore the city, for early morning runs by the Promenade and easy trips to the mountain, beach and City. A very walkable area as well.
However, do note, that this is a hotel and not the typical type of accommodation one finds on AirBnB. The rooms can pass as small apartments, but it is foremost a hotel room with common areas, hotel breakfast, bars, etc. If you're looking for a boutique hotel, it's great.
Great spot located in the heart of Sea Point in the vicinity of the boardwalk as well as nice restaurants and shops.
Happy to have stayed here. WiFi didn’t work which was a hassle. Amazing pool. Good location. Furniture old and dusty. Staff were great and friendly.
Had amazing time at this property, Hymie was very welcoming and an overall great host. I will certainly be coming back in the near future! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Hymie wants you to feel at home. Very hospitable and I felt welcome. Had some lovely Braais!

Hymie was a great host and the stay was as expected. Location is great it’s a lovely house which is also safe and good for single traveler’s. Hymie was also very helpful and always ready to help wherever he can. Thank you I will come back

Best host I have met! Very helpful and kind and even a good tour guide for a bike tour!
The views of the airbnb are amazing to the ocean and also right by the lion‘s head! Safe neighborhood, big rooms and cozy place!
Looking forward to my next stay at Hymie‘s airbnb! :)

We had a wonderful time and we felt right at home. Hymie is a wonderful host and very friendly and welcoming. His premises look better than the actual photos. The views are breathtaking. Love love it😍.

We had a fantastic week away at Hymie’s place! He was always welcoming and had lots of great tips about activities in the area, not to mention his beautiful home. Hymie truly made our holiday complete, and I would recommend this place to everyone!
Great spot, it's just off the myciti bus route so you can get anywhere you need to easily. Jean-Pierre is lovely to deal with. Thank you for a lovely experience.

We really enjoyed our stay in this beautiful home. The place was spotlessly clean, with a very well stocked kitchen with everything we needed. We spent hours sitting on the veranda with partial ocean views and the sound of the waves. We appreciated the freshly laundered and soft linen and comfortable beds, and the little details.

The place is very nice, clean and has all the convienience you want in your vacation. The location is amazing, second row to the beach and walking distance to nice coffee shops, delis and the best surfing beach on the western cape. It was a great pleasure staying here and enjoying nature, ocean and beautiful sunsets.
Shona's place is a very nice stay. the place is beautifully arranged and is very relaxing. the views around the place were amazing. My family and I really enjoyed our stay!

We are so thrilled to got to know Shona and this awesome Arum Place. Shona spoiled us with her hospitality & kindness. And Arum Place was definately the best accomodation we had during our four weeks travelling through South Africa.
Already feeling homesick for Kommetjie and this wonderful home far from home !
We will come back - thanks a million for everything !!!

The apartment inside of the beautiful home was absolutely stunning, had so many extras and just so cosy!! We didn’t get to use the outside spaces like the pool and fire pit but still really enjoyed the stay. The beds are 5 star and the apartment is super clean.
We really enjoyed our stay. You can also rent the entire home or just the apartment. A easy check in and out and a super safe and secure area of kommetjie.
Thanks again 🔆💛

A pleasant and quaint place to retreat to.
Very tastefully styled
With no clutter.
I will highly recommend it.
We had a fantastic stay in Kommetjie. The house was in a good location with easy access to the beach and coastal path. I can recommend the property.

What a superb house for family accommodation. Brilliant location away from the chaos of Camps Bay and the like, never got caught up in traffic. Beaches are all so close, we used Fishoek, Noordhoek Long Beach and Llundudno. Nothing was too far away, we did it all. What a superb location with all the amenities that you could possibly require. We will be back!

Werner is a very nice man and his house is perfect no far to the city center. Excellent room.
Thanks you for the time to give me.
It was pleasure to meet him and Hope to come back to you in others travels
Sincerely
Mostapha
Werner was very friendly and welcoming.    Made coffee and breakfast in the mornings and invited me to sit breakfast table with him.
Great place to stay in the Observatory! The room is spacious, has it's own bathroom. Tastefully decorated home and welcoming host.

This is my first Airbnb experience and I couldn't ask for more. The location is great (central to everything), the house is clean and comes with all the amenities that you need. The host, Richard is very helpful and shows great hospitality. For example Richard went out of his way to help us book a restaurant, provided us with his My City card (for free!) so that we can experience the bus tours and ensured that our internet access is always working. He welcomes you with his open arms and will not hesitate to offer his help. Overall, he is a really good host. Highly recommend this location to all travelers.

Richard is a fantastic host. The apartment is really spacious and everything you would need is there. The place is very secure and all the pedestrians that walk past stop and look at the place. The other people staying in the other apartments are very friendly and helpful.
There is a Super Spar nearby and restaurants are plentiful. Public transport is on your doorstep. To take a walk is very nice and the park and sea is nearby.
The area is very quite and you get used to the traffic very easy.

we definitely chose the right location for the beginning of our south africa vacation. camps bay is a rich and calm neighboorhood with a great beach. the room was clean and cool, although a little cold in september. there were lots of nice people living there or staying in the big shared house for a couple of months. they like to party and its nice to join them. we'd definitely go there again

First class in every respect. Peter deserves the title of Super Host and his property at 1 Clyde Street, Greenpoint, Cape Town is superb.
The building was formerly a small church which, with the use of great architecture and interior design, has been transformed into a most comfortable and modern interior.
Peter's eclectic design style has resulted in a beautiful interior space that has every mod-con.
Even though Peter's space is filled with beautiful objects and furniture he is not 'precious' about it, to the extent of even being pet-friendly. I brought along my 2 miniature Schnauzer dogs without any problems, with the understanding that the dogs were always under my supervision and 100% house trained.
This is one of the best places I have ever stayed at, in the 30 years of my extensive traveling both within South Africa and overseas.

Truly a 5 star home in every way.  Great secure location and easy walking distance to shops and restaurants.  Easy access to to Green Point park.  The home is beautiful  and Peter and Giselle made our stay very easy and comfortable.  Everything is exactly as it appears in their ad and this is a true value for the quality and location.

The church-house is really something special. It is impressive and cool but so homely too. Each different section is so well designed it feels just right, Peter and Gisella have thought of everything. I would 100% recommend staying here. They are fantastic hosts who go above and beyond and really care that you have an enjoyable time there. It felt like home (but way more glamorous!)
Great place, beautifully styled, very big, well situated. Really enjoyed my stay. Will definitely be back!

Gisella was a standout host. She was responsive and flexible to our requests and check-in/check-out was a breeze. The space is exactly as pictured: stylish, comfortable and unique. Truly a special place and rare find in Cape Town.

This was the MOST amazing Airbnb I have ever stayed in!!! The hosts were so welcoming and met me upon arrival!  The house was beautifully decorated!   It just felt like home with extra beautiful frills and opulence!! I will be staying here every single time I come to CPT!
Had an amazing stay. Gisella met us and went through everything in detail. The house is beautiful and unique in a perfect position. Wonderful stay.
The lady that I meant on the way out was pretty rude considering we left the place spotless and payed a cleaning service fee, the owner though is lovely and the space magical
This is a bucket list type of place. Extremely comfortable, unique and just plain cool! Peter is a generous host and a genuinely interesting human being with top notch taste.

Incredible stay at Peter's place! His home truly exceeded expectations and is beautifully decorated and a fun place to spend time enjoying the scenery. The location is also very convenient and a quick walk to some great restaurants and a short drive to just about anywhere you'd want to visit. Peter so welcoming at check in and incredibly responsive during our stay. We were also so very appreciative of Peter letting us stay for a super late check out- it made our midnight flight departure that much more tolerable. Would recommend this place in a heartbeat- a great deal for the area and a very memorable stay.

Staying at Peter's place was truly wonderful ! It is a unique experience to live in an old church, and at the same time in a very well designed, modern interior with carefully picked design pieces. All amenities and security are top notch. Peter was very responsive and friendly and told us about the history of the place. Check-in was flexible and easy. The place is well located, close to restaurants in green point. We felt so comfortable we could have stayed much longer if we didn't need to fly back. Thank you Peter for being such an amazing host, we look forward to staying at your place again!

The Church is unlike anything we have stayed in before. It’s not only full of history it’s also got modern touches that make it very unique. The bathrooms and bedrooms and kitchen are stunning and so is the architecture.
Peter has been extremely helpful and responsive and attended to our queries super promptly.
The area is very convenient with amazing restaurants and Greenpoint Park on your doorstep , all walkable.
A truly special place and a must stay in Cape Town!

Peter’s place was absolutely stunning—full of charm, character, and exactly as described in the listing. From the moment we booked, Peter was incredibly responsive and helpful, making the entire experience seamless. The home itself was beautifully designed, well-equipped, and made for a comfortable and memorable stay. The location was fantastic—walkable to so many great spots, making it easy to explore Cape Town. If you’re looking for a place that blends style, convenience, and a welcoming host, this is it. My colleagues & I would highly recommend staying here!

Beautiful place. Not super practical for basic things. No communal shower so the person in the other bedroom had to use our bedroom to shower. No door from bedroom to bathroom so not good for privacy. . Good tv/speaker set up.
the host is quite lovely,I think I enjoyed my sleep,access to just walk 50m and meat the beach and also shopping complexes are not that far,really enjoyed my stay.
Loved my stay in the apartment. It was clean and tidy. Loved the views and the location was perfect 😊

It was a pleasant surprise to arrive in a beautiful, clean and perfectly located apartment. The view over the ocean was breathtaking.  The hosts were always available, friendly and willing to assist with any request. I would recommend this appartment for anyone.

Love love love the view of the ocean at St Tropez. Great host. Thank you for small important touches like dishwashing liquid and coffee sugar etc and other basic essentials. Despite bad weather we thoroughly enjoyed our stay we just wish we could have stayed longer.

The views of the e mountains and ocean is spectacular.
The inverter, backup battery and uncapped Wi-Fi, really made our stay pleasant
Overall we’ve enjoyed our stay
Unfortunately I wasn’t able to stay at the Apartment because of delayed Flights. For cancellation was it to late.
It was my best Christmas, with the best views. The flat was perfect and the hosts were great!

Stayed at Rob’s Airbnb for a month and had an amazing time! Two minute walk down to the beach to watch sunsets! Five minute walk to the shops and restaurants. Very safe and secure and such a lovely area and such an amazing space! Will 100% stay here again. Thank you again to the hosts!

I really had great first time in South Africa.Teresa help me a lots even before we arrived the Country.she gave  me the information to somewhere like safari and so on. Her place nearby has many interesting thing keep Me busy during the two weeks and nice environment.very lovely cats and dogs.kind and attentive family near also.just like stay myself home.and just driving a little bit to downtown and beach and wine farm.monkey town .cheetah. Quite and safety then Cape Town city center.

Thersa was a fantastic host, made us feel very welcome. The apartment was clean, comfortable and in an ideal location to visit the local vineyards, beaches and surrounding areas. Would highly recommend.

If you are staying in Cape Town for a while it is a really good idea to stay in different places, and for me the Newlands area worked well, so handy for Kirstenbosch Gardens, for cricket at Newlands (and rugby, which is next door) but also for driving to other parts of the city and beyond, as Judy's house is in a very secluded road but close to main roads. A car is pretty much essential, I would say. The accommodation is tucked away in a beautiful back garden and very comfortable, secure and well appointed and Judy and James were really helpful and generous to me, their first Airbnb guest!

Judy and James were delightful! The room was comfortable and I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. I was recovering from being sick and Judy even brought me an omlette for dinner one night with the fresh vegetables from the garden. Delicious! They were even kind enough to drive me back into Cape Town on their way out of town. I would absolutely stay again!

Considerate host with warm welcome (fruits and nice muffins). Safe and peaceful place with clean room and all facilities.  Highly recommended for those looking for a peaceful stay. Mall not far away (10 mins walk).
The place has most things any visitor might require. The garden brings a pleasant relaxing feel to the place. Hikes and restaurants/shops within walking distance.
As described, Judy's place is a rustic retreat in the middle of the city. Stunning views from the back garden which is a working garden.

I had a lovely stay at Urban Farm cottage. It's beautifully situated in Newlands with a stunning garden and mountain views. The apartment is very comfortable, with very hospitable hosts! I can definitely recommend it
Had a wonderful stay with Judy and James. Very quiet cottage, and Judy's bran muffins were amazing :)
Judy"s place is very cozy and neat. The cottage is situated in the Newlands area: close to EVERYTHING important in Cape Town. I even walked to the Kirstenbosch gardens.
This is the perfect Place to explore capetown and surounding and also a quite oasis for coming home after a long day. Thanks a lot for a great time in your beautiful garden cottage.

Judy and James were great hosts - very friendly and accommodating. Judy even made muffins and sandwiches for me on arrival which was a lovely touch! The location was also wonderful - very peaceful and close enough to get to all the central locations by car or even on foot (depending on where you want to go). I highly recommend a stay here for anyone visiting Cape Town.
Great hosts, lovely personal touches, very quiet and comfortable; everything I needed and more.  The muffins were a real treat too.
Thank you Judy and James for my very pleasant stay and all your friendliness.  You both are such lovely people and I enjoyed every minute interacting with the two of you.

Thank you Judy and James for being for warm and welcoming hosts and for making my stay so enjoyable.
The cottage is so quiet, neat and comfortable. Your muffins was such a sweet touch and the vegan meal was so thoughtful!
Your kindness and chats was appreciated. It was nice to get to know you a little. Thank you again for you kind invite to join you at the Oranjezicht Market!
I look forward to booking your place again.
Great place to stay in Cape Town. The location allows for easy access to most of the area. Judy is a very thoughtful and accommodating host, and the value is tremendous.
I enjoyed my stay at Judy’s lovely garden flatlet, and wouldn’t hesitate to return on a future visit to Cape Town. It is well situated in a serene environment.

I loved my stay with Judy and James, they are lovely friendly folk who help out where they can. The Urban Farm Cottage lies in a peaceful garden with a view of table mountain from the window. The cottage was within easy walking distance from Cavendish Square and the UCT Campus, very convenient for the the 2 oceans run and a lovely home from home.

Perfect hosts, I always felt safe and secure in their beautiful property.
Excellent privacy and sparkling clean - will stay again.

If you want to stay in one of Cape Towns best areas this is the place.Nice comfortable place,homely feel.Great bed.Beautiful mountain backdrop,safe and secure,nice people.
Well recommended.
Very pleasant surrounds, hosts are friendly but not intrusive. Comfortable cottage - a lovely place to stay.

Judy’s place is as described and very homely. Little touches like home made scones and cake made all the difference. The location was excellent and very quiet and safe. The amenities in the place were very good and the availability of a small kitchenette was a bonus as we could make our own breakfasts and chill the beer and wine for our sundowners in the garden. The bed linen was good quality and the bed very comfortable. The only thing I would say is that the walls and ceiling in the bedroom were showing signs of wear and tear and would benefit from a repaint at some point soon.
A very cosy and perfect spot nestled in the heart of Newlands. Everything you need and wonderful, thoughtful hosts. The space was very clean and neatly laid out. We will definitely be visiting again.

Windows need repair. This place is cold to stay in winter. It gets quite cold with drafts.
The building is not new. It should be provided with reasonable repairs.
Judy and James have an excellent lil farm cottage with a great vibe. Don't miss out on a dinner in the garden!

Lovely garden setting and very private and quiet. No disturbances from anyone or anything. It’s just very warm in there and there is no aircon during hot Feb week/s. A pedestal fan is provided but that wasn’t enough for me. I did get attacked verbally a bit on my early departure (as I checked out days early) which was not appreciated because I left without explaining why but they were not home to explain why to (as I asked for them before I departed).
This was a lovely stay surrounded by a beautiful garden with a wonderful view and a comfortable bed! I even received a hot cross bun which was one of the best ever.

Judy's place is in a peaceful, well tree'd neighbourhood, and her garden attracts some lovely birds.  We were fortunate with the weather so had some lovely views of the mountain.   Ideally located close to Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens, Cavendish Square shopping mall and various restaurants.  The cottage is comfortable and nicely decorated.  Judy and James were welcoming hosts.

Lovely peaceful garden suite and had all the necessary for a comfortable home from home experience
Will definitely stay there again
Jude and James were very welcoming. the BnB was as described, very clean and comfortable.

I made the booking at Judy's for my folks who were visiting Cape Town from out of town and they spent 3 relaxing nights there. It's a great location in a lovely tree lined suburb which is also very central allowing one to explore all parts of the city.
With all the amenities one needs for a short stay and warm and friendly hosts I can definitely recommend it.

Judy and James are one of the most welcoming hosts that I have had the privilege of being hosted by. Their home is exactly as described, and they made it feel like home with a home cooked meal and freshly baked shortbread. The place is conveniently located in a safe neighbourhood with lots to do in the area. I would highly recommend this as a place to stay for anyone new in Cape Town, or looking for a great vacation spot.

Zen was a wonderful host and the room was spacious and very comfortable. Best bed I've slept in for a very long time. There is sufficient off-Street parking and the neighbourhood is quiet. Everything in the room was stylish and quality and the room was immaculately clean and tastefully decorated. I really enjoyed my stay.
Zen has really thought this through. Everything you could possibly need is there and presented in a stylish and convenient way. A first class experience.
It's homely and relaxing. Viv is the most sociable person with incredible people skills. Easy to use kitchen. Four minutes walk from beach.
Viv and her place are fab ... cool and caring and great value ... my friends and I had a great time

I had a great time at Viv! I was warmly received and the Airbnb has everything, you need for a good stay. The surfboards are a cool extra you should use in Muizenberg :) The beach, the Supermarket, restaurants and bars are just a few minutes walk away. I would definitely recommend Viv‘s Airbnb to others! I feel very comfortable and I’m glad to spent my time here :)

I had a wonderful month at this beautiful home, where my room was a delightful retreat. Viv's warm and welcoming spirit made me feel safe and at ease during my first time living away from home. The lovely garden offered a perfect spot to relax in nature, and I truly enjoyed connecting with the other ladies, sharing stories and embarking on exciting adventures like surfing.
- Sharne
Thank you, Viv, for making Sharne’s stay so perfect! Looking forward to doing it again.
- Bethany

very nice and quiet neighborhood despite everything Bering within a 5 minutes footwalk... beach, doctor, pharmacy, restaurants, checkers etc.
very nice and quiet other guests and super friendly host!

The apartment is located beautifully on the Sea Front right next to the public pool pavilion. We were welcomed by Veronica who gave us the keys to the very nice apartment, perfect for our family of 6. The place was clean and well equipped. The shower head in one of the bathrooms was loose, something that was meant to be fixed while we were there. They weren't able to do so, but we managed anyway.
Other than that we have no complaints and were very happy with our stay.

Gayle's apartment is just as described. A well done remodeled three bedroom that is comfortable and very well kept. There is wifi, built in USB hubs, cable TV, and an easy to use coffee maker for morning coffee drinkers like me. The apartment is steps away from the beach, restaurants, and plenty of parking. Gayle is a wonderful host and very responsive if needed to answer questions. You can get anywhere in the city within fifteen minutes. The security at the front desk is helpful and pleasant. I highly recommend Gayle's apartment.

Great location, close to many restaurants in Sea Point...big red bus pick up very close by so you can hop on and get around the city easily. Lovely spacious apartment, very modern, kid friendly as well, clean and very well maintained! Ideal for a weekend away in the city....thanks a lot Gayle !

Fantastic destination and the place is newly refurbished so exactly the way the pictures depict it.

Thank you for the great service we really enjoyed our stay and will look to book again.
The apartment is nice in good location,but the owner haven't told us about big renovation that have been in the building,it was noisy :( .
Sunny seaside location, Clean and hospitable.  A short walk to shops, groceries and restaurants on Cape Town's Sea Point. Recommended for family, business or holday.

1. Accomodation is at great location,infact one of the best I ever lived in.
2. Apartment is neat and clean
However,
1. Apartment is at 4th floor,and the lift doesnt work during load shedding,it was really hard to took stairs with kids and elderly.
2. Parking allotted to apartment is bit tricky,if there is a car behind you,its gonna be very very difficult to park.

The apartment was spotless! Beds were very comfortable and we had everything we needed! Security in the building is brilliant. Perfect location! We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! We wished we could have stayed longer! Thanks for being a super helpful host!
Gayle and her husband are kind and helpful. Easy to communicate with them and the appartement is well located and fully equipped
What a stunning place, beautifully put together and located. Would love to come back, was sad to leave. Thank you for a great stay.

This was an excellent location and suite for our stay. For family trips this was good for shops, boardwalk, beaches and getting in and out for driving trips and excursions.
Thanks Gayle.
Was a lovely flat and great location, the ensuite and bedrooms are a little small but the main area was great. Very clean and fab kitchen! Felt very safe because of the security

Staying here has been the highlight of our trip! The location is perfect and in walking distance from the beach, wonderful restaurants and shops. The apartment is very  spacious with a beautiful private garden and pool. Our host was extremely friendly and always happy to help. We feel spoiled to have stayed here and will definitely stay again!! Thank you so much!

The perfect apartment in the perfect location! The apartment is very spacious, fully equipped, with a beautiful private garden and pool and in walking distance from the beach, wonderful restaurants and a few shops. The view is amazing (Lions Head and Table Mountain)! Our host was extremely friendly and always happy to help. Definitely recommended!

We had such a wonderful time - the apartment was absolutely perfect for the two of us, fantastic location and Paul was a brilliant host. Guido the dog was super friendly and we felt very safe and at home.

Lovely apartment in great setting.  Spacious living area with good kitchen and a welcoming feel.  Comfy bedroom and nice bathroom, everything spotlessly clean.  Sacha and Paul are very responsive, very welcoming and great hosts, only surpassed by Guido, the dog, who is a very cuddly, friendly companion!!  We had a great time, thx all!!

Fantastic location with views of the mountains and the sea. The space is great, really spacious and has everything you need, plus the pool area is fantastic on a hot day. Guido the dog is so friendly and well behaved, never came into the apartment and great fun to play fetch with in the garden! We would definitely recommend this apartment to friends and will stay again if we're ever back in Cape town.

Apartment has a very relaxing feel to it, very light, open and airy with easy flow of movement between internal spaces and from inside to out with exits through 3 glass patio doors. Garden offers shade and if preferred spaces to sunbathe. There is a small pool to  dip in to, swim a few strokes and cool off. Beautiful view with a glimpse of the sea through a woody glen through which you can walk down to get to Camps Bay  shops and restaurants. Guido , a very friendly Alsatian is  always welcoming and loved attention we gave him. The host’s father Paul who lives upstairs was charming and always helpful.
Perfect location close to the beach in camps bay. We enjoyed camps bay the most on our cape Town trip :)

We had a great Stay at Sacha’s apartment in Camps bay! His father was there to greet us and helped us settle in. Also his lovely dog Guido who was there to greet us everyday and fun to play with.
The apartment is in a great location, clean and safe and everything you need for a stay in Camps Bay! Would definitely return in the future. Thanks
We had a great time at this Airbnb - Sacha was a great host, and Paul was very helpful. The location is very nice, and we had a great BBQ one night

Perfect location, great value for money, the place is very well equipped, spacious and clean. Paul, Sacha's dad is a very pleasant host, very helpful and decent. The outdoor garden and pool are fantastic, overlooking table mountain, it's very private, yet you feel like you're having a picnic in a nice outdoor park. Definitely coming back again. Gido the dog was the cherry on top.
Thank you Paul and Gido for everything :)

Great place and amazing outdoor space. Loved Paul and Gido !
Would definitely comeback here.

We had really great time there. It is very well situated and the garden and the views from it are really beautiful. It s a peaceful place surrounded by a lot of stuff to do. We can only recommend to stay there!

We were warmly welcome by Paul and Guido and our stay was really great and friendly. The place is not luxurious but well equip, well located and we really enjoyed our stay.
Will come back soon hopefully

We loved to stay in Paul's house. it's really roomy, the garden is amazing and the views are stunning. Paul, a Swiss with a hair studio in Sea Point, is a great host and has lots of interesting stuff to talk about. Fully recommended.
We had a really good stay. The host is very friendly. The house is nice, open, light and quiet. We liked the garden as well. The dog is also nice and always wants to play!

We had an incredible stay at Sacha’s place! The photos don’t do it justice! The flat is clean and spacious, and has everything you need and the garden is awesome  to chill in the sun and look up at the mountains. Easy walk down to beach and Camps Bay restaurants and shops. Paul is so lovely and chill, Sacha gave us awesome tips on the area. We wished we could have stayed longer. Thankyou!
Had an amazing stay in Camps Bay. Location is amazing as is house and garden. Great chats with Paul and play sessions with Savie his friendly German Shepherd.

Lovely, bright, very spacious apartment with everything you could need and very comfortable bed.  Set in a beautiful garden with stunning view of the Lions Head and the sea. Great location, easily walkable to the beach and restaurants at Camps Bay. Great communication with Sacha and hosted beautifully by his delightful dad Paul and gorgeous dog Savvie. We'd love to stay again.

Our family of 4 (2 adults, 2 kids) really enjoyed staying here. It felt comfortable, safe, clean and in great proximity to everything (restaurants, mall, and convenience store are all within a 5 min walk), not to mention a wonderful view of Table Mountain. The pool was also clean and in good condition. Our communications with Nazley were timely, informative and pleasant. The only downsides were the lack of air conditioning (we mistakenly assumed that there was A/C, but there was only a fan) and Wi-Fi, which the owner said is coming in the near future. All told, we really enjoyed our stay at Sutton Place and would recommend it to others, particularly to singles, young couples, and young families, as the residence and neighborhood have an active and younger vibe.
2 nights at our second Nazley owned Sutton Place apartment.  Apt is as photographed, very clean and convenient.  Nazley was quickly responsive to Wifi and towel needs.

We enjoyed our stay in this very secure and comfortable apartment.  It is within walking distance to the Garden's shopping center and restaurants.  It was great to be  close to Table Mountain, the city and waterfront.
Great location, clean and stylishly furnished, fitted the description. We had a lovely stay. Thank you Nazley.
It was a very comfortable stay. Nazley was very prompt and helpful whenever we communicated. Thank you for hosting us!

Leigh is one of the friendliest people I have met in a long time! She was very helpful and made sure I had everything I needed. She even carried my super heavy bag and also brought me dinner on the first night I arrived. I felt home immediately. The cottage is absolutely perfect. There is nothing more that you would need and it is extremely private with its own entrance and security gate. I would definately recommend anyone visiting Cape Town to stay with Leigh. A wonderful experience using Airbnb for the first time.

A fantastic private space. Super clean, well equipped and tastefully decorated, with everything that was needed for the stay, even teas, coffees and cookies provided. Well Equipped kitchen, towels provided and close to the motor way to get about Cape Town.

The Shower and washroom is a great space, also super clean. Bed super comfy also!! Excellent storage space throughout, TV and Internet.

I was contacted back quickly and everything was well arranged and clearly communicated.

Hosts are wonderful people, very welcoming and are there for anything you need. Can't praise enough!

Leigh and her parents are really good hosts, they respond quickly to any questions.
The Cottage is very cosy and a truly beautiful little gem. The location is good, close to several shopping centres and the M3 motorway. It was a really good experience staying there.
What a great place to stay as it is convenient, comfortable, well equipped and beautifully hosted by Leigh. I would recommend The Loft and I have stayed there twice now.
From start to finish my partner and I loved it. The host is very accommodating and the place is fantastic. Very private and cosy. Would 1000% recommend for long or short stay.

Great spot! Lovely hosts! I miss it again already. Hope to be back soon again. Lots of love to all of you, Leigh, Sue, Tim, Virginia, the garden man I didnt see and remember his name, the dogs and sorry if I forget someone <3
Thank you Leigh, Brendan loved staying in this flat!  Appreciate all your help and Merry Christmas

We stayed at the house for 6 days with 2 small children and enjoyed it very much! Location and view on the mountains are terrific. And everything we needed was available, including two children table seats. To our surprise, a dog was staying at the house too. Although she was very sweet, our little boy of almost 2 yrs, found her a bit scary.

Christine and Friedrich's place is beautiful! It's so relaxing staying there and really felt like home. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a place which give you the opportunity just relax with fab views. Bella the dog is an amazing addition too, we miss her. Probably the best AirBnB we've stayed in.

Our first Airbnb experience and it did not disappoint. Wonderful home which was clean and tidy, enough room for a family of 4 with 2 little kids. Situated in a prime spot in Camps Bay. Extremely enjoyable stay.
This was a fantastic family space, with great views, garden and pool. The addition of a housekeeper was a luxury. Highly recommended.
The place is clean, very well situated in Camps Bay.. The house was complete with good descriptions of everything. Contacting the host was easy. I would go back if we were going back to SA.

The villa is big with three bedrooms and a large and new kitchen. But it's like without that details that make this structure really amazing. The pool was not clean (the housekeeper was not in the hous on saturday and sunday). And you need the car to go to camps bay.

Totally recommend this place! We had a fantastic time in Camps Bay and this spot is perfectly located: easy to reach and short distance to the beach as well as into town.
The house is comfy, safe and well equipped - the view from the pool is amazing. All three bedrooms are good - living room/kitchen and outdoor area are even nicerthan suggested by the pics.
Everything was superclean and working (bathroom, dishwasher, washing machine, braai, ...) which is explained by the presence of Thelma, the housekeeper. Be aware that this also means that there is always someone around, almost the entire day. This helps if you forget your keys (as we did) but also that you are never supersuper private and on your own.

I would like to thank Friedrich and Christine for the use of this wonderful house. It was absolutely perfect for our needs and we were able to work from there in comfort.
I would also like to thank Thelma for ensuring that the place was always in perfect condition.
Will definitely go back.
Fantastic place at a great location. Strongly recommend it to anyone who are going to Cape Town and would like to spend some time in Camps Bay.

Christine & Friedrich have a warm family house on the best spot of cape town! We stayed with my parents and children and had a wonderful time. Everything you need is there, we were welcomed by Thelma which was really nice. Communication is perfect with almost direct response. All and all highly recommended.

Just perfect for us: Family with 2 kids.
Perfect size, anything you need there, great view, nice pool…and super nice housekeeper Thelma!!
Great view, very peaceful, 1 minute walk away from restaurant and grocery store. would recommend!
A perfect place for us to stay for two weeks while work was being done on our house. We so appreciated finding an Airbnb that allowed us to bring our dogs! Beautiful views and great location.

Our stay at Christine’s place was lovely. The place was very well equipped and clean. Thelma was very helpful and the check in/out process was very easy. The location was perfect and the pool was a lovely addition . I would definitely stay here again.
Lovely garden and pool. Location was the best in CT. The interior was not same standard. Lots of tired items including high chair, chairs, appliances etc. No fans provided on arrival.
we have the perfect stay we had all we wanted at our door step ,thank you for the lovely hospitality we will call again

What a beautiful home.  It was a wonderful location and so homely and comfortable for a 5 night stay with our 3 children.  Very responsive and helpful and we felt safe and secure.  Best steak restaurant close by and the pool was amazing on a hot day. Thelma was delightful and Frederich very helpful.  Highly recommend.

Thank you so much for sharing your incredible home with us. We truly enjoyed our stay in Cape Town. The house is beautiful and cosy designed and comfortable but also radiates warmth and hospitality.
It truly feels like a second home and it makes our time in Cape Town extra special. Thank you again for your hospitality.

Christine was a wonderful host. We loved the house and felt like at home right away. Would come back anytime again, as it is a great location and the house is very nice and convenient, especially with kids.
Very friendly host of a cosy small Apartment. Only thing to improve is the internet. Recommend to check if the host has installed fibre, before you book. Other than that, I can recommend the place.
Judelle’s apartment is superbly situated in a quiet location. Judelle and James are excellent hosts and the apartment has everything you need. I can definitely recommend the apartment.
Amazing place, enjoyed it. 5G is not 100% ready, however, 4G and lower or other work perfectly.  Enjoyed my stay.
Beautiful house, great hospitality and beautiful location just 20mins from Cape Town in a safe gated community.

Etienne and Irina were extremely welcoming. They prepared the room with fresh towels and welcome treats. The room and bathroom were very clean. The room is located in a separate wing of the house with a separating door between your room and bathroom with the entrance of the house. This makes it is super quiet. You have direct acess to the garden from your bedroom.  Amazing location with great security but above all absolutely amazing host. Thank you Etienne and Irina.

My husband and I will always check into Etienne's place each time we are in Cape Town. Not only is it an amazing place but Etienne and Irina make you feel so welcome. Their excitement for meeting new people and sharing their city is wonderful. The entire complex is so safe and there are wonderful paths straight to the beach, perfect for Kit Boarding or just walking along the beach.  My husband and I are looking forward to our next visit in the Fall. For us it feels like we are visiting friends rather then just a normal Airbnb. Thank you Etienne and Irina for your wonderful hospitality. See you soon.

Another home away from home! It was a pleasure staying with Etienne and Irina, who made me feel at home right from the start. They were very helpful and always in for a chat, yet giving me all the privacy I needed – easy with the room being situated in a separate 'wing' of the house, with its own bathroom and garden.
Sunset Links is a great place to live, spacious and safe, and as a windsurfer it was a real treat to be able to rig on the golf court right next to the beach.

My experience was beyond expectations! Irina and Etienne were the most welcoming and friendly hosts. They were always ready to help and give me directions or suggestions . The place is amazing, I felt so safe and also I was also able to enjoy nice walks in the area. I had as much personal space as I wanted, I never felt uncomfortable. I have nothing to complain about, I really felt like home. I highly recommend the place and I look forward going back!
Another week of wonderful stay! Your place will be our first preference whenever we need to book a place around . Thanks for hosting us.
A lovely home away from home. It's cozy and beautiful with amazing hosts Etienne abs and his wife

Etienne and Erina are such friendly and wonderful hosts. I stayed with them for a month and throughout my stay I always felt at home. Their place is neat and tidy. It is exactly as advertised and I enjoyed my stay with them.
I highly recommend them to anyone who is looking for a short term accommodation.
Our stay was absolutely great! Wonderful host family: Etienne and Irina. Thank them for hospitality and friendly atmosphere!

Really enjoyed my stay.
The unit is clean, tidy, secure and safe with a great location. The host was welcoming and helpful.
I would stay there again.

Spent 5 weeks in 1 of Gio's beautiful apartments in Norfolk House, she's a great host, full of local knowledge of the best spots to visit, always on hand if needed but not in an "in your face" kind of way. Spotless beautiful apartment, ideal situation with great views over the ocean, loved my stay and will be back, thinking of staying in Sea Point, try one of Gio's places, you won't be disappointed

Amazing beautiful flat, what is written is what you get...
Fully equipped
Gio is very kind and easy to talk, amazing host.
My girlfriend and I loved there.
Cheers

We had a lovely 3 week stay and Gio as our host could not have made it easier for us. The apartment is well appointed and has all the amenities you would expect in a great location. The block is very secure. There is lots of living space but only one bedroom. Ideally for the price we paid we would like there to be a second bedroom and this may put us off next year. However for the 2 of us this trip it was excellent. TV is an older one and could do with upgrading but not a major issue.

If you want the view and the location, then this is for you
Absolutely stunning 180 degree views of Cape Town with both the seaside and the mountains.
Plus great location to, step outside and you’re right there amongst the vibrant promenade with the salty sea air to start your day.

This is a properly amazing flat with stunning views in maybe one of the best locations in Cape Town. We sat on the couch and watched as paragliders landed on the promenade. Everything was well stocked and the bed was comfortable. Gio was a great host, and super communicative. Would highly recommend. Thank you Gio!

Lovely views of the sunset from the balcony or inside if it was windy.   The location of the flat was perfect in Sea Point with easy access to the boardwalk for walks, to shops in the main street and many restaurants - everything you need within easy walking distance.   Couch in the living room very comfortable as a second bed.   Gio was a very responsive host - she anticipated our needs and took very good care to make sure everything was perfect.  Many thanks Gio.   Really enjoyed our stay.

Had a wonderful 9 days at Gio’s place as bases for Cape Town. Very convenient location, great view over the sea from the sitting area and bed. Nice city views. Walking distance to all you need and nice to watch the paragliders land and sea all the activity on the promenade.
A little short bed, but did not bother me. Road can be noisy, but the views are well compensating for that. With windows closed it’s very quiet.
Fantastic to sleep with windows open unless to windy.
Would come back any time when staying in Cape Town.

My accommodation exceeded my expectation by far. Tessa is a friendly and gracious host and I felt at home the moment I drove through the gates and was met by her friendly and helpful staff. The property has easy access to the M3,  the beautiful Constantia Winelands and all that Cape Town offers. I was short of nothing : from the beautiful kitchen and lounge area with DSTV to the private area in the garden surrounded by bird sounds and squirrels. If you don't need to be at a beach, definitely a place that I will recommend to everyone. Thank you Tessa!!

Both Tessa and her husband are lovely hosts that will do everything to make your stay enjoyable.  The property is big and very green with a wonderful garden and a pool. The studio is not huge, but has a small kitchen to warm up meals and a small bathroom with a shower that has everything one needs. The road next to the studio is not very busy and will not disturb your sleep. There is enough space to park your car and it's only a minute to the M3 which will lead you straight into town. I had a very nice stay - no complaints.

This is the perfect sanctuary for a stay in Cape Town. Close to everything you could possibly want or need, beaches, mountains, vineyards, world class restaurants but also a tranquil oasis just outside the city for a bit of peace and quiet in beautiful surroundings. One of the best Airbnb stays we have had.

Tess and Steve are the epitome of super hosts ! They went above and beyond what one would expect from a stay to make our time memorable. Extremely supportive to our needs, superb little details/extras, prompt and clear communication. I would definitely recommend their places!

We had a great time at Tessa and Steve's place. The communication was super easy and quick and they were so friendly, welcoming, and attention to detail. The neighborhood is very conveniently located. We would absolutely recommend to stay there!

We felt very comfortable in the
studio! Ideally located in the beautiful Constantia neighbourhood. Relaxing sleep in the super comfortable king size bed!! But of course there is still much more reasons to come back. Privacy is respected, the garden offers tranquillity, the studio was cleaned daily and Tessa & Steve are ideal hosts! Helpful, open, communicative, energizing!
Very comfortable , clean and neat studio in a beautiful garden with lovely host. Studio had everything one could need, and some. Super friendly hostess! Tx Tessa
Absolutely lovely! Tessa and Steve are the sweetest hosts, we felt right at home! Would definitely return.

It was great to be back visiting Tess & Steve and they were as accommodating and friendly as ever. Everything was clean and tidy but while we were staying it was unusually hot so a really effective fan (or even a lighter duvet) would have made things more pleasant.
Thanks for having us, we had a great stay.

Tessa’s place is so beautifully appointed, yet comfortable and has everything you could need in a self catering apartment.  Set in beautiful gardens and Tessa is a super hostess.  We loved it and wished we could have stayed an extra night
Lovely place, clean and safe! Hosts went out of their way to help when there was a problem with the Fibre, Tariq and Albert were exceptional! will definitely be back

Our stay here was outstanding!  The property was great and the room perfect.  Clean and well maintained, it had all the amenities we could ask for and more.  Jacko was great too  - responsive and welcoming, always polite, always smiling!  Would definitely do it again.

What a wonderful experience! The cottage is nestled at the heart of the quiet Imhoff Park in beautiful Kommetjie. The cottage itself is beautiful and well-appointed, with all the amenities and mod-cons one would need, down to satellite tv and fast Wi-Fi - although the latter two may seem retrospectively counterintuitive, because all we wanted to do was sit and listen to the crashing waves and squabbling guinea fowl!
Roger is an incredible host, and was attentive to our every need, both during the reservation phase and during our stay. Comfort and tranquility in one of the most beautiful places. Roger and his cottage come highly recommended... Unless of course I want it for myself over a weekend!
Imhof Caravan Park within a short walk from one of the most truly beautiful beaches in the world, located in laid-back Kommetjie. The A frame cottage is a cute little home from home!
Fantastic home, walking distance from the ocean in a peaceful setting surrounded by nature, very reasonably priced and Roger was the perfect host; we couldn't have asked for more, Cheers Roger!
Roger's spot is a tranquil paradise close to a bunch of great surf spots, a home away from home, I will be a repeat customer for sure!

We loved our stay at Rogers Cabin and all the nature and beauty surrounding it—a short walk to the beach and epic surf spots. Roger was very friendly and was always available when needed, we will definitely be back. Thanks, Roger
Great location!  Lovely place, we felt quite at home.  Just wish our stay could have been longer

I really enjoyed my short stay in Anne’s cottage. It was very nice, clean and comfortable, and has everything you need. The surrounding gardens are very pretty and well kept, and create a lovely relaxing environment if you fancy staying away from the city centre. You are also closer to the wine district of Constantia, which is great!
Anne is a lovely host and I’d definitely recommend staying here for anyone visiting the city.

Anne and Thomas are incredibly welcoming and the apartment is lovely. Comfortable bed, all small touches to make your stay comfortable.
Set in beautiful garden it is private and a wonderful stay. Will definitely be back.

Amazing place, highly recommended, truly worth 5 stars!  Comfortable, stylish and a lot of special touches to ensure comfort for the guest - a two point plug at both sides of the bed allows you to charge your phone on the bedstand - most places overlook this.  I always judge a place by the shower head as well - this one did not disappoint.  Will definitely stay over again!

Anne's home and garden are beautiful and the cottage is very private and well appointed. There were small luxuries from a basket of chocolates, to ground coffee with plunger, to fluffy towels hanging on a towel heater. The room is made secure with tasteful shutters and the ceiling fan was much appreciated on the hot day we were there. Anne was greeted us warmly and gave us our space to do our own thing. I can highly recommend staying here.

I had an absolutely fantastic stay at Anne's place. The accommodation has been finished to a very high standard and had everything I needed and more!  Anne and her husband were very welcoming and went the extra mile to help me when needed and to make sure I had a great stay. I would highly recommend staying here and I plan to do so on my next visit to Cape Town.

I love visiting the Cape. This was my first trip back in almost 10 years. And I found a lovely host in Anne. She was patient with my learning Airbnb for my first time. She was quick and communicative, helpful and friendly. She hosts  a beautiful and safe cottage, both things I was looking for and not sure exactly how to find today. I enjoyed staying at the Garden Cottage in the Sun, the mountain in the background and sun in the garden as I arrived, brief rain in the morning but sun at sunrise and as I leave now. Thank you, Anne (and Thomas).
An absolutely idyllic experience with excellent hospitality. A wonderfully comfortable stay in a beautiful setting, ideally situated in Cape Town.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Anne's and Thomas's cottage in Wynberg. The unit is well very clean, well equipped and maintained, ideal for a single person on business or a couple on holiday . The area is quiet and safe for travelers. It was a huge advantage that the property has an invertor as a backup during load shedding so we always had electrical connectivity , incl. internet. The cottage also has a private verandah which was particularly nice to enjoy on warmer days and the adjacent garden of the main house is pure bliss.
Anne and Thomas are the perfect hosts .
Our highlight every morning though was the visit from beautiful super friendly and tail wagging resident dog Bentley whom we would like to adopt if we could 😊 .

Anne and Thomas were marvelous hosts! My parents thoroughly enjoyed their stay in the beatiful accommodation.
Thank you very much! 😄
Thank you Anne and Thomas for yet another great stay at your beautiful cottage.   We always feel very welcomed and appreciate the little extras you provide.

I had a fantastic stay at Anne’s place! The cottage was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything I needed. Anne was incredibly welcoming and responsive. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay in Cape Town. Thank you for a wonderful experience!

Anne, Tom and GRM Bentley, greeted me and made me feel right at home. After welcoming hand and paw shakes I settled in. The pictures and description are true to their word. Everything is within a reasonable driving distance; 30 minutes to Table Mountain and just over an hour to the Cape of Good Hope. I took the opportunity to try and see some of the yachts heading round, including those taking part in the Vendee Globe Race. I would thoroughly recommend staying with Anne, Tom and Bentley to all. Clean and tidy people, with amazing recommendations of things to do. An amazing location for a stay.
A beautiful home and area of Cape Town. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Would definitely recommend.

From the first time I saw the pictures and red the reviews I decided to take the villa. I know the area well, all the four bedrooms have sea view. Glass windows are covering ocean view. Sky light makes the villa bright and healthy.
It's located in a very safe and secure neighborhood.
The villa looks better than the pictures. It's furnished with nice and clean furniture. We manage to swim on warm day, water wasn't that cold, it is nice to have your own privacy.
Ricardo is wonderful host and cooperative and keeps calling the maid and check on us, whenever you need help he is there. Having a maid in the house give you the feelings you are staying in a hotel.
If I come back with family I will stay with Ricardo.

Do yourself a favor and book a stay at this magnificent property that lives up to every description. Photos don't do this house justice and the views are amazing. Fabulously managed and VVIP treatment provided by the property team! We will be back. Thanks Riccardo and big thanks to Caroline and team.
We had a wonderful Time in the villa injoyed fantastic view of ocean  and mountin. The villa was big and beautifull  .  location  was exclent Carolin and Judith v nice and helpfull.

62 Camps Bay is absolutely beautiful. My friends and I had an amazing one week stay. The pictures are totally accurate and the house is even more beautiful in person. Everything was very clean and we had all the amenities we needed to feel comfortable. The weather was a little chilly so we were not able to enjoy the pool but the views from the balconies were breathtaking. Additionally, we were in walking distance to some great restaurants and we felt very safe in the Camps Bay neighborhood.

Ricardo's place was just perfect! It was very modern, spacious and clean.  Lots of storage space in all the bedrooms and throughout the home.  All bedrooms were ensuite and the beds were very comfortable.  The views were amazing and the location was walking distance to the beach, local  shops and restaurants.  Judith, the housekeeper, came in to clean daily.  She was very nice and having her there was a huge bonus! Check in/out was very easy.  I highly recommend Ricardo's place to anyone looking for a nice, upscale home in Cape Town.

You will not be disappointed in your stay here! The entire beachfront villa is exactly as shown in the photos but better! The location is ideal if you are looking for a place to stay just a short walk away from the beach, restaurants and grocery stores if you like to cook while on holiday like we do. Breathtaking views. Thank you to our wonderful hosts!
Wow wow! What a luxurious house! We really enjoyed our stay with my sisters. The views are to die for exactly as described. Thank you Ricardo
Wonderful location and spacious villa with all amenities. Judith the housekeeper was great, would thoroughly recommend and we will definitely be back!

This villa is the perfect escape from reality. With stunning view of Camps Bay and the 12 Apostles it’s hard not to fall in love. Each floor offers unique views and would be perfect for a getaway of any group from family vacations to friend reunions. Cannot recommend the place enough. Ricardo, the host, was attentive and ensure we had a peaceful check in and wonderful time.

We had an amazing experience at Ricardo’s place. From cleanliness to utilities, everything was prepped to perfection! The house itself was even more beautiful than the pictures and the location couldn’t have been better. On top of that, it was great to have Judith around to keep the house clean which is something you don’t get in most of the bnbs.
Thank you so much. We look forward to plan again soon.
Regards
Hyna & Farhan

This is a fantastic house. The views from all bedrooms are stunning, and the location is convenient—close to the restaurants, bars, and supermarkets. One of the best Airbnb that I rented.
It was very comfortable for our group and well-maintained by the adorable and very efficient Judith, who also managed everything to make our stay perfect. Ricardo was very responsive as well, unfortunately, we had an issue with the bathroom and internet but he answered quickly to fix things.
We absolutely love this house and hope to come back one day.

Ricardo's place was amazing - it looked like the photos and met all our expectations. It's walkable to the beach, restuarants, coffee shops and grocery stores. It is also close to one of the setups on the 'Hop-on Hop-off' bus tour. The sunset views from the balcony are stunning.
Judith keeps the house meticulously and is friendly and helpful. she was there to meet us when we checked in, and was willing to let us drop our bags off early.
All in all we and our friends really enjoyed our stay in this beautiful home. Thank you

Perfect location for active holiday! Everything went well and place was just like in the pictures. Some furniture should be updated and the wifi was sometimes slow, but these were just very small things and did not bother us! I would definitely recommend this place.
Great location and nice appartement. It can be very noisy if the neighbors are home. But overall I would recommend!
Beautiful lovely spacious place in a great area, loved the swimming pool.. It can be a bit noisy though when neighbors are around. Other than that it's a great place.

Great stay. I've spent almost 3 months here, and it felt like being home, as it contains everything one could need for a long term stay. The location is perfect with Table Mountain Park, the promenade, shops, and some of the best restaurants in town within walking distance. The people working here are all very friendly and always committed to helping out. Would definitely recommend this apartment to my friends and also visit again, should I ever return to Cape Town.

we stayed 3 weeks in this apartment and felt like home. I really enjoyed the terrace and loved being in the centre of Seapoint. The communication with Frederike was top and she really helped us. I absolutely recommend to stay here. I definitely will book again when coming back!

A great apartment in a convenient location, with shops and restaurants in easy walking distance. There is everything you need, and it is a comfortable and peaceful place to holiday or come back to after a busy work day.

This was a great place and Koos and his colleagues communicated meaningfully. Check in instructions was a little confusing but after being supported everything else went really smoothly. The place is cozy and quint and the balcony is a treat. Definitely a great stay!
Good ambience. Conviniently located, place is 100m from shopping mall and restaurants

A great apartment to enjoy Cape Town and seapoint.
We would happily stay there again, check in was easy and the hosts were easy to deal with.
Thanks

Absolutely LOVED Koos place! So comfortable, clean and spacious. Amazing deck area. Lovely pool area. Perfect location, seconds walk to the high street, soooo many bars, restaurants, shops, coffee shops, all within very easy walking distance.
Seapoint is such an amazing area too! So vibey.
We wish we’d stayed longer here!

Paul's home is really the perfect place to be as it's a stone's throw away from the beach and some of the nicest sundowns you'll ever see. The whole stay was perfectly managed and communicated too. Couldn't be happier. Thanx for everything.

Wow what a view! Furthermore Moniek and Paul were great hosts and we were met at the Cabana by Moniek with good advise and a welcome hamper. The beds and apartment ware very comfortable and clean. The proximity to the beach was exactly what we wanted for our short break.
We are looking forward to our next stay.

The cabana at Dolphin Beach is so gorgeous and the location could not be more perfect. A small drive outside of the city center with a pristine beach right outside the backdoor. Underground parking left me worry free about my car and they had everything ready from extra linens to snacks. I will definitely book this place again! Did I mention the beach has one of the best views of table mountain? Everything looks exactly like the pictures and is as described. Thank you Paul and Moniek!

As one of the few places on the beach side of the road in Blouberg, we absolutely loved this spot. With beach access literally steps away, a permanent view of Table Mountain, and a most generous host, good luck finding a more super location.

Paul’s apartment is in a fantastic location with amazing views of Table Mountain. I would never tire of waking up next to the ocean and beach.
The apartment had all the facilities we needed. It is clean and tidy. Dolphin Beach is a safe and secure location. It is located close to bars, shops, restaurants and they all seemed to offer takeaways, after all who wants to cook on holiday.
We found it extremely easy to find our way around Cape Town from the apartment, visiting many of our favourite places.
We received a warm welcome and would stay in the Table View location again, and Paul’s apartment if it was available.

Awesome place, location and best views in Cape Town! Paul's friend Moniek gave us a warm welcome and gave a few suggestions what to do in the area. The Africa Café is a must for both tourist and locals! We had a great time at the cabana and would highly recommend.

Absolutely fantastic unit!! Incredible sunsets and views of table mountain. Each evening we went out and watched the pro kiters at sunset. The location was close to everything, while also being very private and quiet. Paul and Moniak were very kind to allow us to check out (very) late on our last day with our 9 pm flight. The welcome snacks were also greatly appreciate after a long day of travel. Highly recommend to kiters, windsurfers, adventure seekers and anyone looking to unwind.

The cabana was wonderful, cozily decorated and situated right on the shore. Beautiful, very safe and well-groomed background and fantastic view of Table Mountain.
We were welcomed with fresh flowers and a goodies basket and felt right at home. We had everything we needed.
The place is better than anticipated. Close to everything. City centre it's just 10-15 min to drive. Paul was very nice and welcoming. Easy to get in touch with Moniek and answered immediately to any enquiries. Would definitely recommend Paul's place for everyone. Hope, will come back there soon.
I Recommend accommodation to 1000 %. Fantastic view and very nice/friendly hosts. They are reachable around the clock and help were they can.Looking forward to our next stay.
Looks just like the pictures, a truly stunning place. Unfortunately, there was some load shedding, but we had candles and made it cozy ☺️ truly gorgeous and safe place.

A beautiful unit with an amazing view of the ocean and dunes. Well equipped with some lovely welcoming touches like chocolate and wine on arrival. There were a few issues with cleanliness and functionality of a few appliances but nothing that serious enough to completely put me off returning. They have renovated a large portion of the house which is stunning and can’t wait to see it when it’s fully refurbished.

This place is absolutely stunning!!!
We had a great time and can´t wait to come back.
Paul+Moniek were great Hosts and every detail was on point.

This place is perfect for singles, couples and families. Everything you will need. We are had a fantastic time. Very well located, and central to everything. The view is undeniable. Definitely worth it.

The unit is nice an large for a 2 bedroom and is fully equipped with everything one would need. The internet is fast so working from here is not an issue. Would recommend!

A perfect cabana for a beach holiday in a superb setting...table mountain, kitesurfers, beautiful gardens, lawns and birdlife. Moniek, our hostess attended to our every need.!! We will certainly return to this lovely cabana! Thanks for a wonderful stay!!

I love the cabana, it’s beautifully decorated & very comfortable, and being able to walk barefoot to the beach is a dream.
Paul is a great host, very attentive & excellent communication.

The place is as advertised and well maintained.
The garden and access to the beach makes it very ideal for a family as well for the water lovers.
Location is also good with easy access to shopping malls and many food options.
Second time here, and still loving it.  Little paradise in Cape Town. Can definately recommend for family of 4. Will be back in the future.

This apartment was absolutely stunning, I really enjoyed waking up to the view of the ocean' and watching the sunset from the cabana. This was a perfect escape get away vacation with an amazing ambiance, received a lovely bottle of white wine and some fruits and snacks love it.

Lovely stay, the place was very clean, very friendly host and response time was really fast! The place is Really close to the beach and very well located. The place was also adequately equipped for Loadshedding with lighting. We enjoyed our stay and will definitely recommend this to people need a place to stay for a holiday or work trip in Cape Town.

What a stunning apartment, and what an amazing location!! Literally on a beautiful white sand beach with breathtaking views of the magnificent Table Mountain and the Atlantic Ocean. We slept like a baby to the wonderful sound of the crashing ocean waves, the best relaxant ever. Last but not least: he apartment was spotless. Good to know for future guests this already wonderful apartment will be renovated in March/April 2024. We will definitely come back!

This was a wonderful place to stay for our family of 4.  It was super clean and had everything we needed, and arriving to milk, wine and Pringles was  very much appreciated!  The beds were very comfortable and everything was high spec.  The location was beautiful, safe and private - we walked across to the beach barefoot!  and it was very easy to get to Cape Town, both by Uber and in our own car.  We also enjoyed the dolphin beach restaurant, and in particular the Sunday evening half price sushi bar. Paul was really helpful and responded quickly to all our queries.   Can’t fault anything - it exceeded our expectations and gave us a lovely base for our stay in Cape Town.
Our first ever Airbnb experience. Paul contacted us long before our visit to make sure everything went smoothly. I could not recommend Paul as a host enough. We will definitely be back again!

Paul’s place is beautiful! The beach is amazing to listen to the waves and watch the sunset, looking at table mountain and lion’s head in the distance. Paul was communicative and responsive which was awesome and super helpful! The beds are very comfortable and the showers and bathrooms are stunning! Along with the rest of the house- all cozy and stunning. Thank you so much for making our trip across from our side of the world so memorable! I hope our paths will cross again and I come back one day.

Hi everyone, I would like to say that I am lucky to have the chance of choosing this home,

Very lovely stay and the view and the fireplace was really nice! I would love to stay again!! Great Choice

We very much enjoyed our stay at Charl’s Villa. The house offers space for 12 people and everyone can enjoy their own privacy. This is a great place for families with children. The view from the terrace is amazing, the area is very safe, and there is almost no traffic, so it’s very quiet.
It can get a bit cold in the house in spring, so ensure to buy firewood for the beautiful fireplace in the seating room, or bring warm comfy clothes for inside.
We can only recommend this place and will definitely consider staying here again next time we’re in Cape Town.

Beautiful house with a great views and magic sunsets from the top deck, although some furnishings were a little tired. House construction opposite was very noisy and disturbed our stay on several occasions.
Amazing house!  Plenty of space for the 9 of us who stayed :)  Great location only a short drive to Sea Point.  Great hospitality received from Patrick.  Will definitely stay again!  Thank you!!

Charl is an awesome host with an amazing place, gave me a less than 20 minute response time made me feel as if I was home. And the view from the balcony is breathtaking!! It was my first trip to Cape Town and I can say I enjoy every single day I was there. I couldn’t of ask for a better place and host. I recommend Charl’s place to everyone! Five stars! Thanks Charl! I will definitely be back!
Great location, incredible view, beautiful home. The host, Patrick, couldn’t have been more helpful and willing to go out of his way to make our stay the best it could be.

Great value, my friends and I enjoyed the place. It’s close to the beach, shopping, and the water front.
Once you at the house you can Uber everywhere you needed.
The host is friendly and helpful.

We had a great time staying at Charl's place, the house is as amazing as it looks on the pictures. Communication was super easy and Patrick (caretaker who is living on the property) helped us out with everything we needed at anytime. We would definitely come back!

Great location for city and Western Cape activity. Excellent views of coast and Robeen Island and close to Lion Head if you want even more spectacular views and a bit of exercise. Charl is a good communicator.

Hello, we are a group of 11 Spanish people, we spent a lovely week at Charl' house. Lovely host and the guy who takes care of the house also helped us at all times. Impeccable house, unbeatable views, cleanliness, services ... Thank you for everything, a wonderful week in Cape Town.
Amazing villa in quiet good place, the villa is beautiful and cozy, many space, good swimming pool, everything was very good, i recommend it without any doubts!

Once in a lifetime trip with a once in a lifetime mansion! My friends and I loved staying at Charls place, great location- although not waking distance to most places, but ubers made the trip really easy and they are very cheap. Live in housekeeper Wilfred was super helpful and super lovely, even checking that we arrived safely home after our flights back to the UK! Would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to experience a gorgeous mansion without the crazy price tag! Thanks so much Charl and wilfred!
We had a great time at Villa Kali!The place looks even better than on pictures. I can just recommend this place, the location is nice and you have an amazing view.

This was our first booking on Airbnb and I'm really impressed. Charl (host) and Wilfred (house manager) were superb also easily accessible, home was beautiful, clean and we had a wonderfull holiday. can't wait to be back.

We had a fantastic time at Charles's place! We loved the house, the view, the service everything was perfect! the house is awesome! unfortunately I could not stay longer because it was already fully booked!!  hope to go back soon soon!
The house in a wonderful area of Cape Town. Everything was clean and pretty and we were attended very politely! It can definitely be recommended for a stay!!!

If you want to feel like a King - This is the place for you.... The villa is well equipped - spacious & well maintained.  Charl was super helpful #perfect host... The view is to die for - especially the sunset.. Will be back 100%
Absolutely phenomenal stay, Charl was exceptionally accommodating and made sure all our needs were met. The house itself was stunning, definitely would recommend!
had a fabulous stay, the use of space is great when going with a crowd as you had your own privacy. was clean and had everything you needed, would highly recommend this beautiful villa, thank you
Amazing place and Victoria was very helpful with whatever we needed. Enjoyed our stay and loved everything about this beautiful home.

A stay Villa Kali in Bantry Bay is one of Caoe Town's best-kept secrets! High on the lower slope of Lion's Head, it offers unmatched mountain views including Lion's Head and Twelve Apostles, as well as panoramic ocean views. Charl is a most excellent host, and ensured our stay was both comfortable and enjoyable.  You won't be disappointed staying here!

My family and I were at Charl's home in Cape Town while visiting for a week and enjoyed everything the town and surroundings had to offer. Its in a great location near Lions Head and within driving distance of all the tourist attractions. We definitely felt at home, the area was safe and communication was efficient. The home itself is spacious, clean and updated with all amenities needed for a family stay.
We loved our stay and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great host and home in Cape Town!
The only issue i had was s broken elevator. There is s lot of stairs to get to the house. It was difficult with bags and my disabled sister.

Nick and Steph's house is absolutely exquisite. The decor, the location, the smell and sound of the ocean as you sleep - its incredible! I've stayed at more than a few luxury homes and I must say this house takes the cakes. Nick was also a great communicator, and his staff were very helpful. Two massive thumbs up, can't wait to stay there again - if they will have me.

What an absolutely lovely place to stay at. The house is stunning - spacious and clean - with incredible views. Nick was such a friendly and accommodating host. He truly went out of his way to make sure we enjoyed our stay. I would definitely stay here again and would highly recommend this house!

A great experience an awesome time. Perfect location with views across the ocean. Nick is as friendly, warm and mature as you wud wish. His assistant helped us with our luggage upon arrival and departure and made sure to that we had a pleasant and clean stay. Bravo!

What an absolutely incredible place (I can’t emphasise enough!). Everything was perfect. The location is one of the best in Cape Town with fabulous views and the house itself was spectacular inside. We didn’t feel like we ever wanted to leave it. We also felt extremely safe and Nick was great. Best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in !

Stunning villa. The interior design is really well done and the views of Clifton beach are truly breathtaking. The kitchen is very well equipped - it has everything you could possibly need. Nick was a fab host too. Would 100% recommend this place. Nothing to fault apart from we didn’t stay longer!

Excellent place to stay and surpassed expectations. The views, location and standard of housing were fantastic.
Nick and his team were readily available when required and we will be back for sure!

Wow!  Nick's place is unbeatable!  Everything is outstanding! The view... The vibe... The Location... There is no way we could have experienced Clifton in this way without Nick's place on Airbnb.  We will stay there every chance we get when in CPT.

We had an amazing time in this spectacular and clean villa. The location is excellent an Nick was always very helpful and immediately answered our questions. We definitely recommend the place! Thank you Nick
The views are amazing😍. The house is beautiful, clean and fully equipped, has great security, friendly and accommodating owner. Perfect Cape Town accommodation👌

We are lucky enough to travel extensively, and fortunate to stay in some of the best hotels, resorts and residences across the world.
Ezulwini is up there with the very best.
We booked the property for a family reunion, and this property turned an already special event into a little bit of magic.
Nick was such a great host and so down to earth.
Thanks again
Shaz & Ive

We had a fantastic stay! The house itself is amazing with gorgeous, uninterrupted views of the beach. Updated furniture & decor throughout with lots of amenities. Nick & the rest of the staff (including security & housekeeping) are quite helpful. Nick in particular is quick to respond to any inquiries, & he even offered to take me to the doctor when I got sick shortly before arriving in Cape Town. We were so appreciative of everyone’s kindness.
