If I had one suggestion, it would be to ask Nick about the water restrictions, as well as how much he charges for laundry before booking. Cape Town is in a drought, & we wish we knew about this ahead of time so we could plan accordingly.

This place was fabulous in every way. We would love to stay there again.
Thank you Nick for hosting our family.

I can’t emphasise enough how amazing this place is. Even better in real life than the photos convey. The location is perfect, view will take your breath away, and the hospitality of the hosts is amazing. There is secure parking, a small gym in the garage area, TVs with Netflix in each room, amazing pool overlooking the ocean, superb modern decor and appliances, and of course that view. I wish we never had to check out!

I am struggling to avoid gushing and borrowing every tired, over-used cliche in the travel industry here, but this apartment truly deserves a gush: The location is ideal and the spectacular views of the ocean from the balconies make for one of the most memorable settings for sundowners you will ever experience. The apartment itself is spacious, decorated in a clean, contemporary, stylish Afro-centric vibe, and boasts every comfort and convenience you could hope for. The servicing staff were friendly and efficient and the apartment immaculate. Security is excellent and you feel completely safe in the apartment and surrounds. The owners live in close proximity and were most courteous and helpful but completely unobtrusive as well and have really gone to extra lengths to provide thoughtful touches like fresh milk in the fridge and a fine complimentary wine. The gallery of this spectacular apartment barely does it justice - it truly cannot disappoint. Highly, highly recommended.

absolutely out if this world.... Nick is a real gentleman, kind professional & accommodating.
THE HOUSE lol WOW!
THE VIEW.....WOW!
GUYS ITS ABSOLUTELY UNQUESTIONABLY THE BEST & MOST AMAZING PLACE ON AIRBNB!
Tons of GRATITUDE, THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU

Had the most amazing stay at nick’s place, wish it lasted for even longer. Best Airbnb I stayed in for sure, the attention to details is impeccable, the villa had everything you could imagine and even more, FULLY stocked kitchen, beach towels, full sized toiletries, comfortable lay out with many tasteful additions .. The list goes on.
Highly Recommend it 👍🏼

Nick was a great host! I would definitely stay here again. The amenities were perfect and the daily cleaning service was very helpful. Nick was very attentive and checked in throughout the stay. The place felt like home and was absolutely stunning. It was a pleasure.

Nicks spot was outstanding! It’s in an amazing area in Clifton, stunning home and great/expansive amenities. Perfect for a family or group of friends. My friends and I felt very comfortable and safe and loved that there were perfect beach views from every room in the house! Can’t recommend this property enough and such a reasonable price.
Thank you Nick and Patience for being so easy to communicate with and accommodating for all of our questions and needs.

Wonderful home in a superb location.
We had a most relaxing time and would want to book again.
Great stay, we all hope to own a house like this. The host is very nice, totally recommend!

I don’t know if i can find the right words to describe this please i think Heaven is perfect i felt like i was in heaven the views were amazing breathtaking, the kitchen was literally screaming use then who am I to resist😂. And Patience OMG so lovely 😊 always available to help.
I can’t wait to come back the villa worth every single dollars and more.
Thank you for giving us a bit taste of heaven on earth 💯♥️

A beautiful property overlooking the Clifton beaches.. unbelievable views!
The house had everything you needed. We were 2 families, and there was plenty of space.
Loved the experience

Glenn's apartment was a great place for the two of us to spend a few days in Cape Town! Fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bed, outdoor space and good wifi. Walking distance to grocery, restaurants, waterfront, trails, etc. Very quiet, safe neighborhood - it was perfect!

The place was nothing short of perfect. My girlfriend and I stayed there for a month and it was everything we expected and more. From Location to Comfort, there was nothing that was falsified from the description and pictures. Glenn was always there for assistance when needed as well as went out of his way to make the stay that much more pleasant. Would recommend to anyone in  heartbeat.

It is a lovely place, close to everything you need ie beach, mall, restaurants etc
Glen is super friendly and helpful

Ideally situated close to the beach and all the outlets you will need. Shops, restaurants, etc are in walking distance. The unit is very neat and offers a fantastic private sitting area. Wifi and DSTV are also included which is perfect for those days when you want to simply relax at home. The little thoughtful touches are what make all the difference here. Just imagine waking up every morning to the beautiful sight of signal hill, it is truly a wonderful unit and Glenn is a great host.
It is extremely well positioned for visitors to Cape Town and was immaculately clean and Glenn was a great host.
This place has everything you need and is very clean, in a save area. The hosts are super nice and helpful, Glenn answers very quickly. We really enjoyed our stay.
Glenn's place was absolutely amazing. He has everything you would need for a little staycation. 5 stars all around
Glenn treats you like his family not a tenant. He listens and attends to your needs, very helpful all the time.

Glenn and his wife are the best hosts in my life. Although I have a lot of travel experience and I have something to compare. Place and apartment are very beautiful, specially bbq zone. Thank you so much!

The location is great, close to the seapoint main road and waterfront. The place was spotless and john (the cleaner) was extremely kind and did an amazing job at keeping everything tidy. Glenn was very quick to reply whenever i had an issue. The price was also extremely good. Highly recommend staying here !!!
Glenn’s place it’s perfect. Clean, well organized and it had everything that I needed. A beautiful view from Lion’s Head in a quiet neighborhood.
We had such a lovely time! The pictures are 100% accurate and they were so accommodating and helpful with everything! We will definitely be coming back!

Glenn, as a host, and his place are both highly recommended. We had a comfortable stay and will happily return. Highlights of our stay include peaceful surroundings, privacy, and a patio overlooking lion's head. Glenn's place is spacious, neat, and was fully equipped to suit all our needs.

My stay at this Airbnb in Sea Point, Cape Town, was fantastic! The host is friendly and maintains excellent communication throughout the entire stay. The location is ideal, nestled in a quiet and charming neighborhood, yet within easy walking distance to the main street bustling with restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, and malls.
The room had everything I needed, and the lovely balcony added a special touch. It was the perfect spot for a small gathering or just enjoying the beautiful views with lions head.
I also appreciated the regular cleaning schedule, with the apartment being tidied up every two days (except for holidays). It added a touch of comfort and convenience to my stay. I loved this apartment and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a delightful and well-equipped place in Sea Point. Thank you for making my time in Cape Town so enjoyable!

We had an amazing stay at Glenn’s apartment! Everything was arranged nicely and the accommodation was just like the description said. The amenities could get a little revamp - but all in all the price you pay is so very reasonable for the location. We loved the little patio with the grill, had amazing braai evenings.
Glenn was an incredibly great host, always answering instantly, no matter what time we messaged him. We found a solution for all the little tweaks and issues we had during our three month stay.
John cleaned the apartment on Mondays and Thursdays to perfection and helped with every question we had!
We can definitely recommend the apartment for short and longer stays!! Thanks again for everything!

Really nice and safe neighborhood, walking distance from main road but in a pretty big hill to walk back. Comfortable and private place to stay with a really nice view. Both hosts are super nice, easy communication and assisting with whatever you need.

Had an amazing time! Glenn and his partner were very responsive and helpful. Went for regular hikes on the nearby Lions head mountain and enjoyed a bunch of unique restaurants a walking distance from the place!

Glenn was very professional and accommodating. However the place is nothing like the pictures posted on the site. My wife was very uncomfortable and immediately wanted to leave. The place was not as bright and large looking as the pictures posted. We were very disappointed. Glenn was very understanding and apologetic when we told him we were leaving.

Glenn was a friendly host. The place was neat and private. We fully enjoyed our stay and hope to return again. We forgot our laptop charger, Glenn was quick to notify us to return and collect it.
Thank you, definately recommend.

Karen's place was perfect for my needs! The room was tidy and clean and parking for the hire car was great! The room also has a little coffee/tea
stand which was lovely. Thanks for letting me stay at your lovely place.
An amazing place, great for kids. We had a fabulous stay. Great touches and modern design. I’ll go back any day. Thanks Cate for your prompt communication and warm welcome.
Super friendly & clean, very accommodating. Close to all shops. Virgin Active is a few hundred meters away. Would go back anytime again.

Karen is a lovely, friendly person who made our stay very comfortable. The room was very neat, clean and cosy and the bed was very comfortable. Karen also left a few very sweet personal touches for us to enjoy and a coffee/tea station in the room. My husband and I had everything we needed for our overnight stay and we would definitely return if we ever pass through the area again. Thank-you Karen!!
Absolutely outstanding hospitality, Karen goes all out to help you and make you feel welcome. I absolutely love it the room was stunning smells great and we enjoyed the pool too

Excellent place to stay well equipped so handy to the Water Front and City and safe.
Super Market and deli really close with great wine selection also good restaurants nearby Mano's especially good.
Enjoyed every minute spent in Cape Town a fantastic City.

What an absolute wonderful stay we had again in Cape Town. Nick and Tanya, so pleased we have found this little hideaway place that is so comfortable and welcoming. Travel to Cape Town has never before been as enjoyable as we now find it. Thank you so much for all you do to make our trip extra special

We spent two weeks in this lovely flat in Cape Town. It was bright and light, well equipped, roomy, with a comfortable bed, well supplied kitchen with everything you need. It was also immaculate. Check in was simple. The secure parking garage was an added benefit in CapeTown.  There were a few minor issues with the WiFi, but they were addressed immediately . It was a pleasure to deal with Nick and Tanya. We would definitely recommend this flat and would stay here again. The location in Cape Town ( Green Point ) is perfect. Thank you for a wonderful stay.

Great location, fantastic hosts with useful tips and advice.
Only a 15 minute walk from the waterfront.
We cannot think of a better location to spend time in Cape Town.

Nick and Tanya's place was amazing! We had a truly wonderful experience. The location was awesome, right near Giovanni's which turned out to be soooo convenient. Great views, and every piece if information you'd ever need. Would definitely recommend this to any traveler. Thanks again....
Looking forward to seeing you soon!
Sara and Ben

Excellent hosts!!
Location is ideal... very centrally located!!
Apartment is nice / modern and ideal for couple or small family.
Highly recommend Nick & Tanya!!

Clean, comfortable, convenient, well appointed apartment and only a short walk from V&A waterfront.  Internet a bit variable however probably no fault of the apartment but just local connection problems.  Overall a very good place to stay.

Nick and Tanya are quick to respond and went out of their way to share their guide book of recommendations of what to do when meeting us. There was plenty of space for 2 people and the place is tidy.
The place was very light, though may benefit from blackout curtains to help you with that sleep in and elevate noise, being just off the main road with the constant car horns and the early sunrise.

Great location with handy cafés and shops closeby (including Jason's Bakery). Nick and Tanya were very quick to respond to our emails and provided useful tips to make the most of our time in Cape Town. There was also an underground car park with private garage, which was very useful for us as we had rented a car.

Great apartment in one the best and most lively areas in Cape Town. Close to the waterfront, downtown, beaches and countless trendy restaurants.
The apartment is huge and has excellent modern finishes. You can easily cook your own meals if you like or choose to dine at one of the many close by restaurants and cafes.
Nick and Tanya were super easy to communicate with and made our stay easy and enjoyable. I would definitely stay here again when in Cape Town.

We had a wonderful stay for 3 nights in Nick & Tanya’s apartment which is perfectly located in front of the Green Point where you could walk to the centre of V&A Waterfront. The room was new, clean, comfy and spacious enough for our family of 3. There is a big and good bath tub but they have removed a bath plug in consideration of the water shortage in Cape Town, which was totally fine. Their response was quick and check-in/out were easy. The flat is located on the 5th floor of the building with two lifts. We would definitely come back if we have a chance and would recommend to our friends!
Beautiful little apartment with everything we needed for a short vacation, the location was good and the neighborhood was safe to walk around at night. Would definitely stay there again

Our stay here worked perfectly.  We have traveled extensively and I would not hesitate to recommend it.  The premises were very clean and stocked with everything you would expect.  The hosts provided numerous maps, brochures, and travel guides as well.  One feature that was very useful was it’s proximity to a wonderful bakery (Jason’s ) , deli (Giovanni’s), and market (Woolworth’s). If you decide to make use of the kitchen, then everything you might want is a few close steps nearby.  Building security  was very good and I never had any concerns.  We rented a vehicle and there was a secure garage space as well.  Parking space is tight in town so this was a big plus.

The place was very nice, and we really enjoyed our stay
The apartment building is safe and close to the V&A waterfront.
Nick & Tanya gave their very best to feel totally at home.

Great location, spotlessly clean, crisp bed sheets :)
Local shops and restaurants great, and 10 minute walk from V+A
Great stay at nick and tanyas! Supremely clean apartment in a great location. Easy check in. Comfortable bed, nice complimentary touches. Really the perfect apartment! Thanks so much
The apartment itself is really nice very clean and well equipped. Good location. Nick is very responsive  but the neighbors are very noisy from very early until late evening.
A lovely garden cottage in a quiet setting. The cottage is well equipped, clean and very comfortable. Sally is a very accommodating and helpful host. I will be recommending to family and friends.

Sally was very responsive and welcoming.  She was very flexible with our arrival and departure times and made us feel totally at home.  The cottage is next to the main house and is in a gated community, which made us feel very safe.  We were welcomed with a bottle of wine and very comprehensive guide of the local area.  The location is perfectly located near lots of local wineries and beaches and is very close to downtown Cape Town.  We LOVED staying here and plan to again!
Very comfortable and wheelchair friendly. Helpful, attentive hosts with the personal touch. Will certainly return.

The place has fantastic views and is located in a safe and very well accessible neighborhood. The cottage itself is pefectly equipped with everything one may need for the stay there, it is very cosy and decorated with taste. We would most certainly recommend it to anyone wanting to stay close to Cape Town in a bit more quiet surroundings than the city itself. It is also very well suited for families with little kids such as ours:)
Sally and Chris are also the perfect hosts taking very good care of their guests. Thank you so much!

From the accommodation to the location, everything was perfect for our stay.  The bedrooms were both comfortable and spacious.  The one and a half bathrooms avoided any conflicts.  The kitchen, dining area and lounge were both convenient and comfortable and the outside sitting area in its own private garden with a beautiful view of Table Mountain exceeded all of our expectations.  Secure parking for two vehicles rounded off a perfect stay.

Loved staying in this beautiful cottage. Sally has put a lot of thought into what would make her guests comfortable and has thought of every little detail. Stunning location, beautifully decorated and very much a home away from home. Highly recommend and we will definitely use it again.

This is the perfect to stay, fully equipped , in the Constantia Valley, very safe and a wonderful host.
Bob

Our stay here can be described with one word: PERFECT!
We loved the cottage, the location (absolutely beautiful and safe), the furniture & facilities provided (all the basics being provided in bath & kitchen!) and last but not least Sally's & Chris' welcoming and lovely hospitality.
As a family of 4 this is the place we will recommend our friends to come to and what more can we say than that we just can't await to come back here again ourselves!?

Absolutely beautiful and perfectly equipped cottage in the stunning area of Constantia! We loved to stay at Sally’s place with our little daughter and will definitely come back during future travels! It was the best start for our South Africa journey we could hope for! Thanks Sally, for providing such a lovely place!
This was already the third time we stayed in Chris and Sally's wonderful cottage enjoying the surroundings and the hosts' hospitality. We will hopefully come back next year again! Thank you!

What a fantastic place. Sally and her family were so welcoming and helpful throughout our stay. The small touches she did to make the cottage a home away from home was amazing. Would highly recommend this cottage if you'd like to relax in a beautiful and peaceful setting.
Beautiful place on a perfect location! The place was bigger than we expected. Hope to be back one day!

Wonderful property and fab hosts. Super accommodating by allowing us an early check-in as we came straight off an overnight flight with a baby, and this was invaluable. And there was a super comfy cot waiting for him which was amazing! Property is even better than the photos and the private garden is wonderful. A brilliant start to our holiday in South Africa (visiting from the UK). Thanks for having us!

Sally's cottage is very peaceful, beautifully maintained, and very private. It was a great place to entertain a few friends. Felt like a home away from home. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to friends.

Sally is a great host. She accommodated our late arrival and always responded quickly.  The cottage is private, has high ceilings and the bedrooms are big. The main bedroom is especially big. You'll be surprised when you arrive because I think the place looks better than what you see in the pictures. Location wise, it is a quiet cul-de-sac in Constantia so with all the trees around I would describe it as peaceful.

My family and I had a wonderful stay at the Sun Valley cottage, was exactly as pictured, serene, beautiful garden, very private, careful consideration to making this a home away from home. Sally was an excellent host, very accommodating and pleasant.
We had a lovely few days, so quiet. For staying near but not in Cape Town this is the best.

One of our favourite Air BnB places we have stayed in! Spacious, clean, peaceful, with homely furnishings. Lovely location and view. Sally was very friendly and helpful.
Thank you for a lovely stay!
This is the 4th time we have stayed at Sally's for work and and with the family. Always a winner, excellent location for what we require and Sally always on hand in need. I'm sure we will be back.

Nick & Tanya are amazing hosts. We highly recommend their place in Capetown. The coordination and communication was excellent. The apartment location is perfect, you can walk to just about everything. The apartment was sparkling clean and had everything we needed, even washing detergent which came in handy with our toddler. We hope to visit again.
Great location, perfect for a couple. You have everything you need in a home away home. Everything is good quality. Very nice view, easy check in. We had a great time and will return.
This is a very comfortable, well located and well equipped apartment exactly as described. On occasions it suffered from the street noise.
The hosts were amazing, the apartment has a great view and location. i would highly recommend it to everyone.
Perfect to work from, the sunsets are gorgeous. Close to great breakfast and lunch places. You can smell the sea from the flat.

Lovely apartment in a huge oldish security block directly facing 2 main roads. The central location comes with heavy traffic noise. So if you are sensitive to that, be aware. Even though the block might be secure, there are lots of beggars/street people just outside.
The apartment itself was spacious, has nice views and was kind of clean. I stood for 3 nights. Not again due to the location.

had a great stay with my daughter was so relaxing .
thank you sally love your cottage.

I would highly recommend staying in Nick and Tanya's apartment. As a solo female traveler I felt very safe in the apartment as it has 24h security, underground parking and is on the 5th floor. The apartment is tastefully decorated and has every amenity you might think of with great attention to detail: toiletries, many towels, kitchen appliances, free coffee and tea supplies, a comfortable bed and fast wifi. The location of the apartment is  ideal for those that are in Cape Town for work or travel. I would definitely like to stay in this apartment next time I am in Cape Town.
Such a beautiful place, best location. It offered more than I expected. I loved the fact that it made me feel at home 👌🏾

Very well located to everything and a very well appointed apartment.  Loved going downstairs and round the corner were the coffee shops, restaurants, deli,  Spar and Woolies a very short walk away. Had to phone Nick once and he was most helpful. A bit noisy at night but the location certainly overrides this minor issue. Convenient to drive to anywhere. Cynthia & Brian

We spent a wonderful week in the apartment! It was spotlessly clean, had all the amenities we needed, very comfy bed and beautiful views! The apartment is close to almost everything, so it’s ideally situated for exploring Cape Town!

The check-in process was seamless. Any minor issue I may have had was quickly resolved by a phone call to Nick. It is really close to V & A Waterfront and other amenities. The apartment has a lovely view of the stadium and sea. The doormen were friendly and helpful.
My son and I enjoyed our stay.

Tanya & Nick appartment is exactly as per description. Well located, clean, spacious, well equiped and safe. It also have a secured parking for your car. These superhosts were also reacheable when required and attended to our request promptly. They also keep us notified about check-in, check-out and load shedding schedules. A shout out to the security guys who were always nice and helpful. Thank you for the stay.
Nick and Tanya's spot is fantastic. Very conveniently located, well equipped, clean and comfortable. A perfect base for a trip to the mother city. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

Great location and walking distance from restaurants and Woolworths foods. Nice and sunny apartment for winter. Might get hot in summer. We would definitely be back. Nick was available when we had questions. Safe and secure parking. 5 ⭐️!!

Lovely stay at Nick & Tanya’s appartment. The check-in was easy. The appartment complex was very safe. The appartment was clean,  had everything we needed and had a great view of the sunset. I would recommend anytime.
Lovely place with all amenities, and very well located. Nice views of the city too. Nick was very helpful and responsive throughout.

The apartment is great!
good location, good appliances and kitchen and feels very safe with (very nice and helpful) security guards.
Nick and Tanya were informative, available and considerate!
location was first class, Giovannis deli just stone throw for quick coffee. Bao Kapp and VA walking distance. secure parking. Great find.

Beautiful views and sea breezes from the apartment, and very convenient to Green Point and the V&A waterfront. It can get pretty loud, though: there was a football match at the stadium my first night, and the traffic from the Main Road was pretty noisy.  The flat was really well-appointed, with a really great kitchen.

Comfortable, clean and bright apartment in a great location.  Restaurants and a supermarket  within easy walking distance, the V&A waterfront is also within walking distance. The area felt safe, Nick and Tanya had secure parking below their apartment building, the doorman at the apartments was able to let us in when we first arrived. We had great instructions and Nick was very helpful. We would recommend this apartment to others.

Great air bnb and very well located! The apartment is clean and tastefully decorated, it has anything you would need for a long and short stay. Hosts were very responsive and we really enjoyed the stay.
Secure accommodation in a central location, easy walk to V&A Waterfront. Great communication from hosts, would recommend! Expect some noise from the stadium when there are events.

We stayed two weeks in Cape Town , and Nick & Tanya’s place was perfect.   Great location, easy walk to shops, cafes and the Waterfront.   Easy to access MyCiTi bus and Ubers were easy to get.   A great location from which to explore the many wonders of Cape Town.  N&T we’re always quick to respond to any questions we had, which weren’t many, because they had left very clear instructions in the apartment .

Great location in Cape Town, with views of the ocean. Place could do with a bit of a refresh, and quite noisy as you are in the middle of town. Overall really comfortable space, well kitted out kitchen, and a good base for exploring Cape Town.

We booked this place again, as we loved it so much the first time. However, the hosts (which I suspect have outsourced the comms to a company), left out a code required for check in, and thankfully we guessed it hadn’t changed from the previous stay. The wifi was absent on the whole of the first night, and when I reached out to the hosts on how we could fix it, they didn’t respond. Until now, they haven’t gotten back to me. We did our own troubleshooting and found that there was a problem with the provider in the neighbourhood - it resolved itself the next day. The place is great - comfy, and all, but I think they need to work on comms. We were resourceful, but other guests who might not have good technical knowledge may not manage as well.

We loved this apartment. It was in a fabulous location with a great deli, pubs, restaurant & two supermarkets. Nick & Tayna very kindly left milk for us. There was plenty of dishes etc for use. We had Wi-Fi & lots of hot water. It was a short walk to the V&A & the beach walk. I would have no hesitation in recommending this air B&B to everyone
The apartment had everything you need for a short and even a longer stay (including washing machine & tumbler).  Short way to the waterfront. Thanks to Nick& Tanya!
No information mentioned about the apartment being on the 5th floor, and due to electricity cuts had to  carry the luggage to 5th floor; the instructions were shared very late and not concise.

Contact to the owners was perfect, always quick to answer if help was needed.
We loved the location. Walking distance from waterfront and green point (perfect for kids) and not long of a drive to table mountain etc.
Infos for load shedding were provided which was good!
The apartment seems to be newer in the pictures than in real life (good photographer) - slightly “worn out”
Also internet took forever after load shedding which can be irritating for planning of the days if you don’t have a mobile plan
We came with a 2 year old toddler and had a great time! Tipp for parents: there is a window from Livingroom to bedroom. If kids need darkness, you have to be creative (we blocked it with the living room table). But fully recommended for families due to location and nearby activities

Very nice apartment and was easy to check in. Great views of DHL stadium and even the ocean. Everything is just like how it is in the pictures. Just a few things that were inconvenient. The Wi-Fi was not working most of the time or it either worked for a few minutes and disconnected on its own. Did write to Nick and Tanya about it but never responded. The bed was slightly uncomfortable for our backs to sleep but still manageable. Other than that, everything else was great. It was clean overall, kitchen appliances worked very well and it was peaceful just as we hoped for it to be. Best to contact them through a phone call if you need to reach them like we did. My fiancée and I really enjoyed our stay there.
Nick and Tanya’s accommodation was clean and close to V&A. The arrival was easy despite we arrived late in the evening, and they were very accommodating with us. Recommend!

I enjoyed my stay here. Check-in was initially complicated as the guard wasn't around. Overall, it is a lovely comfy apartment with great views and light. Only downside was that it was a little sticky / dusty in some corners of the apartment and on the handbook. Thanks for a great stay!

Everything was organized, clean. Great location.
I felt at home with all the care, tourist information and amenities available in the apartment.
Easy check-in and check-out.
They are great hosts - I really recommend the apartment.

Super convenient location, with a few tiny tweaks (full length shower curtain, welcome rug/mat, hooks for towels/clothing) it would be much more comfortable for a longer term stay. Super friendly hosts.

This place is a gem! Walkable to great restaurants and the stadium (we came for the rugby). The apt itself is perfect for a couple or couple with a baby. Everything was very comfortable and clean. Nick was responsive to my questions and was easy to access. Would absolutely stay here again.

Excellent place to stay in Cape Town. The apartment is situated in a lovely area - everything you need is within a walkable distance. You can also easily reach Camps Bay, the Waterfront and much more must-see-places in Cape Town. Rose and Roy are wonderful, lovely hosts and made us feel super welcome. They even offered us to stay another night at no costs if our flights would have got cancelled due to the weather conditions.
We would definitely stay there again and we recommend the place for anyone who wants an amazing time in Cape Town!

Rose and Roy's property is a hidden gem in Cape Town. It's walking distance to tons of shops, restaurants, and beaches. The home itself was very well kept and truly matches its' description. We wish we could have stayed longer!
Rose's place is central and close to many attractions in Cape Town. The house was perfect for me and my two boys. Would stay there again!
It is a very nice garden appartement in Fresney. Everything was exactly how it was described and I felt very safe there. I highly recommend Rosemary's appartement for a stay in wonderful Cape Town.

Rose was a good host, available at check-in and responsive. Great neighbourhood close to good restaurants and beaches. There was some noise for a few minutes a day as kids ran on the upper floors. Friendly dogs and space to sit outside by the pool. Overall we had a good time.

Didn’t meet Rosemary until check out but she was easy to communicate with. Was checked in by their housekeeper who was lovely. Good location if you want to be between camps bay and the waterfront. Would agree with previous reviews that you can hear the family running around above you but it didn’t ruin our stay. Thanks for hosting us!
Everything is on 100% for me. Will recommend, great location and easy access to every major attraction centres💛

Rosemarys place was very spacious, comfortable bed, super fast WiFi, safe on street parking. The kitchen was well equipped and extras such as fruit, milk, tea, coffee and spices were very thoughtful. The only think to note was that you can hear the kids talking and running upstairs and you see the dogs pop up in the garden occasionally but it is not intrusive.

Exceptionally clean and spacious with a lovely modern kitchen and full bathroom. The garden is right on your door step and is shared by the 2 very friendly Labradors. As the unit is below the main house we did experience a lot of noise from upstairs.

Fabulous week long stay in a spacious, homely studio. Very clean, bright and modern with a full kitchen  was perfect for us, and being pet friendly was an absolute bonus as we were travelling with a small dog.  All the comfort of home in a quiet yet very convenient location was ideal. Friendly hosts gave us complete privacy. One of my best Cape Town stays👌

Roy and Rosemary were fantastic welcoming hosts.
The place is a nice ground floor flat with access to the garden and pool.
Would recommend anyone planning to stay in Sea View with convenient 10–15 min access to beaches and town center.

Highly recommend - would definitely stay again. We had a great stay with Rosemary and Roy. The apartment is in a fantastic location, easily walkable to Seapoint and Bantry Bay, which have all the restaurants, cafés and shops you could need. It is also a sizeable space, comfortably big for a couple staying with all the amenities you could need.
Hosts were helpful and responsive and have 2 super lovely dogs!
It was very hot during our stay so only small improvement we could suggest would be having a fan already in the space (as there is no AC).
This house was a gem. It is in a great location with the beach & amazing restaurant close. The owners were so friendly & the house was so comfortable. We felt right at home
Had a lovely time staying at Rosemarys place with my dog! The outside space was perfect and the accommodation cosy. Really helpful and welcoming hosts :)
Nice and cosy apartment.We were here for 2 weeks.Its a little bit of a walk to the promenade (and steep) but the two of them were super kind and helpful.

What a gem! Clean, very comfortable and perfectly located for our busy itinerary. Hosts are friendly and very knowledgable, and more than happy to help us plan how to fit everything in. Very close to constantia wine lands and easy to get to beaches, town centre, waterfront shopping etc. We had a great stay!
Grit was so accommodating and even helped us with our laundry despite the water shortage. Great host!!!
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Quiet safe neighborhood, comfortable clean cottage and Grit and her family were very hospitable. Highly recommend
Very neat apartment, centrally located. It is very easy to find and the staff at the building are extremely helpful. I would definitely stay here again.

The location of the place is great and convenient. Close to the Sea Point Prominade for joggers and Sea Point swimming pools. The internet is stable and reliable for working.
However, the furniture on the picture and at the house were different. The coffee table, the mat and the cute chair close to the window were not there.
Check in was smooth and the host was fast on replying.

It was a real pleasure staying at Koos’s place.
The unit is conveniently located and only a short walk from the main road at Sea Point and is very close to grocery stores and plenty of yummy breakfast places and restaurants.
I'd recommend this place to anyone wanting a convenient place in Sea Point.
Great place, near to the beach, groceries, all the things that we need. The apartment is large and comfortable.

Unpleasant stay, what was advertise we did not receive, flat was not clean properly, furniture was not as advertised, no dstv. Blind in bathroom  can't close so if you shower there is no privacy people that walk past can see your silhouette, although we try to make the best of an unpleasant stay and welcoming.
We had a great time at this Airbnb. It qas exactly what we were looking for. The location, in Seapoint, was amazing. Thanks!

The apartments are better in real life than in the photos. Convenient kitchen - has everything you need. Spacious bedroom and large closet. There is a washing machine and hair dryer. All necessary utensils are also available. Comfortable bed and good bed linen. Excellent location - all restaurants and shops are nearby, but the house is below the noisy places. Ideal for 1-2 guests. I was on a business trip for 1 month - it was very comfortable, quiet, light in the apartment. Thanks to the owner for always being in touch. There were no problems with the accommodation. I am very pleased and recommend.

Absolutely beautiful apartment with the most amazing views of Cape Town. The decor of the apartment was like something you see in a magazine. Just beautiful and such attention to detail. The location of the penthouse is ideal for exploring everything Cape Town has to offer and is within walking distance of the local shops and a few local trendy cafes and restaurants. Varenka was a really lovely, friendly host. We are already planning our visit next year!

BEST SPOT IN ALL OF CAPE TOWN. This was the finest airbnb experience I have had to date. I'm part-South African and think Vredehoek is THE nicest part of Cape Town: fantastic view put across the city and harbour, and nestled below the Mountain. Varenka's apartment maximizes all these location advantages. The place is outstanding. So stylish, so clean, so well-equipped. It felt like the most perfect blend of home and hotel. Prefect also for two couples or, as we were, colleagues travelling together.

The apartment is awesome and it is exactly like in the pictures.  it is very stylish beautifully furnished and decorated spacious apartment and has everything you can wish from a holiday home.  The area is nice and quiet and has shops and restaurants nearby.  Varenka as a hostess is very precise and you get answers, help and information from her promptly. But perhaps the best of it all is the amazing view of Cape Town which you can admire endlessly. I will definitely recommend this apartment for a succesful vacation and would absolutely like to stay here again on my next trip to Cape Town.

Nice contemporary Apartment, good interior design, stunning views over Cape Town, Signal Hill and Table Mountain. From a location point, safe neighborhood, but it can get quite windy.  Varenka very prompt responding. Dixon very friendly and helpful with the check-in and cleaning.  Thank you Varenka for your hospitality, T & J

The apartment is as it looks in the photos so there are no surprises there. The hidden bonuses of this place are: 1) the host who was amazingly responsive and helpful before and throughout the visit; 2) the 360 degree view from the wraparound desk over the city bowl and up to table mountain; 3) the location, which was quiet, felt safe, and was a 5-7 minute walk to a grocery and half a dozen good restaurants.
Varenka even brought games for our kids and though I don’t know if they will be there next time, an entire marvel library that kept my kids (and me) occupied during downtimes.
The only warning for this area in general — which after visiting a ton of other neighborhoods on a housing hunting tour, I now love — is that during certain times of year it can get very windy so be careful not to leave anything (like small children) out on the deck.

This was our second extended stay at this airbnb. It is spacious, has lots of amenities, and beautiful views. The location is ideal - you are close to supermarkets, restaurants, the mountain, and are a five minute drive to the city center.
Varenka is an excellent host. We would highly recommend this airbnb to those visiting Cape Town.

Just fantastic. Epic views with a great outside area for entertaining. Big living space will plenty of seating. Desks for remote work a huge plus for us. Kitchen is a joy to cook in. Huge master suite and second is plenty big enough

What can I say - we absolutely loved staying at Varenka’s beautiful apartment. She was extremely welcoming, flexible with check in timings, and really helpful with anything we needed.
The apartment is gorgeous and well located. Couldn’t quite believe we were able to have a braai overlooking Table Mountain!
Everything was super clean, the wifi worked really well and Varenka even left a bottle of wine for us on arrival. The generator worked well during load shedding too. I would love to stay at this place again.

This is my first time to South Africa. The place was wonderful. The views are breathtaking. I love the extra touches the host had with fresh flowers chocolates a nice board with a greeting hello. Everything was a nice touch. I love the decor the beautiful picture in the living room. Spacious and I enjoy the kitchen . As far as the rest of the place It could get very windy at times so you just had to be prepared. I can't wait to come back again.

The place was beautiful and private with stunning views.
Varenka is a wonderful host who made us feel welcome and always answered any questions we had right away.
We used the place to work remotely for a few days and the Wifi is fast and load shedding proof.
Thank you Varenka!

We were lucky to get instant booking in this lovely two-bedroom apartment along the beachfront for our family of four. Great location near the lovely Green Point Park with parking in a garage.  Great amenities with washer/dryer if needed and milk/fruit/ snacks provided. Hosts gave us a very warm welcome, and they were very professional with key drop off and flexibility with arrival/ departure times!

Michael welcomed us to the flat, showed us around and was very helpful. the flat was clean and was as we expected. we only stayed one night, but it is in a great location for visiting the cape town - sadly the weather was against us for our planned run along the front!

This will be our go to accommodation in the Cape. Perfect location, pleasant and friendly host, well appointed clean flat.  Milk and breakfast cereal with tea and coffee, fruit and chocolates and a bottle of wine. Thank you.

What a wonderful stay! This place is truly special! Great location, clean, modern and spacious! I can definitely recommend it!!
Thank you for being such welcoming hosts, with great communication and being so friendly and accommodating.
This place is in an excelent location with restaurants, transport and  entertainment at walking distance. Michael is very attentive and always has a solution to help unexperienced tourists!

This apartment has everything you need.
Fully equiped kitchen, Bathroom and bedrooms.
Fresh fruit on arrival was such a treat when my family arrived from a long trip from Portugal.
Across the road from Cape Towns amazing Promonade, great to run, sunset views.
Amazing Cafe Neo on the corner and New Port Deli around the corner as well. BEST coffee!!
Green Point park right there. Sunset walks.
The list is long and the experience was just phanominal.
Michael and Kristen were amazing host's always made sure that we were taken care of and just to organised on arrival.
I would definitely like to utalise this apartment again when my family visit and would recommend it 5 stars to any visitors.
Thanks again.
Raquel

Mike is a super host - efficient and really helpful. He goes the extra mile w.r.t. assistance in the flat and info out and about.
The location is superb. With or without a vehicle. Top class restaurants on your doorstep and sights and attractions close by.
Look forward to staying in contact.
Michael was a wonderful host, he was there to meet us, and left lots of goodies for us to enjoy, including two of his very interesting books.  The Location was the best ever.

Michael & Kirstens place, is certainly the place to stay on your trip to Cape Town. Located near the Waterfront, a good location to do further exploring of the beautiful cape. A very clean and comfortable apartment, with very friendly hosts. We really enjoyed our stay.

This place is very well situated - a massive park behind you, the ocean in front of you, the waterfront is close by. The apartment has great amenities - including a media player and fast wifi to stream whatever you need. Beds are very comfortable. Kitchen well-equipped.
Michael and Kristin are fantastic, friendly hosts. Their place is clean, a home away from home.

The best location you can find in Cape Town. Hardly any distance from the top locations and the waterfront , this house offers everything one needs for a perfect vacation. The hosts ensured a sparking clean house , lightning fast interned , all essential amenities , personal touch to prepare the house for the guests and excellent coordination before arrival. The personal parking space is a big add one, the building is super safe and quiet. The park and walkways in front of the aprtment make life fun and interesting ,especially for families. The hosts are highly responsive and are confident of their hospitality. Would love to stay at Micheal and Kristin house everytime I come to Cape Town. Highly recommended to all.

I didn't have the pleasure to meet with Michael but everything was perfect. The communication was really great and it made everything so much easier for our trip. I definitely recommand their appartment.

Very  nice flat, clean and friendly, very uncomplicated hosts, excellent location. If you travel with kids, this place is extra perfect as there is a putt putt course and amazing playgrounds right outside. For runners - the seapoint promenade is lovely for a nice little run. We will book this place again for our next Cape Town trip, no doubt.
Very nice flat, ideally located for a stay in Cape Town ! Michael is very friendly and easy to get hold of. The flat is clean and secure. We had an awesome stay there and we recommend to all.

We couldn't have asked for a better stay in Green Point thanks to Michael and Kirstin! They were so quick to respond to any questions we had and ensured that we felt "at home" in their flat. Can't beat the location, either. Would definitely stay there again :)

Fantastic host. Check in was effortless, with Michael personally showing us the ropes. Lovely, comfortable apartment, very well equipped. Our two teenage boys enjoyed the super fast internet. The apartment is very well situated in Mouillie Point, in close proximity to the Waterfront and some good restaurants. We loved the vibe in the area and always felt safe. Can definitely recommend.

INCREDIBLE LOCATION with a lovely, accommodating host Michael.   We only had one night in Cape Town and couldn't have picked a better location within walking distance to VNA Waterfront and Sea Point.  Restaurants, sightseeing and athletic opportunity abound in this area of the city.  This is our 6th trip to Cape Town and we felt that this was the best accommodation base so far for exploring the city (especially when one only has a short time).  The flat is very clean with a stocked kitchen (although great restaurants outside the door) and comfortable living room.  Child friendly too.

Firstly, I’d like to say that Michael and Kirstin are AMAZING hosts. You’ll see that I’ve stayed in their accommodation several times and I’d struggle to look elsewhere.
I love this place, it’s one of my favourites. There’s everything you need, the locations amazing, it’s spotless and very comfortable. Don’t delay, just get it booked if its available!

Great location close to all that Mouille Point has to offer, ideal spot for a night or two, but a tight squeeze for a family to reside in for longer.
Lovely helpful hosts, great that its pet friendly too!
Thanks for the short stay!
Great hosts! great location! and everything you need is in the area...will definitely reccomend this place

Micheal is a great host, he hosts a few places so make sure you read the review for the right property and not just for him. Lots of really thoughtful touches such as coffee, cake, fruit and milk. All very much appreciated when arriving after a long journey with "hangry" children.
Loved the lullaby of the sea each night, position of this place is great, close to park, enjoyed Park Run with the locals on Saturday. Also close to great cafes and the Hussar Grill, which even caters for those of us who don't eat meat.
Only stayed one night. Michael was great with communication. The place is exceptionally well located, clean and secure.
Great flat in one of the best areas in South Africa.  Can recommend Michael & Kirstin's place to anybody.  Exceptional value for money.

The second bedroom is too small for two children.....
The smell from the discharge sewrage pipe from the beach is bad....
Superb location safe with sea view from part of the living room. Nice airy bright spacious and smartly decorated. Comfortable beds and sofa. A drying rack is only thing we’d add!
Great location and the apartment was comfortable, clean and overall good value for money. Michael is an excellent host.
Location was superb, all was as expected and better, and communication was great. Michael went above and beyond to cater for my family and we had a wonderful stay. Will definitely be back.

Perfect location- close to everything.
Apartment with everything we needed. Michael responds almost immediately to any and all enquiries

We had a great stay at Michael & Kirsten’s place! Perfect little place with everything you need. Perfect location with lots of great restaurants within walking distance, the beautiful promenade on your doorstep and great base to explore the beautiful city of Cape Town from.
Loved our few days in Cape Town! Thanks for being great hosts!

We stayed here when we ran the Cape Town marathon and it was the perfect location.
Walking distance from Green Point Stadium and Caffe Neo on the corner has the best coffee and ice cream.
Also just across the street from Sea Point Promenade and there is a fantastic public swimming pool just 2.4km away.
Would definitely recommend this place for anyone!

We stayed here for 10 days with our family and it was perfect for us. The apartment is in an awesome location with the promenade, restaurants and beaches on your doorstep. The place is well equipped and has everything you need, including an inverter so we had power and WiFi during load-shedding. The decor is lovely and neutral and welcoming and everything feels comfortable.
This was an absolute beautiful place, close to everything. And my kids of 4 and 5 had a blast. Great place for the family

Our stay at Michael and Kristen's Airbnb was great. The location was ideal, right across from the promenade, and they were kind enough to let us leave our bags for a few extra hours. It was a very nice and convenient stay.
This was a great establishment for our purposes to rest and be close to the beach. Check-in & out was easy, very responsive communication and amenities of high quality.

Very cozy and clean home directly across the street from the waterfront. Easy walk to many good restaurants and the V&A Waterfront. Very helpful and responsive hosts. Would absolutely stay here again.

We had a great stay in Michael and Kristin's place. It was in a great location. The place suited us perfectly with small children. It was neat and tidy and had all the amenities we needed. Michael was very helpful with information and excellent at setting us up with equipment for our baby. Will definitely look at staying again in the future.

Fantastic apartment.
Beautiful and clean, just as described with the most comfortable bed we have slept on for a while!
It was a real treat relaxing in the bath!
Local restaurants walkable can recommend Lily's, The Butcher shop and Grill and Soltanos.
Also enjoyed The Firemans bar a taxi ride away.
Thank you for a wonderful stay.

We really enjoyed staying here! It is prime location close to downtown and amazing restaurants. This place is very spacious and has an awesome view of the city, you can view the city while having coffee out on the balcony (that's what I did!). Melinda and Symon (who gave us the keys) are very welcoming and helpful! I would definitely stay here!

Staying at Melinda's apartment is the best of both worlds: I felt like a local because it is so central and accessible to everywhere I wanted to be, but felt like a 5 star guest because of the thoughtful touches in this beautiful apartment with an exceptional view of the city, mountain and sea. Melinda has made sure that not only are the essentials taken care of (washing machine, wifi, sparkling clean apartment) but that there are thoughtful touches which make staying here feel like home (great restaurant recommendations, books, yoga mat and beach towels). If we didn't have to check out, Melinda would battle to get rid of us!

This is a great place to stay in an awesome location. The unit is easily accessible with a lift and has a great view and lovely balcony. It is walking distance to a variety of restaurants and other amenities, yet within the Tamboerskloof suburban area with a homely feel and a small park just around the corner for kids.

Melinda's place is as pictured and described, a cosy and comfortable apartment with a nice balcony overviewing Cape - City.  The district feels safe and there are plenty of dining, eating and shopping options nearby. During the week, the kids and ring-bells of the school across the street may be a bit loud which is not an issue if you are out sightseeing but it may be disturbing if you wanna sleep longer. Communication was easy, Melinda left many good tips about where to go and what to do, she is very hospitable and caring. Thank you

Mel's place is in a great neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and bars within walking distance as well as easy access via bus or car to all of the main tourist sites. Mel and Symon were very responsive, provided great local recommendations, and made us feel safe and at home. The flat is clean, large and well equipped, and it provided a nice 'home' while we toured Cape Town. Can definitely recommend!

It is in a safe neighbourhood, close to the shops and restaurants. The apartment is very clean and stylish. It has a great view of the mountain and part of the city especially at night.
Melinda,the host is amazing, she is organised, responds quickly to requests and very caring.
Enjoyed my stay there!!

Thank you very much. We had a fantastic stay in a clean, neat and tidy flat with everything we needed. Great locality, excellent communication with host and easy friendly and professional check in.
Highly recommended.
Melinda is an amazing host and very helpful. She is very responsive and kind has an awesome sense of humor. I’d definitely recommend staying at the apartment on Warren Heights.
A lovely, well-lit apartment in a great area. I haven't slept so well in my life (it has a great bed). 100% recommended
had such a lovely time staying at this airbnb! close to great places to eat, drink & the beach. the hosts were also so helpful. a great apartment for a homely stay, will be back :)
the apartment is immaculate and clean! Kitchen is fully equipped and modern. Views are stunning! And Georgi was quick to respond to any of our needs! Would def recommend!

We were really blown away by the scenic apartment, gorgeous views of the ocean and surroundings. The location provides easy access to many of Cape Towns star attractions and neighbourhoods. The decor is clean and very attractive. A great spot for travellers wishing to find the perfect homeaway. Would highly recommend booking.
Great location to visit all of Cape Town from. Perfect small apartment with everything you need! Georgi was very easy to deal with and communicated straight away. Definitely recommend

Great location, spacious, clean amd good taste in deco.
Georgi was a great host and always considerated in her guest's confort.

Location of appartment is very convenient, just in front the sea. We saw dolphins everyday. No parking issue.
Appartment is very clean with a very niceand modern decoration.

Georgi, thank you for letting us stay in this beautiful, beautiful, BEAUTIFUL apartment! Everything was perfect, from sheets to private garage.
And the place looks and feels exactly as advertised. One of my best accommodation experiences. We will be back!
xx

The flat has a frontline sea view and is exactly as the pictures depict. Great value for money and there are restaurants just around the corner and a great coffee shop and deli (Newports) for groceries. Safe off road parking and fast wifi make this a great base from which to explore the city. Highly recommend!

Nice, clean, bright and central to the city - just like it says!
We had a great long weekend. Thank You so much.
Place was just as it looked in the pics.  Water view was amazing and place was clean and up to par with what was expected. Georgi was quick to answer any questions I had and was very accommodating.
It was a very happy stay. Such a beautiful house with great location. The host made everything so easy. Very close to the parks on the beach, so if you have kids I definitely recommend.

The view is amazing!! The apartment is located in a safe area and you have a garage for your rental car which is quite convenient. Only negative aspekt is that its not that clean, especially floors & bathrooms.

Georgi’s spot is location perfectly for walks, food and of course views. The apartment has all one needs when staying in an area where you will spend most of your time away from it. The building is quite and secure.  It is a nice, clean, neat and light space.

It could have been such a lovely place, but it was dirty. Cockroaches running around everywhere. Dirty cups , thick layer of dust, especially the kitchen. Skirtings very dirty and stained. WiFi was not working the first night. Shower floor dirty with hair in the outlet.

Beautiful, bright and spacious apartment with great balcony on the 5th floor overlooking the ocean. Impressive view over the ocean. Well equipped and with Wi-Fi. Georgi was quick to respond when I sent her a message.
If there is fog on the ocean at night time, you will be hearing the fog horn from the light house 400m away.
I'd like to stay there again on a future visit to Cape Town.

Georgi’s air BnB was everything we expected! Was a lovely place to spend afew day’s exploring Cape Town and the surrounds - definitely felt like a home away from home!
She was very considerate and allowed us a later check out to accommodate for our international flight time. It was very clean and safe, with friendly security guards who answered any questions we had. Parking was very secure and convenient. Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others!

Ok, I read one bad review of this place.  Who ever wrote it was not right.  There is nothing but praise to be given.  If you like bright mornings, cleanliness, and amazing views... this is it.  Your close to all.  If you want calm chill spot with amazing coffee mornings, and chill wine sunsets.... look no further.
This is a stylish place with amazing 180 degree sea views in a safe secure block with private lock up garage.  We'll definitely book here again.
Great place to stay, excellent location and value for money. Slight problem with wifi but sorted straight away by host. Checkin very simple and quick. Close to V & A waterfront. Beautiful seaviews.
Unbelievable location! The most beautiful apartment and was everything we needed and more. Can’t wait to return
Prime location and ocean facing! Walkable to many convenient places. Easiest check-in and responsiveness. Also 24/7 front desk/building security! It was a lovely week here :)
A lovely place, with great views and a wonderful location. Apartment is beautiful and clean. Will definitely stay there again

This is a perfectly situated location which has all the requirements for a comfortable stay . The flat as well as the apartment block were very clean and tidy . The host was very efficient and quick to respond .
Words cannot describe the apartment, its cleanliness, its location and the very beautiful view. I will visit it again.

Stunning flat with spectacular views. Excellent location, within walking distance to the Waterfront as well as Sea Point.
WiFi is great. Decor is tasteful and minimalist. Check in process absolutely easy. G is a very kind and understanding host. Would definitely recommend this flat for a holiday or a long stay.

Amazing place and it’s just as it looks in the AD! The views were amazing, family friendly and very clean. When we first stumbled upon this apartment on AirBnB, it seemed almost too good to be true. There must be a catch! But everything was as perfect as it seemed online. All necessities provided, kitchen equipment, cleaning supplies, literally everything! The host was reachable on cell at all times. My family had a great time indeed. Perfect place.
Great location. We stayed for the weekend of the Cape Cycle Tour. The unit was within walking distance from the finish. Many great restaurants in the area. Fantastic view of the ocean.

Amazing apartment.  We thoroughly enjoyed our week. The apartment had everything we needed and the view and location is wonderful. However you do need to repair the sliding door as it is rather dangerous and couid come off its rail.  Will definitely try and plan a future stay. Many thanks
Great venue.  Clean. Furnishings a bit bare. Good amenities. Note that it is a limited bouquet for DSTV and the WiFi was terrible, as is the MTN service.

Place is central and easy to get around.
House keeping should be given more attention to detail .Wi-Fi is is the worse.

The place is really great— beautiful seaside views, super clean, safe central location, instructions were clear and the host was responsive. Overall great stay. Just a note for future guests, the amenities list an option for luggage storage… which we found really isn’t a thing. This left us scrambling a bit to find a place to store our luggage after checkout so that we can explore Cape Town a bit more  before we needed to head to the airport at 6pm

What a fantastic location and apartment. The views are spectacular and a joy to wake up and see the sea each morning from bed! The apartment has everything you will need for a short stay and the host is extremely communicative ensuring a straightforward enjoyable visit. Will definitely stay again and highly recommend.
We loved the accommodation. Perfect location and very lovely flat. Wished we could have stayed longer and would definitely like to re visit. Host was super responsive
We are very pleased! Everything worked perfectly with key delivery even though we arrived late. The apartment is nice, fresh and well-kept. And the view is amazing.
Great location - came for the stormers final and stadium was a walking distance. Amazing sea view and sunset. perfect location. will definitely be back.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Lovely, spacious apartment in beautiful & convenient location. There were a few small irritants. Initially insufficient glasses and all eating utensils limited to 4. Not sufficient cleaning materials. The garage remote didn't work properly and was never fixed. All in all we were satisfied and would go back.
The location was great, with awesome coffee spots close by on either side of the building. The beds could be firmer, the street is a bit noisy. Overall a good stay!

No effort made to offer any soaps, and small bathroom luxuries .
Very sparse, basic, no heating additional heating for cold weather.
Lacking imagination this is a bed and sleep over only.
And the beds could do with new mattresses.
My bed cover had a cigarette burn hole.
No attention to detail
Such potential but no interest to lift this apartment to international level.
We have enjoyed our stay. The view was amazing. Everything was as described. We had a great stay.

Absolutely stunning place with a spectacular view.
Armand was a superb host and we highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay in Cape Town.

i have been booking this apt for 5 years now whenever i visit SA - home away from home. the view is absolutely breathtaking and within walking distance of great restaurants. shopping mails, salons fr hair , massages etc.  The pictures do not do the beauty of the apt justice. Easy check-in. Good hosts - thanks G and Armand.

The apartment is spacious and in a secure apartment block, with garage parking.  Both bedrooms have double rooms and sea views.  Only disappointment was could not access DSTV stream, and was not assisted with this.
Our second stay here and it was just as great as our first visit! Lovely apartment with great views and location.
Great location & great view! Isabella responded our questions  very quickly. We enjoyed staying here as a family.

We enjoyed our stay in this pleasant 5th floor appartment very much. It is very well situated with stunning views of the ocean. The flat was well equipped, clean and comfortable.  The hosts Isabella and Almond responded very quickly to any message and were very flexible around check in times which helped us enormously arriving from the UK. We also appreciated how warm the appartment is in winter and we  did not need any of the extra heaters, blankets etc.  We would highly recommend this property.
Lovely stay. Great location! Very neat and clean. Easy check in and check out…no arranging to meet people to pick up keys like most places in the area. Responsive and helpful hosts.

Michele is a great host and Sopra is a very modern apartment built in a large property smack in the heart of Constantia.  I stayed in the 2-bedroom unit for 6 days. It was superbly appointed with all mod cons and also stocked with essential groceries and Michele brought a bottle of wine to welcome the weary traveller! Wi-Fi was a bit spotty, but other than that it was truly a very comfortable base to attend meetings in Cape Town as well as to explore the gorgeous Constantia area!

Sopra is a no-brainer for anyone looking for quiet, very modern accommodation in the heart of the beautiful Constantia region. The apartment is lovely and Michele is always on hand to help with local tips or anything else you may require. Book happily... You can thank me later :)
Another outstanding stay! Michele is an amazing host. The location is fabulous with all mod-cons on offer.
Micheles place was a delight to stay in. Her place has more than enough space for a comfortable extended stay. The place was clean and comfortable. I can highly recommend Michele's place.

I cant say enough about Michele's place. It is a large comfortable space with all the amenities one could ever need. There are thoughtful touches throughout the flat and it is a comfortable space for an extended stay. I will be back.

Sopra is Cape Town’s best kept secret! It is situated in the heart of wine country, with easy and short access to shopping centres, etc.. the apartment itself is so beautifully and luxuriously appointed, all which makes for a really comfortable stay.
The unit can also be extended for a family stay, something which I am eyeing for the future.
Do not hesitate to seriously consider Sopra as an extremely luxurious home from home!

Michele's airy, spacious Constantia apartment, off a tranquil country road, is an absolute gem. Michele is a charming and consummate host and an excellent communicator who made me feel right at home from the very first day of my extended stay. I cannot recommend her place highly enough!

Our stay at Colleen's apartment was truly memorable. The apartment is stunning, the location is perfect, and the views are gorgeous. It is very convenient that all of the shops one requires are located just downstairs! The apartment was clean on arrival and was also very well equipped. Colleen is so friendly, accommodating, and the most amazing host! She went out of her way to bring us some Christmas decorations to give the apartment a festive feel, as we had not brought any decorations with us. I highly recommend! :)

Everything about Blackwood is exceptional - the studio itself, which is beautiful; the welcome from Colette; the view...oh my word the view...I just adored it and I will never stay anywhere else in Cape Town ever again (if it's available that is!).

My advice to you all: you will have the best time at Blackwood. It's an absolute beauty. And enjoy the shower ;-)

We had a wonderful stay here for two nights after our wedding - very peaceful, with spectacular views as everyone has said.
Everything was very modern and clean, just as it looks in the pictures - would thoroughly recommend it.
Colette also graciously accommodated our request for a late arrival time.

This is such a gem! Only have good things to say about this place. The view from cottage is scenic! Stay here, you won't regret it.
Anna and Mzi

Colettes cottage is an private oasis away from the bustle of the city but easy to get to and  convenient to the Kirstenbosch Gardens and Table Mtn.  it is very comfortable with amazing views, can recommend a stay here.
Just the most exquisite spot... Fresh, light and airy, with the most incredible views and very well equipped.
This studio offers fantastic views and amenities (including an outdoors shower). I did not see Colette but she was responsive on text. I would definitely come back!
It's not secluded , its directly onto a road with a dog which doesn't stop barking ever!  If you are there to work within Cape Town you will not have success with the poor Wifi signal.
The room and the view from the balcony are just remarkable, place is clean and has everything you need, loves our stay and if ever going to Cape Town again is definitely book again x
This place was so amazing. The views of table mountain are unbeatable. Very private and the outdoor shower was great! It was dreamy and such a stunning place. Best to have a car for the location.

This is a lovely and stylish studio cabin with stunning views. Colette has recently installed a fireplace which adds to the ambience in winter and accommodated a late check out for me on the day I left.
This is a must for those looking to get away from the hustle and bustle of life. The ideal place to wake up on a winters morning and have a warm cup of coffee!

We had a great time staying at this Airbnb and wish we could have stayed longer! The place is beautifully decorated (with several nice perks, e.g. an outdoor shower) and has the most amazing view of Table Mountain. Communication and check-in were great too. For animal lovers: one of Colette's dog paid us a visit when we arrived - a very cute surprise!
Highly recommend this home to couples looking for a quick romantic getaway. Spectacular views and sunken bath makes it great value for money.
This is a beautiful place with a spectacular view in a quiet area!  If you like peaceful surroundings, you will love this guesthouse!
The view from the room is beautiful... enjoyed waking up and viewing the smoking mountains while lying on the bed...
Amazing studio, stylish inside, very cosy and with a breathtaking view! We had a great stay !
Staying at the Blackwood Studio was amazing. We enjoyed it very much! The view is great and you feel immediately at home. Thank you Colette.
The Studio is a very nice and open space with a great view. Colette was a great host, easy to reach and communicate with. We enjoyed our stay and can recommend this listing to other guests.
Beautiful space with an incredible view of Table Mountain which is even more spectacular than the pictures! We had a wonderful time and would highly recommend it.

We've stayed in a lot of Airbnb's, and this is probably the best one ever.
The space is so beautiful, with an incredible view of Table Mountain and the surrounding area. Check in was smooth and easy and we had everything we needed - the place was also spotless.
It was amazing to just sit on the balcony in the sun and enjoy a drink in the evening before dinner. The bath was a super cool feature.
When we come back to Cape Town we'll definitely stay here and I've already recommended it to friends and family.
Amazing hosts, incredible views, and the outdoor shower alone already is a reason to book this place.

Such a stunning hide away with a beautiful view. We got to experience the studio in perfect and stormy weather, making the experience rewarding. Loved sitting on the deck for an afternoon braai and then also lying in bed gazing at the mountain as the storm came in. Fun sunken bath in the studio and awesome outside shower too! Would love to go back and relax here again.
Awesome stay to get away for a break from the hustle and bustle, excellent value and stunning views from the deck, would love to return.
Amazing, trendy little place! It has everything you need and more! Had an awesome stay and enjoyed every minute! Definitely an awesome place for both summer and winter stays.
A wonderful and relaxing location. The studio is comfortable and has needed amenities. Will definitely be my place of choice the next time I'm in Cape Town.
I will definitely recommend this stunning place to anyone wanting to just sit back and enjoy a peaceful time in a tranquil setting.
The cabin was beautiful, has everything we needed and the most amazing view. We loved our stay and will definitely make use of this place again
The space was kitted with everything we needed and provided beautiful views and charming interior, perfect for a quick getaway!

Amazing , perfect Cabin , for those looking for a Woods feel with beautiful views with out actually venturing out to the wilderness. Collette has thought of everything thing that one would probably need for a quiet , romantic or solo get away. the cabin has cute little features that give you a home away from home , but maintaining that luxury of authentic Cabin experience. I am definitely coming back !!

One of the best close by getaways I’ve experienced by far.
So close to home yet it feels so far.
An Extremely tranquil property and no picture could do that view justice, especially the sunsets.
I highly recommend this place to anyone wanting a quiet relaxing getaway close to home. We are already planning our next trip lol.
Faz and Sodah

The place was very nice. its a very nice place to visit and quite. I really enjoyed my stay at Blackwood.I would recommend this place to anyone looking to relax and enjoy some time any from the city and also I would come back again.

This is a lovely place! The views are even better than in the pictures! Truly felt like we were on holiday in a faraway place, even though it is so close to home. Close to some of the best wine farms. The bath and showers was absolute luxury.

Thanks for all, it was amazing!
Photos can’t show the real beauty of this place.

Had a lovely stay at Blackwood.
If you are lookingfor something quiet and out of the city this is your place.
Gorgeous view.

What a dreamy place! Would go there anytime again! It's out in the green, wonderful view. And also the studio itself is lovely. Decorated really tastefully, with bathtub and outdoor shower. Truly wonderful!
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! Great views of the mountain. Definitely would recommend staying here!

What an amazing stay!! The space was fully equipped with everything we needed, the view was breathtaking and your fast response was highly appreciated. We will
Definitely come back soon and recommend you to our entire community.

A beautiful property and a pleasure to wake up to every morning. Having a coffee with that view  is priceless. The hosts are always looking to make your stay the best possible one. Highly recommended.

Nice stay to explore winelands in Constantia, scenic and fast drive on the coast to Cape Town and something different to a stay in the city/nice getaway. Beautiful views and cozy place. It was very easy to communicate with Colette, even as we had some spontaneous changes in our travel plans.

We had an amazing stay, totally worth the price. Super private and safe. The host(Colette) was very helpful. She even answered our call at 6 AM🙈.
I’d recommend that you have your own car, or if not buy most of the essentials before because the Uber is not always available around the area.

Would definitely recommend and would definitely stay again. Beautiful view, close enough to the city but far enough to feel peaceful and secluded. Collette was very helpful and very responsive.
We loved it!
Just ideal, one would never think you are 20 mins away from Cape Town CBD, this is truly a gem. Excellent location and just a terrific place.
We had a fantastic stay, wonderful setting with Mountain View and all the amenities you need (and more). Would highly recommend. Hope to come back one day!
We enjoyed our stay very much! The only small downside was the road noise during the night. But we loved the view and especially watching the sun go down. We would stay again!

Peaceful and beautiful oasis. Checking instructions were clear, guidelines were informative and the studio had everything you needed and more. The studio is not far from restaurants, wine tasting and activities in and around the Hout Bay area. Thank you for our stay, we will definitely be back!

Stayed at Colette’s little cabin for my honeymoon and had a lovely and relaxing stay.
The deep floor bathtub is a great touch to the intimate space!

We had everything we need and we enjoyed our time that we spent there. Loved the surroundings . It was just what we needed.
Thank you very much.

Wonderful cabin with everything you need.  The bath definitely stands out!  If you're looking for a place to relax and unwind, this is perfect for tranquility.  The view is breathtaking, and there is lots to do and see in the vicinity, if you want. I could easily spend a week or more there by myself, or with my partner.  Highly recommend.

Colette was great host, she was responsive and always had solution for any issue we had in apartment. I like the apartment, view was awesome. We only found hard to fell asleep during the night, apartment is a bit noisy.
