it's hard to summarise this place. this is what tranquility looks like. the cabin is idyllic, the views breathtaking, the careful layout, the beautiful bath, the outdoor shower, the comfy bed, the well considered kitchen, the amazing braai area. everything about this space is about restoring peace. nearby hours has some nice spots to eat and drink, and the drive up Chapman's is phenomenal. it's a mere 22mins drive through the mountain to downtown cape town.

Blackwood studio sits in a beautiful location amongst the trees and Mountain View. It is very peaceful and a great space to relax in. Has very adequate facilities for cooking and the outside shower is wonderful! Also sunken bath a lovely addition:)
Location perfect for exploring all areas around Cape Town.

A beautiful, well cared for home. Exquisite views, beautiful design and a smooth checkin/out etc. spotlessly clean and a luxurious place to stay. The hosts were very helpful and I would absolutely recommend this spot for a memorable base 🏔️💛🦅

We had a lovely stay at this Airbnb! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect — quiet yet close to everything. It truly felt like a home away from home. We would definitely stay here again.
We loved our stay! The view was magnificent and the studio was neat and private. Great experience.
It was a great getaway from the hustle and bustle aswell as very scenic. I will 100% recommend you book with Colette as i will 100% be booking again.

I had such a wonderful stay in this beautiful cabin in Hout Bay. Nestled in the woods and surrounded by nature, it was the perfect serene escape. The mountain views were absolutely breathtaking, and the peaceful atmosphere made it feel like a true hidden gem. The cabin itself was cozy, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a relaxing weekend getaway. I left feeling refreshed and recharged, and I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a quiet retreat in nature.

My stay was truly heaven on earth. The home is surrounded by breathtaking mountains and nature, making it the perfect escape from the noise of everyday life. The pictures don’t do it justice as it is even more beautiful in person. It also has a few lovely surprises when you arrive that make the stay even more special. It was peaceful, serene, and inspiring. I will definitely be back.

We really enjoyed every moment. Julian form turnkey365 waited at the house for us and he was helpful and friendly. Well done, Julian. The house super clean and the view to die for. We relaxed at the pool and close to drive anywhere. Well done Julian and turnkey365, I will recommend them. What you see on the pictures is what you get. The unit was service by princess she was super friendly. We definitely be back.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The description and photos are very accurate, I would say the view is even more beautiful in person! Our host Julian was very responsive and helpful and explained everything really well at check-in! Would not hesitate to book this beautiful place again!

Our stay at Amanda and James house was just wonderful and we felt very comfortable all the time:
They welcomed us very warm, gave us informations about the hotspots of the town and made us feel at home. We had a private, luxury modern apartment, a secure parking place and the possibility to use the pool and bbq. We can highly recommend it to any further travellers! Lena & Chriss

Best Airbnb we've stayed at! James and Amanda are exceptional hosts and went the extra mile to make our stay as comfortable as possible. The apartment is exactly as in the photos with a lovely pool. Will definitely be back :)

This place is amazing. The pictures do not do justice to how truely wonderful the apartment is. As for the hosts, James and Amanda are a cut above the rest. They go the extra mile to make you feel right at home. I highly recommend this place as you will not be dissapointed.

Amanda and James are the greatest hosts! We were welcomed so warmly and spoilt with lots of treats which made my sister and I feel so special. We were happy to find that that the space looks as advertised in the pictures, if not even better in reality.
The space was immaculate, and well appointed. The full DSTV bouquet was really nice as well as having off-street parking. The bed linen and towels were fresh and luxuriously soft which only added to an already incredibly stay.
We have only good things to say and James and Amanda are genuinely amazing people. As hosts they were attentive, warm and friendly; even went out of their way to wish me well for my exams.
We will definitely be retuning soon!

Warm Welcome, fabulous hosts, perfekt apartment = 100% recommendation.
Thanks for having us, we enjoyed our stay so much and I hope to back back soon.

I can not fault this AirBnB! Everything was everything we could hope for and more. Safe, clean, accessible! Great hosts who went the extra mile. Sparkling pool, and amazing backyard! Thank you James and Amanda, my wife and I will definitely be back again.

A beautiful and well-appointed apartment in a quiet location, close to local amenities, with very welcoming and attentive hosts.
It’s decorated and equipped (indoors and out) to an extremely high standard with some lovely extra touches. The pool is larger than you might expect, and very welcoming in the Cape Town summer heat !
It’s right up there with the very best Airbnbs we’ve been to. Highly recommended !
I willl recommend james place anytime,goid value for money and james hospitality was top notch,it’s home away from home

We loved Amanda and James place, everything about it was perfect, very reasonable price, very clean, had everything we needed, lovely bed, kitchen had everything, modern TV stuff, lovely outdoor space and pool. Amanda and James were super friendly, bought us some essentials for when we arrived! We couldn't fault one bit! 100 percent we book with them again! lovely people! 🙌👏
Jessica is a great host and her place is very neat and tidy. I felt at home and would recommend her place more so  if you appreciate peace and quiet a stone's throw away from the city

I had a wonderful stay in Cape Town courtesy of Jessica. She was an amazing host and she always made sure i was comfortable during my stay.
She actually made me a very nice coffee on the first day.
Very welcoming and friendly.
A really friendly place in a quiet suburb of Cape Town, no frills, but clean, welcoming, and good value for money.

This is a very nice and quiet place to rest. The bed is very comfortable and warm.
I loved staying there and Marguerite was a wonderful host
It is a huge sunny room. The water is hot. The bed is super comfy and warm.  Enjoyable stay. Host is friendly and informed.
The bed was very comfortable and warm. Room was average, but clean. Nice for a overnight stay for work purposes. :)

Home was comfortable. There is a fridge in the bedroom which comes in handy. She provided us with towels, tea & coffee. She automatically fitted the bed with an electric blanket as it was so cold. The room is large and spacious.
We had exclusive use of the guest toilet & shared the shower with another guest, both bathrooms were clean and easy to use. The home has so much character and was a lovely place to stay.

Due to short of water of Cape Town in common, she gave some extra rules to guests are:
- Total time for bathing is only 2 minutes
- Bathing only once per day
- Do not use kitchenware to cook cause you have to clean dishes afterward...

Very good value for money. Spacious bedroom with plenty of cupboard space. No problem with shared bathroom, water always hot and extra guest loo very useful. We stayed here after a wedding in the area, and the accommodation satisfied all our needs. Marguerite was very amenable with our request to check in an hour earlier.
Lovely, clean room with nice touches. Very friendly host with great communication. Slightly away from the beaten track, but great if you’re looking for a peaceful spot.
Ive stayed a few times at Margueritte and will stay again. Always a pleasure to receive a warm irish welcome.

Marguerite's house was easy to find. About 30 minutes from the Airport. The bedroom was very clean. We could make coffee in our bedroom. We are not sure if the kitchen is available, you might want to check with Marguerite if you're staying longer. Thank you Marguerite, for having us! Kind regards, Sindi & Ingo
Margeurite has a lovely clean spacious space. She is very welcoming. It is a quiet neighbourhood and very safe and comfortable

Very comfortable room, conveniently located in the Southern Suburbs.
Host was very welcoming and quick to respond to booking queries.
Awesome Host, The house was spotless,Thoroughly enjoyed my stay, I'd recommend her place ANYDAY

was absolutely lovely, extremely nice and private room!
great easy communication as well
highly recommend to anyone who isn't looking for a whole flat by themselves

Marguerite is a great hostess and was very accommodating with our requests .
House was extremely clean and tidy and our room was spacious and just what we were looking for.
Definately would go back !!

Marguerite was very helpful and quick to respond to my messages , I arrived late due to a late flight, I needed a place for one night. The check-in was very smooth,The bed is extremely comfortable. Marguerite is wonderful and also helped me out with recommending a trustworthy driver for my transport needs while in Cape Town.

We had an awesome stay with Marguerite. The room was spacious, comfortable and clean. The bathroom and toilet facilities were always clean. Marguerite was a wonderful and welcoming host. She was extremely helpful and went further and beyond. I will whole heartedly recommend her place as a base for tourism, business or work.

Comfortable bed, slept well, large fridge in room is convenient. Efforts made to ensure needs met.
To note: no cooking facilities as described in listing, also dogs on property doing what dogs do, occasional barking. Good value overall.

Our room was large and very clean and Marguerite was friendly and caring. She also very kindly offered to wash some of our clothes as we were staying for over a week which was very appreciated. It was useful having the fridge in our room but we were only able to use the microwave in her kitchen and not the hob or oven which was a bit tricky with cooking for over a week. This was in her description though so we weren’t surprised.
She had some sweet dogs which we liked but the only thing is they barked quite loudly early in the morning or in the evening from time to time.
Marguerite was a lovely host and it suited us well for the week we were there. It is great value and some of the most affordable accommodation we could find.

Marguerite was a pleasant, friendly host but I arrived tired and the doorbell did not work. I banged and shouted but there was no response as garden service was making a heck of a noise. I phoned but the number I had been given was incorrect. I had to contact a neighbour who knew her number. I did not realise there was no en suite bathroom or lavatory. Dogs barked incessantly and I received a phone call from home, which meant I had to leave immediately. I wanted to have a short doze before I left but gave up with the constant noise.
Lovely spacious room in quiet suburb. Thoughtful attention to detail and very welcoming. Truly a lovely stay with Marguerite.
So thankful that the host did not mind our very late check in and extremely early check out. Had a good nite rest, warm and comfortable.

Andrew was a great host!!
We had an amazing time in the apartment and therefore also a great overall stay in Cape Town.
The flat is great, super clean, it has everything you would ever think you need. Top modern furniture and kitchen tools super good, and we loved the “wing chair” on the Balcony :)
Andrew also gave us many tips for restaurants or things to do.
We will definitely stay there again if we return to Cape Town.

Amazing place! The unit is very clean and the furniture and touches are perfect. You can locate everything in the unit from toiletries to kitchen supplies to towels for the beach. Andrew even left a few bottles of water and small snacks in the unit, which was a great touch. All that being said, the location may be the best possible spot for proximity to Clifton Beaches. Would recommend to singles or couples - you'll have a great stay.
Great views including sunsets, close to sandy beach. Some road noise. Great place to stay.

Great location, ideal central point to visit local spots.  If you are not hiring a car,  is worth investing in a weekly pass for  the bus service that stops right outside the door. Views were outstanding and hope to go back again

We had a lovely long weekend, the apartment is great for two guests and the host goes the extra mile by getting essentials (coffee, milk, water, etc)
The location is a walking distance from Clifton 3rd Beach.
Andy was an excellent host for the three nights that we stayed in his small, very clean, perfectly equipped and well located studio apartment.

Andrew’s place is such a clean small apartment with great views by the balcony ideal for couples or solo travelers. The beach is just a street across the apartment on a very lovely neighborhood. We also received a lil welcome package at arrival. Would definitely recommend the place.

Andy’s place sets new standards. Period.
We’re coming back. You feel the love in the details. We stayed longer in the apartment than we wanted to. Mind you, this is in the heart of Clifton. Definitely staying longer next time.

Cute Studio in a very safe area. The communication was easy, the beach only 2 min from the apartment and it was fully equipped! Comfortable bed, clean and even the fridge was stocked. We loved it and would definitely come back. great value for money!
Andrew’s place was great, super close to the beach and restaurants. Will definitely recommend this place to my friends and will stay here again.

I would HIGHLY recommend staying at this apartment. First of all, Andrew made this whole experience worthwhile. From check-in to check-out the communication was really good.
1. The apartment is very neat and clean with all the necessary appliances needed. I especially enjoyed the coffee machine 😊.
2.The apartment is perfectly located. We walked to Clifton 2nd and 3rd beach.
3. Camps bay is also a walking distance.
4. You actually don’t need to rent a car. We used an Uber to move around if we couldn’t walk to a certain place.
We will definitely go back.
Beautiful cozy apartment in a wonderful location overlooking mountains and one of the best beaches in Capetown. Super helpful and welcoming host - 100% recommended! I will come back :)

We loved staying at Andrew’s place . Everything was as we hoped it would be . Beautiful view , the apartment was lovely & clean and Andrew was a great host giving us clear check in instructions. We appreciated the small touches and would love to come back !
Great beach house, with all the lovely touches you expect from a family house. Fresh flowers and a roaring fireplace! Really nice kitchen. We had a great weekend.
Lovely house closed to a wonderful beach. It was the perfect house for our whole family and we felt like home!

We really enjoyed our getaway at Sue’s lovely beach house. It accommodated our three young families perfectly (lots of space in the rooms for camp cots, and a nice outdoor space/garden for little ones to play safely). The house was also well-stocked with everything we could need (although if you need a bathtub for a little one remember to pack your own, since the house only has showers 😊). Sue was very responsive and even offered us flexibility with check-in and check-out. We’d highly recommend it for a relaxing spot close to a stunning beach!

Sue has a beautiful home, with a well equipped kitchen with everything you can possibly need for your stay. There are ample board games, magazines and books to ensure you really wind down and relax. We would stay there again in a heartbeat.

It's just perfect for a family getaway. There were 9 of us, some kids, and everyone had a wonderful time. Scarborough has a lovely beach and the house is about as close as you can get to it. It's on a quiet street, is cozy and stylishly decorated, has great spaces to relax, both inside and outside. The backyard fire pit is a treat! Altogether highly recommended. Thanks Sue!

Wonderful holiday house and Sue was a brilliant host, wanting to make sure everything was as it should be from the moment we arrived. Carol the cleaner was also excellent, very friendly and did a great job. House is ideally placed for a beach holiday and the beach itself is stunning. A rare hidden gem of a location in fact. A top class house and host!

A very welcoming and family friendly house with lovely touches that make it feel like home away from home (e.g. compact deck chairs and beach towels, little swing out front, outdoor clothes hanger on way to the outdoor shower for post-beach efficiency). Took us seconds to get in and settle, and last minute requests were tended to very rapidly. The absolute golden star is undoubtedly the location - Scarborough beach is wonderful, with a friendly, surfer/family vibe that sits perfectly with the beautiful crisp clear blue water and white sands. you can tell walking along the small and quiet (but very safe) main road that the locals take pride in it - e.g despite lots of dogs there was no problem with excrement on the beach as I've found elsewhere. It was bustly without being busy.  Local restaurants were great for brunch and a good coffee (whole earth cafe) and an easy dinner/drink (camel rock).  Can heartily recommend

We had an incredible time in sues amazing home
She was fantastic beginning to end
Super helpful with loads of recommendations !!
I can definitely recommend this gorgeous home perfectly situated and a 2 min walk from a stunning beach
We will definitely be back next year
Thank you sue for everything!!!

Beautiful house on a special spot next to the sea. House is very welcoming and warm, rooms are super comfy and has a lovely layout. Gorgeous little trail to the beach. My favorite was the boma fireplace!! Thank you so much Sue and Eric!!
Incredible balcony and living area to watch the sun go down on. Right on the beach and a great space for family and kids.

We have enjoyed the house! The location is perfect, very close from the beach and Scarborough's little hub. Sue was very communicative and super helpful. The house is perfect for a family. We fully recommend!!

Perfect house, well equipped, lovely furnished, very close to the beach. Scarborough is a nice and save little village close to the table mountain national park, quiet, peaceful, surrounded by astonishing nature but still less then a one-hour-drive from Cape Town center. Sue is the perfect host. Highly recommended.
Great location, short walk to the beach, very clean and well equipped (including a dishwasher), large bedrooms and all furniture and appliances new. Recommended

We had such a lovely long weekend in this beautiful home. Stones throw away from the beach and walking distance from the local breakfast and coffee spot. Highly recommend Sue’s spot for a relaxing weekend away.

A gem of a gorgeous beach house in a perfect location! Elegantly decorated with a laid back family friendly feel - yet stylish and welcoming! Only a short walk to the beach! Ample entertainment and relaxing areas all in and around the house! Very safe and secure! All amenities for great entertaining!
Sue is super easy to communicate with and the welcoming touches with the local flowers was very thoughtful! We had a fantastic time and hope to be back again! Great house to enjoy the peace and serenity of Scarborough! Thank you!
Sue's house is well appointed and perfect for families with children.  It is clean, well kept and the photos are accurate. A short stroll to beach too

Absolutely stunning house and amazing location. More than enough space for everyone and filled with any thing you might need on a weekend away and more!
Then one thing I do have to really mention was how spotless clean the house was!
Will definitely recommend.

Beautiful Stay, so many board games no body will get bored hehe.
They really do accommodate for all ages. Great set up. Bring yourself and enjoy the sea side

Fantastic place to stay. 2 minutes from the beach. Great fireplace inside for a winter getaway and Scarborough is one of the best areas in Cape Town. Great Kitchen/Living room. Really good all round. Thanks to Sue and Dusty who is a legend and looked after us.

We had a wonderful stay in this perfect Beach House. We were 2 couples, but the house is also suitable for a large family, the children‘s room is really nice as well. Next time we would love to stay much longer.

We really had a lovely stay. The house really have everything you need. We will definitely like to go back again.
The area are beautiful with the most amazing sunsets.
Thank you so much.

Sue was a great host. Her house is cozy with the most amazing sunlight throughout the house all through the day. I havent slept this well in a long time. Great distance from the beautiful beach and a lovely comfortable house with all amenities. Thank you so much Sue

We so enjoyed our stay! The house was very comfortable and relaxing for our family.  The fireplace was a great for the winter chill in the evenings. The backup electric was great during loadshedding.  Thanks for everything!  We would definitely stay again

Thanks Sue for letting us stay in your fantastic beach cottage.  The location near the beach was great and the house was was comfy and relaxed.  We loved it and look forward to hopefully coming back to Scarborough in the near future!

This was such a beautiful place to stay. The house has everything you need and much more ( Eg: hot water bottles and sunhats). The location is just perfect, with really just a few steps to the beautiful beach. Went for an early morning walk/run along the beach and through the area and it was breathtakingly clean, quiet and safe. The house is absolutely beautiful, with the best natural lighting. Decor is aesthetically pleasing.
We were a group of seven ladies and the entire experience was just warm, comfy and absolutely pleasant. Definitely worth staying at.
It was very difficult to leave, so a return in the future is definitely on the cards.

We had a beautiful stay at Sue's beach house.
We traveled with our moms and stayed for a week. The generator was super helpful during load shedding periods, and were able to 'work from home' without any interruptions.
The indoor fireplace is so wonderful to have and it makes the cottage super cozy, especially on colder windy nights!
Dusty, who met us on check-in and check out, was lovely and helpful, and their house keeper, Bonghi, was also lovely and does a beautiful job keeping the home spotless.
The cottage is beautifully decorated, cozy and so close to the beach! We enjoyed sunsets overlooking the ocean and morning coffee on the bright porch.
Thank you, Sue, for being so responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We hope to be able to stay with you again!

Sue's house was impeccable and what we needed to disconnect for a few days. The house was well appointed and exactly as advertised. Sue was a great communicator, just enough to make us feel at home, but not too much as to invade. We felt completely at home in her home. With the beach just around the corner, and a lovely coffee shop a few steps away - it was heaven in a sandy bottle. Thanks Sue:)
What a stunning home and location. Easy walk to the beach, store and restaurants. Sue was the perfect host!

What a perfect stay. It was a beautiful, spacious, and well-appointed home with an awesome location. Not only are you within walking distance of the beach and village centre but there is so much to do in and around the area. Communication was super and Sue was very kind and accommodating. We had a lovely time, thank you.

We had a wonderful weekend in Sue's beautiful house. The fireplace was wonderful and it is a dream kitchen. We had lovely beach walks and even saw a family of otters frolicking in the waves.
Highly recommend.
Wonderful place to stay. Beautifully decorated and very comfortable. Perfect location for a nice peaceful weekend away.

Great place. Close to the hub which was perfect for coffee, souvenirs and food plus wine you may have forgotten.
She was extremely helpful and friendly. Felt like staying at an old friends place.
Felt really safe, locals very friendly. Loved the location. Beach is a stone throw away.
Scarborough has its own unique vibe. I'll be back.
Beautiful location- the house is exactly as described and extremely well equipped. It is a great place for a break from Cape Town. Or in our case from the cold of England. Hope to be back.

A beautiful and peaceful oasis. Sue’s place is an ideal spot for a family holiday by the beach. We will return! The house is exactly as described - I would only add that it’s better than the photos. The coffee at the Hub delicious. And the beach is incredible…away from the madding crowds.
We had a wonderful time!

We had a great Easter weekend stay in Scarborough. The home was well equipped and extremely comfortable.
We enjoyed games in the garden and many walks on the beach.
Perfect location, even in bad weather . Nice big garden for kids , close to beach , mountain and shops .
Scarborough is a fantastic “getaway” beach town. House was cozy, elegant and with everything you need.
The garden flat is very close to great beaches and shops. Brian is very helpful with anything needed! Loved the flat. ❤

The place is the best nook in the world- semi-secluded by the sea with the mountains in the background. The most beautiful part of Cape Town (read the prime real estate of South Africa for such an amazing price). Brian was amazing- he even went out and bought a hair dryer when I asked if there was one. He was so kind and gracious. Couldn’t have asked for a better Airbnb experience (and best one I’ve had after having many!)

Brian's place was a great location for my visits to Bakoven Beach which I loved. It's a great place for one person. Simple and comfortable. The wifi worked well but will go off during loadshedding. Brian was very responsive to my questions and let me keep my luggage there while I enjoyed my last day at the beach.

I had a good time at Brian's place, you have a nice room with all you need : kitchen, bed, desk and bathroom in Camps Bay for a fair price. It is 15min away from Camps Bay main area so it is more calm and way less busy with access to very nice and beautiful little beaches. Also the owner Brian is very nice and helpful. I recommend !

I stayed at Brian’s Airbnb for 11 days working remotely and exploring at the weekends.
I wanted to be based super close to camps bay but in a slightly more peaceful, residential area and this was spot on. Excellent value.
Lovely terrace where I watched the sunset as many nights as possible. It was an easy and self contained little flat. Just what I needed! Bootleggers cafe over the road was great for brunch and did great coffee. A few cute beaches close by as well away from the crowds and I enjoyed running along the pavement both ways along the coast and under the 12 apostles from here.
Brian was helpful and responsive when I needed anything.
I’d thoroughly recommend staying here! The Wi-Fi was even better than at home (the UK!)
Would happily stay again.
Thanks Brian!
I really enjoyed staying here. It’s very peaceful. The unit had everything I needed. The lights and Wi-Fi work during load shedding. Highly recommend!!

The place was not clean there were lots of spider web, kitchen not well equipped
tv was very dirty lots of dust and spider web
Linda has a lovely spacious and comfortable family home with beautiful views of mountains and the Hout Bay beach front. We would recommend to everyone.

Perfect location--walk to beach, bus to downtown, and grocery store. Very comfortable home--more than enough space for 3 adults and 2 small kids. Host was extremely helpful, updating us on local events during g our stay to help is plan our trip and even arranging a babysitter one night--above and beyond what we expected.

Wonderful house. Linda is a very nice host, always available for any enquiry.
we had a very nice stay. Thank you Linda!

We stayed at Linda’s place for 3 nights and highly recommend it. The house is beautiful, spacious , well equipped, comfortable and the views are stunning. Great location. The house has everything you need.
Linda was a super host - she made us feel so very welcome and left thoughtful extras for us, which we really appreciated. She was always very quick to respond to messages too. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay there. Thank you Linda.
This is a well fitted, beautiful  house in a superb position, the host was very accommodating, everything was perfect. Only downside was given 2GB of 4G Wi Fi, rather than the continuous as listed.

Beautiful area, great views!
Laundry facilities only include washer, no dryer making it a bit difficult during colder seasons, especially during longer stays.
Super awesome place with such great views of the mountains and Hout Bay. Close to the Harbour and Park Run. Nice big house for groups sharing and an incredible open plan living area with kitchen.
Lovely Apartment in a very nice neighborhood. Very Safe And superclean. We loved the modern and well chosen interior and the amazing view!

This studio is spacious for a solo traveler and would be good for two as well. It has high celling and many windows therefore its very airy. It's well furnished, with modern equipment and everything else beyond your expection, just like home. The view is fantastic. You could watch the sunrise and sunset also the beautiful Table Mountain in bed. The street is quiet and safe, close to the Kloof Street. it is exciting to rent a car and travel around the city otherwise you can take Uber to all interesting places. Our hosts are very nice and welcoming. They prepared extra duvet, blankets, chocolate and wines to make you feel like home. I highly recommend you to stay in this place if you are traveling to Cape Town.

Maya is super welcoming, flexible, and a great communicator. The flat is very cute and has great views of Lion's Head and downtown Cape Town. The neighborhood is quiet and scenic and just a few blocks from some great cafes and a little bit more to the bustling Long Street.
We had an amazing stay. Beautiful views and great location. Maya made sure that all our needs were attended to.
Apartment offers best of both worlds in that it is conveniently located with easy access to restaurants, shops and general city life yet is quiet and peaceful.
Spacious studio with all the amenities you could need, in a pleasant area with some good bars and restaurants nearby. Plus fantastic views. Thanks for a great stay!

We really enjoyed everything about the place. The view is magnificent. The apartment is clean and cosy, with smart fittings and extras. Maya is outstanding in all aspects. She accommodated our early check-in, and so much more - Maya and her family are wonderful.
I really hope to visit again.

Such a quiet space so close to the city bowl, the perfect spot to go to at the end of the working day. The flat is very neat with well thought out decor. Will definitely be staying here every time I'm in Cape Town!

Maya's place was in a beautiful location right by Table Mountain and Lion's head. It was close to everything I wanted to get to in Cape Town. With the small kitchen, I didn't need to worry about going out for every meal, and I could feel at home. While it was a studio apartment, it had plenty of space! I loved waking up to the view of the sunrise over the city every morning!
An excellent space to relax watch a movie or simply a very comfortable bed to return to after a night out, excellent value for money
Very nice apartment in a great area. Communication with maya worked great and we felt really comfortable in the apartment

Maya is a wonderful and helpful host. The apartment is located in a save, calm and beautiful neighborhood. We couldn’t have imagined a better location, it’s like everything is nearby. Furthermore it’s a really nice and well equipped apartment.
Overall we can recommend Maya and her apartment to everyone who is planing a trip to Cape Town.

This is a beautiful apartment! Located on the third floor, it requires a bit of stair climbing, but the view of the bowl and the mountain are amazing! We appreciated the many thoughtful touches that made our stay a special one. The amenities are fabulous.

We had a great stay at Maya's Cape Town apartment! Check-in was easy, the location was perfect, the apartment had everything we needed, and the views were incredible.
Maya was in touch anytime we needed her, and went above and beyond providing us with chocolates, a bottle of wine, and a little information book about the area.
We would definitely stay again the next time we are in Cape Town!

Maya was an exceptional host. She was always reachable, super friendly and made sure that we had a fantastic time. The apartment is in an amazing location, close to the city as well as the table mountain and lion’s head.
I would recommend the apartment for couples, singles or really close friends, since the bathroom is super close to the bed.

Fantastic accommodation - couldn't recommend it more highly. In an awesome and easily accessible part of Cape Town. Just note that the building does have issues with sound, so listening to music and watching TV might overflow into neighbour's apartments so this Airbnb is more suited for peace and quiet than it is a home-away-from-home.
Maya's place is fab! Had everything I needed for the month. Only minor issue was the proximity to the neighbours. It's a very tight space with thin walls but overall a great place to stay.
Great view in very nice area that is quiet but close to the city. All the amenities available for longer stays.

Maya was an amazing reponsive host who put so much personality into the apartment from the introduction boolet to the amenties like a beach bag. The apartment is bigger than the pictures lead you to believe and have amazing views of lions head and table mountain. Thank you for hosting us in your amazing apartment!
Maya was a great host and super easy to communicate with. The apartment was great. I would stay there again and recommend it to anyone looking for a compact apartment.

Maya was an incredible and gracious host, as well as Lucy who cleaned the apartment for us. Maya is kind and understanding to all one’s needs and takes great care of her home. Immaculate bright and light indeed with incredible views. Maya is very quick to respond and attended to all our needs with such kindness! I  highly recommend this place as a local myself.

Lovely studio apartment with everything you need, in an excellent location with spectacular views of the city and the mountains. Maya is a great host. Easy to communicate with and quick to respond. Enjoyed my stay very much and would definitely recommend.

This is the most amazing place you can possibly stay in Cape Town - and so far one of the cities best hidden secrets. Seriously. The hosts are absolutly gorgeous and made our stay better than we could have dreamed of, the rooms all have a separate bathrooms and a terrific view over the coast. The house is located directly below Lion's Head, the hike up starts just in front of the door. Jil is preparing complementary breakfast every morning. We will definitly come back!

Jill and Gerald were amazing, friendly and went out of their way to make us feel at home.. It felt like we were visiting family!! If you looking for amazing views of Cape Town and perfect location... It's all right here... You will not be disappointed!

we stayed only a night and had the chance the use the garden space as a location for a photo-shoot.
maureen was very friendly in her messages. katya welcomed us and she was lovely with her little son. we were the first guests in this house and we really enjoyed staying there.
everything was on point. all the little details, the fresh lavender on the towels or the welcoming flowers, or the refreshing cold water as we arrived.
the interior is well picked and the furniture is not from ikea - which is nowadays not normal on airbnb! i highly recommend maureens beautiful and quiet house.
the next supermarket is only 2min drive from the apartment.
a perfect house for family or a group of friends !
thanks xxx

Gorgeous house, very well-appointed and maintained. Not just nice-looking furniture and decor, but comfortable too. We were able to make a fire and braai; the fire really warmed up the large open-plan, double volume area.
Host and representative very helpful and friendly (even though we were late for check-in).

The communication around our accommodation was excellent.
The location suited our needs perfectly, being close to the airport and Grand Central where we had a fantastic birthday dinner for my twins, and an easy trip to the airport next morning.
The house was perfectly clean and comfortable.
Highly recommended.
Thx so much for a wonderful experience!

An awesome place to stay.  A home away from home.  The home offered everything we needed and more.  Is ideally located.  Maureen is the perfect host.  We couldn't have asked for a better place to stay.  THANK YOU MAUREEN

Six of us thoroughly enjoyed our 10 day stay.  The location is great, half way between the airport and the Waterfront, with good access to the main roads.  It is a quiet neighbourhood, a short stroll from the "happening" Obs nightlife.  Many thanks.

Beautiful. Clean. Spacious. Quiet.
What a fabulous home. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Thank you Maureen!

We had a great stay in this very charming and comfortable house. Great neighborhood as well, nice shops, good restaurants (sushi @ 1890) convenient to city center. We would recommend this house to families with children. Ours loved it!
This is a little gem . Perfectly situated and just a great spot. Will definitely use it again

Quaint place located in the quieter area in Observatory. Welcoming open space with beautiful outside areas fit for a great braai and chill. Everything you need is in the house and because of the location, it is close to most places and accessible. 😊

Maureen has a lovely place and its perfect for families. Unfortunately the WiFi wasn’t working during our stay as Maureen was changing service providers. The place is clean and tidy and very spacious.
All in all this was a modest home in a safe environment, with basic amenities and sparkling clean. It is most suitable for a family with young kids.
Perth House is very spacious and has all the basic amenities. Very clean too. Maureen is accessible and easy to get hold of. All in all, I had a wonderful stay🌸

This home is ideally situated for easy access to  the airport and to the entire peninsular.  The owners have refurbished the house and decorated it simply and tastefully. We felt welcome, safe and at home here, and we enjoyed the quiet neighborhood and our space. Well done , and thank you.  Sandy Murray
Lovely host with a beautiful aura. The house had a spacious and clean space. The house is placed at a peaceful neighborhood.

Amazing Host, very helpful and always quick to respond. The house is was very clean upon entry and has everything a home needs.
Thanks Maureen!
Lovely home from home. Wonderful responsive host, has all the little bits, plugs, fans etc. great stay thanks Maureen.

Maybe not the nicest location in Cape Town , but all the needs ( groceries, restaurant, ..,) in walking distances. Check Main Street ( 7’ walk) for good bars and restaurants and a little old time feeling.
With Uber, 15’ to waterfront, table mountain gondola, and multitude of trailheads.
The house is big and with all amenities needed for those who wants to stay longer than a couple of days. We stayed 2 nights and would have stayed much longer. The load shedding has no real impact because they have their own power supply …. Why looking for something else when all the checklist is covered. Highly recommended. Thank you Maureen for the constant and quick communication.
A big thank you to Maureen for her friendliness and hospitality. We were very happy in the house in Perth street. It was very clean and comfortable.
We really enjoyed our stay. The house is comfortable and well-equipped. The area is quiet and centrally located. Checking in was easy.

We were a bit disappointed as the pictures in the internet differed from what we found. The house smelled a bit less than fresh. Kitchen was overall well furnished. WIFI worked properly. Communication with Maureen was very good. She offered help and was reachable.
This worked perfectly for us. very homie! loved the fire place! Very functional and spacious...

Can only rate this house as A++++ ! Carole and Trevor were wonderful hosts.
The house is in a fabulous location. Very nice shopping centre is just 5 minutes away by car.
Two very lovely wineries are within walking distance!
The trip in to Cape Town central and the False Bay areas are around 20minutes drive.
The house is a very elegant home. Everything at your finger tips. It provides comfort with a capital C. Inside and outside.
Can't recommend this place highly enough.

Carol's place was a perfect home base for our family’s holiday.  The house is large and spacious, with all the privacy, and communal areas we needed for the large group.  She and her husband are a lovely couple, who helped us get setup and were always available without ever being in our way.

We cannot fault Carole our host.All communications during the booking stage were precise and easy.Carole greeted us on our arrival and gave us clear instructions of how to use the house.The house is spacious,comfortable and super clean.Gourgeous bed linen and towelling in the bathrooms.There is a gourgeous pool area and outdoor terrace.We were sad that we didn’t have time to use the house’s amenities better.There is a lot of attention to detail with the guests needs in mind.Cynthia Carole’s housekeeper was a pleasure to have in the house.We had a very pleasant experience staying at Middelberg and would highly recommend and definitely return.Thank you Carole and Trevor

Carole’s house exceeded our expectations!
It looked fantastic on the website but was even better when we got there!
Carole was flexible and helpful during the booking process and very welcoming when we got there.
She had left snacks for us which were so welcome with two young adults !
She was always contactable and helpful if we had any questions .
I thoroughly recommend this Air bnb 😃

An absolutely fantastic Airbnb. Carole was the perfect host - quickly responsive, stayed in touch as needed, flexible and friendly. The house is beautiful and feels very special. My parents arrived first and messaged to say it was palatial! Carole, very kindly provided a proper baby cot, a baby bath and a pram. There is ample storage, it’s beautifully decorated and they maid was very good. We were sorry to leave to move to a different area for the second part of our trip, and on returning to Cape Town we will definitely be checking in with Carole again. The two very nearby wineries are excellent, and also have great food.

We had a wonderful stay in Carole and Trevor’s home in Constantia. The house was impeccably furnished with an interior designer’s touch, yet was very comfortable and functional. The house is large and open plan in nature, with a lovely outdoor entertaining area and a stunning garden. The pool was clean but unfortunately we did not have the opportunity to use it much as the weather was a little chilly. The location is superb, with easy access to great restaurants, shopping and tourist attractions. Carole was very responsive to our questions and facilitated a late check out for us on the final day. Thank you for a lovely 12 day stay!

We had the most relaxing, peaceful, tranquil stay at Carole’s place. Everything that I needed for this holiday, I had at Carole’s.
Beautiful spacious and comfortable bedroom, lovely tranquil outdoor space with plenty of garden and greenery to freshen the air. Just beautiful. The pool looked very clean and inviting but was a bit chilly for me. I’ll look forward to the summer months here. I’d definitely come back and I’d highly recommend. Carole was very easy to communicate with and responded timely. I also want to note, I felt very safe here in the neighbourhood and in the home.

Nadav was a great host. Everything was like descripted. Really nice appartment with a great view over Kapstadt City Bowl and a very nice and big pool in the garden. We really had a good time and definitely can recommend it.

Staying at Nadav’s was an absolute pleasure. I was looking for a quiet and private place to stay and I got it, and Nadav was always ready to help and super quick to reply. I also booked very late and he was very flexible with check in despite of it. The room was great, had everything I could ask for including a stunning view and access to an extra balcony where I could have my breakfast. I enjoyed every little bit of it and thank Nadav so much for the hospitality and the excellent stay!

AMAZING VIEWS. Incredible location, safe quiet neighborhood really close to restaurants and all the vibes of central Cape Town. The bed is hugely comfortable and the the place has aircon and an awesome shower. Highly recommend this place.
Scenic place with a fantastic view, clean and excellent communication. Highly recommended to all those who like natural landscapes and enjoy the sound of wind. Well connected to town via Uber.

Nadav’s Airbnb is the best place to stay in Capetown when you are looking for a beautiful and quiet neighborhood. The view from the balcony is amazing, the apartment is beautiful and you’re really close to the city center (around 10-15 minutes by car).
Nadav and his family were really helpful, whenever I needed something they responded immediately and were really nice.
I had the best time staying there and will definitely come back when I’m in Capetown the next time!

A unique experience! Nadav and his family are absurdly sympathetic and receptive. Any questions are answered and solved very quickly. The neighborhood is warm and cozy, with great security. Highly recommend!

Thank you very much for hosting us in your home !
It was a wonderful place, and Nadav was extremely welcoming :)
See you soon
Super great chill spot right by table mountain, has got just what you need--what you see is what you get.  Nadav is a great guy, flexible and easygoing.

Very attractive setting with a panoramic view from the balcony. Although I gave approximate time of arrival, the place was not ready and took a long time to get the bed made. Would have added to the experience to have entered a ready flatlet. Otherwise good value for money and safe area.

Perfect for a weekend getaway or longer stay. The hosts were amazing!
Hospitable and welcoming. All needs were accommodated for and location was perfect to travel in and around Cape Town.
Thank you again for such a wonderful stay!
Everything was as in description. The host replayed immediately. There is now standard kitchen. Rather kitchenette. Nothing to complaint. Recommend. Amazing view over Capetown.
Nadav is a great and friendly host, we felt very welcome and enjoyed our stay to the fullest. The view from the balcony is breathtaking and unique! Would definitely book again.

Mixed reviews here and overall this place wasn't for me. Many will be more than happy, but the host should update the listing description so you can make an informed choice.
What I loved: gorgeous views, decent area, good parking, spacious apartment, nice patio and den area, overall clean. Host is very nice.
What I wish I knew: there's no sink in the kitchen and host expects guests to wash dishes in the bathroom sink (which I personally find unsanitary). Host also expects guests to take 90-second showers given the water shortage (although other Airbnb hosts don't express this expectation). A bit of an insect issue at night that I didn't get the sense the host was intent on resolving. Very little privacy - you're above the family apartment and walls are paper thin. You can hear everything of them, and most likely they everything of you.
Very comfortable with wonderful views of Cape Cape Town and mountains . I would have given 5 stars, save that there was no coffee plunger or coffee machine. Loved the balcony!
Loved the views and location of this place! Thanks Nadav for the local eatery tips as well !
A beautiful location. A magnificent view of Capetown  and Table mountain. Value for money.Will definitely visit again.No mistake with this one.

A beautiful location with city and mountain views for a stress free stay. Quiet and close to town and walking trails, with everything you’ll need provided for by the helpful hosts for a pleasant stay. Superfast internet  for work from home situations was a plus.

Lovely location, nice and central but still in a quiet suburb.  So close to Table mountain.  Beautiful views. Good value for money with few bells and whistles.  Stairs are a bit steep for an older person but not an issue if you are careful.  All in all a very pleasant stay.
A true gem of a place with amazing views of the mountain! Our host was really kind and very helpful!

A fantastic spot. You are getting exactly as advertised. Nadav is a great host who also accommodated a couple of schedule issues I had and I could check in early. To say the view is splendid does not quite do it justice. You'll have to come and see it for yourself. Overall 10/10.

I had a pleasant stay in this Airbnb. Nadav is a very accommodating and welcoming host. The accommodation has everything and is very well located in a quiet area yet close to the city centre. I would definitely recommend it.

We absolutely loved our stay! The peace and tranquility of the area, and the setting of the accommodation was wonderful. We felt totally relaxed, the views were spectacular.. what more can one ask for when you need a much rested break from the hustle and bustle of the concrete jungle.
It's such a safe area, and the pictures on the website does not do it justice in comparison to when you're sitting on the balcony just relaxing and watching the rest of the city. Definitely a hidden gem.

What a great place to stay! Apartment was nice and clean, well located and the views were simply stunning.
Nadav was also a great host, ensuring that our stay is comfortable and that we have all we need.
Would definitely stay there again.

We stayed three nights and we enjoyed a lot ! It’s not really downtown but you get to have this beautiful peaceful neighborhood. We went for morning walk around and into the woods. Having stayed in sea point and all those other cbd condos this is a good change. I also got to read some photography books in Jenny’s collection.
Overall very good stay. I will recommend!

Beautifully located with views of Signal Hill and Lion's Head and also Table Mountain.
Relatively safe and quiet area in capetown. Recomend not walking on your own at nighttime anyhow.

This is my second stay and I will stay again.   A home from home in Cape Town.  Comfortable with friendly, responsive and welcoming hosts.  And an unsurpassed view of Table Mountain,  Lion's Head and Signal Hill, and Table Bay, from the balcony.

I had such a fantastic stay. I was travelling solo and the family were so warm and welcoming. If I had any questions and queries it was really easy to contact them. The accommodation and hosts were so great and made my trip even better. I would highly recommend and will definitely visit again.

Great location and fantastic hosts. Well equipped apartment and good views.
But renovations were done for 2 out of the 3 months of my stay, of which I wasn’t warned of prior to booking and paying. Also front gate heavy to open and close as it is without an electric motor.

A beautiful home away from home. Fantastic facilities, wonderful decor and an extremely responsive host. The jacuzzi was the cherry on top of a very memorable family weekend. I would recommend this home to anyone looking for a peaceful and relaxing holiday.

Really beautiful house, just a short walk from the beach. the house offers everything you need.
Enjoyed our holiday very much.

The Owl and Pussycat is the most wonderful space in Scarborough. It’s stylish, spacious and comfortable beyond belief. We had a wonderful stay. Our host Jean was so easy to communicate with and went out of his way to help us. We will definitely want to stay there again. Highly recommended.
Beautiful and relaxing! Perfect house for a relaxed getaway. The jacuzzi was a special touch! We highly recommend it.
The house is exactly what is described. It is warm, cosy and definitely quirky. It has all the amenities needed for a comfortable stay.
We had a very good stay and enjoyed so much. The kids liked the kids sleeping room as „their“ area most.
We loved staying here, close to the beach and in a safe little town. Our boys and we enjoyed it thoroughly.

Scarborough is a quiet but fun beach town. This well decorated house makes you feel right at home. A drink at the upper deck while watching the sunset over the ocean, a braai in the garden or a dip in the jacuzzi are a must. Check in and out was easy. We will be back

We, as a family of four, had a great stay at this beautiful house in Scarborough. The house itself is awesome, with a lovely interior, a lot of wooden furniture and lots of natural light. The garden is beautiful and is home to two turtles. From the balcony one has an incredible view of the ocean in the distance and sunsets over it. Due to the peaceful environment we had a really relaxing and peaceful stay while at the same time there are a lot of places to discover not too far away from Scarborough.
Communicating with Jean was easy and a pleasure. He was helpful and answered all our questions, not only before but also during our stay.
Just a note in case you plan on staying at the house with more than four adults: Three of the mentioned seven beds are in an awesome kid‘s room and are only about 1.80 meters long.
Jean was a great host and made the stay so easy. The home is charming and playful. We had a wonderful weekend enjoying the braai, walks to the beach, hot tub and having lazy lunches on the verandah
Lovely place for a short stay. Walking distance to the beach and the deli/ restaurants, with the jacuzzi and tortoises in the garden a highlight for our kids!
The fireplace was what made our whole holiday! We loved how cosy, peaceful and relaxed we felt. Perfect winter getaway!

Izak and Ian have a lovely home with beautiful views of the city. The room was nice and private and the bed very comfortable. Izak was extremely welcoming and made sure I had everything I needed. The offer to help myself to breakfast, tea and coffee was appreciated. Izak definitely went out of his way to make sure my stay was as good as it could be.

House is really clean and tidy, and modern! What I really want to say is that Izak and Ian are really kind, and they are really easy to get along with! They make you feel home, and we had a nice convo together at night with glass of wine :) And they served breakfast for you, it was really nice and I really appreciate all of things they've done for me. So in conclusion, I highly recommend this accomodation and of course lovely hosts :)

You will love staying with Izak and Ian. They are a very kind and the apartement is very clean and with a very cosy bed. They even make you a great breakfast. If you want to, you can have a Glas of wine with a nice conversation with the guys. Sorry for the bad english :-)

Located in a nice quiet neighbourhood with a supermarket less than 5 mins walk away. Awesome area for a morning run!
Izak was prompt in his replies. It was a pity we didn't get a chance to chat much.

Lovely little flat with great views and a verandah to enjoy the sun. Lovely sunny lounge  - great for winter. It didnt have a microwave which is unusual for AirBnB's (I didnt check to see if it had one when booking) - but there was an oven which unfortunately was acting up a bit but host said he would get it checked out for future guests. There was a UPS for load shedding so had uninterrupted wifi.

Izak’s place is very much value for money. It is based in a great location which can get you around Cape Town via car or Uber and the place itself is accurately described with all the amenities and more.

We enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb. The hosts were responsive and always eager to assist, ensuring a comfortable and seamless experience. The place itself was well-maintained. My only suggestion would be the addition of a microwave in the kitchen

Lovely spot ideally located in Vredehoek!
Walk to mountain, walk in the village and walk to shops and restaurants.
Highly recommended.

Lynn has been very kind and flexible about check in and out time and she was always ready to help us in everything we needed. The room is very clean and cozy, in front of the golf field and next to the city centre. Perfect for our holiday!
I booked at Lynn because her her very good reviews and was not disappointed.  Will definitely stay again.  Patio and view of golf course was wonderful.

Ideal spot for both business, to just relax or to explore the area. Amazing sunrise view over the golf course in the AM. Close to surrounding wine farms, amenities, and main routes to the city or wineland areas
Great place to stay, we really enjoyed it and Lynn was an awesome host who really helped us out, would highly recommend their place.
Super quiet and lovely view of the greens, golf course. Enjoyed the thoughtful little extra's. Very tastefully decorated.

Second time staying here and I will be back again.
Stayed longer this time and the service was awesome.
Really recommended staying here
I booked Lynn’s place for my sister. She was so happy and absolutely loved the place - especially the king-size bed. Thank you!
Was a very nice place to stay. Modern feel, felt like I was in an actual hotel. Lynn was a very gracious host. Loved the bathroom and shower. Very clean. Thank you very much for hosting me.

The place is sparkling clean. Host is great and is always there for you. Right in the Centre of Durbanville and exactly what you need for a nights business or a weekend away with your partner. I will be back if I’m going to Durbanville.
Modern and very spacious spot. Just what you need for a little getaway. Would highly recommend to anyone wanting to stay in the Northern Suburbs.
Lynn was very friendly host, hosting was great. Place was much more for value, very clean and neat. I definitely recommend to others.
Lynn has international standards of hosting and I highly recommend her to anyone considering to stay at her place. She is an extra super host.

Lynn's AirBnb is a modern, stylish and sparkling clean space offering great value for money. Easy access to the centre of Durbanville and the surrounding wineries. Perfect for both business and pleasure travelers.

After moving all day, coming back to the beautifully appointed studio was exactly what we needed. A great little spot to have a drink with a view, then a great shower and even better nights sleep in comfort and style. I would recommend it to everyone and will definitely be back!

Thanks for your warm welcoming and accommodating us in your private,spacious and squeeky clean apartment.modern and stylishly  furnished.most comfortable big bed with great bedding and soft towels.highly recommended and we will definitely make use of De View when visiting Cape Town.

Lynn's place is stylish and clean and very comfortable.  Check in is quick and access is easy.   The location was excellent for us as we had some business in Durbanville where it is situated.  We would definitely want to stay there again

Lyn is a superb and accommodating host. My repeat visit was as enjoyable as the first. The unit caters for all your needs for an overnight stay. It is conveniently situated - close to the wine route and it has easy access to other amenities. Clean and modern.
Lynn's  place is a great,  it is clean and tastefully furnished. I can recommend it, whether going on holiday or business.

Wonderful, spacious and crisp clean room. You have a great view over the golf course and  hottentotsholland mountains and a private, safe porch. It is in close proximity to the local wine farms, mall and airport. I would highly recommend this property.

Lynn was very kind and thoughtful. The room is spacious and clean. The added bonus was the daily serviced room and private entrance. Close to "The Village" shopping center with everything you possibly need.

Sparkling Clean! Lynn is an Incredible Host! Lynn went out of her way and literally wrote half of our itinerary for our tour around  Durbanville and Cape Town. I rate Lynn 12 out of 10 stars!
Everything as described - comfortable, clean, spacious and neat. Will recommend Lynn’s place to all!
Thank you Lynn for a wonderful stay. We will definitely be back. Spotlessly clean, beautiful accommodation

Third time staying at Lynn’s place & I’m never disappointed.
She’s really managed to make this space so functional & comfortable & I’m always impressed with the cleanliness.
Lynn is so friendly & her communication is great.
Wonderful, clean spacious Airbnb. Lynn responds to messages quickly and offers a very comfortable clean and neat place to stay. Oh and a very comfortable bed!

We really enjoyed our stay. Sparkling clean, definitely a home away from home, and has everything one needs including an aircon. Lynn is a great host and was attentive to us throughout our stay. Most definitely recommend!
The location was exactly as described and seen on the photos. Everything was neat and tidy and my host was courteous and welcoming. Enjoyed my stay thoroughly.

Great Stay, easy 5 stars.
Clean, comfortable and as advertised.
Lynn’s De View will definitely be my first choice when returning to Durbanville for business.
Thanks Lynn.

Gosh - this is a wonderful spot. Spotlessly clean, very well equipped. Some wonderful extra touches - like FRESH milk for ones tea & coffee.  Lynn was so easy to deal with - helpful and accommodating - a real find

Top class, easy in and out lock up and go place near important amenities and shopping centers. Host is friendly, strong WiFi and everything you want for a quick visit to Cape Town.  Very new and modern finishes. Loved every moment of it!
Lynn’s place was amazing, the attention to detail was evident and couldn’t ask for a better location either, beautiful view over golf course. Would really recommend!
This is always my first choice of a getaway. Place is always spotless, private, peaceful and Lynne is a great hostess. I look forward to my/our next stay!

Stunning room with careful consideration given to the needs of anyone staying there.
100% would recommend to anyone, and stay there again.
Great place to stay! Lynn is very friendly and always happy to help. The check-in was super easy and everything was clean. We enjoyed our time and recommend it to others 👍🏻
Nice facilities in a modern room. Great mattress. Good Wi-Fi. Just a bit of traffic noise but with the aircon windows can be closed to manage it.
This was our second time back and definitely not the last! Lynn is such an amazing host ❤️✨
I enjoyed my stay so much. The room is so clean and comfortable. The area is so quiet and calm as well as the view from the room is also beautiful. Would definitely want to stay there again!

Had a truly delightful stay. Lynn is a wonderful host and goes out of her way to ensure her guests feel welcomed and have a comfortable stay. The place is exactly like in the images, is spotless and modern. I really appreciated the aircon unit to warm my room up (especially as I only checked in very late due to a delayed flight) and the black out curtains, along with the comfy king size bed were just what I needed to get a better night's sleep. Would definitely recommend Studio 43 and will be back. Thank you Lynn for making my stay very enjoyable and pleasant.

Beautiful room, very spacious and stylish. The property is situated on a busy road but you don’t hear any vehicles.
Room has a tv with netflix and an aircon and a very comfortable bed!
Great for a quick one night stay.
Modern, well equipped, and super clean accommodation. Lynn is a true super host, will stay here again next time.
Really beautiful place. Clean, private, and comfortable. Lynn was a great host! Would definitely stay here again :)
Great place! Bed is massive, bathroom is stunning, tv and AC was the cherry on top. Don't miss out on this place!

Lynn,
Is an amazing person and sweet, I will love to stay at her place again ana again.

Lynn is super friendly and responsive. The place was super clean and smells good!
And was perfect for the 5 nights spent! Loved it and will recommend it at anytime.

Amazing place. Exactly like the pictures!
Clean, neat & tidy, all things I find super important when I look for a place to stay!
We stayed overnight at Lynn’s place. It was great - clean and comfortable. Just what we needed. Lynn and her husband were friendly and helpful and we would recommend their place to stay.
It was great staying at Lynn's place. Very spacious, modern and exactly what we required for our stay.  We enjoyed our time here! We will be back!

Lynn was extremely helpful and always willing to assist.
Room is lovely.
I enjoyed my stay.
Such great value for money and I just loved the extras, fresh milk and bottled water and cookies.
What a lovely, neat and clean place! Lynn was very clear and proactive with the instructions and check-in/out. The room was private, spacious and comfortable. Will definitely visit again.
Ideal location as you are close to Durbanville area.  Safe parking and such a beautiful room with everything that one needed.  What a lovely stay.
I had a short stay but it was great! The room lived up to my expectations and I'll definitely be visiting again!
A great overnight stay. The place was very neat, clean and stylish. The stay gave us more that what we expected and check in was effortless and flexible. Thanks for a great stay, Lynn!

This place is very close to Restaurants, Shopping Mall but also to a popular Golf Course! Owner is always helpful and quick in communicating. Apartment is well equipped. We were very happy! Thank you Lynn.

Our second stay at Lynn's place, and we were not disappointed!
She's super friendly and the place was spotless, thank you for having us!
I had a peaceful and an enlightening stay. Wasn't hard to find the place and it felt very homely. Definitely recommend.

This cottage is absolutely gorgeously decorated and feels so comfortable and homey. Nicki is an amazing host and is very responsive and takes care of your every need. The staff at the cottage are wonderful and came in and cleaned for us and did laundry whenever we needed! The family who lives in the main house is so lovely and helped us with suggestions for pretty much everything in the area and made us feel so welcome like we were their friends as guests! Everything in the cottage is perfectly clean, brand new and in excellent working condition. All of the little gardens around the house are so delightful! We absolutely loved our time here and would definitely stay again!

A beautiful place which matched the AirBnB description. Hayley was our contact and was very helpful, it was lovely having her there to meet us at the property when we arrived and she provided great communication throughout our stay.
Fantastic beautiful house with a awesome host. Very friendly and inviting place that's located close to the City and also close to the Peninsula.

Iris was a wonderful host and the accomodation was tasteful, spacious, quiet and beautifully put together. We were literally on the beach and fell asleep with the sound of the waves in our ears. An outstanding place to stay!!

This is a great, super clean and well designed unit with lovely support from the “ the house people”.  It is well positioned on the beach but safe for walking and great restaurants within 2 kilometers!

The location is amazing with views of the mountain, the ocean, and anything else that makes for a relaxing trip to the Cape. The location is amazing, the facilities exceptional, and the hosts are extremely helpful, accommodating and hospitable throughout the trip. I highly recommend Mountain View.

This suite was great with enough personal space and walkable distance to 7 restaurants and other shops.
The view is super and the beach within 20 meters from the gate.
This one must be on a bucketlist
Iris’s place on the beach is cosy, homey and the perfect getaway! Iris is the perfect host. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay, we will definitely be coming back!

value for money ! and what an amazing view !
we had a very relaxed stay.
In a few words a very comfortable and clean place with no problems at all - fun to stay a and with an exceptional view over the sea. Professional host !
Gorgeous view of the sea. Great to unwind and get away from all the madness. Definitely enjoyes my stay

It was a great place near the ocean. We went to Cape Town for the kitesurfing and the location was perfect. We had the opportunity to leave our equipment in a separate room near the garden. The flat was totally clean and Iris was very friendly and had a helping hand every second.
We can definitely recommend the place and I will absolutely come back one day.
Beautiful apartment on the beach with incredible view ,  very  peaceful., perfect place to stay in Melkbosstrand  Tastefully designed . Iris  is a wonderful host .
Great location! Literally walk out onto the beach. Beautiful and spotlessly clean apartment. Really easy to get too. I would definitely recommend this and will be back again.
Iris is a lovely host and will go out of her way to make sure that your stay is comfortable as possible.

Iris was an amazing host, very friendly and caring. Had the best time in this stylish flat with the most incredible view. Thanks very much for the time I could spend there, will definitely come again.
The location of 15A is superb - large windows displaying the sea and beach!  Underfloor heating for early winter mornings!   Iris is truly a super host!
This is a gem Airbnb, everything works and Iris is super friendly, the town and beach is great for runs and walks.
What a great place!! Iris is a great host, fantastic view such a great place. I'd definitely go back anytime! Highly recommended!!

This establishment is awesome. Clean and well appointed with good quality linnen and utensils. Expect to wake up with the sound of waves and a beautyful view of the mountain. The host was always available without being intrusive.

The view alone makes this great place; bring your camera because you will want to take a picture of Table Mountain in the distance as from the room. You step out of the garden onto the beach. And if you're a kitesurfer this is the perfect spot for you. I especially liked the view of the beach. Iris's place is in a quiet neighbourhood but restaurants including some well-know places like Melkbosskerm is just down the road. I would recommend you have a car when you stay here, but the MyCiti bus services stop is not too far from the Airbnb. Overall I had a great stay and will visit again.
We had a wonderful stay! Lovely, spotless room with a beautiful view of the ocean. We appreciate all the personal touches :) Will definitely be back!

Step out of this oasis of spectacular views and unsurpassed comfort onto the endless stretch of beach and sky. Our two schnauzers had the time of their lives running freely on the beach, playing with the host's dog or sitting gazing at the sea from the reading nook. The bed super comfortable, a walk in closet with tons of space, a private balcony with wrought iron furniture where I sat to watch the sunset and numerous small touches that show hospitable attention to detail. Well done Iris, we hope to be back,

We had an amazing stay, the place was as is on the picture. Enjoyed the beach front view, people there are super friendly while walking their cute and playful dogs along the beach. The place was clean and checking in wasn't so much of a hasstle. There's a cute mini stove, a kettle,cutlery,mugs and glasses available as well as pots. The yard is nice and spacious too,the area is nice ,quiet and safe. We enjoyed the sound off the ocean even slept with windows open. I'd recommend having your own car as it ia difficulty finding any available bolt/uber rides to the cbd but we had an amazing driver from the airport and had asked to be our drivwr for the weekend. Irish is an amazing host, wouldn't mind going back there every year.

Thank you for sharing your wonderful home with us and giving us the ability to share in your spectacular views.
Hope to visit again soon.
Will definitely be returning, unforgettable experience.
Would highly recommend it.
Enjoyed my stay, close to everywhere I needed to be. Lovely and peaceful. Really enjoyed it
This was one of our favorite stays. Loved being so close to the beach and the amazing views of the ocean. Iris is a great host.

We had the best time at Iris’s place and the view was extraordinary!!!! 😄 We were welcomed so friendly. The unit looks exactly as on the photos and our host was just the best. Thank you for having us (and our little doggy). I think she enjoyed our stay the most. We will be back very soon, that’s for sure!!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Iris’s beautiful home. Location is fantastic, right on the beach, and accommodation is great, set in a beautiful garden. She even has loadshedding provisions in place!
We look forward to staying there again soon. Thank you Iris
This is the third time I've stayed at Iris & I've always left extremely happy & content. Not just the room & surroundings, but Iris' calming soul immediately welcomes you.

What a treat this was for myself and my family. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the serenity of Dale and Iris's beautiful beach property. They were amazing hosts and so friendly, they made us feel right at home.
The studio is just perfect and myself and my husband most especially loved the reading nook.
Such a cleverly designed space that will have you coming back for more - which definitely is the case for us.
If you are after a peaceful little getaway, that slow life - this is the space for you!
Don't hesistate to book an extra day or two if you can, you won't regret it!
Iris place is an absolute gem ito of the amenities, the attention to detail and then the location, view and access to the beach.  Wish we could stay longer!
I would definately recommend staying at Mountain View! Iris is a great host and the apartment is very well appointed and has everything you will need for a comfortable stay.
Such a enjoyable stay right on the beach. Iris was so friendly and very helpful. We will definitely be back

This studio flat is very central, justN one block from one of the main arteries of Cape Town, Long St which has an interesting variety of shops and restaurants. Janina is extremely helpful for information and very fast in communicating.

This apartment is very cute, with modern design. It is comfortable and the bathroom is especially well designed. The location is phenomenal for people who want to be close to nightlife (without being so much in the midst of it that the noise is unbearable) or also for people who are business travelers with a need to be near the high court (down the block on the same street) or parliament. Janina is helpful and communicative and was even able to accommodate a later check out time. I would definitely stay here again!

Janina's place is great value for money. We really liked the flat's interior, it was clean, well-decorated and had everything we needed.  There was a bit of noise coming from the street below, especially over the weekend, so just keep that in mind. Communication was good, and check-in / check-out was really easy.

Amazing hostess. Could check in whenever we wanted as key was in lock box which is very handy. Messaged me every morning to make sure I had everything I needed and to ask if I had any questions. Always told us to have a good day, you can tell she really cares that you have a good stay and wants to make your trip as good as possible. Amazing trip, apartment was really clean and had everything you would need.

Cute place in a great neighbourhood - easy to walk everywhere. Make sure you bring ear plugs - it's really noisy in the weekend and in the mornings with building/renovating noises in the streets below and in the apartment building itself. Janine is a great host, always in contact checking everything is okay. A cute place for a couple to stay for a party weekend in Cape Town.

Janina's flat was beautifully furnished and spotlessly clean. She was always available to answer any questions we had. The apartment was ideally located just off long street so close to many good bars and restaurants. The only thing to note is the window blinds let quite a lot of light in so be sure to bring an eye mask if you want to lie in late!! Overall would recommend to everyone.

Very friendly, fast responding and responsible host. We enjoyed staying in her flat. Everything was taken care of when we arrived. It was very clean, the interior was nice and Janina helped us with tips, restaurants and provided us with everything we needed.
Thanks again :)

I was a single travelling woman and for me the location was great. Close to Cafés and Restaurants, V&A in walkable distance and also I felt very safe thanks to the 24/7 Security Guard. The apartment has everything you need and a beautiful view of Table Mountain. Janina was a great host, always concerned if I have a good time. Perfect location for single travellers or couples. If I have ever the chance to go to Cape Town again, I surely would book that apartment again.
Had a great stay at this apartment. Its stylish and in a great location. Jenina was attentive and extremely kind

the perfect apartment if you want to explore cape town.. such a cute little place, very close to good restaurants & shops.
I will definitely stay at Janinas place when i come back.

The house is fantastic, felt like home! Sparkling clean, super cozy bed and nice touches like speakers and a heater. Janina is a wonderful person. She was super communicative and ensured that I always had what I needed. One of the best airbnb I’ve stayed in! Thank you Janina! Xo

This is a perfect flat for exploring Cape Town, it is in a great location with amazing views of table mountain. Janina was a fantastic host and helped us with everything we needed throughout our stay!
My stay at Janina's place was great, love the apartment and was really easy checking in was easy  easy and checking out would def stay there again

This apartment is perfect for anyone visiting (or in my case, relocating to) Cape Town. It’s in a very convenient area, close to loads of nice shops and restaurants and has a lovely view of Table Mountain. Janina is a spectacular host who is extremely friendly and knowledgeable. She was able to help me with so many things and made me feel right at home. The space is very stylish with lovely furnishings and a homey atmosphere.
