There can sometimes be noise from the street, but that comes with being downtown and would not deter me from booking this apartment in the future. 10/10 do recommend!

This apartment is very centrally located - one street away from Long Street and Company Gardens which made it easy for us to walk around the city bowl. It’s also about a 20min drive to the airport. We came on the weekend via car so we got free parking on the road outside (not tough to find a space). The place is was nicely decorated with cute plants and furniture and was cosy to stay in. Janina was quick to reply texts and ever willing to offer assistance or recommendations about Cape Town (and she’s v sweet!). She clearly stated in the descriptions that it’s a bright apartment and that it might get a little noisy on the weekends - true - but we were not bothered by it and we were very happy with our stay :).

Beautiful apartment in a great location with a fantastic host and tons of amenities. We loved exploring the V&A waterfront, the Company’s Garden, and Kloof Street shopping—all which were within walking distance!

Spacious, clean, stylish and very central apartment. Janina was really helpful and friendly. A previous guest had left the shower drain blocked, and Janina came personally that evening (a Saturday) and unblocked the drain for us. Thanks Janina for a wonderful stay!

Janinas apartment has everything you need for a stay in the city.
The apartment is located just around the corner to Longstreet so it’s close to bars, restaurants and shops. It can get a bit noisy in the night but it was still fine.
We felt safe and comfortable in Janina’s place .

Enjoyed our stay. Loved the proximity to Long Street and other places.
Bbtw superfast lift ;)

I had an absolute lovely stay at Janina's apartment! It is stylishly decorated with a few lovely art deco pieces, and really comfortable. The locations is super central for easy getting around in Cape Town, and most of all Janina was a wonderful, and very attentive host. She made the check-in experience completely effortless and responded immediately to questions. Thanks for letting me stay in your lovely apartment Janina!
Place is exactly as images portray. Not too noise and has a lovely view 24/7. Would 10/10 recommend.

Views, glorious views!
Extremely centrally located makes this stay incredibly convenient. A short walk from the bustling Bree and Long streets, with dozens of cafes, bars, and eateries to choose from. Table mountain and Devils Peak fill the end to end windows.
While you are in the heart of the city, this stay is on a quieter “side street” so it’s far quieter than one would expect.

Spacious studio apartment that’s tastefully decorated and in a central part of town. Great for working from home with enough table space for 2 or 3 people. Stable wifi. Super friendly, attentive and flexible host who made my stay very comfortable.

Great stay. Basic stuff all sorted and any queries or requirements were dealt with by the host very quickly and stress free.
Will definitely consider again for my future Cape Town stays.

Our stay was great. Beautiful space and fun neighborhood.
Would definitely recommend it!
Sara
A big and wonderful thank you to Janina for yet another beautiful stay! I came back so that should say a lot. Great stay! thank you thank you! xx

This was such a wonderful studio and Janina is amazing! The location is phenomenal, the furnishing is gorgeous, and the room has a lovely view of Table Mountain. Couldn't ask for more! The apartment felt very safe and always had multiple security guards manning the front desk. Wi-Fi was excellent (I took several important work meetings from the room) and the kitchen is fully stocked with dishes etc, so had everything I needed. The bathroom is also lovely with great shower pressure. Janina was so responsive, kind, warm, and professional. She went above and beyond to ensure I had a nice stay. So grateful to her and highly recommend this studio! It was the perfect pick for my two week stay in Cape Town.
the apartment is nice, but the neighboring bar street is very noisy and dangerous in the evening, after a walk in the evening it is better to return by taxi

We had a wonderful stay. Janina was very accommodating, friendly and responsive.
The location is in walking distance to numerous restaurants, stores and sites around the CBD. Although at times, you are able hear the bustling streets around, we did not find this to be too much/disturbing.

Excellent value. Exceptional clean, simple, quiet space in the best location for a Kalk bay stay. Perfect host. Lovely little house cat to keep me company. I will definitely recommend this to everyone. Thank you.
Lovely views, great location - if you aren’t afraid of a few steps - fabulous linen and extremely comfy large bed, friendly cat. I’ll definitely be back and would highly recommend it!

There certainly are numerous steps as commented on by previous guests, so this is not an advisable booking for the elderly. However, the extremely comfortable bed and the spacious shower were appreciated. The kitchen in a cupboard as pictured was a tight fit but met our needs adequately. The location high above Kalk Bay is outstanding with easy access to shops and restaurants below. Beautiful view from the terrace.

We loved the garden cottage!  Its got a fantastic view over the ocean and harbour and is brilliantly located for swimming at the Dalesbrook tidal pool and nearby Fishoek beach.  Not to mention the fun shops and restaurants for which Kalk Bay is renowned.  Paul was a great host - we'll definitely be back!

This garden flat it great!
We loved the huge comfortable bed and the choice of outside areas to hang out.
Laying out on the comfy sun beds with that beautiful view over kalk bay and the ocean was our highlight.
Communication and checking in was all good too. Thanks!
A little gem in Kalk bay. As an other review says, is nicer than it looks in the pictures. Short walk to main road. Beautiful view.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Kalk Bay! Paul was a wonderful host with plenty of excellent recommendations. He is responsive, flexible, kind, and considerate.
The flat is a perfect launching pad for adventures around the neighborhoods of Kalk Bay, St James, Muizenberg, Fish Hoek, and Clovelly. It is small, but clean and well-appointed. The bed is very comfy, the bathroom is immaculately clean. As a bonus, there is a private area attached to the flat that offers some very impressive views of False Bay.
We loved it. Thank you, Paul!

We had a nice stay. The wifi had limits, however, which was not ideal as we planned to work from home, which requires being able to do video meetings etc.
Had we known this, we wouldn't have booked there.
However it was still pleasant.

amazing place!!! felt like home
from the beginning. everything walking distance, feeling safe, suler clean and had a great host who was always here to help. Can only recommend and sad to leave!
Wonderful area, comfortable beds and nice kitchen with serious coffee machine. Boat-Pedalling in the Marina was great fun. See you again next year

We absolutely loved our stay at 40 Marina Da Gama. What a homely space with such thoughtful touches and a warm host. We had absolutely everything we needed in the space...the paddling boat and beautiful scenic views were just a thrilling cherry on top. Thank you Sue for really making our stay comfortable and memorable!

Great secluded area, but close to main roads and easily drivable. A coffee and paddleboat lap was a great way to start the day. Beautiful scenery, between the mountains and lake. Would definitely stay here again!

Sue and her husband are wonderful hosts. The apartment and the neighborhood are great for a stay in Muizenberg and for exploring the Cape. It is totally safe and just a couple of minutes drive to the beach where we enjoyed many days of surfing and laying in the sand.
The apartment itself is a big enough for a family and the view from the bedrooms is superb. Sue offered to have us use the pedal boat which we gladly accepted to check out the neighborhood from the water. Also, Sue gave us great advice for restaurants to go to or activities to do.
We can totally recommend the place and would have liked to stay longer.

Sue was an absolute sweetheart and pleasure to deal with. Her place has a lovely home feel and her communication with us about the goings on in Cape Town and places to visit was excellent. We absolutely loved our stay, thank you Sue.

great place with an awesome view right at the water.
sue is one of the best hosts I have ever had and she will help you out with everything you need.
this apartment is an absolute no-brainer if you are looking for place to stay in this area.

How does one describe Sue’s place in one word…”Wow”. We stayed for six weeks being our fifth visit to Cape Town and our second to Marina da Gama. Immediately you enter the door you are confronted with an absolutely wonderful thought out living space. The bed was super comfortable, the kitchen very well equipped for those wishing to cook for themselves, the outside balcony a delightful place to sit and watch the world go by on the lake. The use of the pedalo was a big bonus to idly while away a sunny afternoon. The nearby nature reserve was our “go to” place every morning and we saw many unusual birds and wildlife.  Sue is without a doubt the “hostess with the mostest”. She was on hand to respond to any requests/queries and was so helpful with everything. We are already seriously thinking of a return trip to this idyllic apartment next year.

We had a wonderful stay at Sue's appartment with our two daughters. The apartment is beautiful, very clean and perfectly equipped. We felt right at home. Our kids enjoyed the hot tub and we took some great tours with the paddel boat. Sue and Ian are great host who really cared for us to have a good time. The location is great, the beach, town center and shopping are reached quickly by car and there is a very nice coffee bar in walking distance. Thank you for a great stay!
We had a great stay at Sue’s place. My son loved the paddle boat on the marina. Sue was a great host with good communication.
Had a really nice stay - the apartment is cosy, with everything you need and the hot tub was a real highlight of our time

This comfortable apartment in its peaceful, waterside setting was ideal for us whilst visiting family and friends in the local area.  We particularly enjoyed our breakfasts on the sunny balcony overlooking the water. Sue responded promptly to any messages and made our stay very easy.

“The apartment has the most spectacular uninterrupted view of Table Mountain! My host was simply amazing – very professional and reliable and the “little touches” (basics like being able to make a cup of coffee and have bathroom amenities, welcome note) made a huge difference. The apartment was immaculate, comfortable and exactly as advertised. I will go back there for sure!"

Maria is warm and helpful and made sure that we knew exactly where to go and what to do upon arrival.  The apartment is light and airy and has a great view of Cape Town.  It is close to literally everywhere that you would want to be. Well worth booking this one.

Maria's apartment in Cape Town was gorgeous. Very comfortable, clean and had everything you will need to have a nice stay. Location is perfect for exploring all the cities attractions. We also liked the building's security.

If you have the chance to stay here - book it! The location was amazing - right in the middle of town so was within walking distance to everything (grocery store, bars, restaurants, etc.). The views of table mountain and lions head are more amazing than the pictures. Maria was so helpful with checkin and quick communication any time I had any questions. Had a wonderful time - highly highly recommend staying here, you won't regret it!

From start to finish Maria's hospitality is top notch.  Maria is very responsive to messages and her home is beautiful.  I have stayed in this block before and was disappointed I couldn't get the same apartment; however that soon disappeared when I started communicating with maria and from the moment we entered the apartment.  Lovely little touches like we were able to have a cuppa when we arrived. Top quality bed linen and beautifully furnished apartment with a view to die for.

The apartment of Maria is very centrally located in Cape Town. All major attractions are within walking distance. The self check-in was excellent and very simple. Maria was always available via phone or Whats app. In addition to the apartment, the accommodation offers a garage parking, which we were very glad about. The apartment is great for 4 people and is equipped with everything your heart desires.

Maria was an outstanding host. She really went out of her way to help us navigate the city and troubleshoot with travel issues. Her place was very clean, comfortable, and had a great view of the city. If we are in the area again, we will definitely stay here again!

If you don’t stay here, you will miss out on the best part of Capetown - from access to the best places to eat and hangout, to the amazing amenities and warm, welcoming service,  Maria’s place has it all!

The apartment is what it promises; it is very spacious and the views on table mountain are excellent. We stayed in the appartement for a week and we enjoyed it a lot. It is right in the city centre so you can walk to places from there. When we arrived there were some things to eat and drink in the fridge, very thoughtful. We got clear instructions about how to enter the apartment and also answers to all our questions via WhatsApp throughout the week. The gym and pool were out of order when we were there, it is probably fixed by now.

Maria’s place was awesome. I was travelling with my elderly father and he loved it. The view is sooo good to wake up to...but aside from that, the apartment was clean, very spacious and had all the things you need to feel like home. Maria’s finer touches were appreciated. Bathrooms were clean and spacious, showers had excellent water pressure.  Beds are on the firm side (which I like but others may not). The apartment is high up and quiet. Maria was a very accomodating host. We spent a long time considering different apartments/locations in cape town and upon reflection, we have ZERO regrets!  Very close to amenities including big supermarket, easy secure parking for rental car, felt safe...and the pool was a godsend after our 24hours-awake-journey to get there. Can’t recommend this accommodation enough.

This apartment has beautiful views of the city and is in walking distance to amazing restaurants and coffee shops and the Fugard theatre. I personally would not walk around at night. It was sparkling clean, modern, and stocked with basics that got us started! We loved having fresh fruit after been traveling by airplane for almost 30 hours. It’s a very secure building. Being in the city is great for avoiding the heavy traffic. We were always heading out in the morning and returning later in the day, thus going in the opposite direction to traffic. Great location!

Modern light apartment with amazing views of the city and mountains. Clean and good facilities with extra touches of some food essentials waiting for us which was really welcome
Maria was a great communicator which helped as we had some additional queries. Highly recommended
Will definitely return on our next visit

Great views of the mountains, walkable to the restaurants and nightlife on Long, Loop, and Bree streets. King size beds and being on the 16th floor made for nice comfortable sleeps. Easy parking in the basement, gym was empty each time I went was an added bonus. We had no issues walking around the CBD late at night during our 1 week stay, but some may prefer to Uber to avoid dark side roads.
If you book this room, also make a reservation for Fyn down the street for amazing fine dining- it was may favorite restaurant in Cape Town and deserving of being #37 in the world.

What a beautiful place to stay in downtown Cape Town. The building is secure with great staff, the apartment, stunning with incredible views of Table mountain and lions head. The night lights over the city are gorgeous too. Easy walk to shops and restaurants. Well appointed apartment with fabulous views.

Place was very clean and tidy. The building was very secure- key card front entrance, 24 hr security guard, and key card elevator. The gym (open 9-5) was bare bones but had a treadmill, two bikes, two rowers, and weights.
Issues:
The AC DID NOT WORK and the host did not offer any help or make inquiries when messaged.
There was only one key and given the security to get in, it was annoying to leave the house separately.
Great place, well equipped kitchen, great views, the security was very friendly and the place is well located.

We loved our stay at DelaHilcremat. Our hosts, Dean & Hillary went out of their way to make us feel comfortable & provided us with everything we needed. The location was perfect for us and every morning we were greeted with a beautiful sunrise & view of the ocean. The deck suite is ideally located close to restaurants & shops. Our unit was  very neat, modern & equipped with everything we needed. We had a great stay and will definitely recommend it to friends and family.

Dean is pretty welcoming and accommodating,
Cosy environment, enjoyed our stay,
What you see on the pics is exactly the value for your money👌🏼
Such a clean, cute spot. So close to a lovely little tidal pool and beach, with a beautiful view of false bay. Dean was very welcoming and kind. We will definitely be back!
Amazing place, local and alot of things to do around the area. Chill, time out spot, very clean, very tidy and views are amazing. And the hosts are very accommodating. We will definitely visit again.
it is a beautiful stay close ro the ocean the view is spectacular the room is just perfect close to the mall...loved every second thanks so much ! it is everythingyou need.

The cottage is very comfortable set in the most beautiful tranquil gardens. The host Mary is very hospitable and nothing was ever a problem. Very centrally situated with easy access to all shops. We had a wonderful stay

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Mary’s cottage. Very private and felt like a home away from home.  Perfect base to explore Cape Town and very close to all the great eateries and wine farms in Constantia.

Thanks again for your hospitality.we really enjoyed our stay in cape town. The community is very nice with parks and shopping malls closeby. Dominique is a very nice hostess.I would recommend to my friends.

Dominique and Jeremy are very kind hosts. They were very kind with our kids. They gave us some tips about nice things to do and see.
We highly recommend this lovely and comfortable cottage in Cape Town.

Dominique was a great host and a really friendly woman. She definitely tried to go out of her way to make you comfortable.
Unfortunately she has some undesirables that live on the property and makes your stay not very feel safe

A neat, central 2 bedroom flat that offers exactly what you need. The flat, filled with an enjoyable show of Professional Dancing pictures from the past. Shops so  close, makes it handy to the traveler. We loved the clever decor by Jeremy. All  the best. And thank you once again.
A cosy and locely place to stay. Dominique was a great hostes. Can recommend this accomodation.

Dominique and family were very kind and courteous
We where assisted with any additional requests .
The WiFi was awesome .
The Apple TV & Netflix a welcome addition.
It works, but could consider and upgrade on stove plate and oven .
The location is great but with that comes traffic - nothing much the hosts can control.

It was a great place to stay, with character, neat and value for money with friendly hosts. Although we enjoyed our privacy we always knew that assistance was a knock out WhatsApp way. Will recommend to anyone.

Jeremy’s house was such a beautiful hidden place. The house was very cosy and stylish at the same time. Furthermore the open  kitchen was very well equipped. The terrace invites to have lunch or dinner or just enjoy the sun outside. The area is also very safe and the city center is not too far away. Jeremy has hosted us pretty well and he responded also very quickly. I would definitely book it again!

Great location ... walking distance to the main promenade and all the bars and restaurants ... good value ... perfect for the time we stayed .. extra touches were the things in the fridge , fruit , milk , coke .. plus tea and coffee ... we didn’t need to cook as we were out but had the basics should you need to make basics .... will definitely come back

Linzi and Albie are fantastic hosts that are attentive to detail and very helpful! The cat Maxi and dog Kayo are also a nice addition to the house and will surely make all animal lovers smile (if you ask for them). The apartment also has gorgeous sea views from the deck perfect for tanning and sundowners. Would definitely recommend Linzis place!

Linzi’s place was an absolute find. Lovely hosts, comfortable bed, lovely and cozy decor, lovely views and a secret garden with a plunge pool.
Also super pet-friendly!
We can definitely recommend Linzi’s place to everyone!

We had a wonderful time in Linzi‘s Appartement and in Cape Town in general!Thank you very much for everything - the helpful tips and insights about the area, very early check-in etc) We felt right at home and enjoyed the time very much. We can only recommend the Appartement with the perfect location to all the nice places around Capetown. Thanks and best, Benny & Susann
Linzi's place is a beautiful place, very clean and bright. It's beautifully situated in Camps Bay. We would like to recommend the place 100% and definitely come back when in Cape Town

Great space in Camps Bay. The apartment is big which is great and if you are lucky their very friendly cat Max will come and visit you and hang out if you like cats.  It is a good 20mins walk down the hill  into Camps Bay and a steep walk back if you want some exercise but easy to get ubers back and forth and Camps Bay is a good location for getting into town as well as along the coastal route. Liniz communicated quickly and willing to help with anything if we needed it. Well worth a visit and a stay here

Had the most wonderfully relaxing stay in this beautiful apartment. Set in a divine location overlooking Camps Bay, it is quiet and comfortable. Everything was clean and tidy, with all amenities you could ask for. Could not recommend it more.

Ciska's place is perfectly located within easy walking distance of the buzz of the V&A Waterfront yet peaceful enough to snooze on the balcony soaking up the tranquility of the scenic canal. The stylish apartment is very well equipped and is situated in a high security complex with its own amenities.  Ciska's place doesn't disappoint and is highly recommended.
Great little spot in the Waterfront. Beautiful apartment, nice and quiet but close to everything you need.  Has all the mod cons you would have at home and just has a “feel good” factor. Stay there!

A great apartment- excellent location,very clean and convenient to everything !!
Ciska was a great host, very informative and helpful- would stay there again anytime!!
Fantastic stay! Just a short walk to V&A, uncapped internet, and tranquility stay with a view.

Ciska’s place is what you see in the photos and more! Ciska is welcoming and made our check in smooth. I was travelling with my kids, and they loved the close proximity to the Waterfront and the walking trails. Thank you Ciska!
We had an amazing stay at Ciskas place. The location could not be more convenient. It’s a beautiful apartment and the view is stunning. We really enjoyed ourselves.
Clean, modern, superb location, very accommodating and friendly host - you can't beat it in Cape Town

What a fantastic place - perfectly situated on the V and A Waterfront and stylish! Ciska communicated superbly and went out of her way to make us feel welcome. Nothing was a problem - highly recommended!

The apartment is exceptional and ideally located for both the Waterfront as well as the basis for trips further apart. Check-in is easy with Cisca's housekeeper (Princess) waiting for us at the security gate and showing us the apartment. The apartment itself is very clean, well organised and has a good feel to it. The Waterfront is in walking distance (some 15 minute) and the garage is welcome and secure place for the hire car. The balcony has nice views to the canal front and it is a very quite area.
In summary, I can greatly recommend Cisca's apartment and hope to be able to visit again in the future.
Beautiful apartment, brilliantly located for the Waterfront. Easy check in and out. Would highly recommend for a short stay in Cape Town.

A great location at the right price that suited all 4 of us. Felt safe, secure and very comfortable in the apartment and will return again next year. Nothing but compliments and the support of a great  and caring host.

We thoroughly enjoyed our time at Ciska's apartment. Communication was clear and speedy before and during our stay. Check in and out was so easy. The location was superb and everything is so safe.  The standard of accommodation was exceedingly high, spacious, extra homely touches. Fabulous bathrooms. Lovely large balcony with superb views.
Spacious and well located, within a safe and secure complex. Ciska was a great host and was always available to help.

Ciska’s communication was great and she replied almost instantly regarding all queries both prior to and during our stay. The host was very accommodating when our travel plans were delayed due to events beyond our control and kindly changed our reservation dates. The apartment was secure, well located and clean. We will definitely be back!

Absolutely loved this place and highly recommend! The apartment is well decorated and clean, in the perfect location, and Ciska and her team were easy to reach and very helpful throughout. Don’t think twice - you have to book this place for your stay in Cape Town!

This was our second time in this apartment. It felt like home.
The communication with the host was perfect.
Beautiful place to stay for a trip to Cape Town but don’t expect too much of a view.
Amazing, beautiful, clean place and makes you feel homely. Best situated and the view to die for
Place is stunning, pictures are exact. The area brilliant..it actually felt like being in a fancy hotel. I loved every minute of our stay!

Walking distance to many attractions!
It was very wheelchair friendly. The step-free shower was very easy to use for a domestic walker like myself.
Great apartment in a great location. Only drawback is getting into the complex can be a pain due to the tight security protocols.

Very comfortable place with everything we needed and great location.
Ciska was a fantastic host that made all needed for an excellent stay. Communication was great as well.
This is a fantastic apartment in a great location and is very well appointed and stylish. We thoroughly recommend it!!

Lovely apartment in a good location to access all the facilities at the V&A Waterfront. Safe & secure.
Load shedding was taking place during our stay, and it would have been helpful to have some information about this. We were visiting CapeTown from the UK, so load shedding is not something we were familiar with.
The Waterfront is an iconic upmarket environment, and Ciska’s place is as good as I have seen.

Ciska was very responsive & flexible at every stage. Her place is very secure and also walking distance to V&A waterfront where there is lots to do and many choices for dining, shopping,  and sightseeing. The unit is clean and well-appointed. Great visit to Cape Town.

Fantastic Apartment and lovely surroundings!
Description are pictures of the place are accurate.
Ciska was super responsive and promptly gave very thorough and helpful instructions in a true SuperHost style.
Simply a five star experience.

Highly recommend staying here! The apartment is modern, clean and large. It has everything you need for your stay including lights/generators for during load shedding. We felt extremely safe in this complex with so much security and passes to get in and out. It is also walking distance to the waterfront where there is plenty of shops and restaurants.

We had a wonderful stay at Kylemore. The apartment was immaculately clean and very stylishly furnished. Marina Residential is very safe gated complex with an easy access to V&A Waterfront by foot, even in the evening. And Uber takes you wherever else you need to go. Luckily we did not have load-shedding during our 6 day stay, though back-up for wifi, TV and lights was available.

The location could not be better. We walked to V&A Waterfront area each day for meals, shopping, and sightseeing. We took the peninsula tour from the City Sightseeing pick up spot there. We took several recommendations from the guest information for places to go and were pleased with them.
The flat was clean, spacious, and quiet.
We had rides pick us up at the building with no issues which was nice, especially when it was time to leave for the airport.
The place is amazing with a great and safe location. Ideally for families and great relaxing place for your adventures in Cape Town.

Very high level facilities and very secure.Walkable to the V& A where there were plenty of attractions and restaurants.If you wanted to cater for yourself there was also a supermarket where you could pick up or have a delivery.
There was a number of rules that went with the place that were common sense and when getting picked up by your guides and taxis you did have to notify the front gate.

Ciska was amazing. She was extremely responsive to any questions that I had. The property is superb and exceeded expectations. Having stayed in multiple properties within the same complex over previous years I did know what expect, however, this property will still above this. I could not recommend both the property, and Ciska as a host more.

We had a wonderful stay at the Marina Waterfront apartment! Ciska was incredibly accommodating, helpful, and attentive – from booking to check-out, she took great care of everything. The location is simply unbeatable: very central and extremely safe. A special highlight was Mona – she is absolutely lovely and made our stay even more enjoyable. We would love to come back and highly recommend this accommodation!

Only one word is needed to describe the time in this accommodation: wonderful!
The Apartment is an absolute dream and even more beautiful than in the pictures. The view of the sea is to fall in love with. Everything is clean and very well maintained. The pool is the perfect way to cool off after a sunny day at the beach. The location of the property is perfect.
Linzi is a true superhost. Check in and out was flexible and pleasant. During the stay she gave us helpful advices to experience the area even better. If we had any questions, she was always able to help us immediately. 5/5!!! A sixth star would also have been appropriate. Thank you so much for your flexibility, hospitallity and your kindness! Thank you for everything, Linzi!

This place has the most beautiful view over Camps Bay, directly overlooking the ocean. Really one of the most memorable sunset views!
It is bright and well-equipped. We also felt that the surrounding area is quite safe and calm, but still close enough to all of cape town’s great sites.
Linzi was a great host - friendly, very pro-active and had lots of good recommendations.
Only downside was that the place had no A/C and can heat up quickly during very hot days - would still highly recommend to go.

We had an absolute amazing time here! Linzi is a great host and did everything to make us feel at home. We got excellent recommendations for restaurants, beaches, day trips, shopping. The area itself is beautiful and feels safe. Perfectly located for hiking and just a little walk down to the beach with all the restaurants!
I would absolutely come back and I highly recommend to book this Airbnb!

We had a fantastic stay, lovely place with everything you need. Linzi went out of her way, and huge thank you for use of the penthouse. Great communication throughout. Would highly recommend. Peaceful, quiet location. Five minutes to everything Camp's has to offer.
Its fantastic place, so many clean and very well maintained by the owner....confortable for couples....there is a apple tv

This place is amazing. This stylish decorated loft is in a very safe area near Waterfront. Plenty of nice restaurants and bars in the neighborhood. Andre is a great host, and would recommend this accommodation!

Lovely place in a great neighbourhood.  The space is full of light and while very central, also extremely quiet.  It worked very well for me since I was eating out and didn't need to do much cooking although I enjoyed trying the fancy milk frother!  Comfy bed, crisp white sheets, lots of pillows.  Andre was absolutely lovely - very friendly and very responsive.
Very central location, close to good restaurants and nightlife. It's nice to have parking in this part of town. Andre was very responsive and check-in was super easy. Had a great time!
Hip, central, safe and quiet romantic getaway near the VA waterfront. Easy parking, nice central courtyard, great air con and buetiful apartment! A great stay in central CT

Andre’s place was a spectacular find! We arrived at 1am, but the hosts were still happy to meet us and walk through the place and general information! We felt safe throughout Cape Town, but if the safety is a concern, this is the right place for you. The grounds are gated, as well as a security gate for the unit. The views from the unit are amazing, looking out to table mountain. Lastly, the place is great, clean, nicely decorated, spacious, and comfortable. We would absolutely stay again.
The place is lovely!  Beautiful, clean, lots of light, quiet,  filled with  orchids, comfortable- good location.  Was a pleasure to stay here. Host are very accommodating and responsive.

Andre's place is just as good, if not better, than it looks in the photos. Located within a secure complex and includes a parking space. Location is good. Easy drive from the airport and to Waterfront. Some great places to eat within walking distance. A home away from home, would happily stay here again.

Apartment was beautiful and stylish with amazing views of table mountain! The neighbourhood was very safe with a secure undercover carpark and 24 hour security petrol!
Andre was a great host with excellent communication! Can't wait to come back!

What a lovely apartment you have - It was exactly as advertised, and I would absolutely recommend it to friends and colleagues.  Super central, close to the V&A waterfront, and to the CTICC.  Beautifully decorated, well organised, and much more storage and space than a hotel room.  Thanks so much!

Thanks Andre for being a great host, my wife and I had a great time in the loft.
The fact that it is in the center of everything was awesome. We literally drove 5 minutes to anywhere we went to.

This place is an amazing, stylish loft apartment in a safe spot in Cape Town. Mini mart around the corner, restaurant across the street.
You won’t be disappointed!

Amazing loft! You won’t be disappointed! Great location! We walked to waterfront every morning and also walked to CBD as well. My daughter absolutely loved this stylish loft! She definitely wants to come back here!!!!

Excellent loft apartment - thoughtfully designed to maximize the use of space and feels like it has a designers touch with the all white theme. Great location for business in the waterfront - 5-10 mins walk to most places there.

comfortable and stylish place in central Cape Town.
We didn't meet Andre, but he was very responsive and friendly in his messages.
Great location (just 10min walk to V&A), very clean and we felt so safe here with the 24hr security. Andre was a fantastic host with super quick responses! Thank you

the space is beautiful but for me being a light sleeper it wasn't ideal. everything is white and Windows dont have blackout curtains but sheer ones. this only makes it worse and traffic noises start early!
host is great though and it is beautiful . Couldn't sleep even with a mask and ear plugs

This condo is beautiful and certainly lives up to the pictures and descriptions. Everything you need is right there. The security in the building is obvious, kind and helpful.
It is nicely located to the waterfront harbor area where there are many restaurants and activities. There are food markets, running and biking paths etc within walking distance.
The owners were available and quickly responsive whenever we had the least little question.

This truly is a stunning loft apartment, as expected from previous reviews!!!  The decor was very modern and chic, there is on-property security, the location is wonderful with a charming coffee shop, Table Thirteen, just around the corner and a short walk down to the V&A Waterfront and there is the view of Table Mountain to top it all off!  Andre was very responsive to any questions or concerns I had and both check-in and check-out were seamless!  I highly recommend Andre's loft should you find yourself in Cape Town!

The place is very clean in two aspects! Impressed by all the living plants in the apartment; made me feel at home even though I only stayed for two days.
The picture over the bed with a girl wearing a diamond ring threw my girlfriend of a bit 😂

This was by far my favorite place I stayed at in Cape town. I felt like I was living in luxury. The design of the place is absolutely beautiful and very elegant. I also loved all the personal touches Andre gave the place, such as pillow spray, perfumes, laundry detergent,etc. I wish I could have stayed longer and booked further in advance. The place also felt very safe as it was in a gated area with security guards.

We loved staying here! Amazing and beautifully-designed space in a great location near the Waterfront. The communication was excellent, and there were lots of little touches to make us feel at home. Highly recommend!

The location of Andre’s apartment was perfect. The place was clean, well equipped and very safe and secure. It made our stay in Cape Town very enjoyable. Andre replied promptly to any messages and his instructions and recommendations made our trip smooth sailing and stress free. Would recommend to anyone looking.
It's a really nice flat. Really clean and stylish! We had a good stay, it's only a bit much light in the morning and a bit noisy in the night

We had a wonderful stay. Check-in was very easy and everything was clean and nice and very chique. The appartement had everything we needed and the location close to the waterfront was great. We loved the decoration, the plants. The restaurant on the other side of the street was super delicious.

Fantastic place and great location.
Brilliant hospitality provided by the owners who provide everything you need for a enjoyable stay in Cape Town.

Andre was good at communicating prior to our arrival, checking that we understood the self check in process. The apartment is beautiful and in a great location. The complex feels very secure and the security guards were friendly. Definitely recommend!

Wonderful place to stay!  It is in a great location to everything!  Everything you need is there to make your stay feel like home!  The bed is super comfy too!  Highly recommend staying in this cute loft!!

The apartment was very easy to get to. Has security in the development so it felt very safe and the apartment itself was beautifully decorated. Within easy walking distance to the Waterfront during the day and a quick Uber at night. Great apartment

Excellent accommodation in a prime location. Beautifully appointed apartment with all your home from home amenities.  If required Andre was always available and accommodating to our needs. Don’t hesitate just book this apartment.

What a stunning stay. We enjoyed everything about Andre’s home. They thought about every detailed, even down to the olive oil which was fantastic.
The location is perfect and very central to everything you might want to take advantage of in the Mother City.
We’ll definitely be back again soon.
This is an excellent value for money AirBnB! The position is exceptional and the unit was spotless!
I enjoyed every  moment  of being in  this beautiful apartment. It is central  and located  in  a peaceful  area, definitely  coming  back!
Fantastic Apartment! Beautifully decorated and very well located. The host is kind and accommodating, ensuring we checked in without a problem and had all the amenities needed, thank you!

The place was beautiful. The pictures do not do the place justice!!! Everything was in walking distance and very convenient. It is a very nice apartment and what made it even more unique was that it was somewhat a smart house. I loved all the gadgets and what we could do in the household. Andre made us feel very welcome and I’d definitely recommend this place.
We had a lovely stay, the place is well positioned and very quiet for a city centre apartment. We will stay there again on our next visit to the mother city. Thanks

Fantastic warm great looking space
The host communicated very well. Such great extra pieces like washing supplies dishwasher milk coffee. I was really impressed. Great location as well. Good value for money. Would stay there again

This place deserves all the positive reviews! Quick communication from the host, stylish design of the clean loft, strong WiFi and a quiet hotel complex. We were there for 1 week, so having a washer & dryer was useful :)
I would definitely recommend and return to this loft!
It looked exactly like the pictures. Loved the location and the hosts were very attentive. 10/10 recommend.

A very nice apartment in a really good location. We loved it !
The only thing we didn’t understand beforehand is what a tandem parking space is. Generally speaking if you’re in Cape Town with a car you’d have to always rely on the other person using that parking spot to be available to move their car. If this is not a problem for you: 100% recommend this Airbnb !
Everything was great. Very clean. Easy to contact the host. Great location. Only wish there was enough hot water for 2 people at the same time otherwise you would have to wait for the hot water.
Amazing place! We stayed 8 nights and everything was perfect. Located in a nice and safe area very close to V&A waterfront we had everything we needed. Highly recommend!
Beautiful home. Andre's home is exactly as described. Very full of character and in a very convenient location.

Beautiful and exceptionally designed apartment in great location near waterfront. I stayed at many airbnbs but that was by far the most uniquly designed one. Everything is in white, together with the huge windows the place is very bright and friendly.
Andre is a super host and reactes very quickly if someone has a question. The apartment and the car parking spot is in a gated complex and therefore very secure. One thing for people who have problems sleeping when it is bright outside: despite the curtains and blinds a lot of light comes into the room. We totally didn't mind and actually liked it that way but I thought it is worth mentioning. A small table and chairs on the balcony would be nice but I understand if that is not possible because it might get stolen.

This apartment is as gorgeous as the pictures. Very conveniently located aswell. My most favourite stay in Cape Town. The host was sooo accommodating and even assisted me when it came to locating a lost item after I had already checked out. A must see and definitely will rebook in future.

A fantastic spot for a first time visitor to Cape Town! Very walkable, safe feeling neighborhood with several fantastic restaurants within a 10 minute radius. The place itself was great, lots of natural light and easy to navigate.

Fantastic location, safe, and clean with Andre being as responsive of a host you could ever want or need.  Easy access to the Waterfront, short walk to city center and Bo Kaap if you’re up for it, and quick taxis to Seapoint and Camps Bay. Would stay again.

The apartment was very and in a safe neighbourhood. Communication with the host was great and I was even able to retrieve some clothes that I had left at the apartment a week later when I returned to Cape Town
Great location near Waterfront and has private parking. Don’t forget to get your morning breakfast and coffee at the coffee within the compound. Perfect location to explore Cape Town.
We stayed for a week and thought it Andre’s place was in the perfect location for exploring Cape Town. The apartment looks just like the pictures.

A fantastic find. A very beautiful apartment which is all white inside with lots of fabulous green plants. The bed was very comfortable and the shower is excellent.
We were very happy there. And it felt very safe. The apartment itself has all the amenities you need and is located in Green point for close restaurants and you can also you walk directly to the Waterfront.
Andre and Candice were very helpful and check in was easy.
A plus was the fabulous pool in the complex which was great to cool down.
We would highly recommend this apartment.
Sarah and Peter
Absolutely amazing! Gorgeous space, easy check in, and lots of thoughtful details: coffee, milk and water in fridge. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and wish I could have stayed longer!

We stayed at Andre's place in Cape Town for our honeymoon and it's an excellent apartment. Good Security and large apartment, we felt safe whilst walking within the complex even at night. the apartment is beautiful as advertised.
However do take note that you'll need to carry your luggage up a flight of stairs to reach the apartment, as well as another flight of stairs up the loft itself.
Amazing stay, would not regret coming back again in future!
A lovely light and airy apartment in a secure location within easy walk of the Waterfront. We stayed for a week and had a great time. Would happily book again next time we are in Cape Town.

You must stay at this amazing apartment. It is in the perfect location. It is stunningly gorgeous inside with an amazing year of table mountain.   Security is outstanding and parking within the secure courtyard was so easy. Walking around this neighborhood and I was very comfortable and safe.

Very spacious loft, well furnished, well stocked., very clean and great interior decor. Stunning views of Table Mt. Great location, several restaurants, shops, etc. - all walkable. My prefered airbnb whenever I’m in Cape Town. Thank you Andre🙏🏾

Place was beautiful as described. Easy walk to the waterfront and very walkable to city center. Felt safe and secure at night. Would absolutely stay here again. Andre was very helpful in alerting me when I left something behind and arranging to get it back to me. 5 stars ⭐️

Loved my stay here.
The place was just as described in the photos, maybe even nicer in real life. The design and setup is lovely.
We loved our stay here! It was the start to our honeymoon and we felt right at home and safe with lots of privacy!

couldn't have asked for a better stay right near the V&A and accessible to everything! felt right at home and had a wonderful time! would recommend to anyone looking for an inexpensive yet luxurious stay in cape town

Andre had great communication and was able to help us check in our luggage early before a road trip. The place was very nice and at a great location to explore the waterfront. I’d highly recommend this to anyone visiting Cape Town
Had a really pleasant time at Andre’s place! This place is really close to the V & A waterfront, and the farmers market
This place made our stay really special. We felt right at home and right in the center of everything we wanted to do. It was secure and relaxing.
Very communicative and answered all our questions. Location was great and very safe/secure. Would recommend!

This house is absolutely stunning, and I can’t recommend it more highly for a stay in Cape Town! We were 4 adults staying in the 3 bedrooms and it was perfect. A beautiful high ceiling, spacious house. The house was clean and so large, the pictures don’t do it justice! The beautiful touches were much appreciated like fresh flowers on the dining table, and a bottle of wine and fresh coffee waiting for us.
The house is just a 5min walk from a Spar supermarket and from a bustling bakery where we enjoyed breakfast. In general the location is great - opposite a lovely park, but just a road away from the Main Street, so whilst close, it’s still quiet, and you feel very safe.
Bertus was a wonderful host and was very flexible with our check-in time, and responsive when I messaged about the TV.
I have no doubt that if I’m back in Cape Town I’ll be staying here!

This is a lovely home and we thoroughly enjoyed it stay! Several nice outside spaces. Beautifully and simply decorated. Close to many restaurants and shops. Would definitely recommend families or a group of friends to stay here!

Beautiful Victorian styled house , so clean and homey . Thoughtful touches with the kiddies books . We really enjoyed our stay we felt so comfortable and safe the kids had such a great time , check in was very smooth great communication. Everything is conveniently close restaurants ,malls and the beach. Loved Anna and Bertus’s place .I highly recommend it ....

a lovely stylish little place.
our second time staying there, will definitely book it again.

Superb place! We will be back.
Loved the central location, and a mere step out of the hustle makes its perfect.
Great home, kids loved the space and we loved the comfort.

This was a great place for our first stop with three young children - despite it being beautiful it was also very comfy and functional as a home for us all. the location was good to reach most of the best central beaches, grab a good coffee and get into the city and markets. We did drive most places as have a 1, 3 and just turned 6 year old, but it would have been close walking distance to places too. Hazel welcomed us at the house and despite load shedding it was absolutely fine and the house was well equipped to deal with that and for us a family in general. Thanks for having us!

This is a great place to stay! We were able to get to Waterfront easily, as well as other attractions— we caught tour bus for winery and down to ocean for kayaking with no problem… the only issue I would say is we had a 90 year old traveling with us…. All the bedrooms and bathrooms were on second floor…. It may have said it on description and I missed it, not sure… the rest of us had no issue with stairs…. Great location, would totally recommend. 😊

Lovely home in a great part of Cape Town. Only things to be aware of are stairs and uneven floor boards, whilst fine for us, may not be suitable for everyone. Nice outdoor space, lovely neighbourhood and the hosts were super helpful with whatever we needed

We loved our stay at this beautiful home! Communication with the hosts before and during our stay was great, and they were really flexible regarding the check-in time (we arrived a little early) and allowed us to leave our bags at their office after we checked out. The house itself is lovely and super comfy. I also really appreciated that they already had adapters plugged in, we brought our own but this was convenient. Beds were SO comfortable! Oh and wifi during load shedding was great as well! Would come back here anytime.

We had a woderfull stay ! The location is perfect to enjoy Cape Town , Water front , great park , the sea ... all is very close to the house. The street is very quiet , kids was playing outside and enjoyed it. The house by itself is very nice , very confortable with great beds. For sure next time we will come to cape Town we will stay there.
The house is absolutely fantastic and in a great location! It had everything we needed with really charming deco. We would love to come back 😊

We had a lovely time staying at this beautifully decorated terrace house.Great area in a quiet street so close to a strip of great restaurants and Greenpoint park.The waterfront is a short drive away.
Very well equipped kitchen.
The only comment to make is that it was deceptive regarding air conditioning. It was very hot over New year and only the master bedroom had aircon.
It was terribly hot in the other two bedrooms despite fans which was very unpleasant at night.
Excellent communication with a super host.Thank you.

We’ve stayed in a fair few Green Point airbnbs over the years. It’s always our favourite area to stay in Cape Town, having so many great restaurants and amenities nearby and bring drivable to all key areas as well as quiet and safe. This property may have stolen the crown as our favourite, it’s just stunning! Can’t fault it and we’re already looking at bringing our family out for a trip in a years time.

The team were great, professional and responsive. check in was easy and welcoming. The home was wonderful and cozy, we felt right at home as we entered the beautiful space. Perfect for a family, has everything you need and felt very private and secure.
We will definitely be back.
Thank you Bertus and team

Bertus’ place is incredible.
Communicated throughout.
The location is great. And it is great value for money.
Yeah, book it if you can.

Lovely place to stay when visiting Cape Town. Looks exactly like the photo’s and exceeded our expectations! Host is quick to respond very accommodating. Felt right at home from arrival. Will definitely recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay in Cape Town, whether for a weekend or longer stay.

The house is a beautiful old lady full of charme. Cozy and warm atmosphere. Well equipped.
Would need a little better maintenance and cleaning to be perfect but definitely a fantastic accomodation that I would recommend. The location is also very good. Easy parking in the steet in front of the house. Thank you Bertus!
The place was neat, comfortable and quiet. We were able to walk around the neighborhood and had a run by the beach. It was a great stay.

Kevin is a great host, very accommodating, waited for us as our flight was delayed, welcomed us warmly to the Mother city as he handed over his cosy, clean and well kept property.
The property had everything that my family could possibly need, located in a quiet safe area, walking distance to the beach, shops and laundromat.
The property is ideal for a family, we had a pleasant stay, felt like a home away from home and will be number one on our list next time we visit Cape Town.

Awesome place to explore Cape Town
Nice and neat and cookware was good quality
Fridge was nice and big which is a bonus
Friendly reception and all very well worth it
Bedding clean and immaculate
Washing machine would be nice but i understand the reasons for not having one .... laundramat is very close
Thanks for a wonderful stay
Bernice was a friendly and responsive host. The place is in a safe quiet neighborhood and met all our expectations. Would definitely reboook here

This is a great b&b opened by its fascinated hosts, Tian & Lowee. Being a genuine world traveler, Tian has obviously put a lot of thoughts and passion into this place. The beautiful house is located at the mid campus of the university of Cape Town, the neighborhood is thus very safe and convenient. The rooms are clean and quite spacious, most them have private bathrooms. Understanding the need of people on the road, Tian has tried to meet the preference of individual travelers, from the diversified breakfast to addressing our different living habits. As someone from the local community, Lowee was also a great source for us to understand the country and culture. Their suggestions on sightseeing and how to get around the city have made our stay so interesting and perfect. This is definitely my choice of stay for my next visit to Cape Town and I would recommend it to all travelers, rookies or experienced.
Tian’s house is wonderful. Vibey little place with lovely people passing through. Tian clearly attracts good energies into his life.
The is a perfect location for lock up and go.. WIFI and netflix and a comfortable bed.. 1min walk to the beach which is more than i needed.. Great option
Great host and great location.  centrally located to all things Capetown and cape peninsula.  Beaches are great and town has great vibes.
This is a wonderful apartment in a great location, close to the CTICC, banking district and the Waterfront. Place is refurbished and in great condition.

Dylan´s place is at an amazing location, walking distance from the city center. Also, it is really close to public transport stations. It it a little unsafe in the night, considering homeless people around.
The place itself has good accomodation, an fits as well for a short stay.

We had a wonderful stay at the apartment! The location was close enough to walk to the V & A Waterfront and Long Street. The apartment is fully stocked and we were even greeted with a welcome basket. The only note I have: Be aware that there is no AC. The weather was very hot while we were there making it a little hard to sleep.
We loved our stay and recommend the apartment.
The flat was dirty, sheets had stains and the towels were very smelly. The area is very noisy as well

Clean & comfortable and everything in perfect condition. Very small but sufficient. Earl was helpful & responsive. Streets around dimly lit but plenty of security. I was comfortable & would stay there again.

Love loved my stay there . Nicole is such an awesome host and she is very inviting . The location is perfect it’s close to everything that you need
Thank you so much Nicole x
We have stayed in Kalk Bay previously but this place is outstanding. The views and location must be one of the best in Kalk Bay. Would definitely look to stay again if visiting the area.
Fantastic apartment in a brilliant location. Had everything needed. Really secure with excellent staff. Will definitely recommend and cant wait to go back.

Nice location and amazing comfortable house. Host welcomed us with timed information and support to reach the house. We really enjoyed this place and we highly recommend it for a break away from the city!!

Peter and Leigh’s apartment is unusually large with a superb position, just across from the railway line overlooking the Fish Hoek beach. Both the gate to the garage area as well as the garage door itself are easily operated with a remote control.
The security measures are adequate and we felt very secure.
Access to the second floor apartment is by stairs. The view from the large windows of the lounge and the main bedroom are however worth the effort of climbing the stairs!
The extra large double bed in the main bedroom was a real treat!
We will be back!!

Good place to stay. Hospitality was good. He arranged hand made olive pickle for us. He guided us for our short visit to nearby locations. Beach view common room and bedroom. Very calm and quiet place. Had a touch of artistic mind everywhere.

What a perfect gem with a beautiful view of False Bay and the kindest, most considerate host ever, Peter! The flat is sparkly clean and comfy, with everything you need and more, stone's throw from the beach and he goes way beyond the call of duty, with excellent communication. We had the loveliest weekend for my sister's wedding, and hope to be back soonest. Thanks for the memories, Peter and Leigh!

The view from this flat is picturesque and breathtaking.
The host is both accommodating and hospitable; and the building is quite and serene.
We'll definitely remember this place when we need a break.

Beautiful Tranquil Amazing.
We went down as a family of 5, and this unit was well equipped and big enough for all of us. It was a quick walk to the beach, close to the shops and all verbose to beautiful kalk Bay and Muizenberg. We will most definitely be back. Loved every minute of our stay.

Value for money. Super neat and spacious
Peter and Leigh really helpfull.
Highly recommend
Beautifull view. Lovely comfy beds. There is no TV, which is not a problem but i might have missed the notice.High speed wifi a bonus. Very nice restaurants and playpark in walking distance.

This is a great place to stay in Fish Hoek. The apartment is spacious and clean. The location is great. Convenient to shops, restaurants, and right next to the beach. We would definitely stay here again.

Location, location, location! homely apartment with stunning views of fishhoek beach. Right across the road from the beach. secure parking in garage. Peter great with communication and welcoming us. Would definitely stay again.

lovely selection of books to read
beautiful view of the beach, walked & swam
very central
the flat was light, bright & sunny and relaxing stay. very spacious! very nice to park our car in the garage.

Very nice host that we could call and ask anything. The place is right on the beach and right next to a shopping mall so very convenient. 2 separate rooms for us and the kids. Overall nice place. Recommended

Peter and Leigh are fantastic hosts - always responsive and proactive (they earned us in advance of the cycle race that would impact us getting there on our arrival date).
Their place is lovely and clean and a special touch is the cleaned windows to appreciate the fabulous view.

My stay was amazing and will definitely recommend to friends and family. I loved to view from both the living room and bedroom windows. The peacefulness was great and calming. The fact that there was no TV had me and my kids playing games and just chill together. My husband is already thinking of booking again

great location- just a 3min walk to the sea, great panoramic view of the beach, safe area, good located for daily trips.
Apartment is well equipped with everything you need (and more -thanks for the south african delicasies) , nice and cozy decorated. We enjoyed a few days of our holidays with our two kids (2,4).
thanks for everything!

The home is sparkling clean with a tight security.It is located in a beautifull quiet place and is close to all ameneties -airport,malls,table mountain etc
Deborah was very welcoming and responds to questions immediately.
Thanks Deborah for making our CT vacation a good and memoriable one😙

We had a perfect stay at Deborah’s place.
The house has everything you can expect. We were four adults and we had a lot of space.
The location is very safe, with an alarm and garage.
Very close to the airport and close to the city and the peninsula.
But most of all, we loved the warm hospitality of Deborah.

Deborah was available to assist at all times and also gave us tips on the best places to go around Cape Town. The house was exactly as photographed and felt like a home and very safe.
We look forward to coming back.

We had an absolutely enjoyable stay in a lovely home in a quiet suburb, and very centrally located.  Deborah is such an attentive host. I do recommend this listing for those looking for a place to stay in Cape Town!

Great place to relax, beautiful surroundings in a peaceful setting. Place is wonderfully furnished and everything that’s needed for a comfortable stay . Debbie is a great host, would definitely recommend and would love to stay here again.

Deborah is a fantastic host, we felt right at home. This was our home away from home!!!
We will definitely be back, the neighborhood is super safe and there is so much to do close by!
Make sure to ask Deborah about the bakery nearby, it's worth the visit!!!
We enjoyed our two week stay. The home is very spacious and clean. We felt safe and right at home. Deborah responds quickly. I’d definitely recommend her home.
Nicki’s place was absolutely stunning. We were met and welcomed by Candice who was so friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend this accommodation to other travelers.
Wonderful stay in this beautiful home, thank you! Everything worked perfectly and the apartment is in a great location for reaching both the city and surrounds!

Wow what a beautiful place to stay! We honestly could not recommend Nicki’s place enough - from the modern and very stylish accommodation, thoughtful touches throughout the house, fantastic location 5 minute from great shops and about 10-20 minutes from main tourist attractions to amazing communication and flexible and smooth check in.  We felt at home from the minute we walked in the door! Also a huge thank you to Valentine for looking after us and her cleaning services and we miss seeing your friendly face every morning!

I visited Cape Town with my partner and our 15 months daughter. This place was just perfect and had everything we needed. The host welcomed us with some treats which was very thoughtful. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Cape town

Nicki’s place is stunning. Photos are a poor reflection- the space is far more spacious, sophisticated and comfortable. We had everything we could possibly need, and more. My kids loved it too. Candice was amazing throughout - so generous with her warmth, kindness and information. This is a place that I would feel privileged to return to.

We hast a wonderful time. The house was fantastic. Very quiet, with a great garden and outdoor kitchen. We felt very comfortable and would like to come back! Thanks a lot for all the activity and restaurant recommendations!

I am absolutely in love with this property and also appreciate a great hospitality. Firstly, the place has stunning decor and an amazing views. The property is based in a safe area and has a lot of security options to feel extra safe. Secondly, the hospitality is spot on, with daily housekeeping, wood for bbq and welcome coffees. Thirdly, the wifi is perfect and I never had any issues with the internet access which is great for the remote working. I highly recommend staying here!

We loved staying at the house, great spaces, views, staff. It was perfect fpr our needs. I would strongly reccommend this property to anyone going to Cape Town. The space was so comfortable that we often stayed in and prepared dinner rather than going our for dinner. The kids had lots of fun un the pool. A perfect stay. We will definiteòy go back.

A beautifully styled home! John made our stay really pleasant. We noticed the bbq didn’t work 100% and there was a brand new one installed the same day! Perfect service and would definitely recommend this place.
Very nice villa with beautiful sea views, especially from the first floor! Tasteful interior and decor. John the housekeeper was super nice, played with our little one and kept everything in order.
Excellent stay in a beautiful and convenient location. Loved that bootleggers was so close by for a coffee or breakfast in the mornings. I would highly recommend staying here.

Great place! Would recommend and would stay again. The back up solar was a life saver! Every thing was nice and clean. Well equipped place. John the housekeeper is amazing and so helpful. Easy check in and check out. Very secure!

Elijah was very responsive, friendly and polite. John - looking after the house was wonderful. The place is immaculate and John was always available but unobtrusive. Hugely recommend this as a place in the Camps Bay - Bakoven area. Esta-Marita and her team are world class. Thank you all.
Exceptional house and host. I will definitely recommend it to everyone and I would rent it again if I ever come back.

It is a beautiful place, extremely thoughtful design.
We enjoyed our stay. John is exceptionally good.
Worth trying.
The pictures don’t do this place justice! It’s absolutely gorgeous and perfect for large groups. Our backup power went out but the property managers and host were helpful and responsive.

This house is just plain wonderful. A lot of space for family and friends, very kid friendly (in many details), wonderful views towards the mountain but also the sea: everything you need for a wonderful stay close to the beach. Many things are just a walk away: beach, restaurants, playgrounds. We also felt very safe and Antje, the host is very fast in responding, helpful and super friendly. We will hopefully be back soon.

Barefoot luxury! Gorgeous Airbnb in a very laid back area. Close to the beach, and beautiful restaurants for dining under the stars. A great escape for a family holiday. Our 2 boys particularly loved the pool which was a perfect temperature for little swimmers, and me! The house was well equipped and more spacious than expected. Communication with Antje was very pleasant and easy. Thank you for an amazing stay!

This house is amazing! It was so comfortable to stay in and the views are amazing. The solar-heated pool was brilliant as well. The only problem was that we couldn't stay longer as we had to fly home! Antje was a brilliant and attentive host as well.

Very nice accommodation and a great location with fantastic views.
Elise was a super host.

An amazing experience staying at this lovely stylish accomdation. Great communication from the hosts and we felt very safe due to the security systems in place. We really enjoyed spending time at the beautiful garden and pool. There were some lovely touches that we hadn’t expected such as milk and toiletries available for our use. These hosts definitely went the extra mile and we would return anytime!

Sally’s Airbnb is extremely comfortable, with a big bed and all the amenities one could wish for. Sally and Doug are friendly hosts, communicating when necessary but also giving guests their own space. We have no hesitation in recommending their airbnb.

Went to Sally’s place as a little getaway from chilly Italy and it was the perfect mix between sunshine and comfort. Sally and Doug are friendly and their place impeccable. Would definitely recommend to someone looking for a relaxing stay.

Sally and Doug are so warm and welcoming. Their home is beautiful, spotlessly clean and the attention to detail flawless.
Conveniently located, close to varsity, shops and restaurants, one couldn’t ask for more. I definitely recommend this gem and I’d go back any day.

I had wonderful 3 night stay. The flat is spotless, in a quiet neighbourhood with easy access to N1 and N2. Sally and Doug were great hosts and were easy to get in touch with. The bed is super comfy! And the pool is a definite plus. Will stay again any time.

Absolutely love staying with Sally and Doug. The space is so comfortable, I have everything I need and the whole process is just very easy and perfect for my demanding work travels.
Will always be my number one choice!

Lovely, well appointed and peaceful.
Very conveniently located as well. Sally is the perfect host, very accommodating and communicates well.
Thanks again Sally and Doug!

WOW, WOW, WOW, what an awesome gem. This property is centrally located, 20 minutes in any direction and you are at a major attraction. The view from the room is fabulous, views of the mountain are simply stunning.  The room was very well appointed, both room and bathroom were huge. Great facilities to make tea and coffee. There was a fridge and microwave if you wanted to buy and heat your own food. Sal and Doug were great hosts, very welcoming and friendly.

We had a lovely stay with Doug and Sally in their spacious accommodation. The bedroom and bathroom are large with great view of a private, beautiful garden. Peaceful surroundings and our hosts were very responsive to any and all questions and made us feel at home. Highly recommended for a complete package.
Many thanks,
Janette and Vince miller

Doug and Sally were great! Very responsive and patient. The home is gorgeous and private. Would make sure to thoroughly read instructions about alarm system when checking in and out to avoid setting off security alert like I did 🙃 . Would highly recommend their place if you're looking to stay close enough to city to commute back and forth to Capetown!
Lovely property and host. We felt right and home and really enjoyed our stay. Highly recommend✨

We had a lovely stay in Sally’s guest suite. It was spacious and clean, with a wonderful bathroom and comfortable bed. We also enjoyed walking to the nearby park in the mornings for coffee and tea. Will definitely stay again in future visits to Cape Town!

We were made to feel right at home!  The room was lovely and spacious.  We slept very comfortably.  The home is conveniently located to many shopping areas and other attractions.  We would definitely stay there in the future!

Sally and Doug are awesome people, really caring and helpful not many like this left in the world. Bnb was exceptional, clean , peaceful and well appointed. We spent just over two weeks there and were sad to leave, just felt like home. We will be recommending it to our family and friends  and will definitely return. Thanks so much Doug and Sal.

Fabulous second stay at Sally and Doug. Extremely comfortable bed, clean and very well located between Atlantic Seaboard and Southern Suburbs. The flat had all the little things one needs like a hair dryer, microwave, etc.
Sally put fresh milk and ground coffee in the fridge which was such a lovely touch and really helpful for a whirlwind visit.
Will definitely be back!
Sally is the kindest, most welcoming host! She was incredibly helpful with last-minute arrangements, and I would definitely stay at this Airbnb again!

The unit is really well presented as per the images. The family is very polite and helpful.
I was comfortable and felt cozy and still elegant accommodation. I can’t fault anything.

Five star accommodation! In fact , we have booked our next stay . The place was immaculate with beautiful views. The hosts, Doug and Sally were incredibly welcoming, responsive and went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed. We highly recommend this air bnb, a pleasure to stay there!

Staying at Gail's place was the perfect place to end up our trip. It has a great location between beautiful vineyards and wineries. Gail and her family were very nice and gave us numerous helpful recommendations for things to see and places to eat. The apartment is clean and has all we needed. Highly recommended.

I only met Gail briefly.She was very accommodating and willing to help if we needed anything. The place is clean in a quiet neighbourhood and very accessible. All shops and amenities are in a +- 3km radius which was really convenient
A charming cottage beautifully decorated. Very friendly hosts. The area is peaceful and scenic & close to places of interest. I have no hesitation in recommending it.

Gail is an amazing host and very thoughtful.
I was travelling alone and Gail invited me to join her and her super friendly family to a Friday night food market.
The cottage was clean, airy and very tastefully furnished.
The garden outside the cottage added to the overall ambiance.
Gail also gave me lots of tips on things to do in the area. Just a pity I wasn’t there long enough.
I would be happy to return.
A wonderful place to stay. You feel welcome. Definitely a place to stay at. Well situated. I would definitely return.

We had a fantastic stay with Gail. The cottage was self contained, spacious and private. We loved the garden surroundings and the regular visits from the sweet dogs, cats - and rabbit! Gail and Roy made us so welcome and we feel we made new friends.
It was everything and more than we’d hoped for and we hope to return one day.

Gail's place is in a perfect location, quiet and safe, tucked away in leafy Constantia. The cottage is self contained with its own access and has everything you need, including a bbq on the patio with access out to a lovely garden and pool and views over to table mountain national park. Plenty of space inside to relax and work if you need to with good wifi. Gail and Roy are wonderful hosts, who made us feel really welcome and were very accommodating with our uncertain departure date during Covid. We can't wait to return!

Gail’s accommodation is incredible in every way. The home is spacious and has a beautiful large back yard with friendly animals. We were able to walk to a couple wine estates. The kitchen is well equipped for all cooking needs. We would love to stay again!
Gail has a caring warmth that puts you at ease the moment you meet her.Her beautiful home nestled amongst breathtaking fauna, is the perfect getaway for any occasion!!II will  be back for sure!!!

This was my second stay at Gail's - I just love it: a beautiful cottage surrounded by greenery, beautiful trees, well-kept garden and a lovely terrace.
It is quiet, safe, well equipped and very comfortable.
There is also internet and light during load shedding, it is very helpful.
Gail is a wonderful host: communicative, very friendly and supportive, warm and a pleasure to chat with.
Thank you so much, Gail, for creating such a beautiful space where I could feel at home.
I will come back again.

We had a fabulous stay at Gail's place. The cottage was beautifully decorated, comfortable, and very clean. The property was located in a very secure neighborhood and near picturesque vineyards with walking trails. It was convenient to Constantia village and High Constantia Shopping Centre for restaurants and all your shopping needs. Gail and her husband were so welcoming and made sure our stay was the best it could be. I really enjoyed getting to know them and will absolutely stay here again.

Gail and Roy were extremely friendly and helpful, checking everything was ok. Their dogs were lovely and we loved their visits.
The cottage was lovely and setting was lovely with our own private garden area, subbed and a lovely patio area
Would definitely recommend it and will will certainly book again
The position is perfect for the shops, restaurants and a pub, lovely walks and plenty of wineries very near

Gail and Roy were fantastic hosts very accommodating in check in and out
Location perfect
Animals friendly
Would highly recommend this AB&B

Although a short stay, it was a lovely one! Eileen's place is kitted out with everything you may need for any stay, from details in the bathroom to a fully functioning kitchen! You couldn't wish for a better location, we would happily stay there again upon our next visit! Thanks Eileen!

Eileens house was spacious and comfortable, with lively views across the valley and fowb to the sea. Its a well appointed spartnent with everything we needed. The 2 outdoor areas give shrkter ftom sun or wind, and it wad handy to have the car off the road. It is a lovely peaceful and friendly neighbourhood, very easy to walk to shops and beach. We eould love to come again!
Great value and location to go with a very friendly host. Would be happy to stay at Avril’s place when I visit Cape Town again.

Avril's place was perfectly situated in Sea Point with lots to see and do in close walking distance. The building itself is central but quiet and very comfortable. Avril was very friendly and responsive. We would definitely stay again.

Great location within walking distance of the ocean and every amenity one could need! Avril and her young son were great hosts and they even have uncapped wifi (which is rare in SA AirBnB). Nice modern building in great neighborhood!

Perfect location
Neat and tidy.
Can smell the ocean from bed.
Avril loves a good chat.
Try for yourself and see
