This was the second time we stayed with Avril and because of the perfect lokation and her great hospitality we chose her plase again.

Avril's place is cozy and pleasant.  it is very close to Sea Point, bus stops, the beach, tour buses and easy to drive to.  safe parking on the street was good and Avril and her son, were great to visit with.  A great place to stay for my first might in CPT.  Avril was great at directions and answering questions about the area, attractions etc. Highly recommend staying with Avril!
The place it's very well located, safe and amazing area. Avril's hospitality was outstanding and I felt very comfortable.

Perfect location, great value for money and super hospitality. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay with Avril and her cool kid! The bedroom is clean, the bed awesome but most of all, the location is really unbeatable: right between the Atlantic seaboard and the city bowl  - minutes away from the promenade. Thanks Avril, all the quick chats and laughs made our stay extra special! See you soon!
Avril is welcoming and good with people. she shared her space with us and we really appreciated that.

I had a best time at Avril's place, it was as though I'm home alone - a perfect getaway just what I needed. It's a quite peaceful home. It was so nice day I could safely walk to the stadium for the SCTM Race😂😘, and I could get meals from the restaurants nearby. Wanna get away- try this place!!!

Staying with Avril and Pierre was a lot of fun and it was so convenient - walking distance from everything in Sea Point. The road is also quiet enough that I was able to sleep really well. She went out of her way to make the check in and check out as hassle free as possible. A real no stress “at home” feeling. I will definitely be back.

Avril welcomed us kindly - and showed flexibility for our stay -
I recommend her.
Thank you again
Amandine and Tim

Avril is accommodating and welcoming. Her place is well located, and comfortable for a single person. Travels should be aware that the space is relatively small and they should be prepared to share it with a (lovely!) family.

Was really great to stay at this place. The apartment ia very central and has an amazing view over lion's head and table mountain. The view from the swimming pool was adorable! Avril was a very nice host and helpful. We've got a great a very support everytime when needed and at the the same time enjoyed a privacy. Thanks a lot for everything!

This flat was perfect for my fiancé and I. In a great location (walking distance to restaurants, coffee (truth coffee is across the street) shops and a mall). We loved having the rooftop pool and gym. The pool isn’t totally full right now and a bit murky due to the water shortage in Cape Town but that didn’t stop us and others from using it. Avril (Airbnb contact) was great - she always responded very promptly and had some great recommendations. This place was overall great value and would recommend to any of my friends! Thanks Avril
Loved our stay here, great apartment with a lovely pool with views of the whole of CT and Table mountain. Location was great as well and could easily get from place to place.
Avril was a wonderful host. The appartement is perfect for a couple of days in cape town.
Avril was a great hostess! She was very interactive and attentive to us. It is also in a safe great location which made getting around in the city very easy.

You will be amazed at the view; you are a block away from Truth coffee, rated best in the world, a must see for even those who don’t like coffee. Cozy, check out the rooftop view, a great place to stay in Cape Town proper.

Apartment was exactly what we expected, so we loved it. It was a bit hard to find because our gps sent us to a different location in another area when we came from the airport, so just be cautious that you are going to the right location. Having to go downstairs to get from the parking spot to the correct floor for the apartment was a pain to remember but we got used to it. I wish there had been some local tips or activities/restaurant suggestions from the owner that other Airbnb’s I have visited have had in the past because I’ve found those super helpful. But other than that, it was exactly what was expected and had an amazing view of table mountain! Great value!
The best in city living with a view unmatched! The hospitality was spectacular and it truly felt like my place for the weekend. I’m most definitely coming back!
This was a wonderful space in Cape Town, with beautiful views of the mountain. It was easy to find and we were met in person. Great access to Cape Town and a highly recommended spot.

Lovely stay in Cape Town! Avril was a brilliant host although we never met her in person - she made the check in and out process super easy and had great local suggestions. Like most of down town Cape Town, we didn't feel particularly safe at night time, you just had to be very prudent about safety. Truth coffee is only across the road and is just about the best coffee we have ever had. The apt doesn't have AC and was really warm on entering, but with the apt being on the 14th floor, there is a great breeze and handy fan. The roof top gym was very basic.

We had such a wonderful stay at this air bnb. I‘ve never met such a nice host and besides all the tips she gave to us we felt super comfortable with her! The apartment was clean and the view was just amazing! Thank you!
Spectacular....Loved everything about it.....I definitely will be back...Avril was very kind, informative and on par with everything....

The location is amazing. Close to everything. If you’re driving they have a secured parking garage that’s comes very handy. The views from the window are awesome. The place itself is big enough for two people and the communication/suggestions by the host were great! Overall this is a perfect place to stay if you’re ever in Cape Town.

Great location, in a center place with many bars and close turistic areas. The apartment has a amazing views of Table MOuntain and at night of the lighting city.
Avril was pending of us and resolve one problem fast.
We will repeat if we come back again to Cape Town.
Had a great stay in the flat. The view is fantastic, just like the pool on the roof! Thank you for letting us stay😊
This place is amazing! Very central, the apartment is clean and stylish and the views are breathtaking! Avril is friendly and caring. Had a wonderful time in Cape Town!

Avril was very accomadating with a later check in when our flights were delayed.
Place was accurately portrayed and a pleasure to stay in. Right in the heart of the city with a beautiful view of the mountain

You will be so luck to have the opportunity to have a stay here! The professionalism, assistance and guidance made to ensure you feel welcome and comfortable is remarkable. The host and the team were both so friendly and were excellent with communications. Its a gem of a place! Safe, secure, clean, convenient and views that are out of this world. I highly recommend it!
Louis & Avril were wonderful hosts. The apartment is well located, comfortable, and has an amazing view of Table Mountain. I will definitely book here again.
Enjoyed my stay. Check-in was easy, and excellent communication from the host, Avril. Thank you!

We enjoyed our four month stay very much. Have felt safe and right at home right in the center of beautiful Cape Town. Excellent and helpful communication and straightforward check in. Avril is super nice and very helpful. She showed us the neighborhood, grocery stores and even how to get to our job. Perfect parking situation in the same building. All in all we are very happy that we found this apartment and recommend it without hesitation.

We had a really lovely stay, and was ideal for what we needed. It’s close to a lot of things and there are Ubers always within a few minutes (and much cheaper than Ubers in London for example), so very easy to get around quite quickly. One thing worth mentioning is that the flat can get very hot in the summer months especially. There is a fan which is great, but no A/C. Thanks again, we had a wonderful stay

The apartment is as advertised--very light, and more than spacious for me as a single traveler. A couple would like it also very much. Fully equipped kitchen, the bed is fantastic, bathroom very nice! The location is splendid, close to basically everything. If you have a car, you can park it next door in the parking garage. Very safe. Btw, if you stay in Cape Town only, you do not really need a car.
Katia is a terrific host. I made my reservation at the last minute, and she could accommodate me, and show the things I needed to know. She even left a bottle of wine! If that is not welcoming, what is? Absolute recommendation!

Peters place is cozy and inclusive space with everything you need for your comfort and enjoyment , in addition to a host that goes our of his way to meet your needs..  The wifi is great and unrestricted and free, in addition to DSTV.. It goes without saying that you will not be disappointed with your stay at Peter's place
I found Peter house very clean and spacious. My sisters and I felt very welcomed by our host. His dogs are just so cute and very friendly.

Well appointed and adequately equipped. Perfect for our needs.
Peter was an excellant and friendly host.thank you.

Enjoyed the stay at Peter's place. It is neat and clean with lots of space and Peter is a nice host. Even for a business trip, the desk is big enough for laptop and printer. It is value for money. The location is perfect when you busy in the south of Cape Town. It is close to everything, shops, malls, industrial areas like Diep River and Retreat, also close to the . Matter of a 10 min drive.
Comfortable space with all necessary amenities. Nice to have secure parking. Very clean place, and Peter was a welcoming host who was a good communicator.

We booked one night for an event nearby so we didn't stay for long but everything from start to finish was perfect! The flat had everything we needed, the beds were super comfy and Peter made sure we were settled! The dogs made our stay extra happy, so sweet and friendly. Flat is really close to some beautiful constantia wine farms and a lovely place for breakfast across the road. Thanks for having us we will he sure to book again 🙏🏼
i had a pleasant stay at Peters flat. he has 2 very friendly dogs and there is a good restourant right across the street.

Had great time staying at Peter's place. Peter was a great host! Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating to my needs/requests.
The place was clean with all essentials in order. Definitely recommend the place if you are planning a trip to Constantia/Tokai area.
Unexpected rules made it very uncomfortable to live here. Host wanted to know where we were all the time and didn't want us to come and go at our own discretion.
We enjoyed our stay at Peter's place. It was what we required,  peaceful and close to everything that we wanted to do for the weekend. It is also in an area that we preferred.

We had a wonderful family holiday traveling with our 10-month old baby Zadie. The location is outstanding and it felt like the beach was our back garden. The house is very spacious and comfortable and was equipped with everything we needed and more. Carol and Seamus were charming hosts and went out of their way to make sure we felt comfortable. Thank you for everything, we hope to return!

We appreciated the most lovely hosts and their stunning hospitality (incl. bread, butter, jam, milk, coffee & tea), the beautiful beach and the nice surroundings. Perfect place to stay at for a family.
I hope we can come back some day.

I would definitely recommend Carols St James cottage to anyone visiting Cape Town, the location is perfect with Kalk bay around the corner and a road crossing to the beach. The cottage is everything expected for a beach cottage, rustic with lots of charm, there is also enough space for the whole family and kiddies. Carol is an exceptional host and went the extra mile to make our stay better than imagined. I would definitely return.

Our stay at the St. James cottage was beyond wonderful - Carol & Seamus are fantastic, lovely and attentive hosts and offer such a cosy place in great location (just across the street is the ocean and a very family friendly café). We were welcomed with a fire-baked Malva pudding (delicious!!) and got to taste one of Seamus amazing lamb dishes (also made in the fire).
Beda are cosy, the kitchen is very well-equipped and it’s very spacious. We recommend this place by heart! Thank you and all the best!!
The little house was a short walk from the busier part of town. Extremely pleasant stay, Carol made sure we felt safe and at home.
Great hosts, very helpful and generous. It's a comfortable place for a family - especially with small kids. It's a pleasant walk from here to Kalk Bay or Muizenburg.

We had such a wonderful stay at Carols and Seamus Place-they are just lovely people. So friendly and welcoming! They even bought us coffee, tea, bread and fruits and also made for us the special Malva cake🤩 we felt like home and would come back any time again!!!
Lovely location right across the tidal pool. Short walk to shops and restaurants. The place had everything we needed and Carol and Seamus were lovely!

Carol’s place in St. James was perfect for our family holiday. We had two infants with us, and Carol provided everything we needed for them. What a pleasure! Everything we wanted to do was within easy walking distance - Folk Cafe across the street; the beach; Kalk Bay a short walk away. Carol and Seamus are wonderful, welcoming, practical hosts. And Seamus makes the best Malva Pudding we’ve ever tasted!
We just felt at home from the start and what made it for my wife was the fresh bread from Olimpia and good coffee at our arrival! Will definitely come again!
Carol und Seamus were two lovely hosts, always proactive with many surprises (a tent for the kids, cake surprise, etc.). They supported us in every topic we had. We always felt safe and home.

Excellent stay - a wonderful, quirky and clean historic cottage in a great location. There were toys and books for our toddler, some lovely extras and ample space for a large family. Busy road right outside the secluded gate, but straight into beach walks, tidal pools and some lovely cafes. Would happily return. Thanks!

Carol was a gracious and kind host. Our Clothes to Good (CTG) team felt welcomed and comfortable at the cottage. Outstanding location and very accessible.
Thank you Carol. We will use this cottage again in future visits to Cape Town.
Kind regards
Jesse Naidoo
MD Clothes to Good
Carol and Seamus were great hosts, friendly and helpful, did so much to make us feel at home. Seamus's Malva pudding is amazing and will keep you full for days!

This unit is in central Fish Hoek and is well positioned if you are wishing to explore the southern peninsula. We recommend a fish and chips at Kalky's and a Friday night dinner at the Blue Bird Garage in Muizenberg.

Mark is en excellent host and very knowledgeable about the area. The room is in very good condition and there are plenty of extra's. What makes this place exceptional is Mark's attention for you and your experience. He even texted us while we were out on a trip to climb Lions Head to check if we made it safely to the top (and back). Truly making it a home away from home.

I had a wonderfull stay at Mark's place. Really clean and nice place and a very comfortable bed. Mark also has a lot of recommendations on where to go and what to do in Cape Town. That helped me out a lot!
Compact and efficient and a remarkable deal!  Mark is an excellent host.  This is a super find!

It's a good place for a good price a few steps from a beach and Table mountains to look at from each angle. You can even make simple meals on a two stove hub if you like. Mark provided it when I asked. Mark is very helpful and readily available with advice even regarding your next destination!
The space was stylishly decorated and sparkling clean, and Mark was quite helpful with information about the area and surrounding areas. I definitely recommend this space.
Second stay here. Just as good as last time. Mark is a thoughtful host and his place is clean and conveniently situated. Will be back next year.
Enjoyed my stay at Marks's cute little cottage, it has all you need for a short stay. Awesome shower and comfy bed. Safe parking and easy access.

Marks place is a Private Guest Suite with safe parking inside the property. The Room and Bathroom was  spotless clean. the bed was nice and comfy.  I stayed here for 9 Nights during my relocation to Cape town. Mark was the perfect Host. He recommended the Best food places to try out. He is always there if you need him, Very friendly Gentleman to chat to, Pet friendly. He even gave me a Gift for my new home. I will definitely recommended booking his place, I rate Mark's Place 10 out of 10! Location is excellent as the beach is Walking distance along with nearby shops & Restaurants. Excellent Value for money. Thank you Mark,  I Will definitely be Returning!
Great value for money. The room is comfortable and has everything you need. Mark was very helpful and accommodating.
Perfect fit for me. Private, neat, clean space. Secure and lovely area to sit outside. Shower is great and space is neat and clean and fresh. Mark is helpful with anything you might need

I had the most amazing stay at Mark's! He went above and beyond to ensure that I was comfortable throughout my stay. He even showed me around Fish Hoek and would offer helpful insights about places to visit as well as constantly checking on me if everything was fine.
The place was clean and well maintained and it's perfectly located close to taxis, the train, the beach as well as shops.
I highly recommend staying at Mark's to anyone looking for a place to stay in Cape town.
Thanks to Mark for his hospitality.

We just loved this flat. The views were incredible and it was so comfortable with all amenities and great coffee. We loved watching the kite surfers and had great food up the road at cafe orca. A great place to explore Cape Town from, amazingly comfy bed and we’d definitely come back!
This apartment is a real gem. Excellent down to the details - and a 5-star host. Thank you. We'll come again.
This was an amazing location, hosts were phenomenal. I highly recommend this  accommodation  and the hosts were fabulous

The best place to stay in Cape Town if looking for a place close to the beach, quite area, nice apartment with breath taking few at anytime of the day or night. Parking if you're driving. If taking Uber, very accurate location and super easy to get a taxi at anytime. 200% highly recommended!!!

The apartment is very nice with a stunning view!!
Host was available every time we contacted him.
Would recommend the apartment to anyone.
Stylish, modern place. Great views, and good value for money. Will definitely be back.
This apartment is great, the view, the amenities and the space is top quality. Was lovely to relax as it was very peaceful and the neighbours are friendly!
Words can’t describe what this apartment has to offer! It is my favorite place to stay with the most incredible views! I will be back again and again. Thank you!
This is a spectacular apartment, fitted with state of the art toys and beautiful features. You won't regret staying here!
Highly recommended place to stay! Stylish apartment, wonderful view! We will definitely be back. Thanks David, Marc and Luke!

This was an awesome place, the view, I fell in love with the place as soon as I walked in. Everything you will need they have, from board games to DSTV to Playstation to Netflix. Trust me, you won't be bored. And the place was sparkling clean, I loved everything about the place.
Excellent stay! Apartment was clean and suited all my needs. And the view is as amazing as promised!!! Definitely worth spending time there. Would recommend it to all.
Beautiful and comfy apartment with incredible views. You will love the ease of access to the beach and restaurants.
What a beautiful place! The hosts have a great eye for details. Would definitely visit this lovely spot again!

This is a fantastic little apartment that is beautifully decorated with modern appliances and finishes. The views are spectacular and the apartment is a stone throw from the beach. Wish I could have stayed longer.
A perfect home away from home! Enjoy our stay so much. The view was breathtaking and the apartment was a perfect distance from restaurants, the beach, shopping centers.

I booked the place for my clients and they loved the stay so much.
Thank you Marc and Luck for the great hospitality!

The apartment is EXPETIONAL! We enjoyed our stay so much, everything was perfect - from the interior, cleanliness and views. Absolutely stunned and would definitely come again and recommend it.
Thank you so much!

What an amazing stay. As soon as my partner and I walked in we gasped at the view of the sunset. Absolutely amazing. Bed was super comfortable and loved the style of the place. Thanks guys, will definitely come again

Beautiful apartment with the best views. Sunsets are the best and walks on the beach.
The apartment was extremely comfortable with the amazing amenities.
We loved it and would definitely recommend.

An absolute Gem!!! This unit is furnished beautifully and has everything you would possibly need during your stay. Located right by the beach you are spoilt with beautiful views
We loved our stay!

Thanks to Marc and Luke for a beautiful stay. The view is absolutely breathtaking and the area is walking distance to the beach. I love the furniture layout, it’s cosy but still feels like the premium experience that it is. As hosts, they were extremely accommodating of my last minute change request to extend my stay. I just couldn’t get enough of the view and wanted to relish in it for a little longer. I’ll definitely recommend and will be back soon!
Had an absolute pleasure of a time, loved the view, relaxing perfect getaway, definitely recommend for a peaceful, cozy quiet stay with everything you need like home away from home.
Marc's place is well appointed, well equipped with all one may need away from home, and has the most stunning sea views. It was a lovely stay.

This was one of the best places that we have stayed at, especially because of the uninterrupted sea view and the view of Table Mountain from both the lounge and the bedroom.
We were a walking distance from the beach and the interior of Marc’s place made us feel at home.
Everything was perfect!

Beautiful and spacious apartment with stunning views! The host was friendly and easy to communicate with. Close to the beach, restaurants, and shops. This was the perfect spot for my husband and I to stay while visiting family. Would book again!
Marcs  air bnb exceeded  expectations You couldn't fault the  views  and  beachside location The bed was extremely comfortable with high grade linen  & plenty of hot water in the bathroom

Amazing. The fact that under-cover,off street parking was available for our large SUV was a bonus-unlike other places in the area. The location was great-walking distance to lovely Restaurants, shops, myCity-bus and the Promenade. I can see myself living here for a month or two. We will be back.
The stay with Anna & Bertus was great. Location was perfect and the house looked just as it did on the pictures! Would definitely stay again.

The apartment is very clean and spacious, excepting for the 2nd bedroom, which is really only suitable for kids. We were two couples and found the second bedroom, which is at the back end of the apartment, far too small with an awkwardly placed double bunk-bed right against the wall due to the size of the room. The hosts were great and attentive and the apartment is centrally located in Sea Point. The area is noisy - especially the back room.
Hi guys. I hope you good. You need to change the address of your place that people can find it easily coz it was difficult to us to found it.
Lovely stay, perfect location, extremely friendly hosts. Everything I needed was there. Would strongly recommend!

We had a great stay here and the host was very flexible and accommodating.
Spacious clean apartment.
Very short walk to beach, excellent supermarkets and restaurants.
Well stocked kitchen.
Great views of sea and sunset.
Off street parking.
24hr security guard.
It is worth noting that the apartment is by a busy road junction which means the noise could be off putting, especially if travelling with children.

It was such convenient check in and check out, super clean apartment, helpful host, who allowed us to check in 3 hours earlier, great location and you feel like being home there! Me and my parents was glad to stay here!

The place is amazing! Location is perfect & the view is awesome. Bertus was very friendly and welcoming with cool local tips. The appartment is very nice, with everything you could need. Great parking sport which is necessary in CT. We will definitely be back!

Great location with wonderful views, clean and neat apartment, Host was very friendly and reliable, will book
again.

My family (2 Adults, 2 kids) stayed for 3 nights. Very close to the beach (although the nicer ones are slightly further away). Shops are close by, with lots of restaurants to choose from. Apartment was clean and functional. Amenities was sufficient to feel like a home. A bonus is the Queens Road stop for the Red & Blue line bus (City Sightseeing Tours) is LITERALLy just in front of the door.

We had a wonderful time here. It’s a perfect location, very close to the beach and so many nice restaurants nearby. The apartment was lovely, very spacious and great amenities. We’d definitely stay here when we’re back in Cape Town.

*Exceptional Stay!*
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Betrus' amazing property, and I couldn't be more impressed! The apartment was beautifully decorated, spotlessly clean, and perfectly located.
The amenities were top-notch, and the communication with the host was seamless. The neighborhood was vibrant and safe, with plenty of great restaurants and shops nearby.
I would highly recommend this property to anyone looking for a comfortable and relaxing stay. Five stars isn't enough - I'd give it ten stars if I could!
Thanks again, Betrus, for an unforgettable experience!

My partner and I stayed at Jana's place for 7 days. I must say, we were both impressed by the elegant interior, beautiful colors, sparkling clean, safe and secure. Transport was convenient because of a bus stop right across the building, 15min walk to the V&A mall and to the Queen's beach. We had a pleasant stay.

Lovely apartment, 10 mins walk from the waterfront which is a great place for tourists. The apartment has been refurbished and is very modern. Lots of nice touches and everything a tourist could want.
Great place and great location. 15 mins to Waterfront. Apartment is very clean and very modern.  Will definitely stay there again. Thanks Jana
Lovely apartment. Just like the pictures. Well located, the best area in Cape Town. Friendly and available host. Everything was amazing! Really used the washing machine, a plus!
Lovely stylish apartment, good location 10 minute walk from v&a waterfront, felt safe, good amenities, was spotless on arrival and 2 sets of towels were provided

Great hostess. Responds timeously to all messages.
A very neat and tidy apartment.

Jana’s apartment was exactly as described and pictured. She responds quickly to all queries and although she was not available the night we arrived to check us in, she connected us with her father, Philip, who greeted us at the door of the building as soon as arrived. The location although not super near any of the attractions was still convenient if using Uber to get around (and FYI Uber is super cheap, compared to prices in Canada). Also, our day tours picked us up at our location, not sure if that is the case for all Airbnb’s. I would highly recommend Jana’s flat!

A beautifully finished space in an amazing location with everything you need and more. We travelled with a small baby and found the separate bedroom space so helpful and quiet! Lovely views towards Signal Hill, Table Mountain and Green Point Stadium and right on the promenade by the sea. So easy to get out and walk or run along the seafront and near to Oranjezicht Market, the Waterfront and restaurants. Super helpful small touches (eg washing powder and olive oil) and a comfy couch! Thanks so much for a brilliant stay - wish we could have stayed longer!

Jana’s Airbnb is excellent. The flat was spotless, the interior and design were stylish and modern, and the location could not be better. It comfortably exceeded my expectations and I will definitely be back.

Tastefully decorated apartment with everything you need.  The coffee machine (and coffee pods) came in very handy for my early mornings!  the bed was very comfortable. Tv in the room was also nice while getting ready.  Check in and check out was easy.  Great location on the waterfront with easy access to various areas. I would definitely stay here again and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone.

The place is really nice, perfect located in capetown. We loved staying there, close to the ocean.
The appartment is modern and very clean. We would like to stay there again.

Our second time at Jana’s place and not disappointed, we love her place. It is really home away from home and the place is what you see on the pictures, she has such great style and only the best is in her unit.
She is really a super host !
Awesome for couples ❤️

What a gem! Exactly as seen on the pictures. The wifi worked great and the apartment was sparkling clean on arrival! The location is fabulous - walking distance to the Waterfront and right by the Promenade! Jana, the hostess, is very friendly and went out of her way to accommodate me. I will definitely be back!

We had a lovely comfortable stay! The location is perfect. Close to table mountain and just across from the lovely promenade. There are some excellent restaurants very near by too. There is really not a bad thing I can say about this listing!
I had a lovely stay at Jana’s! The flat is beautifully laid out and well equipped. The location is perfect as well.
An absolute gem. This place was breathtaking from the day we arrived till the day we left. Clean with everything one needs for a stay.
Lovely, clean, fab location. Jana was responsive to questions and flexible with dropping off my bags early. Thanks!

Such a lovely and comfortable stay. I would definitely go back! The location is perfect, the interior is clean and modern, the host is extremely helpful and friendly. You cannot get beter than this 🙌🏼

Wow wow wow!! My stay couldnt have been better! I am only disappointed that I cant give more than a 5 star rating! The place, just beautiful, and made me feel so at home and in another world too.
But the host, Jana, just awesome awesome, made everything so easy, quick and a pleasure every step of the way. I needed nothing at all, because I was given everything right off the bat.
I am definitely booking again soon!
Loved it!!

Jana gives you the best experience you might have in Airbnb! During my stay I couldn’t ask for more. Jana makes everything easy and smooth and feels like you are staying in your dearest friend house. Quick response and very helpful and informative. She even provided me with luggage service contact info to store my luggage for couple of hours after checking out. The location is amazing and the building is quite. Using the folder she provides on the coffee table, you will have the best places for coffee and food. Everything was clear that even we rarely needed to ask Jana about anything. Definitely I will stay here whenever I come to CT <3
BTW the place looks and feels nicer in reality than in pictures.
What a stunning place. Exactly as described. Such a pleasant and clean interior. A lovely host and a beautiful area with everything within walking distance

Fantastic location. Clean, lovely apartment with everything you need. Parking is super easy outside. Jana is an awesome host. I even received a video with instructions on how to open and close the fancy blinds :)
Highly recommend and I’ll definitely come back.

I’ve been to a lot of Airbnbs and Jana’s place was the most perfect. Everything about it was perfect, it’s peaceful, it’s beautiful and has everything you need inside. Jana has this nice suggestion booklet that was such an amazing touch. An instruction manual of all the great restaurants, places to visit and dos and don’ts when you’re out in the city.  We loved every minute of it!

Great host, great airbnb, great city! We would be glad to stay at Jana’s property again.
It was clean and spacious.

I had the pleasure of meeting Jana. She is so kind & so helpful. Always available if there was anything I needed.
The apartment is so beautiful, clean, tidy and everything is in the perfect place.
Being a women by myself, I felt extremely safe. I would 100% stay again. The location is perfect for me. In the middle I would say.
So thank you Jana.
We had a great time in Jana’s place. Was exactly the right size and in a great location within walking distance of all the main attractions. Was a great find. Thanks
I had a great stat at the apartment. The location was perfect 👌 close proximity to the stadium, the V&A Waterfront.
Had a great stay. Location was safe and close to waterfront and promenade. Great host. Will definitely be back.

Fantastic location: literally around the corner from a mall with a huge supermarket, a local bus stop, & the Hop On Hop Off tourist bus, and walking distance from the center. Communication was quick & clear.  There were a couple maintenance issues with the unit, but other than that it was clean, comfortable, & exactly what we were looking for.  Would stay here again :)
We really enjoyed our stay at Roland’s place! The apartment has a great view over the city and is very safe. It also has all the amenities you might need and the interior looks and smells nice ;).
An amazing apartment with easy access to shops and restaurants. The apartment is cosy with a beautiful interior. Will definitely be visiting again.

Pictures didn't do the space justice. It's a very quiet apartment block. Little add ons like salt, pepper. Simple shampoo etc. help. It felt like a home away from home. There's a fan heater that also allows for cool air and extra blankets should you need them. I didn't go out but it's really close to Gardens Shopping Centre and you have lots of options for food delivery. (We live in Table View. Not as many options here.) Worth another stay if needed.
Roland is a great host, and we had a fantastic time in his apartment. It was clean, convenient and exactly as advertised.
Great spot, we stayed for six weeks and felt very comfortable. Balcony is the best part! Roland was accommodating and quick to respond. Would recommend.
Beautifuly located near the center of Cape Town. Nice view to the Signal Hill and the Garden Center is 5 min by foot away. perfect.

We had a great stay at Roland's place! The flat was very well equiped, coffee, milk, hair dryer, even a looot of adapters for the socks! The balcony is awesome, larger than expected. Roland is a great host, gave us a lot of tips and the communication was extraordinary. Thanks again, Roland!
Very nice and kind host who provided helpful advice. Nice & clean apartment with beautiful view over Capetown and towards Signal Hill and even Lions Head!

We enjoyed our stay with our baby at Roland‘s place. Very good location to explore Cape Town with a nice view over Signal Hill and City. Roland is a great host who cares for his guests. We can recommend this accommodation. Thank you Roland!

Pro's: Espresso machine, location, safety. Amazing view during sunrise!!!
Con's: 5th floor but thats why you get the view, Wasmachine only washes with cold water.
Very nice location. Roland was very responsive at any time and for any queries we posed. The apartment is spacious and very safe. Loved staying there! Thank you, Roland!

This place became our home from home in Cape Town for a few days. Area feels quite safe and the Gardens Mall nearby is handy. Restaurants on Kloof Street are a very short drive away as is the lovely Greek place called Maria’s. The view from the flat over the city CBD is way better in person and the secure parking was great.

Here you can watch the sun rise over Signal Hill and the city from your balcony. A quiet, safe area, there is a great shopping center at the end of the road, and pizza restaurant and an Indian restaurant on the same street. The building itself is home to young professionals. Even though we were out and about in the city every day, it always felt as though we were going home at the end of the day.

We had a wonderful stay in this well located flat! It is within walking distance to the shopping mall and a couple of lovely restaurants including a gorgeously authentic Indian restaurant. Although close to shops it's relatively quiet and a has a lovely city view from sea up to Lions Head... loved it.
Really nice apartment well decorated and equiped in a nice and safe enough neighborhood, mall just nearby really handy. I had a great stay there. Thanks again to Roland !

The apartment has everything you need, very close to the city center, with a shopping 200m away with everything you need (1-2min walking). Very safe location, the wifi is perfect and the balcony is just amazing to relax outside with a great view!

Fantastic place to stay. quite, privat. Kloofstreet with all shops in 10min walking distance. love the view from the balcony. 5th floor. clean, spacious.
for me the perfect place in Capetown. Was my second time, can highly recommend it and will come again. Roland is a great host and Teddy the house manager always at your service. Thank you!
Thanks Roland!  Amazing view and very responsive host.  Elevator was out of order though (5th floor apartment)
Nice location and excellent views but apartment is slightly outdated and the whole block has extremely thin walls. At the end of the day good value for money.
Denise and Carlton are fantastic hosts , the studio flat looks new and clean , cleverly laid out, giving it a much bigger and welcoming  feel  , really enjoyed our stay.

Excellent hosts that are very thoughtful, friendly and hands on; to the point of assisting you after you check out! Clean and spacious place. Has amenities that come in handy. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay.
Beautiful studio apartment in great location. Denise and Carlton are wonderful hosts; they made us feel at home and gave us lots of tips on things to do. Wish we could have stayed longer.
Beautiful boutique style unit suitable for travelling or holiday. It has everything you need. You won't be disappointed!
Great place, very cozy. Denise and Carton are very kind and welcoming. Will definitely be back!

Denise and Carlton did a great job hosting! They were flexible with my plans and were always responsive when I messaged. The place was clean and perfect for what I needed. A safe space that felt like home at the end of the day. I would stay here again!

I was very impressed with accommodation. Hosts were so friendly and welcoming. The accomodation was super comfortable and clean. So many special touches. Kitchen was so well equiped . I felt safe and was very comfortable.  Very well located.
What a wonderful stay. All one needs for a perfect peaceful stay. Excellent location....spotless  and comfortable. Will surely be back
I had an enjoyable stay! The place was clean, cozy and had everything I needed. Denise and Carlton thought of everything- thank you for making my stay so easy.

Our stay at Dave's place was really great. The Room is rather small, but there was everything we needed. We needed abit of time to get used to the hot water geysir, but after we had set it to our liking, it worked really well. With our car it took us about 20-30 minutes to City center. Supermarket and stores are about 10 minutes away by car.
Top notch accommodation. The garden is so green and lush and the cottage is perfect. It was a most enjoyable stay. We will stay there on our next Cape Town

Dave's place was our sancury for two  weeks of hospital in morning, with rest & work in afternoon.  Garden is paradise with birds and a visiting squirrel and very peaceful cats and old friendy dog.   Please was quite, clean & peaceful.  Wifi good enough to work from.

This is a great place to stay in Cape Town! We really loved the cottage, especially as it's set in a beautiful garden with lovely flowers and birds. The hosts are also very friendly and welcoming. We enjoyed our stay!

We stayed for 5 nights at Pieter's place and had a wonderful, relaxing time. The cottage is cosy and well appointed and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We really enjoyed the evenings on the stoep with a braai and a stunning view of the ocean and mountains. We would easily recommend this accommodation for a chilled beach escape.

Stoepsit Cottage was the perfect getaway over New Year! Its location is perfect, with a beautiful view of the sea and the surrounding mountains. Scarborough beach is a few minutes' drive away. My husband and I love to cook, and bought fresh fish and shellfish nearby in Kommetjie, as well. The cottage is thoughtfully equipped, and was very well suited to our needs. Thank you Pieter and Emmanuelle! We hope to come back!
Great little spot, nestled in with the locals but very private and safe. Great views and calming energy.
This place is magic. A lovely house that makes you feel right at home and with the most amazing view.

This cottage is amazing! The location, the view and the little details are beautiful and the wooden furniture is so cozy. The house is surrounded by a beautiful and colourfull garden of fynbos plants and you can watch the sunset from the terrace. We enjoyed our 5 Nights before we had to go back home.
Cape town is not that far and if you have a car you can visit the area very easily. The scarborough surf spot, kommetjie and misty cliffs are nearby. Go for it! :)

We had the loveliest stay at this little paradise. The pictures of the view aren’t even close of what it looks in real life - just stunning. You can watch the sunset directly over the ocean every night. It’s very quite and safe.
We’ll be back for sure!
Wow what a place! Even better in real life! Super cozy with a great combination of inside and outside living. Most spectacular sunset terrace. Definitely coming back for more!
What a stunning apartment. Views are incredible. Decor really nice and everything you need is there. I felt very much at home.

Claire's apartment is beautifully located, quiet, and incredibly cozy! I loved my stay here and hope to be back again, the no-load-shedding, while I was around, was a plus as well, and there was a great selection of supplies should there be any. Overall great stay for a week in Cape Town, and super kind, even the neighbors!
Good location close to restaurants and only 10 mins to downtown.  Quiet building with no loadshedding. Older but cozy.  Great value and I would stay here again.

Such a perfect place to settle in Cape Town for a while and have some peace and quiet with a beautiful view!! Apartment was homey and well stocked with kitchen supplies for cooking & coffee. Bed was comfortable too. Will happily return when available !

We loved the apartment and felt immediately at home when we arrived. It is easy to find, very safe and quite spacious. It looks even better than in the pictures. And there’s truly is no load shedding here!
The area is cool. Quiet but right around the corner of Kloof Street with a ton of restaurants and bars. During the day it is easy to walk around the neighborhood. At night I would still take some safety measures and rather take an Uber.
Claire and Jelle are great hosts. Easy to reach, super nice to talk to and very proactive.
Next time I’ll be in Cape Town, I would consider renting this place again.
If you are adults, wanting to sleep well and appreciating a very special view from the terrace while acknowledging that you are in a house where people actually have their homes - this place is for you.
Thank you Claire & Jelle!
A very nice apartment with a wonderful view and all the things you need. It was a pleasure to be here 😊.

The whole week went very well at Claire's apartment. It is ideally located, well-furnished, and has a superb view of Table Mountain. It was a pleasure staying in this apartment. I highly recommend it! Thank you for your kindness, it's a wonderful place to stay.

I had a lovely long-term stay in this quaint apartment. It’s nice and quiet, but a very short walk to restaurants and shops. Wifi is strong so working from the unit was easy. Hosts are very responsive and helpful with anything you need. It can get chilly inside in winter, but otherwise this apartment is cozy, homey, and safe! Would definitely stay again.

Well, absolutely amazing flat! Clean, well-equipped, spacious and very stylish! It was comfortable to cook (there are a lot of facilities to do it and enough space), to work (great Internet connection, two comfortable chairs with great desks for a remote work), to relax in the evenings (many gyms, ballet classes around; cafes, restaurants, coffee shops, supermarkets – everything in a walking distance).
We definitely recommend it and we hope we are back one day!

Absolutely wonderful stay. Great comms and the location while being quiet was so close to great bars and restaurants and just beautiful. Very responsive and friendly host. The property itself was really great, beautiful spacey place and funky design.
Highly recommend to friends that are coming
A very easy and comfortable stay, everything just worked well and felt like home. Quiet secure building close to everything you need. Highly recommended!

Wow, what a wonderful experience. The apartment was perfect in every way - sparkling clean, stylish and safe. Our host Bianca made the experience even better. She was easy to communicate with and an expert on the area. We loved the thoughtful touches and luxury amenities, like the espresso machine and dishwasher! I’ll definitely book this apartment again when I’m next in Bloubergstrand.

This apartment is best located & the apartment is beautiful, you can walk to the beach & shops near by. It is safe, felt like home too.
Absolutely loved it. The host gives you absolutely space & privacy which was needed. They are helpful & friendly.
Thanks Bianca.

Bianca and her husband were very helpful and quickly to respond to our questions. We were welcomed by her husband with a bottle of wine and box of chocolate. The apartment is very beautiful and extremely clean☺️, I will definitely come back and also refer. Our vacation(my friend and I) was thee best thanks to Bianca and Hubby for their generosity ❤️💃

I wouldn't have asked for a better host for my first visit in Cape Town. The area is just as peaceful as I would have required it. The apartment and building is squeaky clean and spacious. I loved staying here and I look forward to booking the place for my next visit(s).
Bianca also has a very friendly husband who is always eager to advise and offer clear instructions on exploring the area. I wish I had more time.

Bianca was an great host and would definitely come back! They were super responsive and proactively reached out with check in options (accommodating early check in) and were very welcoming upon arrival. When I had any questions they immediately responded. The location of the apartment is great within the complex, easy entry and access to pool. The pictures are a good representation of the current state of the apartment.
lovely place to stay in a secure complex, walking distance to the beach and Bianca was very friendly and made  our stay very comfortable.
There were a few issues like the broken cupboard door. It would have been nice to have some toiletries in the bathroom.
Bianca has a beautiful place in a great location. My kids were obsessed with the pool.

Great value and comfort in a awesome location with beach and restaurants only minutes away.
The flat was just a the pictures looked and we loved our stay here.
special thanks to bianca who was an amazing host .

I loved that neighbourhood. Very hip and safe and in very close proximity of the mall. Dealing with Claire was easy as she was so friendly . Compound has very strict rules tho on noise and you can barely talk on the balcony without being harassed by the security guards. However great host ,great apartment ,great location !

Great location, great value! place was as advertised if not better. has better location and very close to mall to go for dinner or just some shopping. enjoyed the place, it was nice and cozy for a couple!

My parents had a great stay here. Everything was perfect, the property was spacious and very clean. The location was great. Felt very secure inside the Island Club compound and being right next to Canal Walk was very handy for shopping.
The property was faultless but also the host was amazing. Great quick communication throughout. It made their stay so much more comfortable.
Definitely recommend and it's definitely a 5 star stay! 5*****.
Thank you for hosting my parents.

Stephen was a great host and extremely welcoming. The apartment is cosy, comfortable, beautifully furnished and equipped with everything you might need. I had a wonderful stay and highly recommend it.

The place is lovely decorated and comfortable, nice yard, great location, beach about 10 minutes walking distance and lots of restaurants to choose about 13 minutes walking distance, what is totally fine. some little beverages for welcoming the guests. the host was not there, but helped via messages what was totally ok. the person who gave us the key was really friendly too. we spent a great time for a week and would love to come back if we wanna stay in the area again in the future.

BnB that offers value for money at a prime location in Camps Bay but it is, in our humble opinion, in need of some renovations. All required facilities, like kitchen, microwave, refrigirator, hairdryer,... are there and work fine. Garden and pool area very nice.

We stayed at Ronits place for about a week, check in was great and easy, same with check-out. On our stay we basically had the pool all to ourselves, which was really nice and private. The apartment is right in the middle of camps bay so you can walk most places for food and drive anywhere in Cape Town in under 30 minutes. Ronit was a fantastic host and took very good care of us on our stay!

We stayed for 2 nights only which was a pity.
Everything was very nice, new, well looked after and well maintained.
We will definitely come back again.
Thanks again Ronit and Ronin. We enjoyed our stay very much.

We absolutely loved our stay! The apartment felt extremely private and we basically had the pool to ourselves for the whole 5 days. It was pricier than other apartments we looked at but definitely worth it if you can. It had everything we needed and more!! Walking distance to the restaurants and beach. Ronit was very friendly and responsive as well

We had a great month at Jill and Johan's apartment. They are fantastic hosts. The steep drive to the integral garage looks daunting, but actually is not a problem. All was lovely in the apartment, everything we could ask for and great beds! Wonderful views from the living room, there are steps to patio, garden and pool, all are beautifully kept. A great stay, and no load shedding problems as they have an inverter.
So happy,if I could give her 10 stars ⭐️ I would,thank u🙏

Jillian’s place was extremely spacious, internally all on one level with a drive in garage entry.
The outside space was on a couple of steep levels, and possibly not suitable for elderly people.
The outside space could benefit from an upgrade and benefit from new furniture.
As hosts Jillian and husband were fantastic lovely people.

We loved meeting Jill and Johan, they both met us with a warm welcome when we first arrived and showed us around. Within a few minutes we were settled in and felt at home. The place is extremely private and we never saw them unless we had a question, then they came to the door to help us learn how to use the washing machine, for example. Later, when we wanted to go out and plan some sightseeing, Jill talked through some options with us and then sent the list to use by private message because they were hard to spell. All in all, probably the best hosts on the plant!

big space, i was hardly there so didnt use the pool or have breakfast which is provided.  Love the very friendly dog, Gustav was quick to respond to needs or any questions! close to town but feels like a quiet oasis!
Superb accommodation and facilities. Good welcome from friendly host who willingly helps with and fixes any problems. Very secure and very central for touring much of Western cape.

We had a great time at Gustav’s cottage. He went out of his way to make sure we were happy. Even though the rest of the area might lose power due to load shedding, the cottage had a solar power back-up that kept us spoiled. The linen service was an unexpected bonus that we grew way too dependent on :) So just book his place already, no regrets.

Urchin Cottage is a quaint and quirky cottage on the hill with an absolutely beautiful view over the ocean. The cottage was built by the owner and was their family home until recently. My husband and I had a great time spending 5 nights in this cottage for our anniversary. The town is quiet with a very considerate and homey community. Stunning beaches and beautiful sunsets. Very easy and quick access to Misty Cliffs, Cape Point and a short drive to Simons Town. We will definitely be back!

Candy’s seaside Scarborough cottage is the perfect getaway from the city. The cottage has incredible views over the ocean, which reflect its tranquil nature.
The rustic accommodation has everything that you require, with ample space for our group of 6.
Candy is a fantastic and thoughtful host, and her hospitality is greatly appreciated.
We cannot wait to visit again!

We had such a wonderful stay at Urchin Cottage, and hope to come back again in future. A beautiful home with lots of character and light. Glorious views of Scarborough and the beach from the terrace/balcony too. What a divine spot!

The wonderful views of the sea and mountains from the massive deck were a highlight of this home. No-one wanted to leave at the end of the weekend. The house itself feels like a real home and was very well equipped. Thanks to Candy for being very welcoming and making check in a breeze. Will definitely be coming again.

The view is to die for!  We loved the quirkiness of the cottage,  and appreciated that it was pet friendly.   We had  a great weekend in a well equipped cottage. Candy was absolutely wonderful, and we appreciated the small touches (like leaving flowers and snacks) and the late check out.

This is a great get away from city life that offers a chance to unplug, relax and connect with nature. Love hearing the ocean as you fall asleep and enjoy cuddling up in front of the fire. It's a great home for a eclectic getaway from the city!

What a wonderful place! We'd had hugh ecpectations judging from the pictures we'd seen but we never expected the reality to be even better! Urchin cottage is a true haven with a very special atmosphere thanks to the beautiful  sorroundings for one, but also because Candy and her family have turned it into an unforgettable place. It sure is true what they say about Scarborough: time doesn't matter - the more so of you stay in this extraordinary place!
Candy's place is so unique in such a good way. Candy went the extra mile to make our stay great. The view is incredible and I would highly recommend the outdoors shower!

We had a great stay at Urchin Cottage. Candy is a very warm host and we particularly appreciated the breathtaking view of the ocean. The house is absolutely charming, in the very particular style of summer houses in the region.

The house could not be in a better position - you've even got an amazing view from the upstairs loo!
Just LOVED our weekend of sea, beach and views... and a little bit of Monopoly (provided in the house).
If you love quirky, you will love it as much as we did. Cannot wait to come back...

Candy’s home is very cozy and has a vintage feel to it which makes it different, it’s close to the beach which is always a win and the deck overlooks an amazing view of the ocean and mountains . Its the perfect getaway if you wanting to go off the grid for a few days and unwind.

We loved our stay. We were a family group so the open plan living worked for us and the fact that they allow dogs.
The house is rustic and quirky but it was spotlessly clean and had everything we needed.
Candy left us a thoughtful note, a pineapple and a bag of crisps. Francois gave us a yellowtail he had just caught for our dinner one night.
The very best part of this place is the view. Just beautiful 😍
the urchin cottage is a cozy nest situated in an outstanding place. Everything is very easy and  gentle with Candy. Highly recommended, the whole family loved it.
Really peaceful time enjoying the staggering view in this quaint and quirky home. Loved our time there. Two kids loved exploring the house.
Lovely, clean and comfortable accommodation with beach cottage vibe. Close to all amenities, beaches and walks. Lovely ocean view. Accommodating host. Felt very private and at home.

We loved staying at Heather's place. the location was fantastic for walking down to Windmill beach and Boulders Bay. Its then a very short drive to Simon's Town centre and supermarkets. The apartment was really well kitted out for us to cook, and we also made use of the brilliant braai facilities. Heather was super responsive and helpful whenever we got in touch and made the stay really easy.

Great spot!! It was lovely for the kids to have the beach right down the road and a pool too.
The apartment was as described and very clean. Will definitely come back…

A perfect place to visit the penguins in Simon's Town and the Cape Point. Penguins and the beautiful Boulder beach are just 2 mins walk from the house. The town seemed very relaxed and safe. The apartment was fantastic for 2 people as we had our own bedrooms. The kitchen and the bathroom were modern and the decor is nice to the smallest details. Easy parking in front and a nice patio to have breakfast and enjoy the view to the bay. I can't think of anything negative to say about Heather's house. We didn't meet Heather but everything was well arranged and communicated. Truly enjoyable way to start a holiday after a long journey.

Spotless, stunning Camp's Bay apartment with ocean view and a crisp breeze - we loved our stay at Jean-Paul's place. Jean-Paul was a fabulous host and was exceptionally responsive to all our questions. Fantastic location - we enjoyed the hilly walk down to the beachfront in the morning, and the great steakhouse nearby for an evening feast. We hope to be back!

Our stay at the villa was absolutely spectacular! We could not have imagined that it would be any better. We enjoyed every moment! The pictures online are amazing, but  it’s even more beautiful in person. The accommodations are perfect, and the views are amazing! The cleanliness of the villa was top notch. Prepare to be amazed on your stay.
it is such a lovely place and we enjoyed our time so much! thanks a lot for the great hospitality!

It’s a lovely small cottage equipped with everything you need. Jean-Paul is living on the ground floor with his lovely little dogs. Jean-Paul was really welcoming, so we felt really comfortable.
The area is so beautiful and it’s near to Camps Bay Beach. We really enjoyed our stay at Jean-Paul’s.

If you want a modern, sparkling clean property with lots of thoughtful touches and an exceptional host in one of the most beautiful places in the world then this is the place for you.
My daughter and I felt at home the minute we arrived. We stayed in the garden cottage which is spacious, beautifully decorated and very peaceful.
The pool and outdoor areas have incredible views and the pictures do not do this place justice.
Jean Paul could not have been a more friendly and helpful host.
We can’t wait to return next year!
We had a wonderful stay in the Garden Cottage. It‘s renovated and looks like shown in the pictures. We felt safe and comfortable our whole stay. Jean-Paul was a really nice and helpful any time.

The cottage was remarkable! It was one of the nicest places we've ever stayed at. Jean-Paul was incredibly hospitable and responsive, and our toddler absolutely adored the garden, pool and the dogs. Staying at the cottage was the highlight of our Cape Town trip! Highly recommend staying here for the excellent location, wonderful views, and great host!

I travel for work and would definitely recommend Riane’s space to anyone that likes a peaceful, quiet night. Safe parking inside which was a big comfort. She’s thoughtful, responds quickly and makes sure that you have anything you could possibly need to feel more at home.

Lovely, clean place close to shops, the beach and easy access to main roads. Hostess was very fast with replies and added so many thoughtful touches and treats. I really felt at home and enjoyed my stay! Will be back and can recommend it to everyone.

Riane is a wonderful host and her husband thats assisting her is awesome. They made our stay pleasant with everything we required.
It's really a wonderful place chill and enjoy.
Thank you Riane this will certainly not be my last stay there.
👌

My stay at Riane's place was excellent,
Just want to thank Riane & her husband Kobus for opening their little abode to me. Their place is a gem amongst Western Cape. It is a very calm & tranquil place. I felt safe & relaxed. The time I was there the weather was good, thus the morning I had to check out I actually had breakfast in the garden area, as there were a nice setup for this. It was nice connecting with nature while having breakfast and enjoying the morning sun.
Will be telling all my family & friends about their place. If I need a get away again. I will surely make use of her place again if it's available.
From one Jordaan to Another Jordaan.

Been staying here for around 2years in an out. always a pleasure Riane and Kobus are the best hosts, friendly welcoming and the unit is fantastic.
Thank you!

It was A Very Very Good Holiday, they were a Family for me,  I will Never find a place Better than RIANE AND KOBUS, MY NEXT HOLIDAY WILL BE AT RIANE AND KOBUS MY DEAR FRIENDS, LOVE AND REGARDS TO BOTH! SEE YOU SOON, AND THANKS FOR ALL MY LOVE 'YS MARIUCCIA AND SILVANO
Riane was a lovely host, she went above and beyond in making us feel welcomed. The unit is absolutely lovely, clean, fully stocked, and Loadshedding friendly as well.

What a beautiful house in a stunning location. It was perfect for our large group. The kids enjoyed all the outdoor space and appreciated the large pool.
The on-site help was very responsive and friendly. Five stars all round.

The apartment is really nice and the view is great. The area is residential but you can find delis and markets 10 minutes away with an Uber. We didn't get much assistance from the host. In general, it was a good stay.

Me and 3 friends stayed at the apartment for one month. Whenever we needed help with something we could just text and he'd immediately help us. The Apartment is big and for 2 couples the perfect stay - we really enjoyed the open space as a community area. We felt safe and right away at home :) There is one smaller apartment that you share the pool with and Peter lives in another apartment in the same house which made the communication more personal and fun. Thanks for having us :)
We thoroughly enjoyed our stayed. Also, the communication and consistent checkins was appreciated. This home is perfectly located to everything. We will definitely be returning soon.

The room exceeded my expectations. It is really cosy, with an art studio feel to it. The room is sized like a bachelors apartment.
The hosts are lovely and they really make one feel welcome on their property. Their kidds and dog are a delight.
The house is perfectly located with all amenities within walking distance. Parking is also very safe for one's vehicles
This room is perfect if you require a place close to Stellenbosch Business School. Not only is it conveniently located but also spacious enough to do your studies inside the room
This is a real value for money booking.

Annehette is the most amazing host. She is gracious and friendly and so you instantly feel at home. The apartment is beautiful and cleaverly thought through to serve all your needs. A short walk away you can access your amenities (food, laundry) and an awesome park to spend time in. I can’t wait to stay here every time I come to Tygerberg Medical School. Thank you for an awesome stay!

My stay was so much more than I could have expected. Derek and Annehette are amazing people and great hosts!
The apartment has everything you need and more...a very cool place to stay!

Such a fantastic place to book! It was super clean and extremely cute! Annehette is such a thoughtful host and stayed in touch with us at all times. The added rusks and coffee was a thoughtful touch. I would book in here again without thinking twice!
Our visit was very limited however they replied as soon as we booked, lady was very kind, quiet place.

The highway is easy accessible and the location is great. Very neat and clean space, very comfortable as well. Great host. Definitely would recommend this accommodation to people who are looking for value for their money.

Very grateful for our time in Cape Town and the ease of getting to and from this perfect studio apartment. A recommended little haven from home. An uncomplicated stay with a feeling of freedom. Birds chirping, open sky views and good positioning.
Thank you to this family for making our stay memorable.

Annehette and Derick are very lovely and kind hosts and they gave me a warm welcome! The studio is clean and you can tell that they put lots of love in it! I can recommend the place and would definitely stay there again!
They have 3 units on their property, all 3 lovely, but the blue studio is my favourite. Private, roomy and full of natural light.

William is an amazing host. Even though he was out of town, the communication was brilliant. Williams place is perfect, the area is quiet and has loads of things to do, the apartment is neat and clean. We felt very comfortable, and will definitely return again.

A stylish apartment situated in a quiet complex and neighbourhood central to most tourist attractions in Cape Town.  The apartment itself is quaint and spacious enough for 2 people. Very friendly host who made us feel welcomed and gave us useful tips about the neighbourhood and surrounding areas. Would definitely recommend the space to anyone looking for a safe and quiet place when visiting Cape Town.

It was absolut amazing. Everything was spotted clean and we felt „home away from home“. Carin was very helpful and assisted us in everything we needed. Thank you Carin for making our stay a perfect start into our vacation. 100% recommendation and we will definitely come back.
My friend and me had a wonderful time at this place. Carin and her husband are truly superhosts and I highly recommend staying at one of their rooms. Definitely coming back :)
Great location, trendy and new with great views! Carin is extremely a pleasant host always going the extra mile.  Would definitely return for future stay in Cape Town.

We enjoyed our stay at Carins beautiful house! She is super friendly and her husband to! Also very helpful. The house is just a dream! Super clean und so beautiful! We enjoyed it a lot and would definitely come back! Thank you! :)
Carin's accommodation is very nice, confortable, and pretty (refined design). Carin is very attentive to her guests and makes sure that you have an amazing stay.

Carin's place is probably the best place you will find in Cape Town. It really is a very stylish space in a perfect location with the best view of Table Mountain right from your bed. Carin's hospitality is exceptional and she made sure my stay was as comfortable and easy as possible. Thank you Carin and all of the best.
Carin's place is lovely and quiet. Set in a beautiful location. Close to restaurants, beaches and the city. She is a wonderful host and goes out of her way for her guests.

What a great place to stay in Capetown. The apartment is situated in the really nice and safe neighborhood Tamboerskloof. Plenty of cosy cafes, restaurants and bars close by. Just walk there and uber back.
We enjoyed very much the beautiful view of Table Mountain in the morning from the bed. Carin was a lovely and helpful host and provided us with lots of information. We hope to see her again! Thanks a lot!
The suite is well appointed, very comfortable, ideally located and the view of Table Mountain excellent! It's a great choice for a short stay.

We had a lovely stay, View of Table Mountain is beautiful! Carin was friendly and helpful and communication response was fantastic. Check in and check out went smoothly, no complaints! The accommodation is as it looks in the pictures, would highly recommend and would stay there again when in the area.
Such a beautiful space where one can relax and unwind but still be close to many cute cafes and nightclubs. The balcony view is something else too!

We couldn't be more satisfied with that pick for our short visit. Very safe and nice neighbourhood. Carin is the nicest host we came across with a lot of tips and help. Would highly recommend this place. And the view from the room is amazing!

Beautiful and stylish accomodation in a very quiet and safe yet centrally located area of Cape Town. Great views of table mountain from room and balcony. Hosts that go the extra mile (i.e. helping with laundry). Would love to stay here again. Highly recommended

The area ‘Tamboerskloof’ is a very nice base to visit Cape Town if you’re also looking for calm and relaxed place to stay. Carin, the host, is helpful in every way. She makes you feel like home from the moment you park you car in the driveway. The room was super clean and stylish with all amenities there - we loved to beautiful mermaid shower :) I definitely recommend!

It was a wonderful stay at Carin’s house.
We had a beautiful surprise in the morning with the view.
Very safe to stay. Carin has very great advice for cafe and restaurant to go around.
Thank you so much for your kindness !
Great place to stay when visiting Cape Town! Location is amazing, everything you need is close by and very quiet neighborhood! Carin has some great recommendations as well! Room was very nice too!

We had a splendid time in Carin's place in Tamboerskloof. The location couldn't possibly be better and Carin gave us a very warm welcome. The room has everything needed for a comfortable stay, including the most amazing views.

We really enjoyed staying at Carin’s home
She is very helpful , everything was perfect !

We definitely recommend to stay at Carins Place! The rooms are beautifully furnished and the view on the table mountain is spectacular! Additionally Carin is a great host, she had so many very good recommendations for us and was very friendly. We really enjoyed our stay and would love to come back in the future!

Fantastic option for work and/or leisure in the heart of Cape Town and the city bowl. Quiet neighbourhood, direct access to Signal Hill and Lions Head out the front door. Exceptionally clean and tidy. High quality products. Comfortable and Homely. Super host. Self check in and check out available. Water and milk in the bar fridge. Every detail was considered and the host provided tons of useful information for things to do/see in and around Cape Town. Highly recommend.
Perfect place for 2 nights in Cape Town. It is a simple room but has everything you can need. A stunning view of Table Mountain to enjoy your morning coffee or evening glass of wine. Thanks Carin!
Worth every penny! Spotless and clean. Carin was very responsive and gave amazing local recommendations!

I really enjoyed our first night at Carins place. It was so well organised and very modern look. Carin was super helpfull from the moment we booked. We got so many useful tips and really made us feel like home, even if we didnt saw each other much. Overall, really recommend this place and carin was a very sweet host. Thank you

Highly recommend! Carin is an exquisite host who gave us a warm welcome. Amazing location in Cape Town in a safe and quiet neighborhood. The room was very clean and comfortable, and had an amazing view on Table Mountain. Thank you!
One of the best airbnbs we’ve stayed in. Amazing location, spotlessly clean and perfect for what we needed. You’ll be so pleased you chose this place.

We really enjoyed our stay at carins place, it was a lovely stay. She was so kind & friendly, we felt like home from the beginning. The only thing to mention is, that it‘s not the best isolation, it’s a little loud in the room. You hear the neighbour rooms & everything that happens in the floor. Anyways, we would recommend Carins place & come back again (with earplugs 😉)
Amazing Stay! Carin was wonderful and helpful with recommendations on what to do around the city. Table Mountain View at the place is everything!

This was a superb stay ! Despite the bad weather our stay in Capetown was perfect. We were at home straight away and Carin was a perfect host. Due to the rain our bath towels didn’t dry easily , Carin pro actively suggested to change them for fresh and dry ones ! Will definitely stay again !

Excellent stay however we had a personal malfunction which wasn't a great representation of our conduct at stay. The host was a great host, everything was was perfect on their side. Apologies to the host for lack of communication on our side.

Carins place was amazing.The photos don’t even do it justice it’s beautiful in person, so peaceful, the views are stunning and Carin as a host is very pro active and friendly .Easy to reach her incase of anything and has great recommendations for places to visit and restaurants to visit. The house is very much central as we were not far from most attractions. I will definitely be back

Carin was a great host but I had a bad experience. I can in with a guest for less than 5min she gave me a lecture infront of my guest yet policy permits guests between 09:00 - 17:00. I am sure it is because of our race that we were treated like babies when we are adults

Such a great location.  Gorgeous mountain view of Table Mountain. Crisp Air. Quiet beautiful neighborhood. And the place itself was modern, great amenities and well kept. Great place to stay in Cape Town.
Third time staying at Carin and still didn’t disappoint ☺️ always a go-to when visiting Cape Town
