Comfortable,Clean,Affordable and a relaxing space to catch up with yourself and to explore the wonders of Cape Town.

Pernilla and Pelle were absolutely outstanding hosts. They were incredibly kind and helpful. They went above and beyond to help me and make sure the stay was great. Wonderful experience and wonderful people. The place was beautiful and such a bargain. I loved staying here and would recommend in a heart beat!
Pernilla was an amazing host. We were surprised by fresh flowers in the cottage accompanied by ice cold beers in the fridge. Very warm welcome. Would definitely come again. Anytime.

Pernilla & Pelle are excellent hosts and I enjoyed every minute in this cute guest house of them. They are there for your support and advice any time. There is no better Airbnb to ask for to enjoy the beauty of Cape Town and it’s beaches. Enjoying the sunset from the small terrace is the highlight of the day. Looking forward to come back soon! Thank you for everything!

I really enjoyed staying at the cottage. This is the best deal you can get close to camps bay. I loved the view from the terrace, it was perfect for my morning yoga. The wi fi is quick and the place is super cozy. The hospitality of the hosts is outstanding !

Incredible space and location--near the beach! Loved this cozy and homy cottage. Pernilla is an amazing host and takes care of every need. Her warm personality is a huge bonus, as is the cleaning service that comes with this Airbnb. I had an incredible month's stay, great work from home spot!

I really liked Pernilla's place. Pelle helped me with a lot of small things and both of them were really understanding and relaxed. I especially enjoyed grabbing a coffee down the street and walking over the the beach. everything felt easy from this place! Thank you!
It was lovely stay! I can highly recommend to stay here when you’re in camps bay/Cape Town. All the hot spots of camps bay, Cape Town & surroundings are super easy and fast to reach.

We spend lovely 5 weeks in Pernilla and Pelles cottage. The location is great, safe and it‘s only 10 minutes walk to the beach. The apartment has everything you need, even a cosy terrace. Pernilla and Pelle were very caring, really friendly and allways around when we needed them. A nice place for your holiday. CU soon. 😀
We felt right at home at this beautiful stay! Pernilla went above and beyond to make us feel accommodated and comfortable. Such an amazing home and a beautiful area. Can’t wait to be back!

Pernilla’s place was absolutely wonderful! It looks exactly like the photos. Pernilla was very flexible on check in time and I appreciated having help getting my giant luggage up the steps! The location is amazing. I wish I had had more time here!

Stop reading and book this already.
! Lovely place, neighbourhood and hosts. Thank you for being kind and hosting us. We’re going to miss you dog :(

What an incredible space Pernilla and Pelle have created. Delightfully hospitable and wonderfully accommodating. Their energy is wholesome and helpful. Lovely chats and all round a good vibe. Will be back in the future!

This cute cottage is a great base for the Camps Bay/Bakoven area in Cape Town. The place is very secure & homely, and is a short walk to the Camps Bay main strip. We loved being welcomed in person by Pernilla & Pelle, they are both so lovely and even helped us with our luggage. They were proactive at communicating and responded to messages promptly. The cottage has everything you need, the space is just right for two. The patio area is a delight, the perfect place to read a book or catch a gorgeous sunset. All in all, a wonderful stay with great hosts.
A lovely spacious AirBnb within walking distance to Camps Bay and swim spots. Pernilla and her husband were very responsive and helpful!
It was very nice, we really enjoyed it. It is a nice distance from the Camps Bay strip. Close enough to walk but far enough to not be overrun. We really enjoyed our stay there.
10/10! The best welcome after landing into Cape Town. We couldn’t have asked for a better first 4 days in Cape Town with these hosts.

My fiancé and I had an absolutely lovely time at Pernilla and Pelle’s place. They are remarkable hosts - both extremely responsive and helpful. They made us feel at home in Camps Bay. The house itself is just as described, very peaceful and well decorated. They had great amenities and even helpful bonuses like beach towels and an umbrella. This spot is very close to the beach and within short driving distance of many great restaurants. We also felt extremely safe staying here. Would absolutely recommend Pernilla and Pelle’s place to anyone staying in Camps Bay.
Nice location out of the busy part of Camps Bay. Pernilla was very responsive and had great recommendations!

Our stay at The Nook was a pleasure from start to finish and exceeded our expectations. Barbara and Clive were excellent and friendly hosts who made us feel very welcome. It was a great start to our holiday and the perfect venue to recover from a long haul flight. If you want great sea views and just somewhere to relax, get away from the Cape hustle and watch the world go by I would thoroughly recommend The Nook. There were even dolphins in the bay! 😁

Very clean and spacious loft apartment with the most beautiful views of Table Mountain across the bay. Great location if you want to explore the winelands and West Coast. Gracious host. Restaurant close to the apartment (part of the hotel) was an added bonus.

Remember the feeling of going to the beach when u were a child ..the excitement of building sand castles and the crushing of the Waves on the shore ...NOW THIS IS ALL OF THAT WITHOUT OUT THE SADNESS OF UR PARENTS TELLING U IT'S TIME TO GO !!
TRULY BLESSED TO HAVE COME ACROSS THIS GEM ..
HOPE TO MAKE IT HOME AGAIN SOON 💘
This is a great place to stay for great ocean views and kite surfing. The apartment is awesome and Shirley is a wonderful host. Shopping is a 15 minute walk away. Highly recommend this place!
The place was perfect, great hospitality with a beautiful view of Table Mountain. Thank you very much!

If you are looking for great value for money, incredible sunrises and sunsets, to be right on the beach and apartment that makes your stay, super comfortable then look no further! Shirley the host is super friendly and always wants to ensure you have the best stay, it was such a pleasure dealing with her! This apartment is a gem and is only 20 minutes drive to the V & A waterfront! We will definitely be back! Thanks Shirley for everything!

We loved to stay at Shirley’s place. Spectacular views of Table mountain. Had everything we needed. Check-in and check-out process was very easy. Thanks to Shirley, she is a very nice and helpful person. Would definitely book it again.

This was a lovely place to stay - the top floor of the building, which felt nice and private, with a lovely view of the beach, sea, Robin Island and a glorious view of table mountain, we couldn't ask for better.
The space was just enough for us, with lovely light coming in from all directions, and a cosy patio where we could enjoy the beautiful view.
The beach in front of the hotel is very easily accessible, and we loved spending time there watching people walking and playing with their dogs on the beach all hours of the day (which wasn't mentioned in the listing but was a great added bonus)
Shirley met us at checking with a lovely greeting, and all the info we could need - checkout was also very easy.
10/10 - thank you for a fantastic stay!

Conveniently located near shopping malls and sport spots, the apartment, adequately equipped, featuring a designated parking spot, cellar, and a captivating ocean and Table Mountain view.
Inside, it's got character, just needs a little TLC. No blackout options - an early morning rendezvous with the sun, and the street noise, especially morning traffic, made earplugs a must. But that beach view? Priceless.
Elevator was not an issue - just three flights of stairs, and your baggage is your gym:-)
The overall stay was positive and enjoyable.
Cheers to the host for a gracious laid-back late check-out, a bright spot in this uniquely charming stay.

My wife and Myself had an amazing time.
Shirley's place is the perfect spot for a peaceful couples getaway.
Shirley is so friendly and made us feel so welcomed. Venue and Host gets a 10/10. We will definitely book again in future.
We loved our stay, such a lovely place and location is beautiful with sea view from the balcony.

The apartment was PERFECT! Fitted with only the best furniture, finishes and decor. Close to all amenities and everything was just amazing! Excellent value for money too. Would gladly recommend anybody to stay here!

Marna and André are two exceptional hosts.
Whenever we needed something/ assistance they jumped right on it. We were 4 married couples and there was enough space for all of us. We had a very pleasant stay, we liked the "fresh-bread-farm-vibes" feeling that the place has.
I would definitely recommend staying at Marna's cottage.

Best worth for your money. The host of the house is very helpful, extremely friendly and went out of his way to assure we had everything we need. We were 7 adults,two children and one infant who stayed here and there was more than enough space for all of us. The next morning I got dressed here for my wedding and all of my stylist had a space to park inside. I would highly recommend this place to anyone!

Andre and his family very helpful and make you feel home from home. Everything you require is there and all your needs are met. Very friendly and helpful. Look forward to a restful experience or in our case a little noisy with no complaints from our hosts. Breakfast and evening meal available at a very reasonable price.

The place is really wonderful. It feels like home, away from home. It consist of 2 nice entertainment areas, namely: a braai area and a pool area. There are air cons in all the bedrooms, which is really nice because the house does get warm. It is an amazing place if you’re a group of friends going on a weekend away. But what made our stay even more fantastic, was the gracious host Andre, who is warm and responded quickly to issues we were having.

This place is a bit of a hidden gem, slightly off the beaten track. We were warmly welcomed with smiles, homemade bead & butter and milk in the fridge. The place is very spacious and one can easily relax inside or out with 2 different outdoor areas. There is safe off street-on location parking and is less than 30min drive from Paarl. Andre and his family are very friendly - we loved our stay :)

I highly recommend this BnB.
The hosts are outstanding and friendly. The venue is spotless and so homely.
Thank you for the most amazing stay.
I highly recommend that if you stay you order the food they will prepare on your behalf. It is extremely well priced and absolutely divine, so flavorful and more than enough for the amount of people you request for.
I will most certainly make use of your BnB again.
Thank you.
Great hospitality! The host was very kind and communication was very easy. The accommodation was perfect for a large group! Would definitively recommend for a stay near Stellenbosch and Cape Town.

We needed accommodation to attend my brothers funeral in South Africa. Marna and Andre weres the most generous, understanding, and thoughtful  hosts. My family will forever cherish their generosity during a very trying time.  Thank you 💖

This apartment is a gem. It’s better in real life than pictures.
Fantastically clean and super comfy bed.
Jacob was an excellent host and communication was fluid and easy.
He even left a lovely wine for us to enjoy.
The big TV is a plus.
We will definitely come back. It felt like home. Mabel and Henry

Great location & nice apartment ( clean, nice view & i was feeling home ) , we love it !
Thanks a lot for Jacob . He's response is quickly, and he was very nice ! We really enjoyed and stayed there. Near some restaurant ( our favorite restaurant is Mano's ), stadion for run, mall, and going to market just walk .
I'm not sorry for enjoying holiday in Cape Town this time. Its like heaven, nice place, food, good people & more peace ! ❤️

We really enjoyed the stay in the Airbnb! Everything was easy from the beginning. The Airbnb is very well equipped with high quality furniture. You can see that Jacob has an eye for detail. We felt right at home and enjoyed all the amenities!
U have a supermarket right next to it and a cafe in the same building. It is also perfect for remote work. Definitely recommend this Airbnb!

I recently enjoyed a fantastic 2.5-month stay at this Airbnb location. The place was not only beautifully decorated but also provided a strong sense of security, thanks to the presence of a security guard station at the entrance. Its ideal location near the V&A Waterfront made getting around incredibly convenient with Uber. However, what truly stood out was the exceptional host, who promptly answered all my questions and was incredibly responsive. I highly recommend this Airbnb for anyone considering a long-term rental in the area.

We loved the place. It’s located perfectly, everything was clean and we felt right at home. Could go running easily, grocery shopping was nearby, many restaurants and included security service which supports feeling even more safe.
We enjoyed having such a great place to also relax in this big and alive city.
Would recommend it without any doubts.
Stylish apartment in an excellent location. Great restaurants, coffee shops and other amenities within easy walking distance. Super easy check-in and the apartment was very clean. Thanks Jacob!
Lovely place, very well furnished and equipped, clean and super comfortable in terms of access to common places in the city.. Really enjoyed my stay!

Wonderful place to stay! Thank you so much for the excellent accommodation. The location is fantastic, and the apartments are very comfortable and beautiful. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The host was incredibly helpful and kind, always ready to assist. Highly recommend!

Lovely flat located right at the heart of Green Point - couldn’t have been in a better location. Comfortable, clean, equipped with all you may need for a great stay. Jacob and Tish were super helpful and responsive from the beginning to the end of our stay. Thank you!

The apartment was absolutely perfect for my extended stay! Walkable location, beautiful space, lovely mountain view. I could stay in to work & cook at home as needed (with Woolworths & Giovanni’s just steps away!) or walk 10-15 mins to eat, drink & shop at V&A Waterfront. I loved my walks along the oceanfront promenade, and learned so much on guided tours of District Six Museum, Robben Island & city neighborhoods. (Special shout-out to my favorite, Seven Colours Eatery!) Tish was delightfully hospitable and responsive to questions, as was Isaac at the front door. I enjoyed this place so much and hope to return! Highly recommend.

Very stylish comfortable place, really well designed in every way.   Amazing ocean views.  Short walk down to the beach through the steeply terraced garden, full of beautiful aloes & cotyledons, across the road and down another path - about 150m maybe...  Lovely design touches everywhere - interesting art and beautiful books.   Enjoyed converting the dining table into a ping pong table :-)   Decent wi-fi and nice collection of boardgames.  Kitchen is small but perfectly designed and equipped - perfect for foodies e.g. excellent knives (just note no microwave).   Highly recommend and hope to stay again some time.  Our kids aged 7 and 10 liked it too :-)

This is probably the nicest house I have ever seen outside of a magazine, and that's not even the best thing about it! The views are incredible, and you can see the ocean from almost all the rooms in the house. We had high expectations and this place exceeded them! Misty Cliffs is a wonderful area - perfect for an escape but still close enough to shops and restuarants. I HIGHLY recommend this place!

This place is super stylish - tastefully decorated and it has everything you need for an awesome stay.
The views are magnificent and the location outstanding!
I would most definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants a stylish and luxurious seaside retreat.

Our new favourite place in Misty Cliffs. The house has impressed us with its love for details, the smart design and the amazing garden. The views are breathtaking and the amount of decks and balconies allows you to enjoy sunset from a different place every night. We also appreciated the quick responses and flexibility regarding check in/out time.

Without a doubt the most beautiful airbnb I have ever stayed in! Such an incredibly well decorated space, perfect for rest and relaxation. Everything you could need is available and Cameron and Justin were just so lovely! Definitely recommend!
Amazing place - the view is unbelievable and the house is simply perfect. Attentive host and attention to detail.

This is the most magical place, if you want somewhere to get away from it all and relax with the most breathtaking views then look no further.
The house is gorgeous with stylish yet comfortable decor that makes you feel right at home. The kitchen is well equipped and excellent for self catering.
With the pool, sauna and beach just a few steps away, you have everything you need for a relaxing stay to enjoy the area. There’s plenty to do outside of that with local shops and scenic spots not too far away.
The hosts are fantastic and the house comes with a manual with all the info you need for a comfortable stay, and communication was excellent throughout.
Thank you Justin and Cameron for a wonderful week, we’ll definitely be back!

Justin’s house is an amazing place in a quiet area south of Cape Town. The view on the beach and ocean are absolutely stunning. From the pictures we estimated the house to be located at the waterfront directly, but it appeared to be a row higher when we arrived, although still beautiful and nice. The architecture and design of the house are price winning. Justin is a kind and informative host
A feast for the eyes! This little piece of heaven was a wonderful respite from the city on a winters weekend.   We loved everything about it.

This is as good as it gets! If this place was for sale I would buy it. The location was peaceful and serene, with incredible views. We loved the architecture of the home, the multiple spaces to relax in or take in the views. Sunset saunas we’re a real treat. Wish we could’ve stayed longer…
From the architecture, to the plants chosen, this place is an artwork. Justin and Cameron have been very responsive and friendly. Thanks for opening up this special place to Airbnb community.
We had a great time at this extraordinary place! The house is beyond beautiful and both elegant and cozy in an amazing setting.

Probably the coolest places I stayed in. Justin was very helpful.
The property has amazing views and the coolest furniture

The photos don’t give the house and the  surroundings justice, it has the most beautiful and accomplished interior design. The garden is peacefull and The view is to die for. Misty Cliff is the most beautiful beach in Cape Town. Can look at the sea and surf waves for hours. And most importantly the area and house feels very safe. We will return to Justins house next time we Are in the country. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Such a magical and unique place to stay, Misty cliffs is truly stunning, its incredible to see the sun rise and set every day, walk on the beach and see the kitesurfers work their magic. The house has everything you could wish for and is beautifully decorated. Thank you for a great stay!

We had the most perfect time at Justin's place. It was immaculate and beautiful, incredibly well-appointed (everything from the Babylonstoren hot water bottle through to the incredible art was on point) and our host was so gracious. Please don't hesitate to book for a special weekend away - we'll absolutely be back!

The house was even more beautiful than the pictures. The views. The gardens. Everything was absolutely incredible. It is so peaceful and quiet. Wonderful place to enjoy some down time with friends and family. Would absolutely recommend
I have been around the globe several times and have never stayed anywhere like this home. It was a privilege! Very safe and peaceful. The home is stocked with everything you could ever need. Enjoy!

Justin’s place is one of the most beautiful Airbnbs we’ve ever stayed in. The design and decor are out of this world, and the private tiered garden with manicured gardens, is just breathtaking! It had all the creature comforts we needed for a comfortable stay. A home from home. Thank you for a magical stay!
We will definitely be back! This place has the most amazing view and was just so perfect for our little getaway.

Beautiful house with beautiful views. Yolinda as the host was amazing, we loved the fact that she was in constant communication with us. The welcoming and housekeeping team were lovely and so helpful. Thank you so much for everything.
We are thoroughly happy and looking forward to booking with you again
Xo

The accommodation is beautiful with a stunning view of the beach. It is located in a convenient area so it is value for money. It would help to specify that parking is Pre arranged as we weren't aware so we had to make use of street parking for the first two days. Check in can also be used as an opportunity to show the guest around especially where the pool is located and how to access it. The pool is not in the same yard as the apartment so it would help to highlight that. Some parts of the apartment weren't 100% clean.
Communication post check out can also be more transparent. The agency refuses to share an invoice of the deduction made on the deposit to clean the carpet.

Yolinda was a great host - responsive, helpful, polite. We loved the location right at Clifton #2, great views over Clifton 3 4, across the bay and of the mountain edge. Apartment matched the photos - very clean, well presented, uncluttered.
Would stay again and would definitely highly recommend.

We had a wonderful time, the views of Clifton were spectacular and it was great to be able to walk down to such a beautiful beach from the place.
Thank you!
Very comfortable beds, overall perfect for a family vacation. Victoria Rd is a pretty busy street, so we had to keep the windows shut at night due to car noise but the view is beautiful nonetheless.

Very clean, cozy and comfortable place with all the amenities needed. The hosts were extremely friendly, helpful and offered great advice during our stay. The location is also great and close to nearby stores and restaurants.

This 2-bedrooms unit is in a great
location in a beautiful neighborhood. Check in was very
quick and Nicci was very friendly. I was thankful they provided fresh milk. The unit was very comfortable, and I felt
completely safe. It was so
convenient to be able to do a
load of laundry.
The only downside was lack of wifi. The welcome letter indicated intermittent problems
out of their control, but I only
managed to connect about 5% of the time, and lost connection after a few minutes.
Apart from that, this place is really peaceful, homely and welcoming.
Absolutely beautiful gardens, sweet and cozy little home, and great host! The gardens are truly amazing. We had a great time and would highly recommend!

Nicci and Chris were very helpful and responsive. We loved how neat, clean and organized the house was. We were also particularly pleased to have such reliable WiFi throughout all the house - our daughter in the 2nd bedroom agreed! The garden was just too beautiful for words! One could just see the care and pride the owners took in their place - in every detail. But a stay is not just about the 4 walls or the garden, it's about the people. Nicci was a very kind and giving person who took the time out to ensure that all your questions were answered and that you felt comfortable in her home and in South Africa in general. Her recommendations (when we went away for a 2 day escape) were excellent (as always)!  If we could, we would go back tomorrow....while it may not be tomorrow, we hope to be back some day soon! In a nutshell, it was an excellent home away from home! THANK YOU!

I can highly recommend staying in this cottage! It is located in one of the best areas in Cape Town. A very safe area to stay. The cottage was beautifully decorated, with an outdoor seating area front and back. It had everything we needed. Nicci, the owner, is a very nice lady. She responded almost immediately to my messages.

Perfect accommodation for any couple or small family needing to stay in Constantia.
Spotless, well equipped and overlooking a beautiful garden, this apartment is highly recommended.

We had an amazing week long stay in the guest suite at Nicci’s. Both Nicci and Chris were super friendly and gave us great instruction on everything in the private guest suite as well as helpful information for the area (load shedding schedules, etc). The suite is quite private and my husband loved the window view of their beautiful garden. It was the perfect home base for an amazing week in Cape Town.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay and Nicci was the perfect host, so warm and accommodating. Really couldn't fault the place, it was so beautiful and peaceful.....a great place to unwind after a busy day of sightseeing and enjoying the numerous activities that Cape Town has to offer. It's such a central location and Constantia is so beautiful in its own right.
Thanks so much for having us Nicci and Chris, we really hope to be back soon!

We had a lovely stay with Nicci and Chris. Very welcoming, friendly and accommodating. Our accommodation was lovely, lots of loadshedding implements as well which helped a lot! Definitely worth the stay!

Nikki was a friendly hostess whose house is peaceful and lovely. The garden is beautiful and we were able to swim - all just a wonderful experience. But the location is the most amazing part - in beautiful Constantia surrounded by forests and wine farms. Highly recommended.

Our second stay at Nicci’s place. We had another wonderful three weeks in a comfortable home in a beautiful garden. We enjoyed all that Cape Town and the peninsula has to offer. Nicci and Chris made us very welcome and again we left feeling like family. We will be back.
Lynda & John
We loved our stay, which was close to Newlands and Constantia for 2 Oceans. The unit was neat, clean, very well equipped and the pool was great. We’ll certainly be back
Great location in Constantia, beautiful ground. Nicci is so friendly and helpful, was a lovely stay and would happily do again.

We had a lovely stay at Nicci’s place and felt right at home. It is in a lovely area with a few walking trials.Nicci was also very accommodating in allowing to make a few last minute changes to our reservation.
Thank you Nicci for a lovely stay!! (And your friendliness).

Our travel plans took an unfortunate turn when our flights were cancelled, and I sustained an injury during the 18-hour delay, leaving me unfit to fly.
When I notified Nicci of the situation, she was helpful and supportive. Before our trip, she provided me with a comprehensive list of restaurants, allowing me to research and book a table ahead of our arrival—a thoughtful gesture that I greatly appreciated. Nicci reminded me the following day to cancel my booking through Airbnb in time to recover some of my payment. This was helpful, as I was dealing with intense pain and the overwhelming admin tasks that come with unexpected travel disruptions.
Although we weren’t able to stay at Nicci's property, her kindness, attentiveness, and professionalism before and during this difficult situation lead me to believe that she would have been a good host. Based on my experience, I recommend Nicci as a wonderful, helpful, and polite host.

Beautiful garden & setting.
Cottage very private & clean & very well eqipped.
A definite place to book again

Fantastic stay - wonderful host in a gorgeous location. The place was so clean and functional. Decor is a little old school which is charming and it has everything you need. We’d definitely book again!!!!
Wonderful spot, especially with the extra space and washing machine! Will book in for next year when we return for the next hockey tournament! many thanks 🌻
We had a lively stay at Nicci’s and Chris’ cottage. They are very welcoming and friendly and we had lovely chats. They made us feel welcome.

An absolute gem of a place to stay! The apartment has everything you could need, it’s set in a beautiful location and the host Nicci makes you feel right at home! I’ll definitely be staying here on all future Cape Town visits.

We had such a wonderful stay at Nicci's place that we booked another stay there. That stay was just as enjoyable. The house is clean and nicely furnished and is located in a beautiful part of Cape Town close to Kirstenbosch and Table Mountain. Nicci is a fantastic accommodating host, and a pleasure to talk with. Highly recommend.

Nicci’s communication was excellent and her place was spotless! Highly recommended. Her attention to detail was outstanding - we visited during the winter and had more blankets than we could use as well as a nice touch of hot water bottles on all the beds. Thanks for a lovely visit, Nicci.

We were the first AirBnB visitors who stayed in this lovely cottage and we can highly recommend it for anyone wanting a quiet escape in the lovely Noordhoek. The open-plan lounge and dining room is spacious and tastefully decorated and the view of Chapmans Peak from the patio is beautiful. The bedroom is warm with a very comfortable bed.  I would definitely choose this magic spot again on my next visit to Cape Town!

We absolutely loved staying at Mandy’s cottage. The location was fabulous, private, quiet and easy access to Noordhoek village, Cape Point Vineyards and the beach.
The cottage itself was gorgeous! Very comfortable bed, clean and neat cottage and we loved the beautiful bathroom.
It was so lovely to sit outside on the patio with our morning cup of coffee.
Mandy, herself, is a wonderful host. She answered all my questions quickly and made us feel so welcome.
I highly recommend staying at this cottage. It’s such value for money. We will definitely return!

The cottage is so lovely, with all the amenities you need; very clean, comfy bed, great wifi, amazing shower . Coffee, tea, milk and rusks were appreciated especially for a short stay.  Mandy and Guy were really helpful with advice and even offered lifts if they knew we were going the same way.  Thanks for a great stay.

Beautiful location and accommodation. The hosts were fantastic from the beginning with excellent communication from the start and they were truly welcoming and accommodating. It was an absolute pleasure staying there and we would recommend it to anyone. We hope to be back soon.

Lovely place and beautiful area full of nice local restaurants. A nice quiet space, good for a relaxing weekend away. It is worth knowing that there is an induction stove, in case you plan on bringing something like a mocha pot. Separate entrance was nice, as we could come and go without bothering anyone.

The cottage is really beautiful with small touches that really tell you a lot (of good) about the owners.  We travelled with our dogs and everything about the place really facilitated our trip. I would go back anytime.

Mandy Is a lovely host.  I immediately felt very welcome . The cottage is a delight , with everything you need for a quiet , comfortable  country break . The garden is pretty with indigenous flowers and stunning mountain views .

Lovely stay with spectacular view.
Hosts are very hospitable and really go the extra mile!

We absolutely loved our time at Mandy's cottage. It was a fantastic experience from start to finish. The cottage itself is beautiful, clean and in an incredible location. Mandy went above an beyond as our host, we felt extremely well looked after and her attention to detail was really great. Would highly recommend this spot!

Great cottage. Was clean and accurately described. We will definitely return and highly recommend.
Super friendly, welcoming and communication was great.

Peaceful, tranquil, safe and secure located under the beautiful mountains of Noordhoek.
The cottage is spacious, clean with beautiful views and a lovely patio to enjoy the scenery.
The beach is a 5 minute drive with coffee shops, restaurants and quaint shops along the way.
Mandy, Guy and Miriam made me feel welcome and at home.I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and will definitely be back.
Had a great time. Very well stocked kitchen. Modern bathroom with great shower. Mandy gave us a great recommendation for a nearby market. We'll be back!
A lovely, sunny little cottage for a night or two. Mandy was so incredibly accommodating and so so helpful. A spectacular host. Thank you so much xxx
We had a good night at Mandy's spot in Noordhoek. It had everything we needed and was clean and comfortable. Check in was easy and Mandy was always quick to reply to my queries. Would recommend.
We had a lovely stay at the Noordhoek Cottage. The unit is tastefully decorated, surprisingly spacious, and has a lovely patio with mountain views. Perfect location for a weekend escape.

Absolutely beautiful cottage in a wonderful part of Noordhoek. Very clean and with everything you could need, we so enjoyed our short stay. Very close to local amenities. Mandy communicated well. Can’t complain and would highly recommend.
We had two wonderful days in Nordhoek a very quiet and lovely place. The small apartment has everything we needed. Thank you 😊

Our stay at the cottage was so lovely. The location is peaceful with beautiful surroundings. Close to great restaurants. The cottage was clean and neat and Mandy was so responsive to our messages. We will definitely be back ☀️

Perfect spot for a little getaway. Mandy was super host and understanding of our needs and flexible in a late checkout, which was very kind.
My only regret is that we didn’t stay longer to really soak up the space.
What a beautiful, peaceful spot! Mandy is a great host and very responsive. Will definitely recommend and stay again.
Great stay! Provided coffee, milk and cold water. Great location for if you have a wedding in the surrounding area.

This was my second time staying here and it is a really perfect place. It’s very spacious and Mandy is super responsive!! She allowed me to check in quite early. She also leaves you in private which is great. Really stunning place, highly recommend it

Great location, close to all nearby attractions. Clean, modern and great attention to detail.
We loved our stay and would happily return in future.
Thank you Mandy x
Mandys cottage is a gem. Perfect if you’re traveling on your own. It’s very cozy and has a lovely terrace as well as green, calm surroundings. Definitely recommended!

place is great and very spacious.

The place is beautiful, clean and close to beach. The view is amazing. The place is im quite area suitable for one who love to relax and enjoying beath taking view of ocean and table moutain. The housr cleaning is very good. Rick (host) is very helpful and corprative. definately coming back again.

The apartment is very well kept. Everything you need and more. Beds are very comfortable, apartment is clean and we had a lovely stay. Safe area with beautiful views over the ocean from the balconies. I will definitely visit again.

We love this property.  It is our best relaxing spot.  Best position almost on the beach.  Marcelle is a generous host who left goodies for us, wine, biscuits, fruit as well as every amenity necessary.  Can’t wait for our next stay.

Shannon was the perfect host! She met us in the lobby and walked us through a brief registration process. The apartment was exactly as described and you can’t beat the views. Plenty of restaurants within walking distance and the beach was literally across the street.
As international travelers we were not super familiar with load shedding so just be prepared for the electricity to go out a couple of times a day. The TV and internet work on a generator so they didn’t go out.
Overall, this was an incredible stay and we were sad to leave. Highly recommend this place!!! 5 stars:)
Beautiful apartment with excellent facilities and luxuries linens and towels. Coffee, tea, sugar and milk provided.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Thank you!
Had a really good, peaceful time. Jade was always responsive, friendly and pro-active. This space is highly recommended.

We enjoyed our stay at Jade's place.
The accommodation was clean and suited us perfectly.

May is such an amazing host, and I really enjoyed my stay at her place. The place is located in a quiet, convenient, and beautiful location. The Blue Cafe is just a walking distance from the flat with great food and ambience, suitable for both a relaxing time or working while sipping a good coffee. The flat is very clean and comfortable, with a great view of the city and surrounding hills from the balcony. May was so generous and extremely helpful with many things (from tips on places to visit to providing me with valuable information for some of my work)! May really went to great length to ensure I had a comfortable stay. Indeed, I was so comfortable staying at her place and extremely enjoyed our conversations. Overall, it is a great place for an amazing price with an extremely generous host. This was by far the best experience I have had in booking and staying in an Airbnb, and I will most certainly book May's place again the next time I am in Cape Town.

I felt really welcome and May treated me like a good friend. Sit on the balcony , have a cup of coffee , there is a wonderful view over the City and to Signal Hill .
I liked the room very much , the bed was very comfortable and the neighbourhood is clean and safe. Kloof Street with various locations is a 5 to 10 minutes walk and you are in the middle of fine bars and restaurants. To visit Waterfront or the beach at Camps Bay , call a Uber/Taxi and enjoy a perfect day.

It was one of my best airbnb-experiences — I stayed at May’s place for a whole month, and really enjoyed it. May is very interesting person, with great taste in art (her flat is so beautiful!), very kind, hospital, caring. She made my stay unforgettable. Hope to visit her place again one day.

May's listing is a real home-away-from-home! In the original spirit of Airbnb, this epitomises home sharing. Our hostess, May, is so welcoming and easy-going, making us feel very comfortable in her home.
The small kitchen is fully equipped, the lounge is comfortable and the balcony offers fantastic views of the city - great location!
May offers useful information on places to go and where to eat - much appreciated.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay with May, and can highly recommend this spot to her future guests.

I had a wonderful stay with Maggie. I was there for several months and I really liked the apartment, location and living together. The room was as described and the view from the balcony was indescribable. Maggie was very helpful at all times and I felt very safe and at home there. We had lots of great conversations and I really appreciated my time there. I can only recommend the accommodation and really miss the feeling of home.
Had such a lovely stay with May - she went out of her way to make me feel comfortable. Would definitely stay again!

May is one of the nicest person I’ve met while traveling. The moment I stepped into her apartment it felt like home. I felt very safe and May had so many recommendations for the area. The room and the apartment itself is filled with so much love and is so cozy. I will definitely come back. Thank you!!!

May is a wonderful host and I enjoyed our chats and learning from her.
The room was perfect, had a desk for me to work at and the bed was so comfortable.
thank you May for all the snacks and food.
I am looking forward to staying again with you in the future!
What an unforgettable trip! The house was clean, beautiful, and cozy. May is so warm and kind—she helped me a lot and recommended amazing cafes and local snacks. Every day here was nice and happy.

I truly felt at home here. May is such a kind and thoughtful host she went above and beyond to help me, even carrying my luggage. Her hospitality made my stay so comfortable and welcoming. I only wish I could have stayed longer at her place!
It was a pleasant stay, Michael answered questions very promptly and the staff was very helpful and friendly.

I truly enjoyed staying at Michael’s guesthouse, I truly felt like at home since the first moment and he is a very kind and gentle person, giving recommendations and caring that everything goes fine. As well all the staff and team at the house is very friendly and positive, truly a great place to stay!!
We loved this centrally located cottage in Newlands! Fully equipped and self contained  and there are great restaurants in walking distance. We would love to come back.

This is our second time back to the property, and we loved it as much as the first.
This time around, we stayed in the ‘Koi Pond Cottage’, a private, secure and cosy cottage with access to the pool and a braai.
The property is central and scenic, with great views of Table Mountain and fantastic, lovely, kind hosts in Wynand and Benita! They checked in with us regularly to ensure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. This property has definitely become our accommodation of choice when visiting Cape Town. It’s a great stay, and I highly rate it.

We had a great 10 day stay. Innocent, who welcomed us, was amazing and friendly and nothing and nothing was too much trouble for him. Exceptional quality king size bed and bedding was a big plus. Very private luxury accommodation.
Great stay! The apartment met all our expectations. We always felt warm and welcome and being free from loadshedding troubles was an added plus. Would definitely recommend and return ourselves.

We highly recommend this place. Wynand is an excellent host and Innocent was also very friendly, supportive and welcoming. We liked the privacy of our room, the beautiful area and easy access to main motorways.
Wynand's cottage is charming and peaceful. He was also very accommodating with check-in/out times and always responded to our questions quickly. Will definitely stay here again.

We went to take part in The Two Oceans Ultra Marathon and the place was perfectly situated for the start, finish and great restaurants. Close to shopping centers so we didn’t need a car except to get to the airport

I’ve stayed at Wynand and Betina’s place in Cape Town many times, and it never disappoints. The property is absolutely lovely, secure, and beautifully maintained. It’s clear that a lot of care and effort goes into keeping everything in top condition. Whenever I go to Cape Town, this is my place of choice. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful and comfortable stay in Cape Town, with the mountain as your backdrop!
Another fantastic stay. Beautiful cottage, had everything that we needed and more. Wynand is a wonderful host and we enjoyed our time very much. This cottage is highly recommended.

Great place to stay in the Southern Suburbs - close to shops/restaurants and freeway to both city centre and beaches
Accommodation was very comfortable , with lots of cupboard space.
It was lovely staying at Wynand’s place in Newlands. It had everything we needed and felt very safe. Wynand was very helpful with our inquiries. Would love to come back :)

This gem in Newlands is perfectly located to both relax in a leafy haven and walk to enjoy a bit of the neighbourhood restaurants and shops. The apartment was spotless , had all the necessities and more and the host was responsive and friendly. We especially enjoyed watching the fish in the pond every morning. We would recommend and visit again

Wynand was a perfect host, friendly, very helpful and responsive.  Also the housekeeper, Innocent (!!) was similarly very customer friendly and helpful.  The apartment itself was well-equipped but maybe would benefit from a slight upgrade here and there. Also there is a little road noise, inevitable because of the very accessible location.  Those two things are the only reasons we gave it an overall 4 stars rather than 5.  It is very good value for money.
We thoroughly enjoyed staying at this BnB. Wynand was an amazing and friendly host. The accommodation is conveniently located and very comfortable. We will be back

Wynand's little cottage was a real treat, exactly what I expected and needed!  Lovely cost little place, has all you need and felt right at home.  Pity my stay was so sort!  A perfect host and will definitely be back!!

Thanks for being a great host, we enjoyed our stay, low budget with 5 stars value, few mins to beach front and shops, with easy transportation to anywhere, with the welcome champagne that wasn't expected :)
Thank you so much for the host once again !
This is a awesome place and secure environment we feel at home immidiately we check in,I will definitely be here again .

What an amazing time in Cindys and Marks place in Parkland/Cape Town ! This stay far exceeded my expectations! Starting with a very warm welcome I immediately felt like home. The apartment is gorgeous, very cozy and comfortable furnishings - a real oasis of wellbeing! The place also offers the garden and pool area to use which is a welcome change on a hot summer day! Location is great situated as well - close to shops, public transport, beach and you even reach the city in less then 20 minutes.
I couldn't have asked for more and I'm thankful for the great time! Wish family Hennig just the best and will definitely come back one day to say hi ! Stay as great as you are - warm regards Björn
We had a wonderful time ,we loved the privacy and the host's are very welcoming,I'm definitely coming back again

Lovely immaculate Air BnB, what you see in the pictures is exactly what you get. You will deal with Mark who is lovely and his communication is speedy and they will try and accommodate requests.
Good location and Ubers to the waterfront and table mountain and Cape Town are reasonable and plenty.
They are excellent hosts. They had great communication with me prior to my visit and that made me feel at ease. The actual accommodation, was a lovely living space and spacious.

i enjoyed my stay the place is neat and well looked after,nice and quiet area free wifi and the furniture inside is new and big tv I'll recommend a friend to go especially couple if i go back to cape town ill book that place argain.

We had a great time, thank you! The condo is as described, clean, easy self check-in, private garage, clean, amenities provided. we appreciated the blankets for the cooler nights and lanterns for loadshedding. The views are amazing. It's about a 30 min drive to the city center of Cape town, without traffic. Would definitely recommend it to everyone. Communication with Bianca was effortless, and she was always available.

This is a wonderful property in an equally wonderful location. Not only do you get to be by the ocean, but you have a clear view of the famous Table Mountain. Conveniently located in terms of surrounding activity, places to eat, and for the runners out there nice trail a few meters up the road along the freeway.
It is a bit out of the city so more peacful and quiet, just sounds of the ocean. But a 15 - 20 min drive and you're in the heart of CPT. A solid choice all around.

Such a stunning space. The pictures don’t do it justice:). It was super clean and super cozy with Beautiful views of the city and the mountain and placed close enough to reach almost everything.
Dillons communication was great and the little touches in the house made it a really warm stay.
Absolutely loved being there and will happily return to it for another escape sometime soon😊😊😊

Dillon is a super responsive and flexible host. Check in is super easy and we could stay until end of day in the apartment.
We stay for ~2 weeks and worked remotely from his place. We thought it would be two separate rooms but it's not really separate which wasnt great for us. However wifi coverage & speed is good, kitchen has all most basics things and the power outages never interrupted work since the generators are really good.

Great apartment in a great location. Beautiful views of Table Mountain and Devils peak. Close to everything you could possibly need.
Will definitely be coming back to Cape Town and booking this apartment again.
Highly recommended

Dillon and Lichelle have always been available from check-in to check-out.
The apartment was really nice and close to many shops/restaurants. The parking inside the building is also very convenient for those who have a car.
We would come back for sure, thanks again !

Very nice , very clean apartment in De Waterkant .
I loved the very good boxspring kingsize bed and the very good equipped kitchen .
Highly recommended

Thank you, Dillon and Lichelle! I truly enjoyed my stay, from the seamless check-in to the complimentary weekly deep cleaning. I felt right at home, and your communication was top-notch. I appreciate everything and look forward to staying with you again!

Thank you Diane for your hospitality.
I was very happy and extremely comfortable in your wonderful BnB.
The little touches were noticed and appreciated, your honesty bar a great idea.
Location ideal
This property comes highly recommend
This is the perfect place to rest and the only problem is the flat is so lovely you don't want to leave!!!!!
Lovely, clean space for anyone looking for a convenient spot to stay in the Southern Suburbs!

This space was great! I was in CPT for work and staying here made it easy to get all the work I needed to get done, done. Diane was a fantastic host and I had more than everything I needed. Its the little details that made my stay even better than I expected.

Lovely accommodation. Location is very safe and had beautiful views of the mountain.
You are also very close to UCT

Diane really went the extra miles.
Welcomed us with extra spoils and going through a lot more trouble to accommodate us.
We were met, and experienced way more kindness and care.
These qualities and gestures is a rare find.
Thank you Diane, for everything.
Take care and hope to visit again.

Wonderful place to stay with everything you could wish for.
Lovely weekend spent in CT.

Thanks for a great stay Diane. It is a very nice place with great privacy!The house is so clean and tidy with the best hospitality from Diane.
We will defenitely be back
Great host! Amazing communication and is very helpful <3. She let me move my check-out time to accommodate my needs, and she’s very understanding

Thanks for a great stay Diane.  We felt very welcome and enjoyed our short stay.  The accommodation is clean and comfortable with a small, private garden which was a lovely space to sit in the morning and evening.  We particularly enjoyed the use of your pool during the heat wave.  The small kitchen is very useful for longer stays.
I would recommend the place to anyone who wants to visit Cape Town.The area is safe and close to most shops
Diane was an extremely generous and accommodating host, and staying in her space was an absolute pleasure. The flatlet was lovely, and a real home away from home. Would thoroughly recommend.

What a beautiful place!!! Easy access from the airport and the location is splendid. Check in was easy and Dianne accommodated us at such short notice we appreciate that. All the little things in the place made the experience so wonderful, your little honesty bar was a highlight after a long flight in to Cape Town. Thank you!
Great stay. Neat as a pin, central and safe. Honesty bar and tuck shop is very convenient. Highly recommended!
Diane was very warm and welcoming checking is in. place was neat and clean and just what we needed. was nice to have a little outside patio
This is a lovely place and is real value for money. I especially liked the ethics of trust and care. Will definitely be back.
Fantastic stay - lovely clean space, great value for money, perfect, safe location. Would definitely stay here again.
This is a very safe and quiet neighborhood,  I really enjoyed my stay. I received a warm welcome from Diane and the place was nicely prepared for me.
My stay was short, but worth it. I'll definitely go back. Diane's response was prompt and friendly and I loved that. She was very accommodating with my check in time.

Such a lovely little place to spend my night ! Clean and comfy. Great shower and the welcome chocolate was much appreciated !
A definite recommendation to friends.
The place was really comfortable and felt like home. Amazing hosts who greeted me on arrival and wentbthrough everything. I would definitely stay at Di's place again

I liked staying here, it was a bit far from city centre than I would’ve liked as a first time Cape Town traveller but the quiet and safe feel of the area was also nice to come back to.
There were small details that she has that really made it a “come again” place that I really appreciated.
Overall great host, very responsive and welcoming
Really nice place to stay. Modern apartment with everything you need. Situated in an awesome area and very modern and safe block.
Very central, well planned and luxurious flat. Good security with parking. Walk to V&A. Self admission into your own private flat for your stay. Loved it.

Incredibly clean, amazing location - SO close to pretty much everything so Ubers didn't cost a lot to get around. What a comfortable bed, modern bathroom and absolutely stunning rooftop pool & area! Check-in & out was so easy & efficient. Stunning view of Table Mountain from the balcony. Smart TV, washing machine, hair dryer - you name it. Super stay! Rebecca
Great location. Very comfy bed. Awesome pool area. Very busy apartment block. Mirror outside of the bathroom much needed.
Scotty’s place was absolutely amazing! He was extremely helpful, the staff was friendly and the apartment was centrally located. I enjoyed my stay and will be coming back !

Scotty’s place is located near to Cape Quarter and ideal for those want to be near great bars and restaurants.
The apartment is small and only ideal for one person or a couple, it has a beautiful roof top with a braai facility and pool offering great views of the city. The WiFi was excellent in the property and an added bonus was the Netflix subscription!
Scotty had great communication and was helpful in having an broken iron replaced for me but at this price housekeeping should be included.
Overall a nice stay.
We really enjoyed our stay in Cape Town. Thank you so much you such a beautiful place with a beautiful view.
Exceptional view, the apartment is modern and has everything you need, good wifi, highly recommend!

Excellent location, close to walking distance to V&A Waterfront.
Very clean and neat, exactly as described in the listing.
Personal touches added i.e. rusks, coffee, welcome note.
Check-in process requires improvement to ensure outstanding experience.
Will be happy to return if this is resolved going forward.

Scotty’s place was perfect! It was adorable and the view from the balcony…. unreal! The apartment is on the smaller side, but it’s really all you need when you’re traveling and out and about all day. It’s super close to V&A and walking distance to just about anything. We felt super safe here and check in and out was a breeze. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Lovely place to stay with great views from both the balcony and public pool. Put our minds at ease with 24hour security! Would definetly book again

Enjoyed a great 8 night stay at Scotty's place. The apartment was clean on arrival, and looks wise was identical to photos posted on Airbnb. Bonus park was the secure parking space that accompanied the apartment.
The building is secure, with 24hr concierge/security on hand, all of whom were incredibly friendly and helpful.
The area itself De Waterkant is in walking distance of Cape Town city centre, and the V&A Waterfront, where one can find lots to do.
Scotty remained extremely responsive throughout, always being on hand to answer any enquiries.
I will be staying at one of Scotty's places when I next return to Cape Town, and highly recommend that you do too!
Great location for the Cape Town Cycle tour , this will be our go to spot from now on 👍right in the middle of the Start and Finish.
A great and comfortable place to stay equipped with everything you need. Diane is a wonderful host and is always available to assist.

We had a great stay at Diane's place. The flat was private and had all the amenities as listed. Diane checked in to make sure all was OK and if we needed anything. She also sent us the loadshedding schedule every day which was great so we could plan ahead. We were also allowed an early check-in which helped so much. We will definitely be back.
A really comfy and secure spot. It was also super convenient and well-equipped. Diana was a lovely host. Would definitely book again!

I absolutely enjoyed staying at Diane's lovely airbnb. I am greatly impressed by the beautiful home away from home, location, cleanliness, and privacy. Safe, secure, and central neighbourhood to walk, excercise, and commute. The stunning views of the mountain was a bonus. I fully agree with all the previous reviews. Thank you so much Di, for being a 5-star host and going the extra mile. You are super!

This place is in a nice area and convenient for a quick work stay if you are not spending time there. The entrance is through a garage. It’s best for someone who just needs to sleep and go. Diane was kind enough to let me have a late check out which was really helpful for a late afternoon flight.

We spent two nights at Diane’s place. It very clean, comfortable and private. We slept with the double doors open and the fan on. Peaceful comfortable nights. Coffee on the verandah with a little Mountain View. Dianne provided tea,coffee,milk. There was a microwave but we did not use it as we ate out.
We were grateful for the security of being able to park inside the property as we did no have to offload all our stuff in the car. Dianne kept contact with us all the time. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Diane was amazing, great communication… great check in and tour around the place, then you have your freedom and comfort for the rest of your stay … thanks Diane
A lovely place to stay with a very central location to most places in cape town. A lovely suburb. Enjoyed the stay and place

I had a fantastic stay, and will definitely return next time in Cape Town. Diane was quick to respond and also reached out to me with information which was great. I felt right at home and would recommend staying here if you are looking in the area.
Apartment was not clean at all, mould/needs a deep clean - very disappointing. Host was not very helpful in resolving issues.

The apartment was ideally located and easy to find. The check-in instructions weren't quite accurate as we didn't have keys or a keycard from reception, instead the keycard is obtainable from the lockbox and unlocks the door.
The apartment didn't feel as clean as it could be, there was some stray, suspicious hairs in the bathroom, bedroom and wardrobe and there weren't any cleaning cloths. We also had to purchase our own hand soap and toilet rolls. At one point we dropped something on the floor and swept up and when I swept the rug a lot of grey dust came off which would suggest it isn't vacuumed very often.
Overall we had a pleasant stay and the location is fantastic with super friendly reception staff.

The apartment is well secured and conveniently located in De waterkant. This is close to the centre and the waterfront.
It has a beautiful view of table mountain.
The space is a little smaller than what I feel comfortable. I travelled alone, but with a partner it might get a bit cramped.
The kitchen is sufficiently equipped.
I found the shower is little small. Shampoo and shower gel provided.
There is an aircon in the bedroom. The bed is very comfortable.
The security is strict and guests should check in. No guests allowed after 22:00.
Convenient parking in the basement.
Everything was clean.
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the apartment. The accommodations were excellent, and it truly made my time here memorable.

Scotty is an absolute gem of a host. would definitely recommend booking this space. im definitely booking this space again.
thank you Scott

Wow👌 A place of definite recommendation. Lovely host who had very clear instructions for self check-in,  beautiful and clean apartment as described by the host. Situated in a very peaceful neighborhood not far from shopping centres and fine restaurants. We made use of the rooftop and pool area,which sealed the whole trip. We're definitely coming back to Scotty's.
Great spot to stay for a business trip, overlooking the CBD and very well located in Greenpoint.
A really enjoyable stay. Would definitely recommend this place to others and will be visiting again in the near future.

I really enjoyed my recent stay in this beautifully decorated apartment. The balcony with a view was a lovely bonus, and the location is excellent—just a short distance from the Waterfront, Cape Quarter Shopping Mall, Mouille Point, and central Cape Town.
Check-in on arrival was smooth, and the apartment was clean and ready for my stay. The kitchen is stocked with basic utensils and cutlery, along with complimentary coffee and tea, which was a thoughtful touch.
This apartment is a great choice for a solo traveller or a couple, whether you're visiting for business or leisure. I would definitely book this apartment again in the future.
Despite all the challenges Bianca was very responsive and incredibly kind. Great place and very peaceful, I would definitely book it again.

Our stay at Bianca’s Airbnb in Cape Town was absolutely wonderful! The apartment is perfectly located right in the heart of the city, making it super convenient to explore all the top attractions, cafes, and waterfront spots. Despite being so central, the building is incredibly secure and offers smooth, easy access...something we truly appreciated.
The space itself has such a warm, cosy vibe that instantly made us feel at home. It’s thoughtfully set up, well-maintained, and ideal for couples or solo travellers looking for comfort and style at a very reasonable price.
Bianca was a fantastic host.. responsive, kind, and made sure everything was perfect for our stay. We couldn't have asked for a better experience and would 100% recommend this lovely place to anyone visiting Cape Town. Thank you, Bianca, for a memorable stay! 💛
It was the perfect location, peaceful and practical. The accomodation had everything I needed. I would definitely recommend and will look to stay there again when next in CT.
Great stay! Well equipped, lots of plugs with all the necessary adapters and those towels smell amazing! Diane is kind and very welcoming.

Great place to stay , extremely easy to get to the inner city without a hassle.
Very well looked after and clean.
Was very happy at Diane's b&b, and she went out of her way to ensure that I'm comfortable. well worth it!!

We loved Diane's Airbnb, it was small enough to feel cozy but big enough to feel like you weren't being boxed in. It's beautifully decorated and furnished.
The shower was so beautiful that I would love to have figured out how to transport it to my house back in Joburg haha.
We would have loved to have used the private verandah if it hadn't been raining.
Our only gripe was the skylight in the bedroom, as if you're a light-sensitive sleeper like me, it makes it difficult to fall asleep as there's light coming through into the room both at night and even more so once the sun is up. But if you're normal, like my boyfriend, it's manageable.
Comfortable and conveniently situated. Diane responded to my queries and was helpful.  Accommodation is equipped with essential items.

Zeena is the best host based on my experience. Proactive on suggestions and what’s happening around the area. Responds promptly. Clear instructions. Clean and clutter free apartment. 5 minutes walk to the mall. The building has a gym, swimming pool and Spa. Great value for money.

Had a fantastic visit stay place was clean and immaculate.
Would 100% stay again

Loved the stay and Zeena is an amazing host and responds very quickly to any query.
Can't recommend more.

Unit is perfectly located to walk to canal walk. The place is pretty old, needs a revamp, but fairly clean. It gets hot in the bed room, opening the window attracts mosquitoes, for which there is no spray. Someone comes in to replace towels, and if you are not home, there is no safe to lock up valuables, so you will have to carry all that with. I requested a hair dryer and did not receive one.

Compact and comfortable, just slightly larger than the average hotel room but with every facility to make your stay enjoyable. The bed and bedding were extremely comfortable and I slept very soundly. I was a bit worried that the unit would be noisy, but despite being nestled between two others and with a car park at the back I never heard the neighbours, and there were very few vehicle movements in the evenings. I liked the gate remote control which lets you in to the main gate and in and out of either of the two pedestrian gates to the sea front with stunning views over Cape Town and Table Mountain. A 15-20 minute walk up the coast provides great restaurants and coffee bars, while down the coast even more restaurants and a choice of supermarkets.

the location is awesome if you know cape town no need for too much explanation. the place is really small, for two people only, but is safe and secure. check in is ready and flexible. the shower could have more pressure and longer as there is a step right in front and you only catch half of the shower, maybe personal preference.

Suitable place for a quick visit or business trip. Neat and clean. There are pots and pans but no stove so microwave comes in handy. The units above and next to this unit can be loud. Next door unit guy smokes every 5 minutes right outside the bathroom window (which is frosted glass with no blinds) which makes it a bit uncomfortable whenever you are in the bathroom.

This home truly is luxury comfort. As a family, we felt that we truly were on vacation due to the wonderful convenience experienced,from the downstairs shops & restaurants to the immaculate place itself. Great value for money.
Great modern living with ocean views. Very close to good food! Conveniently located adjacent a shopping center for basics.

When you walk in, your heart feels at home… Beautifully decorated and curated with sophisticated touches…. Quality of the home has not spared.. the tv is huge! The The couch was probably the best couch I’ve ever sat on… The beds were high quality comfort and soft sheets… all this is met with a spectacular uninterrupted view of the ocean…
This place is incredibly convenient with the mall just a quick walk down the stairs and a beautiful quite beach just across the road.
Our hostess was so friendly and helpful to us.
I cannot recommend this beautiful apartment enough!

A modern apartment conveniently located in the ‘Harbour Bay’ development with amazing sea views. Support from Tarryn and Sian during our stay was excellent.
We particularly appreciated that the apartment was equipped to a high standard with everything you will need for a comfortable stay. The WiFi was fast with good coverage and the apartment comes with two secure parking spaces.

What a great stay at Sian's place! In the right spot, great view and very clean!
Would highly recommend!
The apartment was very spacious, clean and easy to find. All amenities were very close by and very useful being inside a shopping mall

A beautiful home, right at the doorstep of the ocean, offering beautiful views and the peaceful sound of the waves. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here. I got to recharge and everything that I needed from a food & beverage perspective was conveniently located via an elevator that provided direct access to the local shopping mall.

We really enjoyed our stay at Sian's apartment. It is a large, clean space.
It is attached to a mall so when you leave the apartment there is a great health food store and some decent restaurants.
Excellent modern well equipped apartment at a great location with a nice host! The ocean view is amazing.

Great apartment conveniently located near walkable shopping. Good view as well. Only surprised there is a charge per person after the first two adults, but it worked out fine for us. Much appreciated. Would return in the future!

Genuinely a lovely experience. The apartment is super chic and has everything you could possibly need for a short or long stay. The amenities are great,  parking and security are an extra comfort and the views are just spectacular.
Sian’s place is in a great location - shops & restaurants are just downstairs, and the view of the bay is great. The place was clean and well equipped. Would recommend.
Sian was an outstanding host with perfect communication throughout. The unit was clean and exactly as it looks in the pictures! Would stay again anytime!
Beautiful view, very comfortable place. Would have benefited from aircon or fans as it got quite hot. We would definitely come for another stay.

Spacious and comfortable, with all the amenities needed for a self-catering stay! Simone's place is quiet and secluded but very conveniently located for access to Cape Town and Constantia as well as Hout Bay. Wonderful hosts - we'll be back!

The photos do not do this wonderful flat justice! Simone & Gabi were EXCEPTIONAL hosts. This flat is ideal for longer stays and feels like a well-kitted home-away-from-home. Llandudno beach is a very short drive away. I'd return in a heartbeat!

We had the most wonderful time at the Dolphin lodge.
The views are spectacular from the terrace, where you can bbq, watch the sunset and if you are lucky, even spot whales.
Communication was quick and supportive and both Walther and Uschi tried to make the stay unique.
One time the the dishwasher didn’t work, but Walther made sure that the very next morning someone came to fix it. We were 2 couples that were working remotely, so be aware that you can’t have too many devices logged into the Wi-Fi at the same time - once logged in the Wi-Fi is great though.
We got some lovely suggestions on what to do around the area and yet appreciated that the apartment was a bit secluded and close to the beach.
We’d happily come again, thanks so much :)

We stayed at Chris’ place and we absolutely love Llandudno. So the view from the terrace throughout the whole day is just breathtaking. You won’t get enough of it. The beds were comfortable and it was clean. Chris himself is also a very polite and warm host. However the furniture isn’t really modern - felt more like it’s from 20 years ago. Also there was no vacuum cleaner nor a washing machine. We stayed for a week and therefore would have loved to wash our clothes and vacuum the apartment. Chris’ mother lives next to the apartment. She is a nice lady, but we somehow felt observed by her; for e.g. she commented not to take out the chair from inside out to the terrace during the day. It’s just maybe a small thing, but it’s not giving a good and comfortable feeling. To summarise, we thought it was a little pricey for the accommodation.

We spent 5 wonderful nights at Chris's . From the day of arrival to departure Chris and his Mom were very welcoming, friendly and helpful.
The flat is 100% as described with the most incredible view of Llandudno Beach and it's sunsets from the spacious verandah.
Just a short 5 min walk and you are at the beach and less than 10min drive to Hout Bay for all your grocery needs.
Make sure you take a walk to the lookout point on the rocks - amazing!!
We will definitely miss those views and the fantastic hospitality at Chris's - thank you so much!
One of the best apartments I’ve stayed in Cape Town. Amazing 360 view from the rooftop pool.

the apartment is amazing! located in the heart of the city. everything is reachable within a couple or minutes. the rooftop is the highlight of the location. Scarlett is an amazing host, she did everything for us!
A modern flat, conveniently close to the V&A waterfront. The pool is a bit small though and Scarlett was slow to respond. Otherwise no complaints.
Very nice apartment with great amenities, very clean, and conveniently located! Scarlett was also very responsive and easy to communicate with.

Wow Awesome Awesome Awesome
that's all I can say.
so beautiful and the Hostesses was great

I stayed here for a month while working remotely and it was perfect! The location is great as it's walking distance to both the Waterfront and the city, and if you want to go for a longer walk you can walk to Seapoint. The building is well managed with 24/7 concierge and I felt safe the whole time as a solo traveller. The apartment was super clean and had everything you could possibly need. I'd definitely stay again!

My stay at Alana's place was nothing short of perfect. The house is set on a very idyllic pice of nature in Cape town. Facing both the mountain and the sea, I could not have asked for better views. The house itself is gorgeously unique and the pod I slept in was the most adorable place I've been in, in a while. With the modern finishes against the natural backdrop, it was simply superb.
The host was very nice too. Friendly, Helpful and informative... Wonderful lady.
Lastly, that natural jacuzzi outside the pod is EVERYTHING! :)
This is an absolutely amazing unit with a great view. Alana was a wonderful host and gave us some great recommendations for restaurants and things to do. Would highly recommend staying here.
A beautiful little cabin with everything we needed. The views are great, as is the location. We just wish we had stayed for longer, to make use of the outside braai area.
Alanas as place is a beautiful pod in a fantastic location and stunning veiws! Alana was a great host and communicated well helping us out with any problems we had
What an incredible accommodation! The pod was so relaxing and comfortable, we really didn't want to leave. The outdoor bath and the view were stunning and our favourite features.

The view was lovely from this Airbnb but we struggled with how cold it was in the pod— there was a fireplace but, without even turning it on, it carried a really strong smoke smell that lingered during our stay. Alana did offer a steam clean which helped for a day or so. Separately, this is a suitable Airbnb for a getaway but we didn’t realize how removed it was from the city center so plan to spend time in and around Hout Bay during your time here.

Gorgeous gorgeous place
Just as in the pictures with a 30 min drive to Camps Bay and a very detailed and helpful guide book provided for other interests
Would definitely revisit

We had a great stay at Alana in the Fynbos. The view was amazing, the location is perfect and everything you need (and more) was there.
Thanks for the nice stay, we'll recommend this place to our friends for sure.

Alana's beautiful home was situated in the most picturesque setting. It was clean and comfortable, with the most spectacular view. The only minor issues were a lack of amenities: only a few tea bags, only one sachet of milk and no other snacks - bare minimum - so pack some bits! There was also no hair shampoo supplied which we would have expected. It was also unfortunate that the outdoor bath and shower could not be used as there was not much privacy. Other than that, a perfect stay!

The Fynbos Pod is a very cosy, lovely and stylish tiny house with a great view! It‘s situated in a nice area. We felt safe and secure. It offers everything to feel at home with great architecture and design. Perfect place to be!
Alana is a great host. She responds very friendly and helpful. Communication was always enjoyable and timely.
We enjoyed our stay very much and would love to come back some day!
A stunning and unique stay! Enjoyed the little fireplace, the breathtaking views, and no loadshedding😂 thanks to the inverter. Even though only a 1 night stay it was so enjoyable!
Absolutely gorgeous spot in a wonderful neighborhood. The big windows and incredible views will make it hard to stay almost anywhere else. Highly recommend.
We loved staying with Alana. She has created such a beautiful place which we would love to come back to anytime! Thank you for being the great host that you are!

Our stay at the Fynbos Pod was absolutely amazing. The place is stunning with beautiful surroundings. Alana is also an amazing host, very friendly, thorough and helpful! Thanks Alana for the great stay

This was such a great find! Alana communicated with me throughout and was available for any questions we had. She had a very detailed notebook with everything we might need in the days we were there as well as a list of activities, e-hailing services and top restaurants in the area.

Wow, wow, wow, the pictures do not do this place any justice. First and foremost, it’s bigger than what you see in the images and it is SO BEAUTIFUL!!! I loved every single thing about my stay. The inside, out experience is just magical and the beautiful pets that wonder around the property make the stay even that much enjoyable. The chicken that always comes around the say, “hi”, was the superstar, honestly. Alana gives you the privacy you wish for, but the responsiveness you deserve.
I will definitely be back, I’m so happy I stumbled upon this mystical stay, as it was everything and more!!!
If you just want to escape the mundane, this is the place to do that!
The place was okay but not really what I expected of it cause there was some problem with our TV and bathroom

The place is amazing. Security is above average. One of three things wrong is, the apartment is very cold. This doesn't help that the aircon wasn't working. But that is mentioned in the advert about the place.
The draconian rules of NO VISITORS is ridiculous. This is however in the rules sent to you before.
There is also a window that has the light signage behind it. This window does not have a curtain or blind. So the light from the sign shines on the bed the whole night.
Over and above those 3 things, I would stay there again.
Propr was great with communication and they responded to messages quickly. If those 3 things were fixed it's would be perfect.

Beautiful apartment but not clean. The floor by the couch had so much dirt and dust. The cushions and tv blanket smelled horrible, as if they weren’t cleaned for months. Other than that, had a good stay.
Nice Apartment just Head to want 2 days for my Keycard for The elevator cause the forgot it

Breathtaking scenery! By far one of the best airbnbs I’ve had the privilege to visit. Alana is really an amazing and outstanding host, I had a few special requests and she made it all possible. I would highly recommend the Airbnb for one if you’re looking for a romantic getaway with your beloved and secondly Alana as a host, simply superb.
