One of the most relaxing stays I’ve ever had. This is what you want to get out of the hectic city and enjoy a nice stay. Don’t hesitate to just take a shower outside underneath the stars, or take a warm wood-burned bath while your Braai is heating up.

We had such a wonderful stay in Alana’s cabin! It has everything you need for a comfy and relaxing stay. We particularly loved the views from the cabin and enjoyed walks on the mountain just a few steps from the front door. It was the most peaceful and relaxing weekend, the perfect way to celebrate my birthday.
Really special place. Lying on the comfy bed overlooking the spectacular views and listening to the nature sounds was special and memorable.

Peaceful modern cabin perfect for a couple traveling. The space is really well integrated into the nature and surrounds and feels very private. Located walking distance from an incredible sunset view from the dunes. Thank you so much for the stay!
We had a wonderful stay and wish we could stay longer! Our host was very helpful when we had special requests and went the extra mile! Beautiful location

Thank you so much for welcoming us into your space. It was peaceful and we truly felt at home. It gets really hot at night but that fan helped us so much! Thank you once again we really enjoyed our stay.

Clyphia Close Cabin is an incredible place to stay. Exceptionnal location hidden in the middle of sand dunes and moutains, stunning view and light inside the cabin, beautifully decorated. Communication was very easy, fluid and lots of great recommandations such as the restaurant Quentin. Would highly recommend !
Incredible stay! The apartment is very centrally located and neat. The place was very clean and comfortable to stay at. The kitchen has everything you'll need. Would definitely stay there again.
Beautiful apartment with everything you need. It was so comfortable. Easy Check in. The hosts were very kind and always in contact to make sure all was well. Would definitely stay again.
This place is exactly as advertised,its central and very safe ,I don't recall having any problems while there.There are alot of nearby activities which are a walk away so you save on the traveling
Easy access to the highways, and other areas. The place is nice and i felt at home in it. Lodewyk made me feel at ease and thanks for checking up on me now and again.

The flat was super well located, walking distance from the waterfront, restaurants and shops in a very exciting area. The flat is very clean, lovely decorated and had everything I needed. The check-in process was seamless, Chris and Lodewyk were so kind and helpful -- i would highly recommend!

Lovely place! Very modern and comfortable. We also enjoyed the rooftop pool and cafe/bar on the ground floor. The Canal cruise has a stop at the back of the building for easy access to the V&A Waterfront. Early risers (waking before  7am) should not have a problem with the noise of loading and unloading of countainers across the road. We sat on the balcony and was amazed to see how it works! Would definitely go back.
I actually couldn’t go but… Cyphia was so helpful!  It’s a gorgeous spot!  Stay!

We really enjoyed our stay at 4 Cyphia Close! The place was clean, comfortable and well-maintained. Communication with the host was smooth and we appreciated the flexibility with early check-in. The environment and Fynbos pod were so beautiful and serene. It is definitely a gem of Hout Bay!

I just wanted to take the time and say thank you very much for the stay,this is definitely one of the best gems in cape town !
We really enjoyed the time and next time we'll definitely book for the whole weekend cause it felt way to short !
Would recommend this place for anyone that's searching for the perfect break away from town!

Nice apartment, beautiful roof pool. Very helpful host, easy check in. It is next to the harbor and there are train tracks passing, but they are more in the many and it will be rare that they bother (maybe a couple passing each day?).
Upside is you are walking distance both of the Waterfront and CBD (~20 mins each).

Great Venue
Very well kept, excellent value for money. A little noisy but understandable with the container terminal across the road. Conveniently and centrally located. Clean and great value for money.

The place is perfect, I can't fault it on anything. The apartment is very clean it has all the essentials to make for a comfortable stay, I expected to hear noise coming from the Port at night but there was none to affect me sleeping. The proximity to the Waterfront is a walking distance you have the model train picking you up at your doorstep the sight seeing boat is also nearby, you basically have all amenities you need within a walking distance. The restaurant down stairs serves very nice food which is very convenient if you don't feel like going out, Chris's place is highly recommended in my books and I'll definitely be going back on my next stay in Cape Town.

This place is awesome! Very comfortable and it has everything you need. The huge TV (with Netflix) in the lounge was a bonus when it was too cold to go out. I love how close it is located to the Waterfront and it took only 15-20 min to/from the airport. Big comfy bed with enough blankets, towels and an aircon in the bedroom. Communication was incredibly fast and check-in was a breeze. Will definitely book again!

The apartment is exactly like the photos. More than enough space and loved the TV in both the bedroom and livingroom. Also the aircons are great addition in the Cape Town heat. Lodewyk was a great host, always available and quick to respond. Also the walk along the canal to the waterfront is a must do.

Chris and Lodewyk were fantastic hosts. I stayed here for a week and they were always responsive and extremely helpful. The Apartment is well designed and I loved the open plan bed and bathroom. Great value for money and if it is available I would definitely recommend booking it for your weekend away or holiday.
Great location, spacious and clean, and feels private. Chris and Lodewyk were very responsive to questions with very helpful instructions.

Amazing place.
The location is perfect, with no load shedding, and everything I needed was there.
Chris and Lodewyk were great hosts, always trying to make my stay comfortable.
Thank you so so much!
Great hosts, great restaurant, close to everything great value for money. However right on the dock so can be a bit noisy at times.

Not my first time and all I have to say is that this is 10 stars not 5 Stars. This is either my 3rd or 4th time staying here and the service is  amazing. Chris and lodewyk are superstars and I will always book with them !!

Fantastic apartment in a great location just a short walk from the V&A Waterfront! The area felt very safe and the apartment was extremely clean. The hosts were very responsive and helpful with providing local recommendations. Highly recommend!
Nice location overlooking the cruise terminal and easy walking distance along the canal to the V and A waterfront district.lovely unit and really helpful and responsive hosts
A handy location for the waterfront and associated activities. The working dock next door was a little noisy at times. Very responsive and friendly hosts - thanks.

My second stay at Chris' and Lodewyk's place did not disappoint as the housekeeper, Shirley, even helped me with my luggage! I hope to have a third!
Best,
Douglas
a bit out of the way for solo traveller. Bedroom very dark and tiny balcony. all in all I enjoyedy stay and would recommend for a few days
Thank you Chris. was a treat to stay in your place, so clean and tidy. the water taxi to the waterfront was so nice, and rooftop pool was a nice extra bonus. Will book again!

I had a great stay at Chris'  apartment. The space is modern, clean, and  wellequipped. . While there was some minor noise at times, it didn't detract from the overall comfort and convenience of the apartment. Chris was an excellent host, providing helpful assistance throughout my stay. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and functional place to stay!

A great apartment, only a 10 minute pleasant walk along the canal into the V&A Waterfront. Note that the walkway by the canal is locked off at 20.00hrs, so use a taxi back from the V&A, the alternative walk isn't the best.
The apartment block is safe and secure, with secure underground parking.
The interior of the accomodation was very nice and the block itself was well kept, with a good bar area for guests.
The owner was good with comms and directions, which was reassuring.
Only comment we would make is that the view from the apartment is of a road, railway line and shipping containers. Didn't really matter as we didn't spend much time in the apartment BUT the dock workers start very early and it did disturb our sleep.

Fantastic location walking distance to the V&A, nice little coffee shop along the canal. Apartment was nice and clean, host was nice enough to let us check in early, communication with them was excellent. I love that there was everything provided in the apartment, I was able to do a load of laundry, felt pretty much at home. I would definitely book again -

Perfect location to attend events at the CTCC.
Walking distance to Waterfront too.

The apartment is modern, spacious, and private, overlooking the harbor with beautiful ocean views.
The hosts were wonderful, especially Lodewyk, who was warm and very helpful. A truly pleasant stay that I can highly recommend! 🌟

Place looks exactly like its shown in the pictures. But we weren't shown the pool and the DSTV was not working and we only found out  about that when we got there and we had a child who wanted to watch tv so we were disappointed. But overall the place is nice.

The place is close to nice views. It is very welcoming, however air-conditioning is required especially for winter months, since the heaters provided are not effective.
We enjoyed being at the beach house

This was just perfect get away …
Great location- walk away from everything …
10/10 👌🏻

Our stay was amazing, it had great views. The apartment looked fantastic and don't let me start on the views the main bedroom and one other had beautiful ocean views.
You can't really make any noise or the neighbors will complain. So if you wanna talk loud or play music this is not the place for you.
but still we had a great stay.
Place was not as advertised. Views are stunning but the unit itself was filthy and smelly. Pity because the place itself has great potential. We did not even spend the night there
The stay was amazing the house is as posted on the advert. The view is breath taking and everything is within reach like Mall’s and restaurant. Definitely value for money

Melanie is exactly what is says...a SUPER HOST! She always goes out her way to make her guests feel comfortable and taking care of every need. My husband and I have thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and very sad to leave. Beautiful neat cosy place and just a few minutes from the beach. Thank you again Melanie, we will definitely come stay here again.

We lived at Melanie’s for three months.  This is a great option for the money, good area, accommodation is clean and tidy.  Melanie herself is very helpful and friendly and always tried to do the best for us. It was sad to leave, if we come back we will definitely stay again.

Beautiful accommodation, very spacious and definitely worth the money.
There is a school nearby so early morning are a bit noisy with the kids walking past to go to school, so if you're planning on sleeping late book during school holidays or weekends!
It's not noisy any other times during the stay.
There is a super comfortable bed in the accommodation aswell!!

Melanie is an amazing host and staying at her place for the month of May was great. 5/5 experience, absolutely loved it and have no complaints! The place was clean and tidy as well as peaceful. Thanks Melanie for a great stay! She truly is a Superhost! 😊

My stay at Melanie's Airbnb was simply exceptional! The place was immaculately clean, cozy, and filled with thoughtful touches. Melanie was incredibly hospitable throughout my stay. From my initial inquiry to any questions I had during my stay, Melanie was always quick to respond and incredibly helpful. The location was perfect - peaceful yet close to attractions. I highly recommend this Airbnb and can't wait to return!
The area , easy access to the city of Cape Town , the necessary services and the feeling of safety in a country like RSA which has a bad reputation in case of safety .

Melanie was an exceptional host, her place lacked absolutely nothing, but instead felt like home away from home.
Thank you soo much for accommodating us over and beyond. You are truly awesome, and have no doubt that soar to greater heights..if ever I need a place to stay in Cape Town, I know where my home is🙂

I stayed at Melanie’s place for five months and it truly felt like home — absolutely perfect for a long stay. She’s incredibly welcoming and made me feel comfortable right away, yet also gave me the privacy and space I needed. Her communication is excellent; she responds to messages quickly and is always ready to help. 😍😍😍😎
The only thing to note is that if you’re on Vodacom, the mobile network isn’t the strongest, but Melanie’s Wi-Fi is fast and reliable, so it makes up for it.💪🏽
Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better host or stay — highly recommended! 🌟
Nadja was a wonderful host and the property location was perfect. The views are second to none!

Excellent location and the apartment is absolutely fantastic with a breathtaking view.
Nadja was very helpful. I highly recommend.
Looking forward to the next time.

Beautiful apartment with an amazing view and tons of shops and restaurants within walking distance.
Nadja was an amazing host. Friendly, always responsive and gave us a list of interesting things to go do and see.
Nadja was a wonderful hostess. She was Delightful and easy to work with.  We would stay at her properties again for sure.
Nadjas place as spectacular!! She was so lovely to work with during our stay! 10/10 would recommend
Loved the home and the location.  Nadja was extremely helpful with recommendations in the area and responsive to any questions.  I hope to return one day and highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay, everything was as perfect as it seemed online.
Nadja is such a lovely host, communicates well and provided us with all the information we needed.

We had the most beautiful stay at Nadia’s Airbnb. It has the most breathtaking view of lions head and the back of table mountain as well as the ocean, Nadja was so friendly and gave us lots of recommendations of places to eat and things to do! We would definitely recommend Nadja’s place to anyone!

I have stayed in many air B&Bs around the world. This place is one of the top! beautiful location overlooking the ocean and wonderful restaurants in short walking distance. Other shops and pharmacies nearby as well. Highly recommend this place.

Nadja’s home was amazing. The location to restaurants and the beaches were awesome.
We would definitely stay there again!

Nadja's Airbnb was an absolute gem! Tucked away in a secure and safe location, we felt completely at ease throughout our stay. The private pool was a definite highlight, offering breathtaking views of the sunset every evening. Nadja was incredibly responsive and attentive to our needs, ensuring a seamless experience from start to finish. The plethora of amenities provided added an extra layer of comfort, and the entire space was impeccably clean. The value of this listing is remarkable, especially considering the upscale neighborhood it's situated in. We couldn't have asked for a better accommodation and highly recommend Nadja's place to anyone seeking a luxurious yet affordable retreat!

On arrival we were welcomed by Martin who showed and explained all we had to know about the apartment. We were welcomed with beautiful, delicious, fresh  little cupcakes which was a lovely touch. Everyone enjoyed them thoroughly. Both Nadja and Henry responded to our messages immediately every time. The views are absolutely beautiful over the ocean. We were sad to leave and could have stayed much longer.  Thank you Nadja and Henry

Nadja and her team have by far been the most amazing host expensive I've had on airbnb. The response time is less than five min and they are always on Standby to assist with anything no matter what time it is.
AMAZING SERVICE IN A BEAUTIFUL HOME. literally the only place ill be booking when I go to cape town 💯💕
Wonderful stay with stunning views and a peaceful location. The host was welcoming, responsive, and the place was clean and well-maintained. Highly recommend!

The place is beautiful, private and with views to literally die for.  The host is very helpful, quick on responses. Am definitely recommending this place. Me and the family will be coming back in summer to enjoy the pool.

We stayed over the Christmas period with our toddler and had the most incredible time here. The house is really beautiful - even nicer than the pictures suggest. It’s built around the pool in a way that makes it feel very private and like a haven. It’s clean, spacious, inviting and feels very safe. Elzanne and Beverlyn were extremely kind, thoughtful and responsive hosts throughout our whole stay. Easy drive into all areas of the city meaning we did a lot of stuff. We had a blast and really didn’t want to come home! Thanks for having us x

Elzanne’s a great host and was willing to meet us late in the evening to check in. The house is close to the highway with easy access to a lot of the tourists attractions. House were equipped with everything we needed and the beds were very comfortable. The lapa was a great place to visit with friends and was an unexpected bonus. Loved our stay!
Burger's place is very clean ,stylish and at the right location . Enjoyed my stay there

Excellent checkin and communication from the host. The apartment was clean, although a bit worn. Kitchen is nicely equipped (could do with some pepper, fresh teabags and coffee). Very central location in CBD (easy walking to Bree street, and even to Kloof) but driving in the centre is quite congested (obviously). Note that the balcony opens onto a back wall (so no view),  and this does echo quite a bit, especially over weekends.

Lovely stay, great location. Quick walk or short uber ride to almost anywhere in Cape Town. Close to bars and restaurants and great security makes you feel at ease from arrival. Very convenient check-in and out.
Very good neat and modern stay. Host friendly and very responsive. Very centralized hub with booming nightlife and lots of places to see close by. Great value for money

we had a great stay. The Appartement is like on the pictures. Its located very central. The private gym is not the best but it worked for a small workout. It feels safe although right infront of the appartement I did not like the homeless people asking for money all the time. all in all I would book it again! Thanks for having us
It was a great stay. Communicated quickly and effectively. Everything was there that we needed and more.
Burger was very responsive and helpful. The apartment was beautiful and close to everything, we love every minute of our stay there.

We had a lovely stay, the property is very cute and cosy and convinient in every way. Its next to long street but once you're inside the complex there is zero noise. The self checkin also went very smooth, would definitely go back.

Had a nice stay at Burger's place, very centrally located place, easy to check in due to the reception downstairs, the gym was a positive surprise. The broken window is only an aesthetic issue, not a functional one. Hope it gets fixed soon. Burger is a very responsive as host.

Burgers place is great for the city area because it’s spacious close to everything & doesn’t experience load shedding. Only thing I don’t like is having to purchase my own toiletries and anything else needed like trash bags etc while staying I believe hosts should provide that for their guests. Everything else was perfect

Wonderful
The place was lovely and peaceful
Thanks a lot we will come back

We had an incredibly unfortunate experience with Burger that we hope to never repeat. He was rude and became unresponsive which was the least of our problems. The apartment is not as displayed in images. The window and sliding door had large cracks in them and the apartment had a foul smell among other things. Long story short would not recommend.

This property is in a good location - for getting around. Definitely be mindful of your surroundings.
There was a terrible and foul odour at this place. I had the French doors open for two days straight and it STILL didn’t improve. Security told us it was the previous stay but then we noted a stay in October which complained about the same thing.
Ceilings need tending to as they have mold on them. As well as the cracked glass on window and doors. Personally, I wouldn’t go back or recommend it unless something is done about the smell

I had a great and peaceful stay at Debbie's. She is very accommodating, warm and informative. From the first day she ensured I was well prepared about electricity cuts, she went over and above what a typical host would do. I honestly would come back again and again. Loved my stay! incredible host.

A compact, cleverly-designed private unit equipped with all the key amenities one might need for a long-term stay. The neighbourhood is generally quiet and the WIFI fast and reliable (even during loadshedding!), making this an ideal environment from which to work remotely. Easy access to the City Bowl and surrounds via Uber and all the usual takeout/grocery apps deliver at one’s convenience. Last but certainly not least, the hosts are genuinely good people. All in all, highly recommended x

Debbie was an excellent host - excellent being an understatement.
Moving from one city to another she really was helpful with showing me around the neighborhood and constantly checking up on me even before my arrival.
The space was absolutely what was promised and even more. Friendly and safe neighborhood, amenities were easily accessible even without the use of one's own car.
At times when I needed to work from home, I was able to do so without any interruptions.
Overall I'd give it a 11/10. 💯💯
Also not forgetting that she also accomodated my fear of dogs😂🤦🏾.
Thank you Debbie ♥️♥️.
Debbie was a great host. From the moment that I made my booking until the moment that I checked out she was very helpful. The room was also a beautiful setup with everything you need.

Debbie is an amazing host, very welcoming and has great communication. The unit was very clean and I had a comfortable stay. The place is easily accessible to public transport and there is a casino nearby which has a lot of restaurants and other activities to do. I would definitely recommend anyone looking for a place to stay in Goodwood to check this unit out.

The apartment was very clean, cosy, very well located and safe.
If I have to go back to Cape Town I will definitely book it again.

Thanks you Anas for being an amazing host, I had a beautiful experience staying at your place, I looking forward to staying at your place again anytime I’m in Cape Town. Thank you for the wonderful experience. 🙏🏾

What a great spot right in the middle of Green Point.
Walking distance to the V&A Waterfront, Sea Point and the gym in De Waterkant.
Place was spotless, very safe security and the secure parking was easy to navigate.
Being so close to a Woolworths and great eating spots is definitely a bonus. I’ll be back, thanks Anas
Stayed at pauls place and it was amazing! Beautiful views from the balcony and the location was perfect. a short distanced walk and youre in the heart of town! Highly recommend this place
My friend and I really enjoyed our stay at the apartment. Very authentic furniture, great views and friendly host.
The flat is beautiful, well decorated, with plenty of light and a gorgeous view of the city. highly recommended!

Beautiful apartment, just like in the pictures. Nice, safe are of Cape Town, next to nice bars, cafes, supermarket and restaurants. Apartment block is also very secure, three gates. Spectacular views of Cape Town and surrounding mountains. Would recommend and stay again.

Gorgeous flat with stunning views across the city and close to lots of restaurants and cafes, as well as beaches and activities.
Very secure building with gated parking and quiet neighbours.
Really helpful and quick to respond hosts.
10/10 would recommend staying here!
We had a wonderful stay! The location is amazing and all the communication with the hosts was easy and fast. Even better than the photos!

Beautifully furnished flat with an amazing wrap around view. 3 flights of stairs up from secure covered parking. Safe with lots of locked doors that made for a lot of keys! Busy road outside but convenient for getting about and going to restaurants etc. despite this a quiet stay. Neil met us and couldn’t have been nicer and more responsive. However some problems with water leaking from an air conditioner and an unscrewed door handle, we also had to ask for emergency lights for load shedding which has become a bigger problem recently. Comfortable , clean bed and good washer/dryer and kitchen stuff.

Amazing stay very comfortable and the furniture was beautiful which made us feel right at home. Neil kindly let us check in sooner and helped us with our luggage when we checked out.
The place was amazing with great views and felt safe. The house felt cosy with great ambiance. The only thing was the school next door was quite loud in the morning but it didn’t bother us as we had to work anyways. Thanks so much!

This really is The Nest! As you enter the apartment you immediately feel cozy and warm, enveloped in your own private space.
Communication was excellent- succinct and helpful.
Yes, there were stairs to walk up but it was worth it! The view is spectacular.
I can’t wait to stay here again, thank you for welcoming my family and me into your amazing place!

My family and I had a lovely stay at The Nest. We were in contact with Emma, one of the co-hosts and she was unbelievably kind and helpful.
The apartment is beautiful as seen in the images and the views are indescribably stunning. The Nest is situated near Kloof Street and is a short Uber away from most attractions in Cape Town.
I hope to stay there again in the near future. Wonderful place!

Such a great spot in Cape Town! We stayed here for 4 nights and it was absolutely perfect. Clean, cosy space with the most awesome balcony and view over the city. If anything, I think the photos don't do it justice. There are now tonnes of plants on the balcony and it's super pretty. Serious bonus having the aircon as well!

This apartment is beautiful, comfortable and extremely well managed! We arrived at 4am after a terrible set of delays. We were met by one of the hosts, with a set of keys. She helped us carry our many bags up the stairs and had the apartment air conditioned and stocked with milk and coffee—exactly what we wanted the morning after brutal international flights. They went above and beyond and we were so grateful.

We had a lovely stay at the next! The porch and views are amazing! The flat was clean, bright, and fun to be in. The bedrooms were great and spacious. Great walkable location to lots of great restaurants. I will definitely stay here again on my next trip to cape town.

Awesome cosy place with the most incredible balcony and views.
Amazing location and super friendly hosts, made me feel right at home.
Paul and his cohosts were very friendly and helpful. beautiful retro home.. Great views. enjoyed my stay.

Very nice place for a short stay in cape town. It has everything you need, an equipped kitchen and a little terrace as well. The second room is very small, with almost only the space for the bed and with all-lenght windows that should be taken into consideration. The apartment also has a parking in the premises
The hosts were very kind and easy to communicate with and check in and check out was very smooth.
This little get away was perfect. The views were amazing. If it go’s up for sale please let me know!
Awesome place, spent a week and a bit there. Loved the interior of the apartment, felt like I matched it perfectly.

Such a hassle free stay.
Friendly Anthony welcomed us and gave us a run down on the entrance/exit procedure.
We loved the location to restaurants/bars/ bus route, didn't need Uber.
Views everywhere, fabulous.

Ant met us and shared really clear directions after we checked in.  He was super responsive and helpful, the place was comfortable and the view was incredible.  The location seems really trendy and with a lot of young people and great energy.  We had a wonderful stay!
We had an absolute amazing time. We loved the open space and pool area. It is within walking distance to the sea
Definitely check this place out. Great amenities and a great host. The pictures are accurate, so what you see is what you get. Brilliant place.

Beautiful house with a great open space in a even better location close to everything, 2 steps from the beach and the shops.
We had a lovely stay.
The house was very clean and had everything you can think especially in the kitchen.
Martina is a lovely guest always ready to help and she made us check out later than the usual check-out time.
Deeply reccomend it ! We will be back for sure.

We stayed at Martina’s house for the second time cause the first time we loved it so much! Beautiful house, Great location so close to the beach and cool coffee shop, very cosy and clean. Highly recommend it - can't wait to go back.
Lovely cute beach house. Nice bright open plan living space. Clean pool. Perfect location, less then 1 min walk to the beach.  The host Martina was very friendly and helpfull. Our kids loved it.
Lovely stay. Communication with Martina was always easy and she was always quick to respond. Enjoyed our stay very much!

Andre and Martina’s place was a gem. We live local but wanted a close getaway for the holidays and this was perfect. The house is open and clean with peaceful surroundings only 2 minutes from the ocean. A close walk to the famous lighthouse and Long Beach. Both a backyard with play structures for kids and a front splash pool. The oven is large for cooking for a big family. Loadshedding lamps and all the amenities. Interesting books, decor and pictures to look at. We will definitely book in again soon.

It is a great place to stay near the beach and make trips in the cape area.
Nice restaurants/coffee places were closeby at walking distance and even in the evenings.
Martina was friendly and helpful with local tips.

Trudy is an incredible host with two incredible apartments in which I had the pleasure of staying in both. She was very accommodating to my evolving itinerary and made sure I had everything I needed. The rooms are both stylish and have everything you could need, yet they manage to feel minimalist. Thoroughly enjoyed my 10 day stay and would highly recommend it as a base from which to explore the beautiful surrounds.

Awesome awesome awesome place! My expectations were thoroughly exceeded. The location is amazing, the hospitality, the space was very clean and had little thoughtful amenities that helped a lot. The view! Splendid.
Trudy was very very helpful and super friendly. I hope I stay here again soon
Trudy hosts a very good place.  Nice location, clean and providing all you need.  Lovely views and close to amenities.  Friendly and helpful host.
A stylish and beautifully decorated room. Good coffee and facilities, gorgeous view. Very comfortable bed and pillows. Trudy is a friendly host. Highly recommended
Wonderful stay in a beautifully decorated room. The views are fantastic and the location great for visiting the surrounding area. I would highly recommend staying with Trudy!
What a gem. Beautifully and tastefully decorated. We loved the look and feel of the unit. Everything was thought of. What a treasure if a spot. Highly recommended indeed. Well done.

What a lovely little paradise to chill before going back to my country after an amazing trip in Cape Town !
Trudy really helped me with all her nice advices (restaurants, fitness club,…)
A comfortable place where I felt home and I could chill in peace.

The space was perfect for our short break from everyday life.  The space was clean and neat. I loved the view and the sound of the waves in the background at night was amazing.
It is walking distance to the beach and mall if you opt not to take your car. Booking in was effortless and the host was so helpful and responded speedily  to any questions you may have.

Everything comes together at Trudy’s guesthouse. It is a well designed and functional space that we really enjoyed staying in. Particularly appreciated were usb charging ports, which for international visitors with limited adapters helped immensely! The view from the deck out to the ocean was second to none and a great perk to start the day and a fantastic sleep in a comfortable bed. Finally, the proximity to Simon’s Town and Kalk’s Bay meant this was a perfect stop-off on our road trip around the area. Trudy was also super flexible on check-out time which was a dream. Thank you Trudy!
Brief but truly lovely stay – everything was immaculate and beautifully decorated. Thank you, Trudy and Juila! We hope to be able to stay for longer next time.
Very friendly, warm-hearted woman welcomed me, I felt really appreciated and awaited. I liked a lot the view, location also is good, with a mall on one side and a beach on another side.

Trudy's place is very cozy and clean !  a very relaxing room with a nice view of the ocean. Except for the power shedding it's manageable since wifi still worked fine :) She is responds quickly if you have any concerns. I highly recommend.

Trudy was a gem, responsive, and  property is lovely. The room and bathroom are cozy, yet comfortable and clean. Perfect for a short getaway to the beach, with a deck overlooking false bay. The location is central to anyplace on the peninsula.
This place was perfect for me for my 3 week visit. Had everything I needed and Juan-Claude was very hospitable and responsive. I’d definitely stay again!

I had a great stay at JC’s place in Green Point. It’s very conveniently located - with a cafe and coworking spot seconds from the apartment and a short walk to the shops/ restaurants and Sea Point promenade which I went for walks along almost every day. The apartment had everything I needed for some time remote working in Cape Town & a lovely balcony. I felt very safe here and would stay again.

Very nice appartement and Juan-Claude is so helpful and kind. Good big bed and had everything I needed. It is next to a road so sometimes you hear cars passing by but it’s close to restaurants and bars and shopping. I enjoyed my stay.

We loved our stay at Catherine’s place. The patio and pool were even better than expected. The location is great and overall we thoroughly enjoyed spending our holiday there. Catherine is a great host. Would stay there again.
Awesome apartment, awesome location, there is little to be left wanting. I would definitely stay again and again.
Excellent apartment with great views and it’s also in a convenient location. Overall had a great stay.
Beautiful apartment with gorgeous views. Manon was a lovely host. Location was perfect. Would definitely stay there again.

The apartment was as advertised within easy reach of the Waterfront VA.  The area is very safe, Manon was helpful and always reachable. The internet kept working during load shedding (aka rolling blackouts) . I can recommend the app ESP to give you the schedule.
Right, where you wanna be to discover all the fun things to do in western Cape Town very nice apartment very nice of view of the harbor

Manon and Rumen were extremely helpful and responsive.
The apartment is beautiful, and the views just absolutely amazing.
Brilliant spot - loved it.

I had a wonderful stay at Andy‘s & Ninas place! The area where your room is, is seperate & big.
The dogs are friendly and keep you company in case you stay in the house. Had some wonderful chats with Andy and joined him for a dog-walk. If you are travelling solo it‘s a great location to feel at home!
Our stay with Lara was nothing short of amazing. beautiful area to jog along the coastline, spectacular views. There are also shops for basic food and household stuff within walking distance.

We had a great stay at the deck house. The house is equipped with everything you need. The pool and outside area are perfect to have some relaxed days. We also enjoyed the 5 min walk to the Kommetjie Surf beach.
Lovely home. Meticulously clean. Quiet community. Loved the fresh air and that you could see and smell the ocean.

Lovely cottage close to the sea. Great set-up perfect for easy coming and going. Location for all that Kommetjie has to offer is perfect and close to great little coffee shop and relaxed local restaurants.
Lara responded very quickly to all our questions and whole process was very smooth!
Beautiful house in such a perfect location! Walking distance to the beach as well as to the small town centre and a few restaurants/coffee shops.
Wonderful stay! Impeccably clean and very nice place in general. Highly recommend to stay here!

We had a wonderful time at Lisa’s place. The house is beautifully furnished, the kitchen is fully equipped. All beds are comfy. The deck and pool with a fantastic view of the near mountain is the perfect hang out spot.
We had three teenagers with us. They especially enjoyed that they were able to walk to the beach, cafes and restaurants.
Lisa was a great host, always available and very helpful. We also very appreciated the cleaning service twice a week:).
Fine place. Not very special and a bit overpriced for the place. Overall the place was very nice. Good surrounding with nice coffee shop just around the corner and a very nice short walk to the sea.
Lovely house catering with more than what you could need. Close to the beach and mid town. Already making plans to rebook
It was a great cosy house in a beautifull neighbourhood and town. Very spacious house with great rooms and kitchen.

I stayed for a month while working remotely and was very comfortable in Kobie’s apartment. The building is centrally located, fully secure, and has great amenities including the rooftop bar / pool. The unit has an amazing balcony, fast wifi, and all the basics you need to settle in. Would do an extended stay again
Had a great time at Kobie’s place! Nice,  clean and bright apartment with a spacious balcony. Couldn’t have asked for better!
Easy check in with friendly staff. The balcony was massive and had a great view! Everything was clean and the area felt safe. Highly recommended

awesome host, perfect location apartment was neat, very clean, spacious and extremely safe.
Will highly recommend

I had a bad experience at this hotel.
But the staff was nice and the rooms clean.

This was a perfect description of a place. Perfect for only sleeping. Super clean! Fantastic undercover parking. Extremely friendly staff. We were only looking for a place to sleep and could book late and check in late. Thanks!

Checkin was pleasant. Room is very basic. In the morning and day time you will hear the cleaners cleaning the other rooms as the door is basic with thin walls that don't block little sound. Room has a window with no view and there is no balcony. Cannot cancel so check the cancellation policy well.
Check Inn place is okay, we couldn’t sleep though because of paint smell, we had headaches the entire night.

It is easy to find and flexible / late checkin, good location for a few nights to arrive in Cape Town. Unfortunately there is no elevator or a lounge area as described so no possibility to sit somewhere except in the room. A little bit noisy while housekeeping in the hallway. Ok for a few nights.
Had a great stay at the Check Inn Hotel. The rooms were very clean and neat. Great location. Definitely a great deal!
Location is great, and easily accessible. Rooms are small, bathroom has a bad smell in the room we were staying in.

Nice staff, clean room, hot water, good WiFi and air conditioning. Ideal for short stays in Cape Town as room is a bit small. Location is green point, so you’re in between V&A and the promenade, so walkable if you want.

Clean and pristine!  The reception staff were very friendly and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable, although the layout was slightly different in the pictures. Nevertheless, I was very happy with my one-night stay. There are no kitchen amenities in the bedroom but what I liked was the vending machines in the reception stocking almost everything you'd need! There's also a microwave to reheat your food. Note that the building does not have an elevator so you'd need to climb about two or three flights of stairs depending on which floor your room is on.

We had an OK overnight stay. I just wish the staff would ensure that guests respects others stay, its was noisy the entire night with guests in corridors. I also don’t understand why we have to request for a shower mat instead of it just being available in the room. Otherwise, we slept comfortably, would stay again but lodge complaints about noise pollution.

It was an okay stay, the room was tiny, stairs took a toll on us, having the basin in the living space was uncomfortable and lastly unfortunately the door didn’t lock.
Besides all this the staff was friendly, same goes for the security who guards the cars parked outside at night and the location was perfect, I’d say the place is ideal for a night or two stay at best.
Good stay, basic but very clean. Stayed with my family for a one nighter, and we were able to walk to where we needed to be.

Thanks for a most magnificent experience in your wonderful loft!
We will for sure be back! This has been the best ever experience with Airb&b. This is the best location, best bed, best view and best host imaginable in CapeTown!

I feel so lucky to have stayed in Lida’s place while in Cape Town. The loft is gorgeous, well-designed and sparkling clean. Lida is a tremendous host and went above and beyond to make my stay easy and comfortable. I am deeply grateful, and will hope to stay in this loft whenever I’m next in Cape Town!

Where do I even begin???? Just the most superb accommodation! The design & comfort of the apartment is out of this world…almost an Scandi/African style blend with luxurious touches & without doubt the best place I stayed in SA. Lida, her husband & staff are beyond helpful & friendly. Lida even hunted down the best cheesecake in CT for me! The view from the bed & balcony of table mountain is an absolute delight every morning! And the coco-mat bed will give you the best nights sleep! Do yourself a favour & stay here!!!!! I’ll be back soon 😄

We had a wonderful stay at Lida’s place! The loft was very clean and super cute. The garage parking was perfect for renting a car and it is centrally located so it was easy to get around Cape Town. We would definitely stay here if we return to Cape Town again!

One of the best Airbnbs we’ve ever stayed in. Lida and Luca were very responsive, the loft is stunning and is perfectly located for anything you’d want to do while in Cape Town. This is a perfect home base for your visit!
Lida’s place was exactly as described and one of the nicest Airbnbs I’ve stayed in. Easy to get around and super convenient location.

One of the most beautiful airbnbs we‘ve ever stayed at. There is a thought behind every single piece of this incredible apartment. Waking up with a view like this on Table Mountain and the city itself is incomparable. We can not recommend enough to book this apartment. Thanks for having us!
Great apartment, very central with incredible views over the city and mountains. Finished to a very high level, would highly recommend booking. Lida is very helpful and responsive.

We are for the second time in South Africa and there are lots of nice accommodations but this one is a Juwel.
If u have the chance to book it, go for it and don’t hesitate.
Lida and her husband Luca are super nice and helpful with recommendations and all what you need.
It’s can getting a bit noisy in the late evening due to heavy traffic at Buitengracht Street but nothing worse.
All what u need (Restaurants , Cafes, Supermarkets) are in close distance.
Go and support The blue Cafe around the corner if u stay here. Just a lovely Place with lovely People.
Thanks for everything. We gonna see us again Lida!
Dominik & Kathrin

Absolutely loved our stay. This flat is amazing - so well decorated and kitted out. Lida and Luca were full of helpful suggestions which made our trip so memorable. The view of table mountain is incredible. Highly recommend!

We really enjoyed our stay at Lida’s place - it might be the nicest airbnb we’ve ever stayed in! It’s beautifully appointed with every detail thought of, and so many extras to make it feel like a luxury stay. Lida was extremely accommodating with our requests and went above and beyond to make our time in her flat perfect. We 100% recommend this rental and can’t wait to come back to stay again!

This is the go to place if you wish to stay in the centre of culture in Cape Town.
It has been dressed to impressed and it’s a beautiful place that you can call home. We have travelled all continents and this is just so special. Thank you for sharing your beautiful place

Lida & Luca’s spot has been lovingly decorated & is a great base from which to explore Cape Town; the view of Table Mountain from the balcony & bedroom is beautiful.  There are also welcoming special touches. Would happily stay again.

Riaan is an excellent host and we great communication before and at the end of our stay. The flat is in a great position near to the shops and restaurants and has everything you need to be comfortable including really comfortable beds and reliable Wi-Fi . The unit is in a safe environment with controlled access and an underground parking area with an electric gate. We’d definitely stay there again. Thanks Riaan.

Great place to stay in an neighborhood perfect suited if you want to experience both Cape Town and the wine lands. The host was quick to respond and ever so helpful if we had any problems. We can recommend this to Anyone ho wish to have a great stay in Cape Town!
Our stay was really great. It is very central to explore Cape Town and the winelands. The apartment was clean and neat. And our host was really accommodating during our check-in.

We had an amazing experience,  the host Lieze is supportive and communicated well through our trip! It really felt like home,  everything is clean,  beds are comfy and more than enough space with a brilliant view of the ocean and table mountain,  coulndt ask for more!  Thank you very much!!
Pictures do not do justice to this property.  Perfectly located, feels very homey and Lieze is a most fabulous & accommodating host. Will definitely be booking again for next CPT stay.
The place is a great place to stay with a very homely feel to it. Communication with Lieze was great as she responded quickly throughout the entire stay. Would definitely recommend!

We stayed with our two kids several weeks in this beautiful apartment and had a great time! We felt very safe and the surroundings are great for kids. Lieze and Conrad were very nice and extremely responsive and helpful!

Dolphin beach is a great location and we loved the place. It’s felt safe and quiet. Apartment was very cozy and we felt home straight away. We came with kids and it was so lovely that we had a beach right in the front where they could run and play where there was not wind ( as we come in April). There is also a kids playground and swimming pool. Conrad and Lieze apartment was very clean and we had everything we need it. We will definitely stay again and we highly recommend the place.
Beautiful home with stunning views and great amenities. What you see in the pictures is exactly what you get. We had a great stay and would definitely book again.

The house is beautiful and fully fitted with everything you can think of. The views are so amazing. The place was always clean and the housekeepers were great. Always willing to assist. Was great to watch the sun set every evening.

The house is amazing and in the perfect location in Camps Bay. Check in was easy with regular communication from Rita prior to arrival and sending instructions once in Cape Town. Also received a house keeper service On two days of our stay. The villa was clean and very well equipped with stunning views. A very special place to stay
Great place in camps bay! Can’t beat the views. Communication with host was easy, will definitely recommend to family and friends.

Rita was extremely communicative and accommodating of our early checkin time which was a huge help flying in from Los Angeles
The views are better than pictured and truly make for a tranquil stay.

My family group of 6 people stayed for a week in December and we loved every minute. The house is stunning and every room gets to enjoy those amazing views. The location is perfect and an easy walk to beaches, shops and restaurants. Rita was very responsive and helpful. We really didn’t want to leave and will certainly book again when we come back to Cape Town. 10/10 from us!
Beautiful stay in Camps Bay! Big thanks to Forward for cleaning. We enjoyed it very much and would definitely come back to this wonderful place.

Lovely modern apartment with great views. Easy walk down into camps bay.
On the negative side
No Satellite tv unfortunately - just Netflix /prime etc
Lots of construction noise during our stay so not very relaxing during the day.
Rita’s place was great, she was very accommodative and responded timeously. I would definitely recommend this place, the views are breathtaking 👌🏾.
Loved our stay here, exceeded our expectations. The place was huge and the views incredible. Would highly recommend!

we loved our stay! The home is beautiful and very well appointed. Very comfortable beds and all of the comforts of home. Incredible view from every room.
I would definitely recommend staying in this amazing home.

Villa had the most amazing views from every room and terrace.  It was also spotlessly clean.  Rita kindly assisted us with a late check in due to our flight arrival time.  The housekeeper Forward is such a lovely man and looked after us so well, he also kindly took delivery of groceries for us before we arrived which made our life so much easier.  The villa is in a great location and is walkable to the stunning beach and lovely restaurants in Camps Bay.

This Villa was amazing!  Rita and Forward were very thorough and helpful for the entire stay.  The daily housekeeping was exceptional and the ability to walk into town was a major benefit!  We did not want to leave and would come back in a second!

What an incredible home! The views are beyond beautiful and the roof terrace is the perfect spot to watch sunset. There’s lots of room for relaxing and sunbathing up there, too. I loved that all of the bedrooms had incredible sea views. The kitchen was so well stocked we had everything we needed.
Absolutely stunning place. The pictures were a good representation of what the place looks like. Rita is an absolutely amazing host who responds quickly if there are any questions. Coming here again

Probably the most spectacular house with views in Camps Bay.
We were a group of 5 friends traveling and Rita welcomed us with open arms.
The house is pristine, jaw dropping and incredibly spacious with all the different levels and balconies.
No matter where you were, the views were glorious all day long - with sunsets that was unbelievable.
Walk safely and comfortably down to the main area in Camps Bay, a short beautiful walk and very safe.
Great house, great service.
Thank you Rita and Forward for hosting us with such grace!
Highly recommended!
Great quiet location.  Warm welcome.  All that you need is accommodated for! Spacious bedroom with spotless finishes! Great first time Airbnb experience
What a gem! peace, comfort, hone away from home. Value for money. Great host! Good communication. Had a great time.

Nikki is a super hostess and made us feel welcome and very comfortable. We had to alter our travel arrangements and numbers at short notice and she easily accommodated our request. The place is in a quiet peaceful neighbourhood and near to various restaurants and a well stocked Spar. The smart tv worked well coupled with strong wifi. Lovely place to stay!

Nikki was a great hostess, she replied quickly to our questions, and was always friendly and informative. The space was lovely, bed nice and comfy. We made use of the sleeper couch for our son which Nikki made up for us on request. We would definitely visit again.
Nikki was very accommodating and approachable. Stay was clean, spacious and comfy. Everything you want from and Airbnb

We had a wonderful stay at Nikki's place. She was so accommodating and kind when we had to check in way later than we planned, which we appreciated. The unit is beautifully designed and decorated and so well equipped. Thank you! We'd love to visit again :)

Nikki is a wonderful host. We had a plumbing issue which was sorted immediately at no inconvenience to us.
Flat is comfortable with beautiful mountain views. We enjoyed our stay regardless of the cold and rain
We had a lovely stay! The apartment is beautiful, clean and neat. Nikki is a terrific hostess!
Our stay was wonderful. Nikki is lovely and her place is as neat as a pin. We will definitely be back.

I loved the Airbnb. It was the right fit for my visit to Stellenbosch. Loved the environment and the Airbnb was so clean. Nikki is a lovely host, always responsive and accommodating. Fantastic communication, will book again 😊

Lovely, clean, and modern flat in a great location. Quiet area but a short walk from restaurants, bars and shops on kloof street - so you get best of both.
Lived here for 6 weeks and worked really well and would highly recommend. Had a really great time and would love to come back.
Occasionally it got quite hot and with loadshedding (no electricity) meant a few uncomfortable nights (but that is a problem across Cape Town). Would also recommend bringing some battery lamps / candles for when there is loadshedding in the evening.
Only thing I would mention to other remote workers - I found it hard to work from the flat due to loadshedding. Wasn’t an issue as loads of great coffee shops and co-working spaces nearby which had back up generators (which I preferred being in anyway as nice to be around other people).
Thanks so much Felix and Michelle!

This is a very nice apartment in one of Cape Town's best residential neighbourhoods. My daughter stayed there for three months and loved it. Communication with Felix and Michelle was always smooth and efficient.

Janine & Rachel’s Airbnb was absolutely perfect! The property exceeded our expectations from the hospitality to the view to the 5 min walk down to the strip. Janine and Rachel made the process very smooth and was there to help us with anything that came up. If you are staying in Camps Bay I would highly recommend booking this Airbnb.

Rachel and Janine are very great, professional hosts. The communication was smooth before the stay as well as during the stay; both keep us updated about eg. upcoming events.
Besides that, the apartment is exactly as described and what you see on pictures.
It’s stylish and comfortable: perfect for a holiday when you want to enjoy camps Bay Area with all its restaurants and bars.
We’ll definitely come back soon! Thanks!

We had an amazing time in Janine and Rachel’s studio. The flat looks exactly like in the pictures and the area is very calm and nice with walking distance to all restaurants in Camps Bay and the beach. Thanks you for a pleasant stay! :)
Beautiful building and outdoor area, lovely furnished apartment and a great base to do all kinds of activities around Cape Town.
Amazing place to stay in a PERFECT location. Well stocked kitchen and thoughtful welcome treats were a lovely touch. Would stay here again if we're back in Cape Town.

We had a great stay at this apartment in Camps Bay.  The property was well presented the hosts were very helpful and responsive and the location was great - within a 5 minute walk to the beach and restaurants/bars.  We are already thinking about when we can return.
Great location, easy check in experience and very flexible. Really good pool area, and plenty of security.

We had an amazing stay at Canal Quays. The security is very kind and helpful and make you feel safe (24/7 security inside and outside also doing rounds). The lady who checked us in was also very friendly and helpful. You can easily get there with an Uber. The room was great, very spacious, perfect to work and not affected by loadshedding. WiFi was also great, only in the bedroom a bit weaker but that was not an issue for us. Balcony amazing with a big bench, living room also spacious with a big bench. We stayed for 2 weeks and they cleaned the room twice! Overall amazing and would definitely go back.

We had a wonderful stay and the location was just perfect for us! We felt very safe and our car was parked in the basement covered parking lot which was very secure! We will definitely come back thank you Koos!

Neat apartment on the V&A canals. Safe, secure, apartment block with a view over the canals. Walkable distance along the canals to the V&A waterfront. Hosts were excellent with respect to communication, instructions and flexible check in. Parking bay in basement provided

One of the most beautifully decorated, centrally located and cleanest properties I've stayed at. The hosts were absolutely easy to communicate with and check-in was just as easy as check-out. I'll definitely be back.
Perfect location and best view of the table mountain great value for money . Mathew and Wellington were the best always there to assist.

Everything about this place was perfect and exceeded our expectations! The view was breathtaking, apartment and linen was fresh and clean, very safe in and around the building, safe covered parking and the apartment had everything we needed and very thoughful details. 100% recommend this apartment if you're looking for a cozy, safe and "city life" atmosphere!
Trendy and upmarket spot! Loved the location, Rooftop bar and swimming pool. The balcony overlooking Table Mountain right from my room. Stunning 👏🏻 Will definitely come back again!

The space is great! Advertisement and photos accurate and up to date. The apartment is modern, beautiful, clean and comfortable with comfy bed. Everything for a comfortable stay was provided! Perfect for 1-2 travelers.
The location is very central. It is in a walking distance to the city center and most attractions: pubs, restaurants, supermarket and the view of Table Mountain from the apartment is amazing!
Easy secure car parking is also available, easy to get in and out and no extra charge.
Communication was excellent and check-in and check-out procedures worked flawlessly. Propr answered our questions immediately and was quite flexible with us for check-in times.
Propr’s flat made our Capetown experience a great success. Everything's good. I highly recommend staying there and I’m looking forward to do it again soon.

Enjoyed the apartment and the skyline view , host was responsive and accommodating.
The apartment looks exactly like the photos.
Stunning views of Table Mountain. Great location for restaurants nearby. The pool and bar on the 27th floor is really nice as well.

Perfect City-view stay in Cape Town. It is safe, it is in close proximity to everything in Cape Town and has beautiful views of the City. The apartment is very clean and has all the amenities you would need. I would definitely stay here again.

Jan is a great and friendly host, and I thoroughly enjoyed our chats. The house is spacious, clean, and well maintained, and the garden is beautiful and very well cared for,  with a lovely lawn, pool, and a day bed to soak up the sun on and admire the birds from.
The place looks better than the pictures! Jan was a great host; super responsive calm and welcoming. The space has a homey feel and a short walk from the beach, I had a lovely and relaxed time here
An absolutely amazing location, from the peacock sounds in the morning right down to the most comfy bed. Most accommodating hosts and amenities were always topped up. Will definitely be back.
The place is peaceful and well decorated with tasteful art. The linen is crisp and smells great. It was a good stay.
Beautiful little place, in the backyard of the house! Because of the separate entrance the accommodation, it provides a lot of privacy and space for guests.

Such a nice space! I'm sure we sound like many of the other reviews, but our only regret is that we couldn't stay longer and felt very bad for only staying one night in such a great space. The home felt very private, comfortable and with all the right amenities in a great location and with amazing host recommendations (if only we could have used them).

Jaclyn’s place offers the perfect accommodation for a little getaway in the beautiful Cape Town.
Everything in the cottage was above standard.
& Jaclyn was super responsive and accommodating during the stay.
Thank you!
-xoxo

Jaclyn’s place was great. My boyfriend and I had the loveliest stay, the small garden was very peaceful and the shower was amazing! A perfect middle location, we were easily able to get ubers to Kalk bay, Muizenburg and Simonstown. Would highly recommend ☺️☺️

Comfortable little studio flat- perfect for one or two.  Lovely to be able to  sit outside in the peaceful, secure little garden with the friendly ginger cat to keep company. Lovely apartment with a comfortable bed. I didn’t have a car and didn’t need one with Uber closeby and lots of great walking trails taking you to fish Hoek and kalk bay.

Scotty's place was just as described, and as photographed.

Clean, staff is very friendly and in the center of the mother city. Great experience. Would definitely do it again.
The place is perfect for a a few days stay my wife and I found it to be comfortable and spacious. It is also walking distance from shops and other entertainment venues
Great little place to stay for a couple of days. Lots of things in walking distance. The area is a bit noisy at night but that would be the only thing that bothered us. Definitely recommend

The place was amazing exactly like the pictures, loved the fact that it is central and it was easier to go places even when we Ubered most of the time but it was easy and close by and the neighbourhood is really safe. I definitely rate it 10/10 and it’s a definite 💯

Awesome stay! So convenient and communication with Natalie was so effecient and thorough. Place was neat and clean...only issue we had was the noise level from the other tenants and street. Also felt safe with the 24hr security guard posted at the entrance:)

Very nice apartment, however, it is very noisy through out the day and night (in the street and in the apartment building). Clean and beautiful apartment. The location sucks, not great when one is looking for a relaxed, calm experience in Cape Town. Check in was accurate. Good service provided.
Aside from the noisy street at night everything was perfect and exactly as advertised. We would recommend staying here to anyone visiting Capetown
Loved this place! The location really surprised me. Highly recommend this to anyone wanting to stay in the city center and is looking for a comfortable stay.
Stunning apartment that was Clean. it has great location,easy access to transport and the mall. loved it
It was a great stay, worth every penny spent. The place was clean and the bed is very comfortable. The dinner room table has had an upgrade. And the host is responsive.
Great stay. Very clean and neat place. Perfect for a weekend stay.  The area is very central but noisy late at night.

The apartment was beautiful, clean, nice art and lovely plants. The unit is situated on the road side of the building causing for a lot of traffic and noise. Ambulances, police vans and people screaming all night causing for disrupted sleep. The pool is nice and the apartment great, but the location is not.
A very nice, spacious flat. Hosts where on the ball and responded timeously when I needed them.

Great apartment right in the hub of Cape Towns bustling city centre. Comfortable and safe with everything I needed for a great bolt-hole to explore the city. Looks exactly like the photos. Spotlessly clean. Shops, coffee bars, and restaurants all within close proximity and and a great vibe in the area.
The place was so beautiful and the host was really friendly and responsive. Will definitely be going back there again.

Loved the place it definitely looked like the pictures and even better. The shower was spacious which I loved and all the cleaning supplies were available. Quiet and very safe area for casual strolls.
Definitely very good place close to everything you don’t really need a lot to move when you stay there everything is up your footsteps would definitely book again
Had a lovely stay in this little apartment. Hosts were lovely and very helpful. The apartment has everything you need. Very helpful that there is available parking across the street and it is safe.

Good stay.Cosy apartment the only down side was overload of mats and artificial plants for an asthmatic.
Overall comfortable stay will definitely recommend.
We cancelled the reservation because the airbnb was dirty and they refunded the money. Jason and his team were quick to communicate

The stay was worthwhile. the place is safe, secured and the staff (from security to the host) was very accommodative and very helpful during the stay.
the place is exactly as how you see it on the pictures.

The Neighbourhood is very cool, with great shops, coffe stores etc.
The Appartement was ok, for a very reasonable price. The team behind acts very professional, always available and supportive.

The place was nice overall. The Wi-Fi was strong, the location was close to town, and it was very convenient to have garage parking. The swimming pool was a great bonus. The surroundings were a bit noisy at times, but it didn’t impact our stay too much.

I had a good experience at Jason's place. Flexible checkin and secure parking.
Shidell was very responsive whenever I had a query (from the point of booking to checking out - I really appreciate this).
This is a value for money apartment, close to the Cape Hub..... It can be very noisy at night/morning however. Would also have like to have Netflix/Prime preloaded.

I enjoyed my stay here. Any hiccups that were had were quickly overcome by communicating it to the host. The host were always very responsive and polite. Joshua one of the host always did his best to assist. The place was close to shops and the train station and bus stop were just down the road.

had a wonderful time. Airbnb was just asking described.
The area was clean and well equipped.
can be a little noisy during the evenings but still worth the stay.

What a great place to stay.
Excellent location, great security and quiet.
Easy access to everything.
Well fitted out, and great atmosphere.

This place is amazing!!  So close to the waterfront, which is super convenient, especially if you don’t have a car. The apartment has great views, is clean, huge, and so well stocked. The guys were quick to respond to all questions. Easy check-in and check-out!  Would stay here again in a heartbeat and highly recommend!

Fantastic condo with fantastic views and Craig, the property manager was spot on, helped out with transportation to the condo, couldn't have been more professional!!  You won't be disappointed, walking to tons of restaurants and shopping!!

A great apartment in a winning location!  Walking distance from the waterfront, restaurants and shopping centers and at the same time in a quiet and beautiful complex.  The sense of security is also high due to the security arrangements.  Communication was easy including a shuttle from the airport.  Highly recommend the apartment!
Highly recommended can't fault the place. Excellent location , well managed and was found in nice clean condition. Check in process was well received as well as check out. Thank you Craig and team

It's just a beautiful bright spacious and private apartment within a short walk to the v and A everything you possibly need is also provided in the apartment really best way to describe it is to give it a 10 out of 10

The apartment was spotless and very well equipped. Very comfy bed and great walk-in showers. The location was very safe and convenient, just a short walk from the V and A Waterfront. We didn’t want to hire a car so Jeremy arranged taxi pick ups for us. We had a great time staying here and I highly recommend this apartment.

Great location, very safe environment, felt totally comfortable to and from v and a at night. Apartment was spotless and had everything we needed for a great stay. Host was able to help us with a driver for a day to tour some wine farms. Very helpful. Would highly recommend.
The apartment is very well situated for the V&A. It’s well furnished, good security, and Kevin and his team could not have been more helpful during our stay. Would highly recommend.

Great location and great accommodation, easy access to the Waterfront. Kevin was very helpful when checking in and responded very quickly to any query. Only gave it a 4 on value as there were some maintenance issues and we felt it would benefit from a little investment which would make the place 5* + certainly justifying the price.

The apartment and location were amazing. We always felt safe and we were close to the Waterfront and all its shops and restaurants. We will definitely be back. Craig and team were incredibly responsive and helpful. First class!
This is a beautiful apartment in a fantastic location. We had a wonderful stay. We would highly recommend this listing!

location of the apartment is the best thing about it. the building is really safe and the its near to almost all the places around. very easy . takes less times.
we will definitely stay here, if visiting capetown again.
thanks

Kevin was super responsive to any questions and prompt to assist in any way.  The security in the complex was extremely thorough (which is needed in Cape Town for the time being) yet easy to access. The security staff was always friendly, answer any questions and ready to assist
This was a beautiful apartment in a fabulous location. We were looking for two bedrooms to accommodate three people. It was perfect for us.
Very good communication with hostess. Very prompt to answer phone. Flat well situated and very clean.
Linda is an amazing host. She has great communication skills and her house was very clean, and it feels homely. It was definitely worth my stay and I will be gladly booking her place again soon. ☺️

My partner and I had a Wonderful stay at Linda’s cozy apartment. Very centrally located with all amenities nearby. There is a friendly community of people staying in the nearby apartments. We had effective communication with our host, an easy non-complicated check in and a really comfortable stay. Would definitely recommend ☺️
Me and my family had a nice stay 1st time staying in that side of CPT. would book again allot of shops and malls near by.
We had a very comfortable and peaceful stay, the Pool was an added bonus in the summer heat. Linda was especially welcoming and was always available for any questions.
This is a comfortable cozy place with everything you needed for a comfortable stay.  Linda is an excellent host.
Very good place to stay for those who love privacy this is the one. On cold days the house is  very cold. It was a happy stay. Linda is very responsive
Linda (the host) was friendly and responsive. :-) The apartment view at night was beautiful too :-)

Just spent a month at this lovely apartment which is ideal for families. The view is to die for!   Communication with Pam was easy & the weekly cleaning was spot on. Just wish we were back there now 🌞

Pam’s Airbnb was the perfect place for our family to stay. Kommetjie is a very quiet town with some very nice cafes and restaurants, all within walking distance. Pam’s home was very spacious and clean. Beautiful kitchen, bedrooms, living space & a great patio. The view is truly amazing!  We loved how close we were to the beach & the town.  We will definitely be visiting again! Pam is a great host, she made us feel at home & was very helpful-thank you!

Lovely property with fantastic views over the bay. All clean, tidy and everything was working and accessible. Within walking distance a few lovely little restaurants and shops, and to the beach. Pam was friendly and clear throughout.

Our stay was great! Such a pity it was just for one night.
Tammy is an amazing host, very helpful and friendly. Im definitely recommending this place to all my loved ones♥️
best stay i ever experienced it was unforgettable with the view and the cleanest you'll ever expect it was sad to leave but will return soon highly recommended

Tammys place was great, very cuute and clean and she was a lovely host.
Certainly recommend
Awesome place with great views at a bargain price. Enjoyed the one night stay at this little gem. Would recommend and would definitely book again. Thanks Tammy.

Tammy's gem never disappoints. We always feel at home and the apartment was really beautiful and spotless.

Great studio, perfect for a night or 2, close to the beach, and a few restaurants. If you need internet, make sure you have mobile data as the listing clearly states there is no WiFi. Tammy is very friendly and kept comms clear and open throughout. I'd return and recommend!

My daughter and I had a great stay. Friendly host, very helpful . We enjoyed our stay . Would not hesitate to recommend anyone looking for a peaceful beach stay. Thank you Tammy for your great hospitality.
Walkowa
One of very few places I’ll always happily check myself into. Tammy (the host) is a gem.
Awesome spot nice and Central and host is very helpful and clear in instructions. WiFi would have made things a bit easier but good value for money and great for weekend away visits

Tammy’s place is spacious, well located and just across the road from the beach. It is very comfortable and Tammy is a very friendly host who has excellent local knowledge of the area. Definitely worth another visit.
Nice place to spend a night close to the beach. There are some cute café and shops nearby.

Best booking ever! Tammy made me felt right at home! Everything was blessed,exceeded my expectations and restored the peace one looks for to restore your restless Soul . Thank you Tammy for being a blessing as host. Thank you for the lovely stay, a place with character, value for money and a superb stay!!!Wow wow wow thank you for going on and beyond, I just wish I could have stayed longer. May your bookings keep on being blessed beyond and above! If God’s will and we stay alive and well, we will definitely see you guys for our next visit in December.❤️
We had no problem with our place... We loved it very much thank you so much we will some again

A lovely place very close to the Pavilion and beach. The apartment is warm and cosy with all the necessities. We only stayed at Tammy’s place for one evening, but will definitely be back during the summer months. Tammy is very friend and responsive:
Very neat and clean place. The place is well-equipped. It's a busy street and the neighbors were a bit noisy. Tammy is pleasant and friendly with quick feedback. Thank you!

Place is nicely centrally located to Gordans bay, Stellenbosch and the beach.
We really enjoyed the restraunt “ Jackson Black ”

Tammy was a great host, and on hand for help and getting a rucksack zip mended. Top tip - car parking confused us a lot ignore the parking limit times on signs. 5 rand coin for locals who patrol the car parking.  Great little coffee shop HeBrews and UK owner David. Accommodation was a little tired and due a freshen up especially in the bathroom but all functional and good.  No quarms as easy going people.

I felt at home and the unit offered easy access to a range of restaurants and the Strand vibe. Older building with character, but the unit is a great deal and has everything that you may need. The street bustle may be disrupting to some, but I found it very entertaining and eclectic. I will gladly stay there again.

Great stay! The place is exactly as listed and I would say it is a lovely combination between cosy/self-catered and hotel. The kitchen is very well equipped (as if you are at home) yet the bathroom has a hotel vibe. The pool even though it may seem small in photos, is plenty on a hot day. Although the hosts live upstairs the place listed is very much self contained and private.
Communication pre-arrival and during the stay was top notch with excellent instructions. There were also some personal touches upon arrival and during our stay that truly make this listing a wonderful find for me.
I will say that WIFI was a bit of a problem but that seems to be the case generally in Cape Town so if you’re hoping to work whilst here, I would plan accordingly.
All in all I would definitely recommend!
Thank you for hosting us 😊
The place is neat. Well kept. Hospitality is awesome. The pool is an added bonus with the February heat.

Absolutely stunning, home away from home. Even more than we expected!
I can only complement the owners, they are outstanding hosts! I have never ever found a place as clean & tidy like this! Unbelievable, you can be very proud of this little gem. Will definitely recommend this property and we will be back for more. Thank you Oom Hannes & Emsie. Strelitzia we already miss you!!!!

We enjoyed our stay at Strelitzia. The flat was surprisingly well-equipped. Many thoughtful little touches to make the stay comfortable. Hosts were friendly and helpful. Would happily stay here again when in Gordon's Bay.

We really enjoyed our stay, Hannes is very welcoming and a incredible host. Strelitzia is beautiful with its view, well equipped and very comfortable and spacious. It had lots to offer with all the amenities including the pool and braai area with a view of Gordons Bay and is perfectly located to shops and the beach.
I would definitely recommend to come stay at Strelitzia if you want to relax and enjoy your good holiday. I would want to come back again.
Thank you Strelitzia and Hannes for hosting us.
We enjoyed our stay and the place is so beautiful we felt like we are home and have everything we wanted. This is the best place to stay & deserves 5 star.
nice apartment, central location, entrance guarded, can be noisy at night, especially when it is windy, because the windows do not close properly, otherwise we felt very comfortable

This is the 4th time  staying at one of Jayson's apartments and the standard is always excellent. Great communication, very clean and always stylishly decorated.

The place is advertised.
