The host is an excellent communicator. I enjoyed my stay. The only con is that it's on a busy road so the noise gets overwhelming sometimes
What a great place! We really loved staying here and would recommend it to anyone. There are a lot of coffee shops in the area, I really like this part of town.
We loved our stay here, it's a very cute and neat place and I love the fact how communicative the hosts were!

Our stay was effortless and worth every cost.
Out Host and staff where always available and so helpful.
The Unit was spacious,clean and had every amenities.
Being in the center of Cape town we felt so safe.Close to all restaurants and shops.
I would definitely recommend this Unit it checked all the boxes for us and more.

Had a very nice stay! Communication was very good. It’s a bit loud at night bc of loadshedding and the generators nearby but the location is very convenient and you can get everywhere in the city within minutes!

The place worked well with my purpose of visiting. Very good lighting from nature and a cozy environment. The security at the place is amazing, and I also didn't have issues with electrical load shedding, which is one of the reasons I thought of while extending my stay them. Overall all was good.

I loved the apartment. Spent 10 days there, I wish I lived there forever.
Strongly recommend to anyone going to CP.

We enjoy our stay , location is convenient and surrounded with local shops and good restaurant
the unit was awesome and as seen in photos

definitely recommend the place
The place is centrally located which gives you easy access. It is clean. the hosts are responsive. I enjoyed the stay
The apartment is true to the pictures. We enjoyed our stay. The area can be noisy at times.

We had an enjoyable stay at Jayson’s place. It is a good location for getting around Cape Town and the 24/7 security was reassuring, however the road was very noisy and it didn’t feel safe to walk outside the gates complex after dark. Getting an Uber to and from the location was easy enough.
Jayson and his team were very responsive and made every effort to make our stay a comfortable one.
Thank you
Great value for money, enjoyed our stay. Apartment spotless and attention to detail. We will definitely stay again
Jayson's Place is central if want to explore Mother city I will definitely recommend it. Amazing host communicate was superb. Thank you be back soon ♥️

My recent stay at this centrally located Airbnb was absolutely fantastic.
The location couldn't be better, with everything you need just a stone's throw away.
Whether you're in the mood for shopping, grabbing a quick bite at a pizza café, or enjoying a night out at one of the nearby bars, this place has it all.

Great place for the time spent in the CBD. very spacious and has great amenities, which you won't find easily in other listing. Outside noise was the only inconvenience however,  as the apartment is facing the street.
Great place for a quick stay in the city. Spacious, central, easy to check in and out and the hosts are always in communication when needed.
Great experience from check-in to check out!! Cozy clean studio with a swimming pool and very up to date gym area. Safe parking. Great staff and stunning security.

I would recommend this place, especially for a solo traveler. It is in the city center near all of the popular tourist attractions, but it is still secluded where you don’t have to deal with a lot of noise. There is a convenient store right in the complex and not too far from camps bay or table mountain. There was an issue with the wifi, but Jayson and his team had great communication and handled the issue in a timely manner.

Had an amazing stay. Jayson was a great host. I was very happy with location, security to the building was also very friendly and helpful. I liked the parking arrangement, very secure parking. I will definitely be staying again the next time I am in CT.

We had a lovely stay,the place was equipped with everything we needed.
Will definitely be back!

Such a gem in a brilliant location! We stayed here for a week and had to work a bit as well. The Internet is super stable, fast and reliable and there are two work-stations in the house. The kitchen is amazingly equipped, it is a joy to cook here. And the location is just stunning, it's just one street away from the sea. We had the best time, thank you!

A very homely place - we thoroughly enjoyed spending the week in this seapoint cottage. It’s spacious, well maintained and located ideally, just steps away from the promenade. Unfortunately, check-in was not very smooth, we had to wait 1h outside the flat with no clear information or contact details for from the management company. Once the ‘concierge’ finally arrived, he didn’t even apologize, and even handled the situation in quite a dismissive manner. (‘It’s not my job to wait for you on arrival, I am just a meet&greet….the agency should have sent you all check-in details….anyway, my service was 5/5 yeah?’) Would have been a 5-star review otherwise.

Abel & Pippa’s home is absolutely stunning, a perfect oasis in sea point. It’s spotlessly clean, secure and beautifully appointed. I can’t thank them enough for their warm hospitality and attentiveness, I felt so at home.

We had a lovely time in this Airbnb. The location is super nice, close to the beach and the nearby mall has a nice grocery store, you can also buy a simcard on the same street, get breakfast etc. Wifi worked well (we were working remotely). Also felt very safe in the cottage, with the alarm and the gate at the door. The host was very communicative before and throughout our stay, and helpful. Would recommend and would love to stay here again in Cape Town.

The location was perfect, just off the main road yet close to the beach. Walking distance to the boardwalk, local restaurants and quick Uber to the waterfront or table mountain. Very comfortable home and wonderful host.

Thanks to the legend AD for hosting his place to us. Thank you for providing such a wonderful stay! Your space was clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared, making it the perfect home away from home. We truly appreciated the little touches and your warm hospitality, which made our experience even more special. We hope to return again in the future and will definitely recommend your Airbnb to others.

A beautiful coastal appartment that is both comfortable and spacious. We really liked the outside eating area and the many interesting plants in the rocky garden. We would love to return one day! Thanks Arend, for being such a kind and helpful host.

One of the Greatest places we've been to.
Walking distance to the beach, close to shopping mall and within comfortable driving distance to other amenities.
Oh and the sea view is killer.

Warm and friendly greeting by Arend and Anita on arrival. Super spacious and spotless apartment which is well equipped and WOW what a view! Walking distance to tidal pool and good restaurant. Good exercise up and down the steps. Great safe location.
Highly recommended.
The house was a beautiful escape for our family to relax and enjoy Noordhoek. Thank you for everything.

The sport and yoga room was a wonderful bonus, offering a great space to unwind or stay active.
The kitchen was fully equipped, making it easy to prepare anything we needed.
The location was perfect, close to charming restaurants, vineyards, and beautiful beaches. It’s the perfect spot for a family getaway or a visit with friends. Highly recommended!

Excellent communication, superb apartment with high-quality fittings. The location is spot on, the road can be a little busy during the day but is much more quiet at night. Lovely fresh sea air and lots of natural light when wanted. The block is very safe with 24/7 security. I would highly recommend.

What a terrific place, the views, having breakfast on the balcony it was truly amazing.

Lastly, the communication was from Genna/Michelle was superb, any questions or help was promptly answered.
You wont regret staying here.
We had a lovely stay in a beautiful apartment. The attention to detail in the apartment made the stay special

I can’t say enough about the magic of this space. The walks along the ocean. The meals on the balcony. Perfect sunset after perfect sunset. The location was perfect for our family. Close to everything. Who could ask for anything more!

We couldn’t ask for a more perfect location and place to make home for a few days. Michelle was an incredible host who went the extra mile to make us feel special and looked after. Watching over the promenade from bed only made you more eager to get out and explore. The apartment was central to most activities and made it effortless to get around. Thank you for all the spoils. We look forward to visiting again in the near future.

This was a wonderful place to call home in Cape Town. Perfect location and a place that was like home very quickly. Comfy bed, a wonderful outlook across to the sea, a huge SMART TV for the nights spent in.
Definitely, one to return to in the future.
Thanks, Michelle!
Truly a repeatable awesome stay. Everything was accommodated for, and the area is so centrally located. Couldn’t have asked for more.

What a pleasure it was to stay at Michelles listing...A Beautiful apartment with so many little personal treats that made it soooo special, centrally situated, spotless, comfy and would highly recommend a stay:)

It’s not often that I find nothing to complain about, but on this occasion….definitely nothing to complain about. A responsive host, beautiful apartment in a great location at Mouille Point. It’s a 20 minute walk to the Victoria and Alfred Waterfront. It’s a safe area, with many bars and excellent restaurants. We loved it !!

This was the first AirBnB booking we have made. Michelle was very helpful with advice and encouraged us to book. The only problem we now have is that we believe we have started at the top and may be disappointed with any other properties we select.
Everything was perfect for our 5 night stay, the apartment was well presented, fully equipped and a fantastic welcome pack was supplied. Location and views are superb, we could ask for nothing more.
We would highly recommend and willingly return in future.
Thank you Michelle for a superb stay

A beautiful apartment in a magnificent setting- special touches provided by the hosts made for a memorable holiday
Highly recommend and look forward to indulging in spending time there again as soon as possible. Thank you

Michelle is a great host and her apartment is simply outstanding. The location of the apartment and the view from the Balcony is really amazing. The house is really well maintained and curated. lot of thought has been given to the little things as well. Welcome hamper from Michelle was a nice touch and Michelle is always available for any help. I would love to stay again at this place if end up in Cape Town again and would gladly recommend this place to everyone visiting Cape Town
We loved this place, and the location is a dream! Everything was fantastic including a great little welcome basket. Would totally stay here again and recommend it to everyone!
Great location, lovely view over the promenade. The apartment is well detailed with everything you need, Michelle kindly provided a welcome basket with all sorts of goodies.

Lovely, clean and homey space with an amazing beach view. A stone throw away from the V&A Waterfront and a walking distance from many great restaurants. The host is very friendly and responsive. Would definitely stay in the unit again.

We had a lovely stay. Thank you Michelle and Kirk! The apartment was even better than the photos and the location was perfect!
Would definitely recommend
This is truly a home away from home. The apartment has everything you need and much more. Yes it is noisy as it’s on the first floor but the view and the vibe is worth it. Will be back.

We LOVED staying here. Felt like I could happily live there.  The views of the water from inside and the outdoor balcony were great as well as being able to hear the water. We could walk to a number of cafes and restaurants nearby as well as stroll the promenade across the street.  Our hosts were very responsive. Can’t wait to return to Cape Town, and when I do I’d want to stay in this same place.

We loved our stay at 11 on Creek. Spacious flat ideal for WFH! A lovely private space that’s super clean and welcoming. Excellent value for money, close to all amenities and a bonus is the flat smells wonderful!

This felt like home away from home. Friendly and great service, but we still had our privacy. Everything in the flat is of good taste and very good quality. Eileen and her husband really care for their guests and you can feel the personal touch and the extra mile that they run for their guests. I definately recomend their services to anybody that enjoy the better things in life !
Beatiful, tranquil, perfect. What a gem. Will definitely be back. Eileen is such a lady and a perfect hostess.

The check-in was smooth and we had a wonderful stay. The place has everything you need and more. Really well-maintained and comfortable. Very central to major shops and other towns. The hosts were so friendly to help us retrieve something we left behind. I will recommend this place to anyone. Thank you for everything, Eileen!

Very tidy and lovely apartment equipped with everything you need. The space was absolutely what was promised. The bed was super comfy and clean, even the kitchen had everything we needed. We had a great stay!
Eileen was an excellent host. I will definitely be staying here again.

Eileen's place was very spacious, and I appreciated that the wifi functionality was put on backup power to ensure that I could continue working online during power outages. The guest information booklet that Eileen put together was very helpful (I ended up using the takeaway and laundry services recommended). It was very clear that Eileen did not skimp on the bed & linen - the bed was one of the most comfortable I've ever encountered in an AirBnB and the extra fleece blankets provided were very comfortable & soft. There was more wardrobe space than I needed and I really appreciated having access to three different streaming services.
Overall Eileen's place was a lovely find for my two-and-a-half week stay.

I really enjoyed my stay at 11 On Creek. The photos don't do it justice - it's very spacious and comfortably furnished, the kitchen has everything you need. Eileen was accommodating with an early check-in, which was easy with a lock box., and a very helpful manual about everything in the flat inside. There were great emergency lights which helped during loadshedding. The area is safe, quiet and peaceful, but only a few minutes drive from Durbanville CBD. Good value for money - I would definitely stay here again.
We had such a lovely time. It is truely a wonderful little getaway place and very neat. Eileen is a great host! I strongly recommend her place.

Very good location, host was very helpful and responded proactively.
The accommodation had everything we needed, and more! Will definitely consider for our next Cape Town trip

Eileen’s place was perfect for my short stay, fully equipped with all I needed and more. I made use of the fabulous study area and really appreciated the attention to detail, the comfort and the safety and security of the place. Eileen communicated well and ensured we had a pleasant stay, will definitely recommend.

We had a wonderful stay with Eileen and her hubbie. The studio is very well equipped and spacious. Everything you need and more. Eileen is a great host and responded quickly when we had a question. The studio is private, perfectly located and peaceful.
We will most definitely return for another stay!
Safe, spacious and impressive decor gliding towards trendy-great interior skills where put out in the place. Pictures limit the picture, there’s more to the place when you see it. Host responsive ❤️

I stayed at Eileen’s studio for the first few days of my stay in Capetown because I wanted to be close to the office in Durbanville. The area is lovely and peaceful and I could take a 20 minute walk to some bars through quiet streets, it al felt very safe. The studio itself is also lovely, a great use of space making it really feel like a small home. I didn’t get to use the braai outside but that a great way to make something if you do feel like cooking instead of going out somewhere.

Eileens place is extremely spacious and comfortable. We will definitely like to stay here again next time we are visiting relatives in Cape Town. The flatlet had everything we needed (and more) and was perfectly located.
Thank you Eileen
We had such a lovely stay. Was private and secure. Very neat and we had everything we need and more. Will definitely book with Eileen again when we are in the area

11 on Creek truly felt just like home!
The space was clean, spacious, peaceful, and in a very safe area — everything we were looking for. The host went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed (and more!) for a comfortable stay.
What really stood out for us were the games provided — we spent so much of our time playing and laughing together, which made the experience even more memorable 🎲
Thank you for a lovely stay — we’ll definitely be back 😊

Warm and comfortable private studio in a great location.
Large space with separate bedroom, lounge and dining / work area.
Great security and very close to central Durbanville which has everything you need including a flagship Woolworths Food Emporium.
Eileen was a friendly and helpful host
Would highly recommend staying here

Amazing apartment with balcony.
Spotlessly clean and sparkling and very very comfortable. Will definately want to rebook next time in capetown!
Thankyou!

We had an amazing time! The flat is beautiful and very well equipped. The hosts are super responsive from the time of booking till the time we left. The view was stunning and the lovely balcony protects from the strong Capetown winds, letting you enjoy the view without being blown away! Thank you Brett and Henry!

On the beach. Great for early  morning walks. Place was clean and well decorated. All amenities were available making for a pleasant stay. Thanks for making our first time Airbnb experience memorable.
Lovely Apartment in a nice complex. Underfloor parking is nice, Pools were nice. Great Ocean View. Restaurant in the complex has very Bad Quality

The whole experience of renting Bretts apartment from beginning to end was a friendly and easy experience. Clear instructions were given and Brett was open to any questions I had as well as offering to assist with activity ideas. We entered the apartment with a "Wow". It was stunning and we instantly felt st home! The apartment was gorgeous and had everything we possibly could have asked for. The balcony was the perfect way to start the day with a coffee and finish off a hectic day with a wine overlooking the lagoon and beach. The building is secure and all staff friendly. Our 8 nights went by too quickly and it  was a sad morning when we left.......but we'll be back for sure!! Thank you Brett & Henry 😊

The place felt like a home away from home with all the necessary amenities. The place was cozy and clean, with a beautiful view of the beach/lagoon. Brett and Henry were also great hosts, very friendly, helpful and just great people to deal with. They even allowed us to check in early 😊 I will definitely come back again.

Brett is a wonderful, helpful and responsive host. The place is exactly what you see in the pictures, extremely comfortable with all the amenities one requires. The location is also easily accessible. We enjoyed our stay. Thank you Brett for being a super host.

We had a lovely stay  we really wish we had more ti.e there and better weather to completely enjoy everything this place has to offer. The guides and recommendations by the host was extremely helpfull and well thought out. Their communication was excellent, and prompt and exceeded expectations. The condo is very well equiped. Thank you for a lovely stay!
I really liked taking afternoon walks on the beach which was basically on our door step, with Table mountain in sight. I also liked the that there was safe undercover parking.

We had an amazing stay in the apartment. The apartment was clean and had all the necessary amenities. The area is also really beautiful and the beach is only a walk away. You can also see the lagoon from the apartment balcony, which is really nice. There is also an accessible pool on the roof top which is also a plus. Brett and Henry are amazing hosts, they were also very responsive. The location is also very convenient, very close to Canal Walk and the V&A. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Cape Town, who doesn’t want to stay in the City Centre but still wants easy access to it.

Staying at Brett's place was wonderful. The home was cozy and clean, good location on the beach and the hosts were always available and responsive, they went above and beyond to ensure we had a comfortable stay.
Convenient location, nice views and affordable pricing. Main bathroom was a bit leaky but otherwise we have 0 complaints. Would definitely recommend!

Spent a week here. Fantastic view, great clean and spacious space with all one needs, in a very convenient location. 24/7 power and security, and definitely a place to come back to next time I'm in town.

Centrally located perfect little home away from home. Paul was awesome great communication from check in till checking out he also granted us a late check out due to our flight being in the afternoon which was much appreciated.
Overall great experience would definitely recommend 👌

Stayed in apartments for a month. Everything as described. Small but nice apartments located in the residential building with safe access only for the residents, good for long stay, in walking distance to the green point park, seepoint restaurants and promenade. Fast WiFi.
Paul was very friendly and ready to help.

Really great place. Paul is an excellent host. He couldn’t do enough to make my stay comfortable and he allowed me to check out later than usual as I had an important conference call. You do hear traffic noise from the road but ear plugs work wonders. I would definitely book Paul’s place again.  It was perfect for my specific needs.

Great place for a 2 week stay. Safe and central but still quiet and cozy. The studio was very clean and had all the amenities for a comfortable stay. Paul was a great host, very responsive and welcoming. Highly recommended!

We had a great stay at Paul’s Airbnb. The apartment was super clean, well equipped and it felt very safe. Definitely recommend this place. Everything is as described in the listing. Paul was also responsive, helpful and nice.
Would definitely come back again.
the room was as described. Everything was there that you need and the location was great next to the park, stadium and restaurants

Great apartment with a great view. Balcony is quite nice and perfect for a romantic getaway as a couple. House is very comfortable and easy to settle into. Jaime is also very accommodating and you can message him whenever you need anything.
Lovely place to stay , super friendly and helpful host and co host. Would definitely recommend it.
Absolutely fantastic place! I thought it was way too good to be true when I saw all the reviews were great, but Jaimes’ place did not disappoint. Will definitely be back!
Thanks for letting us stay. Great location for V&A Waterfront and to explore Cape Town. Will definitely recommend!
Jaime and Nabu were very accommodating and the place looked great! Awesome location. Would definitely stay again.

This place totally exceeded our expectations during our week long stay! The apartment was clean, spacious, and safe!
The location couldn’t be beat! We walked alongside the canal to the waterfront everyday for all the best shopping, restaurants, and bars!
There is also a great restaurant/bar located on the ground floor of the complex for nights we didn’t want to go out and about!
The weather was unfortunately too cold for us to use the rooftop pool, but it would be perfect for those visiting during hot Cape Town summers!
Jamie and Nabu were both amazing hosts and checked in with us throughout our stay to make sure we were comfortable! Jamie even recommended some local spots which would be perfect or anyone who is new to the area!
Overall great stay & we would definitely book again!
thanks for host us Jaime we enjoyed the apartment and felt like home spent 9 days of relaxing.

We stayed at Jaime’s place for 6 weeks during preChristmas time and until past the New Year. It was a super location! We could walk easily to the V & A Waterfront area (about 10-12 min) walk. Once you are there everything you could possibly need is available to you. What we found was great- do your grocery shopping at the big Pic n Pay and Uber back. Uber rides are inexpensive and plentiful. It is a completely safe area with lots of guards/security around. We did not do much walking at night but felt completely at ease during the day. We were able to see the NYE fireworks from the rooftop and hit the Carnival Minstrel Parade on Jan. 2. The building is very secure and the apartment is outfitted well and the wifi is fast. Nice that underground secured parking is included. We would recommend and return if given the chance 😊 The assistant to Jaime (Nabu) was a sweetheart to work with.

Me and my family had an awesome stay, very peaceful homely, clean and an awesome host.
definetly great choice to stay.
malls are nearby.
Highly recommend😊 we had a problem at the airport and couldn’t check-in until 8 pm but Mandy was so understanding and kind. Thank you ladies ✨

I had a wonderful stay at Andreas place. very well equipped apartment with lovely views and a beautiful layout. Dawn was very helpful and communication was great!
Highly recommended to anyone wanting to stay in Cape Town which a little bit out the way of the hustle of city life.

A very beautiful and perfectly equipped apartment. The view was stunning and there are many cool shops and restaurants within walking distance. You can also walk to Hout Bay beach. Andreas is a very good host, he is very communicative and also helped us to store our luggage until we departed. Highly recommend this apartment if you’d like to visit Hout Bay!
Andreas‘ Airbnb is a nice & cozy place with all amenities you need. We really felt right at home. Thank you for everything!

Modernised, comfortable & well appointed apartment (all as pictured on Airbnb). Communications with our host were great & Danielle greeted us on arrival making checkin very easy & welcoming.
Uniquely stupendous views over Hout Bay, from the top level terrace, made the perfect vantage point for some stunning sunsets, wild windy ocean weather and
a mountaintop wildfire the other side of the bay on Christmas night!
Great location, very short walk to major stores/ shops & restaurants. Easy access to Central Cape Town, Constantia’s top wineries/ restaurants, Chapmans Peak Drive, Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens & the wider Cape including stunning beaches like Kommetjie.

The location was great with an amazing view and there is a lot within walking distance. Andreas was very responsive with great recommendations! The place was very clean and beautiful set! I enjoyed my stay very much!

Beautiful place! Gorgeous view from top floor. Very conveniently located across from Checkers and other shopping. There was a strange buzzing sound at random times that kept my husband awake for many hours at night. Didn’t bother me at all, but if you are a light sleeper, maybe bring earplugs. All-in-all I loved the place and would definitely return.

Great apartment in a great and safe location. Andreas was easily accessible via message and the concierge, William, was on hand to help with day to day queries. We plan to stay here when we pass through Cape Town again.

Very nice and central location and clear and easy directions. We could stay a few hours longer as our flight was in the evening, free of charge, which was really nice!
The view from the bedroom is gorgeous.
Only note for the somewhat taller people, the bed was not very large and therefore not comfortable, but that is a personal preference.

What a beautiful elegant and comfortable home! Loved our stay. The furniture and decor are tastefully put together, making the home warm and inviting. Our host Danielle was most helpful and very responsive. Thank you.

Andreas's home was very comfortable. Directly across the road are everything that you need from lovely little shops, restaurants and coffee shops to major grocery stores to stock up on all the essentials.
Danielle was a fantastic host and super helpful. She checked in from time to time to make sure that my mom and I were comfortable and was quick to respond to even the smallest question. It was also great to meet Andreas briefly as he was in town.
Highly recommend to anyone wanting a peaceful break but still have easy and walkable access to everything you need.
Lovely space for our family of 3. Good location if you are exploring all the beautiful tourist attractions around Cape Town. Danielle was a great help checking in.
Hannelore is a great host and her place is in a brilliant location. Clean, homely and surrounded by plants in a quiet area which gives you some peace in the busy city. Would definitely stay again.

It is a very nice and safe location. A super cosy apartment with access to the garden. Hennaleore is really accommodating, and we had many interesting discussions about Cape Town and South African history/politics. Thanks for hosting me, I will be happy to come again! :)
Hannelore was very friendly and welcoming. I loved her flat and garden full of green plants and her cat is very cute

Anthony has a lovely poolside guest suite attached to his large garden in a perfect location in the Constantia wine lands. Both he and his lovely family made us so welcome and did everything possible to help make our stay wonderful and memorable. The accommodation has everything you could wish for and he was a great host in every way.

Anthony has a beautiful poolside guest suite. The large, well-kept garden invites you to relax and enjoy nature. Its location in the winelands of Constantia and close to Cape Town 20-30 minutes makes it an ideal base for touring. Great was the warm welcome from Anthoyn and his prompt help and response to questions, he was a great host in every way.
We had an amazing stay at Anthonys and Robyns place! Beautiful studio and stunning garden. Communication was easy and clear, would love to come again!

Exactly as described and within easy driving distance (most people would not walk) of several restaurants and wineries. Highly recommend the location. Anthony was responsive, kind, and helpful. Would stay again (intend to!).

I felt pretty much as in my autn's house )) Got used to this place. Clean, comfy, with all facilities, in quiet street with an amazing view. Close to the bus stop. Hannelore is also such a kind person. Thanks!
Enjoyed my stay of 10 days. Everything in the Unit as advertised. A good place but more expensive when compared to other Units in the same building also on airbnb.
This home was what we expected. It was spacious and clean. The surrounding area is so serene just what the doctor ordered for a peaceful break away.

It was a fantastic experience and host was very friendly. We enjoyed our stay. Only the missing part was there was no AC or Fan. Sometimes we feel hot a lot,specially in the morning & day time. Rather then that everything was up to the mark. Thanks to our host who always responded quickly. Home & the location was outstanding.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Nadzeya’s house that was nothing short of spectacular. From the moment I stepped inside, I was struck by the beauty of the space. The decor was modern and tasteful.
Nadzeya was also very responsive and helpful.
I also appreciated the location of the house, which was in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood and there were security at night so we felt really safe.
Overall, I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a beautiful and comfortable place to stay.
This was one of the most wonderful AirBnBs I have ever been to. We were quite a big group but the house still had lots of space for living, dining or yoga and was a warm home to us.

Wow ,what can I say about this lovely couple .If you are looking to feel at home this is the best place to be at . They are amazing ,we felt right at home.We went through a difficult time and they didnt know about it but it seemed like they knew before we entered their home.The way they loved us ,the kindness ,the generosity OMW was out of this world .We lost our Mothers Years ago but in Ruth we found a piece of our Mother .Their house felt like home their love made us feel loved we forgot about our problems .We had a family to turn to when we go there people we could talk to .This was the best getaway ever .They give you ,your privacy their home is basically your home ... My son was sick but she was like his doctor checked his temp showed me the guidliness as this is my first child oh i can go on and on about this couple .They are amazing just Amazing ...

Great view from the windows and there's everything you need in the apartment. The only thing you should be ready for is the wind, it might be really noisy sometimes. But you'll get to used to it after some days.
Highly recommend to stay here

This is such a lovely quiet flat with the most stunning views of the mountain.  it is the ideal base for traveling for business or a base for traveling to see the sights within Cape Town.  Lovely and clean, be bed was very comfy!
amazing view and the hosts were very friendly. The check in and checkt out was very easy. We had really stormy weather and therefore it was very noisy in the room.
What a lovely place to stay, equipped with everything you need. We particularly enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere the mountain offered.
The view when waking up in the morning is very very nice! Be aware, that there is a bit of background noise but we got used to it after a few days.  Could use a makeover.

My stay at Leni's was everything and more than I expected. The view was hypnotic as it is the first thing you see when opening your eyes in the morning. Many hiking routes can be approached right from the building which is situated in lovely peaceful neighborhood full of greenery. I can not omit Jani's helpfulness, who really made things easy for me.

Thank you Jani for the easy check in and great communication.
The flat has a stunning mountain view with all necessities.
Great view and stay for a few nights in Cape Town. Jani was great with making our stay easy and homely. Only note is the two beds are joined and not separate!
Pleased with the accommodation, as advertised. Great views. Relatively close to the city. comfortable with all that we required.
We had a wonderful stay,  beautiful view of the mountains and perfect place to stay for our needs!
We had a good stay at Jani's. The place was as described and very quiet. It is like the pictures!

Dear Jani
We had a wonderful stay in your small, but comfortable, clean apartment. It was adventure to sleep in one of the iconic towers overlooking the beautiful city. The view of the mountain we had was equally stunning, peaceful and quiet. The wind howled a bit, but it was strangely comforting. The apartment is old, but clean and had everything we needed. This is very much a unique stand-out stay. Thank you for hosting us!

Loved it! The view is incredible and the bed comfortable! I only heard the wind on my first night and it wasn’t even bad. The pool is beautiful and the place secure too.
Jani was a great host and was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!
We only stayed one night, but it was amazing, we got a morning view like from another world, definitely worth to stay at this place

I loved my time at 11 Bollihop. The commune had great, respectful houseguests and I felt rested when I checked out.
Something that really struck me was the lovely choir sounds I could hear from the church opposite us on Saturday evenings. It struck a chord with me everytime.

My partner and I stayed here for a week and specifically chose a self-catering unit because we wanted to make our own meals. We weren't impressed with the kitchen, but the apartment is clean and we felt very safe there. There's no filtered water in the fridge, so we bought our own water to be cautious. No dishwasher or safe either. The location is great- super close to Table Mountain and V&A Waterfront. The security is friendly. Walls are very thin so you can hear all conversations in the apartment hallway.
Couldn’t have asked for a better stay. Host was in communication throughout. Very clean and cute and central place to stay at. Will recommend anytime and will return whenever in town.
As a returning client, this is definitely my favourite stay in Cape Town! Amazing staff, stunning and well managed place. The hospitality is out of this world. The security is remarkable.
This was a great location and space to stay for 2 days whilst in Cape Town. Quick walk to the V & A waterfront. And overall lovely property!

Highly recommend this place! Especially the location. With the waterfront a times throw away one can enjoy the best of Cape Town without any issues. The facilities including parking come very handy. The check-in was superb breezy. And yes very safe as well!
Had a very enjoyable stay. Jayson communicated everything very well and was available if I needed assistance. Will definitely stay there again.
Apartment has everything you will need for a short stay. Very clean and with many nice decorations. Good location. Check in process is also very easy.
Not the first time staying with Jayson and i must say this dude never misses. He never misses!!! Incredible host always.

The best I have ever seen. I was impressed by the attentive host who gave clear instructions about checkin and everything else.
The apartment was warm, comfortable, beautiful, CLEAN and well equipped with a cosy bed and helpful basics were provided in the kitchen. I loved it, it was so perfect. Thèè Best.
Would absolutely recommend this property.

Loved my stay, very private and my neighbors were very friendly.
The garage guards are my new friends too, the staff around the apartments are very helpful and kind.
Thank you!
Great stay, accessible to key areas in cape town, apartment has everything you need. A home away from home

98% great...excellent communication with host, great location (so many things are nearby and walkable), great security, easy access 24/7...the only 2% flaw would be that the couch needed a good cleaning and it was not comfortable, actually it was hard. After long days of sightseeing, a comfy couch would have been nice to sink into. So, if you are in Cape Town and you don't want loadshedding to affect you, this place will work just fine. The host is probably the best I have ever had...nice, polite and very quick with any responses.

A very cosy and cute house with all amenities needed (dishwasher, washing machine, veranda, garage etc...)
Would highly recommend for your trip in CT. Very safe area and nice view on the mountains
Cavendish shopping mall nearby, very nice

Had a great stay at this apartment! 10 minute walk to the V&A waterfront and in a nice street that felt safe. Jason and team were very responsive. Very clean and great value for money. If you plan to visit cape town and be out and about exploring this is a great base and would highly recommend!
I loved my stay at the apartment, it’s a beautiful, well-located apartment complex. For longer stays, a vacuum cleaner would be helpful, even though the apartment is cleaned on a regular basis.

We loved our stay here - such a lovely area with a lovely vibe. Check-in instructions were clear, the flat was in great shape and if there were any issues, the team sorted them out quickly. Loads of great restaurants within walking distance and the WiFi worked great which was good as we were working from the flat. The only thing I thought was a pity is that although the terrace is large, it is very sparsely furnished. No lounge-furniture, no plants or mats to make it cosy. We enjoyed breakfast out there regardless.
I’ve stayed here a few times now and it never disappoints! Beautiful place and great location! Jayson and his team are awesome hosts, would highly recommend any of there places.
The most fantastic place! Deborah was a gracious hostess and everything was top class. I’ll definitely stay there again on future trips. Thank you!

I booked Deborah’s place on behalf of my parents who were in SA visiting from the US. My mom and dad enjoyed their stay. Deborah was a gracious hostess and the apartment was just as described. Just one thing to note: there are 3 flights of stairs you need to go up to get into the apartment. With that said, this air bnb has all the amenities you need and beautiful views for a memorable stay.

Absolutely stunning unit. Modern facilities and views all around, we were honestly spoilt! Deborah also went out of her way to make our honeymoon special and gave us some great recommendations for dinners in the area. Can’t recommend enough! Perfect for a quiet and relaxed holiday

Wonderful place to stay. Very comfortable apartment with incredible views and great amenities. Apartment turndown service which was unexpected and very great - Phillip was most helpful with luggage and any other needs we had. Big thanks to Deborah and her team for hosting and accommodating our needs.

The accommodation is even more amazing and beautiful in person!!
The 360 degrees views are incredible, waking up to the sight of the ocean and the mountains was beyond picturesque.
Deborah is an amazing and attentive host.
The apartment is truly worth every single penny and you will not be disappointed.
Wow, what an amazing time we had at this beautiful place! Deb is an amazing host. We will definitely come back when we are in Capetown!

If you're looking for the best place to stay we definitely would recommend this beautiful and clean appartement with fantastic views on the Table mountain.
Other benefits of this apartment are: big private parking lot, swimming pool & located near nice restaurants, the beach and other amenities.
Thank you Rene & Deborah for your hospitality!
See you next time!

What an amazing place! The place has killer views from the balcony and from the bar/pool area. It is so central you can walk to many little cafés, bars and restaurants within 4 minutes. The security and staff were also super friendly and helpful.

It was a great holiday! Marius is always available and responds very quick.
Everything perfect 😊

Marius is a Great Super Host, He pays attention to detail He is Now My Best Best Host and I will be Looking at Places He Hosts.The Apartments is Beautifully decorated, Cosy and All. The View is Superb. I am definitely Coming back to this one❤️

Great place, it looks amazing and has a beautiful view as an added bonus. Check in was secure and simple. The place was exactly as advertised and the host Marius was very polite, friendly, reliable and accommodating. Would definitely recommend and would definitely book in future again if available.

Great place to be.
We got a bigger apartment for our stay and it was so great.
Spacious, clean and very stylish furnished. Everything you need is there.
The apartment is on the 23rd floor with a great view on the Table Mountain. The house is very safe.
On the 27th floor is a little sky bar.
Also very practical is the own parking space for the car.
The communication with Marius is so easy and fast. Very clear introductions and we also got some tips for dinner.
The location is near the Waterfront, Loop Street and Boo-Kap.
Next to the building is a nice little coffee shop.
We can highly recommend Marius and his flats for a place to stay.
If we are in Cape Town again we will come back.

Great appartment in the city bowl of Cape Town!
This appartment unit is located on the 23rd floor with a stunning view at the Table Mountain. Furthermore this studio is very neat, clean and complete.
The luxury appartmentcomplex ‘16 on Bree’ has good security services at the reception and parking, and a lovely rooftop swimmingpool and bar at the 27th floor.
Also we had good communication with Marius, he is very helpful and responds quick to any questions.
I really recommend this place for your visit to Cape Town!

A great host, never met him In person but everything was perfect. The apartment was clean and I loved the balcony. You easily see the table mountain from the balcony and some beautiful views. A 10/10 .
Everything perfect!! Felt right at home and safe! Entrance staff is nice and easy to talk to. Appartement super clean. Would definitely stay there again.

The apartment was immaculate and in a beautiful location of Cape Town with great views of Table Mountain and the VNA. Great amenities lovely rooftop bar and infinity pool to enjoy. Great place, highly recommend it.

Firstly, the security of this apartment is great! With fingerprint and face recognition access, i feel safe living in this apartment.
Secondly, it is strategically located. 10-20mins to table mountain, houts bay and most attractions. Less than 10mins to V&A Waterfront.
Thirdly, apartment is clean and beautifully decorated. My husband and I felt right at home during our stay here. Communication with host is easy and host is friendly and their service is great.
Definitely will book again if I were to come back to Cape Town. Highly recommend this apartment to everyone.

We had a splendid stay. Furnishings were modern . Place was clean. View was spectacular..
Will definitely be back

Great place and location was perfect for enjoying Cape Town. View was incredible, far better than the photos. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay again. My only constructive feedback was advert offered coffee machine but when I messaged to check I was told it no longer had one. To be fair they put a nespresso machine in for us but it was faulty & hard to get to work plus they only gave us 1 espresso cup between 2. Bathroom light was also temperamental, worked when it liked to 🤷‍♀️
I had a great time. Felt very safe.  Building security was out of this world. Very modern building and lots of restaurants nearby and the most important the bed was very comfortable

Great location for access to Waterfront and other attractions. It was around a 15 minute walk from apartment. We only stayed one night so didn’t use the on-site pool or bar. Exactly what we wanted. Secure checkin and car parking. Great views from balcony.
The place is ok - but it felt it was just not for me but that could be just me , otherwise not too bad.
Kay and Peter were very warm and welcoming, their place was very convenient for us as a family and the communication with them worked very well. I highly recommend their place.

The airbnb is nice, but it was a little noisy from the street and the people on the floor.
And in my room the locker for the things didnt function.

Not worth it in the end. Rules are not adhered to and people do what they want in the common room. Interesting use of the space also by individuals conducting ‘business’. Would not recommend unfortunately.

Great view and sunsets from the ocean front terrace! The apartment is spacious, well equipped and Joy has been very helpful and nice!
Steep roads up to the address

This is a stunning, peaceful, bright apartment with epic views. We loved staying there, watching sunrise and sunset from the apartment and being so close the beach and Cape Point. The sound of the sea at night was so perfect. Thanks so much Joy.
Lovely stay, such an easy check-in process and shops and beaches are all within walking distance. Definitely will be back!
Spacious house with stunning views. The perfect place to unwind and relax. Joy, the host is very helpful and nice. Highly recommend.

This is a lovely place in a spectacular place. The house has lots of interesting rooms, corners, books, balconies - and a hammock. The view is stunning. Joy was a very generous host. Overall, it is a wonderful place to spend a holiday.
Really enjoyed staying at Joys place. Joy was super friendly and helpful. The apartment is stunningly located.

nice getaway with beautiful views, only thing is that it is rather poorly soundproved. So if upstairs apartment is occupied as well, it can get loud.
The apartment was well equipped.

It’s been fantastic to stay in this great apartment with this fabulous view. Spacious, clean, great bed.
Scarborough is such a nice cosy town and the village hub in the center provides you with everything you need.

A good place to crash.
I appreciate the love and care shown by the family in helping me navigate this area. They went out of their way to assist me and adjust to the dynamics of Cape Town.
They are a true example of Ubuntu.
Great location, Very central, Secure & Enjoyed the stay very much. Would definitely come back!
great place to stay with family, lots space for kids and parents. nice area , GPS will however confuse if in need of Uber but all together will definitely recommend it
Caral and Roy were super nice and very friendly hosts. We had a very good communication. The house was perfect with a very large garden. We felt very welcomed and had a great time.

Sunning cottage, with amazing view of the Harbour. Extra personal touches and amenities were a treat - Nespresso coffee maker and washing machine to name just two.
Charmaine and Sheillah are wonderful hosts, friendly and helpful.
I would definitely recommend a long or short stay.
Very nice and clean place, has everything you might need. The decor is very pretty and the atmosphere was welcoming. Will recommend the place to anyone without a doubt.
Wonderful stay at Charmaine’s - even though only one night. Great value and a beautiful spot with all that you need. Thank you!
Lovely place to stay. Charmaine took me in at the very last minute, so I didn't get to do much, but I'll definitely save the place for next time I'm in Cape Town. Thanks again.
Great shower, fully fitted kitchen and as a bonus the flat was serviced!  Lots of lovely character and beautiful drawings.

Loved staying here! Has everything you need for a relaxing city break. Self check-in instructions were clear and the place was easy to find and host very responsive. A cleaner came in daily which was a bonus. The garden and views are stunning. We used the braai (BBQ) facilities too. Would definitely consider staying here again.
Very handy location for our purposes and close to places we wanted to visit and/or eat at. Everything was as described, and the internet worked well. Very nicely appointed and comfortable.

Always accomodates and makes sure she tries to meet you half way and full way sometimes haha.
Can't go wrong with Charmaine and the places she manages.
Super neat and clean! Looks better than the photos! Would definitely recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
This location is amazing ! The neighbourhood is safe with a nice view over cape town. The host is very flexible and let us checkin earlier. You get more than what you pay for :)
Enjoyed our stay, convenient and central. The place was endearing and had lots of character. Perfect for 1-2 people with a sleeper couch if you are 3 people.

We stayed at Walmer Cottage whilst my husband was writing exams in Cape Town. The area is peaceful and quiet, exactly what we were looking for. Restaurants and shops are only a short distance away. The cottage is lovely, and includes anything you'd need for a short visit or slightly longer stay. Charmaine was kind, helpful and responded to any needs very swiftly. Sheillah came in to clean daily. Thank you for a lovely stay, highly recommended!

This home is amazing!! Beautifully decorated rooms, lovely artwork, each bedroom with its own ensuite, and of course the most spectacular spectacular views!  The indoor heated pool with retractable roof was perfect for sunrise swims, and the location was wonderful. Audrey was a great host and communication was top notch!

Stunning home with breathtaking views of Gordon’s Bay, Somerset West and Table Mountain in the distance.
Perfect for families with kids. The indoor pool is simply amazing, we used it everyday.
Bedrooms and living area were well furnished and comfortable.
Kitchen could do with an upgrade to match the rest of the house. As we stayed for 10days, we used the kitchen quite a bit. Appliances need attending to and deep cleaning of same will be recommended.
Overall exceptional value for money and well worth it if you in the GB area.

Incredible views and a lovely spacious home. The pool area (that can close) was truly a great addition as it protects from the wind and still allows stunning days in the sun. A wonderful stay with the family!

A very special house on the edge of a cliff. The view is the big thing about this house. Extremely beautiful. Big windows. A dark little kitchen - but all other rooms were big and airy. The pool is nice - but small and not made for kids who like to splash and jump ;-)
A small beach (Bikini Beach) close by and a hiking trail just behind the house in the mountain. Strand is close but not really a nice place. Better to drive islands towards Stellenbosch and Franshoek.

Wow, probably the best Airbnb we have ever stayed in (and we’ve stayed in some cool spots). We managed to see the Airbnb hosts as they were leaving and they were so lovely, even left us a bottle of wine which we enjoyed by the fireplace in the evening. You will not regret booking this place!

A stunning, spacious house in a prime location with a breathtaking view you could admire forever. The amenities leave nothing to be desired. Communication with Stan was effortless – he responds quickly, communicates proactively, and provided valuable tips that made our stay even more enjoyable. A perfect experience!

It was an absolute pleasure to stay with Vernon and Mel. They were not only inviting but also included me in their family social engagement. They made my stay memorable. It was special to watch the rugby World Cup with them and this time will always be special. The place was everything I needed for this trip. It was close to all amenities and Tygervalley shopping mall and many others were minutes away. I changed my plans while in Cape Town so I could stay with them again before I leave Sourh Africa. This will now be my home away from home. These hosts are not only super hosts but also extra special. Highly recommended.

Totally recommend this place and it's affordable. Very quiet, safe and private, plus shopping malls and centers are near the location. Easy for Uber and food delivery services to find. Vernon and Mel are the sweetest, kindest, most adorable hosts I have ever encountered. They really do everything they can to make their guests feel at home. Their communication is quick and they are always smiling and very understand. God bless them for being so humble and good. Next time I visit Cape Town, I will book their place again.
Great host and nice safe place. Vernon's place is peaceful and quiet and very convenient to the malls around Tygervalley.
Vernon is a super host. I would definitely recommend the place for quote and peaceful neighbourhood.
Second time staying at Vernon's. He is a great and responsive host. A great place to stay if you are in and around CapeTown
Vernon and his wife are absolute gems of hosts! Very friendly and approachable. I'll definitely go to visit again if I ever need another Airbnb! :)

Truly a home away from home. If you want tranquility, space, peace this is the place you need to book. Family orientation with 2 doggies, a few birds, BBQ facilities, pool, ample parking space so close to everything without the heavy price tag
Ill definitely be back on my next trip to SA
Thank you for all the amazing hospitality, I really felt at 🏡 home😎🥰

My husband and I had such an incredible stay, we loved every minute. Great location, and the space itself is super modern and has everything you could want - a real home away from home. Alexander and Lizl were wonderful hosts and communication was really clear and easy. Highly recommend!

Alex and Lizl’s home was absolutely spectacular! Extremely specious, modern and very clean. Photos don’t show how beautiful the home really is, and the stunning views. Amazing sunrises and sunsets.
Alex and Lizl both communicated well and are both very friendly. They gave good recommendations for activities and helped whenever needed.
This was a genuine home away from home. We were so sad to leave and will most certainly be back in the future.
This has been our favourite Airbnb to date!!!
It's is the most beautiful apartment I've stayed in for a long time. Alex and Ilze are amazing hosts. stunning views of the mountains.

We enjoyed a luxury stay at this apartment! The views are incredible, the living areas are comfortable and beautiful and we had everything we needed. Shops and restaurants are in walking distance and the neighborhood is quiet and safe. We want to stay here again soon!

We had an amazing time at Alex and Lizls apartment. We had everything we needed and more. The house is huge and much bigger than on the photos. It is very stylish furnitured and very modern. We loved the view and sunrises and sets. We will come back for sure! Alex and Lizl are great hosts - always available and helpful. We felt so at home and really enjoyed our stay! Thank you!

An absolute gem of an apartment. tastefully decorated and spacious. Peaceful and relaxing. Alex and Lizl are amazing hosts. Always helpful and friendly. Home from Home!!
We will definitely book their apartment in the future.
Beautiful place, amazing views everything was perfect. The host was really nice and understanding, the staff were very friendly. Definitely coming back

It was great to stay at Pichyanee’s place.
We added days in the middle of our trip and it was seamless
This place is true value for money! Host is nice, communicative and flexible with checkin/checkout.

The location was excellently located in a lively area with lots of restaurants and very close to v&a waterfront. The host was very responsive and accommodating. I noticed some cockroaches on the first night due to windows being open, I brought it up and room was sprayed and issue resolved quickly otherwise room was comfortable clean and wifi worked great.
Our family enjoyed our stay at Barbara's place with large open areas and a spectacular view over boulders Beach, the boys loved looking at the penguins from the deck.

A fantastic ocean view in Simon’s Town! This is where you want to be if you want to travel around the cape. It’s a good, central location. There is a lot to do, and Barbara also has great recommendations! We wish we could’ve stayed longer, because it truly felt like home.

A gorgeous view! Great natural light, very cosy feel about it.
We loved our stay and would stay again in a heartbeat!

We stayed here in winter and it was a dreamy escape. The views of the ocean are amazing and the place is big enough for a family of five. The bed was super comfortable. We were a quick walk to boulders beach and had easy main road access to restaurants and pubs. I love this spot

Wonderful! What is beautiful gem to have come across, quite unexpectedly. Barbara's place was spotless, extremely clean and orderly, yet peaceful and comfortable all at once. Ideally located right on the water with a beautiful view, and, for me especially, the direct access to those lovely little penguins that I didn't even know were in Africa until my visit. I will stay here again if I ever get the chance!

Fantastic little house - beautiful all round sea views and only minutes away from the penguins. Two bedrooms but there was also a little mezzanine bedroom that my son wanted to stay in above the kitchen. If we had known how nice it was we would have booked to stay for longer.

The apartment is very comfortable, well equipped and the car has parking in the garage. There is a beautiful large terrace with a view of the ocean and penguins. The beach is a five-minute walk which is very nice and you can swim. Quiet, peaceful area 10 minutes by car to Simons where there are great restaurants and shops.

A lovely bright and spacious  apartment with a spectacular ocean view of Boulders Beach and the adjacent Simonstown and Kalk Bay area.  Comfortable and clean with everything you need. Spot the penguins from the deck and wander down the lane for a stroll to the reserve and various beaches near by. We enjoyed a morning swim at Water’s Edge beach on our last day and just wished we could have stayed longer. Barbara was a very attentive and communicative host. We hope we get a chance to return to this great apartment and further explore this beautiful part of the peninsula. Thank you, Barbara!

The place is nice & cozy, with a wonderful view, small kitchen and nice bathroom. Our only concern was the security, since there is no fance or alarm and we had the feeling that you can just „walk in“. It’s just a minor concern because the neighbourhood is really safe.
Shayle was a responsive host and I chose this place based on the price & self-check in.

everything was good. flexible check in possible. quick and friendly answers.
I can recommend this place when you want to have a quiet get away place. you can walk over the mountain or around on the street to the kalk bay centre. you will be in 30 min everywhere or you drive in with the car.
Defnitely a nice place to stay. thank you
The only issue was the lack of comms due to checkout times.  In saying this Shayle’s place is perfect 🤩

My roomate and I stayed in the studio apartment for our Cape Town vacation this January. Ckeck-in and Check-out were uncomplicated and flexible. The apartment itself was pristine, had all the listed amenities and is situated in a peaceful and safe environment. The gorgeous view from the balcony adds to the list of why we‘d recommend a stay in this accommodation.
My mother and I enjoyed our evening together at Shayle's lovely studio. It had  a tranquil serene atmosphere with fabulous views, walks and bird watching. Thank you.
Perfect for a short stay. Was exactly what I needed. Loved that Shayle left a small milk in the fridge so we could enjoy a cup of tea in the morning.
Great location, I was at Clovelly for a function and it is a short walk. Beautiful view and sitting on the deck is amazing.
Fabulous location with great views over Fish Hoek towards False bay . The apartment was Very clean and tidy with lovely comfy beds .
Anton went out of his way to make our stay memorable. So many little extras in the flat for us. Will definitely come back again. We had a fabulous time.

Anton and Meryl are truly warmhearted and welcoming hosts, making my stay an absolute pleasure. Their stunning place has an ethereal feel that is simply unforgettable. They were incredibly polite and generous, far surpassing all my expectations. I can’t recommend their hospitality and beautiful home enough!
Had a great stay - quiet area and responsive host. Perfect for those wanting to explore the city and surrounds.

Hosts were easy going and responsive. Lovely flatlet in a beautiful leafy neighbourhood of Cape Town, and had a homely feel. Bed was comfy with firm mattress, just the way I like it. Clean and tidy. Will go back.
Mione's place was great for a quick overnight stay. It was comfortable and clean with safe off-street parking. She was a great host who is very friendly and helpful.
Wi-Fi signal wasn’t the best but, Beautiful place and lovely place to stay, specially if you a runner, the common is just around the corner. Worth the stay!
Great and beautiful place to stay. Had no complaints. The place was as described, clean and there’s also a parking spot. The neighborhood is also safe and near shops and amenities.
Repeat guests.  Well suited to our needs.  Small cosy cottage.  Great host who is always flexible in accommodating our needs.  Will book again when next in Cape Town.
Great stay, clean place and as advertised. Has everything you need hosts are very responsive. The area has a lot of bars and restaurants as well. Nice location near city centre.

The apartment is large and spacious and has everything you need. There are many great cafes within walking distance. The underground parking was very useful. Due to the central location and thin windows, it can get noisy at night and there are a lot of stairs to climb when loadshedding is on.

Great location, easy to get to places.
Host were extremely helpful and responded all questions in time.
Would definitely recommend

Nice and quiet place to stay in Cape Town in 5 minutes away from Bree street.
Very secure building and polite staff. That was a pleasure to stay with Mandy & Dean.
Definitely will book this place again.
Very nice spacious place to stay. We really enjoy the city and the place was 100% nice. Neat and very welcoming feeling. Will visit again soon.

Lovely little quiet flat with a nice view! Everything was new and clean and easy peasy check in and out! Minora was such a lovely host, kind, patient, accommodating, considerate. I accidentally left a piece of clothing behind and she was so kind as to arrange to bring it to me when she was in town (Cape Town). I am very appreciative of her ☺️. Would recommend this stay!
it's been great to stay in Minora's apartment. Minora is a super host. Very nice and considerate. Definitely I will be back again.
Minora is a gracious and hospitable host. Her place is lovely and so comfortable. We would most definitely stay there again.

The apartment is clean and the host is friendly. The location is nice but the view can only be appreciated when you are outside the house, also some construction next door. We had some issues with the hot water when we showered but the host responded quickly and said they would fix it. We loved the beautiful and friendly cats outside !
What an awesome stay! Definitely will be going back. The host were friendly and super nice. I really enjoyed everything. Neat and clean apartment. Very responsive as well.

Minora and her husband were fantastic hosts. They were attentive to our needs and helped us with any way they could. The property is in a very safe area with breathtaking views of the bay. The place is spotless with everything you need in there.
High in Glencairn with partial sea view due to building next door. Good spot but not allergy friendly. Mold in the bathroom and friendly, persistent cats.
Shaun and Kwi's apartment was so beautiful and conveniently located near lots of restaurants and shops in Sea Point. It was amazing being able to go out and walk on the promenade at any time too.

Excellent location, good access to the beach and the convinient stores plus restaurants.
The apartment was clean and all ammenities functioning. It was easy to access from Green Point Stadium which was the start point of our Marathon.
Definitely worth every penny. Shaun and Kwi was very responsive host. Perfect location. Loved the fact that the WiFi was working during loadshedding.

This was definitely one of my alltime favorite airbnbs. The location is perfect. We felt like home immediately. We absolutely loved everything about it. Good thing to know: During load shedding WiFi is working :) and the apartment provides a big battery so that you can load a few things when the power is off.

Location was perfect easy access on foot to shops and promenade
Back up for wifi was great
The apartment was nice.  It looked better in the pictures, so we were a little disappointed.  The water in the shower does not drain.  But the hosts were very friendly and available

Stayed here with my mom and aunt for a week and we felt at home. Communication with the host was easy and the it was close to both the beach, resturants and grocery stores.
I would come back here the next time I am in cape town!

Such a fabulous stay at this lovely apartment - it was central and perfectly situated for us, close to the promenade, and to many fabulous restaurants and shopping centres. It's well appointed, the kitchen was great with everything we needed, the beds were super comfy, and there was plenty of hot water. What's not to love??
Adored all the quirky little touches, and the interesting books.
Many thanks. We so enjoyed our time there.

We had a lovely stay and as we did not realise there was no secure parking lot inside the gate, the caretaker was very accommodating and gave us his parking spot.  The kitchen/lounge is lovely and the view is very nice.  We did not expect to see a washing machine and tumble dryer in the bedrooms, but was nice to have them available to use and there was even a pod to use.  Overall the stay was great.  Thanks!

We loved this place and want to visit again! Beautiful views from the big windows were our favorite part about waking up. The kitchen had everything you could have needed and more. Location is great for getting to all of the tourists spots and you’re walking distance to food and to watch the sunset. The hosts were proactive about load shedding and the colder winter months. They provided a heater and extra lights for our stay. We also had access to wifi throughout the stay, even when we loss power. This place was a gem!
Stay was amazing with great views and interiors. Very clean and well thought! Have all appliances and utilities, near the seafront and nice cafes! Would love to come back!
This was our second time in this wonderful place and we absolutely loved it. Will come back soon!

Great place & location. Views of the beach and walkable to restaurants. We loved sitting at the breakfast nook & reading our books. Super cute decorations, comfortable beds, loads of charging ports. Also, check-in & check-out was SO easy. Would definitely stay again!

Amazing weekend thanks to the prime location of this property! John was very friendly and helpful at check-in. It is very peaceful and quiet during the nights and fun to watch the city come to life in the mornings.
We will definitely be visiting again and will recommend this property to our fiends and family.

Great location in every way. Elegant and modern decor. Felt safe and it was quiet enough during the nights to sleep well. Kitchen was very well equipped although we didn't use it much. The apartment was more spacious than I had imagined and it was fantastic to have extra sinks in the master bedroom. The host was extremely quick to respond. We had no issues whatsoever during our stay and would definitely stay again.

Our first stay in Seapoint.  Beautiful view on the sea, promenade and swimming pools.  The accommodation has everything you'll need for a self-catering stay. Well equipped, sunny space. Walking distance to lots of restaurants and grocery stores. MOJO Market just around the corner.  Parking for us was difficult to find (no inside parking for guests),  circled quite a few times. Weather was stunning so I suppose many people came to the area. Thanks for a great stay!

Stayed for the weekend with a couple of friends and really enjoyed this flat! Views out onto the ocean were absolutely breathtaking, worth booking just for that! Host was also super responsive and the cleaner was contactable for any problems / to help with check-in/check-out. Would definitely book this again!
Great place in a beautiful area of cape town. The Host was very responsive, and flexible as far as check-in/ check-out is concerned. Highly recommeded

This was a great stay for our family. Beautiful view on the ocean, great restaurants and grocery store nearby. An the apartment was charming, good beds at the quiet side of the building. We highly recommend our stay.

Nicole was a fabulous host and the welcome goodies were a very special touch. The instruction manual was clear and detailed. The house is a lovely size and on a very pretty street. The location is excellent. The beds were super comfy. Although the alarm system was a bit of a hindrance and the lights shining through the bedroom window were unpleasant at all hours of the morning, this was not due to  any fault of the house but thanks to loadshedding. The battery provided to ensure there was always Wi-Fi was a win! Definitely recommended.

We recently visited Cape Town for a holiday and had the pleasure of staying at Airlie Family Retreat Airbnb. It was an unforgettable experience. As a family of four (2 adults and 2 kids, 12 and 8), the space was perfect for us. The property offered secure parking, which made having a rental car convenient.
Nicole is an outstanding host, always quick to respond with a 100% response rate. Whether we had questions or needed recommendations, she was available and helpful throughout our stay. Her friendliness and support made a big difference.
One highlight was hosting visiting family members during our stay, and Nicole was completely accommodating. This flexibility made our experience even more special.
In short, Nicole's combination of great hospitality, privacy, and attention to detail made this the perfect home away from home. Highly recommended for families or anyone looking for a welcoming stay in Cape Town. We'll definitely book with her again on our next visit!

The house was amazing and has everything one needs. Security was an added bonus with alarm, electric fence, etc. This area of Bergvliet is very pretty and central to main routes. Nicole was very attentive and made sure we were comfortable and stayed in contact to see if we needed anything. Joy and Jessie the domestics were lovely and highly recommended. Would highly recommend the house and will definitely be back.
Lovely clean and well decorated studio at great location in Cape Town. Would surely recommend. Exactly as in the pictures.

Our stay in Camps bay was wonderful. The location is great. We loved that it included on site parking and not street parking. It is incredible value for money. I would recommend staying with Bertus and Anna
Amazing place, wonderful hosts and staff. The service was impeccable. I really enjoyed my stay with Anna & Bertus. I will Definitely be staying with them whenever I am in Cape Town.

Anna and Bertus have been a great host.
They always replied to my messages immediately and were constantly trying to make my stay as convenient as possible.
The studio is beautiful and the small balcony is perfect for having breakfast in the morning with view on Table Mountain.

Had an amazing stay, wish I could’ve stayed longer. Perfectly located, walking distance to Camps bay and the beach.
Hosts ensured everything was perfect for my stay.
Brillian host, that’s what Albertus is. Very well thought out unit with everything we needed. Definitely would visit again. The care and attention to detail was quite striking.
A beautiful spot to stay! We loved our time there and Albertus was a great host, very helpful throughout our stay.

Very good location, matching with the description.
The instructions were easy and the house very clean.
Very nice and so easy to stay here. The washing machine and dryer was so good for our travels and everything was easy. Hosts were very contactable and helpful.

We really enjoyed our stay here.
The beach is within walking distance. There are plenty of supermarkets and restaurants around and the neighbourhood is safe and clean.
We would love to come back sometime.

Great place! We stayed for a week so it was wonderful to have a fully stocked kitchen as well as a washer/dryer! The space was clean and tidy! Location is wonderful, close to the action but very peaceful! 5 minute walk to the beach and a lovely coffee shop. The host even let us leave our bags at the apartment later than check out so we could enjoy the day before leaving the area! Would happily stay here again!
Fabulous views, close to all amenities. The staff is of the highest quality I have ever encountered, really friendly, helpful and effective. Will definitely return.

A beautiful place, sufficient space for a family of 3 or 4. The view is breathtaking!!! The host is very responsive. The facilities are also very nice... beautiful pool with view of table mountain, ocean and robben island. Basic gym for those crazy enough to exercise whilst on vacation lol. Laundry facility in the building which came in handy when the dryer in our flat was faulty. We would certainly go back again. Thank you!

Me and my family felt home.
Will def visit again, wifi was slow had to buy data hopefully its resolved when next family checks in

it was an awesome experience and I must say the stay was nice the place was beautiful better than what we expected 😊
loved it , loved it ,loved it 🥰 .
The place is amazing! Clean and peaceful. Fulufhelo is a great host. Really I’d visit here many time.

Fulufhelo is an professional, reliable host with a unique sense for hospitality.
He was friendly, welcoming and very attentive. In addition to the professionalism he surpassed expectations and had complimentary items, such as coffee, milk etc. ready. A great experience in the beautiful Marina da Gama :)

The stay was amazing, everything was clean and cosy basically it was a home away from home. All appliances needed was provided and supplies to make it more convenient. The host was more than friendly and accommodating, definitely going back again🥰🥰
Nice and clean place. The staff are friendly as well. We enjoyed our stay👌 Fulufhelo is a great host and always kept in touch.

This was a absolutely wonderful experience, the place is immaculate, Fulufhelo is a very friendly and warm host, the place is beautiful the mountain view from the balcony is breathtaking, the shopping centre is a 5 minute walk away, the beach is a 5 minute drive, we had an amazing time. Thank you Fulufhelo for everything

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Fulufhelo’s lovely property and I can confidently say it was an exceptional experience. One of the highlights of my stay was the overwhelming quietness of the area, which offered a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of daily life.
Fulufhelo was incredibly accommodating, especially considering my late arrival. He went above and beyond to ensure that I felt welcomed and settled in comfortably. The staff were equally courteous and made my stay even more enjoyable.
The surrounding marina is simply breathtaking, providing a perfect backdrop for relaxation and exploration. Each evening, I was serenaded by interesting bird sounds that I couldn’t quite identify, adding a delightful touch to the serene atmosphere.
Overall, my stay at Fulufhelo’s place was nothing short of wonderful. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a tranquil getaway with a host who truly cares about their guests.
Stay was very well,it was neat suitable and everything we needed was there,no noise,peaceful and quiet.Would fully recommended it again to any other who wants to book it.

My fiancé and I had the most amazing month at Marie’s place! It felt so cozy and comfortable. Anything you need it was all there! Very convenient and a 5 min walk to the beach. Definitely would be coming back!

We know Hout Bay well and really loved Marie-José’s apartment. We were very cosy, loved the decor and enjoyed being able to easily walk to the shops. Would love to stay in the apartment again.
Sarah & Peter

Such a lovely apartment and really centrally located. It's just a short walk to the beach and coffee shops.
