I'd recommend it to anyone coming to stay in Hout Bay. I'll definitely be back. Thanks a million for a lovely stay🤗
Peter was a fantastic host. Quick to respond, efficient with communication and very hospitable. High recommend him and he has a fantastic place

A great place for some quiet time! The view from the balcony in the morning and evening towards Table Mountain was breathtaking! Everything I needed was provided. Great Video on demand on TV. Clean and very spacious.
I met Peter for a very brief chat. Thanks again!

The place was very clean and comfortable. The hosts were very welcoming and friendly, which was very helpful in settling us in. They also responded promptly to the requests we made. We shall definitely go back!
Pete is a Super Host. He’ll go above and beyond to assist you and he is so accessible. Nothing is too much for him and he is just a Great Guy. Would highly recommend this accommodation. Thank You
Perfect stay in Pinelands, Cape Town, close to N2 and N1 so anything is a stone throw away. Beautiful fully equipped apartment and lovely experience staying there ! Would recommend to everyone
Peter’s place is very central and very clean. He is very responsive thus anything you need will be provided. The added benefit is solar power.
I really enjoyed my stay, I would definitely recommend for a person that’s looking for a peaceful, clean and value for money airbnb.

I had a fantastic stay!
This is spacious, comfortable and with excellent amenities. As advertised. I highly recommend it.

I enjoyed my stay at 57Forest unit 4, Peter (host) provided me with clear details, directions and requirements well in advance and on the day as well.
Secure parking and access to my unit was private and secure.
Check in/out was effortless.
No complaints from my side, I would highly recommend 57Forest and I will be staying with them again when I need to be in CPT for business!
Very convenient stay, clean and well equipped. If you're not from a big city the road noise could keep you up.
Peter was very accommodating, responded well within a couple of minutes, it was a late check in & he didn't mind it at all. 😊 Will definitely be back for a longer stay ✨

My stay in the treehouse was just what the doctor ordered...peaceful and tranquil. The surroundings gave me the opportunity to do some work I had put off for months. It is a bit isolated, but Uber is available and reasonable. Karin was always available if I needed something. She is very sweet and accommodating. Yes, I will return to the trees next year!
Karin's place is in a good location in Hout Bay and also close to Constantia.

I would recommend Karin as a host anyday. She was so welcoming and accomodating.
The property is safe and peaceful, beautiful mountain views.

Beautiful quiet and clean studio. Comfortable for longer stays with everything one may need . There is a big garden and the flat has a sperate entrance.
Really cool space, recommended!
Had a great stay. A cosy cottage in a lovely area and Karin a communicative and kind host. Would highly recommend it.
This is such a beautiful place to stay, clean, central, with a stunning view of table mountain. We enjoyed our time here and the host Janina checked in regularly with us.

Great location, central to CT. Easy and safe to walk to numerous restaurants. The iron did not work and Janina dropped off a new one the next day.
It’s a pity the TV did not have a signal I could watch the news and a few small cockroaches 🪳 running around on the bathroom and kitchen floors, but overall the apartment was clean and orderly, with clean sheets and towels. The bed and the couch was comfy.
I’d come back in spite of the 2issues.

The accommodation is beautiful with an amazing view.
It's very easy to get there and has lots of bars and restaurants around it.
Feels like home there.

My son and hubby stayed in Janina’s apartment and had a wonderful stay! Location is perfect to get to many places around and nearby . Smooth check in , great communication and lovely clean apartment x

This spot is well located and it was easy to catch an Uber everywhere we wanted to go. It is right in front of Company's Garden Park which is lovely to walk through in the mornings and early evenings. Gorgeous view of Table Mountain that made adjusting to the time difference a breeze. We felt safe since there is always security staffed in the building.
The bathroom was not as clean as we would have liked but there are cleaning supplies stocked so we made it work. And the bed was a bit too firm for us. Good for a few nights but by the 3rd night we were feeling the impact. Overall, it is a cute apartment centrally located which makes exploring and enjoying all Cape Town has to offer an ease.

Beautiful apartment in really convenient location. My husband and I needed to work while staying there - excellent WiFi and no loadshedding, with a view of table mountain from the apartment! We were extremely comfortable for a week here.
Janina is a wonderful host as well, so accommodating and responsive.
As a bonus, the filming of a Hollywood movie took place on the street in front of the building, it was quite exciting!
Great view and nice space. Bring an eye mask because it gets very bright in the morning and there are no curtains on the windows.
Perfectly located apartment for being in the middle of Cape Town CBD with thoughtful amenities and super comfy and views for days!

What a beautiful flat centrally located to everything in and around Cape Town. Janina was a great host and always made sure to accommodate me wherever possible. Would definitely recommend Janina’s place for your trip to Cape Town.
Fantastic studio flat which had everything you needed. Spacious and clean with easy access to places. Janina was kind and helpful and communicated effectively

The place was awesome and i instantly felt home. The key broke the first day but the next morning it already got fixed. Communtication was very easy and i always got fast responses. I can recommend this appartment

I had a fantastic stay at this stylish flat! The space was exactly as pictured, modern, clean, and thoughtfully decorated. The flat was spacious, with a comfortable lounge area, a well equipped kitchen, and a cozy bed. It was a huge bonus that the property had parking and no loadshedding issues, which made everything so much more convenient.
Janina was a great host responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout the stay. Check-in and check-out were seamless, and the location offered beautiful views and a peaceful atmosphere.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a relaxing and hassle-free stay. Would definitely book again!

my stay at Janina's listing was incredible. she's warm, kind, welcoming and such a good communicator.
she was always responsive, and understanding since the initial inquiry before my booking and also made sure to check if I was alright or needed anything throughout the entire week that I was booked at her premises.
her listing is accessible, easy to check in to and very neat. for me it felt more of a home away from my own.
would highly recommend her place and plan on staying there again the next time I visit Cape Town!

Janina is a great, friendly host who was sure to check-in and communicate at all times. Her place is lovely, clean and the double windows block out any outside noise. The location is perfect, right in the middle of town and close to everything. The building has 24 hour security which makes it feel safer. Enjoyed my stay & would recommend her place.
lovely place. Rosie was super helpful and brilliant communication. great location and very safe. Has its own generator so load shedding is no problem.

Rose was the best host..From the day we made a booking she has been communicating with us.
The place was amazing, its clean, well furnished, safe area and the Jacuzzi was our highlight. We were also not affected by loadshedding as the building has backup power. She was kind to let us checkout late. I would definitely recommend this place~ 10/10!

Had a wonderful stay at Ruan’s place. Superb location right beneath lions head. Very easy to get to. Host was extremely friendly and responsive.
The no load shedding was a massive plus for us.
Definitely recommend staying there when you’re in Cape Town

We enjoyed staying at Ruan’s listing and Rosie was amazing!
We loved the jacuzzi, which we used each day we were there!
The location was also great, walking distance to some amazing restaurants.
We highly recommend this place!

We had a lovely stay and Rose was an amazing host. We especially enjoyed the outside space and the jaccuzi, easy to manage and even if it‘s windy outside the terrace is very protected.
If you need both bedrooms- only one has a window, and the walls are rather thin.

We loved our stay in this cozy apartment. It was very nice and clean, just like the pictures. Nice terrace and good location very close to Kloof Street! The bedroom with glass had privacy curtains towards the kitchen. Strongly recommend staying here!
My family and I had a beautiful stay at Ruan’s place. Very friendly host who was also flexible with checkin and checkout times. I would highly recommend.

The apartment was perfect for our few days travel to Cape Town. It is central to major attraction which made it a quick drive to get to Table Mountain, Camps Bay, Lion’s Head, V & A Waterfront etc.  Also just around the corner of Kloof street with all its buzzing restaurants and bars. A great plus is the backup generator during loadshedding and the apartment that is very secure and safe. We’ll definitely recommend this apartment for anyone who wants to travel to Cape Town. Thank you Ruan and Rosi for being such lovely hosts to us during our stay. All the best!

This gated cottage community is in a beautiful and safe location which is close to wineries and great hiking! Ross is a very kind and attentive host. He is also very quick to respond to any questions or needs. The beautiful back patio and views was the highlight of every morning! We would certainly stay here again.
The cottage is also equipped with powerful flashlights during load shedding times, however; the property is quite dark during those times. Just something to be aware of.
We had a great stay and appreciated Ross' responsiveness to our queries and requests. The fireplace was a hit!

This is the second occasion we have stayed at Houtkapperspoort and again it did not disappoint. The Estate is lovely and an easy and central spot for visiting Cape Town and the Peninsula. Ross's cottage was lovely and just what we expected with all the amenities for a most enjoyable stay. We especially enjoyed the patio with the beautiful mountain views, and cooking evening meals on the braai/BBQ. Ross was responsive, and always felt on hand if we needed to communicate. We will definitely return again and highly recommend.

The apartament is jsut like in the photos.
Well located just 20min walk from the Water Front.
The communication was pretty easy with the host.
The place has no heater, at winter it can be a bit cold inside it.
There are many beggars around the building I think because it is too close to the bus station.
It was nice staying here and I would recommend it for short stays.
had to wait for a bit to be shown to my group but all in all I had a pleasant stay
I enjoyed my stay.Staff helpful and friendly.Place is tidy and location is nice and central-walking distance to shops and restaurants.

Just as advertised. Quite central to everything so you can go exploring.
Whenever I needed help there was someone to assist me immediately.
I honestly cannot fault anything about my stay.
Lovely place with different pieces dedicated for the guests as gym room, clubhouse, go-working space..

Clean, modern, stylish apartment with smart TV, microwave and mini bar fridge plus a great air-con to keep the room cool on the hot days. Perfect spot if you need a central location from which to explore the city of Cape Town from. The apartment feels very much like a hotel stay with gym, rooftop and workspace facilities available in the building. Great Wi-Fi connectivity. The front desk personnel are friendly and always willing to help. Having a Truth coffee kiosk at the front desk was a nice touch and convenient to grab a coffee on the run! Great value for money, will definitely be back on my next visit to the city.

The most objective review I can give about this place is that the amenities were great and the people in the building were fantastic but the communication between the "owner" and their management company was one of the worst experiences I've had through airbnb yet. If in part you like airbnb stays for the 'personal touch,' then talking to someone's assistant after they took hours to respond, kept you waiting outside of the building, and then refusing to honor an earlier price probably isn't your idea of an easy stay. This, after nearly a week of staying there. I also want to acknowledge that it may be a one-off, and that everyone deserves a second chance, but after traveling for a year exclusively through airbnb this one stands out as one of the most impersonal experiences yet that in the end...cost me and left me feeling just disappointed.

I really enjoyed my stay at Black Brick. Very neat and modern rooms. Great roof top lounge and chill out area . Having free parking in the middle of town is a huge plus too. Staff was very friendly and helpful . I will definitely be staying here when ever I’m in Cape Town again .

This is the most unprofessional business I’ve had the displeasure to come in contact with. They 1. Told me at 3pm my room wasn’t ready and was still being cleaned. 2. Then decided to tell me I couldn’t stay there because the room had water damage. The receptionists are horrible at their jobs, just in constant state of “confusion” all the time. I highly suspect that they overbook rooms.

The room was awesome, a bit stuffy but other then that we loved our stay, staff are amazing and so helpful. We did not get a chance to make use of all the facilities but I’m sure they are great. We will definitely be back
Very central location in the business district. The building has a lot of extra facilities that can be used, like a gym and a movie theater. Staff was very accommodating as well
Location, design and high speed internet connection made my stay comfortable and productive all the way along. I've never even dreamed of that at the beginning!

The location was so hard to find, ended up having the concierge to help me. Was lead through so many back doors to eventually get to the reception area. The room in itself was smaller than expected and not only was the water off but the toilet didn't work. had to call someone out, one needed to log into your own Netflix or you just needed to watch YouTube. Bad experience overall.

I had changed Airbnb’s in Cape Town because I was not happy with my previous location & apartment but BlackBrick was well above par, would definitely recommend to family & friends
I enjoyed my stay

Prior arrangements with the management made my stay an absolute breeze. Great location , walkable distance to every hangout spot you could imagine. The room was just as it is on the website & it was pristine clean. Would definitely visit again.
Overall my very impressed and will definitely come back… parking also available which was a big plus considering the location

trouble with logging and out of Netflix.
parking was not direct lift to the car level.
This facility is well located and was reasonably priced for the location. Our stay was comfortable and pleasant and we had no issues .

I only planned to stay here for 2 nights and ended up extending my stay, as the team were extremely friendly and welcoming, and there were some great events organised as well during my stay. Wi-Fi was extremely fast and made working from the studio or workspace easy, and the coffee in the entrance lobby was really good and well-priced. Definitely stay here again
I had a great stay at BlackBrick apartments. Helpful & friendly staff and well located. Highly recommended.
It’s a nice location, as in central. It has a business vibe though, but as I said, super central. Staff is super friendly and I felt safe in the building with the 24/7 reception/ security

Absolutely loved my stay here, and the best team I’ve come across!
Thanks Kendall, Akella and Caleb!
I had a really good time and the room was like a little pod for me to rest after long nights DJing. perfectly located if you wanna be in and around the CBD I'll definitely be back.

For the price and give I booked a day before, the place is great value for money and the photos don’t do justice to the place. Friday night drinkups at the roof top are fun and posh. Fantastic location!!
Great place to stay in town for a few days! Co-working space is in the basement, so not that pleasant to work, but the apartment was nice and really comfortable. I'd come again.
My brother thoroughly enjoyed his stay at BlackBrick and there was clear and great communication throughout. The added features of a cinema and gym were great too!

Great location if need to be in central CBD, great study/office co-working area with boardroom.  Great gym and in house cinema room. Regular cleaning, towel and sheet changes with no loadshedding - city professional's dream pad! Front staff are professional, timely and readily available to answer any questions needed to make experience enjoyable. Really a great gem in the city!
Amazing place, just the noise made by the water system on the upper apartment was a bit  startling at times. Overall experience was nice, exactly what they've advertised.

Very pleased with the accommodation: The parking facility is inconvenient, noisy neighbourhood, front desk could be a bit friendlier. House keeping staff amazing, security very helpful. I enjoyed my stay, will certainly want to stay here again.
Lovely apartment and the building has so much to offer. Daily cleaning service is wonderful. Centrally located. Clean. Friendly staff! All round just great!

The place was really stunning. The location was very central to everything in town and easy to navigate, the room was spacious and comfortable.
Loved the extra amenities and as a solo traveller you’ll have a great time with the activities available at the location.
Someone comes in every day to make the bed (but not change the sheets and bedding which is a bit odd) but really liked that and fresh towels are available daily should this be required.
The cons are the same as everyone has listed, I was in 201 and the water pipes are very loud, the WiFi drops and doesn’t come back for the day and there were cockroaches in the kitchen and even inside the fridge

Thànk you Black Brick for your assistance and making me feel safe and at home. I was a lovely stay for me during a tough time. It is close to Christiaan Barnard Hospital and made situation so comfortable traveling easy short distance daily. Check in assistance was super and a real calming for this farm girl lwarning her way around in the big city all alone. I felt safe and cared for. Thank you so much. 5☆ from me. I will be back here soon.
Definitely matched the photos. The interiors of the room is trendy, neat and clean, worth the price. Staff were friendly and helpful.
Really enjoyed my time at Black Brick definitely coming Back soon Place is very clean and the Location 100%

Great place clean and friendly staff at check in. Looks exactly as advertised. The entering and exiting of the parking was a nightmare had to wait 30-45min infront of the boom as there was no staff even after calling no one came. The security at desk was very friendly. Lastly when calling for the iron they advised me to fetch it myself via the Whatspp line.
Not worth my stay. Wi-Fi was not functional, tv not working, heating not working and Cape Town was cold. Their communication and the level of consideration was very poor

Brigitte’s place is really a gem. It’s spacious and very comfortable with absolutely everything needed. Clean and neat with modern amenities and great appliances as well as lovely thoughtful touches. Served us perfectly as a base to get to lots of different areas. Super comfortable lounge and bedrooms and luxurious bathroom and shower in the main. Kitchen is the best equipped I’ve seen in an Airbnb for a while. Wi-Fi worked great and we were able to work etc. super easy access to shops and restaurants. Brigitte was extremely helpful and responsive. Would loved to have stayed longer and would highly recommend to leisure and business travelers.

We choice this cottage for its location but it is also beautifully decorated and furnished, extremely spacious (small private garden and plunge pool, with braai), exceptionally well equipped, and having WIFI and TV that works during load shedding - what a treat! Brigitte is a warm and friendly, yet unobtrusive, host.  It really was a wonderful place to stay for Christmas.
We had a lovely stay in Brigitte's beautiful property. Everything was so well laid out and clean. The cottage was beautiful, comfortable and so well located

Even though the photos of this cottage are very nice they still don’t do the actual place justice! We were a family of four and the cottage was spacious enough for us to very comfortably stay there for a week. Everything seems to have been thought of and anything you could possibly need is provided. The location is central to all of the tourist attractions too. We will most certainly be booking this cottage again!

Brigitte's cottage is an absolute gem.  It is very easy and comfortable to live in.  It was absolutely spotless, the beds and linen fresh, clean and comfortable.  We had clear instructions for our arrival and check out and could want for nothing while we were there.  We cannot wait to stay again in the future when we next travel to Cape Town.
What an absolute GEM 💎. We will definitely be back. Super clean, comfy, neat and just relaxing. LOVED IT!!!

Brigitte's house is spacious, & beautiful with everything you would want for your stay. I especially enjoyed the bath & fireplace and the proximity to everything.
She is very gracious host.

Stayed for two months. Beautiful home and great location. Everything was clean and the house is very well equipped with everything you would need for a long stay and short stay. Brigitte was very helpful with our stay. Would highly recommend.

We stayed 14 days in Tim's beautiful apartment and felt very comfortable there. From the balcony there is a wonderful view from the sea, the bed is wonderful, living room and kitchen offer everything you need for a longer or shorter stay. The wifi is sufficient to be able to work. We walked a lot in Sea Point and felt safe. Shopping can be done within walking distance and various restaurants are also within walking distance. You can always get an Uber within a few minutes and are thus well equipped for further distances or for entire day trips. If we come back to Cape Town, we would definitely take the apartment again. The communication was flawless and very nice.

I had an amazing time at Tim's place. It was a 15 min walk to the beach and close to shops and restaurants. Michele was the best. Our flight was delayed and she kept checking up on us and checking when our flight would land. She also had nice treats for us when we got there including a bottle of bubbly.The place is lovely modern and has all the amenities that you need.

Firstly, the surrounding area is ideal and close to the shops and restaurants.
Upon arrival, Tim took time out of his day to come meet and greet us and show us inside this beautiful paradise. And to our surprise, welcome bubbles for us which was a very generous and pleasant gesture.
In entering this ethereal beautiful apartment, you are met with a pristine kitchen with all the necessary amenities you can think of (coffee machine is just the cherry on top). You’ll notice the apartment having all these modern touches to it that make it really homey. My partner is a sucker for beautiful bathrooms and she immediately fell in love with this one.
The place also has an amazing view overlooking the ocean which makes you feel like you looking at it through Gods eyes.
All in all, definitely value for money!
A great place to stay if you’re visiting Cape Town. Easy access to everywhere you may need, 10 minute walk down to the waterfront, views from the balcony were blissful. Would definitely recommend!

I would like to thank Bruce and Fyton for my stay in Cape Town.  They both have great communication skills and are very responsive.  Fyton picked me up from the airport and dropped me off at the airport.  He is safe and thoughtful driver.  Bruce’s place is a gem of a home away from home. Thank you both for a great time in Cape Town and I will see you soon.
Had an excellent stay, was close to all amenities and well equipped. Fyton met us on arrival and was super friendly and helpful. Will definitely stay again.

Great location for Sea Point. Bruce’s place is on Ocean View Rd above the beach but only 5 mins walk down to shops, bars and restaurants. The sea front is only a few minutes more. The walk down to V&A waterfront took me 55 mins along the front, a lovely walk. The place was immaculate and as described. Fyton was brill, he picked us up from the airport and made sure we were settled into the apartment. I would recommend you use him for transfers, only R300 which is less than £15 sterling or 20 US.
Uber is perfect to get around the city. Really cheap and super efficient. We enjoyed Mojo centre in Sea point for food and entertainment.
Its a great place, enjoy!!!

Bruce’s place felt like home away from home. The location is fantastic and the house itself is well furnished with everything you need, and more! The apartment is clean and aesthetically pleasing! It made for a wonderful stay and we almost extended our stay just by how charming the house was.🤭Fyton, the caretaker who picked and dropped as at the airport; and directed us to some cool spots was an absolute ⭐️!!! Loved it!

The apartment was one of the best experiences I had on Airbnb so far. Bruce is an amazing host who was proactive and super fast in responding to questions. Fyton was a lovely contact on-site and helped us with a small hiccup we had during our stay. The apartment is beautiful, well equipped and offers a stunning Atlantic view for sunset. The wider neighborhood is full of coffeehouses and restaurants but the apartments direct neighborhood is surprisingly quiet. All main tourist attractions are just a short and cheap Uber ride away.

I had a wonderful time and experience, the place was clean and beautiful. The host was well organised. The place looked better than the picture and the have some great pictures. I definitely recommend it, I would definitely come back

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb. Bruce and Fyton are super friendly and respond very quickly! The apartment was very clean and everything we needed was there. The restaurants and promenade are walking distance.
We would highly recommend staying here!!

We really enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb! Bruce and Fyton were both incredibly helpful and made the whole trip very easy for us. Everything was exactly as it was described and the view of the ocean was beautiful. It is in a great location and very close to lots of bars, restaurants and the beach. We definitely recommend!

What a beautiful space! We absolutely enjoyed ourselves in Bruce's flat. Lots of natural light and well decorated cozy spaces. Very comfortable bed, areas to do our work, watch the sunset from the balcony and most importantly, we felt incredibly safe. Fyton met with us upon arrival and he is such a lovely man. He was always on time, accommodating to our needs and available to assist if needed. We appreciated the little touches and amenities that Bruce and Fyton left behind for us. We have zero complaints and would definitely recommend booking with Bruce and Fyton. We will certainly choose to stay at their place again in the future!

The location of Bruce's airbnb was perfect. It's a short drive to the Sea Point coast and we felt extremely comfortable and safe. It was clean and well kept. Fyton, the concierge, was very responsive. As a welcome gift some homemade hot sauce, jams and brut was provided which was such a lovely touch. The only thing that would take this stay from 4 stars to 5 stars is if it were better stocked. Only two towels, two beach towels and two rolls of toliet paper were provided for our 5 day stay and we ended up having to restock ourselves. Not a huge deal, but it's why I'm rating this stay 4 stars.

The apartment is beautiful with an amazing view! It is clear Bruce takes pride in this home and put a lot of effort into it. Communication and check-in was smooth. It was exactly what we needed, would definitely recommend.
Has a great time at Bruce's. the place is spotless, communication was easy, and the location is perfect. Definitely recommend!
We absolutely loved Bruce’s place - it’s in a perfect location. We were close to so many places and we were in awe the whole time! Thank you so much for your hospitality🙌
We loved the place! The apartment was beautiful, cozy, neat and clean. It had everything we needed and we really enjoyed waking up every morning to its beautiful ocean view.

Had an amazing stay at Bruce’s place. The place is perfect for a couple and has all the amenities.
Greenpoint and Sea Point are a short drive away and the balcony offers lovely views of the city, promenade and ocean, as well as Lion’s Head.

Wonderful little topfloor apartment with beautiful views. Great location in seapoint - within walking distance to the promenade. Never had any electricity issues - which was great. The apartment was cleaned once a week and Gift always did an exceptional job. It can get very windy at night which could be an issue for light sleepers and might be something to consider when choosing this apartment for longer stays. Other than that everything was great.
2nd stay here in under 2 months. Must say something… simply love this place! Upon arrival Iris offered an alternative unit which was way better suited for my guests. Definitely coming back …. AGAIN 💙
This connected apartment setup provides stunning view and access of the beach, which is great for those sunrise and sunsets. The owners are very welcoming and extremely sweet.

This apartment has everything you need for a memorable stay in Melkbosstrand. Being practically right on the beach it has breathtaking views of the ocean with the iconic Table Mountain as backdrop. It is well equipped with everything you need for a short or long stay and Iris is a lovely and caring host! Jewel on the bay comes highly recommended and will leave you rested, restored and rejuvenated!

The apartment is perfectly situated practically on the beach, with the most spectacular views of the ocean and Table Mountain. The apartment is spacious, bright, and airy, with access to two balcony areas.  It is well-equipped, has a homely feeling and the soothing sound of the ocean encourages one to truly relax. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and will most definitely return as soon as possible. Thank you Iris for being a lovely host.

Iris and Dale were great hosts, kind, helpful and thoughtful. Their apartment overlooks stunning Melkbosstrand with huge picture windows - it was hard for us to close the curtains, because the view is so wonderful. We walked and ran on the beach often. The apartment is incredibly comfortable and well-appointed, with a large living and sleeping room, and a particularly good bathroom. My wife and I were there for a romantic getaway, and it suited us perfectly. Thank you Iris and Dale!
Amazing views, far better than you can see on the pics. We had such a lovely stay and Iris was very helpful and accommodating!
Such a beautiful cottage 🌸🌷. The pictures does not do the place justice, it is even more stunning in person. Felt right at home and such a peaceful neighbourhood, will most definitely be back .🌷🌸

We absolutely loved Gerda’s place. It was very clean and neat exactly what we needed. We loved that it was resourceful, peaceful. We will def go back there! I have already recommended the place to a friend.

The cottage was as listed and super clean and comfortable. Gerda was easy to reach and always responsive. Only trouble we had was GPS navigates to the road at the bottom of the property where there is no access, but we eventually managed to find our way around, just double check the street names. Otherwise a lovely stay.
What a tranquil cottage! Absolutely lovely to come home after a long day - to such a serene stay in Somerset West x
It's been just over a year since I was last here, and my experience was phenomenal once again. Excellent location, beautiful world-class views, wonderful place and very warm and welcoming hosts.

Booked the place with two friends and we all loved the place and we are probably going to bring back our families.
Super beautiful. Spacious with a modern touch and located at a prime location.

To say the least , this accommodation is way under priced for what it offers , the views are out of this world ,we truly enjoyed our stay as a family and surely coming back. Clean and spotless, very big !!!Thanks again

Spectacular and breath-taking apartment with the most beautiful view of the ocean. It's a place where you relax with absolute tranquility and not worry about the rest of the world. Spacious balcony where you spend time watching kite surfers, beautiful sunset and best view of table mountain. Helga is an absolute professional -very friendly, warm welcome and always available to any request. She even allowed us to extend our stay and we loved the apartment with the most up to date and modern furniture and utilities ( from coffee makers, dishwasher, washing machine, Dryer to the most exquisite well equipped kitchen. My family and l will definitely come back👏👏🎉🎉

Helga provided us with the most beautiful apartment. Not only we're the views of the ocean and mountain breathtaking but the interior and all provided amenities took our breath away too.
Not only did she provide us with a wonderful welcome and apartment, but she also provides a cot and baby bath for my baby .
We can't wait to return to South Africa and stay there again.
I'll be raving about this place to everyone who'd listen.
Helga was truly thoughtful in her provision, very responsive to messages and always friendly and helpful .
Helga's place was absolutely stunning. it was super clean, modern and had everything we wished for and more. Helga was a super host. Thank you for allowing us to stay in your beautiful place Helga.
Stunning views, warm and comfortable living space and bedrooms, very safe and great location. We can only recommend this accommodation and would stay there again anytime :)

The unit had everything we needed for our stay, including reliable WiFi and access to DStv via streaming. The views were stunning, and there are many excellent restaurants in the area. Catch-22 offered some of the best seafood we’ve had recently. Several great shopping centres are in close proximity, offering a variety of stores and conveniences. Additionally, the property provided excellent security with access control and undercover parking, ensuring peace of mind during our stay.
Fantastic host, location was really Central and could get around Cape Town very easily. definitely a lovely view for a morning coffee

Michael is a great host and added a personal touch to the entire trip. From meeting us at check-in, telling us about area restaurants and scenic spots and then checkout. One thing important to me is the responsiveness of a host and he was always available.
The apartment itself has a beautiful view and it's furnished well. We were very comfortable in the apartment.

Michael is a great host. Very communicative and always available when needed. One of the best hosts I’ve had on Airbnb. The flat is in a great location in Green Point, very walkable to everywhere, especially the waterfront.

Absolutely fantastic!
Douglas was extremely responsive.
I had mixed up dates and he helped me with that as well.
I’m so grateful and happy.
Worth every penny!

Lovely apartment, close to the beach and restaurants. We felt very safe in the area and could walk to our favorite coffee shops. The apartment could have been cleaner, but other than that, it was a enjoyable stay.

Douglas’s one bedroom flat is located one block down from the seaside. It doesn’t have a seaview. The only window looks directly down on a dilapidated house next door. It’s fairly close to restaurants and a short drive away from shopping malls.
It was nice location, close to the beach and close to many amenities. The only critique I’d give is that I wish the host had made more effort in the upkeep of the apartment.
Not a bad place. Would benefit from a proper clean, including the walls, and oven, and plates and cutlery. As well as unclogging the bathroom sink. Overall could use with a bit more care

A fantastic, cool apartment within easy reach of all major areas of Cape Town. We loved our stay and would definitely return.
Walkable to the mall for shopping and the most amazing view from the balcony. A perfect stay! Thanks.

Stunning light filled apartment with spectacular unblocked views of table mountain. Super comfortable sofa and beds. The hosts were responsive and accommodating. Location is pretty central and a short drive to most places in Cape Town.
Amazing place! Clean! Neat! Exactly as seen in pictures. Great view of the centre of the city. Will definitely book again anytime.

This place is absolutely amazing! We loved it so much that we extended our stay in the same building. The view is incredible and the room had everything we needed. The building itself is very secure and they allowed us to leave our luggage after check out. Jayson and the hosts were very quick and responsive and instructions were very clear.

The apartment is in an excellent location, with numerous restaurants and other conveniences within walking distance.  The building is well managed and secure.  It’s situated in excellent proximity to many of the highlights in the city.  The apartment is small, however, it is as advertised and is very efficient. We were traveling with excess luggage and had no difficulty finding proper storage for all of our belongings.  The view from the balcony is great!
Beautiful apartment, very clean and looks exactly like the photos. The pool area and beds were lovely even though it was very windy! The parking was great and safe. Responsive host, would recommend.

This stay far surpassed my expectations!! This Airbnb might have the best view of Table Mountain in Cape Town. The balcony, room decor, and room setup were amazing. Plus, there was great building security, a reserved parking spot, and a community infinity pool. Plus, so affordable! Highly recommend for your stay in Cape Town.

Great location und good apartment for a few days in the city. Washing Maschine was great after traveling for some time.
Absolute bonus is the rooftop deck and bar! Perfect for sundowner before dinner.
Good place - all you need for a stop in Cape Town while exploring neighborhood of cafes and restaurants and an easy drive from other areas.
My favourite part about staying here was watching the sunset over Table Mountain from the comfort of the rooms balcony each day. It felt like my very own penthouse.
A very nice and Secure Place in City Center. Thanks for thé nice stay and contact. I can only recommande you book this place! :)

Great host! The space was spotless, stylishly decorated, and equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect—close to V&A waterfront, making it easy to explore the area.
We had a great stay at Bree Street. Fantastic view on the hills with small breakfast terrace! Only one star deducted for the quality of the window - lets through cold, wind and noise (take earplugs).
Great lock up and go, secure unit, central, vibey location and has everything you need for work/holiday. The hosts are responsive and helpful :)

Amazing apartment with a clear view of Table Mountain. A really safe area too with lots of high-end restaurants around. Hosts were very responsive and friendly. Will definitely stay here again when I'm in Cape Town.
Excellent communication from the time of booking until check-out. Very responsive with clear instructions on how everything works.

Jason's place was very conveniently located , 15 minute walk to the waterfront and all the activities there.  Very clean and well furnished, including biscotti and milk in the fridge.  Nice roof top plunge pool, good view of. Table Top mountain.

The apartment building is great. Perfect area in the city within the waterkant and close to waterfront. The possibility for parking very good and save. The service is friendly and the view from the different apartments and from the roof top is insane.  Highly recommend.

This Airbnb is great. It looks exactly like on the pictures. It was very clean. You have a beautiful view from the terrace. There’s 24/7 security, so you feel safe. If I needed anything jayson was always nice and helpful and replied quickly. Would definitely stay there again.

We enjoyed staying at Jayson’s Airbnb. The kitchen is fully equipped for longer stays . We also enjoyed the balcony with the beautiful view of Table Mountain. The location was great, and its walkable distance to good restaurants .

Clean and secure apartment, we had everything we needed here and enjoyed the balcony very much.   Hosts were helpful, friendly and responsive and anticipated questions proactively.   One thing to note is that it seems like everyone in the building has a 10 AM check-out and the elevators are packed.  You should plan to leave a little early if you don't want to wait 10-15 minutes to catch one.  The lack of loadshedding is a massive plus to this apartment as many places in Cape Town were without power for several hours per day.

We really loved staying at this property we almost didn’t want to leave! I am from Cape Town and I fell in love with the city again because of this unit. A clear view of table mountain and centrally located. The place was cozy, clean and honestly the pictures don’t even do it justice! We will gladly stay here again :)
The view of table mountain from the balcony was amazing! We also loved the amenities this Airbnb had to offer, especially the washer unit, as we had to pack light for our trip.
Everything was perfect! the view from the balcony was just incredible, close to everything and the apartment was super clean. I would recommend this to anyone
Great place! Clean and comfortable, and a great view. The building feels very safe. Would recommend!

Perfect stay in Cape Town! My wife and I really enjoyed this apartment - perfect for a couple or solo traveler. Very safe and very easy to get Ubers at any time. Very convenient coffee shop right at the lobby/entrance. The apartment was great and exactly as pictured - the balcony was a nice way to close out the evening looking at Table Mountain.
Would definitely come back! Host was very responsive with clear instructions and communication.

Really enjoyed our stay, it had everything that we need. Host proactive throughout start to finish of booking.
Great location, we walked in the day to the V and A and easy to get back with taxi.
Everything in the apartment was high quality , working and very comfortable!
Nice apartment and easy check in. We had a problem with hair being in the bed and in the bathroom but this was quickly fixed after notifying the staff.

A great place to stay! We were in perfect walking distance to markets, Green Point restaurants and more. Great use of space with an incredible view of Table Mountain. Definitely a recommendable place for anyone looking to tour Cape Town or even break away from hustle of life.
We loved our stay - easy check-in, very safe, and Jaysons communication was spot on.

This is a great apartment. The large balcony with a view straight onto Table Mountain is fantastic. We spent most of our time when at the apartment, on the balcony. The concierge at the front desk were very helpful and the secure parking a bonus. The apartment is in walking distance to the V & A Waterfront with all the bars and restaurants, and only a cheap Uber back after dark.

My first airbnb experience and it was exceptional, I would do it again. The host was very nice to work with and responsive, The place was beautiful and cozy just what we as a couple was looking for, we greatly enjoyed this place and it’s excellent privacy

Chris was a fantastic host - the apartment had everything I needed. Extremely comfortable and relaxing. On the premises there is also a pool , braai area and gym which is rare to have being in such a prime location in Seapoint.
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and even during these Eskom times , Chris has made amends to still have the WiFi working. Besides the WiFi I still had great signal from the apartment. Situated close to the promenade, major shopping centers and bars/restaurants.
The lady for the midweek clean was spectacular, thorough and trustworthy.
I really look forward to coming back to enjoy Chris’s place again. Thanks Chris! 5 stars all the way. ✔️

A perfect stay, in a perfect location.
Chris was an excellent host who was always available.
The apartment was perfectly maintained and extremely clean and well kept.
The property was even better than advertised. The most central location in Sea Point.
Also has a UPS on the wifi which was great!
All the facilities at the property were very clean and neat.
Off street parking was a big plus!
I'll definitely be returning here on my next visit to Cape Town. I recommend this apartment to anyone. Excellent value.
Had a great stay and appreciated the convenient accessibility to good restaurants and shops. Reliable and willing hosts made the experience more pleasant.
We really enjoyed our stay! The location is perfect in Sea point and still super quiet. Chris was very available, we needed a second pair of keys and he organized it for us. :)
Good evening me and my partner had a really great stay at the facility all in order and its a lovely place to stay at anytime of the year. Thanks Chris

Chris's place is better than advertised. The location is great - in the heart of Seapoint, a minutes walk to a number of neat restaurants, markets and coffee shops. The team was great and very responsive. Very good value and will definitely book again when returning to Capetown!

Great place in our favorite areas in Cape Town. Everything you need is within walking distance, and the area feels very safe.
Chris is also very helpful and easy to communicate with.
It was a wonderful stay for us. The AC need to be repaired and Jason and his team responded quickly and accurate. The problem was solved rapidly and the communication was outstanding!
Great place to stay in Cape Town. Centrally located and felt safe, apartment is a decent size and very quiet. Amazing views from balcony and rooftop.

the room is very nice, clean, and tastefully decorated. The appartment block is very safe, as is the surrounding neighborhood. nice restaurants and bars within walking distance. The rooftop pool is a big plus if you're staying for a couple of night in Cape Town! It's a nice place to relax before or after a busy day in the city.

Beautiful apartment in a central location making it easy to explore all of Cape Town. Extremely secure, simple check in & brilliant communication throughout the booking process.
Fantastic views from the balcony & rooftop terrace.

Jason's place was wonderful. The check-in was easy and their biometric security measures make one feel extremely safe. The place was as advertised and the table mountain view was great. There was a little dirt in the living room, but nothing too serious.
Overall, we had a great time staying there and I'd recommend it for anybody looking for a beautiful stay for two in CT.

Esna and Anton are such lovely hosts. We were traveling with teens and experienced no complaints whatsoever. They were very much accommodating and gave us ample space, it almost felt like our own home. The place is a bit dated though, especially the main bathroom. It needs a bit of modernisation. I'd definitely stay there again if an opportunity presents. 💐

Stephan's place was fantastic! We were met by our host and show  through the entire complex and apartment, she also showed us how to access the local shops and restaurants. Close to the beach,  restaurants and cafes. Safe, secure and very clean complex and had everything we needed. Highly recommended!
Spacious clean and modern unit which is walking distance to shops and restaurants on the ocean promenade. Great place! Family loved it.
The best stay we had in Cape Town by far. Nice clean unit. Will definitely make use of this unit again.

Wonderfully spacious and bright in the living areas. Comfortable beds and warm baths and showers a great experience and a must in winter - thank you!
Anything and everything on tv channels 👍🏻 my Family had loads of fun.
!!! Location was great
The place felt like hone. The view was amazing and the area is peaceful and quiet. Cecilia gave us great recommendations on the places we need to visit and which one's to avoid.
Lovely apartment with great location being walking distance from the beach. Very friendly hosts who made us feel right at home.
Lovely place to stay over in Kommetjie, very close to the beach. Lex was a great host making sure we were comfortable.

What an amazing stay we had. Lex and his wife are super great hosts and available to answer questions, no matter the time. The property is right by the beach with easy access for those hot summer nights. The unit itself is quite spacious with a double shower. We really enjoyed our stay, felt at home and will definitely be back again in the near future. Highly recommended. Thanks Lexi

Lex and his wife are super friendly people and went out of their way to accommodate us. The unit is a mere stones throw from the beach which was so lovely. Lex assisted us with a smaller braai which was something he built. Superb and a great find.

Super helpful & kind host.
I had to cancel my stay at the last minute, and Lex was completely understanding and empathised with my situation.
Kommetjie is a complete gem and Lex’s apartment is in the most perfect spot.

Lex and his family became our family while we were staying there. They went above and beyond always, even drove us to other surf spots and came out to be our biggest supporters during the surf competition. Anything we ever needed, and more, they were there. They did a Braai for us, and we went to visit many places together with his wife and awesome kid. Really really good people, excellent hosts, and friends for life. Would never consider staying anywhere else in Cape Town. Quiet, peaceful, and safe location, right at the best surf spot.

Fantastic place in a lovely area of Kom right next to the beach. Lex and his family are super friendly and helpful with suggestions and what's nearby.
Great to find a place not affected by load shedding as well.
Sadly could only stay one night so couldn't use the bbq but had an amazing sunrise coffee before I left!
Lex and his family are great hosts. The apartment is lovely and only a stone throw away from the beach. Lex is super helpful and we enjoyed our stay.
An amazing space in a really quiet area. Hear the ocean as you sleep! The beach is one house away. Would definitely be returning for some down time.

Very nice and cozy apartment. In a quit area, perfect to relax and pretty close from Muizenberg beach. Also recommend to walk the Muizenberg catwalk. Lorna was super nice and helpful. With the company of this wonderful woman and her lovely dog peanut you will have a great stay at her place.
The host was friendly and open minded. You better love the dogs! There’s no Uber in this location, so long walks are required.
The space has an uplifting, sunny and relaxing atmosphere. It had everything I needed to make me feel at home. The bed was super comfy!

I can’t explain in words how amazing our stay was! This place is a steal for what you get at the price !!! The following things  stood out for us ; centrally located so you’re close to everything, extremely clean which we appreciated. We usually travel with our own bath towels , we packed them but didn’t have to use them because of how clean and comfortable we felt ! Impeccable views , more like breathtaking !! Waking up to that view was spectacular! The bed was the most comfortable bed , and we are picky with beds! We pride ourselves in having the most comfortable bed , but André’s place might be giving our bed a run for its money 😂! The state of the art appliances , the inverter ! It’s beautifully decorated ! Basically everything !! The goodies you get when you arrive!! We loved loved this place !!!
We loved our stay at this beautiful apartment and miss it already. We can absolutely recommend this place. Stunning view and on the top spotless.

Andre and Andreas were very responsive since the first time that I reached out about the property and help us with recommendations for spa services, restaurants and tours.
It was nice to arrive to a bottle of South African Savignon Blanc, and a few other treats.
We didn’t have any issues with the power like you’ll find at other properties.
The bed is comfortable and the apartment is very cozy and a little tight on space in certain areas when walking around. I had to be mindful to not hit my right arm on the kitchen door handle after I hit it three times thinking I had enough space.
Walking to Main Street and to the Promenade was safe and the return walk up the hill was a nice little leg burner.
I would return for sure!

Great place to stay in Cape Town. Quick Ubers to the Waterfront, City center, and Sea Point. Easy walk down to the main strip of stores/restaurants and coast. Tough uphill walk to get back! Amazing view and very clean inside!

I loved this place ! The appartement has a great vibe, I felt so comfortable that I extend my stay twice. I could totally live here.
Love the big couch, the agency of the living room, the large windows, the balcony, the mirrors... well equiped too !
The view is amazing, especially the sunset every night.
The location is perfect, in the middle of Sea Point. Going up and down every day was nice, it's not too far and yet a bit of exercice.
And andre was very reactive, flexible for my check in and check out, I felt like he wanted me to have a good time. Which I did :)

I came back n this appartment and spent a month i, I think that says it all :)
I felt home, it was all perfect. They even had the cleaning lady coming once a week.
I wish the place will be available next time I come to Cape Town !

Wisbeach rd is a lovely small road a corner away from the promenade. For some reason the road is louder than expected with vans and cars. The apartment is nice and rooms are large but could do with better furnishing like a working desk

We have lived in the apartment for more than 2 months, and we left with a smile and a tear as it really felt like home! Great location, spacious living and kitchen, and great bathroom.
We did buy some items ourselves like clothes hangers and ice cube makers, but that is more than ok. We were a bit unfortunate to have stayed there during a two month renovation of the building, which made working from home a bit tedious. 5 stars nonetheless!

Lovely spacious apartment. Great location. Friendly neighbours.
Just a word of caution when parked on the street, don’t leave any valuable possessions in the car overnight. Unfortunately our car was broken into.
The apartment was clean, spacious and had a special touch! We really liked being in Seapoint so close to the ocean and all the shops, coffee places and good breakfast spots. Thank you!

This lovely apartment was the perfect sanctuary for me to rest in when I arrived in town unwell. It is very spacious and spotlessly clean, with crisp sheets and all the kitchen amenities I needed. The hosts were helpful and responsive. I consider this place very good value for money and I would recommend this for a family or two couples. Thanks so much! Will stay again :)
The space is spacious and clean. The location is superb, a short walk from the promenade and close to the main road with restaurants.

Lovely apartment to stay in, spacious and clean. Great location in sea point, walkable to lots of restaurants and good starting point to explore Cape Town. There is construction next to the apartment block at the moment but it wasn't noisy and didn't disturb me personally. Would highly recommend the place for a stay!

The photos do not do this place justice. We really enjoyed our stay this was with my two sons and my fiancé plus one extra adult. Cosy house and really clean with an exceptional location.
Thank you for a fantastic stay.

Beautiful and comfortable home in a safe and charming neighborhood in Newlands near many amenities, malls and restaurants. Felt at home and would definitely recommend if you want a lovely place to call home in Cape Town.

You can book this place  with peace of mind: the descriptions and pictures match perfectly with the reality, the neighbourhood is safe and close to a high-end grocery shop, Marc called with when I had trouble switching on the heating and he quickly solved an issue with the shower (the shower is probably the Achilles heel of the appartement as it also has a relatively weak stream).

Lovely place, very ideal for the V&A waterfront - walkable distance & safe. Great selection of restaurants nearby and of course the best Italian cappuccino at Giovanni’s deli. The Appartement was definitely my taste in decor and placement of furniture. The view of mountains was wonderful especially having the sun gleam off them. Peaceful and private area. The Load shedding(national power cuts)to be honest isn’t a problem from what I experienced. It’s also a convenient UBER location. I would highly recommend.
Had an amazing stay! Wonderful studio and brand new. Host Hennie was always responding straight away.

Anke is a responsive co-host. The toilet was open plan which is very uncomfortable, although there is a curtain in front of it.
There are no closets or side drawers.
The wood fired - hot tub was awesome!
Noise and talking from the nextdoor apartment is can be annoying.
Helpful accommodation for just a night.
Really nice apartment, super view, next to everything you need! Nadia is the best host, friendly and helpful. Recommended 100%
Great location and even better view of the beach and Table Mountain. Walking distance to restaurants, pubs & grocery stores. Would definitely stay here again.
Linen was very dirty and the bed not comfortable at all. We had one access key and we were four. TV was not working because we didn’t have a Netflix account. We had only one per of towels - grey
Nadia's place is very cozy. Great view of Table Mountain, and close to all the amenities you would want. Very responsive host.

We enjoyed our stay. Beautiful apartment, great views, the picture quality doesn’t do justice to the place. Close to the beach and Nadia was so friendly and helpful.
We will definitely be back again.
Even though the rooms are smaller than expected, we had enough space. The view is spectacular and Nadia is very easy to communicate with. The place is also extremely close to everything that you need

Chris and James are perfect hosts. The appartment is gorgeous and really clean. I would definately reccomend it. The only downside is the noise from the port across the street as they are working 24/7. Nevertheless I would still book it again any time soon.
The apartment and location are to die for. The apartment was clean and Chris goes an extra mile to check in on you and how your finding the experience during your stay

The apartment was very neat amd clean, very comfortable felt right at home. The location was perfect within walking distance CTICC for business, Waterfront and City Centre for pleasure. Great communication from the hosts. I would easily stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay at Chris’s place and would recommend it. Great, secure location and close to many places in the city. Chris is also very responsive and ready to help with anything. We enjoyed our stay and had a great time!

Chris Place is in my top 2 places I've stayed in my 12 years of visiting Cape Town. The communication is clear, he is helpful and responsive. The place is clean comfortable and cosy. Not a single regret staying here and I will be back as you in the centre of all that you really need in terms of restaurants, places to go and explore. Just wonderful.
Chris is a good host. Clean appartment with all accessories. View is of containers and dockyard activity quite noisy. Not really in the waterfront.

The apartment is well situated. We stayed in that location previously, easily accessible to the waterfront.
The only issue is in one of the room, there is no door in the toilet, lack of me time privacy if two people staying in one room.
Overall the apartment is ok.

I booked Jessica's house for my family when they visited me and it was perfect. Jessica is a great host; everything was simple, the house was just what we expected and just what we needed. This charming cottage is a slice of old Scarborough, from the days before the McMansions started clogging up the village, we cannot recommend it highly enough for those wanted to experience proper Scarbs and a little gem of a cottage right by the beach.
Second time staying here. Unpretentious beach cabin in perfect location and great for dogs. Host is communicative and friendly! Nothing but praise to offer!
This place was exactly what we needed. Located in the heart of seaport we felt safe and right at home! What a great spot with even better hosts.

Harry’s place was just perfect to explore different beaches and highlights in Cape Town. Great cafes, supermarket and beaches just around the corner. Perfectly clean and equipped flat - would always love to come back! Recommended!

Harrys place was perfect for our week in Cape Town. Lots to do in walking distance and nice beach to have a dip in the sea. It's actually a perfect location in Cape town. The apartment has all the comfort and convenience you need as well and felt very safe. Didn't do any cooking because the restaurants within walking distance were all fantastic and reasonable. Will be back

Great location , easy check in and great to meet the owner.
As described
Worth a re visit

Harry's place is a dreamy spot with an extremely comfy bed, a cute little balcony to enjoy, and a great kitchen space to make yourself feel at home. It's perfect for walking around, as it's very close to the prom and has plenty of shops around the corner. Harry was very responsive and friendly, so it made for a very comfortable stay! I would absolutely stay again.

Olivia’s place was quite decent and accommodating. The host was very responsive and made sure I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The space was clean, well-equipped, and exactly as described in the listing. Overall, it was a pleasant experience, and I would definitely recommend it to others.

My husband and I had a great week in Cape Town in this Camps bay home - we enjoyed the home and use of the kitchen (with ice :-) ) and crystal blue pool, the private room, and specifically also appreciated the Lovely Lady that did our dishes and washed our clothes.  The location is great with walking access to Camps bay shops, restaurants and theatre without the hassle to find parking.  The Lawns can easily be accessed via The Glen trails and these trails can be followed to the start of Table Mountain and Lion's Head.  Easy access to to multiple beaches and tidal pools.  Oliva and Shaun were awesome hosts and even introduced us to the stairs at Spitskop which can only be met with lots of energy and provides a superb cardio experience !

Wonderful stay at Mandy & Dean's. Actually being there was better than the descriptions. My family and I enjoyed it very much and wish we'd stay longer.
Thank you for having us!

Me and my family had a wonderful stay at Mandy and Dean’s beautiful apartment. The place had thoughtful touches in it and the deco was beautiful and it had everything one needs for a long stay, especially when traveling with toddlers. I highly recommend the place and will definitely stay there again. Also the communication was good with the hosts.

If I could give them 10 stars I would have! This place is so worth it! it's gorgeous and the hosts are super thoughtful. They had ice, water and milk,coffee, tea and sugar. The bathrooms have body wash,shampoo, and lotion. Towels are fresh and soft. Be prepared to call an Uber to take you to the V&A or the restaurants in Kloof Street. An Uber cost us between USD2.5 and 3.5. If this place is available when we return to the Cape, we totally will book it again!

We absolutely loved our stay! The apartment was perfect—spotlessly clean, well-maintained, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. Dean and mandy were incredibly helpful, making check-in smooth and assisting with any questions or issues we had. Their attention to detail and care for their guests really stood out. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend staying here!
My friends and myself was so inlove with this place ,we had an awesome stay .Everything about this place was just great.Its neat and cozy and the view is just spectacular
Great host, friendly, makes you feel welcome, the place looks nicer than the pictures. awesome stay....

Shimmer’s place was excellent! We felt right at home. The area is secure and peaceful, you instantly feel safe. The house was sparkling clean, spacious and the pool was clear blue. Shimmer was a great, responsive and proactive host. The only issue was the cockroaches and ants that appear at night, which can easily be resolved with occasional fumigation. I recommended Shimmer’s place to all!
What a great stay Shimmers home. The amenities are as listed and the host was a great person. Thank you for accommodating us!
Second time visiting shimmer's place, we couldn't ask for a better home and host :) wifi during loadshedding was a huge bonus to keep us busy

Honestly loved this house I hated that I stayed for one night only, the host was lovely the check in was seamless and the house was worth the amount you paid, the picture does not do the house justice. It's a beautiful house I loved it it and so will you
It's close to everything and easy to find
My family and I really enjoyed our stay. It was a lovely home away from home. Thank you Shimmer!

Spectacular Mountain Views
Keri’s place is in a quiet corner of an apartment complex. It has safe parking with easy access.
Only 1.5kms from Constantia Village for easy shopping.
Stunning modern design with clean lines.
A beautiful space.
The milk and other basics were a very welcome treat after a long day of traveling. Thank you Keri.
We loved our stay!

Great stay.Beautiful surroundings.Friendly host.
Will recommend to family and friends.
Will definitely be staying with Keri again

Keri's place suited me and my family perfectly. It's a great place to stay, and if/when we're looking to stay in that area again, we would most certainly want to stay at Keri's place again. All the support staff, from the front door security to the housekeeper staff, were friendly, efficient and always ready to help. Highly recommended.

Great stay in a beautiful home!
Loved the location and the apartment is in incredible condition! Can highly recommend a stay
A beautiful apartment that suited our needs perfectly.  Immaculate, with everything we needed for our stay in Cape Town.  We will definitely recommend this unit to our friends and family.

very beautiful apartment and it was spotless. my family had a great time and we enjoyed our stay at the apartment.
will def recommend this place for anyone.
The place was just absolutely beautiful. Its a pitty that our trip was for a funeral, wish we could have stayed longer. Peaceful, close to amenities and just stunning inside. Wouldn't change a thing.
Amazing views and sound of the waves. This flat is brand new and modern, the bed was very comfy. Leo is a very friendly and helpful host - we will be back to stay here again in Cape Town!
Great little flat for a short break. Nice location and has everything you need. Leo/Justin we’re really helpful too

Recently had an amazing stay at Leo's place in Sea Point. The location of the apartment is fantastic, with easy access to the beach and some great restaurants and coffee places in walking distance. Leo was extremely responsive, promptly responding to any queries in advance of my arrival and during my stay. The apartment looks even better than in the pictures and has wonderful sea views. Checking in and out was also a breeze. I'll be back!
Lovely place to stay.  Everything we needed.  Only small issue was that there is no heating and it was cold in the evenings.

Had a wonderful stay at Leo and Justins place. Very communicative hosts, fast at responding. The flat was perfect, looked even nicer than the photos. The hosts also organised early check-in and a parking spot for us which was amazing! Would definately come back!

If I were to go to Cape Town a million times, this is the place I have to choose a million times as well. On our day of arrival, we were treated with some complimentary gifts. Justin, our co-host was very helpful and quick to respond. I can't mention the location of the apartment. The beautiful scenery of the Sea is quite amazing. I can't wish to stay at any better place.

We had a lovely stay! The apartment was more spacious than I anticipated for two people, great location and felt very secure. There are generators for during load shedding which was a big plus and private parking. It was definitely worth the money and I never would’ve left if I had the option
Leo's place was exactly as described and felt right at home. Hosts were very responsive and extremely helpful. 10/10 - would recommend!

The location was ideal. Close to shops and ATMs and Hop-on Hop-off bus stops. Easy access to the promenade for walking or jogging. Security was excellent but never felt unsafe in the area walking in the day and early evening. The unit was well equipped with all one needs for a short stay including an electrical adapter for your use. The bed was very comfy.
Beautiful Place in a Beautiful Location. Unfortunately does not have a balcony, however it has a beautiful window view of the ocean!

We had the perfect 5 night stay at this apartment. The location in Sea Point is great! A short walk away from a lot of great restaurants and the promenade. The apartment itself was great, furnished well, and has a stunning view of the ocean from the window. There's a well-equipped kitchen with a coffee machine, plates, cutlery and wine glasses that we could use when we felt like eating in. We needed to clean up daily as the cleaning service was only after checkout which was fine with us. The hosts were very responsive. We'd stay again!
I loved the place and the neighbourhood is superb. The hosts are great communicators and the unit was very clean.

We had an incredible stay at this place! Everything was spotless and exceptionally clean, which made us feel right at home. We absolutely loved the apartment’s design—stylish, modern, and thoughtfully arranged. It was fully equipped with all the utensils and essentials we needed, making our stay so convenient. The location couldn’t have been more perfect—just minutes away from shopping spots, the ocean, and breathtaking sunset views. It truly exceeded my expectations. A definite come-back spot—highly recommended!

Stayed at Leo’s place for 4 nights.
Timon was assisting us throughout.
Very helpful. Always replied to our any questions at any time. We weren’t able to operate the heater, so he came down specially to show us and made a video also got an extra electric heater if we still can’t operate the manual one.
Loved the place. It’s just perfect for 2 people and has everything you need for a comfortable stay with gorgeous views and near to all the restaurants and supermarkets
We had a great time :)

The place was perfect for our stay in Cape Town, you could easily walk to the nearby mall and shops, amazing views, Tino was extra helpful and quickly responded to any questions we had and the place itself was quite beautiful, we would definitely be back!

Tino was a great host! Really responsive and super helpful. The apartment itself is sooo beautiful and has pristine views. It was really great that there were coffee pods, milk and bottled water available at the apartment . I would come here again.

Amazing place with beautiful, modern finishes. Great location.
Only thing was that the washing machine didn't work but the host kindly offered to do my laundry for me.
Very helpful and responsive host.
we spend a very good time in Cape Town and our accommodation helped us to enjoy the time even more. Everything was great. I would definitely come back
only thing bathroom mat was not there. rest all was great.. Appliance furniture etc all great.

great host, friendly very helpful and quick to response💯. had an amazing time with my family would recommend the place to anyone. highlight...the links of what's on the  activities, shopping and others. Extras  house keeper for the lazies👌

Perfect beach facing apartment. Beautifully furnished and very comfortable - felt right at home and slept like a baby first night. The view from both balconies is incredible! The host/agent (NOX) we’re extremely friendly & helpful…we were very grateful for the extra goodies that came with the package we ordered for our stay. 10/10 experience and will definitely recommend and use your services again!

I kept being reminded about the beautiful view in all the communication but could not see out the window at the view really very dirty window. I understand the weather is tricky but they could have been clean upon arrival

The apartment was amazing in a great location.  The two bedroom two bathroom accommodation was more fantastic for our family stay to Cape Town. With secure access and parking we always felt secure and comfortable. Fast wifi, DSTV and regular house cleaning the apartment was great.

First and foremost the apartment was better than the pictures and description of which you get a full grasp of the true meaning of ‘uninterrupted ocean views’. Our host very responsive to answer all questions I had before arrival, and went above and bring to ensure we were set up with back up with wifi after the network at the property went down.
The daily cleaning service (which is included in the price) ensured we fell in love again with the place everytime we came back from the day’s activities. From the furniture to the fittings, the clean linen and rooms, all have you planning your next trip to Cape Town before you even leave!

Not at all as depicted in the pictures. Multiple maintenance and cleanliness issues, which were raised with both the host and Airbnb. The apartment needs better attention to the deeper details. Definitely not a Superhost. Responsiveness was minimal, tackling only the surface issues the second day of stay. Would have preferred to have checked out.
Great location, very clean and spacious, amazing view and very easy check in and check out. Air conditioning in the main bedroom. Best part is the sound and smell of the ocean

Location of the apartment is awesome. But the apartment would need a light refurbishment windows and doors which are slamming and banging especially when it's windy.
Regarding NOX despite a first registration provess, they keep sending you prior to the arrival so many sms, mails asking for a second registration process asking for a 400 or 500 € deposit in the case something would be broken in the apartment or pay 35€ to avoid the deposit....quite annoying as everything shall be included in the Airbnb rental price.
Also on the last day, we were ready to go at 10.00am as it has been asked many times. Appointment has been arrange at 10.00 to give back the keys, 30 min later nobody was there, nobodu answering the phone, I had to call to be informed that nobody could come so I could drop the keyx in the mail box. Overall a good stay but those small details are quite a pain.

Great location with a great view. Very secure. Had everything we needed  washer/dryer was a great feature. Close to waterfront but probably not really walking distance. Lovely walking path across the street. A great home base for Cape Town.

We booked a short staycation to attend a concert at the stadium and thoroughly enjoyed the stay, great restaurants, awesome views, spectacular show by the dolphins in the bay and a short walk to the market.
The apartment has everything you need, is clean, well maintained, well managed and just a wonderful spot all round!

Stunning apartment that overlooks the water. Sunsets just hit differently here. I immediately felt right at home. The interior was well decorated, the kitchen was well-equipped and it had everything I can ever want in an apartment. It was also very clean, in fact, there was a housekeeper come in everyday. This was a very nice touch. Will definitely stay again.
Perfect location, great views, apartment was exactly as advertised and priced in line with what was expected.

The apt was lovely, not the best location for shops, restaurants etc. but exceptional ocean view. Seattle coffee just along the road.
The daily cleaning was really good & the girl was lovely.
Slight confusion on the actual address & Atlantic View apartments which is what Nox calls it but apart from that everything was really good & would recommend.

Our stay here was delightful!! Vuvu made us feel at home and looked after us beautifully.  The apartment is clean, and beautiful with the best Seaview from every window.  complimentary cleaning every day.  Generous amenities, even coffee pods, olive oil and balsamic high-quality salt and pepper and really generous toiletries and more.  So close to everything with a wonderful Broadwalk that goes on for miles. What an amazing space with amazing service and care!!!! I recommend it highly as real value for money.  I'll be back!

This luxury home is such a delight. We started each morning with a swim while enjoying the beautiful views of the mountains. This spacious apartment has all the amenities ( excellent wifi !) and the house is pristine. Rachel and Janine were only a phone call away. Their personal touch and recommendations made our stay that much more special.  We fell in love with this little piece of paradise!

Janine and Rachel are the best host I have dealth with and recurrently too.
The place is newly renovated, quite, clean with excellent views. It is a bit small but has one of the best views of the camps bay beach front.
An amazing property where we felt at home with our two small boys. Camps Bay is an incredible spot so close to the city. Janine, Rachel and Lara couldn’t be more nice and helpful. Will be back!

incredible place!
The views of the ocean and mountains are just stunning.
Very high standard of finishings. incredibly comfy beds.
Rachel is super helpful and responsive with great local tips.

Beautiful home. Everything was just great. Wonderful views. Excellent hosts.
Would highly recommend.
Fantastic stay for families
