I recently had the pleasure of staying at Janine and Rachel’s place and I must say it exceeded all my expectations. The rooms were spacious, clean and comfortable  with beautiful mountain and ocean view. Loved everything about the place . The hosts were incredible as well very responsive
Had a fantastic time. Easy to find, great location and really homely place. Would definitely come back

We had a wonderful stay at Claudia's apartment. The unit is very stylish, well kept, and has absolutely everything you will need for a short - or long-term stay. We felt right at home in this beautiful space and we can not wait to visit again.

We had a great stay in the calm and beautifully furnished apartment. It's a nice and quiet neighbourhood where we could work relaxed the first two days of our stay. It's a bit further to the city but for us it was worthwhile the extra traveltime.
We had a lovely stay at Claudia's place! The house is beautifully designed and decorated. It was also lovely to have dedicated parking, a luxury in Cape Town!
Claudia is a lovely and friendly host whose easy to reach. The home is fantastic and beautiful, didn’t want to leave! I 100% recommend staying here

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay - it was perfectly peaceful, quiet, and safe. Cathryn provided so many thoughtful touches and we felt right at home from the moment we arrived. The kitchen at Forest Walls is extremely well-kitted out - definitely a step above the usual Airbnb offering - something which we really appreciated.
Cathryn was excellent at communicating with us and she couldn’t have been more helpful. We would happily recommend Forest Walks if you’re looking for a comfortable home from home which is also very close to all the attractions Cape Town has to offer.

Cathryn was a wonderful host! She is kind, prompt and helped us with every aspect of our reservation and stay. Her place is clean, well designed and spacious. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay at this home again should the need arise. Thanks!

Fantastic apartment in Newlands. Calm and close to nature. A tranquil retreat from bustling Cape Town. Cathryn is the best host, very helpful with great recommendations and is super responsive whenever we needed something. Highly recommended and we will definitely come back!

We were absolutely delighted with our stay at Cathryn and Mario's beautiful apartment. The location couldn't have been more perfect - nestled in the safe, charming neighborhood of Newlands with the Mountain as a backdrop, with easy access to everywhere we wanted to visit.
Cathryn was incredibly communicative, ensuring that every aspect of our stay was seamless. From check-in to check-out, she had thought of everything we could possibly need, making us feel right at home.
The accommodation itself was outstanding. Immaculately clean, beautifully decorated, and equipped with all the amenities one could ask for. Even a computer screen, chair and desk area to work from. We especially enjoyed the patio and private leafy garden area.
We were thoroughly impressed and delighted with our experience, and without a doubt, we'll be returning for another stay in the future. Thank you to Cathryn and Mario or providing such a memorable and enjoyable stay!
We had a wonderful time and the hostess was very kind and generous. I hope to come back again.

We loved every minute of our stay.  Its peaceful, clean, on doorstep of a very lovely forest mountain walk to Kirstenbosch. Easy to get to shops and restaurants.  Our host was responsive and went the extra mile to make our stay warm and welcoming.  Highly recommended!

Amazing stay! The home is clean, well-equipped, and beautifully located with a stunning garden and forest walk. The host was attentive, making sure we had everything we needed. She even promptly reached out to us about a suit we had a forgotten after check out. My family and I felt like we were back home and regret not being able to stay longer. We will definitely be back again!

That was a great experience and pleasure for our family to stay at Cathryn’s place. Very peaceful, thought out to the smallest detailes, fully equipped apartment at a picturesque and quiet location. Will be a pleasure to return back some day!

Cathryn's place was as described, in a quiet and peaceful part of Cape Town and very close to Kirstenbosch gardens. The host was very responsive at all times and when I had a medical issue due to a sports injury Cathryn was so helpful directing me to the nearest doctors and hospital even offering to drive me there. She cares about her guests and always tries to be helpful.
Kathryn has been a great host. The place is great and surrounded by beautiful nature. Walking distance to trails in the mountains. We loved it!

Loved our stay in Newlands in a well designed apartment with great access to Newlands forest walks. Very conveniently located to highways, yet not noisy.
Great hosts - would definitely recommend this as a place to stay.
Lovely place to stay on the side of the mountain. Very well equipped with everything we needed + more. Wonderful hosts who were quick to respond to any requests. Highly recommended!

All I can say is WOW those views are breathtaking. The place is stunning with modern finishes and great facilities. I really enjoyed working remotely from the workstation and waking up to those views from all sides. The place is located close to amenities, shops and easy access to Century City, Blouberg and Town is about 15min away. The kitchen had everything I needed, comfy bed and an awesome shower. Overall a great stay and I would definitely return.

Great apartment, spacious, with all amenities needed for a long stay.
Host is responsive and helpful.

We had a fantastic stay at Aaron's lovely apartment! The space was spotless and beautifully decorated, and we especially loved the uniquely designed bathrooms and comfortable beds. The location was perfect for exploring the city.
Aaron was incredibly friendly, responsive, and accommodating, making check-in a breeze by meeting us in person. We truly appreciated the warm welcome! We particularly enjoyed the great view of Table Mountain and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Cape Town.
Thank you so much, Aaron!

Aaron is an exceptional host! His apartment exceeded our expectations in every way. The place was immaculately clean, stylishly decorated, and perfectly equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Aaron's communication was top-notch - he responded promptly to all our queries and made sure we had a seamless check-in experience.
What truly made our stay special, however, was Aaron's warm hospitality. He went above and beyond to ensure we felt welcome and at home.
We highly recommend Aaron's place to anyone looking for a fantastic Airbnb experience in Cape Town. Thank you, Aaron, for being an amazing host!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment with the best view ever. Everything was clean, neat and exactly as described. The host is friendly, helpful and communicative. We would highly recommend this apartment and host.
Perfect stay in Capetown. Best location. Safe apartment and parking. Lovely apartment with a lot of personal touches. Very spacious.  Would definitely book again. Thank you.
Amazing stay! Location is in great area. Protected parking, security always around. Apartment is beautiful.
It does what it says on the tin… very good all round. Location is always difficult as it depends on what you’re looking for but this is nice and central with good access to most areas.

Amazing beautiful place. Easy to reach all within walking distance.
We always felt safe and secure. Some restaurants and supermarket within 5 min.
Absolutely recommendable.
We would of course come back.
Thank you very much.

We stayed 2 weeks at the apartment. The apartment is just as beautiful as on the pictures - it was perfectly clean when we arrived. the communication upfront was super easy also the instructions for the check in are very easy. we really had a great time there. we totally recommend staying there.

Repeat stay.
Excellent stay, clean, safe, and central location.
I appreciate the attention to decor and homey feeling.
Definitely recommend.

This unit is immaculate! Located centrally and the rooftop is its own oasis! You’ll see how easy it is to settle into and it’s like leaving home when you do eventually leave. So appreciative that I got to stay here for a couple of days! Looking forward to the next visit and checkin
Safe and private accommodation, with gorgeous views of Seapoint and walking distance to great restaurants and the promenade. Absolutely loved it!

The place was amazing. Exactly as described and in the pictures. Very clean and neat. All the amenities for a self catering unit were there. Sufficient supplies. Easy check-in , with helpful staff. Responsive and pro-active hosts. Friendly building staff. Will highly recommend.

Jayson's Place has the perfect location with everything being within walking distance! Amazing pool and rooftop view of Table Mountain. Good BBQ facilities. Apartment is spacious with everything you need! The hosts were great... quick to respond, helpful and very friendly! Will definitely be returning!

We loved staying at this Airbnb, beautiful setting, modern appliances, quality amenities. We felt very safe with the building security and it wasn't far to get to great restaurants and shops. Will definitely book here again.
A home away from home very clean and safe . The place is very close to many places of interest.

This place is absolute beautiful. Everything we needed, we were there for athletics, very close to Greenpoint stadium.  The apartment was spotless, everything was so clean. I will definitely recommend it and will stay there again.

Loved our stay at Jayson’s. The team was incredibly responsive during our stay. Location was great, making it a breeze to walk to the V&A Waterfront, BoKapp and more. Having a parking spot was also a massive relief, making traveling the Western Cape smooth.
Jason was a great host. We loved the flat, modern and nicely furnished. The flowers was a great extra touch. Will definitely stay there again and recommend to other guests.

Central location, walking distance to the waterfront and nice local cafes and restaurants. The apartment was as described and as shown in pictures. Very spacious living area and kitchen, and well decorated. Would recommend and stay again!

A hidden gem with the some of the best views in the city!! My partner and I loved this place for many reasons but mostly for the peaceful vibes and incredible service from Evolve. Chris organised transport from the airport, organised water to be purchased prior to our arrival, was super responsive and was ready to make our stay as comfortable as possible. Located in such  convenient location yet still tucked away meaning it's quiet. I'd highly recommend it.

Amazing home. Best I’ve stayed in! Very safe, beautiful furnishings, lovely pool to cool off in. We spent so much time just reading on the deck and enjoying breakfast in the patio. So peaceful! The home and location was 5+ stars!
However the property management was very hard to deal with- I was literally getting two different instructions on how to get into the home as we are driving from the airport- and then set off the alarm due to unclear instructions and no one but the armed guard that showed up knew how to turn it off. Then they wanted me to drop off the keys in the middle of the city when we left at 3am (we later found a compromise).
Great house and facilities provided, just like in the photos. location absolutely perfect and noise free form the cars yet very close to walk to the beach!

We enjoyed our stay and Scotty was a great host. The apartment is absolutely beautiful, exactly as shown in the pictures.  It is clean with top of the range appliances. Close to restuarants, grocery stores and 5min away from the V&A Waterfront. I would recommend Scotty's place to anyone who wants a lovely, secure, central and Seaview location.  We went on walks/runs alongside the beach every morning. I would definitely stay here again. Thanks Scotty for arranging for us to drop off our bags on check in day. We truly appreciate it. Sandi

This flat was perfect for what we needed. We were close to everything, felt very safe, and the view was lovely. The accommodation was excellent, and we can recommend this  spot to anyone visiting Cape Town -  in fact, we extended our stay. We would definitely book here again.
Incredible accomodation for the whole family. Spacious, comfortable, safe, modern and homely!! Highly recommended spot right on the promenade!!

A spacious beach front of note! Great for family or friends. Well equipped for coffee lovers like me. We had WiFi and tv connection even during loadshedding!
We wish we could have stayed longer but we will be back! Awesome place indeed!

Great location, great view, and great communication from the host. Would recommend. Our family enjoyed our stay. Since the only thing separating the apartment from the sea is the street, you do hear some street noise from the cars, but it wasn’t bad. The building is very nice and quiet.
Great location, spotless house right across the ocean. The entire space was done up immaculately and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Beautiful place, sea 🌊 views for days. Comfortable space feels like home. Very clean and clutter free. Quiet 🤫 building not much noise inside and outside although it is on beachside. Close to amenities and restaurants which operate even during the dreaded load shedding in South Africa 🇿🇦

Thank you Scotty for a wonderful stay, you have a beautiful place with lovely views. We are from Cape Town but even so this apartment gave us everything we were looking for and more. The apartment is spacious, clean and comfortable. Would love to stay here again

We stayed in the apartment for a week. Great place in central location and within waking distance to restaurants and shops. Spacious rooms and amazing views. We felt safe. Communication with Scotty was great. Would stay in the apartment again.

The apartment is beautiful and the location is fantastic however the apartment was not cleaned properly and the bathrooms was in a terrible condition. The shutters and windows could not be opened and maintenance was sent out to assist.
There is only parking on the roadside which was not mentioned in the ad.
Therefore the price paid for our stay was definitely not worth it.

A perfect place to stay with a sea view, just a walk over the road to get to the main beach promenade for a walk or run, surrounded by restaurants, a lovely place to come back to, comfortable for our family, and a lovely kitchen.

My Family had great  time by Scotty’s place . On the arrival they received  a  very well warm welcome. Very accommodating , they felt it was a home away from home  . The communication was fantastic . Thank you Scotty for making my family’s stay comfortable . Well recommended . Worth every penny too .
Fantastic apartment. Great location, tidy and thoroughly cleaned. The host was always responsive and made the stay that much more enjoyable

Lovely space with stunning beachfront views. Beautiful and spacious home. Initially concerned about no off-street parking, but the area is safe and we had no problems with parking. Would recommend staying here.

Very disappointed!
4 issues: cockroaches in kitchen/dining, no hot water for morning baths due to geyser setting-only in evening from 18h00 it's was hot, the TV was unusable-we were advised that it was not working by the person who checked us in, it was reported by her to the agents as well & water was not filling in washing machine tub for laundry.
Booked this place due to amenities which were all a fail.
This spoilt our experience!
The agency took quite long to respond, phone calls were not being answered, some msgs were ignored.
Eventually spoke to 2 different staff & 2 managers to assist/resolve. Atleast Natasha followed up.
NB. Stayed here last year which was great.
This year was terrible :(

4 night stay, of which 3 days and 3 nights we had no hot water. They seem to know about this problem as just after checking in we got asked if there was hot water. I said no. And from there the situation deteriorated for 3 days. Lack of comms, we were down doing the 2 oceans marathon which was not ideal and extremely stressful. Apparently it got sorted, but then the toilets filled with hot water and melted everything in the toilets, so the night before the race we were trying to flush with buckets of water. The lack of comms between the agents themselves and suppliers was not great. They agreed to a 2 day refund to which we still have not received. There are problems with this unit that are not being addressed!

Loved our stay at this place, so well located, and the views were amazing.
Amenities and the little touches were highly appreciated.
This was an amazing stay for my family! The property was beautiful and the host so gracious. Will definitely book again.

Had a lovely stay- some parts of the house is a little dated, the closet door fell from it’s hinges and the main toilet needs some tlc- the apartment is very clean and big and comfortable and is kitted out with everything you need. It’s on a very very busy street and the cars are noisy 24/7 but for a few nights it was manageable

Place is great. Easy to find and well equiped.
Maybe being Asian there could be more dish cloths to wipe dry the kitchenware (most Asian homes do not use dishwasher)
Thank you for hosting and will recommend fellow travllers

We had a lovely stay. The unit is clean and excellent location. Enjoy the view.
Nice to have checked out a little later. Will definitely visit again.
Tx for nice experience in Cape Town

Excellent, modern and clean accommodation. Exactly as described and shown in photos. Lovely balcony with incredible views of over the city and Table Mountain.
Leave extra time to check in with security at reception upon arrival.
Incredible views from up high but a slight downside is waiting for the elevator to get to the 31st floor.
This was a lovely stay!

This place was INCREDIBLE!!!  The photos simply don't do it justice.  Very tastefully decorated with African accents that convince you of just where you are.  The views from the 31st floor were breathtaking with a wrap-around balcony that provided unobstructed views of Table Mountain on one side, and the ocean (across the V&A Marketplace) on the other.  The bed was super comfortable and the unit had every possible (high-end) appliance you could ask for.  Additionally, Bree St. is "THE" place to be in town and a short walk to great shops and restaurants.  Otherwise, a US $2-3 Uber ride can get you almost anywhere.  Jayson and his team were amazing hosts and I thank them for their hospitality.  When I travel back to Cape Town I won't want to stay anywhere else but here.  It really is just that nice!!

We stayed in this unit for 4 nights. Everything was great. The building is conveniently situated, close to the V&A Waterfront (5 minute drive), and about 15 mins away from Camps Bay.
The place was super clean, neat and well furnished. We had everything we needed. I’d say the space is only big enough for 2 at most (which worked well for us). Very beautiful views of the city and sea point.
The host was very friendly, proactive and communicated very well.
This unit was definitely worth the money. Highly recommended it.

Great apartment in a great location, beautiful pool and bar area on the 27th floor! Host was very responsive and helpful, would definitely recommend if you are looking for a central location in Cape Town
This was a great apartment in a great location . It was spotlessly clean and had everything you needed .
Beautiful apartment, really enjoyed my stay. The grill on the wrap around balcony is a particularly nice touch.

Really nice place! Location is wonderful, perfectly between city centre and the waterfront.
Super secure and the communication was great!
My wife and I stayed here while honeymooning in Cape Town. We found it to be a great place to stay - cozy, safe and in a great location.

Where to begin..my review of the place will even be an understatement. Very beautiful apartment, all amenities listed were there. At no point did we miss anything in the apartment. Great location! Bree street has lots of restaurants where one can easily walk to. Hosts were very friendly and helpful from the moment we booked the place to when we checked out. Very high tech friendly security in the apartment building. Great value for money I must say.

Very impressive decor and equipped with all you’ll need. The views are hard to beat!. Table mountain behind you and the water right ahead. Location is amazing. Very close to long street and a lot of amazing restaurants on Bree as well. Highly recommend!

This is a 10 for sure! Great apartment, so cozy and comfortable with high end appliances. Kitchen is well stocked with everything you may need. Wonderful location. Great restaurants all within walking distance. Great view of Tabletop mountain as well as the waterfront port. Communication with host was excellent. Before and during our stay! I highly recommend this place.

Jayson and his team were very responsive. The accomadation was spot on and enough space for my wife and I. The location was great with Uber access right outside the building.
Nice spot!
Incredible apartment. Location is amazing, right between the waterfront and kloof street. View is incredible, security on the door, parking space and the apartment itself is stunning.

We spent two beautiful nights in this wonderful place. The view itself justifies the stay, but everything in the apartment was to the point. Excellent communication with Jayson and the rest of the team. I highly recommend!

This place beat all expectations. Really great apartment with everything you need for a really comfortable holiday.
The stand out is the overall quality of everything in the apartment from quality bedding to top of the range appliances.
The location cannot be beaten and everything you need is within a few minutes walks. The local restaurants are some of the best and it's feels really safe walking back in the evening.
Everything was easy from communication to easy access. The views cannot be beaten and the staff manning the front desk are friendly.

We had a lovely stay. The use of the apartment pool was a bonus. The room has great views of table mountain and the city. Just be mindful on the weekends, there is a pub below, so it can be quite noisy. Overall we enjoyed our stay and would return.

Hi Jayson,
I wanted to take a moment to thank you for hosting me in your flat. The apartment was just as described in the listing – well-located and true to the pictures. It was clean and comfortable, and I found it a great base for my trip.
I also appreciated your prompt and clear communication throughout, which made everything so smooth. The price felt fair for the quality of the flat, and I’d happily recommend your place to others looking for a similar experience.
Thanks again, and all the best!

Loved staying at 16 on Bree! The views were AMAZING! Apartment was super comfy and appliances were top notch!  Wish we had more time to spend at the apartment but we were booked up with things to do.  It is an amazing choice for sure!

My best AirB&B ever. Superb appartement, with a stunning panoramic view including Waterfront and Table Mountain. Cosy, luxurious, very comfortable with excellent equipment (including a very welcomed Weber BBQ on the terrasse!). This is a high end place, and the location is terrific, with Uber drivers always nearby, making it easy to explore the city with no stress.  Jayson’s been very reactive every time I had a question, making the stay perfect.

We loved our stay at this beautiful apartment and much hope to stay there again on a future Cape Town visit. The apartment has incredible views and is immaculately appointed. The location is super central with great restaurants in walking distance. Highly recommended!

Beautiful views from the balcony, spacious, safe location and building. Helpful backup chargers are there for load shedding. The actual apartment felt like it could use some updating in terms of decor- felt a little outdated.

The views made it worth it. Location being on the coast is also great. There is noise from traffic, buts that to be expected and cant be helped.
Bedding is very comfortable and nice.
On the whole it was a good stay.
We really enjoyed and felt at home. Strategically located, e.g walking distance to most places, because it’s close/ within city Centre. In future, I will make use of the place.

Beautiful place with everything you need.
Building is very noisy and we do not think it’s a great place for kids due to people smoking all kinds of things.
Communication from Scotty was great. If you are keen to be in the heart of the City with all the hustle and bustle that goes with that, this is the place for you.
I would say overall the experience was good and Scotty was very responsive and proactive as soon as we booked the Airbnb.

I absolutely loved my stay at Scotty’s place. It’s a walking distance away from most local restaurants and grocery shops. The My Citi bus stations are a stone throw which is really great. The place itself is spacious, squeaky clean and comfortable. Scotty was just an amazing host as well.
We had a great stay at Scotty’s place.The place is safe,clean and situated in a convenient location, close to all local amenities.I highly recommend booking the place.
My friends and I loved Bianca’s place. We felt right at home .. its closer to restaurants, long street , Table Mountain and V&A
Sandy is an excellent host and very thoughtful. She accommodated us in more ways than I anticipated. Keep up the good work up Sandy.

Sandy was a great host who would go out of the way to make your stay comfortable. She's very responsive and help you resolve any issues quickly. She's extremely cooperative and helpful. It was one of the best Airbnb experienced I've had so far :)
Sandy is very responsive in communication. The house was clean and adequate and check in was simple.

We really enjoyed the stay, the host was very responsive and friendly. I would definitely recommend the establishment. However, the rooms are a little small, both of the smaller rooms should only contain one single bed and it can actually only accommodate 4 adults and not 6 adults.
We had issues with one of the beds, i messaged sandy and a new bed was delivered the next morning :)
Sandy’s house is very beautiful and it is worth you going for it and it was peaceful we enjoyed everything with it I would go again

Extremely poor conditions, rat infestation in the one bedroom. The room had a foul smell and there were rodent droppings on the floor. Extremely disappointed as we obviously weren’t able to use that room. Sandy was also unresponsive and hard to reach. Not worth the price

It was comfy but a little cold, as the heater did not work
The bedding towels bathrooms and kitchen were immaculate
Lovely parks surrounding area for walks and for our dog
Loads of parking space
Close to restaurants
We loved our stay

I took my parents to this little gem for a few days. We literally could not have booked a better place. It felt so homey (if that’s even a word), had every utensil, pot, pan you could ever ask for and a fabulous big gas stove and dishwasher. We enjoyed the barbecue and found ourselves spending way too much time at this house as it was just so nice to lounge outside on the benches covered with beautiful luscious green trees, taking in the most magnificent views of every mountain worth seeing in Cape Town, right from our doorstep.  The place was extremely clean, check-in was a breeze with our host Wane who was not only super responsive and friendly, but made our family feel right at home. We already told Wane we will never stay anywhere else in Cape Town - this is OUR house now! Thank you for an awesome time. If you are thinking of booking this house, then book it now you will fall in love with it.

What a tasteful, homey and safe place! We all loved it. Perfect for family with small children. Margaretha had even some toys for them including water play toys. We felt immediately home and it’s so close to parks / playgrounds, healthy food places, Lionshead etc. The terrace is magical- beautiful SA light, gardening plants framing it - we loved eating and chatting there. We definitely will come back! Thank you so much again Margaretha!

Perfect house in the perfect location. Absolutely beautiful, safe, quiet, yet close to everything. We couldn’t have asked for a better place for our family to stay! Thank you for everything and we will be booking again!

Peaceful place to stay in Gardens area, local restaurants and cafes about 10mins walk. Margaretha and her family were very wecoming attentive and answered questions or dealt with requests rapidly. great place to stay and would book again. We were a group of 3 people in Cape town for a week on business. but would be great for a family too.

Had a great stay at Brad's place. Very clean and well taken care of! There is an additional cleaning fee if staying for long periods for a cost of 400 rand, and very much helped keep the place clean for my long stay. Loved the ease of access to the V&A and was close by for the Pride Parade and Cape Town Carnival. Overall had a great stay!

I had such an amazing time at Brad and Janine’s place. They loft is in the perfect location to explore the city. Everything is brand new and feels like home. They were both very proactive about everything and I had an amazing stay. I can’t wait to go back! Thanks for hosting me
Brad and Janine have an incredible home. One they make feel like your own. Me and my woman really enjoyed the weekend and hope for nothing but success for Brad and Janine in the future!

What a fantastic place, probably the best AirBnB I've stayed at so far! From excellent communication before arrival, helpful guidance how to find the flat, perfect location within Cape Town, secure building and that's before I even describe the flat. It's refreshing to see an AirBnB that has been created with a honey feeling, architectural design and has all the cutlery one can dream of 😊
Comfortable mattress, decent water pressure and a location that's just a few meters from restaurants and twenty minutes from the waterfront. Fully recommend Brad's and Janine's place as a stay in CT!

Amazing place, super cozy, spacious, beautifully decorated. We were working remotely, and the internet worked really well for video calls.
Thanks for having us!

The apartment is beautiful. Really loved the stay as the apartment is well positioned. Additionally it was serviced daily which was a bonus.
Will certainly be back to stay.

This property was gorgeous--the photos absolutely do it justice.  It's in a nice building overlooking the water, and it's walkable distance to both Sea Point and the V&A Waterfront.  The host Peter was extremely responsive, and helped us get settled in the nicest way.  I would highly recommend staying here the next time you're in Cape Town!
The space is so beautiful and decorated impeccably. It’s centrally located to so many restaurants and other things to do. Great view of the ocean.

This place is amazing, We had such a great stay!! The view is absolutely gorgeous!! Safe and easy to find! The communication with Nox was great! Highly recommend if you’re looking to stay in Cape Town!!
Absolutely beautiful apartment, exactly as per the photos. Felt super secure, brilliant location & clean. One small thing is just reliant on fans not A/C which meant it was warm in 33 degrees

Place is absolutely fantastic. Stayed at this apartment twice and will probably book it again when in CPT. The picture windows give you uninterrupted views of the ocean. It’s also on the more quiet side away from the hustle of sea point but very close to excellent restaurants, coffee spots and is a 10 minute walk to the V/A Waterfront.

This Apartment is so beautiful decorated. We had such a lovely stay!
The views are awesome and walking distance to V&A Waterfront, Greenpoint Stadium, many Restaurants
The bus stop is right in front of the apartment for the "hop on & off red bus"
And for the guys who have a rental vehicle there is a lockable garage for this property.
The Apartment is also serviced every day accept Sundays.
We will definitely book this Apartment again it made our Holiday extra special staying here.
This is a great place with an unbeatable view, comfortable, spacious, and in a great location. Communication was easy and friendly. Highly recommend!
Fantastic location near the seafront and easy to get around Cape Town. Lovely apartment- everything has been thought about and the service from Nox was exceptional.

Fantastic apartment with splendid views. The apt is exactly as shown in the photos.
We had some noise from construction works, but fortunately works were paused during the weekend. We would have appreciated prior notice, but in the end tje nuisance was minimal.

The apartment was beautifully decorated with sate of the art appliances .It is super luxurious. There was no unfortunately construction at the time but the hosts were extremely accommodating. I will definitely be back . I will recommend this place to anyone who wants a 5star stay. The daily cleaning service is a bonus!
Very beautiful place, great location, fall asleep listening to the waves. And the communications before, during and after my stay were really great.

Absolutely stunning flat, the interiors were so beautiful and perfectly selected - everything you could need for your stay in central Cape Town. The location was ideal for us between V&A and Sea Point with easy access to Green Point and Breë St.
We would absolutely love to come back, very much recommend to those looking to explore central Cape Town.
The Nox team were so great at communicating, truly a delight.
The best stay we had in Cape Town.  THE BEST! Seeing the dolphins jumping out of the water, when you have your coffee.. best start of the day 🐬

This was our second booking with Nox rentals and for sure not the last.
The apartment was stunning.
Thanks we had a great stay

This place is absolutely stunning. The decor is well thought out and modern. Beautiful use of the space even . On top of the stunning decor, the views are also breathtaking on both sides, on the one side it’s the ocean and the other the mountains. We were here for a short stay but this is a gem that would serve well for a relatively long stay with all amenities you could possibly need . Perfectly situated such that you have easy access to popular spots.

Lovely apartment, great location. If you are not used to the city noise, this place would not be for you.
Propr is not capable in managing this apartment. I was not satisfied with the service delivery and communication.
I strongly recommend the owner of this space to manage it him/herself or find another managing agent.

We had a wonderful stay here! My friend and I were in town for a long weekend and loved having this beautiful apartment serve as our home base. It was beautifully appointed and equipped with everything we needed, even better than the photos. The apartment was within walking distance or a short drive to everything we wanted to do, and with such friendly and responsive hosts, we would book again in a heartbeat. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a well priced and lovely stay. Thanks again Henri and Brandon!

Lovely place in a wonderful location with magnificent views.
Highly recommend this venue and incredible hospitality. Being personally met by Brandon differentiates from other anonymous experiences.
Bed linen, towels and everything are of the highest comfort and quality.
I love the unit and the location. I could live here. Thank you guys! Will be back. Big fan!

The apartment was stunning, with everything and more one could want.The decor, views, there was nothing about it i didnt like or wouldn't recommend.
loved all the extra special touches too.
i wished i had stayed longer, next time :-)

Superb! We wouldn’t change a thing about our stay! Brandon is the ideal host, so responsive and kind. The place has top notch amenities and all the little touches that make a stay feel extra special! The beds and linens are super comfortable!  The place is unique in its layout and we had a great stay! 10/10 would stay again and recommend!
Lovely place to stay in CPT, definetly coming back with my husband ! its a gem gem .... nice views, convient, rooftop... look this place is ideal.  Kudo to the owners ;)
We had a great stay here. Would highly recommend. The host was great, very easy communication, easy check in and fantastic views of Table Mountain.

5 Star Accommodation, in a great area close to all the attractions.  The unit is extremely well kitted with all the creature comforts you could think of.  Uber comfortable beds and luxury linen on the beds and in the bathrooms add to the luxury.  The view from the terrace is breathtaking!  Well worth the price, we will definitely be staying here again.
Such a wonderful appartment for short or long term stays. Henri and Brandon were very responsive and were great hosts.

Absolutely fantastic stay! The host was incredibly accommodating, the space was immaculate, and the location couldn't have been better. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay. Five stars all the way!

Had an absolutely incredible stay, felt right at home! An absolute gem of a home, everything so thoughtful and tasteful. Views are incredible from the lounge, to the bedroom and the private cocktail veranda. Brandon really went out of his way to make sure our whole experience was delightful. We will be back - for a longer stay! Xx ❤️

Henri is such an amazing host who responds anytime you need help.Also the place was amazing and very clean.                                                            The only issue I had and saw that many were having same evening was the security guards downstairs the female ones to be specific,she’s very rude and not understanding at all.
What an amazing Co host! Brandon met us at check in, actually waited an hour for us! Allowed us to check out 3 hours later than normal! And the apartment! Gosh a dream! We’ll definitely come back.

Lovely accommodations near the touristy areas of Cape Town. High security so you’ll always feel safe. Big apartment and very clean with lovely furniture, appliances and bedding. The view from the apartment was fantastic. Brandon was a friendly and very responsive host. Overall a great experience!
We really enjoyed our stay at this pristine penthouse apartment. The views are amazing from all three levels.
Beautiful apartment in an excellent location. Apartment building itself took safety and security very seriously. Our host was friendly, helpful and accommodating. Highly recommended!
Great stay at Henri’s place the views of Cape Town have you sitting in the window seats all day!

Beautiful apartment.  It's got a townhouse layout, so lots of stairs, but worth the climb to the private deck.  Front desk security was awesome and super-helpful.  Only drawback was a bit of noise from the unit next door.  Walls are pretty thin and you can hear voices next door.  Not a big deal, but maybe a problem if you're a light sleeper.

What a gem in De Waterkant! The rooftop terrace was absolutely stunning - we spent our evening watching the sunset over Table Mountain and the city skyline with a drink in hand. The views are even better than the photos suggest. Henry was great with communication, providing clear instructions and meeting us in person for a smooth check-in. The penthouse itself is thoughtfully laid out across three floors, with modern amenities and comfortable spaces to relax. Location is ideal - several great restaurants in the area, and took a quick Uber to Scala Pasta / Bar which was a fantastic dining experience! The V&A Waterfront is just minutes away. The 24-hour security desk and private parking made everything feel very secure. While we only stayed one night, it was the perfect spot to experience Cape Town's beauty from above. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a city escape with spectacular views and easy access to great dining!

This penthouse is the perfect gem with stunning views of table mountain. The private rooftop terrace was my favourite feature.
Brandon was really friendly—- he checked me in and was just the most lovely & welcoming person.
Highly recommend this spot!

The apartment was exactly as pictured and really added something special to our visit. Brandon met us at check in and made sure we were all squared away. On site parking and a keycard for all guests made things very easy. The views from the living room and rooftop are incredible. We would definitely stay again.

This was one of the best Airbnb’s we have ever stayed in. The hosts were very responsive and provided lots of information. The apartment was very secure, well appointed and furnished with an amazing rooftop with a spectacular view of Table Mountain. Excellent location with easy access to transport and lots of sightseeing locations.
We will definitely stay again.

The place is absolutely stunning. Decor was great although the cool lights with the writing in the living room were not working. Breathtaking views of Cape Town as well. Only issues was how hectic the check in process is, the place is basically on super lock down and it was always a challenge to get guests in as they also needed to follow a long process at reception. I wish this was communicated prior.
Amazing experience, from the responsive, accommodating hosts to the beautiful apartment. I would definitely stay here again.

Our 4-night stay at the Penthouse on 117 Strand Street was absolutely spectacular. The apartment is beautifully designed with all the modern amenities one could ask for, and the view of Table Mountain from the windows was nothing short of surreal.
Its central location made exploring Cape Town incredibly convenient, while the top-notch security and excellent facilities gave us complete peace of mind. A perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience — we couldn’t have asked for more.
Thanks Henri and Brandon for everything

Perfect location for us in Cape Town. The unit is lovely and clean, kitchen is very well equipped , comfortable bed and a decent hair dryer!! The complex is super secure, we always felt safe, very easy to find. We enjoyed the beautiful views to the Table Mountains. Highly recommend if you are visiting Cape Town.

The most amazing and beautiful place to stay while in Cape Town!! The views were insane. The host went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable, gave us local recommendations, and made sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely recommend to anyone.

The Seaforest was exceptional. It was newly refurbished will everything you could think of available in the bedroom and kitchen area. Everything was spotless and Cody. The best part of my stay was the lovely hosts. Dee and Craig were the loveliest people you could wish for as hosts. Friendly, caring but most of all kind, honest, genuine people. The views were amazing and a five minute walk to the beach. Pure relaxation for me and I will return so that I can see these lovely people again. Thanks Dee and Craig.

Super cozy place with a great and quiet garden. super sweet interior with everything you need.
dee and Chris are making a real effort to make this a nice stay.

Dee’s place is perfect, the garden and pool are very nice and the beds and bathroom are comfortable. More important, Dee is a great host! She’s not just offering a place to stay but giving you a warm welcome in Scarborough. Pro tip: invite her for a glass of wine!

A relaxed stay in this exquisite hidden gem, nestled against Table Mountain.
This tastefully decorated "cottage" has a well equipped kitchenette with washing machine and dryer, a separate walk in dressing room and beautiful bathroom with a shower en suite. Fluffy white towels and a heated towel rail added to the luxurious stay. The TV offering a range of channels as well as Netflix was a definite plus. An added luxury was the Nespresso coffee machine - we loved our freshly brewed coffee in the mornings!
The little garden area with its beautiful lemon tree and seating area was enjoyed daily by us.
Thank you for making the process so easy to check in and out and for being readily available when it was necessary. You are a splendid host and we had a memorable 5 star stay! We could not have asked for more.
We felt safe and pampered.
We will most definitely return!

We stayed for more than a week at this accommodation and it was fantastic! Would definitely come here again next time. The location is great as its very quiet, and you walk straight into the woods of Table Mountain. Kitchen is very well equipped (so is the apartment in general). Thank you Albertus for everything!
Absolutely fantastic Airbnb in possibly the best area of Cape Town. Even better than the photos, amazing, safe and secure. Highly recommended
Wonderful stay... beautifully appointed and tastefully furnished cottage. We absolutely loved our stay and would love to come back.

We had a wonderful time here! Staying right next to Table Mountain was a dream, and the space was cozy, clean, and private. The neighborhood is beautiful and very peaceful as well, with no road noise. We found everything just as advertised - with all the details we wouldn’t have expected, like fresh apples and chocolates on our pillows upon arrival. We were so comfortable here and would highly recommend it to others! The host is very helpful and responsive, which made our stay stress-free!

Really enjoyed staying here. It's beautifully positioned right at the base of the mountain so good opportunities for walking. Also just a few minutes drive from the centre of town so the best of both the peace and the town.
Very well equipped and a nice private outdoor area. When in the area again we would definitely stay here again. Also comfortable for a longer stay with the washing machine etc. Recommended.

Have always wanted to stay at the foot of Table Mountain - this was incredible and went beyond in terms of location! You literally walk out the gate, up the road and you are on the mountain. The accommodation was on point -- probably the best set up kitchen ever for Airbnb plus extras like washing machine, tumble dryer, iron etc. Brilliant check in and out. Totally seamless. Really well managed and the best welcome.  Will definitely be back!!
Great location, clean apartment. The bathroom is a bit difficult and it will be great to have spare linens.
Had a wonderful time at the place. Excellent location, even easy to walk all the way down into the city. :)

The studio is beautifully furnished and very comfortable. The bed was amazing and it was so quiet that I slept very well. Beautiful bathroom with a very good shower. The little kitchen is very small, but everything you need in there. I would not cook in there as it is all open and food smells will be in the bed as well.
The door goes out into your own garden and patio with a lemon tree in the middle.
I would definitely stay here again. It is a gorgeous little place.
The hosting is not by Bertus though, but rather a company called Authentic Properties whose communication was not brilliant.
What a lovely place on the very foothills of Table Mountain! Thank you so much, Bertus!

Lovely little apartment for a stay in Cape Town the location is perfect for getting around and the residential area is stunning and very quiet. We enjoyed the parks and outdoor areas on our doorstep for our dog.
We appreciated the extra amenities such as the washer, dryer, fan, clothes drying rack and all the kitchen essentials. The apartment is compact, but has all the necessities and is very comfortable. I would definitely recommend.

Simona’s place was great .It is in a quiet neighbourhood but very easy to get to shops and restaurants.We loved stay there and can’t recommend it enough.Simona was very helpful as well if we needed anything or needed recommendations.Thank You

Great stay with my family! Matt was a great host and helpful. The house is really clean, modern and comfortable furniture and no personal clutter. A short walk away from The Cape Vineyard and Noordehoek Village. The beach is also nearby amongst many other activities. Very family friendly home and private. I’m very fussy about cleanliness but this place was perfect, it felt brand new. My kids and I loved it and it was very relaxing. Looking forward to coming back!

The house in Noordhoek is designed beautifully and looks just like on the photos. The garden was very well maintained and our daughter loved the trampoline. Had fantastic nights at by the fire, protected from the wind. Would definitely go there again and highly recommend the place!

Matt was such a great host with a lovely home. He was friendly, responsive and full of amazing suggestions. From the weeks leading up to the trip right up until the day we were leaving Cape Town Matt helped with so many helpful suggestions for activities.
The space is modern and spacious while being homely. The kitchen was stocked with all you’d need for a long or short stay. The bedrooms were comfortable with 2 of the 3 bedrooms being en suite. All amenities were in perfect working condition and although we had neighbours close by, the space was still private and quiet.
I’d definitely recommend this home and Matt as a host.

We had a wonderful stay and wish we could have stayed longer. The house was fantastic and Matt was an excellent host - so friendly, helpful and responded to all our questions and needs very quickly. We couldn't have wished for anything more!

This is my best find to date. Lovely home in an incredible and quiet neighbourhood. The hosts were incredibly attentive and responsive throughout our stay. The home was equipped with all the amenities necessary for our small retreat. Thank you Matt and Shanon for making my Moms birthday weekend incredibly special❤️🌻

This house was absolutely beautiful. It was kid friendly, close to restaurants and things to do, lovely indoor and outdoor spaces and the owner was extremely kind and helpful. Extra little touches with fresh produce, laundry detergent, firewood, and other things were provided. I would definitely stay at this wonderful home again.

Hosts went above and beyond.
Lovely stay in beautiful surroundings and the pool was a huge plus!
The place is very quiet and calm. The owners were also extremely friendly and welcoming - I will definitely come back again!
Marilize was a fantastic host and so incredibly accommodating! Her property is so beautiful and peaceful! I would highly recommend staying there; you won’t be sorry!

A truly wonderful stay!
My host was incredibly helpful, always available with great recommendations while respecting my privacy. The space itself was peaceful—perfect for both work and relaxation. The quiet atmosphere, combined with a secure location, made it an ideal retreat. I felt completely at ease throughout my stay and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for comfort, convenience, and a welcoming host.
Looking forward to returning

Not big, but very very nice, clean, comfortable, new appartment. 100m of the sea-point promenade, for walks/running etc. The Norfolk-deli in the building was also superb. Grant was a great host. Hope to be back someday.

My stay in Grants studio was a nice and comfy one. There's everything you need for a chilled stay in Seapoint. It's close to the boardwalk and sea + there's this cute coffee place in the same building with an outside area where the staff bake fresh breads every morning. The building has shared amenities such as a gym, laundry machines and a pool on the roof!

Very comfortable Airbnb for our 9 day stay. Equipped with most things you might need for a longer stay, including extra bed sheets, towels and cleaning supplies. We especially appreciated Grant's swift responses and flexibility throughout our stay - thank you!

We had a wonderful weekend at Lindi’s cottage and it was such a treat to get away to Noordhoek (even though we only live 30 minutes away). The cottage is super-comfortable and has everything you need: Nespresso coffee, fully kitted kitchen, comfy TV room, awesome double bunk bed for the kids, a desk with a printer (for me to get some work done) and an old enamel bath to soak in. We loved being surrounded by horses, beautiful big trees  and looking up to the Noordhoek mountain. My kids loved the giant trampoline and playing tennis on the astro pitch. In the evenings we would make use of the outdoor braai/fire-pit under the trees and eat outside under the stars. Loved being in walking distance from the Noordhoek Farm Village and the Noordhoek Common. What a magical place to visit in Cape Town!

This cottage was stunning, the location amazing, its very child friendly and Lindi has really put so much effort into thinking about everything a guest would like to know and need! Thank you Lindi, we will defs be back soon!

Our stay was just exceptional with Mandy & Dean. The two-bedroom apartment is superb and very unique! Located next to everything you need - wonderful cafes, Supermarket, Shopping mall etc - all within 10 mins walk from the apartment. What stood out most for me was the location of the apartment in a very quiet and beautiful suburb in the South, the design, and the exquisite feeling you get from the apt - in the kitchen and also in the Bathroom. I definitely hope to stay there again pretty soon! Mandy & Dean are very good people you can talk to just about anything that bothers you during your stay.

What a wonderful rural retreat still so close to Cape Town! We wanted a kid-friendly rental that wasn't too long of a drive from town, where we live. The outdoor space, including kol kol hot tub and boma as well as trampoline and soccer pitch, was perfect for the kids (and adults) to enjoy. The house was so well equipped we didn't need to bring anything from home. The inverter meant we weren't left in the dark during load shedding, and when it started to rain outside, we started the indoor wood-burning stove and were all cosy and warm in minutes!
What a magical place. It was the perfect base for our time in Noordhoek. Our son loved the horses, pigs, and the little goats. Thanks again for sharing your slice of heaven with us.
Enjoyed being here as I spent time in Cape Town. I would rebook. Great if you want a quiet time. The host is responsive.

We had a lovely stay at Faraway Cottage, the animals and surroundings were great and the kids loved playing in the gardens, trees and trampoline, whenever it wasn’t raining.
We had a few minor issues with the stove and electricity but the host was very responsive and fixed them straight away.
We would love to return to Faraway Cottage in the summer months!

We really enjoyed our stay here. The kids loved the animals, and we loved the location - so close to many different excursions we wanted to do. The host was helpful in answering questions and giving recommendations. It was cold when we were here, but the stove heated the main part of the house well and the electric blankets in the coldest room were an awesome touch! Thanks for a good time!

Lindi is a great host, always responsive and very proactive. We had a lovely time at Lindi’s place, the fireplace was much needed during the cold days/nights. We appreciated the small touches eg. Electric blanket on the bed. The farm is beautiful with lots to do. The kitchen is well equipped with everything you need. The hot tub takes a while to get warm so ensure you have enough wood to make a big fire. The farm is very close to shops/restaurants. Due to the weather we couldn’t enjoy the outside but will defs be back when the weather is better.

The kids loved the animals, the trampoline, and the faraway tree. We didn't have time for a braai or a hot tub, but they looked mighty inviting! Would consider staying here again (high praise from coming from someone who never wants to repeat the same airbnb!)
It's our second time we've stayed at Lindi's place and will definitely come back again!

We had a fantastic stay at this beautiful cottage in Nordhoek! The peaceful setting, fresh air, and open space made it the perfect retreat. The accommodation was spotless, well-equipped, and very comfortable.
Our children absolutely loved spending time with the animals, playing on the football field, and jumping on the trampoline—it was a paradise for them! The farm offered plenty of space for them to explore and have fun while we enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere.
Everything was well-organized and we felt very welcome. Charles always helped us out if we had questions. If you're looking for a family-friendly getaway surrounded by nature, this is the perfect place. We would definitely come back!
What an amazing place to start our 3 month roadtrip! We stayed with 2 little kids for 2 weeks and had a great time. The animals, hottub, braai and the location makes it really feel like vacation:)
This place is absolutely fabulous and perfect for little kids. Lots of animals, super friendly hosts and great area. Highly recommend!

We were traveling with two young kids - the cottage was perfect, we had lots of space and privacy, horses and pigs provided endless entertainment, and lots of fun kids books and puzzles.
Good proximity to beach, common, farm village and more.
Host was very proactive and responsive.
As always an amazing time at Lindi’s .  Our kids - and we - just love this place.  It’s a home away from home - including with pets!

Perfect stay for a family with small kids. Kids enjoyed seeing the animal’s everyday. Astro court allowed for hours of family playtime. Truly thought of Charles to provide all of the balls and rackets to make use of the court. Definitely, be returning for another stay!

We loved our stay at the cottage! It was so easy to entertain our toddler with all the animals, a field to run around on, the trampoline, and all the great books for kids. He had an absolute ball! Its a fab little place, with all the amenities and very central.  Themba was very good with our little boy, making sure to call him to help feed the animals. We will be back - thank you!

We had a wonderful stay at Charles’s place! 🌿 The farm is full of lovely animals, and the peaceful atmosphere with stunning views made our stay truly unforgettable. It was the perfect spot to relax and enjoy nature. Highly recommended!
Great view, great location. Busy building and the smell of other families cooking comes through strongly in the evenings
Great spot. Close to the beach and pool, and lots of good eating places nearby. Clean and neat accommodation and very friendly staff :)
Fantastic stay in a great location.  The apartment was clean and had everything needed for a short stay.  Brilliant communication from time of booking to departure.  Can't wait to come back.

As far as micro-apartments go this one was comfortable and practical. Essentially everything you could need for a business trip or a couple travelling together. The apartment is perfectly located within walking distance of the promenade and around 5kms from the CBD
Would definitely stay again and recommend

WiFi worked during loadshedding.
Very clean.
Nice bakery downstairs.
Felt safe with the security guards.
Not too loud.
Very modern.
Honestly great place to stay for one, has everything you need. School nearby so quite loud in the mornings but really enjoyed my stay!

Everything was perfect. The location is right in the heart of Seapoint but far enough back that you have a lot of peace and quiet. The apartment is really big and well equip. Communication was excellent and Terry was always on hand should I have needed anything. I would live here the whole season if it wasnt booked out.

Absolutely perfect stay. Wonderful apartment close to the water, well equipped and very clean. The Wifi is working even during load shedding (South Africa's scheduled power outages) which was awesome. Would definitely come again.

Thanks to the team for rectifying the parking concern prior to my arrival, as the profile doesn't state the parking requires additional payment. My 4-day stay was great, everything was clean, staff were friendly and efficient, ideal location walking distance to shops, restaurants and the beach promenade. Highly recommended.
This beautifully located Airbnb has high end fixtures and is really well equipped for a luxurious stay! Amazing shower and incredibly comfy bed… would recommend!!

Thank you so much for hosting us Leesa, we had the most peaceful and comfortable stay at your place. We struggled to leave for our daily activities because it was just too comfortable. Thank you for your great hospitality and for literally being a text away. Nice and clean place too!

We spent 4 wonderful days here. The bed was super comfy, plenty of hot water. Very clean and modern. Host super helpful. Highly recommend. Very convenient to all of our favourite coffee shops. Would definitely stay here again.

The cottage was even better than in the photos—very comfortable and well-equipped, even with a washing machine. Great location, close to the shopping mall and not far from the winelands.
Leesa was very helpful and provided us with lots of information.

Always a great pleasure staying in Ellen’s apartments! I feel so welcome by the whole team and apartments are perfect.
They are Extremely professional and I will always stay with them.
Highly recommended.
A lovely apartment in a fab location close to everything. The hosts were so responsive and helpful. All in all a great experience, I will definitely be returning!

This is our second time staying here! The apartments are wonderful and have everything you need. Ellen is very responsive and even proactive with her communication. She alerted us about upcoming bad weather and other things going in the area that we should be aware of. Wifi works great in the living room, but even with the extender it doesn’t reach the bedroom which made it a bit difficult for two of us to work from the same place when we both had calls, but we managed to make it work!
Easy check-in. On busy Regent Road with shops, bars cafes and short walk to beach and waterfront park.

My Week long stay was nothing short of amazing. Both Kyle & Daniel were very friendly & helpful. They made sure that if we needed anything or were unsure about something to not hesitate to reach out. The place was very easy to find & is close to shops. Our apartment was breathtaking and felt much like a second home. I’ll be sure to visit again
It was nice and quiet, we had a great time and I would recommend it anytime any day.

Desire was very helpful and eager to assist.
This made our stay very enjoyable, and although the weather was not on our side, Desire went out of her way to assist and accomodate our needs throughout our stay.
Would recommend to anyone looking to stay in or near Hout Bay/Constantia that is looking for a relaxing digitally detached environment.

Phakalane is a haven of peace and spirituality perched above Hout Bay. Absolutely worth the visit. You’ll never want to leave.
A walk through the garden at the start of my stay was the perfect antidote to the exhaustion of a tiring flight.
My room was quiet and homely. I had several great nights' sleep in my safe cocoon - no small feat for an insomniac like myself.
Over and above all this, among other perks, evenings by the fireplace were a memorable treat, as was a brief meditation session I enjoyed in the temple.
To be fair I was out and about lots and really wished I could have hit pause and soaked in the experience, but I’m grateful I could visit. Definitely hoping and looking forward to another.
Phakalane is truly a blessing.
Thank you so much for having me.
Had such an amazing stay, felt right at home from the moment I checked it. It’s a beautiful place, surrounded with nature and amazing views. Will definitely be back again.

Phakalane is a place of peace. The architecture and design are so conscious and the energy of the property spoke to me and my friend. We hiked to the waterfall on Edon’s recommendation and the nature and surrounds of the area were amazing. The sauna facilities were very relaxing as well. I felt immensely grounded after my stay, and left with joy in my heart 🌈 I highly recommend this retreat centre and will revisit again!
A magical, peaceful stay from start to finish. We will be back asap. Thank you! 💖
Beautiful common space, well designed and decorated. The temple. Heated bed. Nice selection of books. Smell of the pines around the property. Natural cold plunge pool. Friendly staff.

We had an amazing stay at Phakalane for my birthday weekend! The hosts were so kind and helpful & we had a great time exploring the beautiful property. The space is excellently designed and we absolutely loved our time in the sauna on the property, which was very affordable too. I’ll definitely be back!
Loved it here so much. Felt right at home and friendly hosts. Would do it again

What an amazing stay!! We were here for 3 nights and loved every minute. One of the nicest places we have stayed for a while.
Very relaxing and peaceful location and great size rooms and bathrooms. Breakfast was delicious and the staff were fantastic.
Thank you so much!
Very beautiful place where you can completely unwind. Beautifully decorated room surrounded by nature and delicious breakfast. Highly recommended!

Great Apartment! I stayed for 38 days with no issues. They upgraded to larger smart tv while I was there, big comfy bed, and nice hot shower. Located on top floor in the back of apartment building so it is very quiet and secure.  Great views from every window and just a few minute walk to the beach.  I was very happy with this Airbnb and plan to return here on my next visit.
It was a really pleasant stay in an idealy placed location. If you have a car you can easily access the peninsula as well as cape town
This was my second time staying here,  just as good as first. She was also able to accommodate a late checkout for me that was greatly appreciated. I already have my third  time booked.

We had an amazing stay! The location is perfect, close to the beach and the restaurants, secure and quiet. The appartement is very cozy, we felt at home right away! The communication was very good.
We are definitely planning on coming back!

The place was ideal for our needs. Lauren and Michael were clear and responsive, making the check-in process smooth. The location is great, centrally situated and just a short walk to the beach. The place was equipped with everything we needed and had more space than we expected. Would definitely recommend.
Spectacular view over the lovely Simonstown. We had an awesome stay! Beautiful house with everything you need!
Me and my partner stayed at the cottage over the Christmas period, the cottage was beautiful and Anna was very welcoming, I would definitely stay there again.

We loved our stay at Anna’s cottage. We had a nice space in her beautiful garden, the cottage was well equipped with everything we needed and it was a quick drive to the city. Anna and her family are great hosts, she went out of her way to make us feel comfortable and welcome . We’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful and beautiful place to stay.

The cottage is very well self contained making it an easy and cosy experience. The property is well kept and peaceful. Monique is a lovely and caring host who is eager to assist you. Would definitely stay here again!

a great place to stay in cape town. large apartment in a hotel for long-term rentals. good facilities around, coffee shop, restaurants with south african,
italien, japanese food in the same building. Supermarkt 100m away.
communication with cathy and tinashe was helpful and quick.
The appartement is very nice, secure, clean, well equipped and close to the beach. Leroux and Neuza are really nice and helpfull hosts. We'll be glad to return next year!
I had a great stay. This place is beautiful and a peaceful home away from home. Great value for money. The host Danielle was very friendly, responsive and helpful.
a fantastic place to be for a nature lover like me. as a matter of fact, I'd love to visit again sometime.....

We absolutely were blown away by Ernest and Danielle's hospitality during our father-in-law's 6 night stay.  They were warm and welcoming, very accommodating and went above and beyond as hosts.  We would stay here again and again, and we VERY highly recommend these accommodations.

Had a wonderful stay and Danielle is an amazing hostess, making us feel right at home. A beautiful room with surroundings and view. Would definitely recommend if you're looking for somewhere private, with a view. Everything that you need is provided and we even had use of the pool and outside area. Was an absolute memorable stay. Thank you so much.
Ernest and Danielle were great hosts.  Incredibly helpful, welcoming and hospitable.  Our stay was comfortable and Danielle went out of her way to make us feel at home.

A huge thank you to Ernest and Danielle for an amazing stay at their Airbnb! The space was immaculate and beautifully decorated, with all the amenities one could ask for. Ernest and Danielle were incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout my stay, making me feel right at home. Highly recommend their Airbnb for anyone looking for a wonderful experience. Thanks again!
We had a wonderful time. The hosts were great, and the mattress and linen was of a high quality. Quiet and peaceful. We will definately stay there again.
The hosts were incredibly warm and welcoming. Their hospitality truly made my trip special. The room was spotless and beautifully decorated with everything I needed for a comfortable stay.

Had a great time, the apartment is very nicely furnished, is in a beautiful area and has everything you would need for short or longer stays.
Heather and Ed are also really great hosts and make you feel right at home.

My wife and I really loved our stay at Clovelly. Heather really treated us so well with attention to details. She added lots of extras from bathrobes & slippers, to treats in the fridge. The bed was comfortable with excellent linen & towels. Good WiFi & we were pleased with the service to wash & iron our clothes. Safe & secure place. Access to main roads was very easy.
Tranquil location.  Stunning interior with attention to detail.  The king sized bed with luxurious bedding was a treat.  I loved my stay

I spent 2 tonights at lee’s house, but I loved it. Lee was super friendly and kind, as her dog tommy and her cat Oscar 😍.
The house is great 🫶🏻
Thanks Lee for everything!

Great location with view of table mountain. Hiking trails and supermarket in walking distance. Lee was a great host, friendly, flexible and responsive. The apartment is a bit quirky, but cozy, clean and worth the money.
Lee was a great host and I really enjoyed my time here. Great apartment, beautiful surroundings and very clean. Highly recommend!

Samuel ( Beru😂😂) is a calm and down to earth guy. Really helpful and friendly. Always there to assist, and knows how to speak to people. On my next visit to cape town, i am definitely booking this place, and hope Sam to be our guy💯💯
My wife and I had a lovely time in Kommetjie, hosted by Martina. the unit is cosy, peaceful and chic. great location with easy access to the beach and the restaurants. highly recommended!

We had a fantastic time during our stay at Martina‘s place! It was very clean, beautifully decorated and filled with natural light creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.
The only minor thing worth mentioning is that if you‘re an early riser who enjoys waking up with the sunrise or if you‘re accustomed to sleeping without curtains, this place is perfect for you. While the master bedroom has curtains for the large windows, the smaller windows lack similar coverings. It might be beneficial to have curtains or alternative blackout options for the smaller windows as well, especially for those who prefer a darker sleeping environment.
Despite this small consideration, our overall experience was wonderful and our host‘s hospitality truly enhanced our stay. We highly recommend her place to anyone looking for a charming and comfortable accommodation. Thank you for hosting us, Martina!

Lovely place, and beautiful, beautiful, view. And very helpful, attentive host, who communicated very well. However, there was a very annoying child next door.  And I found the kitchen sink too small to wash up in effectively. Loved the shower, though!

Six On N is located perfectly. I stayed about 3 weeks but I did not need to hire a car nor everyday taxi. Things are just around the apartment, beach, grocery stores, cafes etc. I just used Uber over weekends to meet friends and visit places out of the area. The cafe annexed to the apartment is also great.
The staffs are very helpful. They also helped me with a couple my requests during my stay including finding out the location of medical facility. I absolutely felt at home here during my stay.

Fantastic place, a stone throw away from the ocean. Lot's to do in the area.
The team is friendly and very helpful, great people all round.

Overall I had a good stay, and the location was excellent. However, this particular apartment is on the ground floor and it is quite dark, which is not specifically mentioned on the description of the place. Also, there are no curtains, which made sleeping difficult.

Had a great stay! Staff were friendly and helpful. The room was very clean and so cozy. It felt like I was staying at a 5 star hotel with extras like towels, shower gel, shampoos, extra blankets. Walking distance to amazing restaurants and the promenade, felt very safe. Can’t wait to go back and bring my friends and family!

Friday’s place is small but neat, conveniently located in Sea Point near great beaches, restaurants and tidal pools. We struggled the first night with the air conditioner which made periodic aggressive churning noises, and just decided to keep it off afterwards. Frida was always responsive to messages, and hopefully this issue will get fixed soon.

Perfect lock-up and go apartment. Very safe.
Central with everything you need around you.
Frida and Yannick were also lovely hosts.

Frida was a great host and communicated very clearly throughout. Even asked if everything was ok as I hadn’t checked in by the time mentioned (delayed flight)! Very responsive and the apartment was advertised and close to all amenities, beaches and great restaurants.

This place was exactly what I needed. Quiet, well-equipped, and no drama, everything worked smoothly. The security personnel were also friendly and helpful. As someone already familiar with Sea Point, I wasn’t looking for much, just a calm and comfortable space for a few days before relocating overseas. It served that purpose perfectly
Great communication, Excellent views, feels homey and all in all it's an immensely stunning place, will definitely recommend to stay here. 😇
The communication with the host was very good. Way closer to the stores and the beach than I thought. The sink is a bit tiny but I think that was the only problem

My stay at Saratoga 206 apartment in Sea Point was thoroughly enjoyable. The apartment provided a safe and comfortable environment throughout my 10-day visit. Its proximity to both the MyCiti bus stop and the sightseeing bus stop made exploring Cape Town incredibly convenient. Additionally, the nearby Mojo Market and shops meant that I didn't need to rely on a car during my time in the city.

The apartment is amazing, it’s great furnished and everything is well thought through. There is not a thing missing. I really enjoyed my stay and the communication was great. Jayson was very quick in responding and solved everything immediately. I highly recommend the apartment and will definitely come back

This place was so nice! Beautiful high ceilings, all new furniture and decorations! Very clean and modern kitchen and bathroom! There is everything you can think of! Jayson was very helpful and responsive, check in was easy! Definitely recommend this place to everyone that’s looking for a location in the centre of Sea Point! Everything is in walking distance and easy to find!
Only two small things to notice, which are no major points but just good to know:
1. no generator for loadshedding times.
2. very loud street outside, calms down at night though.
Definitely will come back next time !!! Thanks Jayson! 👍

Jason's place was in a great location. The door was a little tricky at times, but everything was as one would need. Right in the happenings of Sea Port. In front of Mojo Market. One block from the beach. I can't really complain. Thanks, Jason!
Thank you, apart from the problems with the WiFi. My stay was great. Thank you for offering the router as an alternative
Easy check in, it was very clean and the place is very nice. Place is private and gets busy on weekends. Our stay was amazing. Will definitely come back 👌🏾

We would definitely come back to this great place which has all the amenities you’d need, located in the center of very active neighbourhood with access to a lot of restaurants, bars, shops, the beach…etc. Checking in and out was extremely easy and flexible. Communication was excellent, with assistance prior and throughout our stay. Be mindful of load shedding as there is no generator.

I had an amazing stay at Jayson's apartment! Check-in went smoothly, and the instructions were clear and concise. From the moment I walked in, it felt like a home away from home. The place was impeccably clean, and the interior design demonstrated great taste and attention to detail. The kitchen has everything needed to cook your own meals. I also live right next to a main road where I'm from, so I didn't think that the main road outside of the apartment would be such a big adjustment, but I got used to the vibe and the hustle and bustle after a couple of days. The location is perfect—walking distance from many restaurants and shops. A quick trip down the street to the Prom makes for refreshing morning runs and breathtaking sunsets. Jayson and his co-hosts are great—they always responded promptly and were happy to help. I would be delighted to book with them again in the future.
Very nice air bnb, in the middle of the hustle and bustle. Downside is: its very noisy 24/7.
Amazing apartment in a great neighbourhood of Seapoint. Lots of restaurants close by. A bit noisy with street sounds at night, but that’s what might be expected from such a location.

Our experience was nothing short of delightful! From the moment we received clear directions on how to find and access the property, to stepping inside and being greeted by its stunning beauty, we were thoroughly impressed. The place was impeccably clean, and its charm was undeniable. Being within walking distance to the beach was a huge plus, and there was never a shortage of activities to enjoy. We're already planning our next visit because this place has left a lasting impression on us. We can't wait to return!

What a wonderful spot to stay at in Sea Point. The apartment is in a great location with a beautiful modern style furnished interior. The check in process was easy and the hosts were very accommodating and communicative.
