We loved how close it was to trendy restaurants, a road away from the cycle rentals and right next to Mojo Market, so a perfect place if you want to adventure around Seapoint.
The street is quite busy and vibrant but overall the apartment was homey and private enough for us to also enjoy a movie night in. Definitely would highly recommend staying here. 😁
I loved staying here! The apartment was beautiful with everything you could need and in such a great location. Will definitely be staying here again!

This location was great for my time in Cape Town. Right across from Mojo Market, so on the nights when we didn't have something to do or wanted a quick drink, we could just walk across to the market. Great response from the team, I would definitely stay again.

My wife and I just had the most amazing stay at this AirBnB! Since the time of booking, communication on their end was fast, friendly, and detailed, truly making it an easy process from start to finish. Any questions throughout our stay were answered almost instantly.
The actual property was amazing. It was cozy and had a unique decor; the thoughtful details in every corner made it a real home away from home. I couldn't recommend this AirBnB more, and I would repeat it for sure. Thank you for one of our my most unforgettable experiences!

The space was impeccably clean, and I immediately felt at home. The apartment is situated in a lively area, so there's some ambient noise, though it’s not overwhelming. The hosts were polite, attentive, and quick to respond to any questions.

Many thanks for your hospitality and early accommodations!
This space is perfectly located and excellently styled, with everything necessary for a great holiday in the Cape.
We'll certainly be back 🙏❤️😎
Thank you!
Great place to stay at , a bit noisy due to construction , no arranged parking , I had to park at a 5 minutes walk street parking
Apartment is beautiful and spacious. Close to the best things Cape Town has to offer so the location is perfect if you’re someone who likes to be out and about.

Geraldine is a caring and warm-hearted host! She was always responsive and supportive. Her place is beautiful, exactly as it is on the pictures. Very private, with an amazing view. We had a great time and would always book again with Geraldine! :)

Geraldine is such a Beautiful, kind hearted person.Communication with her was effective and she responded to messages immediately.She was willing to assist with anything you needed and even extended our check out time upon request.I will definitely recommend her place if you looking for beautiful views and peaceful place. I will definitely be booking her place next time I go to Cape Town :).

We had an absolutely fantastic stay at this beautiful apartment in Cape Town! Geraldine, our host, was simply amazing - always available and incredibly helpful throughout our stay. The apartment itself was wonderfully equipped with everything we could possibly want, making our stay comfortable and convenient. I would return in a heartbeat and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a perfect Cape Town experience. Thank you, Geraldine, for making our visit so memorable!

Samantha was a lovely host, made us feel at home without making us feel like visitors at all. Loved the room and the multiple snacks she had for us in the room. Was only worried about the car parking in the streets, but was soon at ease as the area is super safe.
Thank you Samantha

Sam was an awesome hostess. She made us feel at home right away, very friendly and accommodating.She even went out of her way to prepare a special surprise for me and my wife upon our arrival as a anniversary gift. The unit is extremely neat, tidy and peaceful and Sam adds a lot of extras. I would really recommend Harbour Delight. Looking forward to going back in the year.

This is one of the most beautifully arranged places that I've stayed at. I stayed there for 4 nights and I utterly enjoyed it. The bed is comfortable and I used the little desk to work on my laptop. Itis spotlessly clean and you've got all the necessary amenities. Sam and her husband Kevin are very kind and caring, giving their best to make you feel comfortable. I am happy to have met them.

Thank you Samantha for being such a warm, welcoming , attentive and proactive host!  Extending our stay again was a great decision and it’s been a home away from home. It was a blessing to be hosted by you, we are grateful !
It was really an amazing week. Everything was perfect and clean. Sam is an absolutely amazing person and will go back anytime. Sam is so helpful and kind.

Sam's place is a real gem! The comfort, the design, all the amenities and the attention to the smallest details really stand out. I felt quite spoiled and enjoyed every moment of of my stay. Sam is an amazing host, and she will make sure you have everything you need. I can't wait to be be back.

5 ⭐️! Perfect for short and long stay! I stayed for a month here and it feels like home.. peaceful and secure environment and great host services
Everything I needed for my long stay was provided! I enjoyed my stay

We had a wonderful stay here. The condo definitely meets the expectations in the listing. A few good restaurants, grocery stores within walking distance. Load shedding wasn’t much an issue with the battery/inverter in the unit. Would highly recommend.
Only downside was the pool was out of commission, which was a feature that drew us to the listing. Outside the hosts power to fix, it still was a disappointment.

This apartment is amazing and so are Terry and Heather. The apartment was in excellent condition, fully stocked with everything you could need and has beautiful furnishings and attention to detail. The photos don’t do it justice. The hosts were brilliant, gave excellent recommendations and were very responsive. Next time we visit Cape Town, we will definitely be staying here again. Thank you for everything Heather and Terry!
Outstanding apartment in beautiful Green Point setting. Terri was very kind and helpful. Would highly recommend!

***BOOK THIS!*** Terry’s apartment is beautiful, clean and in a great location. The building is secure with a 24 hour guard and it’s in a safe neighborhood with the DHL stadium, deli and coffee shops very nearby. The V&A waterfront with shopping, gyms, museums and great restaurants is a short walk away. Personally, Terry is an amazing host and went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect. We felt like we had a friend in Cape Town. ❤️ Thank you Terry!

A Gem of Comfort and Hospitality!
To our delight, everything was as splendid as it appeared online.
The host, with their thoughtful and gracious approach, provided us with all the information and clear check in instructions, responded promptly and to mention the chocolate treat on arrival. Amazing security and security personnel.
The location was nothing short of incredible, placing us right in the heart of the city locations we planned on visiting.
Our weekend was not just comfortable but genuinely memorable.
Thank you, Terry!

Terry’s apartment is the best I’ve experienced in Greenpoint. It really has everything you need and more. Clean and comfortable and spacious with the stunning views! We loved the balcony looking out at signal hill! Book this apartment if it’s available ☺️

Very beautiful apartment. Worth every minute and Terry is extremely helpful. Location is central to everything you need in Cape Town. My family enjoyed the flat. We hope to book again on our next visit

We loved Terry’s place! We were met by Heather, who checked us in personally and showed us the ropes. It was like meeting an old friend! Heather is warm and helpful and gave us tips on local eateries.
The apartment itself is top notch! Beautifully decorated, with nice fluffy towels and comfortable beds and linen. We were able to walk to local restaurants, delis and shops, and it’s a short walk down to the promenade for a nice stroll or jog. We even had a braai on the rooftop of the building, where there’s a pool and amenities with the most magnificent views. The apartment is a good size for a family of four or two couples. I can’t think what else to mention other than I can’t wait to find a reason to return. We had a wonderful weekend. Thank you Terry and Heather!

We absolutely loved our Stay at Terry & Heathers property. The views to the comfortable home were amazing. It was such a welcoming oasis after two weeks of travel.
A big thumbs up from us!

I had the pleasure of staying at this Airbnb, and it was fantastic! The location was perfect—close to great attractions and local hotspots. The space was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The host was incredibly welcoming and responsive,
One highlight was the beautiful view from the balcony, which made mornings truly special. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a relaxing getaway. I hope to return soon!

The location of the place is fantastic with walking distance to V&A as well as Sea Point.
Check in was easy, and there was accommodation for bags on check out given our flight was late.
Comfortable beds are key, these were right up there.
place was clean, everything you need stocked and amenities available, the small things well thought of.
We really enjoyed staying there.

Terry’s is really a home away from home. She’s put a lot of thought into what she includes from the amenities, utensils and even soap for the washing machine. It’s welcoming , modern and aesthetically appealing.
She was a fantastic host, always responsive and full of great recommendations for exploring the area. This place truly exceeded our expectations, and we can’t wait to return! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Cape Town.
Good location. Second bedroom tad small and pelted by sun, hence quite hot. Responsive hosts. Overall a pleasant stay.

Terry's place was absolutley lovely, very modern and comfortable with great views.
The area is safe and has lots of food options in walking distance - Giovanni's deli is a must!
Definitely recommend staying here.

This is a great, comfortable apartment in a great central location. There are a number of great restaurants around and Heather had some great recommendations.
If you have any business in or near the stadium, I would highly recommend this spot.

Terry has gone above and beyond as a host, making us feel right at home. Her place is spotless and pristine. In addition to the gorgeous designer details in the apartment, all the extra touches have not gone unnoticed. Thank you so much for making us feel welcome in Cape Town!

We had an enjoyable stay, it was very comfortable especially the beds. The apartment is very light and has great views and is in a good area with a park opposite which you can walk through to get to the coast. We found it very central to drive to various locations. It is nice and quiet too, great having a safe carpark as well. Wouldn’t hesitate staying again.
I booked Terry’s place for my in laws for 5 days. They absolutely loved it. Communication with Terry was great, with an easy check in. Location superb. They loved their stay in the apartment.
Really nice place with all the required to enjoy a stay. The view is amazing and our host is very kind and helpfull.
Fantastic, beautiful location with a view of the ocean and everything needed to make yourself at home. The house was super clean and Tina (hosting us) was very responsive and helpful.
We had a wonderful stay at Tina’s place! Beautiful view and everything you need for a comfortable stay!

We truly had an amazing stay. The property was beautiful and clean and right on the beach. Check in and check out was seamless and Tina was so helpful and responsive. I’d definitely recommend this place and would come back for future visits!
Wonderful location close to the beach. Walking distance to shops and restaurants. Ideal for a family holiday. We hope to be back!

Aside from the parking that was quite expensive, we really enjoyed our stay. be careful at night as when you walk from vehicle to hotel there are a few homeless people that came up to us asking for money etc. the suite itself was very private, spacious and comfortable.  besides all of these i will definitely be staying here again. thank you so much for having us!
Ideally located if you need to be close to the CTICC. Comfortable, clean and safe.
Very clean, spacious room. Very minimal amenities, no shower / body wash or soap. Address drops you to location around the corner which was confusing late at night.
Good and nice location, The host was great, I will come back again thanks for the hospitality.
Nice place, it’s exactly like in the pictures only problem I had was with the fridge which wasn’t working.

We had the most beautiful time from the moment we walked in. We absolutely fell in love with this place.
Not only was it neat, and cozy, but it is well furnished. My best friend and I both spoke about how this should have been a longer stay, and that was our wish until we stepped out the door at check out time.
We absolutely look forward to our next visit and we would definitely recommend this accommodation to anyone who wants a peaceful, safe and central location to spend their time in Cape Town.
We are most grateful to have such responsive hosts who made sure we were happy with their property. 🥰
My client really loved the apartment especially its balcony. He said he doesn’t want to stay anywhere else besides there. Thank you so much for your hospitality.

Good stay, but here are a few things i was unhappy with
- the smell was extremely difficult to deal with.
- the sliding door leading to the balcony did not open
- the hair dryer was broken and burnt out
- my towel and bedsheets did not smell very good either
The place is beautiful, the host is responsive the area is quite..Such a beautiful place to chill.

The place was ok but the location was not easy to get to. The location is quite noisy.
It's close to a lot of amenities so I would recommend it for a night stay
The airbnb was clean and nice, the hallways and exterior areas could have been more kempt

I had a wonderful stay at Thembelihle! The place was exactly as described – clean, cozy, and well-equipped. The host was incredibly welcoming, always responsive, and made sure I had everything I needed. The location was perfect for exploring the area, with plenty of local attractions nearby. I felt right at home and appreciated the little touches that made the experience so special. Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for a peaceful, comfortable getaway!

Thanks for an incredible stay! The house is absolutely gorgeous, we loved all of the windows and natural lighting. The house is very spacious and comfortable and gorgeous, very fun for quality time with groups and loved ones. Annalena was very helpful and responsive. We will definitely be back! Thanks a lot!

Great location and beautiful house. A couple of frustrating things, but owners sorted things pretty quickly.
Very friendly and helpful host

The apartment is modern, spacious and very well equipped. The beds are extremely comfy and everything in the apartment is new and modern.
The office and UPS is very useful for anyone on a working holiday.
Fish Hoek is a lovely little town and the sandy beach is wonderful for families.
We enjoyed our stay.

Lovely clean and modern apartment with big spacious rooms and lots of natural light. Location in "downtown" Fish Hoek so a bit traffic noisy but mere minutes walk from the beach which was ideal for us with kids, also a very safe and family friendly area in general. The additional study/office came in very handy. Laurette was very pleasant, responsive and accommodating. We enjoyed our stay and can recommend it for a short stay.

We loved the interior of the apartment, with top-end appliances and fittings, beautifully decorated, neat and ordered.  I particularly appreciated the cleaning supplies not being locked away as they do in so many Air BnB's, so that if one wanted to wipe down the kitchen or run a load of laundry the supplies were available.  With the apartment being on the high street there is a lot of traffic and human noise, but that cannot be helped.  Access to the beach was awesome. Sweet little welcome packages supplied for the children and us. Overall a lovely stay.

Really great place. Lots of good restaurants nearby. Very close to the best part of the beach in fish Hoek. Good internet. Lots of towels. All mattresses are comfortable, even the bunk bed mattresses. Very responsive and helpful.
Great location and very well furnished accommodation. safe, peaceful and very close to the beach.  Awesome!

This is a great place.
- private and peaceful
- walkable distance to the beach
- very good amenities
- responsive host

This is a little gem of a home away from home.  Colleen and Mike were wonderful hosts - they were available when we needed them but left us alone to enjoy the place in peace and quiet.  The house is extremely clean, beautifully decorated and well fitted out with everything a person needs for a few nights.  Although there are no views, it is a mere 2 minutes drive to the beachfront and the mountain can be seen from most of the restaurants in the area (of which there are plenty).  We had a fantastic few days at the property and will go back there in a heartbeat.

Absolutely delightful stay! The charming decor, immaculate cleanliness, and thoughtful amenities made our experience exceptional. Both host's warm hospitality (being very accommodating with our Hilux) and helpful local tips added a personal touch that exceeded our expectations. The is an absolute gem and we can't wait to return to this cozy haven for another memorable getaway when we visit Cape Town in the near future. Thank you Colleen and Mike!
The unit was very clean and neat. Easy access from the garage and nice outdoor space. Everything worked well and we enjoyed our stay immensely.

Thabo’s place was clean and it felt cozy being there. The place itself is located very close to the beach, many coffee shops, and restaurants.
We had a lovely stay! Thank you so much for your responsiveness, kindness, and help with parking after the check out time! Really appreciate it :)
Thabo is a good host, however the place is not that great. It houses old people and has an old building.
The apartment is simple. Has everything you need. Thabo and his assistant were always available to help with any issues. Highly recommended.

For a studio flat it is reasonably cosy.  However the toilet seat was broken, perhaps the cleaner did not report this fact to the owner to have it fixed.  There were no towels fortunately  we had our own.  We arranged to return the key at 0600 but as nobody turned up we hid the key outside the door inside the flower pot and left a message..

This place really felt like home. The staff were really attentive and friendly, the communication both in app and on the ground was top notch. The place felt like my own. It was a clean, had all the amenities I needed. Next time I come back, I’d happily book with them again. Amazing service/accommodation.
Thank you so much!

Stayed for 2 nights. Felt safe and served its purpose. the apartment smelt a little of damp (possibly the bin cupboard needing deep cleaning). no flexibility on check in/check out time was a bit frustrating. overall thank you for a pleasant stay.
The place was nice and clean. The building positioned well and close to most of the things you need. Had no problems with anything and would book there again on my next trip. Kudos to you guys😊
The place didn’t have hot water and no one was willing to resolve the problem or atleast attend to our queries

Fantastic location and a seamless check-in process! The place was exactly as described, and we had a wonderful stay. The only minor hiccup was finding the property using the address provided on the Waze app—it was a bit tricky. I’d recommend using the actual building name instead for easier navigation. Other than that, everything was perfect. Highly recommend!

It was a great place to stay and had everything I needed.
This was located in the centre of the business I needed to see and easy for Uber to collect me as there was a pickup point next to the apartments.
I would highly recommend this place

The apartment was exactly what was advertised, everything you need for a business trip. I found the area very noisy at night with cars racing up an down the streets, no reflection on the accommodation.

Enjoyed my stay. It was close to a lot of cool places in town. Room was well designed and well maintained. Only hiccup was a delayed check-in due to them cleaning after the check-in time but other than that, it was really good.
Place has a considerable roach population. I have not seen cockroaches in any of the places I booked in until I got to this one. The place is cold and noisy too.

Loved this space and the hospitality of the hosts so much that I returned to spend an additional week!
Everything from the design of the space, the generosity of the hosts, to the prime location of the apartment exceeded my expectations.
I will certainly return again when back in Cape Town!

I had the best time at the SustainableStays apartment. The design is beautiful and everything you may need is available to you. It is very comfortable and clean. The team was proactive and communicated instructions clearly. I hope to be back soon!

We enjoyed our stay very much and had a fantastic time. The staff was very friendly, helpful and organized, which made the whole experience even better.
We would definitely come back one day and recommend it to everyone who wants to visit Cape Town.

We loved our stay in this apartment! It was super clean, great location in sea point, pool was lovely.
Terrance was amazing - helpful at check in, really clear instructions telling us where to park and about the safety of the local area. Terrance gave us advice about drinking water and safety when walking/ running when asked, and kept in touch with any issues throughout the stay.
The safety was great - facial recognition was excellent, as well as access to the apartment and parking garage.
The apartment was lovely, quite compact with everything you would need.

Overall good apartment and location. Check in and check out was very simple and easy.
Tips for improvement - more laundry tablets and need some cleaning products and cloths for cleaning tabletops etc.
loved the stay and rooms were spacious.

Very nice and clean place
Prepared very well
Nice guy was waiting for us.he gave us round
It’s a save neighbourhood u can come late and park u car in the garage in back ground
It just seem like smaller than the pictures
Other that u can go ahead and book

Laura Loft apartment, had a fresh modern appeal, it’s was very spacious and very well decorated with modern clean finishes. The bathroom was spotless, kitchen was neat and modern and had everything one would need. Walking distance to nice restaurants and pub in the village square. Could not recommend more and good value for money.

Laura was a wonderful kind host. I bumped into her beautiful family along my travels around the home and each one of them was warm and welcoming. The 2 cutest dogs come to say hello and settle you in for a homely stay. HUGE BONUS : NO LOADSHEDDING!
walking distance from the beach and the best coffee in town.
Can't wait to stay again!

The loft was cozy and chic with all the features of a little home away from home. Our stay was nothing but comfortable and Laura provided fantastic local restaurant recommendations. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

The Noordhoek Loft, is so peaceful and exactly where you want to be staying in the area. I loved walking out of the property every morning and being right in front of the commons, which is where all the local horses roam freely with the mountains overhead. Truly a remarkable location. I loved Noordhoek already, but after staying at the loft I love it even more. Laura took extra care to make sure I had some food the night I arrived (it was dark and windy), which was a really kind gesture. She was really lovely to talk to and the airbnb was clean and comfortable. Highly recommend.
Laura's place is quiet, comfortable and centrally located to all the great spots in Noordhoek.

We stayed at Laura's place for a quick weekend breakaway and it was perfect - neat as a pin, squeaky clean, peaceful and a fantastic location. We would love to visit again and stay for longer. I would highly recommend Laura's place if you're looking for a break from city life and want to enjoy the tranquillity and natural beauty of Noordhoek at its best.

My wifes stay at The Loft felt like a fairytale stay in a forested countryside.
Laura was very welcoming and warm and my wife felt safe and at home immediatly.

Loved our stay here. Great location for exploring Noordhoek. Plenty of food options nearby. Can walk to the farm village etc. Laura even went above and beyond when we were unable to get the induction job working she welcomed us into her home to make some brekkie. Would highly recommend staying here!
Laura's place is a great find. It is modern, clean with everything you need, and is located in a beautiful part of Noordhoek. Laura is a super host: very friendly and easy to communicate with.
We booked for one night but wished we had booked for more. Our short but wonderful stay at Laura's loft was so restful and replenishing. We will definitely be back - next time for longer.

My partner & I stayed with Marelé at her spot for a month. The space is so beautiful, peaceful and cozy. We felt so at home. The energy and space is calming and comfortable. The small kitchenette had everything we needed to cook in. This spot was perfect for our longer stay and we would not hesitate to stay again. Marelé was great with communication and even left us a beautiful welcome note & some pasta sauce on arrival. Safe, comfortable, clean & so peaceful. Highly recommend.

Marelé’s space was perfect for my stay! It provides everything one needs to be comfortable. The kitchen is equipped to cook a simple meal; there is a fridge, kettle, two plate stove/oven, crockery and cutlery etc.
One thing that might be important to consider is the parking spot inside is small and it takes a skilled driver to get into. 🙂 Although parking outside on the stress is safe for bigger cars.
Thank you!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this charming Airbnb, and I couldn't have asked for a better experience. From the moment I arrived, I felt like I was staying with a dear friends rather than just a host.
Marlené and John , truly goes above and beyond to make their guests feel welcome and comfortable. Their warm hospitality and genuine kindness made my stay memorable! They were always available to provide local tips, answer any questions, and ensure that I had everything I needed. It's rare to find a host who genuinely cares about their guests' well-being.
The location of the Airbnb is simply unbeatable. Situated in a vibrant and walkable part of Somerset West, I found myself within easy reach of numerous wineries and restaurants.
I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a delightful and convenient place to stay, coupled with the warmest hospitality from an exceptional hosts. :)
Lovely, comfortable room in a pretty area. It was very hot so appreciated the aircon! Would recommend.
We had a lovely time by Marelé. Quick and sweet response and Marelé also did some very nice recommendations for things to do nearby. A place we really recommend!
Thank you again Marele for opening up your home. Cute, simple room to stay the night. Little garden backyard. Felt safe. Perfect for a short-stay!

I stayed here for over a week after a trip through Africa. It was clean and had a the amenities I needed to regroup and relax. There are many restaurants, pubs and grocery stores in the neighbourhood within an easy walk..
At night, the neighbourhood can be a bit intimidating with street people and walking feels risky, but Ubers are plentiful and inexpensive.
Highly recommend staying at Hara’s! It was perfect for my stay and very clean. All essentials were provided and was centrally located to everything. Thanks for a great stay!

My stay hosted by Propr was wonderful. The apartment was clean and well equipped with everything necessary. Communication was prompt and clear and checking in and out was effortless. I would recommend and definitely visit again.

Had to wait in the lobby for a while for Check-in. The guy was upstairs apparently. Not communicated. Very small place, good for when you’re out all the time, but too small to work for example. Good location and lovely terrace at the top. The shower smelled like sewer most of the time unfortunately.

Had a great stay over the Easter weekend. Booked the 5 sleeper with everything on hand. The house is huge, clean and spacious. The hostess was welcoming, always available and accommodating. Felt like  home away from home.

Marna was lovely from before we even git there she kept checking on us.
Super friendly and very helpful.
We had a lovely stay.
She Lives on the property behind this one, but we were completely separate and undisturbed the whole time.
Thank you for a lovely stay!
I highly recommend this place! Also kid friendly.
Really beautiful :)

We had a wonderful time at the Apartment, it is equipped with everything we needed as a family of 4, great location above the deer park cafe with playground and a coffeeshop. Beautifully decorated, cozy spot and the hosts were super friendly and attentive.

a great place to stay in Cape Town. Judith was so friendly and helpful and the apartment was super clean and cosy. the apartment has everything you need and the environment is lovely. nice and quiet. there’s a lovely café downstairs and it’s walking distance to garden centre, a great shopping centre with lots of convenient stores. would totally recommend staying here and would definitely book again myself!

We only stayed for one night, but enjoyed our stay and the closeness of the restaurants and park.  Appreciated the basement parking and the lift with our luggage and a little one.  Highly recommend Deer Park Cafe.  We will stay here again :)

The place was great, we worked from there for a week. The internet was good for video calls and was not affected by loadshedding.
We felt safe at all times. And the coffee shop below is a real bonus! We will definitely book it again for our next trip 😃

We have been staying in Judiths place for one month and can say that’s a perfect apartment.
The equipment was amazing and quite new.
The host was responsible and communicated well.
I think its one of the safest places in Cape Town, we felt 100% safe.
It was also enough space even for 4 people.
Highly recommend!

Really loved our stay here and had everything we needed. We really enjoyed the location, being above two lovely coffee shops and walking distance to a beautiful park. Central and easy to get around Cape Town from this location. It felt safe and peaceful in this area. Quick tips for potential guests: if you are getting a rental vehicle, it is quite easy to scrape the bottom of your bumper when exiting the parking lot in a sedan, so be careful or consider parking in the street right in front of the building. Additionally, the sofa bed is not as comfortable as the bed, so if you will be using both be aware it may not be suitable for those with back problems.

So glad we found Judith’s place. It was the perfect first accommodation for our trip to South Africa. The coffee shop and restaurant (with a play park right beside it) was excellent, we went every day and the kids loved it.
Lovely family friendly area.
Thanks so much

The Mountain View, the centrality to shops, bistros and restaurants. Vredehoek is peaceful and beautiful and merely 5 minutes drive from the V& A. There is so much to do. When we are in Cape Town, we would love to stay at Judith‘s place again.
Judith’s exceeding our expectations. Pristine condition, host was so helpful and accommodating. Exactly like the picture. Amazing location 10/10. Everything was perfect. Thank u !!
Secure parking and conveniently situated in the City Bowl. Enjoyed our stay and would definitely book again.
Great host, very responsive and helpful.  His apartment is clean, cosy, and homely. The complex is peaceful and great security. He offered an electric blanket to keep me warm :-)

Fantastic stay, great location. Home away from home! Everything we needed and more! Extra, valuable touches like tea/coffee, sugar, milk, salt/pepper etc & chocchies. Safeera is a wonderful host, kept in touch from the get go and was always immediately available. We shall return!
Had a very nice stay at Safeera’s place, very nice apartment and the views were so beautiful.  The service and communication was good, I’m definitely going back again.
What a wonderful stay this was. Did not even want to leave and would most definitely come back!
Highly recommend this place as it’s cleanliness, location, and comfort were exactly what we were looking for.

Safeera was such a great host to us. We didn’t lack anything and if we did she acted almost immediately.

I do feel like there can be grace time like an hour or so, just to not make guests feel unwanted anymore and typically being kicked out. This could make someone change their mind next time. Just saying though. But generally, everything else about the stay was great.
Thank you Safeera for hosting us.

I had a great stay at Safeera's home. It was an easy walk to the Convention Centre plus quick access to the mall using the private bridge. The apartment was spacious and and nicely decorated. Work friendly too. Safeera communicated quickly and proactively.

Excellent experience at the venue. Hassle free, nicely decorated and excellent value for money. No impact from load shedding on the premises. Excellent proactive communication from the host, and easy to understand instructions on the check out.
Understanding and accommodating Housekeeper as well.
Well appointed unit, within walking distance to Canal Walk Mall. Very convenient, while host very informative and proactive. Highly recommended.
Very convenient central location and also easy to travel to nearby tourist attractions. We loved crossing the canal to the beautiful, spotlessly clean pool located centrally in the complex.
I will recommend Safeera as a host to anyone. Her response was prompt,and was always kind when dealing with her.I love the spaciousness of her space.

Safeer´s flat is spacious and has a beautiful garden. The location is great, next to the mall and restaurants and even the waterfront is only a short drive. We really liked our stay there. Will definitely come back. Thank you!.

The place was a great spot with kids! Central to the location and a mall within walking distance.
The host went out of her way to ensure a comfortable stay.

The place was dusty and the bathrooms had a bad smell which I think comes from the drains.
And Yacoob was very slow to respond as I contacted home before we checked in and I had no response what so ever and upon checkin when there was a problem with the stove as it was cracked, it took 2 days for him to respond which was less than ideal

One of the best accommodations in the CBD. We felt extremely safe, and the building had everything to offer: a rooftop terrace, pool, workspace, and superb views! The security staff was extremely helpful and friendly. The accommodation was spacious and exactly as depicted in the pictures. I will definitely come back again! Thank you :)

Would normally stay elsewhere in Cape town when I am there, but had an early meeting and glad I stayed here. Exactly as described,  no hassle, and the staff and people are friendly and supportive. The early morning views of table mountain and the city are worth getting up early for.
Thank you so much I had a great weekend experience at your apartment, the security team downstairs are great hosts thank you. You have a great team

Great place to stay in Cape Town. We loved the pool bar with great views.
Beds are really comfortable!
Will come again.

We really loved the place .  We had a late night out to celebrate my son’s birthday . We could not wake up the next morning We were allowed to check out an hour  later. My son and daughter in law just wanted to  go to the pool in the morning .  So the hour later check out was much appreciated .  Our bags were safely stored after check  out . We picked it  up at 3 on our way to the airport 👌🏿👌🏿👌🏿
The place was really amazing, clean and close to all amenities the staff at the building were very friendly and helpful. I highly recommend.
Gteat stay would definitely be back.Everything was very close and Walking distance from Bree street.Really nice time.

Perfectly acceptable and fine but considering what else is available in the area, definitely too expensive for what it is. However hosts were friendly and the listing was accurate to what you get. Apart from the price, the only real downside was the heat in the room, but a fan was provided which helped a bit.
I loved spending time in Maria’s beautiful space. She was so friendly and I am so excited for my next visit 💛

Maria’s place truly felt like a home away from home. She is an exceptional host, always friendly and welcoming. The price per night offers excellent value for money. The area is peaceful and quiet, with several charming cafes and bars nearby. Overall, I highly recommend staying here.

Maria's place is amazing.
The house is super comfortable and has everything you need for a long stay.
The neighborhood itself is very safe and you can walk freely in the streets nearby the house.
I definitely recommend this place.
Thanks Maria for everything 😊

Perfect apartment and stay, very clean,  comfortable, quiet, self sufficient apartment with beautiful views of Table Mountain. Very comfortable bed, great WiFi, I would have stayed again if it was available during my next stay.
Our stay was warm and welcoming. Super close to Kloof street which was walkable to the apartment. We felt right at home and didn’t want to leave

What a lovely home! I so enjoyed my time there. I appreciated having assistance at check-in.  Everything was as described. I felt so much peace there. Great location and amazing views. Also to note was super clean and had cleaning supplies if you want to do additional cleaning through out your stay. Loved it!

We can definitely recommend staying in this apartment. The location is great, we never felt unsafe and it has a lovely view on table mountain. It is possible to walk to bars/ restaurants but quite steep downhill. The balcony is towards the street, so sometimes it gets a bit loud due to traffic but with closed door no issue at all. The pool/ braai area is very clean and nice to use. The parking garage is well secured and has sufficient space/reserved parking.
Ocean View 503 was a great place to stay, amazing views and super comfortable.  Host was very friendly and welcoming. Easy check in and check out procedure.
Cecilia is the best I have never experienced love and warmth. The residence is very beautiful I hope to visit again 👌🏽⭐️🌟
it was great experience and we really enjoyed the place as it have all what family needed plus it was very clean and well designed and relaxed

We had a wonderful stay. The location is central - close to everything!
The view is absolutely incredible. The apartment had everything we needed.
It was also great to have an allocated, safe parking.
The place was great and within walking distances to near bye eating places. Overall i would highly recommend this place. It is as described plus more.

Loved our trip. We did escape the room, went on a sunset cruise. Sang karaoke at Bokeh karaoke bar and lounge. Bapiste rooftop pool bar and lounge in Camps bay's food was amazing. The apartment was beautiful and comfortable. The location was great!

"I can't say enough good things about our host Andrew! He’s  super attentive and made sure we had everything we needed. His  kindness and willingness to help with anything made our stay truly exceptional. A+ host!"

Shafieka and Lieza were great hostesses, very responsive, proactive and you could feel that they really cared that we would have the best stay possible 😊 The place is in a good location and has everything for a shorter/longer stay. And having a pool in the same floor, a great coffee place downstairs and a grocery shop and gym next you is very much a plus. Thanks for a lovely stay!
WONDERFUL PLACE AND HOST. Inverters should just be sorted out, but definitely worth the stay. Thank you Myles!

Shafieka is a great host, the house is super clean in a very good location 😚 it was a home away from home 😍 my kids were so happy with the house that they didn’t want to check out🥰 I highly recommend  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Lovely, peaceful and comfortable place. Very homely and warm.
We really enjoyed our time in there.

Shafieka's apartment was in a great location, with shops and cafes nearby, and walking distance to lots of the sights. She was very responsive and flexible especially around check in and check out times to accommodate our travel arrangements.
The flat was well equipped for cooking and relaxing, and we enjoyed the roof top swimming pool.
The flat is a little dated and could do with a bit of decoration and renovation, but for the price and location it was great.
Highly recommended.
Shafieka was very responsive. Building felt very safe and needed a key fob to get in and out of the elevator as well! Many doormen! Tons to do around the area. Greenmarket Square around the corner.
We had great time. The apartment is just what we needed.  It's perfect for a couples. Thank you again for an amazing week.
Super central and close to downtown and all the sights. Super friendly host. Extremely communicative and fast to responsive and helpful with recommendations. Great for 3 people.
Needs some refurbishment as looks tired.Sower in Main bathroom.had very poor water flow so had to use the other shower room

Overall, for this price the accomodation was ok. Nothing fancy, nothing special, but good value for money when you need 2 bedrooms. However, the showers were really bad. Hardly any water and 0 pressure. The apartment was not really clean. A lot of dust on the headboards of the bed. Walls were drained with humid. Overall the apartment could use an upgrade. But again, it is cheap. But a normal shower and dust-free for us is a must. Too bad!
The apartment was beautiful and centrally located which means you have easy access to a lot of cool places to check out, and the hosts were super responsive!
Super nice and spacious apartment with amazing roof top terrace and a private pool   We very much enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back when in Cape Town. Highly recommend!

What a gem of a place, the host and property it self was even better than described on the app.
Easy to check- in and the response time on the app was quick and easy. A great experience all round.

This property was absolutely delightful to stay in. Our hosts made sure to provide us with clear instructions throughout our stay. Everything was extremely seamless and enjoyable. The PH has everything you need for days so you wont run out of essentials. Location is great and neighbourhood is nice and feels safe. Also views are amazing. Id stay there again without a doubt.

Absolutely loved my stay at Nicholas and Nicole’s beautiful penthouse! The decor is stylish and tasteful, and the place was spotlessly clean. It actually looks even better than in the photos, with stunning views to enjoy. Nicholas and Nicole were fantastic hosts, and their communication was impeccable throughout my stay. Highly recommend!

Our stay at Nicole's apartment was incredibly gratifying.
The sea point area felt very safe and is close to several interesting places.
Nicole is an awesome host.
Her responses were quite timely and she made sure we were comfortable.
We got everything we needed and more.
The apartment is beautiful, easily accessible and well organized.
I will heartily recommend this apartment to anyone.
Looking forward to be back in some months.

Ten out of ten. The pictures doesn't do justice to this stunning apartment. One of the best Airbnb's i've been. We enjoyed every minute of our stay. The terrace with the views and the private pool is just amazing. Lot's of restaurants, bars and Shops and the Promenade are in walking distance. Will definitely come back and highly recommend this place!

We absolutely loved staying in Nicholas’ stunning penthouse apartment! We appreciate the flexible check in and check out and the excellent, always responsive communication. The apartment itself is really spacious and well laid out, like a luxury boutique hotel. We had everything we needed and really appreciated the shower gel, hair dryer, tea, coffee, milk and wine. We can highly recommend this stunning apartment and we will definitely be back!!

Besides the check in not being very smooth, this place is a steal. Close to everything nice bars and restaurants close by and great views as well.
I would stay here again. I just hope thye can improve the check-in process.

Awesome spot, really central , the pictures show exactly how the space is - really spacious. Great staff at the building too.
Chregan was great quick to respond and really accommodating.
Will definitely be back!
Loved every bit of this place. Pristine and beautiful. The hosts are amazing too. Will definitely be back again.
I had a wonderful stay. It is really value for money. Great location. Ive stayed at The Docklands many times and i always have a good time there. Its safe and peaceful.

Ridhwaan was a great host, and the apartment was perfect for us. Incredibly safe in a great location, and the security guards made it feel even more secure. Pool area was super, and apartment was as described in great condition, in contemporary style.

The host was super responsive and communicated well during my stay , I only had issues with the Wi-Fi I understand it was a weekend so sometimes these issues happen but overall I always enjoy dock land , looking forward to staying again

Koeberg Inn is a lovely apartment to stay in for our three week visit. It's just one street back from the pristine Melkbos beach, so very easy access. We loved walking to the restaurants and shops in town.
The apartment itself is very comfortable, spacious and clean. The pool is very clean and we used the bbq area every night as it was covered and very social.
All in all, we highly recommend Koeberg Inn because you will enjoy your stay.

Space is not as clean and modern as pictures suggest.  Big sliding doors are stained and need replacing.  Wifi did not work and property managers are highly disfunctional.  I liked the location but I would not stay again.  Huge space outside with no seating or dining area.
I must say, it's a very nice house. The books inside the house were even more beautiful.
Really loved the place. Had a few issues with Wi-Fi for the first few days it was sorted eventually. The terrace is amazing. Stunning views. Quiet area near lots of restaurants.

clean apartment
comfortable bed
parking was a bit tricky because it is not in the actual apartment building

Great place in a good part of town, with lots of cafes nearby and easy uber to Sea Point, Silo, etc

Overall it’s an awesome place, the team was fast and easy to talk to, and I’d book it again in a heartbeat.

Very comfortable apartment in amazing location. Few steps from many nice restaurants and shops, very close to the beach.
Apartments has also great view.
Big advantage is also a private parking spot.
I also have to mention about extremely comfortable mattresses in both bedrooms.
We slept like babies.
Coming back to Cape Town we would definitely stay in Carla’s apartment again.

I loved my stay here, it was so central and close to all my favourite places, a road away from the promenade and my favourite is how sound proof the windows are. I am so claustrophobic and i loved how open and light the place was. I also loooved how low maintenance the check in and out was too. Such a great stay 😍

Lovely stay in a lovely apartment right in the heart of Cape Town. Ocean view. Steps away from beach promenande. Chic shops and restaurants right downstairs. Apartment was just as chic as the neighborhood. All around great stay

Firstly, Carla allowed me to book the place and allowed me to check in within 1.5 hours. This was incredibly helpful as I had been disappointed on arrival with another separate accomodation I had booked from another person. I decided on arrival it was not up to standard and that I needed to find new accomodation. I then booked Carla's place. She let me check in within an hour and a half and rescued my entire holiday. The place was amazing, clean, as advertised, really well appointed apartment. Check in was seamless. Carla allowed me to extend without issue when I wanted to extend my stay. Carla was responsive when I had questions. I will definitely use this exact accomodation next time I am in Cape Town. Absolute Recommend!

Checked out and all good. It was a nice, clean and cozy stay. The host agent Yudi was superb, very communicative and met us for check in on time. He also offered to meet us for check out but we checked out early. Great hospitality by these agents. Made.for a wonderful stay and the location was amazing, both from a view and access to the beach, and close to our store making Uber cheap and easy.    THANK YOU YUDI
My father spent some time here and he found it perfect for his trip. It is in a very nice location and perfectly safe. Had everything he needed.
A really great space in a peaceful leafy neighbourhood that is safe and conveniently situated. Jacques is a great host and every effort was made to ensure my comfort during my stay. Recommended!

Robin was an exceptional host, making the check-in process seamless and stress-free. The apartment is beautifully designed, offering both style and comfort, and the location is incredibly convenient. I highly recommend staying here.
The host were very accommodating and welcoming. The place was clean and it is literally a home away from home. The place  was safe and secure and easily accessible. Will definitely be coming back.

A unit in a great location with beautiful views and every amenity required.
I look forward to my next stay.

Had a fantastic stay. View and accomodation was perfect.
Will be back.

One of the best places i ever been to
Although it was last minute booking, everything was ready and clean and response was super fast
Definitely one of the best
Bianca the manager was extremely helpful and friendly
Its 5 star place for me and definitely will recommend to friends and family

We had a wonderful stay! The host was amazing and always responded quickly to our messages. The place was very clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. We truly enjoyed our holiday and would definitely recommend it to others

We really enjoyed our stay. The unit is very neat and clean. It is also equipped with everything one could need for your stay. The hosts really went out of their way to make our stay very comfortable. Highly recommended. We would definitely love to visit again.

Dear host, my stay at Beach Retreat was nothing short of extraordinary! The seamless professionalism of the hosts is created an atmosphere that felt like a personalized haven. The opulent apartment not only exuded luxury but also provided a secure and lavish escape. Its prime location, just steps away from a breathtaking beach, elevated the experience to sheer magnificence. With the added convenience of being within walking distance to all amenities, this stay surpassed all expectations. Thank you for orchestrating a truly spectacular retreat!

an ideal place to stay if you want to be in the Strand, Gordons' Bay area  with easy access to Somerset West and Stellenbosck. Waking up with a sea view, and a stroll next to the sea will set you up for a productive day. Grocery store, restaurants and coffee shops are waling distance.

It was a lovely stay. Such a cute apartment, perfect position in the city. Everything was close, it was cozy, perfect for a solo traveller like me or a couple.
Loved the interior, it has great and fair amount of space for a 1 bedroom place. Also LOTS cupboard space which was lovely for a girl like me who loves to unpack her life into Airbnbs
Jayde, you’re an absolute star. I will definitely be coming back.

Had a lovely stay. Check in was an absolute breeze. Jayde was very warm and responsive throughout my stay.
The place itself is an absolute gem, very cozy and welcoming. Felt right at home the moment I set foot through the door!
Definitely my go-to accommodation next time I'm in Cape Town.

Great stay, cozy, and good value for money. I wish there was allocated parking within the building for added peace of mind as you are not guaranteed parking on the street. Other than that, we had a lovely time.

We had such a lovely stay and will definitely be back😁 The place is exactly like the photos and is in a perfect location.  The coffee machine was a bonus and we were extremely grateful that Jayde had 2 complementary pods waiting  for us🙏🏾
The apartment is very comfortable, looks like the pictures. The location is very good, just a couple minutes walking from most bars and restaurants in Kloof St, Long St and Bree St.

Had a lovely stay at Jayde’s place

Replies on time.
Great location to move around as Uber pricing isn’t bad.
Highly recommend this place.

Outstanding location, steps from Salt one of the best places in Kalk Bay. Surprisingly wasn’t too hard to find a place to park on Windsor most of the time. Also a few minutes walk from the train station. Very central but no real street noise or anything like that even at peak times.
Apartment is conveniently laid out with two decent-sized bedrooms with storage. Almost every amenity one could imagine, and extremely well and generously outfitted by hosts for a long-term stay. We were able to easily cook meals although of course Kalk Bay has a lot of options for eating out as well.
Modest payment for outstanding weekly cleaning during a longer term stay. We had one small hiccup caused by local utilities (not fault of host or unit), and host was very responsive and accommodating.
We had an amazing stay. Her place is immaculate. Great location. We will definitely be booking when we come back to Summerset West.
Had a great stay, room was perfect and extremely neat and clean. Barbara was a great host and check-in was super easy. Will definitely stay again next time I’m in town.

We enjoyed our stay at Barbara's place. It was as described, clean and peaceful. We enjoyed our drinks outside under the trees in the evenings during our stay. Thank for being responsive and also organizing the steamer for us.
Will definitely visit again
Nice location, great kitchen, cozy living room and a good pool. We enjoyed our stay very much!
Great apartment within walking distance for Camps Bay, children loved the pool. Very responsive host. Thanks so much

We had a lovely stay here. Location is absolutely perfect; only minutes walking distance from the beach. A plunge in the pool was very satisfying when coming ‘home’ after a long, hot day of exploring beautiful Cape Town.
The apartment was simple, clean and had a nice cozy atmosphere making you feel right at home. Few points of improvement in our eyes: the master bedroom bed was quite small, the curtains did not really block light well, and there was no back up for load shedding (only wifi).
Other then that, we would definitely recommend this place.

We had an amazing stay in Cape Town at Charmaine’s flat. It was impeccably clean and we felt right at home with everything we needed.
Amazing roof garden with epic views of V&A and Table Mountain - even better to be able to look back at the mountain you just climbed with some of South Africa’s best breakfast wine (Waterford Rose-Mary rose 👌🏻).
Really well located for doing anything in Cape Town and beyond. Ubers were really quick, easy to use and exceptional value for money to take you anywhere you needed (CBD, Stellenbosch, Kalk Bay etc.).
Thank you Charmaine for being such a great host and very responsive.

Charmaine was amazing every step of the way. The apartment is well located and easy to get to local restaurants and the V&A Waterfront. We felt safe all the time.
The pool and entertainment area was private with awesome views of Table Mountain and the waterfront area.
We will definitely stay here again.
The place was spacious for 2 people, quiet and a nice walk to all the beautiful beaches and great restaurants of Camps Bay. It felt very safe. We enjoyed a nice relaxing afternoon at the pool.

We throughly enjoyed our stay at Fred’s place. Nick was helpful with check-in and queries during our stay. A superb, fresh and airy house, great proximity to shops and restaurants and secure parking. Highly recommend !

The apartment is spacious, beautifully designed, spotless, and fully equipped with everything you need. It’s also close to the Conference Centre, perfect for business travelers. Charmaine, the landlord, was incredibly helpful—she accommodated me on a Sunday evening within an hour of reaching out and continued to be fantastic throughout the week. She was always responsive and available, almost 24/7, if we needed any advice. Truly an exceptional host! Charmaine, you are the Best!

Thanks Charmaine for being a super host and allowing me to stay at your lovely place. The apartment is gorgeous and I thoroughly enjoyed spending time upstairs by the pool area. I would definitely love to visit the place again.

We were blown away by the views that Richard’s place had to offer. Falling asleep to the twinkling lights across the water was so peaceful. The bed and linen was notably comfortable and Richard makes a clear effort for his guests.

Space is private and quiet ♥️ so happy we chose them!

Great stay! Awesome location for shopping and getting a feel of the area. Really friendly and understanding host.
Host quickly acted on what we requested.
Be careful with the indoor shower. There's a really nice outdoor shower and toilet which was a bonus especially with the heat of summer. The house remained cool though.
It was nice overall. Having an awesome host like Retha goes a very very long way.

Thank you Norah for hosting us! We enjoyed our stay. Great location, very clean, slept comfortably.
Thank you for the treats and water! Will definitely come back in the future.

I highly recommend staying with Karen and Tracy!
To live by the ocean, what else can you dream of!?
Quiet and cozy area, close to the beach and many cafes. The apartment is completely as in the photographs, it has absolutely everything you need. There is also a swimming pool, brai area and laundry on site.
Thank you very much for having us!

I had an excellent stay at Karins place. Host was exceptionally helpful, proactive, and friendly. The property was in a pristine condition. A true home away from home. Everything available at your fingertips for use.
Well thought through consideration for her guests. Neighbour freiendly and respectful of each other.
Loved the Karin's place. Highly recommended.

Great place! Hosts were super friendly and helpful with local suggestions for surf and beaches and food/drinks/music and and and🙌🏼we used the bikes most days and rode the cost for miles checking out all the beaches, local shops, coffee shops and restaurants from muiz - simon’s town. Places to check out:
James Town stretch for quieter beach and water temperature in summer is a tad warmer.
Hiking; Silvermine Gate 2 (Left trail) killer views of both bigger mountains and the ocean. Beautiful scenery as far as the eye can see, rock formations and their shear size is incredible.
Foodies: Lighthouse dinner, Minari Korean Kitchen lunch, Hang Ten Cafe, Vietnamese Street Kitchen all are great!!
Cheers enjoy🤙🏼

The flat was beautiful, comfortable and neat and located close to main amenities in Muizenberg. Tracey was very reaponsive and let us know about local activities to do in the area. Although not directly on the beach it was close to everything within driving range. Highly reccomended.

Wa-Iz and his whole family are amazing hosts. They make you feel right at home. I requested an early check-in and a late checkout, and Wa-Iz did not have a problem with both. He accommodated our needs throughout our stay and went above and beyond. At some point, I needed a charger for my phone, and his daughter looked for one that I could use. I was so surprised by their hospitality.
The unit was nice and clean, exactly as advertised on Airbnb. It had everything you could possibly need, including toothpaste.
The pool area is a bonus.
Roland was extremely responsive and accommodating. The place was even better than expected, and the location was perfect. We really enjoyed our stay!
We’ve had a lovely stay, enjoyed Camps Bay. Roland made us feel at ease within the first minutes, definitely coming back!

We stayed in this place for about a week. Working remotely on weekdays and exploring cape town on weekends. Everything worked great and we had a good time at Roland's. Roland was incredibly quick and efficient in his communication and everything went smoothly. We especially appreciate the help with getting some laundry done.
This flat is a gem. Clean and bright, ocean view, five minute walk to St James beach. We are huge fans of the Kalk Bay area and lived our stay. Highly recommend.

We absolutely loved Nic’s place. It is very clean and is everything the pictures promise and more. The view is amazing. There are plenty of restaurants and coffee places around the corner. The communication with Nic was very good. And on top off all that there is a perfect espresso machine. We would definately go back here the next time we are in CT!

My family and I had an amazing time in Nics accommodation. Had amazing views of the CBD as well as Table Mountain . Some unbelievable sunsets while we were in the hottub on the deck and overall really close to everything.

We had an absolutely fantastic time staying at Cosy Beach Cottage. From start to finish, everything exceeded our expectations.
The communication with our host was smooth and prompt, making the booking progress hassle-free.
Upon arrival, we were warmly greeted and given a thorough tour of the property. The space was immaculately clean and beautifully decorated, providing a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. The amenities provided were top-notch. Ensuring that we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
The location was perfect, we could make use of Uber Eats & Mr. D. We went for walks to the Beach!!
Overall, our experience was nothing but amazing 💯💯 We highly recommend Demi & Renier's property.
Thank you for a memorable stay____we will definitely be back!!

I had a wonderful stay at Cosy Beach Cottage in Strand! The hosts, Demi and Renier, were incredibly helpful, accommodating, and kind.
The cottage itself was lovely — neat, well-equipped, and perfectly located. As a solo traveler, I had everything I needed. It was just a short stroll to the beach, close to fantastic restaurants, and only a quick drive to the shopping center.
Thank you, Demi and Renier, for being such gracious hosts. Wishing you all the best and may your accommodation continue to be blessed.

Great place and hosts. Has everything you need for a comfortable  stay. Walking distance to the  beachfront  with all the lovely restaurants  and long walks along the beachfront  with spectacular  views.

One of the most wholesome stays! The place is newly renovated yet very cozy. Nafisa was an incredible host, if i asked for anything, she was super responsive, and the atmosphere was exactly what we needed. Thank you for a special stay!
loved the place,Nafisa is very friendly,.loved the place it was very close to cavendish,i can see myself staying one more time.
We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was great, in a beautiful and quiet location where we felt very safe. Nafisa was super friendly and gave us great recommendations. Highly recommend!😊

We were three sisters looking for a relaxed place to catch up, see some sights and wine and dine. Inga's place is in a great location for this while still exuding a super relaxing atmosphere, the surrounding area is quiet and peaceful. We could walk to the beach and some restaurants. Inga was a lovely host and communicated clearly. We will hopefully be back again one day!

This is the second time I have booked with Brett and Hendry and the first experience was so amazing that I had to get hold of them again for my next trip. We booked via airbnb and the pictures don't do justice to how stunning the unit was. Once booked I receive confirmation and things to do in and around Cape Town, key pick up is effortless, the unit was immaculate from brand new fresh towels to sufficient cutlery and crockery. They have prompt responses if we had any queries and communication was effortless. They are very accommodating for early checkin if possible and late check outs if there isn't another guest arriving, we always tend to extent our stay because we are always happy. We have small kids and this unit is perfect for families as well. We highly recommend any unit Brett and Hendry list as we trust it will be amazing.
We really enjoyed our stay at Brett's apartment. The house was clean at convenient location.. I'd highly recommend the apartment to anyone visiting Capetown. Value for money too 💯

This is the perfect stay, my family and i loved every moment here. Beautiful views, and the place was clean. The hosts responded to any queries we had in a timely manner. Close to cape town central and that made everything so much better . Everything was a 10/10, only issue was there was a problem with hot water here and there, however it was a building issue not the actual apartment itself , which the hosts communicated effectively about.
An amazing, beautiful apartment to stay in ❤️

The view is beautiful and Brett and Henry are super host……
The only inconvenient was the packing place in front of the back ont

Absolutely stunning apartment, beautiful views... of Table Mountain, hot water, great shower, fast Wi-Fi. The kitchen was amazing, everything you could need, like you would have at home, although we didn't use anything, it was definitely something that stood out. We will be back in a heartbeat. Close to shopping centers, beach and restaurants. A quick drive to the city or to Blouberg. The location is just perfect. Quiet neighbourhood, no one hassling you trying to sell stuff or beg. Safe basement parking and an elevator (when you have a lot to carry up). Will highly recommend Brett's place.
Well accommodated, great views and host overall. We had all the essentials and it is near a shopping centre which was quite convenient. The place was clean and the check-in process was seamless.

This Airbnb was a wonderful experience! I definitely recommend a stay there. It was clean, cozy, very well furnished with everything you could need, and it has a beautiful view. Brett and Henry were also very helpful and available. It was in a very convenient location, near the shops, and not far from the many attractions Cape Town has to offer!

Our stay with you was truly amazing. From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. The apartment was clean, the rooms were comfortable, and the first impression was stunning. The view was incredible, and having private parking was a big plus.
Everything we needed was nearby: supermarkets, restaurants, and all essential services. The city center was just 10 to 15 minutes away, which made everything even more convenient.
Honestly, if we had known how perfect this place was, we would have booked it for our entire trip from the beginning. Thank you so much for the great hospitality!

Ian was the perfect host.
The apartment is as advertised in the pictures and even better!
Great central location and very friendly staff.
Highly recommended and Ian, 5 stars!
See you soon!

Very nice apartment in a good area. Unfortunately, the check-in wasn't so smooth as room wasn't ready by the stated check-in time.
Otherwise, we had a great stay.

Ian's apartment is lovely and very clean. I liked the kitchen with the utensils I needed for cooking. Ian is also a very responsive host, he agreed to a change of dates when I booked the wrong dates in error. I would love to come back when I visit Cape Town
Nice studio to stay a short time. Small for two people with lots of luggage for a long trip, but a short stay its perfect
I had a great stay. The apartment had all I needed and I felt safe. Building staff were super friendly and helpful too. Comfy bed! And great coffee shops right outside the building.

Wonderful apartment. Comfortable with all the essentials. Very clean and safe. Great central location in Sea-point. Great host and easy check-in.
I would highly recommend.

The apartment has a central location but facing away from the main road so relatively quiet but with open window you still hear the construction work which has currently just started so will probably be going for a while.
Everything (super market coffee shops, restaurants, beautiful beach promenade) in walking distance.
The apartment is small but very smartly designed. It really has all you need.
Big disappointment was the portable cooler which did not cool at all. If it is hot outside it gets very fast hot inside (29 degrees!). It is basically a fan.
Safe building with security. Very friendly staff.
Ian was very responsive and helped where he could.

I really enjoyed my stay at One Two Six, JP and Wonder were very friendly and helpful at reception and were able to let me check in early. Having been staying in a place with no aircon or blackout blinds this was such a welcome cool dark haven to get some good sleep. The power point enabled me to continue working while power shedding happened too. You served all my needs, thank you!

Colleen and her husband are the best hosts ever. I truly felt at home and they were very helpful.
I would truly recommend their Cozy Garden Cottage.
Really nice feel-at-home place. Felt like in my own apartment. But most importantly: Colleen and Graham are super friendly and welcoming. Definitely highly recommended.
Colleen hosted my cousin and it was such a beautiful experience and my cousin is having to extend her stay as a result and she’s so very helpful. Rare find honestly

We recently had the pleasure of staying at this incredible place in CapeTown, and it was one of the best experiences we have ever had!
From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with warmth and kindness by the hosts family, who truly made me feel at home. Their hospitality was unmatched, and they went above and beyond to ensure my stay was perfect.
The space itself is fantastic. The comfortable bed and thoughtful amenities made for restful nights and enjoyable mornings.
If you're looking for a delightful getaway with thoughtful hosts who go above and beyond, this is the place for you!
Thank you for an unforgettable experience!

What a wonderful place. The attention to detail was amazing - we had everything we needed and more. The apartment was a lovely space - light, airy and a perfect size. We will definitely be back - time and again

Had an amazing stay! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, making check-in and communication super easy. Great location with everything we needed nearby. Would definitely stay again!

What a wonderful stay!  Wendy was a super host, her communication and attention to detail was excellent.  The flat was tastefully decorated with thoughful items e.g. coffee, tea, rusks, milk, juice, bathroom neccesities left for use. The close proximity to the Strand beachfront meant lovely, long morning and evening walks. The added bonus of a braai room equipped with braai grids and firewood was an added bonus. All in all a place worth recommending.

I felt right at home, Brett is a kind and uncomplicated soul. Malik (my dog) was more than welcome and allowed to run around freely. The place is also close to the beach. We can definitely recommend to stay there if you get the chance 😊
I had an amazing stay here the host Brett is super friendly and helpful with advice on places to go. 😊

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Johan’s place. It’s great that we could enjoy our breakfast on the balcony before we headed out for the day. Lovely view from the apartment. The place was clean and had all the necessary amenities. Couldn’t find the parking at first but Johan was quick to respond with clear directions.
Highly recommended! I wouldn’t mind staying here again if I ever go back to Cape Town.
We enjoyed our stay. The unit was exactly as we expected. The area was pleasant and not far from the beach. We were able to settle in and enjoy ourselves. Thank you for your hospitality.
lovely apartment,  very comfortable. although it is not very spacious and the air Ventilation is very noisy and not adjustable.

Hey Jonathan,
Thank you so much for accommodating us. We really had a great weekend, no complains 😄 your place is very beautiful, clean and convenient. Million thanks 🙏🏽
It’s like you were just one phone call away, your communication was on another level 💯. Definitely coming back soon 🤗 I certainly refer and recommend

great place to stay. very modern and clean. it was very windy when we stayed so it was quite loud at night but not the apartments fault it was windy. easy to get in and out. myciti bus stop right around the corner.

Booked this gem last minute for my partner’s  birthday celebration. We loved it easy access to the restaurants, waterfront, sea point and to long street for those who want to enjoy some night life. We are definitely coming again.
The house is well equipped, very comfortable and well secured. It is also found in a very peaceful neighbourhood. Definitely worth the stay for 2 persons. Thank you.

Dorothy was very welcoming and the place was just as expected. Dorothy even added a working desk for me as I'd mentioned I'd need to be working while there.
I will definitely stay there next time I'm visiting the area.
Stunning little place with beautiful views. Just a short walk from some great restaurants. Stephan was a pleasure to deal with.

Stephan's place was very nice and super convenient. it was safe and had plenty of restaurants and amenities with a huge mall across the road too. I had a bit of trouble finding the place and with the WiFi, and energy meters which ran out while I was staying. But these were small things and I enjoyed my stay, and would stay again! Thanks to Stephan!

Hannes was kind, caring and helpful and willing to go the extra mile.
Indeed a place of peace.
Felt right at home. Hannes is so kind and friendly and so helpful. Would definitely recommend. Exactly what the listing describes. Home was also very clean. Thank you Hannes
My stay here was pleasant and comfortable! Hannes is a man with a big heart! Unfortunately it was a short stay and I would definitely come back if possible. See you again
Hannes is an attentive host. Interesting to chat with and extremely helpful. Offered to take me to my function when Bolt did not arrive for my pickup (25km’s away) Highly recommend.

Hannes was very hospitable. I also arrived with a fairly large vehicle which he helped me navigate out of the garden parking in the mornings before work. Very clean and the pictures match the venue. Love the way he and his friends are trying to build up the community.

Hannes is an excellent host. He is friendly and kind and always made sure i had everything i needed. He even drove me to a market and showed me around a bit. He also lent me maps that a guest had left.
Hannes is an amazing host, always responsive, kind-hearted, and very accommodating! The place does feel like an old homestead with its quirks.

This place felt like home, warm, cozy, quiet and peaceful, friendly house mates. The hospitality was great, Hannes is an amazing host, I wouldn't mind booking again the next time I'm in Cape Town. I definitely recommend him.

Thoroughly enjoyed my stay,  if quirky, in the best possible way, is what you're looking for then you've hit the sweet spot. Hannes accommodated late check in and was most helpful, giving me a lift into CBD in the morning to organise Bus Card - always fancied a look around Woodstock and you're bang in the middle. Will stay again.

Staying at Hannes' place was one of the best decision that I took in my life. Top hospitality, great maintainance, always asking for coffee and food, has a cute cat Oscar and I can go on.
Without even a second thought, book this place! You'll love it!

I always feel at home when I am at Hannes place. What a gentleman, what a peaceful person.
Keep it Hannes.

Juan & Lauren’s place was surrounded by beautiful views. The outdoor area was stunning especially during sunset. The space was clean and modern. Juan was very helpful and accommodating with everything that we needed. They had clearly thought of the small things and provided many useful items to get started which was much appreciated. Overall a lovely stay!
Perfect place for a short stay in Cape Town.  Everything you need is right there.  Great views, too!

We really loved the apartment and enjoyed beautiful views of Table Mountain, Lionhead, Signal Hill and the whole city. The host, Juan, went out of his way to make our stay enjoyable and hassle-free. Will defiantly add the apartment to my top ten places to stay in Cape Town.

Nice quiet spot in Deer Park above a few cafes with easy access to the city. The place is great- comfortable and easy to enter/exit.  Two parking spaces makes it nice for guests. Juan & L were super easy going and flexible - very nice host who knows the business well.  Will be back!
Juan was a FANTASTIC host and we absolutely loved his place. Juan is amazingly friendly, kind and just had an amazing experience with him. Thank you so much!

Unbelievable views. Very well set up kitchen. 2 restaurants in same building with great food and great vibe. Area felt safe. Park outside for kids was great. Building security is very good and parking is safe in a basement with lift to unit which is awesome.

“The place was spotless and had everything we needed. The host was wonderful, always in touch with us and very helpful. The view was absolutely stunning, overlooking Table Mountain and Lion’s Head. I will definitely come back again
Beautiful,  clean and cozy space with thoughtful touches. Thoroughly enjoyed my short stay, the host was super friendly and responsive too.

Nice place to stay, quiet, safe, nice area and walking distance of cafes and the beach etc. Outside space was also a bonus but needs a bit of cutting back near the washing lone area and patio itself needs some tidying up. Great stay overall though :-)
Great location and very nice apartment. Outside patio has lovely view of the ocean and nice braai.

We had a great time staying here. It was very clean, and very comfortable. The place is inset from the road which made it nice and quiet. The tidal pools across the road were a bonus! It's everything you need for a comfortable little home while exploring Cape Town.
Communication with Lu Cherry and colleagues was responsive, friendly, and helpful, which made the admin side very easy.
