We had a great stay. The apartment has everything you need. The patio is great for relaxing too. It is situated perfectly close to beaches and the beautiful village of Kalk Bay. Quick walks to all but still a super peaceful location. Falling asleep to the sound of the waves was bliss.
Highly recommend. Thank you for a lovely stay.

Shumi was the greatest host ever that I’ve had
Her communication was accurate always responding the place my word beautiful spotless the first place we had no issues with
And the kind heart she has the house had everything and more than expected
Shumi is the Best ever
Thank you so much ♥️♥️

We had an absolutely wonderful week. The place had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, from a fully equipped kitchen to a relaxing living area. Shumi was incredibly responsive and went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable.
Overall, I would definitely return if I'm in the area again. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great experience

A home away from home.  My family and I did not want to leave. Her house felt like home. She had everything available for a summer home. It’s safe and she is very friendly by nature. I 100% would recommend anyone to stay with her. We truly appreciate the safety and comfort you gave us. God bless you

The house is very beautiful and the warn welcome received from the host was very nice.
The house is clean with well setup bedrooms. Additional items in the kitchen were very much helpful. This house is a perfect getaway when you just want to relax with with family.
Board games were available to enjoy during family time, swimming pool always clean even though we didn't have time to use it.
I'll gladly come back to this house again

Belinda was an amazing host, super friendly and flexible with the check-in and check-out times due to our late flights. She even surprised us with the most thoughtful welcome basket of snacks, fruits, goodies for our toddler and a few yummy essentials in the fridge as well. The place is stunning, the photos do not do it justice. It is in a very safe and lovely suburb, right across from a big park for kids, safe to walk. Close to shops and amenities and a +-25 minute drive from multiple beaches. This is the best Airbnb experience we have ever had and cannot recommend this place or Belinda more. There was even a teddy placed in the cot for our son. This truly is a home away from home and has everything you could possibly need.

We had a lovely stay!  So easy to access both the surfing at Muizenburg and the small village of Kalk Bay (which is only 3 minutes by foot).  The place was well stocked and Lu was quite attentive.  Highly recommend and would stay here again.
Lovely place, such a convenient location, great host. Even had water delivered when there was no water in the area for the day.

A great convenient place to stay. Clean and comfortable with all comforts considered, such as a heater , washing machine, and hairdryer. Norman was a great handyman ready to help with heavy bags, and sorting issues. Easy to get to my early sea swims from here too. Thank you for a great place.

We recently stayed and the place is stunning, good views, decent sized bedrooms, good closet space and very well equipped kitchen. Lu Cherry and her team were very responsive with their communication and very courteous. I only rated the overall stay as a 3 just because we were without water for a couple days due to repairs in the complex which did put a bit of a downer on our stay but if that were never to happen, it would have been a 5 stars. The timing of the maintenance was not ideal but I would still highly recommend this place.
Lovely neat compact  flat, walk out to restaurants and shops very close by, including the tidal pool for early morning dips :)  Enjoyed our stay
A beautiful and peaceful place indeed. I am looking forward to staying there again on my next visit to Cape Town.

Great place in the perfect location for visiting the city. A short Uber ride to the V&A (but we also walked in 20 min!) and the market which is always fun.
The flat is perfect, spacious and with everything you might need for a short stay. The view of the mountain from your bed is incredible!
We also went to the pool on the top floor, amazing views and a great spot to work from …with your feet in the pool ;-)
My favourite part was how friendly everyone is, especially Chum, the owner of the coffee shop on the ground floor.
This really was the perfect stay, in the perfect flat. We’ll be back.

Our stay at Nadine's place exceeded all expectations. If you're looking to experience Cape Town in style, this is the place to be. The breathtaking view from the accommodation is unparalleled, offering a picturesque backdrop to your stay.
One aspect that truly stood out was the exceptional treatment of our furry friend. Nadine goes above and beyond to ensure that your pet feels just as pampered as you do. With their own bed, buckets, and an abundance of treats, our dog was in doggy heaven throughout our stay.
We are immensely grateful to Nadine for her warm hospitality and for helping us create beautiful memories during our time in Cape Town. Our experience at Nadine's place was nothing short of perfect, and we can't wait to return for another unforgettable stay.
Good location , best service , amazing host always ask if I need something , my stay was 5 star I will definitely stay here over and over very small but has everything you need .

I had a wonderful stay at One Two Six. The place was clean, comfortable and homely.
The famous sea point promenade is just a short walk away. The area has such a great variety of restaurants which are easily accessible.
The host, Tinago was so helpful, friendly and informative. He gave great recommendations on places to visit. I would definitely stay at One Two Six again!

I had a lovely time staying here. Amazing airbnb with lots of space, felt right at home. I was welcomed by Debbie who was kind and friendly.
Its a very spacious one bedroom townhouse with no shared internal spaces. Everything (Bedroom, Bathroom, Kitchen, Lounges, Balcony) is just for you and your group. Its a beautiful place and the views from the balcony are stunning
Place was clean and kitchen had everything you'd need to cook up a storm. Wifi worked brilliantly. Balcony was lovely to hang out after a long day. The area is very safe including at night time.
Location is 10/10. Five minutes walk to the beach, shops and restaurant. And the restaurant precint is very lively. I did not need a car, Uber was easy to use.
Debbie, Shane and family, thanks for the great hospitality
Great stay! The place was bigger than it looked in the photos and the view from the balcony was beautiful! Great location next to restaurants and beach as well.

This place was absolutely perfect! It was walkable to Camps Bay Beach and all of the restaurants and a short Uber away from anywhere else I wanted to go. I felt very safe walking around, even in the evenings. The unit itself was great and well equipped, and the view from the upstairs balcony was stunning. Debbie (Stacy’s mom) was lovely throughout my stay and very responsive and ensured I had everything I needed. The family lives in the adjacent property and helped me with check in and to carry my bags. Parking was also very easy to find near the home. Overall, great stay and would definitely recommend anyone to stay here.
Perfectly located to a number of restaurants & shops. Amazing views from the verandah & overall a great place to stay
This was a great spot for a short weekend getaway. Based in a quiet, leafy suburb, close to plenty of amenities, this cottage felt like a home away from home.
This cottage is extraordinary. It is everything you could wish for. The location and facilities one could not wish for more. We will certainly stay there again if accepted

Clean and beautiful house in which everything is provided.
I was especially pleased with the garage and friendly owners.
The best AirBnB we have stayed in. Cannot fault a thing and will definitely be back.

I had a wonderful stay at Tess' place. It is finished to a high standard, spacious, private, safe and central. Tess communicated proactively, checked-in regularly and was always friendly and helpful. Highly recommend.

We had a lovely stay. The place was even better than our expectations, and the communication with Kyle and Tess was excellent and very easy; they were very helpful. The place is great—you have your own private parking right next to the entrance of the cottage. The space is big, comfortable, and really nicely furnished. The neighborhood is also very peaceful. We honestly loved our stay here and would happily come back on our next trip to Cape Town

Tess and Kyle were very friendly. And the cottage was beautiful and well kept, spotless. It also had many small touches which you appreciate being away from your own home. The bed was extremely comfortable and spacious. Coming and going was easy and it was easy for me to get to UCT from their place. It will be the first place I look out for on my next visit to Cape Town. Thank you for a lovely stay!
Oh it was lovely,I had so much peace and quiet and enjoyed my week and the unit was lovely. Thank you!
We had a lovely stay in Tess's cottage. Very spacious with all you need. Would highly recommend her place

Anthea, thank you so much. I felt right at home. Instructions were clear. Place was cozy and really nice. The view right onto table mountain was the peak!
The pool area might benefit from some WiFi coverage especially for foreigners.
Apart from that it’s your home away from home!
What an amazing 4 days!

Excellent apartment in great location. Easy to walk around the neighborhood in the day time and close to good restaurants and coffee shops and easy to get to the waterfront from the apartment. Views were excellent

Great location within easy walking distance of the V&A Waterfront in one direction and Bo Kaap in the other.
Flat block is extremely secure with 24hr security - whilst this means a slightly longer check in process it’s worth it for the safety and security for the stay.
The flat itself has great views of Table Mountain from the balcony and is well equipped per the listing.
Great rooftop pool and braai area too to make the most of the summer weather and more views over Cape Town and Table Mountain.
Photos are very accurate and would say this is great value stay for the location and quality of place.
Thanks Anthea and Adrian for a great stay.
We truly enjoyed our stay, very clean and cute space. Loved the shower especially. The views were the best part, breathtaking! Smaller than expected but comfortable.
The camera isn’t doing enough justice for this place. It looks even nicer. It’s quite cozy and quiet. I’d definitely love to book again.

Anthea and Adrian were amazing, they were so friendly and helpful. The view of table mountain is breathtaking , especially being able to see it at all times of day and night. Location is perfect easy to get around and go for a walk to the waterfront. The apartment was clean, neat and cosy all in one.

Beautiful apartment in a secure complex. The 24 our reception was very helpful.  Check-in with building staff was easy with clear instructions. The apartment is very comfortable with an amazing view of Table Mountain. A 15min walk to restaurants and the Waterfront. I would definitely recommend this accommodation for a visit to Cape Town.
Apartment was very clean and cozy,exactly as captured in the photos.Great communication,will def be back

Great location for what I needed in town - walking distance during the day, easy to get an Uber in the evening. The view is stunning, the apartment is lovely, and both hosts were responsive and helpful. My only complaint is that they knew there would be work happening on the balcony (and neighboring balconies) during my stay and did not inform me until after I’d spent the first night and woke to a man climbing onto the balcony. This could have been disclosed before I arrived or at the very latest upon arrival. Regardless, it’s a wonderful flat, well-equipped, in a safe building, and if I need to stay in that area again, I would happily return.
Hi enjoyed my stay at Freda’s . Well located , very neat and very comfortable bed . Great linen and super comfy pillows and soft fluffy towels . Home away from home 💜💜💜

The place is in a great location, clean and the people are helpful(security guards and the lady that helped with my check in and check out)
Many thanks!!!!
Absolutely beautiful space. Very close to a lot of great places. Fun to walk around. The hosts were very helpful and it was a pleasant stay 🤗

This place was exactly what I needed — like staying in a hotel room, but with the added bonus of a private patio to enjoy the weather. It’s located in a quiet residential area but still just a very short walk to shops, supermarkets, and great restaurants, which made everything super convenient.
The security was excellent, and the host was responsive, helpful, and flexible throughout my stay. It was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped — perfect for a short stay or even a longer one if you're looking for a hassle-free setup in a peaceful yet central location. Would definitely stay again!

The apartment was great and exactly what I needed for my first time in Cape Town. It is only a fee minutes walk to several shops, restaurants and the beach. The apartment was very clean and in a great part of Sea Point. The patio area and pool area are definitely nice additions. I would definitely stay here again. The Host was also very easy to communicate with and responsive.

We enjoyed a relaxing stay a Denham's.
Close to the City (you can cycle there) but far enough away to avoid traffic noise and parking problems- Recommended!

Great appartement, a bit up the hill (5 min from main road), but wonderful appartement with great cooking equipment, TV, there was even a playstation. :-)
Check-in and -out was great, relly happy with the stay.
This place was perfect for my stay, very well located and comfortable! I would recommend it and hope to stay there again soon :)

My husband spent three nights at Landi's studio. From being spotless clean, to having everything needed for his stay, to being close to the shops, quiet space and friendly  owners, it is a place highly recommended.

The studio is lovely as it is private and quiet, it has everything you need for a short stay. Walking in the estate and outside the estate is very pleasant and safe.
Landi and family are lovely and friendly people and they would go extra mile to accommodate you.
I highly recommend Landi's studio.

I booked this beautiful spot for my mom to stay for 10 days and we couldn’t have asked for a more perfect home.
The home is beautiful and very well equipped! So much thought has gone into making the guests feel at home.
The home was spotless and incredibly peaceful. The location of the home is excellent as it’s very close to everything, but you don’t have any noises coming from the roads/highways.
Landi was incredibly kind, generous and helpful. Her home truly is a remarkable find. My mom was so happy there and didn’t want to leave.
Definitely would recommend Haus Merwe to anyone. It exceeded all our expectations.
Landi's place was the perfect hideaway after a lively social event - quiet and peaceful! Flexible easy checkin for us to come and go.
Perfect place to stay close to the mall and not far from school as we had a school tour.

Estelle’s place was just gorgeous. Sparkling clean, all the mod cons, thoughtfully decorated and a few lovely little touches that didn’t go unnoticed. The photos didn’t do it justice at all. Estelle and Ian were very friendly and responsive hosts. The area felt safe. Thanks for having us.

I really enjoyed my 3 week’ stay at Estelle’s place, I felt right at home. The whole place was in an excellent condition and Estelle was really kind, making sure that I was comfortable and happy.  I highly recommend her place!
We really enjoyed our visit, Estelle was amazing, and the personal touches made us feel right at home.  This place is a gem that does not disappoint.  Looking forward to our next visit!

If I could give Estelle’s a million stars I would. What an amazing host and such a lovely place she has.
I stayed there in one of the coldest winters I’ve ever experienced in my life but the place was absolutely warm, the electric blanket and air-conditioning was just what I needed. It was very clean with top of the range bedding, appliances, soaps etc. Estelle really put such care to make the place comfortable.
She is such an amazing and warm host, she checked up on me regularly to make sure I had everything and went above and beyond to make my stay a great experience. I wished I could’ve stayed for a longer period of time and will definitely recommend the beautiful place to everyone coming to visit Cape Town.
very well located  beautiful  apartment clean with an amazing view of the sea. very  comfortable and spacious was very very happy will Def be back

A lovely well positioned apartment close to major attractions in CT. Walking distance to the CT Stadium, the Oranjezicht market and the V&A Waterfront.
Lovely sea views. Clean apartment with all required facilities, good wifi etc.
Deena was a pleasure to deal with and met me as we checked in and showed me around. Easy checkout instructions too.
Will definitely stay here again when we are in CT.

An exceptionally deliberately good host in Kumi Collection. The team of Kumi was available to our needs and this made us feel at home. As a family we were at a home away from home thanks to Kumi collection. A special thanks to Elri, Jeandre and Abongile who were on hand to make us as comfortable as possible. We enjoyed our holiday in Cape Town
We had an amazing time, the place is beautiful with an great sunset and nice hiking opportunities in the surroundings and great house keeping

This was a breathtaking place ! The scenery was beautiful. The owner was very friendly. The hosts were amazing as they greeted us at the door was all around a beautiful experience and I would stay again in a heart beat. The house was immaculate ! Thanks again!
We had an amazing stay with our 2 children at this beautiful villa. Everything was perfect from start to finish. The owner was very kind and friendly

The apartment as well as the hosts are just lovely. It was exactly what we were hoping for. A stunning view, comfy bed and a cozy outside area with bbq and a cute garden. We would definitely come back.
I really enjoyed staying at this place! It had a modern and spacious feel, and it included everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Highly recommend it!

Had a great time staying in this apartment. The apartment is spacious and modern with a large balcony .  Walking distance to shops and restaurants. Guests have secure parking in the basement with 24hour security

I had a wonderful stay at Petra's place. Great access to the beach and restaurants along the coast.
Breathtaking views of the mountain.
The apartment is stunning and has everything you need.
I'd certainly book this again

Lovely flat well furnished, as shown in pictures with the exception of the view that was truly stunning & breathtaking. Ideally located for walks on the beach & walking distance to restaurants & amenities. Would have no qualms about booking again.
Unparalleled views, superb host with clear instructions who is friendly and accommodating. Enjoyed our time there, thoroughly.

A great stay at a great location with fantastic views of the sea and the mountain. All communications from initial booking to check-out were answered promptly and professionally. The apartment was neat, clean and well maintained. Give it a go!

Had a fantastic stay. The place was spotless, well-equipped, and in a great location. Petra was a warm and attentive host, making sure everything was perfect for my visit. Would happily stay here again!
We had a wonderful stay in Harbour Lodge which was a stand out accommodation choice in every respect. So happy we booked a return stay! Laura was also a great host - thank you.

Loved the proximity of this place to restaurants and shops, walking, beach and tidal pools. Very secure. Great friendly staff. Very colorfully coordinated decor in the house. Well equipped. Loved our stay.

What a fabulous home to live in! Central to all amenities, walking distance to the beautiful Fish Hoek beach.
The house has high quality and beautiful equipment and we simply loved staying there.
Gorgeous place to stay, views are to die for! Very friendly hosts and the apartment itself was very cosy. Couldn’t have asked for a better spot to spend the weekend.
My family had a beautiful stay , good location,near all major tourist attractions Unit was exactly like the pictures. Loved our stay felt like home!
A beautiful and central stay in Cape Town. We had a good stay and was accommodated well by the host.
We have no complaints about the accommodation, except for the shower drain issue, which we believe poses a health hazard due to the risk of slipping.

We absolutely loved our stay at Villa Verdot. It is brilliantly kitted out and very well located, and our children particularly loved the outdoor playhouse and swimming pool. Hans and Sabina could not have been more welcoming and we really appreciated their friendliness and advice, and their excellent recommendations of local restaurants. Overall we’d thoroughly recommend this for any family but especially one with young children like ours.
Esme is such a kovely, nice and carrying person. She makes sure that you feel very welcome. I really enjoyed the stay at her place. Beautiful house.
My mom enjoyed her stay at Esme’s place. My mom found it to be welcoming and enjoyed the conversations with Esme.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Alet and Mark’s. They were incredibly responsive and helpful in all regards. The townhouse is beautiful, spacious, light and very tastefully decorated; I felt right at home. Ample amenities and thoughtful touches. Would happily recommend and stay again.
Wunderful apartment, beautiful decorations and style, lots of personal space. Clean and modern. Recommended! I would go there again
Loved this little gem. Alet and Mark were super helpful and the place is ideal for a quiet space to work.
Lovely flat and in a great location. I had a very nice stay and Ronak was very friendly and helpful throughout.
We had a lovely stay with our three young children. The location is beautiful and very convenient for visiting Cape Town. The home itself had everything we needed.

Epic views, prime location and beautiful space! We would 100% stay here again!
We stayed for a week and found the house to be gorgeous, spacious and close to everything we needed. Gardens center mall and a few restaurants are walkable whilst everything else is a short uber away.
Highly recommend!!
The house is nice, well decorated and situated in a quiet street of Oranjezicht. It is confortable and has everything you need. :)
The apartment very nice and stylish 💯,easy access to all shops .1min walk to the beach very peaceful.

The property was compact and clean. Looked exactly like the pictures. FYI. There isn’t any central heat or ac but there is a heating blanket and a small heater. If that works for you then you’ll be great. I’m sure they’ll figure out the ac stuff when summer hits.

I had a bad experience with Tyler which I raised with Airbnb. He was unresponsive and provided no details about the check in process at all. The listing showed before that there was air con - which there was not. A small fan was provided without an adapter so couldn’t be used. When I asked about this his response was so rude and quote “you want to drive two hours to give you a plug”. I’ve never had this experience before on Airbnb which is a real shame as the apartment in the whole was nice. Thankfully Airbnb have been very supportive about my case.

The accommodation was perfectly located and kept very clean. Tyler was always responsive to my questions and helped with the extension. The conditions were excellent. I will definitely stay with him again!

Charmaine was a great host - extremely kind, responsive and flexible. However there was an issue that we encountered that dampened our stay a bit, but it was taken care of proactively. Overall, really nice accommodations.
Safeera was so lovely and responsive...even to my dumb questions that were clearly stated but I didn't see! The location of the flat was so convenient and I felt very safe and comfortable.

This is my second stay at an Airbnb hosted by Safeera, and I’ll definitely be returning. The apartment was fantastic—well-equipped kitchen with a washing machine and dishwasher, a spacious lounge, and an incredibly comfortable bed. The balcony offered beautiful views, and the place was spotless and well-maintained. The on-site security team was very helpful as well. Overall, the experience was wonderful, and I highly recommend any property listed by Safeera for a top-quality stay.

✨ Our stay was absolutely delightful! The apartment was so modern and beautifully minimalist, creating a perfect atmosphere for relaxation. The views from the balcony were simply breathtaking, making every moment feel special. We loved how quiet the area was—it truly allowed us to unwind completely. We can't wait to come back for another escape! Just a heads-up for future guests: bringing a lighter or matches for the gas stove , would be super helpful if you want to whip up a meal on your first night. Overall, it was a wonderful experience! 🏡🤍

I had a fantastic stay at this beautiful flat in Cape Town! The apartment was clean and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The view of Century City and the iconic Table Mountain was absolutely breathtaking—perfect to wake up to every morning and watch the incredible sunset in the evening. Safeera was very helpful and responsive, making check-in and any questions during the stay completely hassle-free. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking to stay in Cape Town! I will definitely return on my next visit.
Gail's place is truly a home away from home. From the stylish decor to all the special little extras, the lovely view and overall comfort, we had a super enjoyable time.
An unbelievable beach home, seconds from the beach. Beautiful layout and everything you could need for a perfect beach break! Stunning pool area and loungers.
Fabulous house in a great location. We were delighted. Felt very secure and spoilt with the views and facilities.

We spent an incredibly special time here with our family the weekend before our baby was born and it was so special. The weather was sublime, and the setting couldn’t have been more serene! We’ll be back!

What a beautiful house, garden and swimming pool! We were surprised by the spaciousness, cleanliness and welcoming atmosphere. Watching the sunsets, having a braii … the house is simply stunning! Would love to visit again !
Great place to stay, once we had right address & code for gate. Noreen very helpful and obliging.

What an incredible stay. Cannot recommend this place more. Perfect location in Seapoint and easy to get to everything in and around Cape Town, walking distance to great shops and a short run to the promenade. Great amenities with everything you’d need, helpful host, clean, safe and felt right at home from day one. After settling in Gail helped organise a desk so that I could work remotely and the wifi was more than adequate. The hot water in our room wasn’t working and the next morning it was fixed swiftly by Gail. The room 3 we stayed in was large, bed was super comfy and we could have easily stayed there for another month.
Thank you for making our stay so memorable and we will definitely be back.
It is a really nice and silent appartement with two nice pools. Oli welcomed us and gave us tips for restaurants close by.

The B3 is great, spacious room and large bathroom, best location with many restaurants, close to the city center, beaches and the Lionshead-Hike. Nevertheless very quiet and the beautiful and cool garden with pools also invites you to linger. The well-equipped kitchen makes it easy to prepare breakfast or a meal. Gail is lovely and very attentive. We will definitly come back!

this is the place you will want to book again, anytime youre in town.
the location is great, for capetown pretty walkable and safe. the property itself feels very safe, with multiple locked gates. the pool and building are incredibly pretty and great to calm down inbetween activities.
the hosts were super super nice and didn’t just allow a late check in, but were incredibly accomodating and sweet about check out. thanks again!

This was an amazing place! We loved everything about it! I even used the pool even though it was winter!
Gail and Oli are very friendly and helpful!

Thank you Shaleeni for a great stay! I felt at home.
The property is modern, clean and the position is brilliant.
Communication was great from both of you!
Highly recommended

My wife and I booked the accommodation for our anniversary and Shaleeni was so thoughtful and left a card and a bottle of bubbly. The place has beautiful views, centrally located within walking distance from great restaurants. It was neat, clean and looked just as advertised. A can certainly recommend it!
What a great host. His place was very clean walked around with my white socks and they were clean. He even allowed me to check out after checkout time. Great stay indeed. Thank you Ntlanhla🙏🏾

Very pleased overall. Great location for my needs. Secure location. A problem or two with amenities but the host's easygoing, helpful, approachable and friendly style helped me feel right at home very quickly. Top host, thank you Nhlanhla!
I had a good stay, Nhlanhla is a gracious host, who made me feel right at home. Perfect location just a stone throw away from Cavendish Mall.

Very convenient if you plan on travelling alone and don’t plan on being indoors often. The place is really quite and has a mall that’s walking distance. Nhlanhla is very nice chill guys. The shower has a bit of an issue with leaking but other than that great stay :)
Tony is very good anything in capetown … I’m like her place and I’m come back to her place anytime when I’m come to capetown thx u Tony

The location was nice, my host was really friendly and helpful
Although the return on money was not great
You can find a great places with same cost
In short the hotel was really old place
I felt rly at home staying in this apartment and will definitely want to stay here again when I visit Cape Town the next time!

My stay was great and I would choose the same place again. The location is very convenient, at gardens centre with supermarkets, pharmacies and cafes in the same building. The bus stop is right across the road and the company gardens is a short walking distance. Toni's apartment was clean, with a functional kitchen and many ammenities that were very helpful. She made sure I had fresh linens and was more than helpful to arrange everything I needed. I'm very grateful for the stay!

Really great value for money in the heart of Gardens also for longer term! Perfect location with the shopping center right below with all amenities you might need. Also Toni is an amazing host, being extremely proactive in resolving any issue or topic and being very "customer"-centered. Will definitely consider staying here again when I go back to Cape Town.

A fantastic place to stay in Cape Town. Staying in an apartment with an amazing view over Lions Head and a mall with everything (!) available. Every day breakfast from Woolworths is priceless.
Toni was very quick to respond and accommodating.

I have been visiting Cape Town yearly for the past decade, and this was one if my loveliest stays yet! The apartment was cute and cozy, and the views are immaculate. Toni was very kind and responsive. Gardens is a great spot to stay, with plenty of amenities and proximate restaurants and parks. We will definitely be staying here again!

We’ve spent more than 50 days and it was perfect.
The accommodation was clean, very organised. There are a lot of shoppings in the area, and is also very safe to walk around. We enjoyed the beautiful view ( specially the sunset )
Electricity wasn’t that much for a long term stay, we’ve paid a fair amount and based on our responsible usage.
I would come back, FOR SURE!

We had a lovely stay at the View. It's located by the water and has a handy overpass crossing the railway lines. The trains start late and terminate early and were entertainment rather than nuisance
We enjoyed watching the water and were happy not to hear the street running behind the house. The apartment is well equipped for a stay

This was easily the best place I have ever stayed at. The place exceeded our own expectations. Pauline, the host, was extremely helpful and friendly. I will definitely be staying at Somwe's during my next stay with my friends in Cape Town. I would most certainly recommend Somwe's place. We certainly got our money's worth and more.
We enjoyed our stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and as described. Somwe was friendly, communicative and helpful throughout.

Perfection doesn’t exist but this is pretty close. This was my second time here and it was amazing. The place was spotlessly clean, close to shops, restaurants and the beach and an amazing view to watch the sunset.
The place is peaceful and private as well. I will definitely be back again soon.
The host communicated well and was friendly.

This place was an amazing gem!  It was exactly like the photos, and had a great view.  Easily walkable to the V&A Waterfront and the beach.  She sent a very helpful graphic detailing the check-in procedure.  When we were unable to call a restaurant to make a reservation, Carrie stepped right in and made one for us. She was always responsive when I had a question (and I had lots lol).  Oh, and the beds are super comfy!  We had a great stay there... highly recommend.
She is a bad host.. she will send you a bill for linen cleaning after checkout. You expected me to use days at your space without washing linen?
I had a good stay. Carrie was responsive, the place is beautiful & cozy, and the location is perfect.

Lovely studio apartment. Great location close to everything . Brand new secure building. Super comfortable bed. Everything you could possibly need in the kitchen. As a frequent visitor to Cape Town, this is where I’ll look for accommodation first.

This apartment was exactly what we were looking for: stylish, modern and sleek, close to shops and restaurants, very close to promenade. We actually took a slow, beach-hopping walk all the way to Camps Bay via Saunders and Clifton beaches.
The building is lovely and not stuffy like most apart-hotels. Super clean and easy to get in and out with biometrics and safe underground parking.
We will definitely be back!

Amazing place, clean and beautiful. Closer to almost everything in Sea Point. Enjoy it.
🙁: Cleaners arrived before check out requesting to clean the room. That’s was a bit off.

My partner and I had a wonderful time at this Airbnb. The place was cozy, clean, and had everything we needed. The views were absolutely stunning, perfect for a relaxing getaway. The hosts were great too! Highly recommend for anyone looking for a peaceful, scenic retreat.

An absolutely beautiful place. With very helpful and friendly staff. Our view was amazing and it's conveniently located to restaurants and grocery stores. And we even had the option of leaving our bags at reception after checking out and collected it at a later time. We're definitely going back again soon.

Frank was welcoming & available to sort out a geyser issue during our stay.  The apartment was comfortable and spacious.  The flowers, fruit, milk, water, tea & coffee were appreciated.  The TV package was disappointing - local DSTV would have been far better.  The tranquil surroundings and restaurant at the Clubhouse were very nice.  Thank you!

This is a beautifully styled apartment on the 14th floor with stunning views. It is spacious, comfortable, and has all the amenities you are likely to need. A bonus for me was the clothes washing machine which allows for longer stays. It was also very easy to regulate the temperature and was lovely and warm despite the freezing cape winter raging outside. There is also a Planet Fitness gym in the building which was a bonus.
Amazing coffee shops and restaurants are within walking distance although I would not recommend walking at night. The Cape Quarter is close and has all the basics you will need for food etc.
Markus is an attentive host and is readily available should any issues arise. You are in safe hands. This is highly recommended for both short and longer stays.
Thank you Markus for such a beautiful space, truly enjoyed my stay. Thank you for also being so friendly , helpful and responsive. Absolutely enjoyed the views .

We had a great stay at the Eagles Eye, Very central apartment and easy access to different parts of the city. Apartment was clean and exactly as described. The check in process was seamless, Markus shared a complete guide including videos to help with the check in process. The cleaning service provided was excellent. Markus was very responsive and assisted when needed. Overall, A wonderful stay and would definitely stay again long or short term.

We really enjoyed our stay at Markus's. Great apartment with stunning views. Easy walking distance to some great coffee shops. The building was very secure. Check-in was easy with instructions. Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to everyone.
Markus was a wonderful host. The space is light and airy with a wonderful view. The apartment had everything one could need and Molly the house keeper was an absolute delight!
Very friendly and made me feel at home, the place was sparkling and beautiful area. Also very easy going
Beautiful view, great location, great communication & highly secure - I definitely recommend staying here! I was there for 9 days and really enjoyed it. Thanks Markus and team!
Not the first time at this stunning apartment and definitely won't be the last. This place, the view and the aesthetic is amazing. Markus is a very responsive host and very helpful.
The place looks exactly like in the pictures. It is beautiful, smells good, very clean and welcoming.  Great stay, thanks Tshenolo and your brother.
Great host and very friendly. Beautiful space. Home smelled and looked beautiful. I would highly recommend this listing.

This property is well equipped, located and clean. There’s any thing you need to enjoy your stay in CPT.
Thanks Rest Easy. We have enjoyed a lot of!

Enjoyed everything besides that it wasn’t shown in the pic that it was not a single level home, it had stairs
Also disappointed with the fact that I didn’t get housekeeping everday as was mentioned on the details
And for 3 nights water leaked in my room which was inconvenient for my stay.

Disappointing. The one sliding door didn’t lock, cupboard doors were missing, mould was in the fridge doors, one of the bedroom doors didn’t close. Cupboards were dusty inside and the host didn’t try to rectify these and other issues when we brought it to his attention. Not worth the money advertised.

Very safe and peaceful location. This place also has a nice balcony with lovely mountain views.
Tau is a very helpful and responsive host who was quick to assist with anything that needed to be sorted out. I would definitely love to stay there again.

Tau was a wonderful host definitely willing to make our stay as comfortable as possible friendly and helpful.
A few minor adjustments need to be made in unit to make it more enjoyable.
Darker curtains in the living area help with viewing the TV better in the lounge area as the sun is harsh in the day also making the unit hot.
Kitchen cupboards doors need maintenance and a few walls and kitchen door needs a wipe down to make the unit appearance more appealing.
Overall enjoyed our stay good location.

It was a short stay at this property, however it was nothing short of amazing. From the moment we arrived,the reception was great. The space was exactly as described, clean, stylish, and equipped with every amenity we could need.
The location was perfect, close to local attractions
Jason and his team went above and beyond as hosts offering tips on the best places to hangout. Communication was seamless, and they were always quick to respond to any questions I had.
I will highly recommend this property to everyone.
The apartment exceeded our expectations. The location is central to many amenities, everything is in walking distance.

A wonderful apartment in the Central Business District.  Nicely furnished and decorated.  No clutter and very clean. The apartment had everything we needed and the building is very well managed and conveniently located. Having parking in the building was great.

Jayson’s place was pristine with a fantastic city view, peeks of the water, and in an amazing location. Close to many restaurants, local attractions and nightlife, this place was positioned in the heart of the city making it easy to walk to your destinations or take a quick uber if necessary. There is security and we felt very safe here. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay, the nightlife was noisy until late but the unit was modern and had everything we needed.
Thank you.

Perfect city getaway!
This home was absolutely stunning beautifully designed, spotless, and incredibly comfortable. The location couldn’t be better, just a stone’s throw from all the must-see attractions and some of the best dining spots in the city. From the moment we arrived, we felt so welcome and at home. Every detail was thoughtfully considered, making our stay not only relaxing but truly memorable. Highly recommend to anyone looking for the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience!

Good place to stay for a family of 2-3. It looked like a quiet and safe neighborhood.
The adjacent unit is only separated with a dry-wall in one area, which brings the risk of noise. In our case the other tenants were fairly quiet.

I had a very comfortable stay. It's in Seapoint, near green point, and generally pretty central to all of the good areas of the city. I didn't realize that there wasn't AC, but that's my mistake and I had fan close to my bed to stay cool so it was fine. I recommend booking this place

All good! We were a 6 people party and the house was very confortable for all of us. Fully equipped kitchen and confortable beds and sofas. Very convenient location overall. As we were hosted in August, the house sometimes was just a bit cold ... we found the same in many other houses in the country as they are not equipped for these few cold weeks of the year. Very good value for money overall!

location was very good...close to restaurants
Calvin was excellent staying in touch with us gave us good hins about restaurants and things to do

We had a fantastic stay at Calvin's property! It was exactly as described—peaceful yet central, and within walking distance of Cape Quarter, which has a convenient grocery store.
A few things to note for future guests:
* While the instructions for getting into the property were clear, the specific unit was a bit tricky to locate at first.
* Be aware that there is only one remote for property access and one set of keys for the unit.
Calvin was an exceptional host. He was incredibly helpful and communicative, even assisting with getting an international debit card shipped to Cape Town before our arrival. He was also very accommodating with luggage storage on our check-out day.
I would highly recommend this property and Calvin as a host for anyone visiting Cape Town.

It safe to say that it was our best staying in Cape Town! Michael and his family are so welcoming, he met us and gave a quick look at everything with clear instructions, he left us a bowl with fruits and a bottle of great wine. Also he gave a lot of recommendations about Hout Bay and Cape Town, he was always there to help us like with everything. Me and my friends so grateful for the best hosting!
The place is exactly as you see on photos. Everything is fresh and new. There was everything we needed for a long stay. Hout Bay is safe and beautiful. We enjoyed every walk to the beach! The area is full of trees, flowers and friendly people.
100% can recommend it!

Beautiful place with wonderful surroundings and views. Loved how peaceful the area is, we really enjoyed being there. Definitely worth the drive as we were a bit far from where our activities were but the drive was a beautiful experience.

We had a wonderful stay. The Turnkey365 team were always super responsive, well coordinated, friendly, easy to communicate with and eager to ensure our stay was perfect. The appartment was exactly as advertised, with spectacular views which will surely be missed. Special thanks also to Zethu our cleaner who made sure we always came back to a sparkly, clean space. The activity recommendations were great as well with useful insights that prevented long waiting queues. The appartment is literally only a 5 min walk away from groceries, great restaurants and coffee shops. So if you don’t feel like cooking at home there are always great food options available which can easily be reached without a car. To anyone who books this space please be aware though that the dressing room, bathroom and master bedroom do not separate with doors. We couldn’t recommend this space more to anyone who is looking for spectacular views, a modern interior with all required amenities and accessible location.

Couldnt fault the little apartment. Simple and clean. Everything worked.
The neighbourhood outside to two security gates was rough. I was mugged. This is common now in Cape Town locals tell me. 5 years ago it was much better.
I felt safe once i was in the apartment and locals there were friendly and helpful.
St James were easily reached.
I found the location very noisy. Cape Town never sleeps!

The accommodation was great. Very nice host, always immediate response, allowed early check-in and everything was very nice.
small minus - I would probably put dark curtains in the bedroom. Sometimes I woke up earlier in the morning because of the light. But at least I went for a run earlier :-)

If you need to be on the Foreshore this a very good option.
2!!!!! AirCons.
Very Nicely Furnished.
Well equipped.

Exactly as advertised
Was a few small technical issues with TV & internet but Avukile was immediately on it to get it sorted
Good Service
The place is so beautiful and it looks exactly as the pictures, with such a clean kitchen, bedroom and bathrooms.

We had a great stay with Reno. The apartment is brand new, spacious and well decorated. The position while very central, is on main road, which can be very noisy so best to keep windows closed.
There is no aircon and the unit was boiling at night. Fortunately Reno assisted us in arranging a fan which was helpful.

The stay was cozy and comfortable. The apartment had everything you could need from body wash and shampoo in the bathrooms to tea, coffee, and sugar. Host was always responsive which was very appreciated.
The check in process was very rigid as, per building security, the host must be present to meet you and hand over the keys, all guests who visit must register with their ID with security. Take that as you will, but the area and building were very safe!
Would definitely stay here again.

I stayed in a beautiful apartment in Sea Point and absolutely loved it! The location is perfect, close to the beach and great restaurants. The apartment was clean, modern, and very comfortable. The host was friendly and made everything easy. Highly recommended

We had an incredible weekend at this villa! The views were absolutely stunning, making every moment feel like a dream. The space was beautifully maintained, offering both comfort and luxury. The host was extremely responsive and helpful, ensuring we had everything we needed throughout our stay. From start to finish, the experience was seamless and truly enjoyable. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a perfect getaway!

The service was amazing!
They gave us amazing tips for planning the days and helped us very fast and kind with small problems.

Lovely host and beautiful space , great location too we loved it 😁 the only thing I can complain about is the helper coming in the following day after check in unannounced and staying the whole entire day , we had to ask her to excuse us . After being there whole day she still didn’t do much , left the place almost like it was when she arrived , ddnt even change bedding or towels all she did was be on the phone laughing making noise . Otherwise the host was really helpful and check in was seamless. Will definitely come back again 🫶🏽
Cute little apartment in Camps Bay with amazing view, however without any outdoor area. Tremendous hosts with easy communication. Can only recommend!
Jessica was a great responsive host and the apartment is wonderfully located. Communication was easy. Would be glad to come back soon!

Mattias was amazing host! He greeted on entry and helped with bags on checkin. The place is very new. Very clean, simple, and minimalistic. Love it. You also have great view of table mountain. I definitely recommend! Thanks!

The location was perfect for the venue we visited. It is very central with excellent security measures. Our host was helpful, courteous and friendly. Will definitely recommend for a one night stay over. Meets all the criteria needed. The room was very clean and exactly as described.  Surrounded by coffee shops and bars, the accommodation was sufficient with the option of secure parking close by.

We struggled checking in as they sent the code to my old number. The bedding had bloodstains, the ladies who works saw that as well. The rooms are so small, not like in the pictures. The experience was not great at all, the bloodstained bedding threw me off, that was totally uncalled for. The pictures are misleading, the rooms are very small.
Not happy at all.
Room was great and clean. Redflags at the building dodgy people while checking in and we heard a loud scream while sleeping dont know what that was.
It’s a bit noisy with the clubs near by, it’s not very clean and there’re cockroaches

affordable space,clean and well situated host was commutative and quick to respond.
check in was simple and easy.area was noisy and in a unsafe environment from what I could tell.
cleaning ladies were pleasant and helpful.
not enough blankets. room very cold. no aircon or heater. toilet makes noise after flushing and showering.

This was an absolute gem of a find - great value for money, amazing location, easy access to everything in terms of beach, shops, town, the mountain, all the major roads etc. For a short stay this really has all you need. Phillis is very responsive and helpful and also was flexible with our check out when we had an unexpected delay. The security guards are also very helpful and we never had an issue finding a parking spot outside. We would happily stay again!

The house is in such a good location, a separate entrance at the end of the garden means the beach is right on your doorstep. The house is done up to a high standard and has everything you need for wonderful stay. Felt right at home.

This Is an amazing house both internally, externally and by location. It is beautiful and very well appointed, its proximity to the beach could not have been better for those sundowners. We were 9 people and were all very well accommodated and were able to cook for as many (sometimes more) every night.
The pool room was a particularly great space for the younger members of the group either for studying (A level time!) or for chilling in front of the TV.
The white goods were all high end, and came in handy, and the Ice maker was an unexpected bonus.
I would go back and stay there in a heartbeat.
Beautiful place with secure parking and a lovely bath to relax in. Will definitely recommend. Close to restaurants and leisure activities
Had a great stay at the apartment, was very clean and tidy. Its just that we had problems with the iron. Which did inconvenience the stay but besides that, i would recommend

A beautiful apartment that feels so warm and cosy. We enjoyed our time and even extended our stay. Marius and the ladies are absolute stars, communication was great and they were quick to respond. I sent communication that the iron was not working, the following morning the a new iron was brought to us. This place is worth every cent.

Marius was so attentive, responsive and friendly. Any question I had was quickly answered. The space itself is incredibly beautiful, aesthetically and so spacious. I genuinely felt so comfortable and at home, and it was equipped with everything one would need. Thank you for making my staycation in the city amazing!
The place was exactly as described by Marius and pictures, clean and proper. Good and speedy communication. I would recommend this place to anyone.

Clean and well kept place.
It looks just like the pictures
It's a bit noisy - due to the sound of cars- Main Road is right there so not ideal if you are looking for a 'waking up to the sound of birds type of experience'.

Jacqui is a perfect host. She’s very friendly, her place is absolutely beautiful, the spacious and modern bathroom was my favourite. The bed is very comfortable. I was sad to leave, Jacqui  felt more like a new friend than a host. Will 100% recommend.

From the moment the booking was confirmed to the warm welcome received on the day Jacqui was nothing short of amazing!!! The space is even more beautiful than the pics and the little notes left around the place were so unique. We had such a busy itinerary but coming back home to serene space was just what we needed to rejuvenate!
It’s unfortunate that our stay was so short and we didn’t get to enjoy the pool but I would definitely go back!

Hummingbird Corner is an absolutely  phenomenal place. Our stay there as a couple for our anniversary was the perfect fit. From the natural lighting of the place, to the solar heated pool, a very proactive host who ensures you know where everything is and welcomes you with a big smile. I’d say this felt like home and would recommend this to anyone for any occasion.

Way better than expected,  and I was expecting quite alot. Beautifully decorated and themed room,  lovely fragrance of the unit as you arrive (but not overwhelming). Very neat and tidy, a simply delightful, refreshing stay so close to everything in Cape Town. Just loved it, and Jacqui is such a caring hostess. Thanks for spoiling me

We had the most incredible stay at Hummingbird Coner for our honeymoon! From the moment we arrived, everything was perfect. The space was beautifully clean, cozy and had all the little touches that made us feel special. The location was perfect,and the atmosphere was peaceful—just what we needed.
Our host, Jacqui, was absolutely amazing—so welcoming, responsive and thoughtful. She went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and even left some lovely surprises for us, which made our stay even more memorable.
We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Thank you for making our honeymoon so special! We will definitely be back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a wonderful stay.

Our stay was absolutely wonderful! From the moment we booked, the host was exceptionally responsive, making communication effortless and reassuring. The check-in process was seamless and very well explained. What truly set this property apart were the thoughtful personal touches — from charming handwritten notes to the inviting fragrances throughout the space. The home was immaculately clean, beautifully designed, and impressively well-equipped with everything we could possibly need. Every detail was clearly considered with care, creating a warm, welcoming, and truly memorable experience. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a standout Airbnb stay!

Rebecca and Thembi were amazing hosts. You feel right at home. Everything was absolutely perfect. The hosts were extremely responsive and welcomed us with open arms. I will definitely recommend this place to anyone.

I recently had an amazing stay at  this Airbnb that I absolutely loved. The apartment was clean, beautifully decorated, and felt so cozy and inviting. The host was super friendly and added thoughtful touches that made our stay extra special. The location was perfect, in a safe neighborhood with easy access to local attractions. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay. 🥰
The place is as beautiful as the pictures. Thembi Lin was very welcoming,always ready to listen and help. I felt at home and it was easy to access most places in the CBD.
The place is perfectly located and has a great vibe. Highly recommend for anyone attending Hyrox or exploring Cape Town. Can't wait to come back!

We had a very relaxing stay at Michelle’s lovely apartment! The most beautiful beach is just right there,  Michelle and Bradley are very friendly and accommodating hosts and the apartment is very cozy. We can totally recommend this place!

You’ll enjoy a stay at Michelle’s listing as it’s walking distance to the beach and in a peaceful area.
Michelle and her husband are kind hosts, the listing is comfortable, clean and check-in/out was a breeze. Would definitely recommend.
Accommodation is lovely. Finishes are great. Comfy beds and it has air con which is a must for me. Can cook, can braai. Lovely stay.

Just completed our visit to Cape Town.  Chris's place is just what we needed to finish our vacation.  A nice retreat from the hubbub of the city, yet close to everything we wanted.   Chris and his cohosts were excellent, answering all my questions for a first time AirBnB guest, and making sure we had all that we needed. I recommend this place to anyone.

A very quiet place for all those who want to rest quietly without being disturbed, good value for money and especially James is very quick when it comes to solving a problem.
I recommend to everyone.
Henri Cheko

The apartment is situated in a area of town where we did not feel safe. We have 2 young boys and felt very unsafe. We got there around 7pm and didn't feel safe to leave the car, so I went in to check the apartment. We booked 10 nights but slept one night as it was to late to get another place. We left the next morning at 7am. The paid parking (R185 p/day) is in the building next door, where you park you car to get to the apartment, you need to take a lift then walk around the back of the building, on a narrow steel platform with big open rails making it very unsafe. The additional cost of the parking was only communicated with the check in instructions.

Paid parking was good but it would be better to know when you book how much exactly per night you have to pay for the parking.
Tea and coffee won't be a bad idea, otherwise the place was good and clean.

Thank you to Believe & staff for the their kind hospitality and friendliness. The apartment is perfect for city centre of Cape Town and right next door to the vibrant Green Market Square.
Absolutely loved our stay.
Clean and well equipped for a one night stay, however I didn’t like thst the room was 3 steps away from the reception desk making it super noisy and less privacy
I had a great stay! The place is beautiful, and the location is nearby a lot of amazing restaurants and other amenities. Great host, very communicative and friendly. Would love to come back :)

Had a wonderful stay
The place was clean, safe, comfortable and exactly as described. Everything was well organised and host too was friendly.
I would highly recommend it and my partner and I will definitely come back ✨
Urban chic apartment in the heart of CT. Clean comfy & convenient location. Dylan was a welcoming host & easy communication.  Highly recommended.
Tina was super helpful. Lovely place, as is in the photos. Thanks so much for having us! Would highly recommend

We had a brilliant stay at Tinas apartment, it was perfect for our needs. Spacious, spotlessly clean and really nicely decorated. It's also within a short walk to many restaurants, cafes and shops.
Tina was great at coming back to us to :)
Great little apartment in Sea Point, walking distance to the main road, with a helpful and responsive host. Would gladly recommend and would stay again. Thank you!

We absolutely loved the pristine Airbnb set in the heart of Seapoint . The Appartment was neat and pristine with modern finishes and beautifully decorated .
We had amazing views of the mountain and the sea which added to the beauty.
The linen was the best and the bed was comfortable .
Tina was so helpful and kept in contact throughout our stay .
We highly recommend this Appartment if you need a special place to stay in the heart of Cape Town .

I stayed at Tina’s place over the weekend and it was a lovely stay . The apartment had all the necessary appliances as listed and more ! . We really enjoyed our stay and did not wish to leave . Tina was very helpful and responsive when we needed any information
Really nice apartment, beautiful views, and you don’t often get such a quiet place to stay in this area. 10/10
Amazing flat, perfect for the beach and the ready of Capetown - lovely owner and hosts - would love to come back

Wonderful host and owner! So responsive and welcoming. Provided great local recommendations.
The flat is spacious and beautifully decorated. It has every appliance you could dream of - great for those who love to cook.

The location is central and the views are lovely; plus, there's a restaurant downstairs and the host was responsive (1–2 hours reply time). However, we encountered several issues. The balcony door was unlocked upon arrival, which felt unsafe, and we found roaches—extremely unpleasant. Despite the host knowing four guests were staying, only two towels and no washcloths were provided, and we received only two rolls of tissue (one half-used). Our requests for early check-in and late check-out were declined unless we paid for an extra day. Because the unit is privately owned, we couldn’t store our luggage with the hotel, an inconvenience for early/late flights; partnering with the hotel to offer this service would be helpful. Additionally, the Wi-Fi stopped working after a few days, and the balcony isn’t private, as the neighboring unit has a clear view. If you need flexibility, you may want to look elsewhere.

An amazing place!!
It was easy to check in and had secure indoor parking.
Had a relaxing stay as it's quiet and beautiful views.
We had a nice braai on the balcony.
Apartment was clean and had all the amenities we needed.
Will definitely come back!

Stefan was a really good host, very quick to respond when I needed assistance. Great communication.
The flat was spotless and has the most stunning view of Cape Town and the harbour in the distance. Stunning for sundowners and a braai(gas braai) on the balcony.
The location is central and within walking distance to shops, clubs, restaurants and Ofcourse, Cape Town Stadium where myself and friends went to watch the Stormers vs Lions game live.
I highly recommend this place and I’m looking forward to spend more time there, especially during the holidays.
Thank you Stefan for being a great host.

I really enjoyed my stay. Stefan was such a great host, he was very responsive. The place was very clean and was close to a lot of great restaurants. Check in was easy as the security was extremely helpful.
Would definitely stay here on my next trip!!!

We booked the apartment on short notice and were very happy with our stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed, well equipped. Stefan was quick to respond to any questions and made the whole process easy. We’d gladly stay here again! The bedroom window faces the stairwell, but no need to worry, it was very quiet.

Stefan's place was very nice. The back deck was quite lovely and spacious although chilly so I couldn't quite enjoy as much as I wanted. The kitchen was pristine and had good, durable cookware. The place was comfortable and organized with a great, high quality shower. Bedding was especially comfortable and very clean. I appreciated that Stefan provided a portable heater and TV entertainment like Netflix. Stefan is very professional host who takes care of his guests and responds to messages very fast. We made special requests that Stefan accommodated with wonderful ease and understanding. I would definitely make a return trip without hesitation. One of the best AirBnB hosts.

Great place! Clean, modern, comfortable and nicely decorated. Eloise was friendly and helpful. Easy check in. Safe affordable parking in building, very convenient.
Exactly like photos!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
My stay at this place was simply perfect! The apartment was spotlessly clean, stylishly designed, and just a five-minute walk from the water – an unbeatable location.
A true highlight was Bonny, who took care of everything on-site. She is by far one of the warmest and most welcoming people I have ever met. Her kindness and positive energy are contagious, and she was always there to help with anything I needed. Thanks to her, I felt at home from the very first moment.
The combination of her exceptional hospitality and the breathtaking view of Table Mountain from the nearby beach made this stay unforgettable. I will definitely be coming back – highly recommended!
Good reception,great flatlet but noisy allround,noisy entrance and exit of location at all hours

Janinas place was the perfect home base for my mothers birthday.
While being conveniently located in the middle of city centre - central to everything we had planned to do - The apartment itself is a beautifully styled oasis that felt like home.
I couldn’t recommend this apartment enough!
What a great and peaceful place to stay! The whole experience is perfect for any first-time AirBnB users.

The accommodation is as described, offers a lot of space and gives the feeling of home for the duration of your stay. It’s a very stylish and lovely apartment with everything you need for a great time in Cape Town.

Have stayed in this building before and really like the security as only key holders can enter the building. The space is very tastefully and thoughtfully designed.  Loved the washer dryer - very convenient. Comfortable and peaceful and close to lots of restaurants.  Ubers were always quickly available. Very responsive and friendly hosts. Overall had an awesome stay. Thanks - will book again.

This is a great, clean and comfortable spot. The promenade just a walk away with lots of restaurant  and coffee shop options around and within walking distance. Great WiFi and working space allowed me to connect when I needed to so if you looking for an amazing getaway but can still work remotely I would recommend this place. The host was very proactive and responsive which always helps when checking in or out.

Great little flat that has everything you need for a comfortable stay, easy to walk around Sea Point and Green Point from here. It felt safe and quiet and comfortable. Humari was very helpful and communicative - I booked very last minute because of a change in my travel plans and was able to check in within an hour. Very happy stay
Wonderful oasis in a prime location! Would most definitely stay here again - has everything you need for a stay

My stay at the Old Cape Quarter Apartment was exceptional and fulfilling. Zuleika went above and beyond providing great hospitality. Upon arrival, we did a tour of the unit, and she took us to the nearby shops to get ourselves familiar with the area. Some groceries were in the fridge for us and of course we learned about the special tea at Cape Town. She was available to answer any questions and sent someone to help with the door lock situation. I forgot my shoes when I checked out and she informed me about it, and left it at the receptionist for me to get them before my flight. I recommend staying at this place if you will be around Cape Quarter. Thank you so much Zuleika, you were sweet, helpful, and a blessing to us. xoxo
Generally good, but one bad encounter me in the last night of our stay, which I will report to you under discretion
One of the best apartments you’d find in Cape Town. The host makes sure your stay is amazing and you feel at home immediately.

I was thoroughly impressed by the spotless condition of the apartment. The pictures provided a realistic representation of the space, and it’s conveniently located in a central part of town, close to excellent restaurants and bars. Highly recommended!

This place is tucked in the perfect spot. Restaurants, Theatre, Parliamemt is nearby and the beach/V&A waterfront is a few mins via Uber.
It's peaceful at night, the room is clean, clean amenities and it's secure.
Matthias is very kind and friendly. For the anxious birds, I do suggest you send a message early (when communicating) but he will always respond on time (hahaha). I just needed to re-book for my Dad and update him cause I made a last minute extention of his stay. But it all worked
My dad loved his stay and i loved the place for him, I'd recommend it to my friends and anyone looking for an affordable, compact, self-catering and secure place to stay !!!!!
After conducting research, I selected this place. I was highly impressed with its clean and comfortable rooms and additional facilities. I highly recommend it!

I had a pleasant stay at Mattias's place. Everything was exactly as described in the booking information: easy access and self-checking in, the room was neat and tidy as well as the spotless clean kitchen. I could walk to nearby places for food and had peace of mind while staying over with a lovely view.
The room was clean and tidy. Unfortunately our sleep was very disrupted by outside noise and then other inconsiderate guests that showed no regard for the establishments noise policy.
It's a beautiful place, exactly as advertised. What stood out for me was definitely the view, it overlooks Table Mountain. Would definitely come back.
Great location! The apartment was on ground floor with easy access to the parking lot and main entrance. Definitely worth a visit!!!

The apartment was as listed with incredible views of table mountain located in bo kaap. Maintenance staff were lovely and the place was spotless. I was disappointed by the poor communication from the property company when the water stopped working for two days. They should work on their approach to handling issues like this with proactive communication and clarity.

The property is beautiful and the views make you want to stay there all day.
The kitchen is well equipped and the bed is comfortable
The staff are friendly and very helpful, especially the security who show us where to park and how to access the apartment

Place was nice and clean. A bit smaller than expected. The place had a smell from little to no ventilation but it was dealt with by just opening the balcony sliding doors. Responsive and clear communication at all times. Very quiet area and it was quite easy to get to and from.

Beautiful place, with wonderful views - simply breathtaking. Very quiet neighbourhood but close to all of Hout Bay's delights. The room is very cold in winter, even with a small oil heater and there is no microwave - small inconveniences but definitely don't detract from the beauty of the place. I did notice a few times that the front door was unlocked - so just a note to be cautious.

Hi Julian
You have contributed so much to make our children honeymoon in Cape Town enjoyable. We sincerely appreciate it and look forward to visiting again soon.

We enjoyed our stay at this lovely apartment and Lance was especially great to make our stay very smooth by providing all needed information.  On my next trip to Cape Town,  I will definitely look to see if this apartment is available then. Thank you Lance

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The space was very clean and smelled fresh like we were the first to stay there. Host was very quick to respond to enquiries. Honestly wish we could've stayed longer.
We booked in last minute because we were late and everything was perfect! Easy check in. Everything clean. And really nice place to stay, with security and only 2 streets to the beach.
What an amazing experience, by far the best stay we have had in any Airbnb and very kind and friendly host that goes above and beyond to make your stay enjoy.

Dave was an amazing host, very friendly and readily available for anything we needed. The place was very neat and had everything in that you can think of at home, basically home from home would 100% recommend it.
And the views are amazing from the kitchen, living room and both bedrooms and super safe.
Would love to stay here again. Incredible views. Super clean, exceptional airbnb. Host company knows how to make guests feel comfortable and well accommodated. 10/10 experience

Ben and his team were very good hosts. They received us as we arrived and gave us a full tour of the place to ensure check in was smooth. They were also so kind to prepare dinner for us on our final night. Would 100% stay with them again.
The most beautiful Airbnb we have stayed in this far. The location in Bo-Kaap is really great with amazing views of table mountain. Highly recommended!

We had a great stay surrounded by beautiful scenery. Definitely worth the visit and we would definitely visit again
Soon

We had an amazing stay at this beautiful apartment in Cape Town! Everything was perfect, the space was spotless, stylishly decorated, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
The location was fantastic, close to great restaurants, shops, and sights. John the manager, was incredibly welcoming and responsive, making check-in and our entire stay super easy.
We truly loved everything about it and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

We really enjoy our stay in Capetown! Candice was so nice and really made us feel at home at her place :))
Looking forward to come back already!

This was a perfect base for my wide, one of our sons and me to use for a couple of nights. Very easy to get to the V&A and also easy to make the most of Sea Point and Camps Bay. The very short walk to the beach and promenade were also great for a lovely and sunny Sunday morning walk. I would definitely recommend staying here!

I love this place! What an amazing getaway in the middle of Cape Town. Perfect location close to great little restaurants and bars. The complex is quiet and serene and totally safe and secure. The views of the city at night were insane. I had such an amazing stay, I will definitely be back!
This unit was perfectly positioned for our needs. Close to the V&A Waterfront & top eateries PLUS breathtaking mountain views

Such a wonderful stay! Clean, spacious with great interiors. Great for lock up and go and close to so many fantastic restaurants. Jonathan was super responsive and ensured  a smooth arrival and departure. We suggested a few things and he was super supportive and understanding. Love to hear he wants to make this spot as comfortable for his guests as he can. Would definitely book again 🤗
I would book this airbnb again. Beautiful space, walkable neighbourhood, and short drive to top beaches and hikes.

I had an absolute blast staying here! The experience made me fall in love with the vibrant energy of the city, while the peacefulness of the neighborhood offered the perfect balance. This space is a hidden gem, beautiful, comfortable, and affordable. I highly recommend it to anyone passing through the city looking for a great place to stay. Wishing Jonathan all the best, may his future guests enjoy the same warmth and charm that I experienced during my stay!

Great location. The view was phenomenal. 5 min drive to the Lions Head trail and no more than 10min to the Table mountain lift and 15min to the V&A Waterfront (through Sea Point). The Nespresso pods were very much appreciated.
All in all, a great experience.
Do keep in mind you are working with a R.M. company not the owner so the feel is slightly different than with a usual AirBnb (more like a hotel).
Arrival instructions were extremely clear and it explains everything about the apartment.
Definitely recommended.
I can't imagine how epic this place would be in the summer.
Great view. Well equipped. Check in check out process very easy. Good restaurants nearby. Would definitely recommend
We really enjoyed our stay here. Thoughtful design and amazing interior. Great location. We have had a wonderful holiday escape here. Thank you!

We had a wonderful three days in Cape Town staying a Chris ‘s apartment. The apartment was in a great location and had beautiful views . Chris was very helpful and the apartment had everything we needed. The Gentleman on reception was very welcoming and friendly. I would definitely stay there again .

It was absolutely amazing
everything was so clean, the kitchen was fully equipped, the balcony was super relaxing, and the bedroom was really comfortable!
I’ll definitely stay here again next time I come to Cape Town!!
Thank you CJ!

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment! While it doesn’t have an ocean view, the location right by the water is unbeatable—you can hear the waves and feel the sea breeze as soon as you step outside. The real highlight was the pool and jacuzzi—perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. The apartment itself was clean, well-equipped, and very comfortable. The host was responsive and made check-in super easy. I’d absolutely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful coastal escape!

The place was fantastic close to the shopping mall we never lacked anything and the neighbours are very friendly and and everything we paid for was there nice patio area Im looking forward to come back again

Whats not good: The place is smaller than it looks on the pictures. I am 1.9m tall and couldn't sleep on the double bed, as it’s too short. I used one of the single beds instead. The blanket there was super narrow, I didn't even know they made such size. Traffic noise was well heard in the apartment.
What's good: The apartment is very clean, location was safe, close to beach and a shopping center. I liked mountain view from the lounge.

Worth every penny! From amazing communication and proactive care of us as guests to the picture perfect views and comfortable bed, I will 100% stay here again. The apartment is cozy and intimate, just perfect for 1 or 2 people for short stays. The building is extra secure and conveniently located.
Perfect unit! Clean, safe and definitely worth booking. Bespoke was always just a message away. Highly recommend!

Was here for 11 days and didn’t want to leave the day of checkout
Was an amazing place with even a better view
Would highly recommend it for people visiting Cape Town

This place is stunning! Very open, bright and Sunny.
Super calm and safe area for good night rests.
Private parking in front of the door.
Communication woth Don and Jaco is always fast and smooth.
100% recommended

This must be one of the best places I've stayed in - also the cleanest! The apartment sits in a great location, with Canal Walk Mall just a short walk away.
