I loved the gym and the large swimming pool. I also appreciated the thoughtful touches, like the milk, water, and Coke in the fridge. Everything about this place was great, and I will definitely stay there again. Highly recommended!
I booked this apartment for a newly wed couple. They thoroughly enjoyed their stay, and appreciated the location. Thank you Bridget.
The place was great and felt like home. Bridgete is a great host👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽

We had an incredible stay at Manon’s apartment in Cape Town! The place was spotless, stylish, and perfectly located for exploring the city. Manon was an exceptional host—warm, responsive, and went above and beyond to ensure we felt at home. From local tips to quick communication, she made our trip truly special. Highly recommend staying here!

We’ve rented Airbnbs around the world, but nothing compares to our magical stay at Tarentaalkloof. The location is unbeatable—breathtaking views of Table Mountain and Lion’s Head from every room, and walking distance to vibrant Kloof Street if you don’t mind a bit of a climb. The house is perfect for entertaining, with a fully equipped kitchen, two barbecues, and indoor/outdoor dining areas. We hiked both mountains straight from the house. It’s incredibly spacious—my husband and I had the entire third floor while our kids enjoyed their own space. The jacuzzi was perfect in winter, and we can’t wait to return in summer for the pool. Louzanne, the property manager, was wonderful—always available and helpful. Honestly, the house was so spectacular we barely wanted to leave. Even our local friends said it’s the most beautiful home they’ve seen.

My trip was for work and leisure. The apartment had ample space. A dedicated work station, which was away from the rest of the home, allowed the kids to enjoy the space without any disturbance.
The home was clean, and had everything needed.
A walking distance from grocery stores and the promenade.
The home looks as beautiful and meticulous as the pictures, thank you for being great hosts! I look forward to booking with you again.

Even much better than pictures, fabulous view and sea sounds , we enjoyed the stay too much. Clean and well equipped apartment. Friendly in communication and very clear instructions, very cooperative and easy check in and out. Definitely we will come back 👍🏻

Bertus’s a great host easy to communicate with, flexible check-in rules,
The apartment was really clean and as described with amazing ocean view, we felt right at home the moment we entered through the door, bonus point high security system
I really recommend this accommodation 🙏🏼

I have done 100+ airbnb stays and I thoroughly enjoyed this stay.
So relaxing on the balcony and very nice apartment.
Better if you have a car but not mandatory.

The location for this house was simply fantastic. The views and the neighborhood and access to downtown Cape Town was quite fast..
I would recommend checking it out. It has a wonderful backyard area to cook and is quite peaceful and seems to get less of the evening wind then on the other side of Lionshead.
It also comes with great hosts .

Absolutely loved our stay at Johan and Janine's beautiful family home! The space was perfectly suited for our group of 7, with plenty of room to spread out and relax. The home was immaculately clean, well-appointed, and full of thoughtful touches that made us feel right at home.
The location was fantastic, and Johan and Janine were super responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We had a wonderful 3 nights here and would highly recommend this property to anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming space for their family or group. Thanks again, Johan and Janine - we'll be back!

A stunning apartment with an amazing rooftop area.
This place is centrally-located, has all the essentials, and is absolutely immaculate.
Contemporary decor, secure (staffed 24/7) reception, and a fantastic pool & summer kitchen on the rooftop made this a great choice for a few days in Cape Town.

We had an amazing Holiday!
Great Location, high end designer interiors, responsive host.
Love the “secret” pathway to the “three wise monkeys” and the rooftop pool.
Will definitely come back!

The apartment is brand new, everything is clean and stylish. The surrounding is super private and feels very safe, the sea view from the terrace is beautiful! We really liked the whole place! The only negativ point is, however, that the bed under the roof without air conditioning can be a bit challenging on hot days.

This Camps Bay Studio is perfectly located near outdoor adventures, restaurants, shops and supreme relaxation!!! The hosts are superb… the unit is cozy yet contemporary… and the neighborhood is peaceful. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay in the space and I would stay here again. Thanks Janine & Rachel!
Super clean and great location, well connected to CT downtown and the southern party. Perfect if you are looking for a location which is central but away from the city noise. Super friendly hosts.
Beautiful space. Everything you need, modern, clean and peaceful. Located inside a lovely estate which has walkways by the water and lovely birdlife. Exceptional stay, highly recommended. 🌟
